papers.title: DiffusionBench: On Holistic Evaluation of Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformer (DiT) research on image generation has converged to a single evaluation setup: class-conditional generation on ImageNet. While methods improve the FID and related metrics, it is increasingly unclear whether they reflect real progress in generative modeling. The natural alternative, i.e., text-to-image (T2I) generation, is perceived as too costly or inconvenient to train and evaluate and is often skipped. We argue that this perception no longer holds. We introduce NanoGen, a unified DiT training and evaluation framework. NanoGen matches state-of-the-art DiT baselines on ImageNet and, with 12 lines of configuration change, also trains competitive text-to-image models. It currently supports RAE, VAE, pixel-space, and MeanFlow diffusion methods under both ImageNet and T2I setups. Under NanoGen, training T2I requires comparable compute to ImageNet. After training 21 latent diffusion models with NanoGen, we observe that method ranking shows no strong correlation between ImageNet and T2I generation: Pearson correlation is between -0.377 and -0.580 across three metrics. This suggests that a method which improves class-conditional ImageNet FID may show no corresponding improvement on T2I, clearly indicating the necessity of evaluating DiTs on both tasks. To this end, we summarize ImageNet and text-to-image results, which yields DiffusionBench, a holistic benchmark for DiT research. We recommend reporting DiffusionBench in place of ImageNet alone: methods that improve DiffusionBench are more likely to reflect broader progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的扩散变换器（DiT）训练与评估框架 NanoGen，支持 ImageNet 类别条件生成和文本到图像生成两种任务。基于 21 个潜在扩散模型的实验发现，方法在 ImageNet 和文本到图像任务上的排名相关性很弱（Pearson 相关系数在 -0.377 到 -0.580 之间），因此建议使用包含两项任务的 DiffusionBench 基准替代仅 ImageNet 的评估。
Motivation: 当前扩散变换器（DiT）研究仅使用 ImageNet 类别条件生成的单一评估设置，方法在 FID 等指标上的提升是否反映真实进展不明确，而文本到图像生成因被认为训练和评估成本高而被回避。
Method: 提出 NanoGen 框架，统一 DiT 训练和评估，支持 RAE、VAE、像素空间和 MeanFlow 扩散方法，在 ImageNet 和文本到图像设置下均能训练；仅需修改 12 行配置即可切换任务。
Result: 训练 21 个潜在扩散模型后，发现 ImageNet 和文本到图像任务的方法排名无强相关性（Pearson 相关系数 -0.377 至 -0.580），表明 ImageNet 上的改进不一定会迁移到文本到图像任务，从而推出 DiffusionBench 基准。
Conclusion: 建议在 DiT 研究中报告 DiffusionBench（结合 ImageNet 和文本到图像结果）而非仅 ImageNet，因为通过 DiffusionBench 验证的方法更可能反映广泛进展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InSight: Self-Guided Skill Acquisition via Steerable VLAs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can learn manipulation skills from demonstrations, but their capabilities are bounded by the skills in the training data. We present InSight, a framework that unlocks autonomous skill acquisition by rendering VLAs steerable at the primitive-action level (e.g., "move gripper to the bowl", "lift upward", "pour the bottle"). InSight consists of two primary stages: (1) an automated segmentation pipeline that partitions demonstrations into labeled primitives via VLM plan decomposition and end-effector poses to enable VLA primitive steerability, and (2) a VLM-guided data flywheel that identifies missing primitives required to accomplish a novel task, autonomously attempts demonstrations of the missing primitives with VLM-proposed low-level control, and automatically labels, stores, and integrates successful demonstrations into the VLA training set. We evaluate InSight across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, including block flipping, drawer closing, sweeping, twisting, and pouring, without any human demonstrations of these target skills. Once learned, these primitives can be composed to execute novel, long-horizon tasks without additional human demonstrations. Our findings demonstrate that primitive steerability provides a practical foundation for continual skill acquisition in VLA policies. Project website: https://insight-vla.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InSight 框架，通过使视觉-语言-动作模型在原始动作层面（如“移动夹爪到碗”、“向上抬起”）可操控，实现自主技能获取。框架包括自动分割流水线和 VLM 引导的数据飞轮，无需人工演示目标技能即可学习新技能，并组合执行长程任务。实验在模拟和真实世界操作任务中验证。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型能力受限于训练数据中的技能范围，无法自主获取新技能。
Method: InSight 包含两个阶段：1) 自动分割流水线，利用 VLM 计划分解和末端执行器位姿将演示分割为带标签的原始动作，使 VLA 具备原始动作可操控性；2) VLM 引导的数据飞轮，识别缺失原始动作，自主尝试演示并通过 VLM 提出的低级控制实现，成功后自动标注并集成到 VLA 训练集。
Result: 在模拟和真实世界的块翻转、抽屉关闭、清扫、扭转、倾倒等任务中，无需任何人工演示即学会目标技能，并可组合执行新长程任务。
Conclusion: 原始动作可操控性为 VLA 策略的持续技能获取提供了实用基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BenchX: Benchmarking AI Models for Cancer Detection and Localization with Demographic and Protocol Biases
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) has achieved remarkable success in medical imaging, but it is widely recognized that these models often perform inconsistently across real-world clinical settings. Such inconsistencies occur when patient demographics and imaging protocols vary, for example, in detecting small tumors, analyzing scans from different contrast phases, or evaluating patients of different ages or sexes. To quantify these inconsistencies, we develop a large-scale, open benchmark of 85,355 CT scans that systematically evaluates 12 tumor-detection AI models across tumor size, location, patient subgroup, and imaging protocol. We leverage large language models (LLMs) to extract and organize subgroup information from clinical data, which makes the analysis both scalable and reproducible. Our benchmark reveals that current state-of-the-art AI models, optimized for average accuracy, perform poorly in rare or underrepresented subgroups, such as young, female African Americans. However, collecting sufficient annotated data for these rare cases is often impractical. The benchmark provides a foundation for building more reliable and robust AI models for tumor detection and highlighting the need for rigorous, subgroup-level evaluation in medical imaging and computer vision. Datasets, code
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个包含85,355次CT扫描的大规模开放基准BenchX，系统评估了12个肿瘤检测AI模型在肿瘤大小、位置、患者亚组和成像协议上的表现。利用大语言模型（LLMs）从临床数据中提取亚组信息，揭示了当前最优模型在罕见或代表性不足的亚组（如年轻女性非裔美国人）中表现较差，而收集足够标注数据又往往不可行。
Motivation: 现有AI模型在临床实践中常因患者人口统计特征和成像协议变化而表现不一致，缺乏对亚组级性能的量化评估。
Method: 构建大规模CT扫描基准，包含85,355次扫描，使用LLMs从临床数据中提取亚组信息，评估12个肿瘤检测模型在不同肿瘤大小、位置、患者亚组和成像协议上的性能。
Result: 当前最优AI模型在平均准确率上表现优异，但在罕见亚组（如年轻女性非裔美国人）上性能较差。
Conclusion: 该基准为构建更可靠、鲁棒的肿瘤检测模型提供了基础，强调在医学影像中需要进行严格的亚组级评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: New Bounds for the Last Iterate of the Stochastic subGradient Method
papers.abstract_en: We study the last iterate of the stochastic subgradient method for one-dimensional convex Lipschitz objectives. For a fixed horizon $n$, we consider the standard fixed stepsizes $η=Θ(1/\sqrt n)$. We prove that, for such stepsize policies, under additive i.i.d. subgradient noise with uniformly bounded variance, the last iterate features an optimization error of order $1/\sqrt n$, thereby removing the extra $(\log n)$ factor present in existing generic bounds. On the other hand, we show that without the i.i.d. assumption, the optimization error can be of order $(\log n)/\sqrt n$. Thus, under the uniformly bounded variance assumption alone, the last iterate of SsGM is suboptimal even in dimension one, resolving negatively an open problem posed in Koren and Segal, COLT, 2020.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一维凸Lipschitz目标下随机次梯度方法的最后迭代误差。对于固定步长η=Θ(1/√n)，在i.i.d.次梯度噪声下误差为O(1/√n)，去除现有界中的log因子；在非i.i.d.有界方差噪声下误差为Ω((log n)/√n)，表明均匀有界方差假设下最后迭代是次优的，否定了Koren和Segal的开放问题。
Motivation: 现有随机次梯度方法最后迭代的误差界包含额外log因子且紧性未知。本文旨在精确刻画i.i.d.与非i.i.d.噪声下的紧界，并解决一个开放问题。
Method: 使用一维凸Lipschitz目标函数和标准固定步长η=Θ(1/√n)，对加性i.i.d.次梯度噪声与一般有界方差噪声分别分析。
Result: 在i.i.d.噪声下，最后迭代优化误差为O(1/√n)，去除了对数因子；在非i.i.d.有界方差噪声下，误差为Ω((log n)/√n)，因此均匀有界方差假设下最后迭代是次优的。
Conclusion: 本文证明在均匀有界方差假设下，即使在一维情况，随机次梯度方法的最后迭代也是次优的，否定了Koren和Segal的猜想。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FLAT: Feedforward Latent Triangle Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating explorable 3D scenes from a single image requires strong generative priors and accurate geometric representations suitable for downstream use. Current video diffusion models offer high-quality generation and implicitly encode multi-view geometric structure in latent space. However, existing feedforward latent scene decoders typically output volumetric 3D Gaussians that lack a well-defined surface, limiting their use in simulation or standard graphics pipelines. This motivates decoding surface-aligned primitives that are not only renderable but also closer to explicit geometric assets. We ask whether compressed video diffusion latents can be mapped directly to explicit surface primitives in a single pass. To this end, we introduce FLAT and, for the first time, show that triangle splats can be decoded directly from video diffusion latents. Compared with decoding 3D Gaussians, predicting flat primitives is notoriously more challenging due to high sensitivity to primitive orientations, oftentimes leading to poor gradient flow. FLAT solves with two key ingredients: a ray-centered rotation parameterization for triangle regression and a novel product window function that improves gradient flow during differentiable triangle rendering. On standard benchmarks, FLAT achieves significantly better geometric accuracy while maintaining competitive visual quality compared to state-of-the-art feedforward baselines. We further show that a lightweight test-time refinement step converts the predicted triangle soup into a fully opaque, game-engine-ready representation that supports real-time rendering. By evaluating 3DGS, 2DGS, and triangle splatting variants under an identical training setup, we provide the first systematic analysis of representation tradeoffs in feedforward scene generation. The project page is available at https://flat-splat.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FLAT，首次从视频扩散潜变量中直接解码三角形面片（triangle splats），用于单图生成可探索的3D场景。通过光线中心旋转参数化和乘积窗函数改进梯度流，FLAT在保持视觉质量的同时显著提升了几何精度，并可通过轻量级测试时优化转换为游戏引擎可用的表示。
Motivation: 现有前馈潜场景解码器通常输出体素化的3D高斯，缺乏明确定义的表面，限制了在模拟或标准图形管线中的使用。需要能够解码表面对齐的图元，使其更接近显式几何资产。
Method: 提出一种前馈方法，从视频扩散潜变量直接解码三角形面片。关键包括：光线中心旋转参数化用于三角形回归，以及新型乘积窗函数改进可微三角形渲染中的梯度流。
Result: 在标准基准上，FLAT相比最先进的前馈基线方法取得了显著更好的几何精度，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。通过测试时细化，可将三角形网格转换为支持实时渲染的游戏引擎就绪表示。
Conclusion: FLAT首次证明了从视频扩散潜变量直接解码三角形面片的可行性，并通过系统分析了3D高斯、2D高斯和三角形面片在前馈场景生成中的表示权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FLUX3D: High-Fidelity 3D Gaussian Generation with Diffusion-Aligned Sparse Representation
papers.abstract_en: Sparse voxel representation has emerged as a scalable foundation for image-to-3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) generation, yet current methods struggle to preserve high-frequency visual details of input images due to two structural bottlenecks. First, they adopt discriminative 2D features optimized for semantic abstraction to construct sparse voxel latents, which suppress reconstructive cues and induce a representation bottleneck. Second, in the generation stage, standard diffusion transformers lack effective mechanisms to align dense 2D image tokens with sparse 3D voxel latents, resulting in a cross-modal correspondence bottleneck. To address these issues, we propose FLUX3D, a scalable image-to-3DGS framework that boosts both representation learning and cross-modal alignment during generation. We first revisit 2D feature selection for sparse-voxel-based 3D representation learning, propose Diffusion-Aligned Structured Latents (DA-SLAT) and couple it with a decoder-only architecture to improve 3DGS reconstruction fidelity. We also design a sparse-structure-aware diffusion framework, which integrates the Sparse-structure Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (SMDiT) and Modal-Aware Rotary Positional Embedding (MARoPE) to achieve geometry-agnostic 2D-3D alignment. Extensive benchmark experiments demonstrate that FLUX3D yields substantial improvements in appearance fidelity and significantly outperforms all state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in generating high-quality 3DGS assets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FLUX3D，一个可扩展的图像到3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）生成框架，针对现有方法中高频细节丢失和跨模态对齐问题，通过扩散对齐稀疏表示进行改进。核心包括Diffusion-Aligned Structured Latents (DA-SLAT) 和稀疏结构感知扩散框架（SMDiT、MARoPE），在基准测试中显著优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有基于稀疏体素的图像到3DGS生成方法存在两个瓶颈：使用判别性2D特征导致表示瓶颈，以及生成阶段标准扩散变换器无法有效对齐密集2D图像token和稀疏3D体素潜在表示，造成跨模态对应瓶颈。
Method: 提出FLUX3D框架：重新设计2D特征选择，提出Diffusion-Aligned Structured Latents (DA-SLAT)并采用解码器-only架构提升重建保真度；设计稀疏结构感知扩散框架，集成Sparse-structure Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (SMDiT)和Modal-Aware Rotary Positional Embedding (MARoPE)实现几何无关的2D-3D对齐。
Result: 大量基准实验表明FLUX3D在外观保真度上取得显著提升，生成高质量3DGS资产方面优于所有现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 论文通过解决表示瓶颈和跨模态对齐瓶颈，实现了高保真图像到3DGS生成，但未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出FLUX3D，一个可扩展的图像到3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）生成框架，针对现有方法中高频细节丢失和跨模态对齐问题，通过扩散对齐稀疏表示进行改进。核心包括Diffusion-Aligned Structured Latents (DA-SLAT) 和稀疏结构感知扩散框架（SMDiT、MARoPE），在基准测试中显著优于现有最先进方法。

papers.title: OpenThoughts-Agent: Data Recipes for Agentic Models
papers.abstract_en: Agentic language models dramatically expand the applications of AI yet little is publicly known about how to curate training data for broadly capable agents. Existing open efforts such as SWE-Smith, SERA, and Nemotron-Terminal typically target a single benchmark, leaving open the question of how to train models that generalize across diverse agentic tasks. The OpenThoughts-Agent (OT-Agent) project addresses this gap with a fully open data curation pipeline for training agentic models. We conduct more than 100 controlled ablation experiments to systematically investigate each stage of the pipeline, yielding insights on the importance of task sources and diversity. We then assemble a training set of 100K examples from our pipeline and fine-tune Qwen3-32B on this dataset, which yields an average accuracy of 44.8% across seven agentic benchmarks and a 3.9 percentage point improvement over the strongest existing open data agentic model (Nemotron-Terminal-32B, 40.9%). Moreover, our training data exhibits strong scaling properties, outperforming alternative open datasets at every training set size in compute-controlled comparisons. We publicly release our training sets, data pipeline, experimental data, and models at openthoughts.ai to support future open research on agentic model training.

papers.title: It's Complicated: On the Design and Evaluation of AI-Powered AAC Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) can enhance what people who use augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) are able to do with their systems. However, evaluating AI-powered AAC interfaces can be difficult. People are intersectional beings and current evaluation metrics can struggle to capture the multifaceted and nuanced desires people may have for their AAC. We explore the complicated nature of six AAC problem spaces, explore how AI might be used in these spaces, and suggest more robust methods of evaluation that take the intersectional nuances of people into account. We also discuss broader issues that arise across these problem spaces and how they could be addressed using our proposed evaluation methods.

TL;DR: 本文探讨了AI增强的AAC（增强与替代沟通）界面评估的复杂性，分析了六个AAC问题空间，并提出更鲁棒的评估方法，考虑用户的交叉性细微差别。
Motivation: 现有评估指标难以捕捉AAC用户的多方面和细微需求，需要更完善的评估方法。

papers.title: Real vs. Complex Spectral Bases for Neural Operators: The Role of Green's Function Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) learn solution operators of partial differential equations by parameterizing global convolutions in the complex Fourier domain. For real-valued PDE solutions, the complex FFT carries representational redundancy through conjugate symmetry. We introduce the Hartley Neural Operator (HNO), the exact real-valued mirror of FNO: it replaces the FFT with the purely real Discrete Hartley Transform and learns a single real multiplier per retained spectral mode, with no complex arithmetic. Because the real Hartley spectrum is not halved by conjugate symmetry, HNO retains twice as many frequency corners as FNO but one real weight where FNO carries a complex pair, so the two operators are iso-parametric at equal width and differ only in spectral basis. Our central thesis is that the best basis is a property of the operator. Self-adjoint elliptic operators (Poisson, biharmonic) have real, symmetric Green's functions that the real Hartley multiplier diagonalizes exactly, and HNO is favored there. Time-dependent operators carry phase, from oscillation in the wave equation to transport in advection, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, which a real diagonal multiplier cannot represent, so FNO is favored there, and increasingly so with the operator's phase content, leaving the phaseless heat equation as the borderline case. Training both operators identically and benchmarking across PDE classes, initial-condition families, and boundary conditions, we find an elliptic-versus-time-dependent split that is monotone in operator phase content and matches the Green's-function theory we develop. Rather than a universal winner, our findings give a predictive rule: match the spectral basis to the symmetry of the solution operator.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了傅里叶神经算子（FNO）与哈特利神经算子（HNO）在求解偏微分方程时的表现。HNO是FNO的纯实值对应物，使用离散哈特利变换代替傅里叶变换，参数数量相同但谱基不同。理论分析和实验表明，对于自伴椭圆算子（如泊松方程），HNO更优；对于含相位的时间相关算子（如波动方程、对流方程），FNO更优。结论是谱基的选择应匹配解算子的对称性。
Motivation: FNO使用复数傅里叶变换处理实值PDE解存在冗余，且不同PDE算子可能更适合不同的谱基，需要理论指导来选择最优基。
Method: 引入HNO，用离散哈特利变换替换FFT，保持参数数量不变但使用实值谱。通过格林函数对称性分析，推导出椭圆算子与时间相关算子对谱基的偏好，并在多种PDE类、初始条件和边界条件下进行对比实验。
Result: 实验发现椭圆算子（泊松、双调和）上HNO优于FNO，而时间相关算子（波动、对流、Burgers、Navier-Stokes）上FNO优于HNO，且优势随算子相位含量单调增加。热方程作为无相位的时间相关算子是边界情况。
Conclusion: 没有通用的最优谱基，应匹配谱基与解算子的对称性：自伴椭圆算子选实值Hartley基，含相位时间相关算子选复值Fourier基。

papers.title: IV-CoT: Implicit Visual Chain-of-Thought for Structure-Aware Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Unified multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong text-to-image generation quality, but still struggle with structure-aware prompt following, where object counts, spatial relations, attribute bindings, and coarse layouts must be preserved. We attribute this limitation in part to the entanglement of structural planning and appearance rendering within a single conditioning stream. To address this issue, we propose Implicit Visual Chain-of-Thought (IV-CoT), a latent visual reasoning framework for query-conditioned image generation. IV-CoT decomposes the visual conditioning queries into a structural-to-semantic cascade, where structural queries first form a latent visual plan and semantic queries then render appearance conditioned on this plan. To guide the structural queries, we introduce training-only sketch supervision, which encourages them to capture structure from sketches without requiring sketch extraction or intermediate decoding at inference time. IV-CoT performs implicit CoT reasoning in a single forward pass and achieves superior results on GenEval and T2I-CompBench. Visualizations and analyses demonstrate that the learned structural and semantic queries play complementary roles in structure-aware generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出隐式视觉链式推理（IV-CoT），将文本到图像生成中的结构规划与外观渲染解耦。通过将视觉条件查询分解为结构查询和语义查询的级联，并在训练时引入草图监督引导结构查询，IV-CoT在单次前向传播中实现隐式推理。在GenEval和T2I-CompBench基准上取得更优结果，可视化显示结构和语义查询互补。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态大语言模型在文本到图像生成中难以保持物体计数、空间关系等结构信息，原因是结构规划与外观渲染纠缠在单一条件流中。
Method: 提出隐式视觉链式推理（IV-CoT），将视觉条件查询分解为结构查询和语义查询的级联：结构查询先形成潜在视觉计划，语义查询再根据该计划渲染外观；训练时仅使用草图监督指导结构查询，推理时无需草图提取或中间解码。
Result: 在GenEval和T2I-CompBench基准上取得更优结果，可视化显示结构和语义查询在结构感知生成中起互补作用。
Conclusion: 通过解耦结构规划和外观渲染，IV-CoT能够以单次前向传播实现隐式链式推理，显著提升结构感知文本到图像生成的质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spherical-to-ERP Epipolar Rectification for Single-Axis Disparity in 360 Stereo
papers.abstract_en: Omnidirectional stereo images provide full-surround perception but violate the geometric assumptions of classical disparity estimation: in spherical or fisheye views, epipolar correspondences follow curved great-circle paths, producing two-dimensional displacements that cannot be treated as single-axis disparity before geometric rectification. In this work, we adopt a standard spherical-to-equirectangular (ERP) projection as a preprocessing step, which straightens epipolar curves and restores a one-dimensional disparity structure - horizontal for left-right rigs and vertical for top-bottom rigs. Building on our previously introduced RAFT + Epipolar-Aligned Channel Selection (EACS) framework, originally developed for rectilinear and ERP stereo, we examine whether the same modular pipeline remains accurate when the input originates from spherical stereo imagery. After ERP projection, dense optical flow from RAFT is reduced to disparity by retaining only the baseline-aligned flow component. Experiments on synthetic fisheye stereo datasets show that this spherical-to-ERP-to-RAFT+EACS pipeline produces accurate, smooth, and structurally consistent disparity maps at real-time speed. These findings confirm that established ERP preprocessing can be effectively combined with our earlier RAFT+EACS method to enable practical, interpretable, and efficient disparity estimation from spherical stereo, providing a straightforward pathway for extending conventional stereo pipelines to 360 imaging.

TL;DR: 本文提出将球面立体图像通过等距柱状投影（ERP）预处理，将弯曲的极线拉直为单轴视差，从而使用之前提出的RAFT+极线对齐通道选择（EACS）框架进行视差估计。实验在合成鱼眼立体数据集上验证了该流水线的实时性和准确性。
Motivation: 全向立体图像中的极线对应是弯曲的大圆路径，导致二维位移，不能直接作为单轴视差处理，需要几何校正。
Method: 采用球面到ERP投影作为预处理，将极线曲线拉直，恢复一维视差结构；然后使用RAFT+EACS框架，从密集光流中提取基线对齐的分量作为视差。
Result: 在合成鱼眼立体数据集上，该流水线能够生成准确、平滑且结构一致的视差图，且达到实时速度。
Conclusion: 证实了ERP预处理与RAFT+EACS方法结合可以有效实现球面立体图像的实用、可解释且高效的视差估计，为传统立体流水线扩展到360度成像提供了简单路径。

papers.title: Bridging the Manifold Gap: Riemannian Residual Line Search for One-Step Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: One-step diffusion editors are fast because they avoid inversion and iterative optimization, but a single transport update must be aggressive enough to realize the target prompt and conservative enough to preserve the source image--and no fixed update strength satisfies both demands across edit types. We treat this tension as a post-hoc candidate-selection problem on top of energy-field transport rather than as a new editing model. Our proposed method, Riemannian Residual Line Search, first builds a stronger edit by estimating the local time curvature of the prompt-delta field and projecting the corrected direction back onto the update norm of the original first-order energy-field transport estimation. It then forms a small residual path from the source image to this strong edit, retains the original first-order output as one candidate, and picks the final image by maximizing target-prompt CLIP alignment. On a 700-sample PIE-Bench++ evaluation across 10 edit type IDs, our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance among current one-step update algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对一步扩散编辑器在编辑强度上的矛盾，提出黎曼残差线搜索（Riemannian Residual Line Search）方法，通过估计局部时间曲率修正候选编辑方向，并在保留原始一阶输出作为候选的同时最大化目标提示CLIP对齐，从而在PIE-Bench++ 700样本评估中取得当前一步更新算法的最佳性能。
Motivation: 一步扩散编辑器需要同时实现强编辑效果和源图像保留，但固定更新强度无法适应不同编辑类型。
Method: 定义能量场传输，通过黎曼残差线搜索估计局部时间曲率，修正方向并投影到原始一阶更新范数上，构建从源图像到强编辑的残差路径，最终通过CLIP对齐选取最优候选。
Result: 在PIE-Bench++的700样本评估中（10种编辑类型），该方法达到当前一步更新算法的最优性能（SOTA）。
Conclusion: 该方法通过后验候选选择解决了编辑强度矛盾，无需设计新编辑模型。

summary_sections.method: 定义能量场传输，通过黎曼残差线搜索估计局部时间曲率，修正方向并投影到原始一阶更新范数上，构建从源图像到强编辑的残差路径，最终通过CLIP对齐选取最优候选。
summary_sections.result: 在PIE-Bench++的700样本评估中（10种编辑类型），该方法达到当前一步更新算法的最优性能（SOTA）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法通过后验候选选择解决了编辑强度矛盾，无需设计新编辑模型。

papers.title: World Models in Pieces: Structural Certification for General Agents
papers.abstract_en: In the big-world regime, agents cannot be universally capable and their ability is inevitably specialized across a world model in pieces. Consequently, standard uniform guarantees fail to distinguish between the understanding of critical bottlenecks and irrelevant failures. We first formalize this limitation by proving that general agents are not universal, rendering standard worst-case analysis uninformative. To overcome this, we introduce structural certification, a transition-local framework that maps bounded goal-conditioned performance to entry-wise guarantees on the agent's internal world model. Our main contribution is constructive. We provide algorithms that filter specific transitions using deep compositional goals and prove that a general agent on these goals has a structural world model with a $\mathcal{O}(1/n) + \mathcal{O}(δ)$ error bound. Conversely, this bound is tight in the small-$δ$ regime, whose existence is explicitly guaranteed by our certification. These results enable the certifiable deployment of general agents by localizing the specific transitions where long-horizon planning is reliable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明通用智能体在“大世界”框架下无法普遍适用，其能力必然被碎片化于世界模型的局部片段。为此提出结构性认证（structural certification），一个基于转移局部（transition-local）的框架，将有界的目标条件性能映射为智能体内部世界模型的逐条目保证。主要贡献是构造性算法，使用深度组合目标过滤特定转移，并证明这些目标上的通用智能体具有结构世界模型，误差界为O(1/n)+O(δ)，且该界在小δ区域是紧的。该结果通过定位长时规划可靠的特定转移，实现通用智能体的可认证部署。
Motivation: 标准均匀保证无法区分关键瓶颈与无关失败，通用智能体在碎片化世界模型中缺乏可认证的可靠性保障。
Method: 提出结构性认证框架，通过深度组合目标（deep compositional goals）过滤特定转移，构造算法并证明通用智能体在该目标上的世界模型误差界。
Result: 推导出O(1/n)+O(δ)的结构世界模型误差界，并证明该界在小δ区域是紧的，且认证明确保证紧界的存在性。
Conclusion: 该框架将长时规划可靠的转移局部化，从而实现通用智能体的可认证部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Matching Tasks to Objectives: Fine-Tuning and Prompt-Tuning Strategies for Encoder-Decoder Pre-trained Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-based learning has emerged as a dominant paradigm in natural language processing. This study explores the impact of diverse pre-training objectives on the performance of encoder-decoder pre-trained language models across generation and question answering tasks, with a focus on commonsense knowledge retrieval and completion. We highlight the benefits of incorporating multiple objectives during both pre-training and fine-tuning stages. We introduce the Match Task to Objective (MTO) framework and methods for determining the appropriate objective for a given task. This framework offers automated methods to prepare task-related data for adaptation through unsupervised training, based on the identified objective. In the fine-tuning stage, we design novel templates that align with the objectives of the pre-training and adaptation stages. When aligned with task requirements, these strategies can achieve a performance gain of over 120\% compared to conventional methods in few-shot settings. They significantly outperform related works in few-shot settings and exceed the baseline even in full-dataset scenarios. Furthermore, we extend this approach to include prompt-tuning methodologies, providing guidance for more effective soft prompt engineering and optimization. Our strategies significantly enhance prompt-tuning performance as well. These insights hold substantial value, precisely guiding the selection and optimization of models customized for specific tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/puraminy/MTO/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究编码器-解码器预训练语言模型在不同预训练目标下的表现，提出MTO（匹配任务与目标）框架，通过设计对齐预训练和适应阶段目标的模板，在少样本设置下相比传统方法性能提升超过120%，并扩展到提示调优方法。
Motivation: 现有提示学习方法对预训练目标与下游任务的对齐关注不足，导致模型性能受限。
Method: 提出MTO框架，自动识别任务对应目标并准备无监督训练数据；在微调阶段设计对齐预训练和适应阶段目标的新模板；并扩展到提示调优。
Result: 在少样本设置下性能提升超过120%，显著优于相关研究，在全数据集场景下也超过基线；同时有效提升提示调优性能。
Conclusion: 本文方法为指导针对特定任务的模型选择和优化提供了精确策略，代码已开源。

papers.title: Grading the Grader: Lessons from Evaluating an Agentic Data Analysis System
papers.abstract_en: Agentic data analysis systems produce rich outputs, including code, numerical results, and verbal diagnostics. This makes them more challenging to evaluate than single-turn LLM responses. It is therefore necessary to distinguish genuine disagreement between an agent's output and a ground-truth answer from grading artifacts. We investigate how reliably automated graders assess such a system and what strategies improve grading quality by applying LAMBDA, a multi-agent data-analysis system, on 153 numerical QRData tasks from DSGym. We develop and evaluate a three-layer human-AI grading cascade: strict regex matching, LLM-based lenient grading, and snippet-based human inspection, which combines non-GenAI and GenAI strategies with different failure profiles. Both automated graders achieve 100% observed precision (0/70 false positives). The lenient grader's recall is 97% against human labels. A keyword-anchored extraction pipeline raises the strict grader's recall by 60 percentage points over a last-number heuristic; the lenient grader is architecturally parser-independent. An iterative nudge mechanism raises grading run success from 36% to 97% and lenient-pass rates from 16% to 46%; comparing nudging with and without original-question re-injection shows that re-injection offers no benefit, confirming the nudge as an answer template cue. We further observe in this case study that variable type is the task metadata field most consistently associated with grading pipeline dynamics and observed outcome grades.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何可靠地评估智能数据分析系统（如LAMBDA）的输出，针对自动评分器与真实答案之间的分歧问题，提出了三层人机级联评分策略（严格正则匹配、宽松LLM评分、基于片段的人工审查）。在153个DSGym数值QRData任务上，自动评分器达到了100%的精确率，宽松评分器的召回率为97%。关键词锚定提取将严格评分器的召回率提升了60个百分点；迭代提示机制将评分运行成功率从36%提升至97%。研究还发现变量类型是与评分动态最一致的元数据字段。
Motivation: 智能数据分析系统生成包含代码、数值结果和诊断文本的丰富输出，比单轮LLM响应更难评估。需要区分系统输出与真实答案之间的真正分歧与评分假象。
Method: 开发并评估三层人机级联评分：严格正则匹配、基于LLM的宽松评分、以及基于片段的人工审查，结合非生成式AI和生成式AI策略，并设计了关键词锚定提取和迭代提示机制。
Result: 两个自动评分器均实现100%的观察精确率（0/70假阳性），宽松评分器召回率97%。关键词锚定提取使严格评分器召回率提升60个百分点；迭代提示机制使评分运行成功率从36%提升至97%，宽松通过率从16%提升至46%，且重新注入原始问题无额外收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自动评分可以高效可靠，但需要结合不同策略的失败模式；提示机制作为答案模板提示有效；变量类型是影响评分动态的关键元数据字段。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Accuracy and Satisfaction in Multi-Turn LLM Dialogues for NFR Assessment
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based dialogue assistants have become mainstream tools for software developers, yet current evaluation benchmarks focus exclusively on functional correctness. This leaves a critical gap in assessing the quality and accuracy of these conversations when handling Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs), which are inherently vague, context-dependent, and involve many parts of a program. Evaluating how well these systems support collaborative reasoning about NFRs requires methods that go beyond single-turn accuracy to capture both the correctness of the system's outputs and the quality of the multi-turn interaction. In this paper, we investigate the accuracy and quality of multi-turn conversations between developers and an LLM-based agent in the domain of Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulatory compliance. We hired 49 programmers to interact with GitHub Copilot to assess 148 HIPAA-derived NFRs against the iTrust codebase, a system designed to comply with HIPAA regulations, across three dimensions: requirement satisfaction level, reasoning, and code localization. We find that developers tend to agree with LLM assessments, but accuracy against expert ground truth is low. We model user satisfaction and find that longer system responses and more information-providing turns negatively affect user satisfaction, whereas proactive interactions positively affect it. Our findings provide insights for designing LLM-based dialogue systems that support NFR assessment.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to SIGDIAL 2026 (27th Annual Meeting of the Special Interest Group on Discourse and Dialogue)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多轮LLM对话在非功能需求（NFR）评估中的准确性与用户满意度，以HIPAA合规为案例。雇佣49名程序员使用GitHub Copilot评估148个NFRs，发现开发者倾向于同意LLM评估但准确性低，且长回复和信息型轮次降低满意度，而主动交互提升满意度。
Motivation: 现有LLM评估基准仅关注功能正确性，忽略非功能需求（NFR）这类模糊、上下文依赖的需求，需要超越单轮准确性的多轮交互质量评估方法。
Method: 设计实验让49名程序员与GitHub Copilot进行多轮对话，从需求满足等级、推理和代码定位三个维度评估148个HIPAA派生的NFRs，并建模用户满意度。
Result: 开发者与LLM评估的一致性较高，但与专家基准准确性低；更长的系统响应和更多信息性轮次负向影响用户满意度，而主动交互正向影响。
Conclusion: 为设计支持NFR评估的LLM对话系统提供了见解，强调需要平衡响应长度和交互主动性。

papers.title: Difference-Making without Making a Difference
papers.abstract_en: Over a series of seven papers, Andreas & Günther have introduced seven definitions of actual causation and have classified them as belonging to three different, competing, types of accounts: factual difference-making, counterfactual difference-making, and regularity-based. I show that their most recent - factual difference-making - definition instantiates all three types, thereby proving that these are distinctions without a difference. I further compare their novel account to the other six accounts on several crucial examples, revealing that this undermines all seven of their accounts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出 Andreas & Günther 提出的七种实际因果关系定义中，最新的“事实差异制造”定义实际上同时体现了事实差异、反事实差异和基于规则三种类型，从而证明这些分类是无实质区别的。作者进一步通过多个关键例子比较该定义与其他六种定义，揭示其削弱了所有七种定义的有效性。
Motivation: 针对 Andreas & Günther 提出的七种实际因果关系定义及其三种分类，证明其所谓的类型区分实际上没有区别。
Method: 通过逻辑分析，证明其最新定义同时满足所有三种类型；并通过比较例子揭示定义间的冲突。
Result: 证明事实差异制造定义同时属于三种类型，且这种混淆使得所有七种定义都存在问题。
Conclusion: Andreas & Günther 的分类是徒劳的，其定义存在根本性缺陷。

papers.title: GeoT2V-Bench: Benchmarking 3D Consistency in Text-to-Video Models via 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Camera-prompted text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly used to synthesize virtual camera captures, such as orbiting objects or moving through static scenes. For these outputs, visual plausibility is insufficient: the generated frames should also provide coherent multi-view evidence for a single static 3D scene. We introduce GeoT2V-Bench, a reconstruction-based diagnostic benchmark for evaluating whether camera-prompted T2V clips can support explicit rigid 3D reconstruction. Our pipeline estimates per-frame camera intrinsics and poses with VGGT-style geometry estimation, fits DeformableGS, derives a static MedianGS proxy by temporal-median aggregation, and renders this proxy along the estimated camera path. Instead of producing a pass/fail label or a single scalar score, GeoT2V-Bench reports a continuous reconstruction profile covering apparent image motion, estimated trajectory behavior, MedianGS static rendering error, static-render flow agreement, and the gap between flexible and static fits. On a fair-format four-seed evaluation with 3,840 completed reconstructions from 12 open-weight model configurations and 80 GeCo-Eval static-scene prompts, we find that visible motion, static rendering error, flow agreement, and flexible-vs-static behavior often disagree. GeoT2V-Bench therefore captures complementary failure modes that emerge when generated videos are tested as global static-scene acquisitions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoT2V-Bench 是一个基于3D重建的诊断基准，用于评估摄像机提示的文本到视频 (T2V) 模型生成的视频是否能够支持刚体3D重建。该基准通过估计相机内外参、可变形高斯泼溅 (DeformableGS) 拟合和静态中值高斯代理 (MedianGS) 计算，生成连续的3D重建剖面，包括图像运动、轨迹行为、静态渲染误差、流一致性和灵活与静态拟合差距等指标。在12个开源模型配置和80个静态场景提示上进行了3,840次重建实验，发现可见运动、静态渲染误差、流一致性和灵活与静态行为往往不一致，揭示了视频作为全局静态场景捕获时出现的互补失效模式。
Motivation: 摄像机提示的 T2V 模型生成的视频表面上看起来合理，但可能无法提供连贯的多视角证据来支持单一静态3D场景，现有基准缺乏对这种3D一致性的系统评估。
Method: 提出 GeoT2V-Bench 基准，使用 VGGT 风格的几何估计方法得到每帧相机内参和位姿，拟合可变形高斯泼溅 (DeformableGS)，通过时间中值聚合导出静态中值高斯代理 (MedianGS)，并沿估计的相机路径渲染该代理，最后生成包含图像运动、轨迹行为、静态渲染误差、流一致性和灵活与静态拟合差距的连续重建剖面。

Conclusion: GeoT2V-Bench 能够捕捉生成视频作为全局静态场景获取时出现的互补失效模式，为 T2V 模型的3D一致性提供了细粒度的诊断工具。

papers.title: L3Cube-MahaPOS: A Marathi Part-of-Speech Tagging Dataset and BERT Models
papers.abstract_en: Part-of-Speech (POS) tagging is a foundational NLP task underpinning machine translation, information extraction, and syntactic parsing. Despite Marathi being spoken by over 83 million people and ranking among the top twenty most spoken languages worldwide, it remains severely under-resourced in annotated corpora and standardised evaluation benchmarks. Marathi presents unique challenges for computational modelling owing to its rich morphology, relatively free word order, lack of capitalisation conventions, and pervasive code-mixing with Hindi and English. We introduce L3Cube-MahaPOS, a gold-standard POS tagging dataset for Marathi comprising 32,354 manually annotated sentences drawn from news text. Annotation was performed entirely manually by a team of Marathi-proficient annotators following a 16-tag Universal Dependencies-aligned scheme. A structured preprocessing pipeline covering Unicode normalisation, Devanagari-aware tokenisation, and noise filtering ensures label consistency across all splits. We benchmark the dataset across six model families spanning HMM, CRF, BiLSTM, BiLSTM+CharCNN, MuRIL, and the Marathi-specific transformer MahaBERT-v2. The best system achieves 88.67\% token-level accuracy and a macro-F1 of 81.67% over 15 evaluated tag classes. We release the dataset, annotation guidelines, and trained model checkpoints to foster further research in Marathi NLP.

TL;DR: 本文介绍L3Cube-MahaPOS，一个马拉地语（Marathi）词性标注数据集，包含32,354条手工标注的新闻句子，遵循16标签通用依赖对齐方案。作者使用HMM、CRF、BiLSTM、BiLSTM+CharCNN、MuRIL和MahaBERT-v2等模型进行基准测试，最佳模型达到88.67%的token级准确率和81.67%的宏F1。
Motivation: 马拉地语虽有超过8300万使用者，但在标注语料库和标准化评估基准方面资源严重不足，且其丰富的形态学、自由语序、缺乏大写惯例以及与印地语和英语的语码混合给计算建模带来独特挑战。
Method: 构建手工标注数据集，采用Unicode标准化、天城文感知分词和噪声过滤的预处理流程，并使用HMM、CRF、BiLSTM、BiLSTM+CharCNN、MuRIL和MahaBERT-v2六类模型进行基准测试。

Conclusion: 作者发布数据集、标注指南和训练模型检查点，以促进马拉地语NLP的进一步研究。

papers.title: Solving Inverse Problems of Chaotic Systems with Bidirectional Conditional Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Modeling chaotic systems is crucial yet challenging. Inverse problems in chaotic dynamics, namely inferring initial conditions from final states, remain largely unsolved because of ill-posedness, non-uniqueness, instability, and potentially chaotic time-reverse dynamics. We address this open problem with Bidirectional Conditional Flow Matching (Bi-CFM), which learns bidirectional mappings between distributions of initial and final states to capture the stochasticity of chaotic evolution and mitigate exponential error accumulation over time. Furthermore, for systems with conservation laws, we extend it to Conservation-constrained Bi-CFM (CBi-CFM). Across the classic Lorenz, Circuit, and high-dimensional Lorenz 96 systems, Bi-CFM improves five distribution-level metrics over baselines while achieving a speedup of more than two orders of magnitude. In the three-body planet-planet scattering problem in planetary dynamics, CBi-CFM better respects conservation laws, with conservation errors comparable to those of the ground truth. Finally, on real observations of globular clusters, collisional million-body systems shaped by $\sim 10^{10}$ years (10 Gyr) of evolution, our method represents an advance in accuracy, establishing a scalable route to solving inverse problems of long-timescale real-world chaotic dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混沌系统逆问题（从终态推断初态）提出双向条件流匹配（Bi-CFM），通过学习初态与终态分布的双向映射来捕捉混沌演化的随机性并缓解指数级误差累积。对于具有守恒律的系统，进一步提出守恒约束Bi-CFM（CBi-CFM）。在Lorenz、电路、高维Lorenz 96系统上，Bi-CFM在五个分布级指标上超越基线，速度提升两个数量级以上。在三体行星散射问题和真实球状星团观测上，CBi-CFM更好地满足守恒律并提升精度。
Motivation: 混沌系统的逆问题由于不适定性、非唯一性、不稳定性及潜在的时间反演混沌而长期未解，急需可扩展的方法。
Method: 提出Bidirectional Conditional Flow Matching (Bi-CFM)，学习初态与终态分布之间的双向映射；对具守恒律的系统扩展为Conservation-constrained Bi-CFM (CBi-CFM)。
Result: 在经典Lorenz、电路及高维Lorenz 96系统上，Bi-CFM在五个分布级指标上优于基线，速度提升两个数量级以上；在行星动力学三体问题中，CBi-CFM的守恒误差与真实轨迹相当；在真实球状星团（约10^10年演化）观测上取得精度进步。
Conclusion: 该方法为求解长时间尺度真实混沌系统的逆问题提供了可扩展的途径。

papers.title: High-Fidelity Synthetic Transmission Electron Microscopy Image Generation Using Diffusion Probabilistic Models for Data-Limited Semiconductor Metrology
papers.abstract_en: Advanced semiconductor nodes drastically increased demand for Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), yet destructive sample preparation, slow imaging and high costs severely limit the availability of diverse datasets needed for downstream machine learning (ML). Synthetic data generation is becoming essential, but current generative models often miss TEM-specific noise, structural detail, and stochastic variability crucial for evaluation. We present a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) framework for synthetic TEM image generation under extreme data scarcity. A progressive patch-based training strategy scales from low-resolution patches to full images, enabling from-scratch training with only 15 samples. We integrate a custom TrivialAugment adaptation, cross-process domain transfer, classifier guidance, and RePaint-style inpainting, culminating in full-image generation that preserves global structural and spatial relationships in compliance with FAB metrology requirements. Beyond synthesis, we repurpose DDPM feature representations for segmentation, partitioning encoder feature maps to obtain coherent region masks. Our synthetic images achieve up to MS-SSIM > 0.98 and qualitative expert assessment consistent with structural similarity results, facilitating downstream ML training for defect detection, segmentation, and metrology while preserving statistical and physical realism.
papers.comment: To be presented at the 2026 International Symposium ELMAR, published by IEEE in the conference proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的框架，用于在数据稀缺条件下生成高保真合成透射电子显微镜（TEM）图像，以支持半导体计量中的下游机器学习任务。摘要报告方法在仅15个样本训练下实现了高结构相似性（MS-SSIM>0.98），并展示了在缺陷检测、分割和计量方面的潜力。
Motivation: 先进半导体节点对TEM需求增加，但破坏性制样、慢速成像和高成本限制了多样化的数据集可用性，影响下游机器学习。现有生成模型常缺失TEM特定的噪声、结构细节和随机变异性。
Method: 提出一个DDPM框架，采用渐进式基于块的训练策略从低分辨率块扩展到全图像，在仅15个样本下从零训练。集成了自定义TrivialAugment适配、跨过程域迁移、分类器引导和RePaint式修补，最终生成全图像，保持全局结构和空间关系。
Result: 合成图像在MS-SSIM上达到>0.98，定性专家评估与结构相似性结果一致，能促进下游缺陷检测、分割和计量的机器学习训练。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了该方法在数据稀缺条件下生成物理真实且统计有效的合成TEM图像的能力，可用于半导体计量中的机器学习。

papers.title: Large-Language-Model Discovery of Quantum LDPC Codes through Structured Concept Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Quantum computers could outperform classical machines on important problems, but only if the errors that pervade quantum hardware can be corrected at scale. Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes offer a promising route to this goal by combining sparse parity checks with finite encoding rate and growing distance, but their construction remains a challenging discrete design problem. Here we introduce structured concept evolution (SCE), a search framework that pairs a large language model with a structured algebraic mutation grammar to discover lifted-product code families, a class of CSS qLDPC codes. Instead of asking the LLM to design codes from first principles, SCE evolves structured concepts consisting of algebraic specifications paired with executable programs that realize them, using hierarchical mutations that modify the group algebra, protograph geometry, or base space. Running SCE, we discover a diverse set of competitive code families, ranging from abelian constructions to families over non-abelian groups beyond those underlying standard designs such as bivariate-bicycle codes, and characterize them under code-capacity depolarizing noise with BP+OSD decoding. These results are obtained with lightweight models (GPT-5.4-mini and GPT-5.4-nano).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构化概念进化（SCE）框架，结合大语言模型与结构化代数突变语法，自动探索量子低密度奇偶校验码（qLDPC codes）。SCE通过层级突变修改群代数、原图几何或基空间，进化出代数规范与可执行程序配对的结构化概念，从而发现提升积码族。使用轻量模型GPT-5.4-mini和GPT-5.4-nano运行，发现了包括非阿贝尔群上的多种竞争性码族，并在码容量去极化噪声下用BP+OSD解码进行了表征。
Motivation: 量子计算需要可扩展的纠错码，而qLDPC码结合稀疏奇偶校验、有限编码率和增长距离很有前景，但其构造是一个困难的离散设计问题。
Method: 引入SCE框架，将大语言模型与结构化代数突变语法配对，通过层级突变（修改群代数、原图几何或基空间）进化结构化概念，这些概念由代数规范和可执行程序组成。
Result: 发现了多种竞争性码族，从阿贝尔构造到超越标准设计（如二元自行车码）的非阿贝尔群上的码族，并在码容量去极化噪声下用BP+OSD解码进行了表征。
Conclusion: 使用轻量模型即可发现竞争性qLDPC码族，表明SCE是一种有效的搜索框架。

papers.title: DDStereo: Efficient Dual Decoder Transformers for Stereo 3D Road Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Stereo-based 3D object detection still faces two critical safety challenges: real-time performance and open-set generalization. Existing stereo 3D methods typically achieve twice the accuracy of monocular methods but suffer from significantly lower inference speeds, making them unsuitable for real-time applications. Meanwhile, recent advances in open-world detection have introduced open-set and open-vocabulary algorithms in monocular 2D and 3D settings, yet stereo-based open-set detection remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose DDStereo, a novel Dual-Decoder Stereo Transformer for real-time open-set 3D object detection. DDStereo features two lightweight decoder branches: one for open-set foreground 2D detection and the other for 3D attribute regression. These decoders share object-level queries to achieve unified target-level alignment. To enhance inference efficiency, we designed a compact disparity feature extractor and a streamlined decoder architecture. Experiments on public stereo 3D benchmarks demonstrate that DDStereo achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under both closed-set and open-set protocols. Notably, our method surpasses existing stereo 3D detectors in inference speed and, for the first time, achieves real-time performance comparable to monocular approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DDStereo，一种双解码器立体Transformer，用于实时开放集3D目标检测。该方法包含两个轻量级解码器分支：一个用于开放集前景2D检测，另一个用于3D属性回归，共享目标级查询。通过紧凑的视差特征提取器和精简解码器架构提升推理效率。实验表明，在闭集和开放集协议下均达到最先进精度，且推理速度首次接近单目方法。
Motivation: 现有立体3D检测方法精度高但推理速度慢，不适合实时应用；同时立体开放集检测尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出双解码器架构：一个解码器负责开放集前景2D检测，另一个解码器负责3D属性回归，两者通过目标级查询对齐。设计紧凑的视差特征提取器和精简的解码器结构以加速推理。
Result: 在公开立体3D基准上，闭集和开放集协议下均达到最先进精度；推理速度超越现有立体方法，首次实现与单目方法相当的实时性能。

papers.title: OrbitForge: Text-to-3D Scene Generation via Reconstruction-Anchored Video Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Generic text-to-video models can be used as rich open-world scene priors. Despite the high quality of today's generated videos, they do not directly yield reliable 3D assets: camera motion is difficult to control, view coverage is partial, and frames often contain inconsistencies across time. We introduce OrbitForge, an adapter built from frozen video priors and per-prompt Gaussian Splatting reconstruction optimization that converts a single text-generated video into a canonical closed-orbit 3D Gaussian Splatting scene. We use 3D reconstruction as an anchor to improve the 3D consistency of the generated video. We obtain a preliminary 3D reconstruction from a first generated video via Deformable Gaussian Splatting with a robust MedianGS proxy. We render views from a prescribed orbit to detect missing viewpoints. OrbitForge uses the text-to-video model to complete only the missing views, and reconstructs the completed orbit into a final Gaussian Splatting scene. This design requires no task-specific video or multiview fine-tuning, avoids per-prompt score-distillation optimization, and does not progressively generate views one step at a time. We further argue that this setting demands coverage-aware evaluation: local smoothness alone rewards methods that never attempt a full orbit. On a frozen 300-prompt T3Bench-derived audit, OrbitForge reconstruction attains a 359.0-degree measured median span, raises originally unsupported-bin Q10 ImageReward from 8.07 to 16.36 relative to MedianGS-only reconstruction, while remaining competitive with VideoMV on the coverage-quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OrbitForge，一个基于冻结视频先验和逐提示高斯泼溅重建优化的适配器，将单次文本生成的视频转换为规范的闭环3D高斯泼溅场景。通过3D重建锚定提升视频的3D一致性，利用可变形高斯泼溅和稳健的MedianGS代理获取初步重建，并检测缺失视角以引导视频模型补全，最终完成全轨道重建。该方法无需任务特定的视频或多视角微调，避免了逐提示分数蒸馏优化。
Motivation: 现有文本-视频模型生成的高质量视频难以直接用于3D资产：相机运动难控、视角覆盖不全、帧间不一致。
Method: 提出 OrbitForge 流程：首先生成视频，通过可变形高斯泼溅和 MedianGS 获取初步3D重建；然后渲染预设轨道视图检测缺失视角；再用文本-视频模型仅补全缺失视图；最后将完整轨道重建为高斯泼溅场景。
Result: 在T3Bench衍生的300提示测试集上，OrbitForge 重建达到359.0度测量中位跨度，将原本不支持的Q10 ImageReward从8.07提升至16.36，与VideoMV在覆盖质量上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 该方法无需任务特定微调或逐提示优化，利用3D重建作为锚点改进生成视频的3D一致性，并倡导覆盖感知评估。

papers.title: EG-VQA: Benchmarking Verifiable Video Question Answering with Grounded Temporal Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have yielded promising performance on video question answering (VideoQA). Nevertheless, existing benchmarks are predominantly evaluated through answer correctness, while the grounding of predictions in relevant video evidence remains largely unexamined. This disconnect between answer generation and evidence understanding motivates the construction of the Evidence-Grounded Video Question Answering Benchmark (EG-VQA), an open-ended evaluation protocol in which each QA pair is explicitly annotated with supporting temporal evidence, thereby requiring joint reasoning and precise evidence localization. EG-VQA is comprised of 2,067 videos and 11,838 QA pairs with fine-grained evidence annotations. To evaluate predicted evidence, Evidence-Grounded F1 (EG-F1) is introduced as a unified metric in which temporal alignment and semantic consistency against ground-truth evidence are jointly measured. Experimental evaluation reveals that even strong proprietary models struggle to accurately ground their predictions, exposing a fundamental discrepancy between answer correctness and faithful evidence localization. To bridge this gap, EG-Reasoner, an evidence-grounded reasoning model trained with explicit supervision, is proposed. State-of-the-art performance is achieved among open-source models, with results competitive against proprietary systems, particularly pronounced gains are observed on reasoning-intensive tasks such as counterfactual questions. These findings demonstrate that scaling alone is insufficient for robust video understanding and that structured evidence supervision is essential for the development of more reliable and interpretable VideoQA systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EG-VQA基准，用于评估视频大语言模型在视频问答中对答案的时空证据定位能力，并引入EG-F1指标统一衡量时间对齐和语义一致性。实验发现现有模型在答案正确性与证据定位之间存在显著差距，为此提出EG-Reasoner模型，通过显式证据监督训练，在开源模型中达到最优，并在反事实等推理密集型任务上提升明显。
Motivation: 现有视频问答基准主要评估答案正确性，忽略了预测是否基于视频中的相关证据，导致模型在生成答案与理解证据之间存在脱节。
Method: 构建EG-VQA基准（2067个视频、11838个QA对，每对标注时间证据），提出EG-F1指标联合度量时间对齐与语义一致性，并训练EG-Reasoner模型显式学习证据定位。
Result: 即使强商业模型在证据定位上表现不佳，EG-Reasoner在开源模型中达到最优，性能与商业系统竞争，尤其在反事实等推理任务上增益显著。
Conclusion: 仅靠模型规模不足以实现稳健视频理解，结构化证据监督对于开发可靠、可解释的视频问答系统至关重要。

papers.title: Pocket-SLAM: Rendering-Area-Aware Pruning for Memory-Efficient 3DGS-SLAM
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has garnered significant attention in Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) due to its advances in capturing fine-grained geometry features and synthesizing novel views. For SLAM in large-scale scenes, such as autonomous driving, 3DGS-SLAM faces a critical limitation: memory consumption increases continuously over time as Gaussian points accumulate, leading to poor memory efficiency and limiting its applicability. In this work, we propose a rendering-area-aware pruning strategy that selectively removes Gaussians based on their contribution to the effective rendering area, rather than solely relying on Gaussian-level heuristics such as opacity or gradient magnitude. This perspective directly targets the sources of memory redundancy, effectively reducing the peak memory footprint of 3DGS-SLAM during runtime. Evaluations on the EuRoC and KITTI datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing pruning approaches in large-scale outdoor scenes, achieving over 60% memory reduction and more than 2 times FPS improvement while preserving localization and mapping accuracy. These results highlight rendering-area-aware pruning as a promising direction for scaling 3DGS-SLAM to real-world autonomous driving scenarios. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/UMN-ZhaoLab/Pocket-SLAM.git.
papers.comment: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation(ICRA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种渲染区域感知的高斯剪枝策略（Pocket-SLAM），用于减少3DGS-SLAM在运行时的内存消耗。该方法根据高斯对有效渲染区域的贡献而非单纯的不透明度或梯度进行剪枝，在EuRoC和KITTI数据集上实现超过60%的内存缩减和2倍以上的FPS提升，同时保持定位与建图精度。
Motivation: 3DGS-SLAM在大规模场景（如自动驾驶）中面临高斯点持续累积导致内存消耗不断增长的问题，限制了其实际应用。现有剪枝方法依赖高斯级启发式（如不透明度），未能直接针对内存冗余来源。
Method: 提出渲染区域感知的剪枝策略，根据高斯对有效渲染区域的贡献度选择性移除冗余高斯点。
Result: 在EuRoC和KITTI数据集上，该方法相比现有剪枝方法获得超过60%的内存减少和2倍以上的FPS提升，且定位与建图精度保持不变。
Conclusion: 渲染区域感知剪枝是扩展3DGS-SLAM到真实自动驾驶场景的有效方向。

papers.title: Grad Detect: Gradient-Based Hallucination Detection in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks, yet they remain prone to generating hallucinations. Detecting these hallucinations is critical for deploying LLMs reliably in high-stakes applications. We present Grad Detect, a gradient-based approach for predicting hallucinations by analyzing layer-wise gradient patterns from a single forward-backward pass during inference. Our method shows that the internal gradient structure of a model carries rich information about the correctness of its output. This information is not accessible through output-level signals alone. We evaluate Grad Detect on several Q&A benchmarks across both hallucination detection and model abstention prediction, where it consistently outperforms confidence-based and sampling-based baselines. Through comprehensive layer ablation studies across all eleven models from four architectural families, we find that the final five layers concentrate over 97% of the discriminative gradient signal, enabling efficient deployment with minimal performance loss. Grad Detect provides a unified framework for predicting multiple dimensions of LLM reliability, offering strong predictive performance alongside interpretable insights into where and how model failures originate.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Grad Detect，一种基于梯度的大语言模型幻觉检测方法。该方法通过在推理时执行单次前向-后向传播，分析逐层的梯度模式，利用内部梯度结构预测输出是否正确。在多个问答基准上，Grad Detect 在幻觉检测和模型弃权预测任务中均优于基于置信度和采样的基线方法。跨四个架构家族共11个模型的层级消融实验显示，最后五层集中了超过97%的判别性梯度信息，支持高效部署。
Motivation: 大语言模型容易产生幻觉，而现有检测方法主要依赖输出级别的信号（如置信度），无法充分挖掘模型内部的梯度信息。
Method: 提出 Grad Detect，在推理期间通过单次前向和后向传播获取每层的梯度，并基于这些梯度模式预测幻觉。
Result: 在多个问答基准上，Grad Detect 在幻觉检测和模型弃权预测中持续优于置信度方法和采样方法。层级消融表明最后五层包含97%以上的判别梯度信息，可在最小性能损失下实现高效部署。
Conclusion: Grad Detect 提供了一个统一的框架来预测大语言模型的多个可靠性维度，同时提供可解释的洞察，揭示模型失败的位置和原因。

papers.title: Counting Trees from Satellite Imagery with Noisy Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Counting individual trees is a fundamental task for environmental monitoring, yet remains largely unexplored with satellite imagery. At these resolutions, isolated trees may still be identifiable, but crown boundaries become ambiguous in dense forests, making the notion of an individual tree inherently ill-defined. Moreover, large-scale manual annotations of individual trees are prohibitively expensive. While scalable supervision can be derived from airborne LiDAR, the resulting annotations are noisy and difficult to exploit effectively. We address these challenges by formulating tree counting as a spatial density matching problem supervised through Unbalanced Optimal Transport. This formulation naturally accommodates both precise localization of isolate trees and robust density estimation in dense forests. We further introduce a self-correction mechanism that leverages transport residuals to progressively refine noisy supervision during training. We evaluate our approach on TinyTrees, a new benchmark spanning three continents and three satellite sensors, comprising over 215 million tree annotations (including 773K manually verified instances) across 23,000 sq.km. Our method consistently outperforms detection-based, regression-based, and transport-based distribution-matching baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of unbalanced transport and reliability-aware supervision for large-scale tree counting from satellite imagery. Code, data and models are available at https://github.com/dgominski/treematch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从卫星图像中计数单棵树的问题，针对密林中树冠边界模糊和人工标注昂贵的问题，将树计数表述为通过非平衡最优传输监督的空间密度匹配问题，并引入基于传输残差的自校正机制来利用有噪监督。在覆盖三大洲、三种卫星传感器、超过2.15亿个树标注的新基准TinyTrees上，该方法优于检测、回归和传输匹配基线。
Motivation: 卫星图像中的单棵树计数任务尚未充分探索，主要难点在于：密林中树冠边界模糊导致“单棵树”定义不明确，大规模人工标注成本过高，而可从LiDAR获取的监督存在噪声。
Method: 将树计数形式化为受非平衡最优传输（Unbalanced Optimal Transport）监督的空间密度匹配问题，并设计一种利用传输残差在训练过程中逐步校正噪声监督的自校正机制。
Result: 在新基准TinyTrees（包含215M+树标注，其中773K人工验证，覆盖23,000平方千米）上，该方法在性能上一致优于基于检测、回归和传输匹配的基线方法。
Conclusion: 非平衡传输和可靠性感知监督对于从卫星图像进行大规模树计数是有效的，代码、数据和模型已公开。

papers.title: AerialFusionMapNet: Online HD Map Construction with Aerial-Onboard BEV Fusion
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution aerial imagery has recently emerged as a complementary modality for automated driving perception and has shown potential to improve birds-eye-view (BEV) scene understanding when fused with onboard sensors. Prior work demonstrated performance gains for online high-definition (HD) map construction through aerial-onboard fusion; however, conventional end-to-end fusion does not fully exploit the structural information contained in aerial representations. In this work, we introduce AerialFusionMapNet, a fusion-based mapping framework with a structured two-stage training strategy that explicitly enhances the contribution of aerial features within a unified pipeline. The proposed training scheme enables more effective integration of structural aerial priors. On the nuScenes geographic split, AerialFusionMapNet achieves up to 54.7 mAP, improving over prior aerial-onboard fusion baselines from 48.8 mAP by +5.9 absolute and +12.1% relative. The results suggest that structured training design, rather than increased architectural complexity, plays a more decisive role in unlocking the full potential of aerial imagery for online HD map construction. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/DriverlessMobility/AerialFusionMapNet.

papers.title: Paying to Know: Micro-Transaction Markets for Verified Product Information in Agentic E-Commerce
papers.abstract_en: Commercial NLP treats the shopping chatbot as a recommender or a conversion tool: its job is to match a user to a catalogue entry and close a sale. We argue that the arrival of agent-native micro-payment rails (e.g., x402, AP2) changes what is scarce. When the buyer is an autonomous agent that can investigate exhaustively, the bottleneck is no longer matching products but acquiring trustworthy, decision-relevant information about them. We envision agentic e-commerce as a micro-transaction market for verified information: buyer agents spend fractions of a cent to progressively unlock seller- and reviewer-supplied data -- service histories, third-party test reports, bills of materials, audited sales and support metrics -- paid for a la carte under a freemium model, with reviewer trust scored reputationally. We sketch the architecture of such a market and argue that it rewards genuine product quality and yields truer competition than ranking-based storefronts. We then translate the vision into concrete NLP problems -- cost-optimal information acquisition, data pricing and negotiation, real-time entity resolution, grounded value exchange, and privacy-preserving persona modelling -- and argue that these, not chat fluency, deserve the field's attention.

papers.title: Assessing Distribution Shift in Human Activity Recognition for Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: While the field of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) continues to draw interest from researchers and advance in important ways, some key challenges remain. One of the most difficult aspects of building HAR models that show good performance in real-world settings is dealing with data diversity from device and sensor heterogeneity, and contextual changes that are intrinsic to real-world applications. While data diversity in HAR has been well-acknowledged in the literature, there remains a gap in understanding the effect of various types of distribution shifts on HAR models and the domain generalization problem that arises. Towards that end, this paper systematically evaluates 4 different types of distribution shifts, including variations in device type, sensor placement, sampling rate, and user behavior. Quantifying their effects, we illustrate that diversity shifts predominantly define all types of shifts, indicating the existence of unique features that are not shared across different domains. We then introduce a uniform HAR-based distribution shift benchmarks and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of up to 28 domain generalization methods. Our analysis exposes the limitations of current domain generalization algorithms in achieving model generalizability, marginally outperforming the empirical risk minimization baseline. This work represents the first systematic exploration of domain generalization and adaptation concerning specific distribution shifts in sensor-based HAR, offering an open-source benchmark platform and datasets to spur further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了人类活动识别（HAR）中四种分布偏移（设备类型、传感器位置、采样率、用户行为）对域泛化的影响，并构建了统一的HAR分布偏移基准。通过评估28种域泛化方法，发现现有方法在模型泛化性上仅略优于经验风险最小化基线。
Motivation: HAR模型在实际应用中面临数据多样性（设备、传感器异质性及上下文变化）导致的分布偏移，但缺乏对各类偏移影响及其域泛化问题的系统理解。
Method: 系统评估四种分布偏移（设备类型、传感器位置、采样率、用户行为），量化其效应，并引入基于HAR的分布偏移基准，对28种域泛化方法进行全面评估。
Result: 分析表明多样性偏移主导所有偏移类型，且现有域泛化算法在实现模型泛化性上表现有限，仅略优于经验风险最小化基线。
Conclusion: 本研究首次系统探索传感器HAR中特定分布偏移的域泛化与适应问题，提供开源基准平台和数据集以促进后续研究。

papers.title: BluTrain: A C++/CUDA Framework for AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Progress in deep learning is, at scale, more a matter of systems engineering than of modelling: the behaviour of a model in training (its throughput, its memory footprint, and the numerical fidelity of the result) is determined less by the architecture itself than by how that architecture is expressed on the hardware. To achieve absolute control over this hardware expression while abstracting away systems complexity to make modelling seamless and eliminating the need for repetitive orchestration logic, BluTrain was architected from first principles as a robust, lightweight, and architecture-general training framework in standard C++ and the core CUDA programming model. Every layer is implemented natively: a typed tensor module with reverse-mode autograd, a linear-algebra library, a caching allocator, a multi-mode distributed-execution module, and an MLIR-based deep-learning compiler. In formal evaluations training a 124M-parameter GPT-2 baseline in FP32 on an 8-GPU 6000 Ada system, BluTrain outperforms industry-standard baselines in both throughput (sustaining an average of 407K tokens/s versus PyTorch's 395K tokens/s) and memory efficiency (achieving up to a 22% footprint reduction), while strictly preserving numerical fidelity and converging to a marginally lower final validation loss. With every layer explicitly open to native tuning, the performance ceiling is the framework's own to raise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文介绍BluTrain，一个用标准C++和核心CUDA编程模型构建的轻量级、架构通用的深度学习训练框架。所有层（类型化张量模块、自动微分、线性代数库、缓存分配器、多模式分布式执行模块、基于MLIR的编译器）均原生实现。在8-GPU 6000 Ada系统上训练124M参数GPT-2（FP32）时，BluTrain在吞吐量（407K tokens/s vs PyTorch 395K）和内存效率（减少22%）上优于行业基线，同时保持数值精度。
Motivation: 深度学习的进步更多是系统工程而非模型设计；模型行为由硬件表达方式决定。需要完全控制硬件表达，同时抽象系统复杂性，消除重复编排逻辑。
Method: 从第一性原理设计BluTrain，使用标准C++和CUDA编程模型，原生实现所有层：类型化张量模块（带反向模式自动微分）、线性代数库、缓存分配器、多模式分布式执行模块、基于MLIR的深度学习编译器。
Result: 在8-GPU 6000 Ada系统上训练124M参数GPT-2（FP32），BluTrain平均吞吐量407K tokens/s（PyTorch为395K），内存占用减少22%，保持数值精度，最终验证损失略低。
Conclusion: 每一层都明确开放给原生调优，性能上限由框架自身决定。

papers.title: DeepBD: A Grounded Agentic Workflow for Variant Prioritization and Diagnosis of Genetic Birth Defects
papers.abstract_en: Birth defects are a major cause of fetal loss, neonatal morbidity and long-term disability. In the subset with suspected genetic etiologies, exome and genome sequencing have moved many cases from variant detection to post-sequencing interpretation: clinicians must rank patient-specific candidate variants under incomplete fetal or infant phenotypes and heterogeneous evidence from population genetics, variant-effect prediction, gene-disease validity, phenotype ontologies, cellular and pathway context, protein structure and clinical literature. We present DeepBD, a grounded agentic workflow for variant prioritization and diagnostic interpretation of genetic birth defects. DeepBD organizes the workflow into LLM-assisted case structuring, a pretrained evidence engine, specialist evidence modules and a grounded diagnostic review layer. The evidence engine learns patient-specific variant scores from structured rule evidence, sequence and variant-effect representations and phenotype-conditioned biological context, whereas specialist modules and the agentic layer provide tool-based refinement, candidate-pool review and diagnosis-oriented synthesis from ranked candidates. Developed using an in-house fetal and infant cohort comprising 18,622 cases, DeepBD achieved Recall@1/3/5/10 of 0.658/0.882/0.912/0.929 on an internal held-out solved-case benchmark, outperforming standalone Exomiser, DeepRare and prompted LLM reranking baselines evaluated on Exomiser-derived top-20 candidate variants. Ablation and overlap analyses show that rule evidence, mechanistic context, and specialist refinement provide complementary signals. These findings support a grounded agentic workflow that separates evidence integration, tool-based refinement, and LLM-assisted diagnostic review for retrospective variant prioritization in genetic birth defects.

papers.title: Revealing Training Data Exposure in Vision Language Large Models via Parameter Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Large Models (VLLMs) trained on massive crawled corpora raise pressing copyright and data-provenance concerns. These concerns are particularly acute in healthcare, where patient medical images paired with clinical reports demand rigorous privacy safeguards. However, existing training data detection methods either fail in cross-modal scenarios or rely on superficial output signals with insufficient discriminative power. We introduce GradAudit, a gradient-based auditing framework that examines internal optimization dynamics rather than treating VLLMs as black boxes. Our approach builds on a key observation: model parameters converge to regions where gradients on training samples become stable and well-aligned, whereas gradients on non-training samples remain noisy and inconsistent. By analyzing these gradient signatures, GradAudit achieves strong separability and detects genuine image-text associations learned during training, not merely individual modality membership. Empirically, across both medical and general-domain datasets, GradAudit substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both pretraining and fine-tuning VLLMs. In a case study employing copyrighted content, we show that existing training data detection methods not only underestimate the extent of unauthorized data usage, but that this underestimation becomes more pronounced as models become more recent and more advanced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GradAudit，一种基于梯度的审计框架，通过分析视觉-语言大模型（VLLM）的内部优化动态（而非仅输出信号）来检测训练数据泄露。实验表明，在医疗和通用领域数据集上，GradAudit 在预训练和微调 VLLM 中均显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有训练数据检测方法在跨模态场景下失效，或依赖表面输出信号、判别力不足，尤其在医疗等隐私敏感领域亟需更强的审计手段。
Method: 利用模型参数在训练样本梯度上趋于稳定且对齐，而非训练样本梯度噪声大且不一致的观察，通过分析梯度特征实现训练数据检测。
Result: 在医疗和通用领域数据集上，GradAudit 在预训练和微调 VLLM 中均大幅超越现有基线。案例研究显示，现有方法严重低估了未经授权的数据使用，且模型越新越先进，低估越明显。
Conclusion: GradAudit 能有效检测 VLLM 训练数据中的图文关联，尤其在版权和隐私审计场景中具有优势。

summary_sections.result: 在医疗和通用领域数据集上，GradAudit 在预训练和微调 VLLM 中均大幅超越现有基线。案例研究显示，现有方法严重低估了未经授权的数据使用，且模型越新越先进，低估越明显。
summary_sections.conclusion: GradAudit 能有效检测 VLLM 训练数据中的图文关联，尤其在版权和隐私审计场景中具有优势。

papers.title: Dirac-Frenkel dynamics with inertia for nonlinearly parametrized solutions of evolution problems
papers.abstract_en: Even when Dirac-Frenkel dynamics determine a well-defined evolution in function space, the corresponding parameter dynamics can be non-unique or ill-conditioned for redundant nonlinear parametrizations such as neural networks or mixture models. We propose to add inertia to the Dirac-Frenkel dynamics and show that this allows useful parameter velocity information to persist from the past trajectory in directions that are weakly informed, while well-informed parameter velocity directions continue to follow the Dirac-Frenkel dynamics. We prove that the inertial formulation yields well-posed parameter dynamics and provide a posteriori error bounds. After time discretization, the method requires the solution of the same type of regularized linear least-squares problem as standard Dirac-Frenkel dynamics, but with the previous velocity appearing as an anchor. Numerical experiments demonstrate the increased robustness obtained with inertia.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在Dirac-Frenkel动力学中加入惯性项，以处理非线性参数化（如神经网络、混合模型）中参数动力学的非唯一性或病态问题。理论证明了惯性公式导致适定的参数动力学，并提供了后验误差界。数值实验表明惯性提高了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 标准Dirac-Frenkel动力学在冗余非线性参数化下可能导致参数动力学非唯一或病态，影响演化问题的求解稳定性。
Method: 在Dirac-Frenkel动力学中引入惯性项，使弱信息方向保留过去速度信息，而强信息方向仍遵循原始动力学。时间离散后，求解同类型的正则化线性最小二乘问题，但以前一时刻速度作为锚点。
Result: 证明了惯性公式给出适定的参数动力学，并推导了后验误差界。数值实验表明惯性增强了鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 惯性机制有效改善了非线性参数化演化问题中参数动力学的条件，且计算成本与标准Dirac-Frenkel动力学相当。

papers.title: Compact Object-Level Representations with Open-Vocabulary Understanding for Indoor Visual Relocalization
papers.abstract_en: Indoor visual relocalization plays a critical role in emerging spatial and embodied AI applications. However, prior research was predominantly devoted to low-level vision schemes, struggling to perceive scene semantics and compositions, which limits both interpretability and applicability. In this paper, we explore the issue of how to organize rich object information in a scene, including semantics, layout, and geometry, into a structured map representation, thereby utilizing object units exclusively to drive the camera relocalization task. To this end, we propose OpenReLoc, a camera relocalization system designed to provide scene understanding and accurate pose estimation capabilities. Leveraging recent foundation models, we first introduce a multi-modal mechanism to integrate open-vocabulary semantic knowledge for effective 2D-3D object matching. Additionally, we design object-oriented reference frames as position priors, paired with a reference frame selection strategy based on the Distance-IoU (DIOU), enabling extension to scalable scenes. Moreover, to ensure stable and accurate pose optimization, we also propose a dual-path 2D Iterative Closest Pixel loss guided by object shape. Experimental results demonstrate that OpenReLoc achieves superior relocalization recall and accuracy across various datasets. Our source code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OpenReLoc，一个利用开放词汇语义理解的对象级表示进行室内视觉重定位的系统。通过多模态机制融合开放词汇语义知识实现2D-3D对象匹配，设计对象参考帧和基于DIOU的选择策略，以及双路径2D迭代最近像素损失。实验表明在多个数据集上取得优越的重定位召回率和精度。
Motivation: 现有室内重定位研究主要依赖低级视觉方案，难以感知场景语义和组成，限制了可解释性和应用性。需要一种组织对象信息（语义、布局、几何）的结构化地图表示来驱动重定位。
Method: 基于基础模型，提出多模态机制集成开放词汇语义知识进行2D-3D对象匹配；设计对象参考帧作为位置先验，结合基于距离IoU的参考帧选择策略；提出由对象形状引导的双路径2D迭代最近像素损失用于稳定精确的位姿优化。
Result: 实验表明OpenReLoc在多个数据集上实现了优越的重定位召回率和精度。
Conclusion: 本文证明利用开放词汇理解的对象级表示可以有效提升室内视觉重定位性能，代码将开源。

papers.title: UniDrive: A Unified Vision-Language and Grounding Framework for Interpretable Risk Understanding in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for autonomous driving scene understanding, yet existing methods still face a fundamental trade-off between temporal reasoning and spatial precision. Models that rely on single-frame or low-resolution inputs often miss small, distant, or partially occluded hazards, while language-centric driving models frequently provide limited grounded evidence for their explanations. To address this gap, we propose UniDrive, a unified visual-language and grounding framework for interpretable risk understanding in autonomous driving. UniDrive combines a temporal reasoning branch that models scene dynamics from multi-frame visual input with a high-resolution perception branch that preserves fine-grained spatial details from the latest frame. The two branches are integrated through a gated cross-attention fusion module, enabling dynamic context to be aligned with precise spatial evidence. Based on the fused representation, UniDrive jointly generates natural-language risk descriptions and grounded bounding-box outputs for risk objects. Experiments on the DRAMA-Reasoning benchmark show that UniDrive outperforms representative image-based and video-based baselines in both captioning and risk-object grounding. In particular, UniDrive achieves the best overall performance on the validation split and demonstrates clear advantages in small-object localization, zero-shot generalization to NuScenes and BDD100K, and human-rated interpretability and trustworthiness. These results suggest that explicitly combining temporal semantics and high-resolution perception provides a stronger foundation for interpretable and safety-oriented autonomous driving systems. The code is available at https://github.com/pixeli99/unidrive-dev.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniDrive，一种统一的视觉语言与定位框架，用于自动驾驶中可解释的风险理解。该框架结合时间推理分支（建模多帧场景动态）和高分辨率感知分支（保留最新帧精细空间细节），通过门控交叉注意力融合，联合生成风险自然语言描述和风险物体的边界框。在DRAMA-Reasoning基准上，UniDrive在描述生成和风险物体定位方面均优于图像和视频基线，尤其在小型物体定位、零样本泛化（NuScenes、BDD100K）以及人类评级的可解释性和可信度上表现突出。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在自动驾驶场景理解中面临时间推理与空间精度之间的权衡：单帧或低分辨率输入常漏检小型、远处或部分遮挡的危险，而语言驱动的模型缺乏定位证据。
Method: UniDrive包含两个分支：时间推理分支从多帧视觉输入建模场景动态，高分辨率感知分支从最新帧保留精细空间细节。两者通过门控交叉注意力融合模块整合，使动态上下文与精确空间证据对齐，并基于融合表示联合生成风险描述和边界框。
Result: 在DRAMA-Reasoning基准上，UniDrive在验证集上取得最佳整体性能，并在小目标定位、零样本泛化至NuScenes和BDD100K以及人类评级的可解释性和可信度上展现出明显优势。
Conclusion: 明确结合时间语义和高分辨率感知为可解释、安全导向的自动驾驶系统提供了更强的基础。

papers.title: Adaptive Hebbian Memory Routing in Vision Transformers for Few-Shot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot image recognition requires models to adapt to new classes from a small labeled support set. Hebbian fast-weight memory can provide temporary associative information during an episode, but fixed memory behavior may not be appropriate for every few-shot task. In this work, we propose Adaptive Hebbian Routing for few-shot Vision Transformers. The method uses a lightweight MLP router to control the contribution of Hebbian memory, the strength of memory updates, and the retention of previous memory from support-set features. We study Adaptive Placement, Adaptive Plasticity, and Fully Adaptive Hebbian Routing. Experiments use ViT-Small, DeiT-Small, and Swin-Tiny under 5-way 1-shot evaluation on Omniglot, CIFAR-FS, and cross-domain transfer from CIFAR-FS to Omniglot. In the direct Swin comparison, fixed and adaptive Hebbian variants use the same memory location. Adaptive Plasticity improves the fixed Hebbian result from 96.74\% to 96.92\%, while Fully Adaptive Routing achieves the best result at 96.94\%. The fully adaptive Swin model also reduces inference time from 16.51 ms to 14.05 ms relative to fixed Hebbian Swin. On CIFAR-FS, adaptive variants improve performance across all three backbones, and the multi-shot evaluation shows that these gains remain useful as the number of support examples increases. These results show that adaptive plasticity and adaptive memory activation can improve few-shot Transformer representations beyond fixed Hebbian behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应赫布路由（Adaptive Hebbian Routing）改进少样本视觉Transformer，通过轻量MLP路由器控制赫布记忆的贡献、更新强度和保留。在Omniglot、CIFAR-FS及跨域迁移任务上，基于ViT-Small、DeiT-Small和Swin-Tiny的5-way 1-shot评测显示，全自适应路由在Swin上达到96.94%准确率，并降低推理延迟。
Motivation: 固定赫布记忆行为不适合所有少样本任务，需要自适应机制来调节记忆的贡献、更新和保留。
Method: 提出自适应赫布路由，包括自适应放置（Adaptive Placement）、自适应可塑性（Adaptive Plasticity）和全自适应路由（Fully Adaptive Routing），通过MLP路由器动态控制记忆参数。
Result: 在Swin-Tiny上，自适应可塑性将固定赫布结果从96.74%提升至96.92%，全自适应路由达96.94%，推理时间从16.51ms降至14.05ms。在CIFAR-FS上，所有自适应变体均提升性能，且多shot评估显示增益持续存在。
Conclusion: 自适应可塑性和自适应记忆激活能够改善少样本Transformer表示，超越固定赫布行为。

papers.title: Can Scale Save Us From Plasticity Loss in Large Language Models?
papers.abstract_en: The loss of plasticity - the ability of a network to learn new information after having already learned older information - is a fundamental challenge in creating artificial neural networks capable of continual learning. Although this phenomenon has been known for decades, it has mostly been studied in older, relatively small architectures and rarely in natural-language domains. To determine whether loss of plasticity remains a problem in the modern transformer-based LLM paradigm, we study plasticity loss in GPT-style Transformer models trained on a multilingual continual learning problem. Consistent with prior work, we find evidence of plasticity loss across models ranging from 5M to 314M non-embedding parameters, as measured by deterioration on a held-out Vietnamese probing task. We further find that the onset of plasticity loss follows a predictable scaling law, growing sublinearly with model size. These results suggest that larger models may delay the measurable effects of plasticity loss, but that increasing parameter count alone is likely to be insufficient to completely prevent it. We also find evidence of plasticity loss under stationary multilingual training, challenging the view that the phenomenon is exclusive to continual learning with abrupt task changes. Overall, our results suggest that even large Transformer language models trained on natural-language will eventually lose the ability to efficiently adapt to new data after sufficiently long training, in both continual and stationary settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型中的可塑性损失（plasticity loss）问题，即在学习新信息后丧失学习能力。通过对GPT-style Transformer模型（5M至314M参数）进行多语言持续学习实验，发现可塑性损失随模型规模增大而亚线性增长，但增大参数量不足以完全避免。此外，在静止多语言训练中也观察到可塑性损失，表明该现象不仅限于任务突变的持续学习场景。
Motivation: 可塑性损失是神经网络持续学习的根本挑战，但以往研究多集中于小型旧架构，鲜有在自然语言领域尤其是现代Transformer大语言模型中进行验证。本文旨在填补这一空白，探究可塑性损失是否仍存在于大语言模型中。
Method: 采用GPT-style Transformer模型，参数规模从5M到314M（非嵌入参数），在持续学习设定下进行多语言（包含越南语探测任务）训练，通过探测任务性能退化衡量可塑性损失，并分析其与模型规模的标度律关系。
Result: 发现可塑性损失遵循可预测的标度律，随模型规模增长呈亚线性增长；增大参数仅能延迟可塑性损失的显现，不能完全阻止；此外，在静止多语言训练（非持续学习）中也观察到可塑性损失。
Conclusion: 即使是大型Transformer语言模型，在经过足够长的训练后，无论持续学习还是静止训练场景，都将失去有效适应新数据的能力，单纯的规模扩展不足以解决可塑性损失问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Task-Specific LLM Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across a growing range of domains, yet their scale poses deployment challenges in applications where latency and cost constraints are critical. This paper derives empirical scaling laws for domain-specific LLM compression, quantifying how in-domain and general knowledge performance scale with dataset size, compression ratio, supervision format, and iterative pruning schedule. Using quantitative finance as our application domain, we compare logit-based and LoRA-based distillation under iterative structural pruning, introducing a blended chain-of-thought supervision loss that stabilizes KL-divergence distillation over reasoning traces. In-domain task quality degrades predictably under compression while general-knowledge benchmarks collapse well before the same point; supervision format is the key driver of this tradeoff, with chain-of-thought supervision actively recovering general knowledge that pruning erases. We release the headline dataset FinHeadlineMix, scaling law results, and practical recommendations to provide a reusable framework for domain-specific compression decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
