papers.title: Beyond U-Net: A Latent-Representation-Aligned Skip-Free Backbone for Flow-Matching Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Generative models, particularly diffusion and score-based approaches, have recently achieved strong performance in speech enhancement, but their iterative sampling process limits real-time deployment. Flow Matching offers an efficient alternative by transporting noisy speech toward clean speech through an ordinary differential equation with few function evaluations. In this work, we propose a skip-free encoder-decoder backbone for flow-matching speech enhancement, guided by Latent Representation Alignment (LRA). Instead of relying on U-Net skip connections, which may transfer noise-correlated low-level features to the decoder, the proposed model aligns its bottleneck and decoder representations with clean latent features extracted from a frozen Descript Audio Codec encoder-decoder without quantization. This codec-aligned supervision promotes compact clean-speech representations while preserving efficient few-step inference. Experiments on WSJ0-CHiME3 and VoiceBank-DEMAND show improved PESQ and perceptual quality, especially on VoiceBank-DEMAND, using only five function evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无跳跃连接的编码器-解码器骨干网络，用于流匹配（Flow Matching）语音增强，通过潜在表示对齐（LRA）将瓶颈和decoder表示与从冻结的Descript Audio Codec提取的干净潜在特征对齐。实验在WSJ0-CHiME3和VoiceBank-DEMAND数据集上显示，仅需5次函数评估即可改进PESQ和感知质量，尤其在VoiceBank-DEMAND上表现更佳。
Motivation: U-Net的跳跃连接可能传输与噪声相关的低级特征，影响语音增强质量。本文旨在消除跳跃连接，并通过对齐干净潜在表示来改善语音增强性能。
Method: 提出无跳跃连接的编码器-解码器骨干网络，通过潜在表示对齐（LRA）将瓶颈和decoder表示与从冻结的Descript Audio Codec提取的干净潜在特征对齐，无需量化。
Result: 在WSJ0-CHiME3和VoiceBank-DEMAND数据集上，仅需5次函数评估（function evaluations），取得了改进的PESQ和感知质量，尤其在VoiceBank-DEMAND上表现更佳。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提出的对齐监督促进了紧凑的干净语音表示，同时保持了高效少步推理，适用于实时部署。

papers.title: BioMedVR: Confusion-Aware Mixture-of-Prompt Experts for Biomedical Visual Reprogramming
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP have demonstrated strong generalization across natural-image domains. However, adapting these models to biomedical imaging is non-trivial: full-model fine-tuning is computationally expensive, while medical data are often scarce and exhibit subtle, fine-grained inter-class differences, making parameter-efficient adaptation particularly critical. Visual Reprogramming (VR) offers a parameter-efficient alternative by injecting learnable perturbations into the input space, but existing VR approaches for VLMs mainly focus on positive class prompts and overlook confusing negatives, leading to miscalibrated predictions in fine-grained medical scenarios. We present BioMedVR, the first VR-based framework for biomedical imaging, enabling few-shot adaptation of pretrained VLMs through compact learnable VR modules. To mitigate class confusion, we introduce a Confusion Minimization Mechanism that leverages LLM-generated confusion-aware attributes together with a Confusion-Suppression Loss to explicitly reduce false-positive alignment. Moreover, the designed Mixture-of-Prompt Experts combines a positive expert for main-class discrimination and a negative expert for confusion suppression, balanced via adaptive gating. Extensive experiments on 18 datasets, including 11 biomedical datasets and 7 natural image benchmarks, demonstrate that BioMedVR achieves superior accuracy and generalization, effectively bridging VR and VLMs in biomedical domains.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. 19 pages, 6 figures. Project page: https://jxliu-ai.github.io/biomedvr-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BioMedVR，首个基于视觉重编程（VR）的生物医学成像框架，通过可学习的VR模块实现预训练视觉语言模型（如CLIP）的小样本自适应。引入混淆最小化机制，利用大语言模型生成的混淆感知属性和混淆抑制损失来减少假阳性对齐，并设计混合提示专家（MoPE）平衡正类和负类鉴别。在18个数据集（包括11个生物医学数据集和7个自然图像基准）上展示了优越的准确性和泛化能力。
Motivation: 将预训练VLM适应到生物医学成像存在挑战：全模型微调计算昂贵，医疗数据稀缺且类别间差异细微。现有视觉重编程方法主要关注正类提示，忽略了混淆的负类，导致预测校准不佳。
Method: 方法包括：1) 混淆最小化机制，利用LLM生成混淆感知属性，结合混淆抑制损失减少假阳性。2) 混合提示专家（Mixture-of-Prompt Experts），包含正类专家和负类专家，通过自适应门控平衡。
Result: 在18个数据集（11个生物医学+7个自然图像）上，BioMedVR实现了优越的准确性和泛化。
Conclusion: 该工作有效桥接了VR和VLM在生物医学领域的应用，参数高效，解决了类混淆问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VSANet: View-aware Sparse Attention Network for Light Field Image Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Light field (LF) image denoising is challenging due to the high-dimensional structure of LF data. While noise is independent across sub-aperture images, scene content exhibits strong cross-view correlations. We introduce VSANet, a view-aware sparse attention network for LF denoising. Specifically, we propose a view-aware sparse attention (VSA) block that represents the 4D LF feature map as a unified spatial-angular token space and performs cross-view aggregation via locality-sensitive hashing-based sparse attention. This enables global feature interactions with linear complexity, effectively exploiting LF correlations across views and spatial locations. In addition, we design a feature refinement (FR) block to emphasize informative features in spatial, angular, and epipolar subspaces. The VSA and FR blocks are integrated within a sequential attention refinement module, forming the core of VSANet. Experiments demonstrate VSANet outperforms stateof-the-art LF denoising methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VSANet，一种基于视图感知稀疏注意力的光场图像去噪网络。通过视图感知稀疏注意力（VSA）模块将4D光场特征图统一为空间-角度令牌空间，并利用局部敏感哈希稀疏注意力实现线性复杂度的全局特征交互。特征细化（FR）模块增强空间、角度和对极子空间中的信息特征。实验表明VSANet优于最先进的光场去噪方法。
Motivation: 光场图像去噪因数据的高维结构而具有挑战性，噪声在子孔径图像间独立但场景内容存在强跨视角相关性，现有方法难以高效利用这些相关性。
Method: 提出视图感知稀疏注意力（VSA）模块，将4D光场特征图视为统一空间-角度令牌空间，通过局部敏感哈希（LSH）实现稀疏注意力进行跨视角聚合，复杂度为线性。同时设计特征细化（FR）模块突出空间、角度和对极子空间中的信息特征。VSA和FR集成于顺序注意力细化模块中。
Result: 实验表明VSANet在定量和定性指标上均优于现有最先进的光场去噪方法。
Conclusion: VSANet通过视图感知稀疏注意力有效利用光场跨视角相关性，为高维光场数据处理提供了高效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Task Decomposition for Efficient Annotation
papers.abstract_en: High-quality annotations of structured representations are expensive to collect over large corpora. Manual annotation of structure is laborious, and model-based annotation, although cheaper to generate, requires expensive validation and potentially significant supervision to ensure that the annotation quality is strong enough to be useful downstream. In traditional annotation workflows, annotation of each complete example is performed end-to-end by a single annotator. However, structured annotation is complex, and each aspect of the task represents a unique challenge with an associated inferential load for a given annotator. Modern annotation projects can incorporate heterogeneous groups of annotators, including both models and human annotators with varying domain and linguistic expertise. It remains unclear, however, how to redesign annotation tasks in this setting, where efforts are discriminately allocated across heterogeneous annotators with respect to distinct annotation challenges. We propose to decompose annotation tasks into sub-tasks in order to reduce the aggregate inferential load of annotation projects. Inspired by the notion of centers from centering theory, we introduce a formal model of inferential load based on the degrees of freedom in the space of valid annotations. Using this model, we show that identifying these centers (i.e. salient anchor entities realized by annotation sub-tasks) constrains the output space complexity, and decompositions which isolate and advance center identification reduce the aggregate inferential load. We provide guidelines for decomposing complex structured annotation tasks, supported by examples demonstrating improved cost-efficiency from our prior work. Finally, we present a procedure for allocating sub-tasks across annotators to maximize quality under a fixed budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过任务分解（task decomposition）来降低结构化标注项目中的聚合推理负载（aggregate inferential load），从而提高标注效率。作者引入基于中心理论（centering theory）的推理负载形式化模型，证明识别标注子任务中的中心（centers）能约束输出空间复杂度，并提供分解复杂结构化标注任务的指南和子任务分配流程，以在固定预算下最大化质量。
Motivation: 高质量结构化标注成本高昂，传统端到端标注方式在异构标注者（包括模型和不同专业背景的人类）场景下效率低下，缺乏针对不同标注挑战的任务再设计方法。
Method: 提出任务分解方法，基于中心理论定义推理负载模型，通过识别标注子任务中的中心来降低输出空间复杂度，并给出分解指南和子任务分配流程。
Result: 通过先前工作中的示例表明，该方法能提高成本效率。
Conclusion: 任务分解能有效降低结构化标注的聚合推理负载，提升标注效率，但需根据具体任务设计分解策略。

papers.title: SER: Learning to Ground Video Reasoning with Semantic Evidence Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Video MLLMs often struggle with fine-grained spatio-temporal reasoning, sometimes generating correct answers based on irrelevant frames or objects. Although outputting spatio-temporal evidence during reasoning is a promising direction, existing RL frameworks typically rely on geometry-only (IoU) rewards, which can be sensitive to boundary perturbations and overlook semantic alignment. To address this, we propose Semantic Evidence Reward (SER), which reformulates spatio-temporal evidence grounding as a constrained verification task. Instead of computing pixel-level overlap, SER uses a referee VLM as a local checker to evaluate model-generated evidence claims across two dimensions: relevance and localization quality, combined with a temporal penalty. This design reduces the reliance on dense box annotations and enables training directly on standard video QA data. On the V-STAR benchmark, SER achieves 49.6% mLGM, improving by 3.0 points over the strong evidence-grounded baseline Open-o3-Video, demonstrating its potential in enhancing both answer accuracy and evidence grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频多模态大语言模型在细粒度时空推理中依赖无关帧或对象生成正确答案的问题，提出语义证据奖励（SER），将时空证据定位重构为约束验证任务。SER使用裁判视觉语言模型评估模型生成的证据在相关性和定位质量两个维度的表现，并结合时间惩罚，减少对密集框标注的依赖。在V-STAR基准上，SER达到49.6%的mLGM，比强基线的Open-o3-Video提升3.0点，同时提高答案准确性和证据定位能力。
Motivation: 现有视频多模态大语言模型在时空推理中常基于无关帧或对象生成正确回答，而现有的强化学习框架仅依赖几何交并比（IoU）奖励，对边界扰动敏感且忽视语义对齐。
Method: 提出语义证据奖励（SER），将时空证据定位视为约束验证任务，使用裁判视觉语言模型评估证据的相关性和定位质量，并结合时间惩罚，避免密集框标注，直接在标准视频问答数据上训练。
Result: 在V-STAR基准上，SER取得49.6%的mLGM，比强基线Open-o3-Video提升3.0点，同时提升了答案准确性和证据定位能力。
Conclusion: SER通过语义对齐的奖励设计，有效提升了视频推理中时空证据的可靠性，减少了对密集标注的依赖，具有在更广泛视频推理任务中应用的潜力。

summary_sections.conclusion: SER通过语义对齐的奖励设计，有效提升了视频推理中时空证据的可靠性，减少了对密集标注的依赖，具有在更广泛视频推理任务中应用的潜力。

papers.title: Decentralised AI Training and Inference with BlockTrain
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI training is increasingly shaped by access to dense, centrally controlled accelerator clusters. This creates a structural advantage for hyperscalers and large centralized laboratories, and makes open or independent AI efforts depend on scarce capital, privileged infrastructure, and data-center geography. We present Spheroid BlockTrain, a decentralized training protocol in which a model is partitioned into independently trainable blocks, each optimized on a local objective derived from the same global target and composed at inference into one model. On byte-level WikiText, BlockTrain reaches cross entropy 1.359 (perplexity 3.89), within about 0.04 CE of a same-setup end-to-end Transformer reference, while each active worker trains only one block and avoids full-model optimizer state. A shared six-worker block training run reaches CE 1.385 by averaging same-block updates into one assembled model. HTTP/TCP transport experiments move real serialized checkpoints and updates, including a public-IP three-host run that improves CE from 5.580 to 1.811 while moving 15.22 GB. For inference, the current BlockTrain path uses one block-stack traversal per full output and serves over direct TCP across three public-network GPU hosts up to a 75.80B-parameter logical fp16 shape, outperforming a matched plain-autoregressive TCP pipeline baseline because it emits a full sequence per WAN pipeline traversal rather than one token per traversal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spheroid BlockTrain，一种去中心化的训练协议，将模型分区为独立可训练的块，每个块针对由同一全局目标导出的局部目标优化，并在推理时组合。在字节级 WikiText 上达到交叉熵 1.359（困惑度 3.89），接近端到端 Transformer 参考结果，同时每个工作节点仅训练一个块，避免全模型优化器状态。HTTP/TCP 传输实验展示了实际序列化检查点和更新的移动，包括公共 IP 三主机运行，将 CE 从 5.580 改善到 1.811，传输量 15.22 GB。推理方面，当前 BlockTrain 路径使用一次块堆栈遍历生成完整输出，通过直接 TCP 在三个公共网络 GPU 主机上提供服务，支持高达 75.80B 参数的逻辑 fp16 形状，优于普通自回归 TCP 管线基线。
Motivation: 前沿 AI 训练日益依赖密集、集中控制的加速器集群，这为超大规模企业和大型集中实验室创造了结构性优势，使开放或独立的 AI 工作依赖于稀缺资本、特权基础设施和数据中心地理位置。
Method: 提出 Spheroid BlockTrain，一个去中心化训练协议，将模型划分为可独立训练的块，每个块在来自同一全局目标的局部目标上优化，并在推理时组合成一个模型。
Result: 在字节级 WikiText 上达到交叉熵 1.359（困惑度 3.89），与相同设置的端到端 Transformer 参考相差约 0.04 CE；六工作节点块训练运行通过平均相同块的更新达到 CE 1.385；公共 IP 三主机运行将 CE 从 5.580 改善到 1.811，传输量 15.22 GB；推理时支持 75.80B 参数逻辑 fp16 形状，优于普通自回归 TCP 管线基线。
Conclusion: BlockTrain 协议证明了去中心化训练和推理的可行性，减少了集中式基础设施的依赖，但当前仍在探索阶段，需进一步评估其扩展性和训练效率。

papers.title: Evaluating the Interpretability of Sparse Autoencoders with Concept Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly used to extract interpretable concepts from vision and vision language models, yet existing evaluation methods largely rely on proxy metrics or qualitative inspection rather than measuring semantic correspondence. We present a human-grounded evaluation framework that quantifies alignment between SAE latents and human-annotated concepts, without requiring user studies, and validate this matching through targeted attribute perturbations. To enable this intervention-style evaluation in vision, we construct synCUB and synCOCO, synthetic benchmarks of paired images that differ in exactly one attribute. We introduce Fully-Binary Matching Pursuit (FBMP), a coalition-based matching procedure that supports many-to-one mappings between SAE latents and annotated concepts, and consistently outperforms one-to-one baselines. For functional validation, we propose a Targeted Attribute Perturbation Alignment Score (TAPAScore), which tests whether matched concepts respond selectively and in the expected direction under targeted image-level attribute perturbations. Under sanity checks, our matching and TAPAScore are the only evaluated metrics that reliably distinguish trained SAEs from untrained ones. Across SAEs trained on CLIP and DINOv2 embeddings, we find that increased overcompleteness can reduce perturbation alignment, indicating a reduction in interpretability. Our evaluation framework suggests that moderate dictionary sizes provide the best trade-off, yielding the most interpretable SAEs. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/JonasKlotz/sae-concept-eval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于人类标注概念的评价框架，用于量化稀疏自编码器（SAE）潜在变量与语义概念之间的对齐程度，无需用户研究。为了支持视觉领域的干预式评估，作者构建了synCUB和synCOCO合成基准，并引入完全二元匹配追踪（FBMP）实现多对多匹配。此外提出目标属性扰动对齐分数（TAPAScore）进行功能验证。实验表明，增加过完备性可能降低扰动对齐，适中的字典大小能提供最佳可解释性。
Motivation: 现有SAE可解释性评估多依赖代理指标或定性检查，缺乏对语义对应的直接度量。
Method: 提出基于人类标注概念的评价框架，包括完全二元匹配追踪（FBMP）匹配方法和目标属性扰动对齐分数（TAPAScore），以及合成基准synCUB和synCOCO。
Result: 在CLIP和DINOv2嵌入上训练的SAE上，发现过完备性增加会降低扰动对齐，表明可解释性下降；适中的字典大小能提供最佳可解释性。在完整性检查中，所提出的匹配和TAPAScore是唯一能可靠区分训练和未训练SAE的指标。
Conclusion: 该评价框架表明适中的字典大小对于可解释性最佳。

papers.title: Model selection with proper scoring rules on data sets of time series
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of model selection between probabilistic models on data sets of time series. Chosen a proper scoring rule, we denote by the term \textit{score} the average value of the scoring rule on the test of an individual time series. For model selection, we need aggregating the values of the scores across multiple time series. Three summary statistics are commonly used for model selection: mean score, median score, and mean rank. Results in previous papers show that these statistics can yield conflicting decisions; we show how the conflicting conclusions are due to the skewness of the distribution of scores. We also show that as the test set of each time series of the data set increases, the different model selection criteria progressively converge to the same conclusion. However, for short tests sets, only the mean score identifies the true model as the best. We illustrate these phenomena with an analysis on intermittent time series, including the data set of the M5 competition, where we underline the importance of having a large test set. In such experiments, we further notice that model selection based on mean ranks remains unchanged using different scaling factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列数据集上概率模型的模型选择问题，使用适当的评分规则。通过分析多个时间序列上得分的分布偏度，解释为什么均值、中位数和平均秩等统计量会产生冲突的决策。实验表明，随着测试集增大，不同准则趋于一致；但对于短测试集，只有均值能正确识别最佳模型。
Motivation: 在时间序列数据集上进行概率模型选择时，常用的均值、中位数和平均秩统计量可能给出冲突的决策，需要理解其原因并确定在何种情况下哪种统计量更可靠。
Method: 利用适当评分规则（proper scoring rules）计算每个时间序列测试集上的平均得分（score），然后通过均值、中位数和平均秩三种方式汇总多个时间序列的分数，并进行理论分析和模拟实验。
Result: 冲突决策源于得分分布的偏度；随着测试集增大，不同准则趋于一致；但对于短测试集，只有均值能识别真模型为最佳。在M5竞赛的间断时间序列数据上，平均秩基于不同缩放因子保持不变。
Conclusion: 短测试集时均值得分更可靠，但大测试集更为重要。模型选择时需考虑得分分布特性。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: TACTFUL: Tactile-Driven Exploration For Object Localization and Identification in Confined Environments
papers.abstract_en: Humans effortlessly locate and identify objects by touch alone, even without vision. In contrast, robotic systems rely heavily on vision and struggle with autonomous tactile exploration and object identification. We present TACTFUL, a vision-free tactile exploration framework that enables a multi-fingered robot to autonomously explore confined workspaces, discover objects through contact, and identify them via tactile reconstruction. Trained entirely on real hardware without simulation, our system learns a single policy that balances global workspace exploration with local surface refinement through a dynamic reward schedule. Our results demonstrate that tactile sensing, when paired with structured learning, can serve as an effective primary modality for object-level reasoning, achieving 77% success with 0.015 m average reconstruction error and outperforming baseline approaches on real-world objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TACTFUL，一种无需视觉的触觉探索框架，使多指机器人能够在受限空间中自主探索、通过接触发现物体并利用触觉重建进行识别。系统完全在真实硬件上训练，无需仿真，通过动态奖励调度平衡全局工作空间探索与局部表面细化。实验表明触觉感知结合结构化学习可有效用于物体级推理，实现了77%的成功率、0.015m平均重建误差，在真实物体上优于基线方法。
Motivation: 机器人系统过度依赖视觉，缺乏自主触觉探索和物体识别能力，而人类可以仅凭触觉轻松定位和识别物体。
Method: 提出一种无需视觉的触觉探索框架TACTFUL，采用动态奖励调度策略，使多指机器人学习单一策略同时平衡全局探索与局部表面细化，全部在真实硬件上训练。
Result: 在真实物体上实现77%的成功率、0.015m平均重建误差，优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 触觉感知与结构化学习结合可作为物体级推理的有效主要模态。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Fourier-Wavelet Transformer for Multiscale Computational Fluid Dynamics Surrogate Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed surrogate models can accelerate computational fluid dynamics simulations. However, many existing methods reproduce global flow patterns more reliably than localized multiscale structures. This study presents a physics-informed Fourier-wavelet transformer for next-step velocity-field reconstruction in real-world flow benchmarks. The proposed formulation combines hybrid Fourier-wavelet spectral encoding with physics-biased self-attention based on partial differential equation residual diagnostics. It also uses self-supervised pretraining through Masked Physics Prediction and Equation Consistency Prediction. The experiments are conducted on two real benchmark cases: cylinder-wake flow and fluid-structure interaction. All approaches are evaluated under a shared local protocol and compared with spectral, transformer-based, operator-learning, and physics-informed neural-network baselines. On the cylinder-wake benchmark, the proposed model achieves the best aggregate accuracy, with an all-channel normalized mean-squared error of 0.05875 and an all-channel Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.97019. On the fluid-structure-interaction benchmark, it gives the lowest all-channel normalized mean-squared error of $2.70 \times 10^{-4}$, compared with $4.02 \times 10^{-4}$ for the strongest baseline. Component-wise field comparisons and scale-separated diagnostics further show stronger recovery of localized wake structures, including near-body, wake-core, and far-wake features. The results demonstrate improved real-world flow reconstruction while maintaining a practical accuracy-cost tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理信息傅里叶-小波变换器，用于多尺度计算流体动力学代理建模。该方法结合混合傅里叶-小波谱编码和基于偏微分方程残差诊断的物理偏置自注意力，并通过掩码物理预测和方程一致性预测进行自监督预训练。在圆柱尾流和流固耦合两个真实基准上，该方法在归一化均方误差和皮尔逊相关系数上均优于谱方法、变压器、算子学习和物理信息神经网络等基线，特别是在局部尾流结构的恢复上表现更优。
Motivation: 现有物理信息代理模型能加速CFD模拟，但在捕捉局部多尺度结构上不如全局流型可靠，因此需要改进对局部多尺度流动的建模能力。
Method: 提出物理信息傅里叶-小波变换器，核心包括混合傅里叶-小波谱编码和基于PDE残差诊断的物理偏置自注意力，并采用掩码物理预测和方程一致性预测的自监督预训练策略。
Result: 在圆柱尾流基准上，全通道归一化均方误差0.05875，皮尔逊相关系数0.97019；在流固耦合基准上，全通道归一化均方误差2.70×10⁻⁴，最强基线为4.02×10⁻⁴。分量比较和尺度分离诊断显示更强的局部尾流结构恢复能力。
Conclusion: 该方法在真实流动重建中实现了精度与成本的良好平衡，尤其对近体、尾流核心和远尾流特征恢复更好。摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: FlowPipe: LLM-Enhanced Conditional Generative Flow Networks for Data Preparation Pipeline Construction
papers.abstract_en: Data preparation pipelines improve data quality in machine learning by transforming raw tables into learning-ready data through sequential cleaning and feature transformation operators. However, automatically constructing such pipelines is computationally difficult because operator sequences are combinatorial and end-to-end evaluation is expensive. Existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) Multi-DQN methods still face three key limitations: decoupled value estimators weaken long-horizon credit assignment, dataset context is only weakly injected into the policy, and exploration is inefficient in a sparse search space with many invalid states. To address these issues, we propose FlowPipe, a unified framework that formulates pipeline synthesis as conditional probabilistic flow generation over a directed acyclic graph. FlowPipe uses Conditional Generative Flow Networks (C-GFlowNets) with a Trajectory Balance objective to connect terminal validation rewards with early pipeline decisions. It further introduces Deep Semantic Modulation through Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM), allowing LLM-derived logical priors to condition the policy's internal activations according to dataset semantics. In addition, FlowPipe incorporates failure awareness into the flow objective to avoid invalid states and concentrate search on high-potential regions. Experiments on two benchmark suites with 74 real-world datasets show that FlowPipe outperforms SOTA baselines, improving accuracy by 11.96% on average and achieving 12.5x faster training convergence. Source code is available at https://github.com/KunyuNi/FlowPipe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowPipe，一个基于条件生成流网络（C-GFlowNets）的统一框架，用于自动构建数据准备管道。通过轨迹平衡目标将终端验证奖励与早期决策连接，并利用LLM推导的逻辑先验通过FiLM调整策略内部激活。引入失败感知流目标避免无效状态。在74个真实数据集上平均提升11.96%准确率，训练收敛速度提升12.5倍。
Motivation: 现有方法（如Multi-DQN）面临三个方面限制：解耦的价值估计器削弱长时信用分配、数据集上下文仅弱注入策略、在稀疏搜索空间中探索低效。需要更有效的管道合成方法。
Method: 将管道合成建模为有向无环图上的条件概率流生成；使用C-GFlowNets和轨迹平衡目标；引入深度语义调制（DSM）通过FiLM使LLM推导的逻辑先验根据数据集语义调节策略；加入失败感知流目标避免无效状态。
Result: 在两个基准套件74个真实数据集上，FlowPipe优于现有方法，平均准确率提升11.96%，训练收敛速度提升12.5倍。
Conclusion: FlowPipe通过统一框架解决了管道合成中的关键挑战，并在多个实际数据集上验证了有效性。代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cost-Optimal Decision Diagrams for Stochastic Boolean Function Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: In many decision-making scenarios, acquiring information incurs different costs. We consider the problem of constructing a deterministic evaluation strategy that minimizes the expected cost of evaluating a propositional formula under variable costs and a probability distribution over truth assignments. We present a branch-and-bound algorithm with variable-selection heuristics, pruning, and caching. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first practical exact algorithm for this level of generality. Experiments on random instances demonstrate scalability and quantify the efficiency-quality trade-off of a greedy beam-search variant. We additionally evaluate a structured heart-disease diagnosis instance. Finally, we prove that the problem is $\#P$-hard and contained in $\mathrm{PSPACE}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在变量代价和真值分配概率下，最小化评估命题公式期望成本的确定性评估策略构造问题，提出带变量选择启发式、剪枝和缓存的回溯（branch-and-bound）精确算法，实验表明可伸缩性，并证明了问题#P-hard且属于PSPACE。
Motivation: 在信息获取代价不同的决策场景中，需要构造代价最优的评估策略，但缺乏精确算法。
Method: 提出回溯算法，包括变量选择启发式、剪枝和缓存，并给出贪心beam search变体的效率-质量权衡。
Result: 随机实例实验验证可伸缩性，并展示贪心beam search的效率-质量权衡；在结构化心脏病诊断实例上评估；证明问题#P-hard且属于PSPACE。
Conclusion: 首次提出该一般性问题的实用精确算法，理论边界被确定。

papers.title: LaGO: Latent Action Guidance for Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for planning and sequential decision-making, but prior work often relies on using them as direct controllers, which requires precise action generation and can be unreliable in practice. This paper proposes Latent Action Guidance for Online Reinforcement Learning (LaGO), a framework that uses a pretrained LLM as a latent action prior to softly guide online policy optimization, rather than treating the LLM as an explicit planner or controller. Experiments on both a discrete-control benchmark, CLEVR-Robot, and a continuous-control benchmark, Meta-World, demonstrate that LaGO consistently improves both reward and success rate over Vanilla PPO. In particular, LaGO increases the average success rate from 15.1% to 27.2% on CLEVR-Robot and from 2.7% to 15.2% on Meta-World. Our analysis further shows that stronger pretrained LLMs provide more effective guidance, suggesting that LLM knowledge can improve planning and online decision-making.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Large Language Models for Planning (LM4Plan)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LaGO 提出利用预训练大语言模型作为潜在动作先验，通过软指导在线强化学习策略优化，而非直接作为控制器。在离散控制基准 CLEVR-Robot 和连续控制基准 Meta-World 上，LaGO 一致提高了奖励和成功率，例如在 CLEVR-Robot 上将平均成功率从 15.1% 提升至 27.2%。分析表明更强的预训练 LLM 提供更有效的指导。
Motivation: 现有工作将大语言模型直接用作控制器需要精确动作生成，在实际中不可靠。作者希望利用 LLM 的知识以更稳健的方式指导在线强化学习。
Method: 提出 Latent Action Guidance (LaGO) 框架：使用预训练 LLM 作为潜在动作先验，在在线策略优化（如 PPO）中软性地引导策略更新，而非进行显式规划或直接控制。
Result: 在 CLEVR-Robot 上平均成功率从 15.1% 提升至 27.2%；在 Meta-World 上从 2.7% 提升至 15.2%。更强的 LLM 提供更有效的指导。
Conclusion: LaGO 表明 LLM 的知识可以提升在线决策和规划，且框架简单有效，可扩展到多种控制任务。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Extended pseudo-spectral physics-informed neural networks for phase-field models
papers.abstract_en: Phase-field models play a central role in the continuum description of phase separation, in which the bulk free-energy density and the interfacial thickness parameter determine pattern formation and microstructural evolution. In practice, these constitutive quantities are rarely known a priori and must be inferred from limited dynamical observations. In this work, an extended pseudo-spectral physics-informed neural network (ESPINN) framework is developed for the inverse identification of phase-field models from transient snapshot data. It enables the simultaneous recovery of both the bulk chemical potential and unknown gradient coefficients. Numerical experiments on the one-dimensional Cahn-Hilliard equation demonstrate accurate and statistically stable reconstruction in the noiseless regime, with substantial constitutive information recoverable from even a single snapshot pair. In the presence of noise, reconstruction accuracy degrades gracefully, and increasing the number of snapshots improves robustness by reducing variance across runs. These results establish ESPINN as a data-efficient and physically consistent approach for learning free-energy structure in continuum models of phase separation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种扩展伪谱物理信息神经网络（ESPINN）用于相场模型的逆辨识，从瞬态快照数据同时恢复体化学势和未知梯度系数。在一维Cahn-Hilliard方程上的数值实验表明，无噪声时重建准确且统计稳定，有噪声时性能退化缓慢，增加快照数量可提高鲁棒性。
Motivation: 相场模型中的体自由能密度和界面厚度参数很少先验已知，必须从有限的动态观测中推断，现有方法缺乏数据效率和物理一致性。
Method: 提出ESPINN框架，结合伪谱方法与物理信息神经网络，利用瞬态快照数据同时恢复体化学势和未知梯度系数。
Result: 在一维Cahn-Hilliard方程上，无噪声情况下能准确重建，单对快照即可恢复大量本构信息；有噪声时重建精度适度下降，增加快照数量可降低方差、提高鲁棒性。
Conclusion: ESPINN作为数据高效且物理一致的方法，用于学习相分离连续模型中的自由能结构。

papers.title: AI-PAVE-Br: Leveraging Large Language Models for Enhanced Product Attribute Value Extraction through a Golden Set Approach
papers.abstract_en: The explosive growth and complexity of product data within the dynamic Brazilian e-commerce landscape demand robust and specialized methods for structured information extraction. Traditional approaches to Product Attribute Value Extraction (PAVE) often struggle with the linguistic nuances and sheer diversity of product descriptions in Portuguese. To address this critical gap, this paper introduces two major contributions. First, we present AI-PAVEBr, a specialized system engineered with Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform high-accuracy PAVE specifically for Brazilian e-commerce catalogs. Second, to facilitate reproducible research and provide a definitive benchmark, we introduce and share the Golden Set, a new, meticulously curated, and manually annotated dataset for PAVE in Portuguese. We detail the creation process and structure (Entity, Category, Subcategories) of this high-quality reference set. Our experiments conclusively show that AI-PAVE-Br, leveraging targeted prompt engineering, dramatically outperforms conventional Named Entity Recognition (NER) baselines. This work not only delivers a superior, scalable solution for a major non-English market but also enriches the NLP community with a valuable, publicly available resource for future PAVE research.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 15th Symposium in Information and Human Language Technology (STIL 2025), Brazilian Computer Society (SBC), 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对巴西电商场景中的产品属性值提取（PAVE）任务，提出基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI-PAVE-Br系统，并构建了首个葡萄牙语PAVE黄金标准数据集（Golden Set）。实验表明，通过精心设计的提示工程，该系统显著优于传统命名实体识别（NER）基线。
Motivation: 巴西电商中产品描述的语言多样性和复杂性使得传统PAVE方法效果不佳，缺乏葡萄牙语PAVE的专用数据集和基准。
Method: 利用大语言模型（LLM）结合针对性的提示工程，构建AI-PAVE-Br系统；同时创建并公开一个手工标注的葡萄牙语PAVE黄金标准数据集（Golden Set），包含实体、类别和子类别结构。
Result: AI-PAVE-Br在葡萄牙语电商产品属性提取任务上显著优于传统NER基线。
Conclusion: 本文为巴西电商提供了可扩展的高精度PAVE解决方案，并为NLP社区贡献了首个葡萄牙语PAVE公开基准数据集。

papers.title: Agentic Collaborative Cognition for Zero-Shot 3D Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements have explored agentic zero-shot 3D understanding by reformulating it as video keyframe understanding with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, existing methods face an intrinsic bottleneck due to the finite observation perspectives inherent in videos and the implicit perception of 3D scenes. In this paper, we propose a collaborative multi-agent framework that assigns a Planning Agent to handle high-level viewpoint planning and supplement novel perspectives, and a Perception Agent to explicitly summarize the 3D scene into a structured holistic cognitive map. Specifically, Planning Agent first analyzes this cognitive map to determine query-relevant viewpoints and supplements missing critical perspectives to ensure comprehensive observation. Subsequently, Perception Agent documents object-level attributes from these views by assigning consistent instance identifiers across viewpoints, thereby integrating fragmented observations into the holistic cognitive map. In parallel, it provides feedback to filter out mismatched candidate objects and guide subsequent viewpoint planning. Through this closed-loop iterative process, two agents collaboratively figure out candidates until Perception Agent determines that sufficient information has been captured to complete the task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on 6 benchmarks, with improvements of 11.1\% Acc@0.5 on ScanRefer, 14.6 BLEU-1 on 3D-assisted dialog, and 2.1 EM on SQA3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个协作多智能体框架用于零样本3D场景理解，包含规划智能体（Planning Agent）和感知智能体（Perception Agent）。规划智能体分析当前认知图，确定查询相关视角并补充缺失视角；感知智能体从多视角中提取物体级属性并构建结构化整体认知图，同时反馈过滤不匹配候选对象。通过闭环迭代，两个智能体协同工作直至获得足够信息。在6个基准上达到SOTA，例如ScanRefer上Acc@0.5提升11.1%，3D辅助对话上BLEU-1提升14.6%，SQA3D上EM提升2.1。
Motivation: 现有基于视频关键帧的零样本3D理解方法受限于视频的有限观察视角和隐式3D感知，无法全面理解3D场景。
Method: 提出一个双智能体协作框架：规划智能体负责高层视角规划并补充新视角；感知智能体将碎片化观测显式总结为结构化整体认知图，并反馈以过滤错误候选对象。通过闭环迭代过程，两个智能体逐步缩小候选范围直至任务完成。
Result: 在6个基准上取得SOTA，包括ScanRefer上Acc@0.5提升11.1%，3D辅助对话上BLEU-1提升14.6%，SQA3D上EM提升2.1。
Conclusion: 通过规划与感知智能体的闭环迭代协作，能够弥补视频视角有限的问题，并显式建模3D场景结构，从而显著提升零样本3D理解性能。

summary_sections.conclusion: 通过规划与感知智能体的闭环迭代协作，能够弥补视频视角有限的问题，并显式建模3D场景结构，从而显著提升零样本3D理解性能。

papers.title: CineCap: Structured Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Anchors for Cinematographic Video Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Cinematographic captioning aims to describe how a video is filmed using professional film-language concepts such as camera movement, shot size, depth of field, composition, and shooting angle. This capability is important for fine-grained video understanding and controllable movie-quality video generation, yet remains underexplored in existing multimodal large language models. Unlike question-answering-based evaluation of cinematic understanding, cinematographic captioning requires a unified open-form description over multiple cinematographic dimensions. This task is challenging for two main reasons: the model must infer professional cinematographic concepts from subtle visual evidence, and it must generate captions that are both comprehensive and accurate. Accordingly, we propose CineCap, a framework that combines structured reasoning with spatio-temporal anchors and reinforcement learning with comprehensiveness, accuracy, and gated coverage rewards. The former grounds professional cinematographic descriptions in explicit visual evidence and organizes them into compact atomic reasoning for supervised fine-tuning, while the latter improves the balance between descriptive completeness and factual correctness. In addition, we construct CineCap Bench, a benchmark of 472 manually annotated video-caption pairs for systematic evaluation. Extensive experiments show that CineCap consistently outperforms strong proprietary and open-source baselines, establishing a new state of the art for cinematographic captioning. The code, model checkpoint, and benchmark are publicly available in https://github.com/Hectormxy/CineCap.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CineCap 框架，用于电影摄影描述（cinematographic captioning），即用专业电影语言概念（如镜头运动、景别、景深、构图、拍摄角度）描述视频。框架结合结构化推理（spatio-temporal anchors）与强化学习（全面性、准确性和门控覆盖奖励），并构建了包含472对人工标注的 CineCap Bench 基准。实验表明 CineCap 在电影摄影描述任务上超越现有专有和开源基线，达到新 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在电影摄影描述方面探索不足，该任务要求模型从细微视觉证据推断专业电影概念并生成全面准确的描述，现有方法难以兼顾全面性与准确性。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：1) 结构化推理模块，通过时空锚点（spatio-temporal anchors）将专业电影描述锚定到显式视觉证据，并组织为紧凑的原子推理用于监督微调；2) 强化学习阶段，使用全面性、准确性和门控覆盖（gated coverage）奖励来优化描述完整性与事实正确性的平衡。此外构建了 CineCap Bench 基准（472对人工标注视频-描述对）。
Result: 在 CineCap Bench 上，CineCap 一致优于强专有基线（如 GPT-4V）和开源基线，在所有评估维度上达到新 SOTA。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CineCap 通过结构化推理与强化学习结合，有效提升了电影摄影描述的全面性与准确性，但未讨论泛化到其他视频理解任务或计算开销等局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Visualizing "We the People": Bridging the Perception Gap through Pluralistic Data Storytelling
papers.abstract_en: Traditional visual data storytelling relies on binary graphics that depict two simplified groups in conflict. This can increase political polarization by oversimplifying intra-group disagreements and erasing ambiguity and shared ideas or values. This can inadvertently foster "us versus them" thinking. Intentional, pluralistic design choices for AI-enabled digital platforms can produce visualizations that emphasize nuance, opinion distribution, and intergroup commonalities. To demonstrate this potential, we examine deliberative technologies that map high-dimensional opinion spaces and highlight areas of both consensus and dissensus. The paper highlights the We the People deliberation conducted by Jigsaw and the Napolitan Institute in September 2025, which engaged over 2,400 Americans across all 435 congressional districts in an AI-supported, asynchronous dialogue regarding freedom and equality. By utilizing AI to synthesize long-form, text-based participant inputs into interactive "opinion landscapes," the initiative provided an alternative format for pluralistic data storytelling that humanized diverse viewpoints and revealed hidden areas of substantial broad consensus. The paper concludes that shifting from divisive, contrast-heavy visual frameworks to distribution-focused, interactive models represents a highly scalable, low-cost intervention capable of bridging perceptual gaps and cultivating a more resilient, collaborative democratic culture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批评传统视觉数据叙事使用二元图形加剧政治极化，提出多元主义设计可产生强调细微差别和共识的可视化。通过2025年9月Jigsaw和Napolitan研究所组织的“We the People”审议活动，展示了AI如何将2400多名美国参与者的长文本输入转化为交互式“意见景观”，从而人性化多样观点并揭示隐藏的广泛共识。
Motivation: 传统可视化过度简化群体内部分歧和共同价值，强化“我们对他们”的思维，加剧政治极化，需要新的设计方法来弥合感知差距。
Method: 利用AI支持的数字平台，将参与者长文本输入映射为高维意见空间，生成交互式“意见景观”，突出意见分布和群体间共同点。
Result: 案例表明，该干预措施能人性化不同观点并揭示广泛共识，是一种可扩展、低成本的方式，有助于减少极化。
Conclusion: 从冲突对比框架转向分布聚焦的交互模型，可以弥合感知差距，培养更有韧性的协作民主文化。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ArtiTwinSplat: Interactable Digital Twin Reconstruction via Gaussian Splatting from RGB-D videos
papers.abstract_en: Deploying robots in unstructured real-world environments needs accurate, interactive models of the objects. Constructing these models at scale remains a critical bottleneck for robotic system integration. We present ArtiTwinSplat, a framework that automatically constructs articulated, photo-realistic digital twins of objects directly from RGB-D videos, requiring no CAD models, simulation assets, or manual annotations. Our method is built on 3D Gaussian Splatting that preserve geometric fidelity and photometric realism, coupled with an unsupervised articulation discovery pipeline that recovers part structure and joint kinematics from observed motion alone. With tracking and optimization stages our method provides stable, queryable digital twins that support real-time rendering, viewpoint control, and interactive manipulation. Unlike prior methods confined to simulation, ArtiTwinSplat operates directly on real-world observations and produces twins that are immediately usable by downstream robot planning and learning systems. This method offers a practical, scalable pathway toward digital twin construction, lowering the integration barrier for articulated object manipulation in embodied AI and human-robot collaboration contexts.
papers.comment: Presented at the ICRA 2026 Workshop on Advances and Challenges in AI-Driven Automation and Robotic System Integration with Digital Twins, Vienna, June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArtiTwinSplat，一个从 RGB-D 视频自动构建可交互、照片级真实数字孪生的框架，无需 CAD 模型或手动标注。该方法基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 保持几何与光度真实性，并结合无监督关节发现，从观测运动恢复零件结构和关节运动学。生成的数字孪生支持实时渲染、视角控制和交互操作，可直接用于下游机器人规划与学习系统。
Motivation: 在非结构化真实环境中部署机器人需要精确且可交互的物体模型，但大规模构建此类模型是机器人系统集成的关键瓶颈。现有方法多局限于仿真环境，缺乏直接从真实观测构建可操作数字孪生的实用途径。
Method: 方法构建于 3D Gaussian Splatting 之上，以保持几何保真与光度真实感；同时引入无监督关节发现管道，仅从观测运动恢复部件结构与关节运动学。通过跟踪与优化阶段，生成稳定、可查询的数字孪生。
Result: 摘要报告该方法支持实时渲染、视角控制与交互操作，且生成的数字孪生可直接被机器人规划与学习系统使用，无需额外处理。
Conclusion: 该方法为铰接物体操作的数字孪生构建提供了实用且可扩展的途径，降低了在具身 AI 与人机协作中集成此类模型的障碍。

papers.title: SAFARI: Scaling Long Horizon Agentic Fault Attribution via Active Investigation
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous agents tackle increasingly complex multi-step, multi-agent tasks, their execution trajectories have scaled beyond the constraints of even the largest context windows. Current methods for effectively diagnosing agent failures load the full trajectory into an LLM's context window, which suffers from attention dilution and fails when agentic traces inevitably exceed context limits. To address this, we introduce SAFARI (Scaling long-horizon Agentic Fault AttRibution via active Investigation), a framework that replaces linear context loading with a tool-augmented diagnostic loop. By equipping LLMs with a specialized toolbox to read and search trajectory segments alongside a persistent Short-Term Memory (STM) for cross-turn reasoning, SAFARI effectively decouples diagnostic accuracy from architectural context limits. Our experiments demonstrate that SAFARI outperforms state-of-the-art results by 20% on the Who&When dataset within a 1M token budget, and by 19% on TRAIL GAIA subset on a 25K token budget. Most significantly, SAFARI maintains a 0.58 precision even when the target fault resides 5x beyond the model's native context window, a scenario where traditional evaluators fail entirely.
papers.comment: Published at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAFARI是一个用于扩展长程多智能体任务中故障归因的框架。它通过工具增强的诊断循环和短期记忆，取代了将完整轨迹加载到LLM上下文中的传统方法，从而在超出上下文限制时仍能有效诊断。实验表明，在Who&When数据集上，SAFARI在1M token预算下比现有方法提升20%，在TRAIL GAIA子集上以25K token预算提升19%。即使在目标故障位于模型原生上下文窗口5倍之外时，仍保持0.58的精确度。
Motivation: 现有方法将完整轨迹加载到LLM上下文窗口中进行故障诊断，但上下文窗口有限且存在注意力稀释问题，无法处理超出上下文限制的轨迹。
Method: SAFARI采用工具增强的诊断循环，为LLM配备专门的工具箱来读取和搜索轨迹片段，并引入短期记忆（STM）进行跨轮推理，将诊断准确性与架构上下文限制解耦。
Result: 在Who&When数据集上，SAFARI在1M token预算下比现有最优结果提升20%；在TRAIL GAIA子集上以25K token预算提升19%。当故障位于模型原生上下文窗口5倍之外时，精确度仍达0.58。
Conclusion: SAFARI通过主动调查机制有效扩展了长程任务故障归因的能力，在超出上下文限制时仍能保持性能。

papers.title: QC-SMOTE: Quality-Controlled SMOTE for Imbalanced Classification
papers.abstract_en: Class imbalance poses a significant challenge in classification, where existing methods such as SMOTE often generate low-quality synthetic samples in regions with noise or class overlap. We propose QC-SMOTE, a quality-controlled oversampling framework that estimates minority sample reliability using a composite neighbourhood trustworthiness score combining local density, safe-level, and isolation from the majority class. Synthetic candidates are generated using an IPQ-guided best-of-K strategy that evaluates midpoint purity and, when required, majority clearance, with allocation guided by sample reliability and boundary informativeness. Generation behaviour adapts across overlap--imbalance regimes, adjusting interpolation range and selection criteria to match local data geometry. Low-quality synthetic samples are replaced with original minority duplicates when neighbourhood purity falls below an adaptive threshold, providing graceful degradation by reverting to duplication in severely noisy regions. Experiments on 30 imbalanced datasets using repeated stratified cross-validation show that QC-SMOTE achieves the strongest average AUC-ROC and Macro F1 among the compared oversampling methods, with particularly clear gains under moderate and severe imbalance. These results demonstrate the importance of quality-aware, geometry-adaptive synthetic sampling for robust imbalanced classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QC-SMOTE，一种质量控制的过采样框架，用于解决类不平衡问题。该方法通过复合邻域可信度分数估计少数类样本的可靠性，并采用IPQ引导的最佳K策略生成合成样本，同时根据局部数据几何调整生成行为。在30个不平衡数据集上的实验表明，QC-SMOTE在AUC-ROC和Macro F1上优于其他过采样方法，尤其在中等和严重不平衡场景下提升明显。
Motivation: 现有SMOTE等方法在噪声或类重叠区域生成低质量合成样本，影响分类性能。需要一种质量感知、几何自适应的过采样方法来改善鲁棒性。
Method: 提出QC-SMOTE，使用复合邻域可信度分数（结合局部密度、安全水平和与多数类的隔离度）评估少数类样本可靠性。采用IPQ引导的最佳K策略生成候选样本，并根据样本可靠性和边界信息分配生成数量。生成行为在重叠-不平衡场景下自适应调整，低质量样本被替换为原始少数类副本。
Result: 在30个不平衡数据集上，使用重复分层交叉验证，QC-SMOTE取得最高的平均AUC-ROC和Macro F1，尤其在中等和严重不平衡下增益明显。
Conclusion: 质量控制与几何自适应合成采样对鲁棒不平衡分类至关重要，QC-SMOTE提供了一种有效方案。

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving RAG via Multi-Agent Semantic Rewriting: Achieving Confidentiality Without Compromising Contextual Fidelity
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation enhances large language models by incorporating external knowledge, but deploying it in sensitive scenarios risks privacy leakage via malicious prompts. To address this, we propose a multi-agent framework that sanitizes retrieved content through semantic rewriting. By employing three specialized agents for privacy extraction, semantic analysis, and reconstruction, our approach collaboratively removes sensitive identifiers while preserving the semantic core. We evaluate the framework on the ChatDoctor and Wiki-PII datasets across six large language models. Experimental results demonstrate a significant reduction in privacy leakage under targeted attacks. For instance, we reduced targeted information exposure in LLaMA-3-8B from 144 instances in the baseline to just 1. Furthermore, we maintain strong contextual fidelity with a BLEU-1 score of 0.122, outperforming the existing SAGE method's 0.117. Finally, the framework operates as an asynchronous preprocessing module, introducing no additional latency to online inference, as all rewriting is executed as a one-time offline preprocessing step. To promote reproducibility, the source code of this work is publicly available at https://github.com/foursoils/Privacy-Preserving-RAG.

papers.title: Themis: An explainable AI-enabled framework for Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Training safe Reinforcement Learning (RL) systems is inherently challenging, with no guarantee of avoiding unwanted behaviors. The most effective defenses against this are (i) transparency through explainability and (ii) alignment via human feedback. While both show promising results, no publicly available framework currently combines them. To address this, we introduce Themis, an XAI-enabled testing and evaluation framework for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback. Themis supports over 200 widely used environments and is easily configurable for experiments in RL, transparency, and alignment. Our results show that Themis can train reward models that match or outperform the environment's true reward signal using human preferences. We also provide a cloud-based platform for collecting human feedback and managing experiments. It is user-friendly, auto-scalable, and supports large participant groups across multiple experiments without extra development overhead. Tests show Themis can support one thousand users in back-to-back experiments on a modest commercial machine.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Themis，一个结合可解释人工智能（XAI）的强化学习人类反馈（RLHF）测试与评估框架。该框架支持超过 200 种常用环境，可用于透明度与对齐实验，并提供基于云的平台用于收集人类反馈和管理实验。实验表明 Themis 训练出的奖励模型能匹配或超越环境真实奖励信号，且平台可在普通商用机器上支持一千用户并发实验。
Motivation: 目前没有公开框架同时结合可解释性与人类反馈对齐，导致强化学习系统的安全训练缺乏透明度与对齐保障。
Method: 提出 Themis 框架，支持广泛的环境，使用人类偏好训练奖励模型，并提供可自动扩展的云平台用于大规模人类反馈收集和实验管理。
Result: 训练出的奖励模型在匹配或超越真实奖励信号方面表现良好；平台在普通机器上可支持一千用户连续实验。
Conclusion: Themis 有效整合了 XAI 和 RLHF，易于配置和扩展，为 RL 系统的安全训练提供了实用工具。

papers.title: Infinitesimal Causality
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a categorical account of infinitesimal causality in Frobenius Markov categories equipped with tangent-bundle semantics. IDC captures the infinitesimal layer in which interventions act as tangent deformations of copy/discard structure. Two distinct Frobenius structures interact: (1) the categorical Frobenius algebra on classical variables encoding copying, comparing, and discarding; and (2) the geometric Frobenius integrability condition, namely involutive closure of the intervention distribution, distinct from the algebraic Frobenius structure. Categorical causal sufficiency is defined as the compatibility of these two notions. A key observation is that, for structural causal models, infinitesimal causality is most naturally formulated in the slice of deterministic mechanisms over exogenous variables, with visible stochastic kernels obtained only after pushforward. Interventions are tangent vectors that deform the Frobenius copy/discard operations; their Lie brackets measure whether this deformation preserves classical information-flow structure. Pearl's do-calculus is used as a guiding example of intervention identities: ignoring irrelevant interventions corresponds to counit invariance, action/observation exchange to coproduct compatibility with pushforward, and independence to involutive bracket closure of the visible intervention distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Frobenius Markov范畴的切丛语义下建立了无穷小因果性（IDC）的范畴论框架。干预被视为对复制/丢弃结构的切形变，两种Frobenius结构（代数Frobenius代数与几何Frobenius可积性）的兼容性定义了因果充分性。以Pearl的do演算为例，将干预恒等式解释为余单位不变性、余积兼容性和可见干预分布的李括号闭合性。
Motivation: 现有因果模型缺乏对无穷小干预的范畴论统一刻画，本文旨在为无穷小干预提供严格的范畴论基础，连接抽象因果推理与微分几何。
Method: 引入Frobenius Markov范畴的切丛语义，利用两种Frobenius结构（代数与几何）的交互。干预定义为切向量，形变copy/discard操作；因果充分性定义为两种结构的兼容性；李括号度量形变是否保持经典信息流结构。
Result: 结构因果模型中，无穷小因果性最自然地表达在外生变量上的确定性机制切片中，可见随机核通过推前得到。Pearl的do演算规则被重新解释为范畴论性质：忽略无关干预对应余单位不变性，动作/观测交换对应余积与推前的兼容性，独立性对应可见干预分布的李括号闭合。
Conclusion: 本文为无穷小因果性提供了严格的范畴论基础，强调干预的代数与几何结构需兼容以实现因果充分性，为因果推理与微分几何的交叉提供新工具。

papers.title: When CQs Go Wrong: Challenges in CQ Verification with OE-Assist
papers.abstract_en: Competency Questions (CQs) are the central component of CQ-verification, an established process in which an ontology is evaluated against a set of natural language questions to determine whether the intended purpose of the ontology has been properly modelled. However, CQ-verification is often time-consuming and error-prone, as it requires careful interpretation of linguistic nuances and precise alignment with formal ontology constructs. Ambiguities and complexity in CQs can further complicate this process, leading to inconsistent modelling decisions and verification outcomes. In this paper, we investigate what makes a CQ challenging and possible solutions to enhance the users' performance in the CQ-verification process. We experimented with the data of 19 participants who performed CQ-verification on 20 tasks using an LLM assistant to support ontology evaluation. The results show the necessity of a tool to refine CQs before publishing them to avoid ambiguity or excessive complexity in later phases of the ontology engineering process.
papers.comment: Acceted poster at https://2026.eswc-conferences.org/program/accepted-papers/poster-demo/ 23rd European Semantic Web Conference (Satellite Event)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究本体工程中能力问题（CQ）验证的挑战，发现自然语言的歧义性和复杂性会导致验证结果不一致。通过19名参与者的实验，使用大语言模型辅助评估，结果表明需要开发工具在发布前细化CQ，以避免后续阶段的歧义或过度复杂性。
Motivation: CQ验证耗时且易错，需要精确解释语言细微差别并与本体形式结构对齐，现有的歧义和复杂性会导致建模决策不一致。
Method: 设计实验，19名参与者使用大语言模型辅助完成20个CQ验证任务，分析挑战来源。
Result: 实验揭示了CQ验证中因语言歧义和复杂度导致的困难，支持了开发CQ精炼工具的必要性。
Conclusion: 论文强调在发布前对CQ进行细化以避免歧义或过度复杂性，并暗示现有工具不足以支持高效验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Abstractions of Queries in Ontology-Based Data Access
papers.abstract_en: In ontology-based data access (OBDA), multiple data sources are integrated via mappings to an ontology. We consider an OBDA setting based on existential rules and the certain answer semantics. We address the recent issue of query abstraction, which consists of abstracting data queries by translating them to the ontology layer. Since a perfect abstraction may not exist, the notions of minimally complete and maximally sound abstractions have been introduced. We study abstractions within an extension of UCQs with a limited form of inequality and a special predicate marking database constants. While this extension does not lead to an increased complexity of the problems of interest, it is able to express minimally complete abstractions, hence perfect abstractions when they exist. We also characterize maximally sound abstractions by making a new connection with the notion of maximum recovery stemming from data exchange.
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper published in the proceedings of KR 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究本体论数据访问（OBDA）中的查询抽象问题，即在存在规则和确定答案语义下，将数据查询抽象到本体层。作者提出一种扩展的联合查询（UCQ），包含有限形式的不等式和标记数据库常量的特殊谓词，该扩展能表达最小完备抽象（进而完美抽象），并通过与数据交换中的最大恢复概念建立新联系，刻画了最大可靠抽象。
Motivation: 在OBDA中，数据查询可能需要抽象到本体层，但完美抽象并不总是存在，因此需要研究最小完备和最大可靠抽象。
Method: 在存在规则框架下，对UCQ进行扩展，添加有限不等式和常量标记谓词，分析该扩展的表达能力，并与数据交换中的最大恢复概念建立联系。
Result: 该扩展在不增加感兴趣问题复杂度的前提下，能够表达最小完备抽象（进而完美抽象），并刻画了最大可靠抽象。
Conclusion: 该工作为OBDA中的查询抽象提供了理论刻画，但未涉及具体应用或实验评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ScaleToT: Generalizing Structured LLM Reasoning for Billion-Scale Low-Activity User Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Accurate user modeling often depends on rich interaction histories, which are unavailable for billions of low-activity users. Large Language Models (LLMs) can infer latent user states from static profiles, but this reasoning becomes unreliable when profiles are sparse, and applying an LLM to billions of users is prohibitively expensive. We present ScaleToT, which learns structured reasoning from a small LLM-processed subset and extends it to the broader low-activity user population. To improve reasoning reliability, ScaleToT constructs typed user-state chains with a bounded entropy-guided Tree-of-Thought (ToT) refinement procedure. To make this structured reasoning usable from sparse profiles, the teacher-curated chains are used to train a student model on static profiles through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Outcome-Driven Segment-Aware Implicit Reward Policy Optimization (OSIPO). ScaleToT then transfers the student's reasoning representations to a lightweight profile encoder, providing shared reasoning signals for the remaining users without LLM inference. We evaluate ScaleToT on lifetime value (LTV) prediction in a billion-scale advertising deployment. A randomized online A/B test increased LT30 by 6.738\%, while offline reasoning covered only 7.32\% of the potential population, greatly reducing compute cost compared with full-population reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ScaleToT 提出了一种从少量大语言模型（LLM）处理的数据中学习结构化推理，并扩展到数十亿低活跃用户的方法。它使用有界熵引导的思维树（ToT）构建类型化的用户状态链，并通过监督微调和结果驱动分段感知隐式奖励策略优化（OSIPO）训练学生模型，再将推理表示迁移到轻量级编码器。在十亿级广告部署中，在线A/B测试使LT30提升6.738%，而推理覆盖仅潜在人群的7.32%，大幅降低了计算成本。
Motivation: 现有用户建模依赖丰富的交互历史，但数十亿低活跃用户缺乏此类数据；直接应用LLM推理成本高昂且稀疏画像下不可靠。
Method: 从少量LLM处理子集学习结构化推理：先通过有界熵引导的思维树（ToT）构建类型化用户状态链，再用监督微调（SFT）和结果驱动分段感知隐式奖励策略优化（OSIPO）训练学生模型，最后将推理表示迁移到轻量级用户画像编码器。
Result: 在十亿级广告部署中，离线推理仅覆盖7.32%潜在人群，在线A/B测试LT30提升6.738%，显著降低计算成本。
Conclusion: ScaleToT 能高效地将LLM的结构化推理泛化到大规模低活跃用户群体，适用于用户建模任务，但推理覆盖范围有限。

summary_sections.method: 从少量LLM处理子集学习结构化推理：先通过有界熵引导的思维树（ToT）构建类型化用户状态链，再用监督微调（SFT）和结果驱动分段感知隐式奖励策略优化（OSIPO）训练学生模型，最后将推理表示迁移到轻量级用户画像编码器。
summary_sections.result: 在十亿级广告部署中，离线推理仅覆盖7.32%潜在人群，在线A/B测试LT30提升6.738%，显著降低计算成本。
summary_sections.conclusion: ScaleToT 能高效地将LLM的结构化推理泛化到大规模低活跃用户群体，适用于用户建模任务，但推理覆盖范围有限。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Longitudinal Forecasting of Alzheimer's Disease Progression Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal modelling of Alzheimer's disease progression is clinically useful only if it can describe not just the most likely next diagnosis, but how a patient may evolve over time and how reliable that forecast is. Most deep learning approaches reduce this problem to single-step classification, treating cognitively normal, mild cognitive impairment, and dementia as flat categories while providing limited insight into how uncertainty accumulates across future visits. We propose a probabilistic framework that combines ordinal diagnosis prediction, multi-horizon trajectory generation, and decomposed uncertainty estimation. A Temporal Fusion Transformer encoder is adapted with a CORAL ordinal output layer, asymmetric loss weighting, and converter oversampling to respect disease-stage ordering and improve sensitivity to MCI-to-dementia transitions. Conditioned on the learned patient-context representation, an autoregressive Mixture Density Network generates five-year probabilistic trajectories for diagnosis state, CDR Sum of Boxes, MMSE orientation, and hippocampal volume. On ADNI, the model outperforms linear, recurrent, and transformer baselines for next-visit diagnosis prediction, with the strongest gains on MCI-versus-dementia discrimination. Generated trajectories achieve near-nominal 90% credible interval coverage, widening uncertainty across the forecast horizon, and biomarker dynamics consistent with expected Alzheimer's disease progression. We further separate aleatoric from epistemic uncertainty using analytic mixture variance and a five-member bootstrap ensemble, which provides the strongest encoder diversity and output-level epistemic signal. Epistemic uncertainty is higher for rare progression archetypes, MCI and dementia patients, and under external evaluation on OASIS-3, where it increases alongside prediction error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对阿尔茨海默病进展的纵向建模，提出一个概率框架，结合序数诊断预测、多时间轨迹生成和分解的不确定性估计。使用Temporal Fusion Transformer编码器、CORAL序数输出层、非对称损失加权和转换器过采样。在ADNI上，模型在下一步诊断预测上优于基线，生成轨迹接近90%可信区间覆盖。进一步分离了偶然不确定性和认知不确定性。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法将问题简化为单步分类，忽略时间演化和不确定性积累，对MCI向痴呆转变的敏感性不足。
Method: 提出概率框架，包括Temporal Fusion Transformer编码器、CORAL序数输出层、非对称损失加权、转换器过采样，以及自回归混合密度网络生成五年的概率轨迹，包括诊断状态、CDR Sum of Boxes、MMSE方向、海马体积。使用分析混合方差和五成员bootstrap集成分离偶然和认知不确定性。
Result: 在ADNI上，模型在下一步诊断预测上优于线性和transformer基线，MCI与痴呆判别提升最大。生成轨迹达到约90%可信区间覆盖，不确定性随时间扩大，生物标志物动态符合预期。认知不确定性在罕见进展类型、MCI和痴呆患者中更高，在外部OASIS-3评估中随预测误差增加。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法提供了可靠的不确定性估计，有助于临床决策，并识别需要更频密随访的患者。

papers.title: ViTexQA: A Multi-Frame Temporal Perception Dataset for Video Text Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Despite remarkable progress in multimodal understanding, current MLLMs still exhibit limitations in video text understanding, particularly when semantics emerge through the integration of temporally distributed textual cues across multiple frames. This perception challenge fundamentally differs from static image text understanding, yet existing datasets fail to capture: the vast majority of questions remain answerable from single frames, inadequately reflecting real-world video text comprehension demands. To address this, we present ViTexQA, a large-scale video-text QA dataset, and FrameThinker for robust multi-frame temporal reasoning. We build ViTexQA via a quality-controlled Chain-of-Thought (CoT) annotation pipeline boosted with temporal constraints; all its QA pairs demand cross-frame text fusion to solve, enforcing true temporal reliance. FrameThinker adopts two-stage training for explicit temporal modeling: CoT-Guided Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) generates frame-aware reasoning chains, followed by Temporally-grounded Reinforcement Learning (RL) optimized with multi-frame coherence rewards. Evaluations show our method outperforms SOTA baselines on ViTexQA, lifting ROUGE-L by 6.3%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有多模态大模型（MLLMs）在视频文本理解中跨帧时序语义融合的不足，构建了大规模视频文本问答数据集ViTexQA，并提出两阶段训练框架FrameThinker。ViTexQA所有问答对均需跨帧文本融合才能解答，确保真正的时间依赖性。FrameThinker采用CoT引导的监督微调（SFT）生成帧感知推理链，再通过基于时序的强化学习（RL）优化多帧连贯性。实验表明，该方法在ViTexQA上超过当前最先进基线，ROUGE-L提升6.3%。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在视频文本理解中存在局限，尤其是需要通过整合分布在多帧中的时序文本线索才能产生的语义。当前数据集大多只需单帧即可回答，无法反映真实世界的视频文本理解需求。
Method: 提出ViTexQA数据集，通过质量控制的链式思维（CoT）标注流程并结合时间约束构建。提出FrameThinker方法，采用两阶段训练：第一阶段CoT引导的SFT生成帧感知推理链，第二阶段基于时序的强化学习（RL）使用多帧连贯奖励进行优化。
Result: 在ViTexQA数据集上，该方法超越当前最先进基线，ROUGE-L指标提升6.3%。
Conclusion: 本文强调，通过专门设计的跨帧时序推理数据集和显式的时序建模方法，可以有效提升视频文本问答中多帧时序融合的能力。

papers.title: ASALT: Adaptive State Alignment for Lateral Transfer in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) addresses the problem of training multiple agents that pursue collaborative, competitive, or mixed objectives. Prior work has investigated transfer learning between source and target domains in MARL; however, the majority of existing approaches impose the constraint that the dimensionalities of the observation space and the global state space must be identical across domains. In this paper, we introduce a method that explicitly accommodates mismatched state-space dimensionalities between source and target domains. The proposed approach, ASALT, incorporates both observation-level and state-level adapters that map the target-domain observations and global states into a shared embedding space, thereby enabling more effective transfer of knowledge across both actors and critics. These adapters can generate embeddings that support efficient strategy transfer across heterogeneous domains. Experimental results on multiple configurations in standard benchmark environments demonstrate that ASALT surpasses existing baselines in terms of sample efficiency and global return in cooperative settings, but its effectiveness depends on the degree of mismatch between source and target domains. Furthermore, our findings indicate that ASALT mitigates negative transfer, which frequently constitutes a major obstacle when transferring policies between domains with differing observation and action spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ASALT方法，解决多智能体强化学习中源域和目标域状态空间维度不匹配时的迁移学习问题。通过观察级和状态级适配器将目标域观测和全局状态映射到共享嵌入空间，实现跨异构域的知识迁移。实验表明在合作设置下样本效率和全局回报优于基线，但效果取决于域间不匹配程度。
Motivation: 现有MARL迁移学习方法通常要求源域和目标域的观测空间和全局状态空间维度相同，限制了实际应用。ASALT旨在处理维度不匹配的情况。
Method: 引入观察级和状态级适配器，将目标域的观测和全局状态映射到与源域对齐的共享嵌入空间，从而允许演员和评论家网络的知识迁移。
Result: 在多个标准基准环境配置上，ASALT在合作场景下样本效率和全局回报超越现有基线，但有效性依赖于源域和目标域的维度不匹配程度。ASALT还减轻了负迁移。
Conclusion: ASALT能够处理状态空间维度不匹配的迁移学习，在合作MARL中有效，但依赖域间差异。

papers.title: AdversaBench: Automated LLM Red-Teaming with Multi-Judge Confirmation and Cross-Model Transferability
authors: Khanak Khandelwal (Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur)
papers.abstract_en: Scaling adversarial evaluation of large language models requires both a method for generating hard inputs and a reliable way to confirm that resulting failures are real. We present AdversaBench, an end-to-end red-teaming pipeline that mutates seed prompts with five structured operators, queries a target model, and confirms failures through a three-judge panel with a meta-judge tiebreaker. We report experiments on 45 seeds across three categories: reasoning, instruction-following, and tool use. Every seed produced a confirmed failure. Four findings stand out. First, operator effectiveness varies sharply by category: inject_distractor scores 0.00 mean reward on instruction-following seeds but 0.80-0.83 on reasoning and tool-use. Second, binary failure rate hides difficulty: instruction-following seeds required 2.4 attacker iterations on average versus 1.1 for other categories, a gap visible in survival curves. Third, pairwise judge agreement of 80-87% coexists with near-zero Cohen's kappa due to label skew; category-level disagreement rates are more informative. Fourth, adversarial prompts generated against Llama 3.1 8B transfer zero-shot to Llama 3.3 70B, suggesting the mutations exploit general behavioral patterns rather than model-specific weaknesses. Code, dataset, and analysis scripts are available at https://github.com/khanak0509/AdversaBench .
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Code and data at https://github.com/khanak0509/AdversaBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdversaBench 是一个端到端的自动化红队测试流水线，采用五个结构化变异算子对种子提示进行变异，并通过三人陪审团加元法官决胜机制确认大语言模型的失败。在45个种子（涵盖推理、指令遵循和工具使用三类）上的实验显示，每个种子都产生了确认的失败，且指令遵循类种子平均需要2.4次攻击迭代，而其他类别只需1.1次。另外，对Llama 3.1 8B生成的对抗性提示可以零样本迁移到Llama 3.3 70B，表明变异利用了一般性行为模式而非模型特定弱点。
Motivation: 大规模语言模型的红队评估需要可靠的攻击生成和失败确认方法，现有方法在确认环节存在不足。
Method: 提出包含五个结构化变异算子（如inject_distractor）的流水线，对种子提示进行变异，然后通过三人陪审团（meta-judge决胜）自动化确认失败。
Result: 45个种子全部产生确认失败；算子有效性因类别而异（inject_distractor在指令遵循上reward为0.00，在推理和工具使用上为0.80-0.83）；指令遵循种子需更多攻击迭代；法官对一致性80-87%但Cohen's kappa接近零；对抗提示跨模型迁移。
Conclusion: AdversaBench 提供了一种可扩展的自动化红队测试方法，并揭示了不同攻击类型和模型间的转移规律，有助于更全面地评估LLM安全性。

papers.title: EERLoss: A Novel Loss Function for Training Deep Biometric Models. A Case Study in Keystroke Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning approaches to biometric verification are commonly trained by optimizing indirect objectives, creating a misalignment between the optimization process and the primary evaluation metric, typically the Equal Error Rate (EER). This paper introduces EERLoss: a subdifferentiable, arbitrarily accurate approximation to EER for training deep biometric models. Furthermore, this framework has the potential to be adapted to optimize any specific operating point on the DET curve, enhancing its generalizability. To validate this approach, EERLoss is evaluated on a particularly demanding behavioral biometric modality: keystroke dynamics verification. This task is characterized by its high intra-class and low inter-class variability. Experiments are conducted on the large-scale KVC-onGoing benchmark, incorporating data from over 185,000 subjects across different scenarios. A comprehensive ablation study initially demonstrates the superiority of EERLoss in comparison to existing state-of-the-art loss functions. It also converges substantially faster compared to other losses, reducing the overall training cost. Additionally, a comparison is made between the proposed loss and the KVC-winning architecture by re-training it with EERLoss, demonstrating that the proposed approach significantly outperforms the original SoTA, achieving a relative EER reduction of up to approx. 30\%. This improvement on a challenging, large-scale benchmark validates the effectiveness of EERLoss as a task-aligned training objective specifically suited for high-variance biometric traits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EERLoss，一种可微分的、任意精度的 EER 近似损失函数，用于训练深度生物特征模型。在按键动力学验证的大规模基准 KVC-onGoing 上，EERLoss 相比现有损失函数收敛更快，并实现了约 30% 的相对 EER 降低。该方法还可适配到 DET 曲线上的任意操作点。
Motivation: 现有的深度学习生物特征验证模型通常优化间接目标，与主要评估指标 EER 之间存在错配，导致训练与评估不一致。
Method: 提出了 EERLoss，一种可微分的、高精度的 EER 近似损失函数，能够直接优化 EER 指标，并支持调整到 DET 曲线上的任意操作点。
Result: 在大规模按键动力学基准 KVC-onGoing（>185,000 名受试者）上，EERLoss 相比于现有 SOTA 损失函数收敛更快，且重训练 KVC 获胜架构后实现了约 30% 的相对 EER 降低。
Conclusion: EERLoss 作为一种与任务对齐的训练目标，特别适用于高变异性生物特征（如按键动力学）的验证任务。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在大规模按键动力学基准 KVC-onGoing（>185,000 名受试者）上，EERLoss 相比于现有 SOTA 损失函数收敛更快，且重训练 KVC 获胜架构后实现了约 30% 的相对 EER 降低。
summary_sections.conclusion: EERLoss 作为一种与任务对齐的训练目标，特别适用于高变异性生物特征（如按键动力学）的验证任务。

papers.title: LLMs Prompted for Legal Context Object More: Overrefusal from Small On-Premises LLMs in Criminal Legal Context
papers.abstract_en: While the validity of LLMs' use in the legal context remains subject to ethical and legal debate, legal professionals are already experimenting with personal LLMs, if only for translation and reformulation. However, even such a seemingly innocuous use can introduce biases through case processing speed if LLM assistants selectively refuse assistance on certain topics. To better anticipate such biases, we investigate several modern small LLMs that are most likely to be used as on-device assistants, to assess the impact of overrefusal on legal prompts. Surprisingly, we find that authority-style prefixes (``you are acting as an assistant of the national supreme court'', ``[...] defense lawyer'') systematically increase refusal rates by 2--20x over the no-prefix baseline, while a known role-play jailbreak prefix shows mixed effects, sharply increasing refusals in some models and barely shifting them in others. The finding suggests that small on-prem deployable LLMs are unstable under contextual framings that a real institutional user might naturally introduce, and further investigation is essential to minimize opportunities for bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究小型本地部署LLM在刑事法律语境中的过度拒绝行为，发现权威式前缀（如“你是国家最高法院的助手”）会将拒绝率提高2-20倍，而角色扮演越狱前缀的效果因模型而异。研究表明，这些模型在真实机构用户可能自然引入的上下文框架下表现不稳定，需进一步研究以减少偏见。
Motivation: 法律专业人士已在实验中使用个人LLM进行翻译和改写，但即使看似无害的使用也可能通过选择性拒绝引入偏见，影响案件处理速度。
Method: 对多个现代小型LLM（最可能用作设备端助手）进行测试，比较无前缀基线、权威式前缀和角色扮演越狱前缀对法律提示的拒绝率影响。
Result: 权威式前缀使拒绝率系统性提高2-20倍；角色扮演越狱前缀对拒绝率的影响因模型而异，有的模型显著增加，有的几乎不变。
Conclusion: 小型本地部署LLM在用户可能自然使用的上下文框架下表现不稳定，需要进一步调查以最小化偏见机会。

papers.title: Quant Convergence: Bridging Classical Value Investing and Modern Factor Models for Systematic Equity Selection
papers.abstract_en: Modern finance relies heavily on complex machine learning models to find patterns in the stock market. However, as these AI models get more complicated, they often memorize short-term market noise instead of finding companies with real, lasting value. We designed this research to test if Benjamin Graham's classic value investing rules could act as a mathematical "low-pass filter" to keep these modern models in check. We built three different sets of features - pure Graham rules, modern market factors, and a mix of both - and tested them against highly complex models (XGBoost and AutoGluon) using 20 years of S&P 500 data. By applying a strict buy-and-hold strategy over a four-year test period (March 2022 to March 2026), the results showed that more complex algorithms do not always win. While the AutoGluon model captured high returns (222.68%), it suffered a substantial 39.78% drop because it bought volatile tech stocks right before the market crashed. On the other hand, the pure Graham Random Forest achieved the highest overall return (232.13%) with much less risk (1.38 Calmar Ratio). Furthermore, the Combined Random Forest successfully mixed momentum with Graham's rules, making a 202.91% return while keeping the lowest maximum drop (34.53%) of any model tested. Ultimately, this research proves that Graham's "margin of safety" isn't outdated; it is actually a highly effective way to prevent modern AI from taking on too much risk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨将本杰明·格雷厄姆的经典价值投资规则作为数学“低通滤波器”，约束现代复杂机器学习模型（如XGBoost、AutoGluon）在股票选择中的过拟合风险。基于20年标普500数据，在2022年3月至2026年3月的买入持有测试中，纯格雷厄姆规则的随机森林取得232.13%总回报、1.38 Calmar比率，优于复杂模型（AutoGluon虽获222.68%但回撤达39.78%）；结合格雷厄姆规则与动量因子的组合随机森林则实现202.91%回报且最大回撤最低（34.53%）。结论认为格雷厄姆的“安全边际”仍是防范AI过度风险的有效方法。
Motivation: 复杂机器学习模型在股市中倾向于记忆短期噪声而非识别持续价值，缺乏价值投资中的风险约束机制。
Method: 构建三组特征集（纯格雷厄姆规则、现代因子、两者混合），用XGBoost和AutoGluon等模型在20年标普500数据上测试，采用严格买入持有策略。
Result: 纯格雷厄姆随机森林总回报232.13%（Calmar比率1.38），高于AutoGluon的222.68%但后者回撤39.78%；混合模型回报202.91%且最大回撤34.53%为所有模型最低。
Conclusion: 格雷厄姆价值投资规则仍有效，可作为约束现代AI风险的工具；复杂算法未必更优。

papers.title: Jolia: Concept-Level Vision-Language Alignment for 3D CT Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language contrastive pretraining has become the dominant recipe for 3D medical foundation models, leveraging the large volumes of paired scans and reports produced in clinical practice. However, medical images usually span dozens of organs, and radiological reports are much longer than typical natural image captions and are composed of multiple structured sections. CLIP-style pretraining compresses this structure by encoding each modality into a single global token, at the risk of losing important details. We introduce ConQuer (Concept Queries), an image-text pretraining method that augments CLIP's global alignment with a set of localized alignments, one per concept. ConQuer splits the report into concept-specific sections and learns cross-attention queries that pool the matching image features without using any segmentation mask or spatial supervision. Contrastive learning is then applied independently for each concept. Concepts can be any unit of semantic localization; here, they are anatomical regions, one query per organ or gross body region. As a byproduct, each query learns attention maps focused on its concept, providing built-in spatial interpretability. We use ConQuer to train Jolia, a 3D CT foundation model on chest and abdominal CT. Jolia consistently outperforms a CLIP baseline on findings classification, report generation, and cross-center transfer, and sets a new state of the art across multiple public benchmarks. Jolia's weights will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConQuer (Concept Queries) 方法，用于 3D CT 医学图像的视觉语言对比学习。该方法将报告拆分为概念特定部分，通过学习跨注意力查询 (cross-attention queries) 实现每个概念（如器官）的局部对齐，无需分割掩码或空间监督。训练得到的 Jolia 模型在胸部与腹部 CT 的发现分类、报告生成及跨中心迁移上优于 CLIP 基线，并在多个公开基准上达到新最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有的 CLIP 式预训练将医学图像和长文本报告各自压缩为单个全局 token，可能丢失重要的局部细节（如多器官信息），限制了 3D 医学基础模型的表现。
Method: 提出 ConQuer，在 CLIP 的全局对齐基础上增加一组概念级别的局部对齐。通过将放射学报告拆分为概念特定的子部分，学习每个概念对应的跨注意力查询，从图像中池化匹配的特征，并对每个概念独立应用对比学习。
Result: 在胸部与腹部 CT 上，Jolia 在发现分类、报告生成和跨中心迁移任务中一致优于 CLIP 基线，并在多个公开基准上达到新的最佳结果。
Conclusion: 通过概念级别的局部对齐，无需空间监督即可提升 3D CT 基础模型的表现，并内置空间可解释性。模型权重将在接收后公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multilevel Stochastic Plug-and-Play for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view computed tomography (SVCT) reduces radiation exposure and acquisition time, but the limited number of projection views makes the reconstruction problem severely ill-posed and leads to streak artifacts when analytical methods are used. Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods provide an effective way to combine data fidelity with learned image priors, while stochastic PnP methods further improve robustness by matching the denoiser input distribution through re-noising. However, these methods often require many iterations to converge, which limits their practical efficiency. In this work, we propose a multilevel (ML) stochastic PnP method for SVCT that accelerates stochastic PnP reconstruction. We highlight that, in the stochastic setting, directly enforcing prior coherence across levels would require accurately estimating fine-level prior gradients through multiple denoiser function evaluations, which substantially increases the computational cost. Motivated by this observation, we perform the multilevel steps in multiresolution analysis (MRA) approximation spaces. This choice is supported by the structure of the wavelet decomposition, which causes the prior-coherence correction to vanish in expectation, thereby avoiding costly estimation of fine-level stochastic prior gradients for the coarse-level corrections. Experiments on SVCT reconstruction show that our method, called Multilevel Stochastic Plug-and-Play (ML-SPnP), achieves reconstruction quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods while substantially reducing runtime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏视图CT重建中随机Plug-and-Play方法收敛慢的问题，提出多级随机Plug-and-Play方法（ML-SPnP）。该方法在多分辨率分析近似空间进行多级步骤，利用小波分解的结构使先验一致性校正项在期望中消失，从而避免昂贵的细级随机先验梯度估计。实验表明，ML-SPnP在保持重建质量的同时显著减少运行时间。
Motivation: 稀疏视图CT重建问题严重病态，随机PnP方法虽鲁棒但需要大量迭代才能收敛，计算效率低。
Method: 提出多级随机PnP方法，在多分辨率分析（MRA）近似空间中执行多级步骤，利用小波分解使先验一致性校正项在期望中消失，避免估计细级随机先验梯度。
Result: 在SVCT重建实验中，ML-SPnP达到与最先进方法相当的重建质量，同时显著降低计算时间。
Conclusion: ML-SPnP通过多级框架加速随机PnP重建，在保持质量的同时提升效率。

papers.title: PatternGSL: A Structured Specification Language for Template-Free and Simulation-Ready 3D Garments
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing realistic, physically plausible garments from a single image remains a fundamental challenge. Template-free methods capture surface geometry but lack explicit sewing structure for simulation; while programmatic systems are simulation-ready but constrained by predefined templates. This reveals a fundamental representation gap between geometric reconstruction and structured garment construction. We present PatternGSL, a structured garment representation in the form of a template-free and learnable specification language that encodes complete sewing patterns, including panel boundaries, parameterized seams, and explicit stitch topology, in a compact and standardized form. PatternGSL preserves the physical rigor of pattern-based models while removing template dependence, elevating sewing structure as a first-class target for generative modeling. We further propose a vision-language framework that predicts PatternGSL specifications directly from a single image and decodes them into garments using lightweight deterministic validity handling, without optimization-based refinement or manual cleanup. In addition, we introduce PatternGSLData, the first large-scale image-to-GSL paired dataset comprising 300K samples with complete sewing pattern annotations, enabling supervised VLM training for structured garment reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate improved pattern accuracy over prior baselines, explicit sewing-structure recovery, reliable cloth simulation, and pattern-level editing through the same deterministic decoding pipeline. Code and data-processing scripts will be released at https://github.com/PatternGSL/PatternGSL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PatternGSL，一种模板无关、可学习的结构化服装规范语言，能够编码完整的缝纫图案，包括面板边界、参数化接缝和显式针迹拓扑。同时提出视觉语言框架，从单张图像直接预测 PatternGSL 规范，并通过确定性解码生成可仿真的服装，无需优化或手动清理。实验表明，该方法在图案准确性、缝纫结构恢复、布料仿真和图案级编辑方面优于先前基线。
Motivation: 从单张图像重建真实、物理合理的服装仍具挑战。无模板方法捕获表面几何但缺乏缝纫结构，无法仿真；程序化系统可仿真但受限于预定义模板。存在几何重建与结构化服装构造之间的表示鸿沟。
Method: 提出 PatternGSL 规范语言，包含面板边界、参数化接缝和显式针迹拓扑，模板无关且紧凑标准化。进一步提出视觉语言框架，直接预测 PatternGSL 规范，并使用轻量确定性有效性处理解码为服装，无需优化或手动清理。还构建了首个大规模图像-GSL 配对数据集 PatternGSLData，含30万样本及完整缝纫标注。
Result: 实验表明，PatternGSL 在图案准确性上优于先前基线，能显式恢复缝纫结构，支持可靠的布料仿真和图案级编辑，且通过同一确定性解码流水线完成。
Conclusion: PatternGSL 将缝纫结构提升为生成建模的一等目标，填补了几何重建与结构化服装构造之间的鸿沟，为模板无关、可仿真的服装生成提供了新范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An observationally constrained probabilistic trigger for organized deep convection in an NWP ensemble
papers.abstract_en: A novel stochastic parametrization scheme representing organized convection is described. The effects of mesoscale convective systems (MCSs) are represented in an observationally constrained manner, by probabilistically triggering an MCS scheme in regions of enhanced environmental total column water vapour. In combination with the probabilistic trigger, patterns with given spatiotemporal scales determine where and when the scheme is active. Our scheme builds on the multiscale coherent structure parametrization (MCSP), which represents the top-heavy heating structure associated with MCSs. The original and new MCSP schemes are tested in a numerical weather prediction (NWP) ensemble. Both MCSP schemes improve the spatiotemporal scales of tropical precipitation compared to a control. When the spread-error relationship of tropical precipitation is analysed, the new scheme successfully boosts spread compared to original MCSP, improving the underdispersion of the ensemble seen with the original MCSP.

Conclusion: 该观测约束的概率触发方案能有效表示组织性对流，提升NWP集合对热带降水的模拟和不确定性表达。未来可进一步优化触发判据及与其他过程耦合。

papers.title: Quantum CT via Dynamic Interval Encoding and Prior-Balanced QUBO Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO)-based quantum computed tomography (CT) casts reconstruction as a binary quadratic problem for quantum annealing and hybrid quantum--classical solvers. For grayscale CT, however, image encoding is constrained by the binary-variable budget: fixed global bit-plane encodings increase QUBO size and coupling complexity as gray-level precision improves, whereas low-bit encodings introduce quantization error. We propose a QUBO-based grayscale CT reconstruction framework that combines dynamic interval encoding with prior-balanced optimization. Each refinement round encodes active pixels only within local gray-level intervals around the current estimate, and a boundary-hit-guided update rule adaptively switches between search expansion and local refinement. To improve optimization stability, the method balances projection-domain data consistency and an edge-preserving quadratic prior before forming the final QUBO. Sparse-view and limited-angle fan-beam CT experiments show that the proposed method recovers structures and gray-level distributions more faithfully than the evaluated analytic, iterative, variational, and representation-based baselines. Expressivity analysis and ablation studies further indicate that the improvement mainly arises from effective gray-level representation through dynamic local encoding and more stable data-fidelity--prior coupling. Experiments on the D-Wave hybrid binary quadratic model (BQM) solver further demonstrate that the formulation is executable on a hardware-backed hybrid quantum--classical backend.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于QUBO的灰度CT重建框架，结合动态区间编码和先验平衡优化。通过每次细化只编码当前估计周围局部灰度区间内的活跃像素，并采用边界命中引导更新规则自适应切换搜索扩张和局部细化，同时平衡投影域数据一致性和边缘保持二次先验。稀疏视图和有限角度扇束CT实验表明，所提方法比评估的解析、迭代、变分和基于表示的基线更忠实地恢复结构和灰度分布。
Motivation: 现有基于QUBO的量子CT重建中，固定全局位平面编码随灰度精度提高增加QUBO规模和耦合复杂度，而低位编码引入量化误差，需要更高效的灰度编码方法。
Method: 提出动态区间编码和先验平衡优化的QUBO重建框架：每轮细化仅在当前估计周围的局部灰度区间内编码活跃像素，边界命中引导更新自适应切换搜索扩张和局部细化；在形成QUBO前平衡投影域数据一致性和边缘保持二次先验。
Result: 稀疏视图和有限角度扇束CT实验表明，所提方法在结构和灰度分布恢复上优于评估的解析、迭代、变分和基于表示的基线；表达性分析和消融研究显示改进主要来自动态局部编码的有效灰度表示和更稳定的数据保真度-先验耦合；D-Wave混合BQM求解器实验表明该公式可在硬件支持的混合量子-经典后端上执行。
Conclusion: 该方法通过动态局部编码有效提高了灰度表示效率，并通过平衡数据保真度和先验提高优化稳定性，可在混合量子-经典后端上运行。
