papers.title: Transformation Behavior of Images in Latent Space
authors: Matthias Kloor (1) ((1) Department of Applied Tumor Biology Institute of Pathology Heidelberg University Hospital
(2) National Center for Hereditary Tumor Syndromes University Hospital Bonn
(3) Department of Internal Medicine I University Hospital Bonn
papers.abstract_en: Training of neural networks for histopathology classification tasks typically relies on data encoding into latent space, which reduces complexity and improves performance. There are several encoder networks available, either pretrained on general image datasets such as ImageNET, or specifically on histopathological images. Training of encoder networks should be adapted to downstream tasks, allowing encoding of biologic/diagnostic content while rendering networks invariant to label-irrelevant transformations. This paper investigates the effect of classical image transformation on the latent space, using networks provided by Lunit Inc. and Bioptimus, both focusing on pathological images, and by Meta Research Team. We assess variance of embeddings resulting from standard data transformations by comparing original and transformed image embeddings and by contrasting them with random, unrelated embeddings, using image tiles from hematoxylin/eosin-stained sections available in a colorectal tissue dataset and the publicly accessible TCGA dataset. Our findings show that embeddings of original and transformed images are closer to each other than to random embeddings, indicating robustness to transformations. However, they are not fully invariant, revealing that the encoder networks do not completely neutralize transformation effects in latent space, explaining why transformation-mediated augmentation of datasets can improve performance. Significant differences were observed between general and histopathology-specific encoder networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究组织病理学图像在潜空间中的变换行为，使用Lunit、Bioptimus和Meta的预训练编码网络，评估嵌入对标准图像变换的鲁棒性。发现原始与变换图像的嵌入比随机嵌入更接近，但并非完全不变，且通用与病理学专用网络存在显著差异。
Motivation: 理解编码网络对组织病理学图像变换的鲁棒性，以优化数据集增强和下游任务性能。
Method: 使用Lunit、Bioptimus和Meta的编码网络，对H&E染色图像切片进行标准变换，通过比较原始与变换嵌入及随机嵌入的距离来评估鲁棒性。
Result: 变换嵌入与原始嵌入比随机嵌入更接近，表明鲁棒性但非完全不变；通用与病理学专用网络在变换鲁棒性上存在显著差异。
Conclusion: 编码网络未完全中和变换效应，解释了变换增强可提升性能的原因，并指出网络类型选择的重要性。

papers.title: Detecting AI Coding Agents in Open Source: A Validated Multi-Method Census of 180 Million Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI coding agents are entering the open-source supply chain, yet their diverse and often invisible traces leave their prevalence poorly understood. We introduce a multi-layered detection framework that integrates configuration-file scanning, commit-message analysis, author-identity matching, and bot-signature lookup across World of Code (180M+ Git repositories), classifying agent traces into four behavioral types. No single method captures more than a fraction of activity: multi-method detection identifies 850,157 Claude Code commits in one snapshot, of which bot-account lookup_the signal most adoption studies rely on_recovers only 28,154 (3.3%), a 30x relative-recall gap, so single-signal prevalence estimates are biased low by at least this factor. Every detection pattern is hand-validated (495 labels) with per-cell precision and Wilson confidence intervals. Across snapshots from December 2024 to April 2026, commit-attributed agents generate over 320,000 commits per month; Claude Code leads (886,122 commits across 17,295 projects) and dominates silent, configuration-file-only adoption (21,078 projects). Compared against an independent pull-request census (AIDev), the two channels capture nearly disjoint agent populations_a PR census misses 79% of commit-detected Claude Code adopters and essentially all Codex adopters_and different kinds of work: PR-deployed cloud agents (Codex, Cursor) surface as feature work, while commit-deployed in-editor agents (Claude Code, OpenHands, Aider) surface as maintenance. The observed work profile follows deployment and detection mode rather than the tool itself, so no single channel is representative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多层次的检测框架，用于识别开源软件仓库中由AI编码代理（如Claude Code、Codex等）生成的提交。通过对1.8亿个Git仓库的扫描，整合配置文件、提交信息、作者身份和机器人签名等多种信号，共识别出850,157个Claude Code提交，其中仅3.3%被传统的机器人账户查找方法捕获，表明单信号方法严重低估了AI代理的普及程度。研究还发现，通过拉取请求（PR）和直接提交两种渠道检测到的代理群体几乎不重叠，且呈现不同的工作特征。
Motivation: 开源供应链中AI编码代理的痕迹多样且隐蔽，现有研究对其实际渗透率缺乏可靠估算，尤其是单一检测方法会带来系统性偏差。
Method: 构建多层检测框架：配置-文件扫描、提交消息分析、作者身份匹配、机器人签名查找；对四种行为类型（如无声采用、显式提交等）分类，并通过495个手工标注样本进行精度验证（含Wilson置信区间）。
Result: 在2024年12月至2026年4月的快照中，AI代理每月生成超过32万次提交；Claude Code在17,295个项目中共计886,122次提交，其中无声的配置文件采用占据21,078个项目。与传统PR普查（AIDev）相比，两个渠道检测到的代理群体几乎不相交：PR普查遗漏了79%的提交检测到的Claude Code采用者和几乎所有Codex采用者。
Conclusion: 单一信号或单一渠道的检测无法代表AI代理的真实活动，无偏估计需要多方法融合；代理的工作模式更多取决于部署和检测方式而非工具本身。

papers.title: NoLimits.jl: Flexible and Composable Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Modeling in Julia
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear mixed-effects models are widely used to analyze longitudinal data, but existing open-source software often supports only a limited subset of the model structures, inference methods, machine-learning components, automatic differentiation techniques, and random-effects distributions required in modern applications. We introduce NoLimits.jl, an open-source Julia package for flexible and composable nonlinear mixed-effects modeling. Its macro-based modeling language enables observation and latent-state models to be constructed from diverse building blocks, including ordinary differential equations, Markov models, and neural networks. NoLimits.jl supports flexible, covariate-dependent observation and random-effects distributions and provides a unified interface to frequentist inference through Laplace approximation, stochastic expectation maximization, and Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo methods. We demonstrate the package on three case studies showcasing its workflows, integration of differentiable machine-learning components, and data-driven estimation of random-effects distributions using normalizing flows. Together, these capabilities substantially expand the range of nonlinear mixed-effects models that can be specified, estimated, and compared within a single open-source framework.

papers.title: EgoSAT: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Egocentric Streaming Interaction Understanding
papers.abstract_en: We introduce EgoSAT, the first comprehensive benchmark for egocentric video reasoning in streaming settings, designed to evaluate the capabilities of modern vision-language models (VLMs). The benchmark targets streaming interaction understanding, where video frames arrive sequentially and models must continuously interpret evolving visual context. EgoSAT unifies several previously distinct tasks within a single streaming framework. In this formulation, queries about completed events correspond to retrospective reasoning, queries about ongoing activities require online understanding, and queries about future actions involve prospective anticipation. This unified setting requires models to reason about the past, present, and future while operating under the constraint that only previously observed frames are available. EgoSAT contains 1,997 unique videos spanning 165 hours of egocentric footage and around 4,800 high-quality question-answer pairs, carefully designed to probe reasoning across varying temporal contexts. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a diverse set of both open-weight and closed-weight VLMs, providing a systematic assessment of their ability for streaming interaction understanding. By distinguishing answerability and conducting diagnostics on confidence of models, we find existing models not only struggle with prospective and retrospective modeling, but also exhibit severe mis-calibration: confidence often fails to track inherent answerability, leading to dangerous "confidently wrong" behaviors. Project page: https://leiyj23.github.io/EgoSAT/
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://leiyj23.github.io/EgoSAT/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 介绍EgoSAT，首个面向自我中心视频流式推理的综合基准。该基准将回顾、在线和前瞻推理统一在一个框架下，包含约4800个QA对，评估多种视觉语言模型（VLMs）。实验发现现有模型在时间建模上表现不佳，且置信度校准严重失调。
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏对自我中心视频流式推理（streaming interaction understanding）的系统评估，而该场景要求模型在仅看到过去帧的条件下同时理解过去、现在和未来。
Method: 构建EgoSAT基准，包含1997个视频、165小时第一人称视频和约4800个精心设计的QA对，覆盖回顾、在线和前瞻推理。评估多种开源和闭源VLM，并区分可回答性问题进行诊断。
Result: 现有VLM不仅在前瞻和回顾建模上表现不佳，而且存在严重校准偏差：置信度与真实可回答性不一致，导致“自信地错误”行为。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了当前VLM在流式交互理解中的不足，为未来研究提供测试平台。论文强调模型校准问题需要关注。

papers.title: Can Aggregate Invariants Accelerate Continuous Subgraph Matching? Limits, Laws, and a Dynamic Spectral Index
papers.abstract_en: Spectral filtering recently delivered substantial pruning for \emph{static} subgraph matching: Laplacian interlacing rejects candidates whose neighborhoods cannot host the query. We study whether such aggregate structural tests can accelerate \emph{continuous} subgraph matching (CSM) over dynamic graphs, and answer in three parts. First, lazily maintained spectral bounds are infeasible exactly where spectral pruning has value: we characterize the tightest safe rule over a formalized perturbation relaxation and show that even it loses essentially all pruning power within four touching updates. Second, exact maintenance is affordable when selective: pruning utility and recomputation cost are anti-correlated across vertices -- hubs provably never prune -- so recomputing small-neighborhood spectra on touch sustains exact local spectra at microseconds per update, complete by construction. Third, integrated into a decoupled CSM benchmark against an identical-minus-spectra control, the tests remove up to $51\%$ of candidates or safely skip up to $47\%$ of update enumerations, yet enumeration intermediates remain unchanged -- beyond the gates' skipped first-level bindings, typically zero -- across two engines, four real graphs, two stream types, and $77$ solved queries; a constructed radius-stratified workload confirms the instrument detects the exception when one exists ($-99.9\%$ intermediates, $748\times$ faster). Aggregate tests accelerate what scales with candidate sets -- construction, list scans -- never adjacency-guided exploration. We distill an intermediate-invariance methodology for evaluating CSM filters and release a reusable dynamic local-spectra index.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究聚合不变量（如谱滤波）能否加速动态图上的连续子图匹配（CSM）。结果表明：惰性维护的谱边界在少数更新后失去剪枝能力；精确维护在选择性场景下可行（每更新微秒级）；集成到CSM基准测试中可移除最多51%的候选者或跳过47%的更新枚举，但枚举中间结果保持不变。
Motivation: 谱滤波在静态子图匹配中有效，但能否用于动态图的连续子图匹配尚不清楚。
Method: 通过形式化扰动松弛刻画最紧安全规则，研究惰性维护和精确维护的可行性，并将谱测试集成到解耦的CSM基准中与无谱对照组比较。
Result: 惰性维护在四次接触更新后失去剪枝能力；精确维护对枢纽节点无效但选择性计算可实现微秒级更新；谱测试在77个查询中移除最多51%候选者或跳过47%枚举，但枚举中间结果不变。
Conclusion: 聚合测试能加速与候选集规模相关的操作（如构建、列表扫描），但不能加速邻域引导的探索；提出中间不变性方法论并发布可复用的动态局部谱索引。

papers.title: Data Augmentation: A Fourier Analysis Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Data augmentation is a simple and model-agnostic approach for exploiting known invariances in learning problems. Given a group acting on the input space, one augments the training set with transformed copies of each sample. Because it exploits symmetries without modifying the underlying learning algorithm, data augmentation can be applied broadly across learning methods. However, this universality comes at a computational cost: when the group is large, full group-sized augmentation quickly becomes computationally infeasible. This raises a fundamental question: Can partial data augmentation achieve the same statistical benefits as full augmentation in terms of generalization and sample complexity? We develop a general framework for investigating this question using Fourier analysis and the representation theory of finite groups. We show that, for a broad class of classical learning problems, partial data augmentation based on a randomly sampled subset of group elements achieves the same minimax rates as full augmentation, up to an approximation error that vanishes as the subset size increases. Our results provide a theoretical explanation for why partial augmentation can retain the statistical benefits of full augmentation despite enforcing symmetry only approximately, and shed light on a recently raised question in learning with symmetries: whether statistically optimal learning under general group invariances can be achieved using computationally scalable methods. Moreover, we prove a complementary impossibility result: enforcing exact invariance via data augmentation requires averaging over the entire group, and cannot be achieved by any strict subset when the hypothesis space is sufficiently expressive. Together, these results provide a unified perspective on full and partial data augmentation, as well as exact and approximate symmetry enforcement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用傅里叶分析和有限群表示论，研究了基于群作用的数据增强问题。证明了对一类经典学习问题，基于随机采样子集的部分数据增强能够达到与完整数据增强相同的极小化最优率，近似误差随子集大小增大而消失。同时证明了当假设空间足够表达时，严格子集无法实现精确不变性。提供了部分和完全数据增强的统一视角。
Motivation: 完整数据增强在群较大时计算成本过高，需要探究部分增强能否获得相同的统计优势。
Method: 利用傅里叶分析和有限群表示论，建立理论框架分析部分和完全数据增强的统计性质。
Result: 部分数据增强（基于随机采样子集）在广义上达到与完全增强相同的极小化最优率，且近似误差随子集增大而消失；同时证明严格子集不能实现精确不变性。
Conclusion: 部分增强可在计算可行前提下保留统计最优性，但精确不变性要求完全群平均；为对称性学习提供了理论支撑。

papers.title: Agentic AI for Bilevel Long-Term Optimization of Policy-Driven Physical Layer Systems
papers.abstract_en: Network operators' changing policies, service requirements, and stringent real-time constraints render existing methods designed with fixed objectives and constraints ineffective. This paper presents Agentic long-term performance optimization (Agentic-LTPO), a nested bilevel optimization framework that can be applied to adaptive physical layer problem configuration. The key idea is to employ agentic AI to generate upper-level configurations in a bilevel optimization structure, where evolving operator policies, environment summaries, and historical experiences are translated into structured lower-level optimization problem configurations. The lower level solves the problems with updated configurations for real-time physical-layer decisions. Considering cell-free MIMO beamforming as a use case, we embody Agentic-LTPO by designing a new multi-agent decision process with retrieval-augmented experience-based verification in the upper level, together with a closed-form beamformer in the lower level. Experiments demonstrate that Agentic-LTPO exhibits strong adaptability to dynamic operator policies and effectively enhances the system's long-term performance by 57.2% compared to traditional methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic-LTPO，一种基于智能体 AI 的嵌套双层优化框架，用于自适应物理层问题配置。在无蜂窝 MIMO 波束赋形用例中，上层采用多智能体决策与检索增强经验验证，下层使用闭式波束赋形器。实验表明，与传统方法相比，系统长期性能提升 57.2%。
Motivation: 现有方法针对固定目标和约束设计，无法适应网络运营商动态变化的策略、服务需求和实时约束。
Method: 提出 Agentic-LTPO 框架，将双层优化中上层配置由智能体 AI 生成，将运营商策略、环境摘要和历史经验转化为结构化下层优化问题配置；下层求解实时物理层决策。在无蜂窝 MIMO 波束赋形中实现，上层设计多智能体决策与检索增强经验验证，下层使用闭式波束赋形器。
Result: 实验表明 Agentic-LTPO 对动态运营商策略具有强适应性，长期性能较传统方法提升 57.2%。
Conclusion: 该框架可有效用于策略驱动的物理层系统长期优化，但具体推广性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Cycle-Consistent Neural Explanation of Formal Verification Certificates
papers.abstract_en: Formal verification produces machine-checkable certificates that attest to the satisfaction or violation of temporal properties, yet these certificates remain opaque to non-specialist stakeholders. We propose a cycle-consistent neural architecture that generates faithful natural language explanations of verification certificates. A forward network NN1 maps certificates to explanations, and an inverse network NN2 reconstructs certificates from explanations; a symbolic verifier closes the loop, providing a differentiable faithfulness proxy. A pointer-generator mechanism ensures lexical grounding by copying state names directly from the certificate. We evaluate on 420 test certificates spanning six verification methods (bounded proof, k-induction, inductive invariant, lasso, reachability, witness pair) in both YES and NO verdict variants, drawn from a financial compliance domain with 207 named states. Our trained architecture, combined with a hybrid inference-time routing strategy, achieves 90.0% cycle-verified soundness, surpassing a multi- LLM few-shot baseline (76.1% for the best of 16 LLM combinations across four frontier models) by 13.9 percentage points. The neural model wins on 10 of 12 verdict/kind categories, with three categories reaching 100% soundness. The architecture offers 860x faster inference (185 ms vs. 160 s per certificate for the full multi-LLM baseline), offline operation, deterministic outputs, and zero per-inference cost. These results demonstrate that trained specialization outperforms general-purpose LLM prompting for structured certificate explanation, while eliminating the deployment constraints of cloud-based inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种循环一致性神经架构，用于生成形式验证证书的自然语言解释。该架构包含前向网络NN1（证书→解释）和逆向网络NN2（解释→证书），并通过符号验证器提供可微的可信度代理。在包含420个测试证书的财务合规领域数据集上，结合混合推理路由策略，实现了90.0%的循环验证可靠性，优于多LLM少样本基线（76.1%），且推理速度提高860倍。
Motivation: 形式验证证书对非专业利益相关者而言难以理解，现有方法（如多LLM提示）存在部署限制和成本问题。
Method: 提出循环一致性神经架构：前向网络NN1将证书映射为解释，逆向网络NN2将解释重构为证书；符号验证器闭环提供可微的可信度代理；采用指针生成器机制复制状态名称以保持词汇基础。
Result: 在420个测试证书上（涵盖6种验证方法、YES/NO两种裁决），结合混合推理路由策略，循环验证可靠性达90.0%，比多LLM少样本基线（最高76.1%）高13.9个百分点。在12个裁决/类型类别中胜出10个，3类达100%可靠性。推理速度185ms（基线160s），快860倍。
Conclusion: 训练专用的神经网络在结构化证书解释任务上优于通用LLM提示，同时消除了云端推理的部署约束。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种循环一致性神经架构，用于生成形式验证证书的自然语言解释。该架构包含前向网络NN1（证书→解释）和逆向网络NN2（解释→证书），并通过符号验证器提供可微的可信度代理。在包含420个测试证书的财务合规领域数据集上，结合混合推理路由策略，实现了90.0%的循环验证可靠性，优于多LLM少样本基线（76.1%），且推理速度提高860倍。

papers.title: Natural Identifiers for Privacy and Data Audits in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Assessing the privacy of large language models (LLMs) presents significant challenges. In particular, most existing methods for auditing differential privacy require the insertion of specially crafted canary data during training, making them impractical for auditing already-trained models without costly retraining. Additionally, dataset inference, which audits whether a suspect dataset was used to train a model, is infeasible without access to a private non-member held-out dataset. Yet, such held-out datasets are often unavailable or difficult to construct for real-world cases since they have to be from the same distribution (IID) as the suspect data. These limitations severely hinder the ability to conduct scalable, post-hoc audits. To enable such audits, this work introduces natural identifiers (NIDs) as a novel solution to the above-mentioned challenges. NIDs are structured random strings, such as cryptographic hashes and shortened URLs, naturally occurring in common LLM training datasets. Their format enables the generation of unlimited additional random strings from the same distribution, which can act as alternative canaries for audits and as same-distribution held-out data for dataset inference. Our evaluation highlights that indeed, using NIDs, we can facilitate post-hoc differential privacy auditing without any retraining and enable dataset inference for any suspect dataset containing NIDs without the need for a private non-member held-out dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）隐私审计中现有方法需要插入人工金丝雀数据或依赖私有非成员保留数据集的问题，提出自然标识符（NID）作为解决方案。NID是训练数据中天然存在的结构化随机字符串（如加密哈希、短链接），可通过生成同分布的额外随机字符串来替代金丝雀进行事后差分隐私审计，或作为同分布保留数据用于数据集推断。实验表明，NID能实现无需重新训练的事后差分隐私审计，并支持对包含NID的嫌疑数据集进行数据集推断。
Motivation: 现有LLM隐私审计方法要么需要训练时插入金丝雀（不适用于已训练模型），要么需要私有非成员保留数据集（难以获取或构造），严重限制了可扩展的事后审计能力。
Method: 利用LLM训练数据中天然存在的自然标识符（NID），通过生成同分布的额外随机字符串作为替代金丝雀或同分布保留数据，实现事后差分隐私审计与数据集推断。
Result: 评估表明，NID可以在无需重新训练的情况下进行事后差分隐私审计，并对包含NID的嫌疑数据集进行数据集推断，无需私有非成员保留数据集。
Conclusion: NID方法为LLM隐私审计提供了一种实用、可扩展的事后方案，克服了现有方法对训练时插入和私有保留集的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Entity Resolution via Batched Oracle Queries
papers.abstract_en: We consider an oracle that processes a limited batch of records at a time and clusters those that refer to the same real-world entity. We study how to interrogate such an oracle to resolve entities in a dataset whose size is far larger than a single batch, and where no batch is guaranteed to contain all records of any given entity. We aim at a pay-as-you-go approach, to have full control over the costs (the number of oracle consults), while achieving the highest possible recall at every step. We formally cast this problem as batched entity resolution, prove that selecting optimal batches is NP-hard, and provide an optimal solution under a natural condition on entity sizes. Finally, we evaluate our approach on six datasets and show its superiority over state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在批次有容量限制的 oracle 查询下进行实体解析（entity resolution）的问题，其中数据集大小远大于单个批次，且无批次能保证包含某实体的所有记录。作者形式化定义了批次实体解析问题，证明选择最优批次是 NP 难的，并在实体规模的自然条件下给出了最优解。在六个数据集上的实验表明该方法优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有实体解析方法假设可以随意访问所有记录，但在实际场景中，oracle 只能每次处理有限批次记录，且批次间实体分布未知。目标是设计一种按需付费（pay-as-you-go）的策略，在控制查询成本的同时最大化召回率。
Method: 将问题形式化为批次实体解析，证明最优批次选择是 NP 难问题；在实体规模满足自然条件（如最大实体大小不超过批次容量的一半）时，提出一个最优算法。
Result: 在六个数据集上评估，该方法在相同查询次数下达到比现有基线更高的召回率。
Conclusion: 本文为受限批次 oracle 查询下的实体解析提供了理论基础和有效算法，但未说明在缺乏实体规模条件时的近似算法性能。

papers.title: Modality-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection for Multi-Modal Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: The incorporation of additional modalities into action recognition models increases their performance across a wide range of settings. However, how this additional information can contribute to making the models more robust remains underexplored, particularly for the case of multi-modal out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. While methods exist that regularize the multi-modal training process with OOD detection in mind, they still apply off-the-shelf OOD detectors designed for the uni-modal case during inference, discarding important information. Based on an interesting relationship we find between the multi-modal and uni-modal predictions, we propose to use this signal to build a post-hoc detector explicitly designed for the multi-modal scenario. We combine this new source of information with a feature-space score, which detects off-manifold samples in the multi-modal space, and normalize them by the multi-modal logits. In doing so, the proposed hybrid detector is compatible with existing training-time approaches and consistently improves performance. Experiments on a wide range of established datasets from the MultiOOD benchmark show that, on average, our approach outperforms the state of the art. Our results show the importance of explicitly considering the different modalities at inference time for multi-modal OOD detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态动作识别中的分布外检测问题，提出了一种后处理检测器。该方法利用多模态与单模态预测之间的关系，结合特征空间分数和多模态logits归一化，有效提升了检测性能。在MultiOOD基准的多个数据集上平均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态OOD检测方法在训练时考虑模态，但推断时仍使用单模态检测器，丢失了多模态信息。
Method: 提出混合检测器，融合多模态与单模态预测的一致性信号以及特征空间分数，并通过多模态logits归一化进行校准。
Result: 在MultiOOD基准的多种数据集上，平均性能超过当前最优方法，验证了显式利用多模态信息的重要性。
Conclusion: 推断时显式考虑不同模态信息对于多模态OOD检测至关重要，所提方法可兼容现有训练阶段的方法。

papers.title: RE4: Transformation-aware Imitation of Object Interactions Using Manipulation Modes
papers.abstract_en: Object interaction tasks have been a focus of advances in imitation learning. End-to-end methods, dominated by diffusion and flow-based variants have shown leaps in performance while sacrificing interpretability. Object-centric and pose-informed variants have had a role in learning from demonstration in manipulation tasks. In this paper, we revisit a few modern imitation learning benchmarks for object interactions, with the aim of composing a framework that repurposes principled theories of manipulation, preserving both performance and interpretability. For image observations, lightweight training is proposed for model-free pose estimation of the target object, using self-supervision over the demonstration data available for imitation learning. This information is then used to inform a manipulation mode-aware retrieval of a demonstration, a mode-aware transformation, a replan step that connects to the retrieval point while preserving mode constraints, and finally rolling out the transformed demonstration. These compose four key steps of the proposed RE4 framework, evaluated over state-based and image-based benchmarks in Push-T and Robomimic. An adversarial benchmark that evaluates sparse data regions of image-based Push-T showcases the robustness, further bolstered by indications from low-data regime experiments. The current work shows promise in using simple interpretable building blocks to learn manipulation skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RE4框架，用于物体交互的模仿学习。通过轻量级自监督姿态估计获取目标物体信息，结合操作模式感知的演示检索、变换、重规划和执行，在Push-T和Robomimic基准上验证了性能与可解释性。
Motivation: 现有端到端模仿学习方法虽性能提升但牺牲可解释性，而物体中心方法在操作任务中有潜力。论文旨在结合经典操作理论，在保持性能的同时保留可解释性。
Method: 提出RE4四步框架：1) 基于自监督的模型自由姿态估计；2) 操作模式感知的演示检索；3) 模式感知变换；4) 保持模式约束的重规划与执行。
Result: 在基于状态和图像的Push-T和Robomimic基准上评估，尤其在图像版Push-T的稀疏数据区域和低数据实验中表现出鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 使用简单可解释的构建模块即可学习操作技能，表明可解释性方法在模仿学习中具有潜力。

papers.title: Parallel Manifold Steering: Efficient Adaptation of Large Associative Memories via Residual Energy Shaping
papers.abstract_en: Large Transformer models function as Dense Associative Memories (DAMs), retrieving knowledge via high-dimensional attractor dynamics driven by the self-attention mechanism \citep{ramsauer2020hopfield, wu2024attention}. However, adapting these frozen memory systems to new tasks presents a fundamental ``Plasticity-Stability'' dilemma. Current methods either risk catastrophic interference by modifying synaptic weights directly (e.g., LoRA) \citep{hu2021lora} or degrade associative capacity by clogging the retrieval buffer with static prompt tokens (e.g., VPT) \citep{jia2022vpt}. In this work, we propose \textbf{H-Res} (Hierarchical Residual Steering), a mechanism that modulates the effective energy landscape of the Transformer without altering its global equilibrium or expanding its sequence length. By formulating adaptation as a control problem on the activation manifold \citep{chen2018neuralode}, H-Res learns a state-dependent vector field that steers token trajectories into task-specific basins of attraction. We formally prove that H-Res preserves the attention entropy of the foundation model and facilitates Neural Collapse \citep{papyan2020prevalence}. Empirically, Manifold Steering outperforms global weight modification by 26\% on associative retrieval tasks and eliminates the computational overhead of prompt-based methods, scaling effectively to structured domains \citep{zha2023vtab}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 H-Res（Hierarchical Residual Steering），一种通过调制 Transformer 有效能量景观来适应新任务的机制，无需修改权重或增加序列长度。H-Res 将适应问题建模为激活流形上的控制问题，学习状态依赖的向量场以引导 token 轨迹进入任务特定吸引域。理论证明该方法保持注意力熵并促进神经坍塌；实验表明在关联检索任务上比全局权重修改提升 26%，且消除了基于提示方法的计算开销。
Motivation: 大型 Transformer 模型作为密集关联记忆，适应新任务时面临可塑性-稳定性困境：现有方法如 LoRA 直接修改权重导致灾难性干扰，VPT 等基于提示的方法则占用检索缓冲区降低关联容量。
Method: 提出 H-Res 机制，将适应形式化为激活流形上的控制问题，学习一个状态依赖的向量场来引导 token 轨迹进入任务特定的吸引子盆地，而不改变模型的全局平衡或扩展序列长度。
Result: 在关联检索任务上，H-Res 比全局权重修改方法提升 26% 性能，且无额外计算开销，能有效扩展到结构化领域。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 H-Res 通过残差能量整形实现了高效的关联记忆适应，保留了基础模型的注意力熵，并支持神经坍塌。

papers.title: Average Rankings Mask Per-Subject Optimality: A Friedman-Nemenyi Benchmark of EEG Motor-Imagery BCI Decoders
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) is the dominant non-invasive modality for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), yet reliable decoding of motor imagery is hampered by inter- and intra-individual variability. A recurring claim is that one decoding pipeline, most often a spatial or Riemannian method, is broadly preferable. We test the weakest version of that claim under the most favourable conditions. Using the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB) framework, we evaluated 1,056 decoding configurations (feature extractor x scaler x classifier), >340,000 subject-level model fits, across three public left-versus-right motor-imagery datasets (PhysionetMI, 109 participants; Cho2017, 52; Zhou2016, 4) and two frequency bands (8-15 Hz, 8-30 Hz). Every model is fit and tested within a single session of a single participant, the easiest regime, giving every pipeline its best chance. We apply the statistics standard for multi-classifier comparison: Friedman omnibus tests, Nemenyi critical-difference analysis and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with effect sizes. Covariance tangent-space projection (cov-tgsp) and Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) are the strongest families, but their ordering is dataset-dependent and, on the largest and most heterogeneous cohort (PhysionetMI), statistically indistinguishable (Nemenyi p = 0.27; Kendall's W = 0.11). At the individual level the single best pipeline is optimal for only 35% of PhysionetMI participants, and nonlinear descriptors are best for roughly one third; matching pipeline to participant adds about seven accuracy points over the best fixed choice. The ranking is not an artefact of dimensionality, and classifier and scaler choices are secondary to the feature representation. Even in the easiest regime, no single pipeline dominates: a lower bound on the personalization problem and a quantitative case for participant-aware model selection rather than a universal decoder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用MOABB框架，通过Friedman-Nemenyi检验对EEG运动想象BCI解码器进行大规模基准测试。评估了1056种解码配置和超过34万次受试者级模型拟合，发现协方差切空间投影（cov-tgsp）和共同空间模式（CSP）是性能最好的方法系列，但排序依赖数据集，且无单一配置对所有受试者最优。个体层面上，最佳固定管道仅对35%的受试者最优，为受试者匹配管道可额外提升约7个百分点的准确率。
Motivation: 现有研究常声称某种解码管道（如空间或黎曼方法）广泛优越，但跨受试者间和受试者内的变异性使这一说法存疑。本文旨在最有利条件下检验该主张的最弱版本。
Method: 使用MOABB框架，在三个公开左右手运动想象数据集（PhysionetMI、Cho2017、Zhou2016）和两个频带上，评估1056种特征提取器×缩放器×分类器组合，并在单个受试者单会话内拟合与测试模型。采用Friedman检验、Nemenyi临界差分析和Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行统计比较。
Result: 协方差切空间投影和CSP是最强的管道家族，但排序依赖数据集，且在最大异质性队列（PhysionetMI）上无统计显著差异（Nemenyi p=0.27）。单个最优管道仅对35%的PhysionetMI受试者最优，非线性描述符对约三分之一受试者最佳；为受试者匹配管道比最佳固定选择提高约7个准确率点。
Conclusion: 即使在最有利条件下，也不存在单一主导管道；结果提出了个性化问题的下界，并支持受试者感知的模型选择，而非通用解码器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ATRIA: Adaptive Traceable ECG Reporting with Iterative Agents
papers.abstract_en: Existing ECG report generation is tightly coupled -- interpretation and reporting fused end-to-end, so errors propagate without stage-level recourse -- while agent-based systems decouple tasks but remain single-pass, never revisiting earlier outputs. Clinical ECG reporting instead unfolds iteratively, requiring progressive context integration and bidirectional editing. We present \textsc{ATRIA}, a multi-agent ECG reporting system that mirrors the clinician's iterative workflow: it binds every report claim to its supporting evidence, flags statements unsupported by that evidence, incorporates additional context mid-session, and lets clinicians verify and revise individual findings rather than accept one opaque output. Because its agents use ECG analysis models already in clinical use, the underlying findings are clinically trustworthy; and as a cloud-based web service, \textsc{ATRIA} is ready for immediate deployment. We demonstrate \textsc{ATRIA} through four interaction cases, with a live demo and video available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATRIA 是一个多代理心电图报告生成系统，模拟临床医生的迭代工作流程：将每条报告声明绑定到支持证据，标记无证据支持的陈述，并在会话中整合额外上下文，允许临床医生验证和修改单个发现。该系统使用已临床使用的ECG分析模型，可作为基于云的Web服务立即部署。通过四个交互案例进行演示。
Motivation: 现有ECG报告生成要么是紧密耦合的端到端系统，错误无法分阶段纠正；要么是单次通过的基于代理的系统，无法回访早期输出。临床ECG报告需要迭代、逐步整合上下文和双向编辑。
Method: 提出多代理ECG报告系统，模拟临床医生迭代工作流程：将每个报告声明绑定到支持证据，标记无证据支持的语句，在中会话中整合额外上下文，并允许临床医生验证和修改单个发现。代理使用已临床使用的ECG分析模型，系统作为基于云的Web服务部署。
Result: 通过四个交互案例展示系统能力，并提供了在线演示和视频。
Conclusion: ATRIA 通过代理解耦和迭代工作流程，实现了临床可信、可追溯和可修改的ECG报告生成，且由于使用已临床使用的模型，基础发现具有临床可信度；作为云服务，可立即部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Age of LLM: A Strategic 1v1 Benchmark for Reasoning, Diplomacy and Reliability of Large Language Models under Fog of War
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Age of LLM, a turn-based 1v1 benchmark in which two LLMs face off on a 13x7 grid to destroy the enemy base. Three stressors are deliberate: fog of war, full diplomacy (messages, ceasefires, ultimatums; uranium kept secret), and a reliability dimension where every turn must follow a strict JSON schema and an illegal action is silently discarded. The engine is private and each match uses a fresh random map seed and opponent, mitigating the data contamination that affects public benchmarks. Models receive a (near) rule-only prompt with no build-order advice (two tactical seed phrases were present during data collection; see Section 2.7). We benchmark 15 reasoning models across 54 matches and 5,258 actions. Findings: (1) the nuclear rush dominates (78% on the rules-coherent v0.11+ sub-corpus; 85% corpus-wide) with a sole-launcher signature that is largely mechanical under secret-simultaneous launch rules, not a cognitive deterrence failure; (2) military conquest is rare but faster (12.3 vs 18.9 turns); (3) diplomacy is prolific yet almost never consummated; (4) ~58% of illegal actions are fog/state errors, making the illegal-action rate a measure of belief-tracking; (5) -- the least established, and the only one we label exploratory -- a weak link associates reliability with winning. The corpus is small, unbalanced and not side-swapped, so the ranking is a preliminary descriptive view, not a contribution. Beyond ranking, the turn-by-turn traces of actions and messages make the corpus a lens on how LLMs reason under adversarial uncertainty -- their belief-tracking, spontaneous deception, and per-model cognitive "personas" -- which we frame as a future research direction. We release the replay format, an isometric viewer and all replays; engine source on request.
papers.comment: 25 pages including appendices, 8 figures, 4 tables; appendices include verbatim system prompt and engine resolution pseudocode. All correlations reported with p-values, 95% bootstrap confidence intervals and Spearman's rho; includes a Steiger test and Bradley-Terry fit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Age of LLM，一个基于回合制的1v1基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在战争迷雾下的推理、外交和可靠性。15个推理模型在54场比赛中进行了较量，主要发现包括：核rush策略占主导地位（78%），军事征服罕见但更快，外交频繁但几乎从未达成，约58%的非法动作源于迷雾/状态错误，以及可靠性与获胜之间存在弱关联。
Motivation: 现有LLM基准测试容易受到数据污染，且缺乏对不确定性推理和外交策略的系统评估。本文旨在通过一个带有迷雾、完全外交和严格JSON格式约束的战略游戏环境，评估LLM在对抗性不确定性下的推理、外交和可靠性。
Method: 设计了一个13x7网格的回合制1v1游戏，包含战争迷雾、完全外交（消息、停火、最后通牒）和严格的动作格式约束。引擎私有且每次比赛使用随机地图和对手，以减轻数据污染。对15个推理模型进行了54场比赛和5258个动作的分析。
Result: 核rush策略占主导地位（规则一致子语料库中78%，全语料库中85%）；军事征服罕见但更快（12.3 vs 18.9回合）；外交频繁但几乎从未达成；约58%的非法动作源于迷雾/状态错误；可靠性与获胜之间存在弱关联（探索性发现）。
Conclusion: 该基准测试提供了LLM在对抗性不确定性下推理的视角，包括信念追踪、自发欺骗和每模型认知“人格”。语料库较小且不平衡，排名仅为初步描述性视图。未来工作方向是分析回合级别的动作和消息痕迹。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Female-RHINO: A Real-Time Scanner-Integrated Framework for Automated Quantitative Uterine MRI Analysis and Structured Reporting
papers.abstract_en: Standardized assessment of uterine MRI remains challenging due to anatomical variability, observer dependence, and the lack of workflow-integrated automated analysis tools. This work presents Female-RHINO: (R)eproductive (H)ealth (I)maging A(N)alysis T(O)ol, a real-time AI-assisted framework for automated quantitative uterine MRI analysis and structured reporting during image acquisition. We present an end-to-end system that integrates inline communication with the MRI scanner and deep learning-based analysis to derive quantitative uterine biomarkers from sagittal T2-weighted pelvic MRI. The framework combines segmentation and anatomical landmark detection models trained and evaluated on more than 500 multi-center datasets spanning diverse protocols, vendors, and patient populations. It performs volumetry, detects and quantifies common incidental findings such as fibroids and Nabothian cysts, and extracts six anatomical landmarks for biometric assessment. Results are compiled into a structured clinician-oriented report with integrated visualizations, without manual interaction. Evaluation on independent retrospective and prospective cohorts demonstrated robust performance across varying acquisition settings. Mean Dice similarity coefficients were 0.82 for the uterus and 0.80 for fibroids, with lower but consistent agreement for Nabothian cysts. Landmark detection achieved a mean radial error of 3.7 mm. End-to-end processing was completed in under 70 seconds, enabling availability of results during the ongoing scan. Prospective deployment yielded immediate, standardized, and reproducible analyses supported by inter-observer agreement. The proposed system enables real-time scanner-integrated AI for automated uterine MRI analysis and reporting, with potential to improve standardization, efficiency, and clinical workflow in pelvic imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Female-RHINO 框架，集成 MRI 扫描仪与深度学习，实现子宫 MRI 的实时自动分析和结构化报告。系统在 500+ 多中心数据集训练，进行分割、常见偶然发现检测（肌瘤、Nabothian 囊肿）和生物标志物提取，端到端处理 <70 秒。独立评估中子宫 Dice 0.82，肌瘤 Dice 0.80，标志点定位平均径向误差 3.7 mm。
Motivation: 子宫 MRI 标准化评估因解剖变异、观察者依赖和缺乏工作流集成工具而困难。
Method: 端到端系统，内联与扫描仪通信，使用深度学习分割和标志点检测模型，自动计算体积、检测肌瘤和囊肿，并提取六个解剖标志点，生成结构化报告。
Result: 独立回顾性和前瞻性队列：子宫 Dice 0.82，肌瘤 Dice 0.80，囊肿一致性较低；标志点检测平均径向误差 3.7 mm；处理时间 <70 秒。前瞻部署显示即时、标准化分析，观察者间一致性好。
Conclusion: 实现实时扫描仪集成 AI 的子宫 MRI 自动分析和报告，有潜力提高盆腔成像的标准化、效率和临床工作流。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PHANTOM: A Large-Scale Dataset of Multimodal Adversarial Attacks for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a large-scale, open-source dataset of pre-generated adversarial attacks for vision-language models (VLMs). The dataset is designed to be diverse, representative, and practical, extending existing benchmarks by covering 10 high-level categories and 55 subcategories of harmful intents. Our primary goal is to make adversarial data accessible to the research community, given the computational cost and complexity of generating large numbers of attacks. The dataset comprises 47 524 adversarial samples, generated using state-of-the-art attack strategies from recent literature. Our work complements existing efforts by consolidating and extending prior benchmarks from multiple established sources, resulting in 7 826 intents, and introduce an additional category to broaden coverage. This provides realistic evaluation resources for studying model robustness and alignment. Our dataset intends to enable researchers and practitioners to systematically evaluate the robustness and safety of VLMs, fine-tune attack-generation models, and develop or stress-test defensive guardrails under diverse adversarial conditions. By releasing this resource, we aim to lower the barrier to adversarial research and foster more reproducible, comprehensive, and comparable evaluations of VLM safety.
papers.comment: The dataset has been released at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/it4lia/PHANTOM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个大规模、开源的多模态对抗攻击数据集PHANTOM，针对视觉语言模型（VLMs）生成，包含47,524个对抗样本，覆盖10个高层次类别和55个子类别的有害意图。数据集旨在降低对抗性研究门槛，促进VLM鲁棒性和安全性的可重复、全面评估。
Motivation: 生成大量对抗样本的计算成本和复杂性高，现有基准覆盖不足，研究社区缺少易访问的多样化对抗数据来系统评估VLM鲁棒性和安全性。
Method: 整合并扩展多个已有基准的对抗攻击策略，形成7,826个意图，并新增类别以拓宽覆盖；使用最新攻击方法生成样本。
Result: 数据集包含47,524个对抗样本，覆盖10大类55子类有害意图，已在Hugging Face上开源发布。
Conclusion: 该数据集为VLM鲁棒性、安全性评估及防御机制开发提供了实用资源，旨在推动可重复、全面的比较研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Stability of Prompt Ranking in Large Language Model Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-based interaction has become a dominant paradigm for using large language models (LLMs), where multiple candidate prompts are evaluated and the top-ranked one is selected for downstream use. This workflow implicitly assumes that prompt rankings are stable under minor variations in evaluation conditions. In this paper, we systematically study prompt ranking stability under common sources of variability, including random seeds and limited evaluation subsets. Across three open-weight LLMs and two benchmark tasks, we find that while overall rank correlations are often moderate to high, the identity of the top-performing prompt frequently changes, leading to unreliable selection decisions. To address this issue, we propose a simple stability-aware selection strategy based on a lower confidence bound, which accounts for both performance and variance. Our results show that this approach improves robustness in unstable settings while remaining competitive in more stable regimes. These findings highlight the importance of accounting for evaluation uncertainty in prompt selection and LLM benchmarking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了大语言模型（LLM）评估中prompt排名在随机种子和有限评估子集等常见变异性下的稳定性。发现整体秩相关虽中等到高，但最优prompt的身份频繁变化，导致选择不可靠。提出基于下置信界（lower confidence bound）的稳定感知选择策略，在不稳定设置中提升鲁棒性，在稳定设置中保持竞争力。
Motivation: 当前基于prompt的LLM交互中，候选prompt排名隐式假设在小变化下稳定，但实际中常见变异性导致排名不稳定，影响下游选择。
Method: 在三个开源LLM和两个基准任务上系统研究排名稳定性，并提出基于下置信界的选择策略，同时考虑性能与方差。
Result: 发现最优prompt的身份频繁变化；所提策略在不稳定设置中提升鲁棒性，在稳定设置中与基线竞争。
Conclusion: 强调在prompt选择和LLM基准测试中考虑评估不确定性的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MATCH: Flow Matching for Multi-View Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Detecting anomalies in industrial objects is an important topic for increasing production efficiency. More complex objects often require the analysis of several view points, which has led to the field of multi-view anomaly detection. We present MATCH, the first multi-view anomaly detection method based on Flow Matching (FM). With the ODE formulation of Flow Matching, we can estimate likelihoods and thereby derive an anomaly score to detect anomalies in multi-view image data at object, image, and pixel-level. The architectural flexibility of FM models allows us to efficiently transform features of different spatial sizes to the normal distribution. We evaluate thoroughly on the already established Real-IAD data set and are also the first to provide a comprehensive evaluation of popular anomaly detection methods for the MANTA-Tiny data set. MATCH achieves state-of-the-art performance in both anomaly detection and segmentation, all while running on consumer-level hardware. By omitting the costly divergence term needed for likelihood estimation, we ensure that MATCH is usable in real-time production scenarios. Lastly, several ablation studies are conducted to validate the methodological choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的多视角异常检测方法MATCH，这是首次将流匹配应用于多视角异常检测。通过ODE形式的流匹配估计似然，从而在物体、图像和像素级别检测异常。在Real-IAD和MANTA-Tiny数据集上达到最先进性能，且能在消费级硬件上实时运行。
Motivation: 复杂工业物体的异常检测需要分析多个视角，而现有的多视角异常检测方法在精度和实时性上仍有不足。
Method: 采用流匹配的ODE公式估计似然，利用其架构灵活性将不同空间尺寸的特征变换到正态分布，并省略昂贵的散度项以实现实时推理。
Result: 在Real-IAD和MANTA-Tiny数据集上，异常检测和分割任务均达到最先进性能，且能在消费级硬件上实时运行。
Conclusion: MATCH证明了流匹配在多视角异常检测中的有效性，并可在实际生产场景中实时使用。

papers.title: Structural Kolmogorov-Arnold Convolutions: Learnable Function on the Values or the Filter Shape as Parameter-Efficient Alternative to Per-Edge Convolutional KANs
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) replace the fixed weights of a convolutional kernel with learnable univariate functions. The dominant formulation attaches one such function to every kernel entry and lets it act on pixel values, expressive but parameter-heavy and prone to overfitting. We argue that the learnable functions are better placed in the \emph{structure} of the convolution than on each edge, and we organise the design space along a single axis: whether the function acts on the pixel \emph{values} or on the filter \emph{shape}. We study three realisations. SV-KAN applies one shared univariate function to the values and leaves the spatial filter free and static, aa classical convolution with a single learnable shared activation. AG-KAN keeps the shared value function but supplies the spatial structure through a content-adaptive Gaussian gate. RF-KAN instead moves the learnable functions onto the filter shape, building each filter from oriented ridge profiles expanded in a localised oscillatory (Morlet) wavelet basis with content-adaptive amplitudes. Under a matched four-layer protocol with in-run references and three seeds, RF-KAN and SV-KAN reach $88.47\pm0.10\%$ and $88.20\pm0.31\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $64.40\pm0.19\%$ and $64.57\pm0.30\%$ on CIFAR-100, at about $0.4$M parameters. At this matched scale the shape model and the simplest value model meet at the top, both above a plain convolution and every per-edge KAN we tested, including the official Gram variant, at roughly a fifth of the parameters. A controlled study attributes the RF-KAN gain to an intrinsically localised oscillatory basis and to content adaptivity, and an ablation that removes the learned shape entirely, leaving only the shared value function, collapses accuracy by over forty points, identifying the learned shape as the load-bearing ingredient at this scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结构化的Kolmogorov-Arnold卷积（KAN），将可学习函数置于卷积结构（滤值或滤波器形状）而非每个边上，设计了三种实现：SV-KAN（共享单变量函数作用于像素值）、AG-KAN（内容自适应高斯门）、RF-KAN（基于定向脊轮廓和Morlet小波的滤波器形状学习）。在CIFAR-10/100上，RF-KAN和SV-KAN以约0.4M参数达到与每边KAN相当或更高的精度，且参数减少约5倍。消融表明可学习的滤波器形状是性能的关键。
Motivation: 现有卷积KAN为每个核条目分配可学习函数，参数多且易过拟合，该文探索将可学习函数更合理地置于卷积的“结构”上，以提升参数效率。
Method: 将设计空间按可学习函数作用于像素值或滤波器形状划分，提出三种变体：SV-KAN（共享值函数+固定空间滤波）、AG-KAN（共享值函数+内容自适应高斯门）、RF-KAN（滤波器形状由定向脊轮廓在局部振荡Morlet小波基上展开，振幅内容自适应）。
Result: 在4层协议下，RF-KAN和SV-KAN在CIFAR-10上分别达到88.47%±0.10%和88.20%±0.31%，CIFAR-100上分别64.40%±0.19%和64.57%±0.30%，参数量约0.4M，优于普通卷积和每边KAN（包括Gram变体），且参数仅为后者的约1/5。移除可学习形状后精度下降超40点。
Conclusion: 在匹配参数量下，形状模型（RF-KAN）和最简单的值模型（SV-KAN）表现相当，均优于每边KAN，且可学习滤波器形状是关键成分。但实验限于CIFAR-10/100，未涉及更大规模或更多模态数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Helpfulness Overrides Causal Caution: Context-Dependent Suppression and Recovery in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into decision-support roles in business and policy contexts. While prior benchmark studies have primarily evaluated LLMs' causal reasoning capabilities, a more fundamental epistemic dimension has been overlooked: Causal Caution, defined as the propensity to refrain from causal judgment when empirical evidence is insufficient. This study examines the systematic suppression of Causal Caution that occurs when LLMs shift from academic to practical advisory contexts. Using an evaluation rubric inspired by Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (the PCH score), we conducted experiments on four high-performance LLMs -- Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT 5.5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro -- across 480 trials. Causal Caution maintenance rates were 91.7--100.0% in academic contexts but dropped to 6.7--18.3% in practical advisory contexts (Fisher's exact test, p < .001 across all models). Furthermore, when restricted to practical prompts requesting concrete recommendations or explanatory rationales, only 1 of 200 responses (0.5%) maintained Causal Caution. A brief self-correction prompt -- "Please reconsider this judgment from the perspective of causal relationships" -- restored the expression of Causal Caution to maintenance rates of 71.4--100.0% (McNemar's test, p < .001 across all models). These results suggest that helpfulness-oriented response patterns may suppress the expression of Causal Caution in practical advisory contexts, with important implications for organizational governance. The findings indicate that this suppression reflects context-dependent variation in expression rather than an underlying capability limitation, suggesting that multi-agent architectures that separate proposal generation from causal auditing may offer a promising governance design.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. SSRN Abstract ID: 6965680
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM在从学术到实际咨询语境转换时，因果谨慎性（Causal Caution）的系统性抑制。实验在四个高性能LLM上进行，发现学术语境下因果谨慎维持率91.7-100%，实际咨询语境下降至6.7-18.3%，且自我纠正提示可恢复。结果表明这种抑制是语境依赖的表达变化而非能力限制。
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估LLM的因果推理能力，但忽视了更基本的认识论维度：因果谨慎性，即在证据不足时克制因果判断的倾向。该研究关注这种谨慎性在实用咨询语境中被抑制的问题。
Method: 使用基于Pearl因果层次（PCH评分）的评估方法，在四个LLM（Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro）上进行480次试验，对比学术和实际咨询语境下的因果谨慎维持率，并测试自我纠正提示的效果。
Result: 学术语境下因果谨慎维持率91.7-100%，实际咨询语境下降至6.7-18.3%（p<.001）。当实际提示要求具体建议或解释时，仅0.5%的响应维持因果谨慎。自我纠正提示后恢复至71.4-100%。
Conclusion: 有帮助性导向的响应模式可能抑制实际咨询语境中的因果谨慎表达，但这是语境依赖的表达变化而非能力缺陷，提示多智能体架构（分离提案生成与因果审计）可能提供有前景的治理设计。

papers.title: Accelerating Disaggregated RL for Visual Generative LLMs with Diffusion-Based Parallelism and Trainer-Assisted Generation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant post-training paradigm, driving the emergence of high-performance RL systems such as veRL for autoregressive large language models (LLMs). In parallel, diffusion-oriented RL algorithms, e.g., DanceGRPO and FlowGRPO, have rapidly expanded the scope of RL from language reasoning to diffusion-based visual and flow-based generation. However, efficient RL systems for diffusion generative LLMs remain underexplored. Existing implementations, e.g., veRL-Omni, still rely on colocated execution, which simplifies synchronization but couples rollout and training resources, limits heterogeneous deployment, and constrains independent scaling. To this end, we introduce DigenRL, a disaggregated RL framework for diffusion-based generative LLMs that supports flexible resource allocation, accommodates heterogeneous GPUs, and facilitates efficient task scheduling. To maximally reduce the execution bubbles in the disaggregated architecture, we propose: 1) a generation-axis pipeline (GAP) and time-step parallelism (TSP) in the diffusion architecture to enable finer-grained pipelining between rollout and training; 2) an elastic trainer-assisted generation (TAG) approach to enable the trainer GPU resources to dynamically assist in executing rollout generations; and 3) a tightly one-step constrained asynchronous strategy to further utilize the tail bubble in the pipeline. Extensive experiments are conducted on three hardware testbeds with 16-32 GPUs using HunyuanVideo-13B, Wan2.1-14B, FLUX.1-12B, and QwenImage-20B generative models. Experimental results show that DigenRL achieves 1.56-2.10x throughput improvements over state-of-the-art diffusion RL systems, veRL-Omni and GenRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DigenRL，一个用于扩散生成大语言模型的解耦强化学习框架，支持灵活资源分配、异构GPU和高效任务调度。针对解耦架构中的执行气泡，提出生成轴流水线（GAP）、时间步并行（TSP）、弹性训练器辅助生成（TAG）以及紧一步约束异步策略。在HunyuanVideo-13B等模型上的实验表明，相比现有系统veRL-Omni和GenRL，吞吐量提升1.56-2.10倍。
Motivation: 现有用于扩散生成大语言模型的强化学习系统（如veRL-Omni）仍依赖共置执行，限制了异构部署和独立伸缩，亟需更高效的解耦框架。
Method: 提出DigenRL解耦框架，包含三个关键技术：1）生成轴流水线与时间步并行，实现细粒度流水线；2）弹性训练器辅助生成，让训练GPU动态辅助执行生成；3）紧一步约束异步策略，进一步利用流水线尾部气泡。
Result: 在16-32 GPU的三种硬件测试台上，使用HunyuanVideo-13B、Wan2.1-14B、FLUX.1-12B和QwenImage-20B模型，吞吐量比最先进的扩散RL系统veRL-Omni和GenRL提升1.56-2.10倍。
Conclusion: DigenRL通过解耦架构和并行策略有效加速扩散生成LLM的强化学习训练，且支持异构GPU和灵活资源分配。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SignNet-1M: Large-Scale Multilingual Sign Language Video Dataset with Downstream Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Sign language models are typically trained on datasets captured under constrained conditions, with limited viewpoint, background, and signer-identity diversity, leading to poor robustness under real-world distribution shifts. We introduce SignNet-1M, a large-scale augmented dataset spanning ASL, CSL, and German Sign Language (DGS). SignNet-1M synthesizes realistic variations along three axes: (i) novel-view rendering (rotation and zoom) via 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), (ii) scene/identity editing via diffusion models for background replacement and signer substitution while preserving sign motion and linguistic content, and (iii) post-rendering augmentations that emulate capture and compression artifacts (e.g., pose/temporal perturbations and video-level corruptions) to better match in-the-wild recordings. Beyond data release, we provide a unified benchmark suite across downstream tasks (e.g., translation and recognition) and ablations that isolate each augmentation component. Experiments across backbones show that training with SignNet-1M consistently improves generalization under cross-view, cross-background, cross-identity, and post-rendering shifts, while maintaining strong in-distribution performance. The dataset, full augmentation pipeline, and benchmark are available at https://signnet.chatsign.ai/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SignNet-1M，一个大规模多语言手语视频数据集，涵盖美国手语（ASL）、中国手语（CSL）和德国手语（DGS）。该数据集通过 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）实现新视角渲染，使用扩散模型进行场景/身份编辑，并添加后渲染增强以模拟真实世界分布偏移。实验表明，基于 SignNet-1M 训练的手语模型在跨视角、跨背景、跨身份等泛化任务上表现提升，同时保持分布内性能。
Motivation: 现有手语数据集通常在受限条件下采集，视角、背景和身份多样性不足，导致模型在真实分布偏移下鲁棒性差。
Method: 通过 3DGS 生成新视角（旋转/缩放），扩散模型替换背景和替换手语者（保留动作和语义），后渲染增强模拟压缩伪影和时序扰动。
Result: 实验显示，在翻译和识别等下游任务中，使用 SignNet-1M 训练可显著提升跨视角、跨背景、跨身份和增强后的泛化能力，并保持分布内性能。
Conclusion: SignNet-1M 提供了大规模增强数据集和统一基准，有助于提升手语模型在实际场景中的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why is Seasonal Climate Predictable Beyond the Limit of Deterministic Predictability set by Chaos?
papers.abstract_en: The Earth's climate is an ensemble of interacting, spatially extended oscillatory media ('climate systems') whose slow-changing averages coexist with chaotic, high-frequency weather fluctuations in quasi-equilibrium. The limit of deterministic predictability (LDP) for any climate system is determined by its fastest-growing errors. However, recent findings show that the Indian Summer Monsoon Rainfall (ISMR) can be predicted up to 18 months in advance-far beyond its LDP. Using a model of two interacting oscillatory media, we show that this extended predictability arises from lag synchronization between ISMR and its predictor, the Global El Nino-Southern Oscillation (G-ENSO), to which it is strongly coupled. We introduce complex order parameters representing the internal dynamics of the two climate systems. Their spatiotemporal evolution is governed by coupled Complex Ginzburg-Landau Equations, producing aperiodic yet strongly correlated time series at long lead times. Our findings have far-reaching consequences in advancing seasonal prediction across climate systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文从理论层面解释为何季节性气候的可预测性可以超越混沌决定的确定性可预测性极限（LDP），以印度夏季风降雨（ISMR）为例，展示其可提前18个月预测。通过双相互作用振荡介质模型和复Ginzburg-Landau方程，作者将这种扩展可预测性归因于ISMR与全球ENSO之间的滞后同步。
Motivation: 传统观点认为气候系统的可预测性受限于混沌引起的确定性可预测性极限，但近期观测显示印度夏季风降雨可被提前18个月预测，远超该极限。论文旨在从动力学角度解释这一矛盾现象。
Method: 建立两个相互耦合的振荡介质模型，用复序参量描述系统内部动力学，其时空演化由耦合的复Ginzburg-Landau方程控制。通过理论分析和数值模拟，研究滞后同步如何导致长时间尺度上的相关时间序列。
Result: 发现滞后同步机制使得ISMR与全球ENSO在长时间滞后下仍保持强相关，从而产生超越LDP的可预测性。模型生成非周期但高度相关的时间序列，定性复现了实际预测能力。
Conclusion: 该工作为超越混沌极限的季节性预测提供了理论框架，指出滞后同步是延长可预测性的关键机制，对推进跨气候系统的季节预测具有重要意义。
Relevance: 65

papers.title: Open-Vocabulary BEV Segmentation with 3D-Aware Geometric Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Bird's-eye view (BEV) perception fuses multi-camera images into a unified top-down representation for autonomous driving. Despite recent progress, state-of-the-art methods remain confined to closed-set scenarios, making them vulnerable to unpredictable real-world environments. In this work, we introduce open-vocabulary BEV segmentation (OVBS), which leverages vision-language models (VLMs) to recognize categories beyond the training set while maintaining precise BEV perception and real-time efficiency. A key challenge in OVBS lies in the 3D geometric inconsistency inherent in the ill-posed lifting of 2D VLM semantics into BEV. To address this, we propose OVBEVSeg, a geometry-aware OVBS framework that enhances efficient Gaussian splatting (GS)-based unprojection by leveraging robust 3D geometric constraints across three progressive stages: (1) 2D-to-BEV pseudo-labeling via reliable 3D projection for OV generalization; (2) joint 2D-BEV per-scene optimization with BEV structural constraints for 3D geometric consistency; and (3) 3D geometric distillation for online efficiency. On the nuScenes dataset, OVBEVSeg achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming closed-set methods by 15.3 mIoU on unseen categories. Remarkably, even with no novel-class ground-truth labels, it remains competitive with self- and semi-supervised baselines trained with up to 40% of ground-truth annotations. Furthermore, it achieves 2.5x faster inference with only 0.22x the memory consumption of projection-based methods. Project page: https://hchoi256.github.io/projects/ovbevseg/.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出开放词汇的BEV分割任务（OVBS），利用视觉语言模型实现训练集之外的类别识别，并解决2D语义到BEV的3D几何不一致问题。方法OVBEVSEG通过三阶段几何约束的高斯溅射反投影，在nuScenes数据集上对未见类别超越闭集方法15.3 mIoU，推理速度提升2.5倍，内存消耗仅为投影方法的0.22倍。
Motivation: 现有BEV感知局限于闭集场景，无法应对真实世界的开放类别。将2D VLM语义提升到BEV时存在固有的3D几何不一致性。
Method: 提出OVBEVSEG框架，利用几何感知的高斯溅射反投影，通过三阶段渐进约束：1）基于可靠3D投影的2D到BEV伪标签；2）联合2D-BEV每场景优化与BEV结构约束；3）3D几何蒸馏实现在线效率。
Result: 在nuScenes上，对未见类别超越闭集方法15.3 mIoU；即使没有新类真值标签，仍与使用40%标注的自/半监督基线竞争；推理速度2.5倍，内存0.22倍。
Conclusion: 本文实现了开放词汇BEV分割，通过几何约束解决了3D不一致问题，在效率和泛化上取得显著提升。

papers.title: A Step Towards Inherently Interpretable Causal Machine Learning Models For Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: The growing reliance on machine learning for decisions across sectors underscores the importance of model transparency and interpretability. Existing post hoc explainability methods and inherently interpretable approaches shed light on model behavior, yet they primarily reveal how models exploit correlations to maximize performance in prediction tasks. However, many decisions require causal insights and the possibility of using models for what-if scenario evaluation. To address this, we propose the integration of causal machine learning with inherently interpretable models for cross-sectional data. We evaluate these methods in terms of predictive accuracy and interpretability. Our findings show that the proposed approach achieves competitive performance in prediction and what-if analysis while offering transparency on the system structure, causal relationships among variables, and the functional forms that connect them. This work contributes to research on causality, machine learning interpretability, and data-driven decision support by offering informed, transparent, and causally grounded decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将因果机器学习与内在可解释模型相结合，用于横截面数据的决策支持，旨在提供不仅预测准确而且能够进行因果推理和假设情景分析的方法。实验表明，该方法在预测和假设分析上表现良好，同时揭示了系统结构、变量间的因果关系及其函数形式。
Motivation: 现有机器学习可解释性方法主要揭示模型如何利用相关性进行预测，但许多决策场景需要因果洞察和假设情景评估能力，当前方法在这方面的支持不足。
Method: 将因果机器学习与内在可解释模型（如可加模型或线性模型）集成，用于横截面数据，以同时保持预测能力和因果可解释性。
Result: 所提方法在预测准确性和假设分析上取得了有竞争力的性能，并能透明地展示系统结构、变量间的因果关联及函数形式。
Conclusion: 该工作通过提供基于因果关系的透明决策支持，为因果性、机器学习可解释性和数据驱动决策研究做出了贡献。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MVG-KAN: Multi-View Geo-Wind Guided KAN for PM$_{2.5}$ Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate short-term PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting is important for public health protection, air-quality early warning, and urban environmental management. However, PM$_{2.5}$ variation is driven by multiple coupled factors, including stable periodic changes induced by human activities and meteorological regularity, station-specific short-term concentration evolution, and meteorology-driven pollutant dispersion among monitoring stations. Existing spatio-temporal forecasting methods may capture station relationships to some extent, but distance-only, correlation-based, or purely adaptive graphs are often insufficient to comprehensively represent these heterogeneous factors, especially wind-direction-dependent pollutant transport. To address this problem, we propose a Multi-View Geo-Wind Guided KAN model for PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting, named \textbf{MVG-KAN}, which models station-level PM$_{2.5}$ evolution from three complementary views: local periodic regularity, station-wise residual temporal dynamics, and meteorological-environment-guided spatial dispersion. Specifically, the periodic-residual forecasting backbone first separates stable daily and weekly patterns from non-periodic residual variations. A Geo-Wind Graph is constructed by combining geographic distance decay with wind-direction- and wind-speed-aware transport, providing a lightweight physically motivated directed spatial prior for residual propagation among stations. In addition, a temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold network (TKAN) residual head is then introduced to learn station-wise nonlinear autoregressive correction from de-periodized PM$_{2.5}$ residuals and historical multi-pollutant sequences, thereby enhancing the modeling of local residual inertia and pollutant co-variation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MVG-KAN模型，用于短期PM2.5预测。该模型从局部周期性规律、站点残差时间动态和气象环境引导的空间扩散三个视角建模。具体包括周期-残差分解主干、地理-风图（结合距离衰减和风向风速）以及时间KAN残差头来学习非线性自回归校正。摘要未报告实验定量结果。
Motivation: 现有时空预测方法在表示PM2.5变化的多重耦合因素（尤其是风向依赖的污染物传输）时不够充分，仅距离、相关性或纯自适应图难以全面表示。
Method: 提出MVG-KAN模型，包含三部分：1）周期-残差预测主干分离稳定周期模式与非周期残差；2）地理-风图结合地理距离衰减和风向风速先验，提供有向空间信息；3）时间KAN（TKAN）残差头从去周期化的残差和多污染物序列学习局部非线性校正。
Conclusion: 模型通过多视图建模和物理引导图增强了PM2.5预测中对残差惯性和污染物协变的捕捉能力。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: What Does ODRL Mean? A Cross-Level Ontological Grounding of Permissions, Prohibitions, and Duties in UFO-L
papers.abstract_en: ODRL policy evaluators produce verdicts, but say nothing about the normative positions a policy brings into existence, the authority structures those positions presuppose, or who holds the power to declare a norm violated. We formulate the Cross-Level Design Principle: any normative language with violable, consequential norms requires both conduct-level positions (Permission, Duty, Right, No right) and competence-level positions (Power, Subjection, Immunity, Disability). Applying this to ODRL, we establish that prohibition is sanctioned (violation possible and consequential), that permission is underspecified across its behaviour parameter (open vs. closed world), and that the formal semantics covers achievement obligations only. We ground ODRL in UFO-L, mapping each activated rule to a simple legal relator and extending coverage from two to eight legal positions; violation-declaration authority, implicit in every existing evaluator, becomes an explicit Power-Subjection pair. All axioms are mechanically verified in Isabelle/HOL and across a 39-problem benchmark under Vampire, E, and Z3.
papers.comment: Accepted at FOIS 2026 (16th International Conference on Formal Ontology in Information Systems), Vitória, Brazil; to appear in Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence and Applications, IOS Press. 16 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对ODRL策略语言缺乏对规范立场、权威结构和违规声明权力的明确语义，提出跨层本体设计原则，将ODRL扎根于UFO-L顶层本体，从4种法律立场扩展到8种，并形式化验证。摘要展示了在Isabelle/HOL和Vampire/E/Z3上的验证结果。
Motivation: ODRL策略评估器只产生判决，但不说明政策创建了哪些规范立场、预设什么样的权威结构，或谁有权宣布违规。这导致语义不完整。
Method: 提出跨层设计原则，将规范语言区分为行为层立场（Permission, Duty等）和权限层立场（Power, Subjection等），并将ODRL映射到UFO-L顶层本体，扩展法律立场从4到8种，显式建模违规声明权威作为Power-Subjection对。
Result: 所有公理在Isabelle/HOL中机械验证，并在39个问题的基准测试上使用Vampire、E和Z3验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作建立了ODRL的深层本体基础，使得政策语义更精确。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Managing Task Execution for Unknown Workloads in Batteryless IoT: A Hardware-Agnostic Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, the Internet of Things (IoT) paradigm has been shifting toward batteryless, energy-harvesting architectures. Sustaining reliable operation in these systems requires intelligent management of highly volatile stored energy. As edge applications grow in complexity, traditional energy-aware schedulers struggle with unpredictable workloads due to their reliance on static execution thresholds or pre-measured, hardware-specific task profiles. To overcome this, we propose two novel, hardware-agnostic dynamic scheduling strategies treating applications as a "black box," requiring no prior energy information: a model-free Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent and an on-the-fly Approximated Prediction (AP) method. We evaluate these methods against an adaptive task rate approach (AsTAR) and optimized static thresholds using a custom-built, physically accurate simulation framework driven by real-world solar data and dynamic LoRa transmission profiles. Rather than claiming universal superiority, our analysis exposes the distinct operational trade-offs of each method: the AP approach delivers lightweight, near-oracle task throughput; the RL agent provides tunable survival-execution balancing; and AsTAR excels at execution pacing across long energy gaps. Finally, we demonstrate that while these advanced strategies provide critical resilience for severely constrained systems with small capacitors, devices with larger energy buffers can efficiently rely on simpler, less computationally expensive static policies.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无电池物联网设备在能量波动环境下的任务调度问题，提出两种硬件无关的动态调度策略：基于无模型强化学习的智能体（model-free RL agent）和即时近似预测方法（Approximated Prediction）。通过物理精确的仿真框架（使用真实太阳能数据和动态LoRa传输剖面）进行评估，与自适应任务速率方法（AsTAR）及优化的静态阈值对比。分析揭示了各方法的不同权衡：AP方法在轻量级下接近理想吞吐量；RL智能体提供可调生存-执行平衡；AsTAR擅长长能量间隙的执行节奏。论文指出，在严重受限的小电容设备上高级策略提供关键韧性，而大能量缓冲设备可依赖更简单的静态策略。
Motivation: 传统能量感知调度器依赖静态阈值或预测量的硬件特定任务剖面，难以处理不可预测的工作负载，阻碍了无电池IoT在复杂边缘应用中的可靠运行。
Method: 提出两种硬件无关的动态调度策略：一是无模型强化学习智能体，通过试错学习最优任务执行决策；二是即时近似预测方法，基于在线能量可用性估计动态调整任务执行。在自定义的物理精确仿真框架中评估，使用真实太阳能数据和动态LoRa传输剖面。
Result: AP方法在轻量级计算下实现接近理想的任务吞吐量；RL智能体提供可调的生存-执行平衡；AsTAR在长能量间隙中表现出优异的执行节奏控制。在小电容设备上，这些高级策略显著提升韧性；而大能量缓冲设备使用简单静态策略即足够高效。
Conclusion: 论文强调不存在普遍最优的调度策略，不同方法在吞吐量、能量效率、复杂度之间存在明显权衡，选择应基于设备约束和应用需求。

papers.title: TIGER: Taming Identity, Geometry, and Generative Priors for High-Quality Face Video Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Face Video Restoration (FVR) aims to recover high-fidelity facial videos from degraded input while preserving identity and semantic consistency across frames. Existing methods often struggle to simultaneously address three key challenges: identity shift, viewpoint-entangled guidance, and perceptual realism. To tackle these issues, we propose TIGER, a structured tri-prior fusion framework that Tames Identity, Geometry, and gEnerative pRiors for high-quality FVR. Specifically, an Identity Prior is first established by injecting subject-discriminative embeddings into the latent space, effectively anchoring the subject's identity against severe degradations. Then, to provide temporally consistent structural guidance for dynamic videos, TIGER constructs a Geometry Prior by lifting 2D reference cues into a disentangled 3D parameter space, creating a geometric anchor through cross-source parameter fusion. Moreover, to achieve maximum efficiency without compromising realism, we harness the video generation model's Generative Prior through a one-step rectified flow. We further design a progressive three-stage training optimization strategy that refines structural fidelity, textural reconstruction, and distribution-level realism to ensure robust optimization. We also construct a large-scale FVR dataset to facilitate robust training and standardized evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TIGER achieves state-of-the-art performance in both identity fidelity and temporal stability, delivering a high-quality, efficient and identity-consistent FVR. Project page: https://yzhoulv.github.io/Tiger/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TIGER，一个三先验融合框架用于人脸视频修复（Face Video Restoration）。通过注入主题判别嵌入建立身份先验，将2D参考线索提升到解耦3D参数空间构建几何先验，并利用视频生成模型的生成先验进行单步整流流，实现高效高质量修复。三阶段训练策略逐步优化结构保真度、纹理重建和分布级真实性。实验表明在身份保真度和时间稳定性上达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有方法难以同时解决人脸视频修复中的身份偏移、视角纠缠引导和感知真实性问题。
Method: 提出结构化三先验融合框架：身份先验通过注入主题判别嵌入锚定身份；几何先验通过将2D参考线索提升到解耦3D参数空间提供时域一致的结构引导；生成先验利用视频生成模型的单步整流流提高效率。设计渐进式三阶段训练策略分别优化结构、纹理和分布真实性。
Result: 在多个基准上达到最先进的身份保真度和时间稳定性，实现高质量、高效且身份一致的视频修复。
Conclusion: TIGER通过三先验融合和渐进式训练有效解决了人脸视频修复中的三个关键挑战。

papers.title: Ill-Posed by Design: Probing Evidence Use in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual analysis is widely used to study evidence use in vision-language models, but its diagnostic value is limited on well-posed tasks: when several cues independently support the same answer, removing one may not change the prediction. We propose monocular metric object-size estimation as an ill-posed diagnostic setting for evidence selection: because physical size cannot be determined from a single uncalibrated image, models must rely on imperfect cues category priors, target appearance, local context, apparent image size, and scene geometry. We assemble Metric VQA ($10{,}813$ dimension queries from Objectron and $331$ tape-measured in-the-wild scenes) and evaluate $12$ open-weight VLMs ($3$--$397$\,B parameters) with counterfactual analysis decomposing six visual and language evidence channels. Even the largest VLMs tested (Qwen3-VL-235B, Qwen3.5-397B, InternVL3.5-241B) trail a text-only frontier LLM on the in-the-wild split. The diagnostic analysis shows: target identity is the most load-bearing cue, target pixels and local context help only some models, apparent size shifts predictions without a directional readout, and global scene geometry is largely unused. We analyze LoRA fine-tuning as an actionable intervention specific to metric estimation: while the task is learnable, the models do not learn to leverage scene geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将单目度量物体大小估计作为病态诊断任务，用于研究视觉语言模型（VLM）如何选择和使用证据。通过构建Metric VQA数据集（包含10,813个维度查询和331个野外场景），对12个开源VLM（3B-397B参数）进行反事实分析，分解6种视觉和语言证据通道。结果表明，即使最大的VLM（如Qwen3-VL-235B、Qwen3.5-397B、InternVL3.5-241B）在野外场景上仍落后于纯文本LLM；目标身份是最关键的线索，而全局场景几何几乎未被利用。LoRA微调可学习该任务，但模型未能学会利用场景几何。
Motivation: 现有反事实分析在良态任务中诊断价值有限，因为多个线索独立支持同一答案时，移除一个可能不改变预测。需要设计病态诊断设置来有效评估VLM的证据选择能力。
Method: 采用单目度量物体大小估计作为病态设置，因为物理尺寸无法从单张未标定图像确定。构建Metric VQA数据集，对12个开源VLM进行反事实分析，分解六种证据通道（类别先验、目标外观、局部上下文、表观尺寸、场景几何等）。
Result: 最大VLM在野外场景上落后于纯文本LLM；目标身份是最关键的线索，目标像素和局部上下文仅对部分模型有帮助，表观尺寸改变预测但无方向性解读，全局场景几何未被使用。LoRA微调虽可学习任务，但未学会利用场景几何。
Conclusion: 单目度量物体大小估计可作为VLM证据选择的诊断工具，现有VLM在利用场景几何方面存在局限，即使微调也难以弥补。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniTranslator: A Unified Multi-modal Framework for End-to-end In-Image Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: In-Image Machine Translation (IIMT) aims to translate scene text in an image and render the translated text back into the original regions while preserving the overall visual appearance. Recent unified multimodal models provide a promising solution by combining visual-text understanding and image generation within a single framework. However, directly adapting such models to IIMT remains challenging. In particular, they often suffer from understanding-generation conflicts, where the translation inferred during understanding is inconsistent with the text supervision used in generation, and spatial position misalignment, where the rendered text does not accurately match the target text regions. To address these issues, we present UniTranslator, a unified multimodal framework for IIMT that tightly couples translation understanding and text editing. Specifically, we introduce an Understand-Generation Alignment Module (UGAM) to bridge the representation gap between understanding and generation, encouraging semantic consistency between translated content prediction and text rendering. We further propose a Spatial Mask Decoder (SMD) with pixel-level supervision over text regions to improve spatial grounding, geometric alignment, and layout controllability during generation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that UniTranslator achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse language directions and complex real-world layouts. Moreover, our results reveal a strong mutual reinforcement effect between translation understanding and image generation, highlighting the advantage of unified translation multimodal learning. Code is available at https://github.com/SeerRay-Lab/Unitranslator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniTranslator是一个统一的端到端多模态框架，用于图像内机器翻译（IIMT），即在图像中翻译场景文本并保留视觉外观。它通过理解-生成对齐模块（UGAM）和空间掩码解码器（SMD）解决了理解-生成冲突和空间位置错位问题，在多个基准上取得了最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型直接应用于IIMT时存在理解-生成冲突（翻译与文本监督不一致）和空间位置错位（渲染文本与目标区域不匹配）问题。
Method: 提出UniTranslator框架，包含理解-生成对齐模块（UGAM）以桥接表示间隙，以及空间掩码解码器（SMD）在文本区域提供像素级监督以改善空间定位和几何对齐。
Result: 在多个基准上，UniTranslator在不同语言方向和复杂真实场景布局上达到最先进性能，并显示出翻译理解与图像生成之间的强相互增强效应。
Conclusion: 统一的多模态翻译学习在IIMT中具有优势，且理解与生成相互促进。

papers.title: REDI-Match: Rotation-Equivariant Distillation for Efficient and Robust Dense Matching
papers.abstract_en: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) have significantly advanced dense feature matching, yet severe in-plane rotation remains a critical challenge. Existing solutions face a fundamental dilemma: data-driven methods require inefficient parameter scaling to implicitly learn rotations, whereas strictly equivariant networks lack the semantic capacity of modern VFMs. Consequently, current frameworks typically freeze VFMs and shift the entire burden of rotation generalization to the downstream decoder. To break this architectural bottleneck, we propose REDI-Match, an efficient framework driven by a novel Rotation-Equivariant Distillation (REDI) paradigm. Instead of relying on rotation data augmentation to establish rotational correspondences, REDI distills the non-equivariant semantic representations of a VFM into a lightweight, strictly rotation-equivariant encoder, leveraging an equivariant geometric architecture to constrain robust high-dimensional semantics. To fully exploit these features, we equip the decoder with an entropy-driven spatial alignment module. By evaluating discrete rotation hypotheses, this mechanism explicitly locks onto the canonical coordinate system, eliminating global ambiguity before continuous refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REDI-Match establishes a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) across multiple benchmarks. Notably, it achieves a 13.89% absolute pose accuracy improvement on the highly challenging SatAst dataset while operating 1.9x faster than the current SOTA (RoMa v2), enabling real-time inference (~41 FPS) on a single RTX 4090 GPU. Code: https://github.com/YinjiGe/REDI-Match.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REDI-Match框架，针对视觉基础模型（VFM）在密集特征匹配中面临的面内旋转挑战。通过旋转等变蒸馏（REDI）将VFM的非等变语义表示转移到轻量级严格旋转等变编码器，并利用熵驱动的空间对齐模块锁定规范坐标系。在多个基准上取得新SOTA，尤其在SatAst数据集上位姿精度提升13.89%，推理速度比RoMa v2快1.9倍，实现约41 FPS实时推理。
Motivation: 现有方法面临两难：数据驱动方法需参数缩放以隐含学习旋转，而严格等变网络缺乏现代VFM的语义能力；常用方案冻结VFM并将旋转泛化负担完全推给下游解码器，形成架构瓶颈。
Method: 提出REDI范式，通过蒸馏将VFM的非等变语义表示转移到轻量级严格旋转等变编码器；解码器中设计熵驱动空间对齐模块，评估离散旋转假设以消除全局歧义。
Result: 在多个基准上达到新SOTA，SatAst数据集绝对位姿精度提升13.89%，推理速度比RoMa v2快1.9倍，单张RTX 4090上达到约41 FPS实时推理。
Conclusion: REDI-Match通过蒸馏与等变架构有效平衡旋转鲁棒性与语义容量，实现了高效鲁棒的密集匹配。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在多个基准上达到新SOTA，SatAst数据集绝对位姿精度提升13.89%，推理速度比RoMa v2快1.9倍，单张RTX 4090上达到约41 FPS实时推理。
summary_sections.conclusion: REDI-Match通过蒸馏与等变架构有效平衡旋转鲁棒性与语义容量，实现了高效鲁棒的密集匹配。

papers.title: ZONOS2 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present ZONOS2 8B, our latest TTS model, which achieves state-of-the-art naturalness, prosody, and voice cloning fidelity. We improve upon Zonos-v0.1 across scale, data, and training recipe. We scale the model from 1.6B to 8B total parameters (900M active) with a novel mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbone, improving inference latency and throughput. We expand our training corpus from 200K to over 6M hours using a new data processing pipeline, and we simplify our post-training and conditioning recipes to improve naturalness and voice cloning fidelity. We evaluate ZONOS2 8B on quality, speaker similarity, WER, and ZTTS1-Eval, our novel TTS benchmark, where it performs competitively with state-of-the-art systems while maintaining good streaming latency. We release our model weights and example inference code under an Apache 2.0 license on GitHub and Hugging Face.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Technical report. Model weights, inference code, and the ZTTS1-Eval benchmark released under Apache 2.0. Code: https://github.com/Zyphra/ZONOS2 ; weights: https://huggingface.co/Zyphra/ZONOS2 ; benchmark: https://github.com/Zyphra/ZTTS1-Eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 ZONOS2 8B，一种新型语音合成（TTS）模型，通过扩大规模、数据量和训练配方，在自然度、韵律和语音克隆保真度上达到最先进水平。模型采用混合专家（MoE）骨干网络，总参数量8B（激活900M），训练数据从200K小时扩展到超过600万小时，并在新基准ZTTS1-Eval上表现竞争力。
Motivation: 现有TTS模型在自然度、韵律和语音克隆方面仍有提升空间，且需要更好的推理效率和流式延迟。
Method: 提出ZONOS2 8B模型，采用MoE架构，扩大训练数据至600万小时，简化后训练和条件化配方。
Result: 在质量、说话人相似度、WER和ZTTS1-Eval基准上达到与最先进系统竞争的性能，同时保持良好流式延迟。
Conclusion: 本文通过规模扩展和数据优化显著提升TTS性能，并开源模型权重和推理代码。

papers.title: Prob-BBDM: a Probabilistic Brownian Bridge Diffusion Model for MRI sequence image-to-image translation
papers.abstract_en: AI-driven image-to-image synthesis is rapidly advancing, with growing applications in medical imaging. Multi-modal image analysis plays a crucial role in optimizing examination quality, yet acquiring multiple imaging modalities in clinical settings remains resource-intensive and time-consuming, especially for 3D imaging. To address this challenge, we propose a novel image-to-image translation model based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion Models (BBDM), which synthesizes magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sequences from 2D axial slices. Our approach integrates a variational encoder-guided diffusion mechanism, leveraging probabilistic image distributions to enhance synthesis quality. Evaluated on the BraTS 2021 dataset, our Probabilistic-BBDM (Prob-BBDM) achieves superior performance across multiple translation tasks, reaching up to 88.46% SSIM and 26.09 dB PSNR, with consistent improvements over baselines. Notably, our diffusion process requires only 4 steps, making it computationally efficient while maintaining high-quality synthesis. To further validate generalizability, we test Prob-BBDM on an external third-party dataset, demonstrating consistent performance across domains. Additionally, we assess the clinical utility of the synthesized slices by using them as input to a pre-trained segmentation model. Tumor segmentation yields a Dice score of 88.71% and an HD95 of 3.49 mm, confirming that the synthesized slices preserve critical diagnostic information. These results highlight the potential of Prob-BBDM for high-quality, efficient, and generalizable MRI synthesis, offering a promising step toward improved medical image translation.
papers.journal_ref: Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics, 2026, 130, pp.102745

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于概率布朗桥扩散模型（Prob-BBDM）的MRI序列图像转换方法，从2D轴向切片合成不同MRI序列。模型结合变分编码器引导的扩散机制，仅需4步扩散步数即可实现高质量合成。在BraTS 2021数据集上，SSIM达88.46%，PSNR达26.09 dB，优于基线方法。外部数据集验证了泛化性，且合成切片用于肿瘤分割时Dice分数达88.71%，HD95为3.49 mm，表明保留了关键诊断信息。
Motivation: 多模态MRI图像在临床中获取资源密集且耗时，尤其是3D成像，因此需要高效的图像到图像转换方法以优化检查质量。
Method: 提出Prob-BBDM模型，采用变分编码器引导的布朗桥扩散过程，利用概率图像分布增强合成质量，并在2D轴向切片上进行序列生成。
Result: 在BraTS 2021数据集上，多任务转换达到SSIM 88.46%和PSNR 26.09 dB，扩散仅需4步；外部数据集验证泛化性；合成切片用于肿瘤分割，Dice 88.71%，HD95 3.49 mm。
Conclusion: Prob-BBDM在高质量、高效、可泛化的MRI合成方面具有潜力，为医学图像转换提供了有前景的方向。
