papers.title: LemonHarness Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM) agents are applied to longer tasks, they increasingly modify workspace state across multiple rounds of iteration. However, agents typically observe only tool outputs and log fragments, while the actual state changes occur in the file system. Without explicit workspace boundaries, state-changing operations such as file writes and temporary artifact generation may scatter changes across paths. Over time, these weakly constrained changes accumulate, making states such as modified files difficult to track. This paper presents LemonHarness, an integrated execution framework for long-horizon agents. LemonHarness establishes an explicit execution boundary by constraining state-changing operations within a clearly defined workspace and bringing model invocation, tool execution, and rule knowledge within a single controlled boundary. State-changing operations, including file writes, dependency installation, and temporary artifact creation, are executed through structured tool interfaces, with execution feedback recorded as observations available to subsequent model decisions. The system also introduces a reusable rule knowledge base, which turns recurring execution rules and acceptance criteria into runtime knowledge. LemonHarness further adds a time-aware execution mechanism that exposes elapsed and remaining budget to the model, so it can rebalance exploration, implementation, and validation effort as time pressure shifts and avoid timeouts from long waits or excessive verification. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, LemonHarness_GPT-5.3-CodeX reached 84.49% accuracy over 445 trials; pairing the same framework with the stronger GPT-5.5 backbone raised the average accuracy to 86.52% across five jobs. The results suggest that a unified runtime boundary, callable rule knowledge, and time-aware execution can improve the stability of long-horizon agent execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LemonHarness，一个面向长时域智能体的集成执行框架，通过显式执行边界、可复用规则知识库和时序感知执行机制，约束状态变更操作并提升执行稳定性。在Terminal-Bench 2.0上，搭配GPT-5.3-CodeX达到84.49%准确率，搭配GPT-5.5达到86.52%。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在执行长任务时，状态变更操作（如文件写入）分散且难以追踪，缺乏显式的工作空间边界，导致执行不稳定性。
Method: LemonHarness建立明确的执行边界，将模型调用、工具执行和规则知识纳入统一受控边界；通过结构化工具接口执行状态变更操作，并记录执行反馈。同时引入可复用的规则知识库和时序感知执行机制，向模型暴露已用和剩余预算以平衡探索、实现和验证。
Result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.0上，LemonHarness_GPT-5.3-CodeX在445次试验中达到84.49%准确率；使用更强骨干GPT-5.5后，平均准确率提升至86.52%。
Conclusion: 统一的运行时边界、可调用的规则知识和时序感知执行能提升长时域智能体执行的稳定性。

papers.title: Real-Time Interactive Music Generation via Data-Free Streaming Consistency Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive music and live performance relies on real-time human expression, but modern generative music AI remains largely absent from this domain due to its prohibitive inference latency and offline rendering paradigm. To provide pioneer musicians with a novel medium for interactive composition, we should fundamentally change these static models into dynamic, playable instruments. In this paper, we propose a framework that bridges this gap. To achieve the low latency required for live interaction without sacrificing structural coherence, we formulate distillation within a streaming autoregressive latent space. Our approach gets rid of the need for expensive paired audio-latent datasets by utilizing prompt-only inputs to synthesize teacher-guided, chunk-wise trajectories on the fly. Because live instruments require high acoustic fidelity, we introduce music-aware consistency objectives, which combine latent, spectral, and temporal-difference losses, to preserve crucial qualities like timbre, transients, and rhythmic stability during accelerated single-step streaming generation. Implemented via parameter-efficient adaptation, our distillation reduces generation steps to achieve a low real-time factor. Crucially, by operating as a continuous autoregressive stream, the system can seamlessly assimilate dynamic human inputs on the fly, allowing users to instantly steer the musical trajectory without interrupting the audio flow. Ultimately, this work recontextualizes generative text-to-music models not as passive prompt-and-wait systems, but as responsive instruments, opening new frontiers for live human-AI musical co-creation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无数据流式一致性蒸馏框架，将文本到音乐生成模型转化为低延迟、可交互的实时乐器。通过自回归潜在空间中的教师-学生蒸馏，结合音乐感知一致性损失，实现单步流式生成并动态吸收人类输入。该方法无需配对音频-潜在数据集，显著降低推理延迟，保持音色和节奏稳定性。
Motivation: 现有生成式音乐AI因推理延迟高和离线渲染范式，无法用于实时交互音乐创作，限制了音乐家的表达。
Method: 提出无数据流式一致性蒸馏，在自回归潜在空间中利用提示仅输入合成教师引导的块状轨迹，引入结合潜在、频谱和时序差分损失的音频感知一致性损失，通过参数高效微调实现单步生成。
Result: 摘要报告该方法实现了低实时因子（低延迟），能够无缝吸收动态人类输入，保持高保真音色和节奏稳定性。
Conclusion: 该工作重新定位文本到音乐模型为响应式乐器，为现场人机音乐共创开辟新方向。

papers.title: TrOCR for Medieval HTR: A Systematic Ablation Study with Cross-Dataset Validation
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning transformer-based handwritten text recognition (HTR) models on medieval manuscripts is challenging because these models are pre-trained on modern text and must adapt to a very different visual domain. This paper studies how three controllable fine-tuning choices (contrast normalization, data augmentation, and layer freezing) affect recognition accuracy when adapting TrOCR to small historical datasets. We run controlled experiments on a 13th-century Italian manuscript (I-CT 91 "Cortonese") and replicate the same experimental grid on the public READ-16 benchmark as robustness evidence. On Cortonese, our best configuration achieves 8.03% character error rate (CER). Statistical comparisons across 13 configurations show that freezing up to three encoder layers or six decoder layers does not significantly harm accuracy, while deeper freezing becomes progressively detrimental. Removing contrast normalization (CLAHE) yields 7.84% CER, comparable to a domain-specialized baseline, suggesting strong optimization can reduce reliance on image preprocessing. Cross-dataset validation on READ-16 shows that decoder freezing thresholds transfer more robustly than encoder thresholds, and combined freezing strategies require dataset-specific re-validation. Finally, we use Grad-CAM gradient attributions and decoder cross-attention maps to diagnose error patterns and failure modes revealed by the ablations. Source code is available at https://github.com/LaudareProject/TrOCR-analysis
papers.comment: Accepted at Document Analysis Systems Workshop 2026 (ICDAR Satellite event)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统消融实验，研究对比归一化、数据增强和层冻结三种微调选择对TrOCR模型适应中世纪手写文本的影响。在13世纪意大利手稿Cortonese上最佳配置达到8.03%字符错误率，并在READ-16基准上交叉验证了鲁棒性。统计分析表明冻结最多三层编码器或六层解码器并不显著损害精度，而更深的冻结则有害。去除对比归一化（CLAHE）得到7.84% CER，与专业领域基线相当。解码器冻结阈值比编码器阈值更鲁棒地跨数据集迁移。最后使用梯度归因和交叉注意力图诊断错误模式。
Motivation: 预训练于现代文本的Transformer-based HTR模型适应中世纪手稿视觉领域具有挑战性，且现有研究对具体微调选择（如层冻结程度、数据增强等）缺乏系统理解。
Method: 在TrOCR模型上，对三种可控微调选择（对比归一化、数据增强、层冻结）进行消融实验，设计13种配置在Cortonese手稿上测试，并复制相同实验网格到READ-16基准进行交叉验证。
Result: 最佳配置在Cortonese上达到8.03% CER；去除CLAHE可得7.84% CER；冻结3个编码器层或6个解码器层不显著损害精度；解码器冻结阈值更鲁棒地跨数据集迁移。
Conclusion: 摘要强调微调选择需要针对具体数据集验证，解码器冻结阈值比编码器更可迁移，以及优化可能减少对图像预处理依赖。

papers.title: MM-TRELLIS: Point-Cloud Guided Multi-Modal 3D Vehicle Generation in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Recovering realistic 3D vehicle models from autonomous driving scenes is crucial for synthesizing training data and building simulation environment. However, most existing vehicle generation methods fail to fully exploit multimodal sensors i.e. multi-view images and LiDAR point clouds) and rely on neural rendering based reconstruction, leading to low-quality mesh. Recently, native 3D generative models have made significant progress, yet they are not built for arbitrary multi-view inputs and often struggle with in-the-wild driving images. In this work, we present MM-TRELLIS, a multi-modal version of TRELLIS for in-the-wild 3D vehicle generation that integrates LiDAR and image sensors from autonomous driving datasets into native 3D generative models. Specifically, multi-view images are cycled as conditioning inputs, while LiDAR point clouds provide test-time guidance to ensure geometric accuracy and cross-view consistency. During denoising, we first align the guidance point cloud with the model priors, then enforce consistency between the generated geometry and the guidance point cloud. Finally, we introduce a voxel filtering strategy based on the opacity of 3D Gaussian Splatting to suppress floaters and produce clean meshes. Comprehensive experiments on Waymo dataset demonstrate our method outperforms existing methods in high-fidelity 3D vehicle generation. Code is available at https://github.com/HongliXiao/MM-TRELLIS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MM-TRELLIS，一种针对自动驾驶场景的多模态3D车辆生成方法，融合多视图图像和LiDAR点云，利用点云引导确保几何精度，并采用基于3D高斯泼溅不透明度的体素过滤去除漂浮物，在Waymo数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有车辆生成方法未能充分利用多模态传感器（图像和LiDAR），且依赖神经渲染导致低质量网格；原生3D生成模型不适用于任意多视图输入，难以处理野外驾驶图像。
Method: 多视图图像作为循环条件输入，LiDAR点云在测试时提供引导；去噪时先对齐引导点云与模型先验，再强制几何一致；最后通过基于3D高斯泼溅不透明度的体素过滤抑制漂浮物。
Result: 在Waymo数据集上，该方法在高保真3D车辆生成方面优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要指出所提方法有效融合多模态数据，生成高质量3D车辆网格，适用于自动驾驶仿真。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PROTECT-90: A Fault Dataset for Power System Protection
papers.abstract_en: The increasing interest in data-driven methods for power system protection is accompanied by a lack of standardized, publicly available high-voltage waveform datasets that enable transparent and reproducible evaluation. To address this gap, this paper introduces the PROTECT-90 dataset, an open electromagnetic transient (EMT)-simulated reference benchmark for high-voltage fault studies with consistent digital-fault-recorder-like measurements, publicly released with this work. The dataset comprises 9,022 physically consistent short-circuit simulation episodes generated on a standardized 90 kV double-line topology with systematically documented domain randomization of grid operating points, line parameters, and fault conditions. For each episode, synchronized three-phase voltage and current waveforms are recorded at eight measurement locations and released together with structured, machine-readable metadata describing fault type, fault location, inception time, and operating conditions. All modeling assumptions, parameter ranges, and data-generation procedures are explicitly documented to ensure transparency and cross-study comparability. By combining physically grounded EMT simulation, balanced scenario coverage, and open accessibility, PROTECT-90 establishes a standardized foundation for reproducible benchmarking of protection-oriented signal processing and learning-based methods.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publication at IEEE PES ISGT Europe 2026. Author accepted manuscript. Final published version will be available via IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了PROTECT-90数据集，这是一个基于电磁暂态仿真的公开高压线路故障波形数据集，包含9,022个仿真场景，涵盖多种故障类型和运行条件，旨在为电力系统保护中的数据驱动方法提供标准化的基准测试平台。
Motivation: 当前电力系统保护中数据驱动方法的研究缺乏标准化、公开的高压波形数据集，导致研究难以透明复现和比较。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 通过电磁暂态仿真在标准90 kV双线拓扑上生成故障数据，系统性地随机化电网运行点、线路参数和故障条件，记录8个测量点的三相电压电流波形，并提供结构化的元数据。
Result: 数据集包含9,022个物理一致的短路仿真场景，覆盖多种故障类型和运行条件，所有数据及生成过程均公开，确保透明性和跨研究可比性。
Conclusion: PROTECT-90为保护导向的信号处理和基于学习的方法建立了标准化、可复现的基准测试基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training-free Cross-domain Few-shot Segmentation via Robust Semantic Representation and Matching
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain Few-shot Segmentation (CD-FSS) aims to transfer knowledge learned from source domain to distinct target domains, segmenting unseen target classes with only a few annotated samples. Although existing methods have made significant progress, they still rely on training or fine-tuning processes, which incur high computational costs and risk overfitting. We observe that when powerful and general-purpose vision foundation models are incorporated into these methods, their performance shows only marginal improvement or even degrades due to overfitting. To address this, we eliminate trainable parameters and propose a training-free framework to avoid both training overhead and overfitting. Built upon the self-supervised vision encoder DINOv3, our framework addresses cross-domain challenges through three core modules. First, the Semantic-aware Feature Re-fusion (SAFR) module identifies and re-fuses features that emphasize semantic patterns, generating representations with enhanced semantic discriminability. Additionally, the Adaptive Support Enhancement (ASE) module narrows semantic gaps between support and query through robust query information aggregation. Finally, the Hybrid Prototype Matching (HPM) module integrates matching results from diverse prototypes to adapt to varying semantic complexity across domains. Extensive experiments on four target domain datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in CD-FSS without any training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练（training-free）的跨域少样本分割（CD-FSS）框架，基于自监督视觉编码器DINOv3，通过三个核心模块（语义感知特征重融SAFR、自适应支持增强ASE、混合原型匹配HPM）提升跨域分割性能。在四个目标域数据集上的实验表明，该方法无需任何训练即达到了当前最优。
Motivation: 现有CD-FSS方法依赖训练或微调，计算成本高且易过拟合；引入视觉基础模型后性能提升有限甚至下降。
Method: 提出无训练框架，基于DINOv3编码器，包含SAFR模块重融语义特征、ASE模块聚合查询信息缩小跨域语义差距、HPM模块融合多种原型匹配结果以适应不同语义复杂度。
Result: 在四个目标域数据集上，该方法无需训练即达到跨域少样本分割的state-of-the-art性能。
Conclusion: 无训练框架避免了训练开销和过拟合风险，在CD-FSS任务上取得最优结果。

papers.title: Hierarchical Spatial and Channel Aggregation for Cross-domain Few-shot Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain Few-shot Segmentation (CD-FSS) aims to learn generalizable segmentation capability from abundant annotated samples in the source domain, enabling accurate segmentation of novel classes in the target domain with only a few annotated samples. Existing CD-FSS methods mainly focus on mitigating feature distribution shifts caused by style gaps while ignoring significant differences in class semantic granularity and discriminative attributes across domains, leading to two key degradations in support-query matching: semantic over-alignment and attribute over-alignment. To this end, we propose the Dual Hierarchical Aggregation Network (DHANet), which comprises three key modules. First, the Hierarchical Spatial Aggregation (HSA) module performs multi-scale region aggregation of pixel features along the spatial dimension, generating hierarchical semantic-enhanced features to alleviate semantic over-alignment. Additionally, the HCA module conducts multi-scale attribute aggregation along the channel dimension, generating hierarchical attribute-enhanced features to mitigate attribute over-alignment. Finally, we propose the Online Probabilistic Semantic Bank (OPSB), which progressively constructs and updates class probability distributions from query predictions during inference, and samples multiple pseudo-prototypes as additional support information to mitigate insufficient support. Extensive experiments on four target-domain datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨域小样本分割（CD-FSS）中因域间类别语义粒度和判别属性差异导致的语义过对齐和属性过对齐问题，提出双层次聚合网络（DHANet），包含层次空间聚合（HSA）、层次通道聚合（HCA）和在线概率语义库（OPSB）三个模块。在四个目标域数据集上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有CD-FSS方法主要关注风格差异导致的特征分布偏移，忽略了跨域类别语义粒度和判别属性的显著差异，导致支持-查询匹配中出现语义过对齐和属性过对齐，性能受限。
Method: 提出DHANet：HSA模块沿空间维度进行多尺度区域聚合生成层次语义增强特征；HCA模块沿通道维度进行多尺度属性聚合生成层次属性增强特征；OPSB在推理时从查询预测中逐步构建并更新类概率分布，采样多个伪原型作为额外支持信息。
Result: 在四个目标域数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法取得了最先进性能。
Conclusion: DHANet通过层次化空间和通道聚合缓解语义和属性过对齐，OPSB利用在线概率语义库缓解支持不足，有效提升了跨域小样本分割的泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ActiveScope: Actively Seeking and Correcting Perception for MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive vision-language understanding, yet still struggle with fine-grained perception in high-resolution images. While existing training-free methods typically rely on attention-based localization or coarse-to-fine search, they are often misled by distractors and fail to locate multiple targets. Our investigation attributes these failures to Contextual Dominance, where salient distractors overwhelm target attention and cause inaccurate localization, and Semantic Bias, where global semantics cause the model to fixate on the most salient concept, resulting in incomplete localization in multi-object scenarios. Built on these insights, we propose ActiveScope, a training-free framework that enhances MLLMs by actively seeking and correcting perception. ActiveScope features two modules. The Semantic Anchor Localization (SAL) utilizes fine-grained semantic anchors to independently localize key targets, thereby mitigating semantic bias. The Interference-Suppressed Refinement (ISR) refines localization by suppressing attention on salient distractions to overcome contextual dominance. Extensive experiments on high-resolution image understanding benchmarks demonstrate that ActiveScope outperforms existing training-free methods (e.g., 96.34 percent accuracy on $V^{*}$ Bench), validating the superiority of the active search and self-correction paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/jasmine-ww/ActiveScope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在细粒度感知中的失败归因于上下文主导（Contextual Dominance）和语义偏差（Semantic Bias），提出无需训练的 ActiveScope 框架。该框架通过语义锚定定位（SAL）模块独立定位多个目标以缓解语义偏差，并通过干扰抑制细化（ISR）模块压制显著干扰物注意力以克服上下文主导。在多个高分辨率图像理解基准上，ActiveScope 取得优于现有训练无关方法的成绩，例如在 V* Bench 上达到 96.34% 准确率。
Motivation: 现有训练无关方法依赖注意力定位或粗到细搜索，常被干扰物误导且无法定位多个目标。作者将其归因于上下文主导（显著干扰物压倒目标注意力）和语义偏差（全局语义使模型固着于最显著概念，导致多目标情况下定位不完整）。
Method: 提出 ActiveScope，包含两个模块：语义锚定定位（SAL）利用细粒度语义锚独立定位关键目标；干扰抑制细化（ISR）通过压制显著干扰物注意力来细化定位。整个过程无需训练。
Result: 在高分辨率图像理解基准上，ActiveScope 优于现有训练无关方法，例如在 V* Bench 上达到 96.34% 准确率。
Conclusion: 主动搜索和自我纠正范式在多模态大语言模型的细粒度感知中有效，且无需额外训练。代码已开源。

papers.title: AVOC: Enhancing Hour-Level Audio-Video Understanding in Omni-Modal LLMs via Retrieval-Inspired Token Compression
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models have achieved remarkable progress in short-form audio-video understanding, yet long-form audio-video comprehension remains challenged by limited context windows and severe information redundancy. To address these bottlenecks, we propose AVOC, a framework for long-form audio-video understanding in Omni-modal Large Language Models. AVOC introduces a learnable token compression module between the modality encoders and the LLM backbone. We reframe multimodal token compression as a top-$K$ retrieval problem: given a fixed context budget, the module must retrieve a compact subset of tokens that best supports answering the user query. We draw inspiration from three classical Information Retrieval criteria for selecting informative units from a large candidate pool: relevance, importance, and diversity. AVOC instantiates each criterion as a tailored mechanism for audio-video understanding, and integrates them into a unified retrieval-style compression pipeline. Experiments show that AVOC achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-form audio-video benchmarks, surpassing the second-best model by 4.9 and 5.5 points in average accuracy on OmniVideoBench and LVOmniBench, respectively. Moreover, AVOC maintains robust performance on Audio-Video Needle-in-a-Haystack task at durations up to one hour.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AVOC框架，通过将多模态token压缩重构为top-K检索问题，基于相关性、重要性和多样性三个信息检索准则设计可学习压缩模块，显著提升全模态大语言模型在小时级音视频理解上的性能。
Motivation: 现有全模态大语言模型在长时长音视频理解中受限于有限上下文窗口和严重的信息冗余，导致性能瓶颈。
Method: 在模态编码器与大语言模型之间引入可学习token压缩模块，将压缩过程建模为top-K检索问题，借鉴信息检索中相关性、重要性和多样性三个经典准则，设计统一的检索式压缩流水线。
Result: 在OmniVideoBench和LVOmniBench上分别以4.9和5.5的平均准确率超越第二名，并在长达1小时的Audio-Video Needle-in-a-Haystack任务中保持鲁棒性能。
Conclusion: AVOC通过检索式token压缩有效缓解长上下文信息冗余，实现长时长音视频理解的最优性能。

papers.title: UniRED: Unified RGB-D Video Frame Interpolation with Event Guidance
papers.abstract_en: High frame-rate RGB-D videos are crucial for a variety of downstream tasks, including motion analysis, dynamic scene understanding, and 3D reconstruction. However, due to hardware and sensing constraints, practical RGB-D cameras are typically limited to low frame rates, making it difficult to capture rapid scene dynamics. Existing video interpolation methods have achieved strong performance on RGB data, but they are not readily applicable to RGB-D scenarios, where they often yield blurry boundaries, visible artifacts, and degraded geometric consistency. Furthermore, motion estimation from only two boundary frames is inherently under-constrained in complex dynamic scenes. Event cameras, by contrast, provide asynchronous measurements with ultra-high temporal resolution, offering dense motion cues. In this paper, we propose a unified multimodal framework for RGB-D video interpolation that jointly exploits RGB appearance, depth geometry, and event-based temporal cues. Specifically, it first extracts and fuses RGB, depth and event cues, then estimates bidirectional flow with motion basis refinement for RGB and Z-axial refinement for depth, and finally synthesizes the target RGB-D frame via bidirectional warping and soft blending. In addition, we construct a new RGB-D-Event dataset to alleviate the scarcity of tri-modal training data. Extensive experiments on a public benchmark and the proposed dataset demonstrate that our method achieves superior photometric fidelity for RGB interpolation and stronger geometric accuracy for depth interpolation than existing approaches.

papers.title: CALIBER: Calibrating Confidence Before and After Reasoning in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models are increasingly asked not only to answer difficult questions, but also to estimate their likelihood of success. Existing methods typically elicit confidence only once: either before thinking or after answering. We argue that confidence in reasoning models is state-dependent: before thinking, confidence should estimate the chance of the model correctly solving the prompt, while after thinking it should predict whether the realized answer is likely to be correct. This distinction determines the appropriate supervision target: prompt-level success should supervise confidence estimates made after seeing the prompt, while individual answer-level correctness should supervise confidence estimates made after answering. We introduce CALIBER (Calibration Before and After Reasoning), which elicits both estimates and supervises each with the target matched to its information state. Under this unified protocol, CALIBER reduces Expected Calibration Error (ECE) by 52.5% over the strongest single-confidence baseline on BigMathDigits for the 7B model, while achieving the best Brier score and AUROC, and remains within 2.1 points of the best accuracy. Further, on a larger 30B model, CALIBER achieves the best ECE on BigMathDigits while remaining competitive in Brier score and AUROC. Out of distribution, it achieves the best ECE and Brier score on GPQA and TriviaQA, and remains competitive on SimpleQA. Ablations further show that this position-target alignment is most beneficial under distribution shift where it consistently reduces calibration error across all out-of-distribution benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CALIBER方法，针对推理语言模型的置信度校准问题，区分思考前（prompt-level）和思考后（answer-level）两种状态，并分别用不同的监督目标进行校准。在BigMathDigits等数学推理数据集上，CALIBER将期望校准误差（ECE）降低52.5%，同时保持最佳Brier分数和AUROC，并在分布外数据上表现稳健。
Motivation: 现有方法仅在一次询问中获取置信度，忽视了思考前后置信度的状态依赖特性，导致校准效果不佳。
Method: CALIBER框架在思考前后分别收集置信度估计，并用与信息状态匹配的监督目标：思考前用prompt-level成功与否，思考后用答案正确性。
Result: 在7B模型上，CALIBER相比最强单基线降低ECE 52.5%，取得最佳Brier分数和AUROC，准确率仅差2.1点；在30B模型和分布外基准（GPQA、TriviaQA）上也达到最优或竞争性结果。
Conclusion: 位置-目标对齐在校准中至关重要，尤其在分布偏移下能持续降低校准误差。

papers.title: Tractable Reasoning and Conjunctive Query Answering for Defeasible DL-Lite under Rational Closure
papers.abstract_en: In Description Logics (DLs), reasoning under Rational Closure (RC) is a well-known and widely accepted non-monotonic formalism to handle defeasible knowledge. In this paper, we study the application of RC to the core and horn variants of the DL-Lite family of lightweight description logics. We analyze both entitlement (instance checking) and Conjunctive Query (CQ) answering under RC. Our main contribution is providing a plug-in architecture that builds upon existing standard classical reasoners, establishing that reasoning and CQ answering under RC for DL-Lite can be done efficiently with minimal computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在描述逻辑 DL-Lite 的核和 horn 变体下，基于 Rational Closure 的可废止推理，提供了插件式架构，能够基于现有经典推理器高效实现实例检测和合取查询回答。
Motivation: Rational Closure 是处理可废止知识的成熟非单调形式化方法，但在轻量级 DL-Lite 家族中尚未充分研究其效率与实现。
Method: 将 Rational Closure 应用于 DL-Lite 的核心和 horn 变体，提出一种插件式架构，利用现有标准经典推理器实现可废止推理和合取查询回答。
Result: 摘要声称该方法在计算开销最小的前提下，能够高效地在 DL-Lite 下实现基于 Rational Closure 的推理和合取查询回答。
Conclusion: 本文表明，对于 DL-Lite，通过插件式架构可以基于现有经典推理器有效实现 Rational Closure 推理，且计算开销低。

papers.title: Deep numerical schemes for systems of Ergodic BSDEs with applications to regime-switching forward utilities
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce two neural-network-based numerical schemes for solving systems of coupled ergodic Backward Stochastic Differential Equations (eBSDEs), motivated by the approximation of optimal strategies within the framework of forward utilities in a regime-switching stochastic factor model. Our approach builds on the representation of such models through systems of eBSDEs introduced in [HLT20]. We first establish a link between the solution of the system of ergodic BSDEs and that of an associated multidimensional BSDE with random terminal time, given by the hitting time of the positive recurrent stochastic factor. Building on this representation, we introduce a locally additive deep learning scheme obtained by minimizing aggregated local error terms. We then present a new Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) inspired algorithm that minimizes the residual of the associated ergodic PDE system, relying on a representation of the ergodic cost. Finally, we apply this framework to regime-switching forward utilities in a stochastic factor model. We first derive a general consistency SPDE that characterizes regime-switching forward utilities and retrieve their representation with systems of ergodic BSDEs in the homothetic case. Numerical experiments demonstrate the performance of the proposed methods, with a particular focus on the impact on forward preferences of taking into account regime switches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机制转换随机因子模型中的前瞻效用最优策略近似问题，提出两种基于神经网络的数值格式来求解耦合遍历BSDE系统。第一种方法通过局部加性深度学习最小化聚合局部误差项；第二种方法基于Deep Galerkin Method (DGM) 最小化遍历PDE残差。数值实验验证了方法在机制转换前瞻效用中的有效性。
Motivation: 在机制转换随机因子模型的前瞻效用框架下，最优策略的近似需要求解系统性的遍历BSDE，而现有数值方法处理高维耦合系统存在困难。
Method: 首先建立遍历BSDE解与以正递归随机因子击中时间为终止时间的多维BSDE解之间的关联；基于此表示提出局部加性深度学习格式（最小化局部误差项），以及基于DGM的新算法（利用遍历成本表示最小化PDE残差）。
Result: 数值实验表明所提方法能够有效逼近机制转换前瞻效用下的最优策略，并展示了考虑机制转换对前瞻偏好的影响。
Conclusion: 文章强调所提出的神经网络数值格式能有效处理系统性的遍历BSDE，并应用于机制转换前瞻效用，但局限在于未在极端高维场景下测试。

papers.title: Pigeonholing: Bad prompts hurt models to collapse and make mistakes
papers.abstract_en: While in-context learning is generally shown to be effective in Large Language Models (LLMs), bad contexts can cause performance degradation and mode collapse, a phenomenon we call "pigeonholing." **Unintentionally bad** contexts can happen without malicious jailbreaking intents: For example, a user asks the model to justify an incorrect math theorem or fails to correct the model's buggy code. Specifically, we investigate ``pigeonholing" in two scenarios: (1) when the user suggests a solution, and (2) when the conversation context includes the assistant's previous (incorrect) responses. Our experiments across 10 verifiable and open-ended tasks with 10 different models show that pigeonholing manifests in several ways: (1) repeating the incorrect answers from context (leading to 38-40% performance drop), (2) converging on a narrow set of answers in coding and text generation without exploring alternatives, and (3) flipping stance on controversial topics to align with the user or the assistant's previous claims. We find that pigeonholing worsens almost monotonically with the number of conversation turns (performance drops by additional 14+% as repeated mistakes increase from 1 to 5), and pigeonholing-induced mode collapse can happen even when the provided example is correct. As a step toward mitigation, we propose RLVR with synthetic errors which improves models by 43-60% under bad contexts compared to vanilla RLVR baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义并系统研究了LLM中的“pigeonholing”现象——不良上下文（如用户给出错误建议或对话历史包含错误回答）导致模型性能下降、模式崩溃。实验表明，重复错误回答导致38-40%的性能下降，且随对话轮次增加而恶化。作者提出RLVR with synthetic errors作为缓解方法，在不良上下文下相比基线提升43-60%。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注恶意越狱提示，但日常对话中无意的不良上下文也会严重损害模型性能，这一现象之前未被系统研究。
Method: 通过10个可验证和开放式任务、10个模型进行实验，定义pigeonholing的表现形式；提出RLVR (Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards) with synthetic errors作为缓解方法。
Result: 不良上下文导致38-40%性能下降；错误从1次增加到5次时性能额外下降14%以上；即使提供的示例正确，也可能发生模式崩溃；RLVR with synthetic errors在不良上下文下提升43-60%。
Conclusion: 研究发现pigeonholing是LLM在实际部署中的严重问题，RLVR with synthetic errors提供了一种有效的缓解途径，但未来还需进一步研究。

papers.title: Neural Network-Based Parametric Model Reduction for Predicting Turbulent Flow for Different Vehicle Geometries
papers.abstract_en: Numerical simulations in industrial applications often require performing numerous high-precision computations parameterized by specific experimental conditions. For instance, in vehicle body design, aerodynamic simulations are essential for evaluating the aerodynamic characteristics of various proposed body geometries. However, computational resource constraints often become a bottleneck. Therefore, achieving the desired accuracy while minimizing computational cost is crucial. To address this challenge, model reduction methods have been developed to decrease the degrees of freedom by constraining the possible states of a physical system to a lower-dimensional subspace. In particular, reduction techniques that project the system onto a nonlinear subspace using neural networks have been actively studied. Our previous research developed a reduced-order model that integrates neural-network-based model reduction with a time-evolution method, implemented as a distributed parallel training framework to process high-resolution flow field data efficiently. In this study, we extend this reduction approach by incorporating a variational autoencoder to assess its robustness in high-Reynolds-number flows around multiple vehicle bodies with varying geometries. Specifically, we evaluate the reconstruction accuracy of vortex generation across different spatial and temporal scales using a compact latent representation, with a particular focus on the flow behavior near the rear end of the vehicle body.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了基于神经网络的降阶模型，通过引入变分自编码器（VAE）来处理不同几何形状车辆周围的高雷诺数湍流。摘要评估了该方法在重构不同时空尺度的涡流生成时的精度，特别关注车体尾部附近的流动行为。
Motivation: 车辆空气动力学模拟需要大量高精度计算，但计算资源有限。现有降阶方法（如神经网络投影到非线性子空间）有潜力降低计算成本，但需要验证其在多几何形状高雷诺数流动中的鲁棒性。
Method: 将基于神经网络的降阶模型与时间演化方法结合，并集成变分自编码器以增强鲁棒性。采用分布式并行训练框架处理高分辨率流场数据，实现从高维数据到紧凑潜在表示的降维。
Result: 摘要声称该方法在不同空间和时间尺度上对涡流生成具有较高的重构精度，尤其能捕捉车体尾部附近的流动特征。但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 研究表明，基于变分自编码器的神经网络降阶模型在多种车辆几何形状的高雷诺数湍流模拟中具有鲁棒性，为高效空气动力学仿真提供了可行方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MotifGen: Spatiotemporal interpolation of misaligned satellite images via multi-source generative modeling, in an application to tropical cyclones
papers.abstract_en: Microwave satellite imagery plays a crucial role in monitoring tropical cyclone precipitation and intensity worldwide, but suffers from long revisit times, potentially missing rapid storm evolution phases. While this raises the need for an interpolation method, it is made challenging by the high level of heterogeneity of microwave data coming from different instruments. In this work, we introduce the first generative model that can be applied to multiple geospatial sources that change across samples, occur at irregular time intervals, are misaligned geographically, and come from instruments with varying characteristics. We apply this model to the case of spatio-temporal interpolation of tropical cyclone microwave images from other microwave and infrared instruments. We train using a self-supervised task in which a random source is masked and reconstructed, and show that it leads to a significant decrease in Continuous Ranked Probability Score over supervised training. We show a further improvement by combining infrared and microwave data compared to microwave only. Using these improvements, the generative model produces an ensemble mean on par with that of a deterministic model, while generating a power spectrum significantly closer to that of true observations. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first generative model that interpolates microwave images of cyclones by combining multiple microwave instruments and infrared observations at irregular time intervals.

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个可以处理多源地理空间数据（不同源、不规则时间间隔、地理未对齐、仪器特性各异）的生成模型MotifGen，用于热带气旋微波图像的时空插值。通过自监督训练（随机掩码并重建）相比监督训练显著降低了连续等级概率分数（CRPS），且结合红外与微波数据比仅用微波数据效果更优。模型生成的集合均值与确定性模型相当，而功率谱更接近真实观测。
Motivation: 微波卫星图像对热带气旋降水和强度监测至关重要，但长重访周期可能错过快速风暴演变，需要插值方法。不同仪器微波数据高度异质、时间不规则、地理未对齐，现有插值方法难以处理。
Method: 提出MotifGen生成模型，通过自监督训练任务（随机掩码一个源并重建）学习多源时空插值，同时处理微波和红外数据，支持不同仪器特性。
Result: 自监督训练显著优于监督训练（CRPS降低）；融合红外与微波数据进一步改善。生成集合均值与确定性模型相当，且功率谱更接近真实观测。
Conclusion: 该模型是首个在不规则时间间隔下结合多种微波和红外观测插值热带气旋微波图像的生成模型，证明了多源融合和自监督策略的有效性。

papers.title: SURGELLM: Rethinking Multi-Task Evaluation through Task-Aware Feature Gating with Class-Balanced Normalization
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuned encoders deployed across heterogeneous NLP tasks face three compounding problems: mismatched inductive biases, class-imbalance corruption of feature statistics, and no mechanism to condition attention on external lexical knowledge. We introduce \textbf{\surgellm}, a unified transformer framework that addresses each with a dedicated lightweight module: a \emph{surgical feature gate} (learned per-dimension sigmoid over curated lexical indicators and \texttt{[CLS]}; provably degenerates to identity when features are uninformative), \emph{task-conditioned prefix tokens} (quantized feature values and task identity prepended to every input), and \emph{Instance-Weighted Normalization} (IWN; removes class-prior bias from gate statistics). We prove an excess-risk bound linking gate benefit to \emph{surgical feature alignment}. Across four tasks, SST-2, multi-hop retrieval, LLM-prompt attribution, and authorship detection, covering 17,830 examples and eleven model variants over three seeds, the IWN variant achieves macro-F1 \textbf{0.940} ($+0.036$ over the strongest non-IWN baseline; $+0.130$ on authorship detection). A random-vocabulary control ($-0.028$ avg.\ F1) confirms gains are lexical, not parametric. Code, vocabularies, and a $99.5\%$-recovery auto-extraction recipe are released.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 6th Workshop on Trustworthy NLP (TrustNLP 2026), ACL 2026, San Diego, California, USA. Available at https://openreview.net/forum?id=WJCalficPT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SURGELLM，一个统一的Transformer框架，通过手术特征门（surgical feature gate）、任务条件前缀token（task-conditioned prefix tokens）和实例加权归一化（IWN）来解决微调编码器在异构NLP任务中的三个问题。实验在四个任务上取得改进，IWN变体macro-F1达到0.940。
Motivation: 异构NLP任务中微调编码器面临三个问题：不匹配的归纳偏置、类别不平衡破坏特征统计、以及缺乏对外部词汇知识的条件注意力机制。
Method: 引入三个轻量模块：手术特征门（对词汇指示器和[CLS]的逐维sigmoid，特征无信息时退化为恒等映射）、任务条件前缀token（量化的特征值和任务标识拼接到每个输入前）、实例加权归一化IWN（去除门控统计中的类别先验偏差）。证明了与手术特征对齐相关的额外风险界。
Result: 在SST-2、多跳检索、LLM-prompt归因、作者检测四个任务上（共17830个样本，11种模型变体，3个种子），IWN变体达到macro-F1 0.940，比最强的非IWN基线高0.036，在作者检测上提升0.130。随机词汇对照实验确认增益来自词汇而非参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过特征门控和归一化解决了多任务评估中的问题，并开源了代码和词汇表。

papers.title: 3DCarGen: Scalable 3D Car Generation via 3D-consistent Multi-view Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: High-quality 3D vehicle assets are essential for autonomous driving simulation. Although multi-view diffusion-based paradigms enable controllable single-image reconstruction, they typically produce limited viewpoints and exhibit cross-view geometric inconsistencies, thereby reducing reconstruction fidelity in real-world scenarios. In this work, we introduce 3DCarGen, a scalable single-view 3D car generation framework designed for real-world images by synthesizing an arbitrary number of 3D-consistent multi-view images. Specifically, given a single image as input, we first synthesize a set of images from fixed viewpoints. These images are then fed into a feed-forward reconstruction model, resulting in a coarse 3D representation based on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Conditioned on this explicit 3D prior, our multi-view diffusion model generates 3D-consistent images from arbitrary camera viewpoints. We further extend a fast mesh reconstruction algorithm by incorporating color-normal joint optimization to recover detailed and coherent 3D vehicle models from the synthesized dense views. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves robust geometric consistency and reconstruction fidelity compared to existing methods. Code and models will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出3DCarGen，一个可扩展的单视图3D汽车生成框架，通过合成任意数量且3D一致的多视图图像，结合3D高斯泼溅前馈重建和多视图扩散模型，再经颜色-法线联合优化的快速网格重建，实现真实世界图像中鲁棒的几何一致性和重建保真度。
Motivation: 现有基于多视图扩散的范式生成视点有限且存在跨视图几何不一致，降低了真实场景中单视图重建的保真度。
Method: 首先从单张输入图像合成固定视点图像集，送入前馈重建模型得到基于3D高斯泼溅的粗3D表示；以此作为显式3D先验，多视图扩散模型生成任意相机视角下的3D一致图像；最后扩展快速网格重建算法，引入颜色-法线联合优化以恢复细节且连贯的3D车辆模型。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比现有方法实现了鲁棒的几何一致性和重建保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确提及局限性，但指出代码和模型将开源以促进进一步验证。

papers.title: Trimming the Long-Tail of Visual World Modeling Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Physical interactions follow a long-tailed distribution: a set of common and regular interactions dominates human experience and visual data, while a broad spectrum of rare and irregular interactions remains underrepresented. Although recent visual world models, including image and video generation models, achieve impressive realism on existing benchmarks, they primarily focus on simulating common physical interactions. This raises a central question: Do current visual world models internalize and generalize physical principles? In this work, we introduce Tailor-Bench, a benchmark that challenges world models to simulate irregular physical interactions. To enable systematic evaluation, we design three scenario modes that progressively challenge model reasoning: Regular scenarios reflect common tool-task pairs, Unconventional scenarios replace conventional tools with attribute-compatible substitutes to test affordance generalization, and Impossible scenarios introduce attribute-violating tools to probe constraint awareness. Additionally, we design two complementary settings under a unified evaluation protocol: predictive generation requires inferring outcomes without guidance, while descriptive generation specifies the target outcome for faithful realization. Our experimental results reveal a clear long-tail gap in physical world modeling: performance degrades from Regular to Unconventional and Impossible scenarios, indicating limited generalization beyond common interactions. Failure analysis further shows that models rely on superficial visual patterns: image models fail to realize correct state changes, while video models further suffer from temporal inconsistencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Tailor-Bench基准，用于评估视觉世界模型在不规则物理交互上的表现。该基准包含三种场景模式（常规、非常规、不可能）和两种生成设置（预测生成、描述生成），以系统测试模型对物理原理的泛化能力。实验显示性能从常规到非常规再到不可能场景显著下降，表明模型主要依赖表面视觉模式而非真正的物理理解。
Motivation: 现有视觉世界模型在常见物理交互上表现优异，但缺乏对长尾中不规则交互的评估，质疑模型是否真正内化物理原理而非记忆模式。
Method: 设计Tailor-Bench，包含三种场景：Regular（常规工具-任务对）、Unconventional（属性兼容的替代工具测试泛化）、Impossible（属性违反的工具测试约束意识），以及预测生成（无指导推断结果）和描述生成（指定目标结果）两种设置。
Result: 性能从Regular到Unconventional再到Impossible场景逐渐下降，揭示长尾差距；失败分析表明图像模型无法实现正确状态变化，视频模型还存在时间不一致。
Conclusion: 当前视觉世界模型在不规则物理交互上泛化能力有限，依赖浅层视觉模式，需进一步改进对物理原理的推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Social Structure Matters in 3D Human-Human Interaction Generation
papers.abstract_en: Although text-to-motion generation has achieved strong progress in synthesizing realistic single-person motions from language, extending it to text-driven 3D human-human interaction (HHI) remains non-trivial, as HHI requires modeling the underlying \textbf{social structure} that governs phase progression, actor roles, and inter-actor coordination. In this paper, we formulate HHI generation as a social structure modeling and grounding problem: the model must first infer how an interaction unfolds and how the two actors coordinate their roles, and then realize this structure as continuous, physically plausible, and partner-aware 3D motion. To study how such structure should be modeled, we first examine the capability boundary of large language models (LLMs) for HHI generation. Our analysis shows that LLMs can \textit{think} by recovering phase decompositions and partner-aware roles, but cannot directly \textit{move}, as they fail to generate dynamic, physically plausible, and interaction-aware motion. This motivates our planner-executor paradigm, \textbf{Think with LLM, Move with Motion Skill}. The LLM planner converts implicit interaction semantics into motion-aligned social supervision by decomposing interactions into phases, assigning partner-aware actor roles, and aligning them with motion sequence. The motion executor then grounds the planned social structure into coordinated two-person motion by adapting a pretrained solo motion model with LoRA, previous-phase self-conditioning, and ego-relative partner conditioning. Together, our Solo-to-Social framework bridges social organization and motion realization, producing 3D HHI with improved phase consistency, role alignment, and partner-aware coordination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将3D人-人交互生成视为社会结构建模与落地问题，采用“LLM规划者+运动执行者”框架。LLM规划者将交互语义分解为阶段和角色，运动执行者通过LoRA微调预训练单人生成模型，并加入前阶段自条件和自我-相对伙伴条件，生成协调的双人运动。
Motivation: 文本到单人运动生成已有进展，但扩展到双人交互需建模潜藏的社会结构（阶段演进、角色分配、协调），现有LLM能推理但不能生成动态、物理合理的运动。
Method: 提出Solo-to-Social框架：LLM规划者将交互分解为阶段，分配伙伴感知角色，并对应到运动序列；运动执行者基于预训练单人运动模型，通过LoRA、前阶段自条件和伙伴相对条件生成双人运动。
Result: 摘要报告该方法生成的双人交互具有更好的阶段一致性、角色对齐和伙伴感知协调。
Conclusion: 本文强调社会结构建模是实现文本驱动3D人-人交互生成的关键，所提规划-执行范式可桥接社会推理与运动实现。

papers.title: TuringViT: Making SOTA Vision Transformers Accessible to All
papers.abstract_en: Modern VLMs and VLA systems commonly adopt off-the-shelf ViTs such as SigLIP2 as visual encoders, but diverse downstream requirements in latency, temporal modeling, and VLM integration often call for customized SOTA-level ViTs. Training such encoders remains beyond the reach of much of the community, as it requires massive image-text data, while standard softmax attention makes high-resolution or dynamic-resolution pretraining prohibitively costly and often forces low-resolution pretraining followed by post-hoc adaptation. TuringViT addresses these challenges with three key designs: Turing Linear Attention (TLA) for efficient sequence modeling, VISTA-Curation to construct supervision-rich image-video training data, and native dynamic-resolution pretraining that supports flexible inputs from the start and transfers seamlessly to downstream VLMs. As a result, TuringViT outperforms leading open-source ViT baselines with only 10% of the data, achieves stronger downstream VLM performance, and delivers substantially better latency scaling on high-resolution inputs. Our scaling-law analysis further shows that TuringViT continues to improve predictably with curated data scale, far from saturation. Its fast adaptation, hardware-friendly design, and efficient deployment have made it a unified visual foundation across XPeng's AI systems. More broadly, TuringViT provides a reproducible pipeline that dramatically lowers the cost for the community to train, customize, and deploy SOTA-level ViTs, moving toward making such Vision Transformers accessible to all.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TuringViT，一种面向视觉-语言模型（VLM）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统的视觉编码器，通过三个关键设计降低训练和部署 SOTA 级 ViT 的成本。TuringViT 采用 Turing 线性注意力（TLA）实现高效序列建模，利用 VISTA-Curation 构造监督丰富的图像-视频训练数据，并支持原生动态分辨率预训练。实验表明，仅用 10% 的数据即超越开源 ViT 基线，在下游 VLM 上表现更强，且在高分辨率输入下延迟更优。
Motivation: 当前 VLMs/VLA 系统常使用现成 ViT（如 SigLIP2）作为视觉编码器，但下游任务对延迟、时序建模和 VLM 集成有不同需求，需要定制化的 SOTA 级 ViT。然而训练此类编码器需要大量图像-文本数据，且标准 softmax 注意力导致高分辨率或动态分辨率预训练成本过高，通常只能采用低分辨率预训练后再进行后处理适配。
Method: 提出三个关键设计：Turing 线性注意力（TLA）高效建模长序列；VISTA-Curation 构建包含丰富监督信号的图像-视频训练数据；原生动态分辨率预训练，从初始阶段就支持灵活输入并可直接迁移至下游 VLM。
Result: TuringViT 以仅 10% 的数据量超越主流开源 ViT 基线，在下游 VLM 任务上取得更强性能，并在高分辨率输入下实现显著的延迟优势。缩放定律分析表明，随着数据规模增加，TuringViT 的性能仍可持续可预测地提升，远未饱和。

papers.title: Probing the Misaligned Thinking Process of Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models exhibit a growing range of misaligned behaviors such as strategic deception, sandbagging, and self-preservation. As they are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, it is critical to reliably detect such behaviors to ensure safe and responsible use. In this work, we propose to monitor misalignment by decomposing it into fine-grained cognitive processes -- misalignment indicators -- and detecting their presence in a model's internal activations via linear probes. We develop a taxonomy of 18 indicators spanning different misaligned behaviors, paired with an automated, meta-plan-guided pipeline that generates multi-turn training conversations. To rigorously evaluate generalization, we construct an out-of-distribution suite combining automated behavioral elicitation, established misalignment benchmarks, and natural benign conversations. Across 5 misaligned behaviors, our probes match a strong LLM judge with 0.935 AUROC on out-of-distribution benchmarks while keeping a low false positive rate on benign traffic. We further perform in-depth analysis to understand the probes and the model's internal representations of misalignment indicators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过将语言模型的对齐问题分解为细粒度认知过程（即misalignment indicators），并使用线性探针从模型内部激活中检测这些指标。作者开发了涵盖18个指标的分类法，并构建了自动化流水线生成多轮训练对话。在分布外测试集上，探针在5种misaligned behaviors上达到了0.935 AUROC，同时保持低误报率。
Motivation: 随着语言模型在高风险场景中的部署，可靠地检测其战略性欺骗、sandbagging、自我保护等misaligned行为变得至关重要。现有方法难以泛化到未见过的行为或对话。
Method: 提出将misalignment分解为18个细粒度指标，通过线性探针从模型内部激活中检测。使用元计划引导的自动化流水线生成多轮训练对话，并构建分布外测试集包含自动化行为诱发、现有对齐基准和自然对话。
Result: 在分布外基准上，探针匹配强LLM评判器，AUROC达到0.935，且对良性对话的误报率低。
Conclusion: 线性探针能够有效检测语言模型的misaligned行为，并且泛化性良好。进一步分析揭示了探针和模型内部对misalignment indicators的表征。

papers.title: M^2C-EvDet: Multi-Domain Multi-Order Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Event-based Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Event-based object Detection (EvDet), as a biologically inspired visual perception paradigm, demonstrates superior performance in scenarios demanding high temporal resolution and a wide dynamic range. Nevertheless, the inherent sparse representations and inadequate visual semantics of event data result in a considerable performance disparity between EvDet and frame-based object detection. Previous works attempt to alleviate this cross-modal discrepancy through knowledge distillation, yet they only focus on spatial visual semantics or pair-wise relational information, thus limiting performance in more complex scenarios. To address this challenge, this paper proposes M^2C-EvDet, a Multi-domain and Multi-order Cross-modal knowledge distillation framework for EvDet. Built upon frequency learning and hypergraph computation, M^2C-EvDet integrates two specialized modules: Adaptive Frequency-Decoupled Feature Distillation (AF^2D^2) and Multi-Order Relational Distillation (MORD).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出M²C-EvDet，一个多域多阶跨模态知识蒸馏框架，用于基于事件的目标检测。通过频率学习和超图计算，集成自适应频率解耦特征蒸馏（AF²D²）和多阶关系蒸馏（MORD）两个模块，旨在缩小事件数据与帧基目标检测之间的性能差距。
Motivation: 事件数据固有的稀疏表示和不充分的视觉语义导致事件目标检测与帧基检测之间存在显著性能差距，现有知识蒸馏方法仅关注空间视觉语义或成对关系信息，限制了在复杂场景下的性能。
Method: 提出M²C-EvDet框架，基于频率学习和超图计算，包含两个模块：自适应频率解耦特征蒸馏（AF²D²）和多阶关系蒸馏（MORD），实现多域多阶跨模态知识蒸馏。
Result: 摘要未明确报告量化结果，但声称该方法在复杂场景下优于现有仅关注空间或成对关系信息的蒸馏方法。
Conclusion: M²C-EvDet通过多域多阶跨模态知识蒸馏，有效缓解事件目标检测与帧基检测之间的性能差距。

papers.title: AutoSpec: Safety Rule Evolution for LLM Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate complex tasks by integrating language models with external tools and environments. However, their autonomy poses significant safety risks: agents may execute destructive commands, leak sensitive data, or violate domain constraints. Existing safety approaches face a fundamental tradeoff: hand-crafted rules are interpretable but brittle, with overly conservative rules blocking safe operations (high false positives) while permissive rules miss unsafe behaviors (high false negatives). Neural classifiers lack the interpretability required for safety-critical deployments. We present AutoSpec, a framework that automatically evolves deployed expert-designed safety rules from user safe/unsafe annotations through counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS) guided by inductive logic programming (ILP). Starting from the expert rules and a stream of annotated traces, AutoSpec iteratively evaluates rules, mines false-positive and false-negative counterexamples, uses ILP to learn which predicates discriminate them, generates candidate rule edits, and verifies candidates to select the best revision. The key insight is that ILP efficiently identifies predicates that appear frequently in false negatives but rarely in false positives (or vice versa), dramatically pruning the exponential search space of rule edits. This continues until convergence, producing interpretable rules that balance precision and recall. We evaluate AutoSpec on 291 execution traces spanning code execution and embodied agent domains. AutoSpec raises rule F1 to 0.98 and 0.93 across the two domains, achieving up to 94% false positive reduction while maintaining high recall, and converges within 4-5 iterations. The ILP-guided approach achieves up to 4.8x higher F1 than heuristic CEGIS. The learned rules are human-readable, auditable, and generalize to unseen scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoSpec框架，通过归纳逻辑编程（ILP）结合反例引导归纳综合（CEGIS）自动进化LLM代理的安全规则。从专家设计的规则和带注释的执行轨迹出发，AutoSpec迭代评估规则、挖掘假阳性和假阴性反例，学习区分性谓词并生成候选规则编辑，最终产生可解释且平衡精确率与召回率的规则。在代码执行和具身代理领域的291条轨迹上，规则F1提升至0.98和0.93，假阳性减少94%，并在4-5次迭代内收敛。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理的安全方法面临根本性权衡：手工规则可解释但脆弱，过于保守导致高假阳性，过于宽松导致高假阴性；神经分类器缺乏安全关键部署所需的可解释性。
Method: 提出AutoSpec框架，使用反例引导归纳综合（CEGIS）和归纳逻辑编程（ILP）自动进化专家设计的安全规则。从专家规则和带注释的轨迹流开始，迭代评估规则、挖掘假阳性与假阴性反例，利用ILP识别区分性谓词以大幅剪枝搜索空间，生成并验证候选规则编辑直至收敛。
Result: 在代码执行和具身代理领域的291条轨迹上，规则F1分别达到0.98和0.93，假阳性降低94%，召回率保持高水平，收敛于4-5次迭代。ILP引导方法相比启发式CEGIS实现高达4.8倍F1提升。学习到的规则可读、可审计，并泛化到未见场景。
Conclusion: AutoSpec通过ILP引导的规则进化实现了可解释、高精度且低假阳性的安全规则，适用于LLM代理的安全关键部署。

papers.title: When Surveys Become Conversations: Adaptive Matrix Validation for AI-Assisted Interviews
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted interviews promise to reduce respondent burden in surveys by allowing respondents to describe experiences naturally while an AI system noisily maps those accounts into structured survey variables. That mapping is a measurement process that is fallible, versioned, adaptive, and potentially behaves differently across subgroups. This paper proposes Adaptive Matrix Validation (AMV), a design in which each respondent completes an AI-assisted interview, which is then mapped into tabular data by the AI. Respondents are also asked a small, randomized set of structured questions, which are used for statistical adjustment. The estimator first calibrates the mapped values using validation answers from other respondents, then corrects the remaining error with the validation answers observed for the target respondent. The paper develops estimators for item means, subgroup estimates, and regression coefficients when outcomes, predictors, or both are mapped from interviews. It also gives planning formulas the number of validation questions required and the sample size. A design-calibration simulation, an American Time Use Survey emulation, and a CHAMPS verbal-autopsy narrative study show when sparse validation can improve precision and when it cannot
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应矩阵验证（AMV）方法，用于AI辅助访谈中从自然语言描述到结构化调查变量的映射校准。受访者先完成AI访谈，再回答少量随机结构化问题，利用这些验证答案校准AI映射的误差。开发了针对项目均值、子组估计和回归系数的估计量，并给出所需验证问题数和样本量的规划公式。通过设计校准模拟、美国时间使用调查模拟和CHAMPS口头尸检叙事研究，展示了稀疏验证何时能提高精度、何时不能。
Motivation: AI辅助访谈中，从自然语言到结构化调查变量的映射存在误差，且该映射是可变的、自适应的，在不同子组中可能表现不同，亟需一种统计校准方法来减少测量误差。
Method: 提出自适应矩阵验证（AMV）设计：每个受访者完成AI访谈后，被询问一小部分随机选定的结构化问题；利用其他受访者的验证答案先校准映射值，再用目标受访者自身的验证答案进一步修正剩余误差。开发了相应的估计量和规划公式。
Result: 通过模拟和两项实证研究（美国时间使用调查模拟、CHAMPS口头尸检叙事研究）表明，稀疏验证可在某些情形下提高精度，但也存在无法改善的情况。
Conclusion: AMV提供了一种在AI辅助调查中利用稀疏验证进行统计校准的框架，但其有效性依赖于验证问题的选择和样本结构，在某些场景下精度提升有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Federated Long-Tailed Graph Learning: An Energy-Guided Dual Decoupling Approach
papers.abstract_en: Federated Graph Learning facilitates collaborative graph modeling across distributed clients while preserving data privacy. However, real-world data categories frequently exhibit long-tailed distributions. Such statistical scarcity severely degrades performance in two ways: it biases the global model toward majority classes, and it structurally isolates minority nodes by submerging them in heterophilic, head-dominated neighborhoods. While existing methods attempt topology-agnostic statistical compensations, they often fail under data scarcity. Instead of recovering tail nodes, they overfit the structural noise from adjacent dominant classes, leading to representation degradation. To address these limitations, we propose FedEPD, a framework built on a dual decoupling paradigm that separates topological purification from semantic recalibration. Specifically, FedEPD utilizes distribution-aware Dirichlet energy pruning to filter spatial heterophilic edges. It then overcomes Non-IID distribution shifts by extracting robust global prototypes from topologically central nodes, which are incorporated into local representations via a spatial low-pass prototype injection. Furthermore, a two stage alternating optimization strategy strictly protects majority decision boundaries while improving minority accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedEPD achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse long-tailed benchmarks, yielding absolute improvements of up to 4.97% in Accuracy and 5.48% in Macro-F1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦图学习面临真实世界中的长尾分布问题：全局模型偏向多数类，少数节点因被异质性的头类邻居淹没而结构孤立。现有方法试图进行拓扑不可知的统计补偿，但在数据稀缺时容易过拟合相邻主导类的结构噪声。本文提出FedEPD框架，采用双解耦范式分离拓扑净化与语义重校准：利用分布感知的Dirichlet能量剪枝过滤空间异质边，从拓扑中心节点提取鲁棒全局原型并通过空间低通原型注入融入局部表示，再通过两阶段交替优化保护多数类决策边界的同时提升少数类准确率。实验表明FedEPD在多个长尾基准上达到最优，准确率绝对提升达4.97%，宏F1提升达5.48%。
Motivation: 现有联邦图学习方法在数据长尾分布下，全局模型被多数类主导，少数节点被淹没在异质性的头类邻居中，且拓扑不可知的统计补偿方法在数据稀缺时易过拟合噪声。
Method: 提出双解耦范式FedEPD：1) 分布感知的Dirichlet能量剪枝过滤空间异质边；2) 从拓扑中心节点提取鲁棒全局原型，通过空间低通原型注入融入局部表示；3) 两阶段交替优化保护多数类决策边界并提升少数类准确率。
Result: 在多个长尾图学习基准上，FedEPD取得最优性能，准确率绝对提升达4.97%，宏F1绝对提升达5.48%。
Conclusion: 通过拓扑净化与语义重校准的双解耦设计，FedEPD有效缓解了联邦长尾图学习中的表示退化问题，实现了多数类与少数类性能的平衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automated Residual Plot Assessment With the R Package autovi and the Shiny Application autovi.web
papers.abstract_en: Visual assessment of residual plots is a common approach for diagnosing linear models, but it relies on manual evaluation, which does not scale well and can lead to inconsistent decisions across analysts. The lineup protocol, which embeds the observed plot among null plots, can reduce subjectivity but requires even more human effort. In today's data-driven world, such tasks are well suited for automation. We present a new R package that uses a computer vision model to automate the evaluation of residual plots. An accompanying Shiny application is provided for ease of use. Given a sample of residuals, the model predicts a visual signal strength (VSS) and offers supporting information to help analysts assess model fit.
papers.comment: Published in Australian & New Zealand Journal of Statistics
papers.journal_ref: Australian & New Zealand Journal of Statistics, 68(1), e70027 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个新的R包autovi及其配套Shiny应用autovi.web，利用计算机视觉模型自动化评估线性模型残差图。该工具基于lineup协议减少主观性，预测视觉信号强度（VSS）并提供辅助信息，帮助分析师判断模型拟合质量。
Motivation: 残差图的人工视觉评估无法规模化且不同分析师判断不一致，而lineup协议虽能降低主观性但需要大量人力。自动化评估能提高效率和一致性。
Method: 开发了一个R包，集成计算机视觉模型来自动评估残差图。通过将观测图嵌入空图集合的lineup协议，模型预测视觉信号强度（VSS）并输出支持信息。同时提供Shiny应用以简化使用。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但表明该工具能自动预测VSS并提供辅助信息，从而辅助模型诊断。
Conclusion: 该方法适用于需要规模化、一致性残差图评估的场景，尤其适合数据密集环境。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: SP-Mind: An Autonomous Reasoning Agent for Spatial Proteomics Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Spatial proteomics enables single-cell-resolution characterization of protein expression within tissue architecture, playing a critical role in understanding tumor microenvironments and guiding precision medicine. However, current analysis workflows remain fragmented, requiring expert manual orchestration of heterogeneous tools and limiting research scalability and reproducibility. We present SP-Mind, the first autonomous AI agent designed to unify the spatial proteomics analysis pipeline, from raw multiplexed tissue imaging to downstream phenotype discovery. Equipped with expert-curated biological analysis skills and specialized computational tools, SP-Mind converts natural-language queries into end-to-end analytical workflows without task-specific fine-tuning. To rigorously evaluate its capabilities, we introduce SP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark spanning diverse tissue types, comprising 102 tasks across 18 distinct categories. Through extensive evaluation on SP-Bench and established downstream tasks, SP-Mind achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing open-source biomedical agent baselines.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to ICML 2026. Equal contribution by Yucheng Yuan and Yuanfeng Ji
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SP-Mind，首个用于空间蛋白质组学分析的全自主 AI 代理，将自然语言查询转化为端到端分析流程，无需任务特定微调。同时引入 SP-Bench 基准，涵盖 18 类 102 项任务。在 SP-Bench 和已有下游任务上，SP-Mind 达到开源生物医学代理的最优性能。
Motivation: 当前空间蛋白质组学分析工作流碎片化，需要专家手动编排异构工具，限制了可扩展性和可重复性。
Method: 构建专家策划的生物分析技能和专业计算工具，使 SP-Mind 能够将自然语言查询自动转换为完整的分析流程。
Result: 在 SP-Bench 和下游任务上，SP-Mind 相比现有开源生物医学代理取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: SP-Mind 首次统一了空间蛋白质组学分析流程，证明了自主 AI 代理在生物医学图像分析中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Open Waters to Enclosed Cabins: ProteusVPR for Cross-Scene Visual Place Recognition in Maritime Perception and Cabin Inspection
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous robotic inspection in maritime environments presents unique challenges for Visual Place Recognition (VPR) due to cross-scene perceptual shifts. Robots navigating ship-borne environments must transition between visually distinct domains: open decks with sparse textures and severe illumination changes, and enclosed cabins with repetitive structures and high visual ambiguity. Existing VPR methods, designed primarily for urban or indoor scenes, fail to generalize reliably across these starkly different scenarios. To address this, we propose ProteusVPR, a two-stage retrieval-refinement framework. The first stage employs any standard VPR model for initial image retrieval. The second stage introduces a geometric-visual estimation network that fuses the retrieved image with two temporally preceding frames, incorporating geometric descriptors, a local affine coordinate system, and camera azimuth encoding to achieve precise localization. To support this task, we introduce the XHZ dataset, an 8K-panoramic ship-borne dataset collected from an operational vessel, featuring multi-floor cabin structures, deck transition zones, and strict query-database separation for rigorous evaluation. Extensive experiments on the XHZ dataset demonstrate that ProteusVPR consistently improves the localization accuracy across multiple VPR backbones, reducing mean localization error by over 60\% on average and that ProteusVPR offers an effective and robust solution for precise visual localization in challenging, cross-scene maritime environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对海上自主机器人跨场景视觉地点识别（VPR）中感知变化大的问题，提出ProteusVPR两阶段检索-精化框架。第一阶段使用标准VPR模型初步检索，第二阶段通过几何-视觉估计网络融合检索图像与两个时间前帧，利用几何描述子、局部仿射坐标系和相机方位角编码实现精确定位。在自行采集的XHZ船载8K全景数据集上，该方法在多种VPR主干上平均降低定位误差超过60%，展示了在跨场景海上环境中的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有VPR方法主要针对城市或室内场景，无法可靠泛化到海上船载环境中开阔甲板与封闭舱室之间的剧烈感知变化，导致定位失效。
Method: 提出ProteusVPR两阶段框架：第一阶段采用任意标准VPR模型进行初始图像检索；第二阶段引入几何-视觉估计网络，将检索图像与两个时间前帧融合，并结合几何描述子、局部仿射坐标系和相机方位角编码，实现精确位置估计。
Result: 在XHZ数据集上，ProteusVPR一致提升多种VPR主干的定位精度，平均定位误差降低超过60%。
Conclusion: 该框架为跨场景海上视觉定位提供了有效且鲁棒的解决方案，尤其适用于开阔甲板与封闭舱室交替的复杂船载环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent Visual States for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The integration of visual evidence has significantly enhanced the capabilities of large multimodal models. However, this integration predominantly relies on generating discrete outputs (etc., code or box coordinates) to invoke external tools, a process that introduces rigid dependencies and substantial latency. To overcome these limitations, we propose {EVA} (LatEnt Visual StAtes), a novel framework that natively generates continuous latent visual representations. These internal representations manifest as an adaptive sequence of Latent\_slot tokens, serving as intermediate visual thoughts during the reasoning process. These Latent\_slot tokens are then trained end-to-end with the discrete text tokens. This co-optimization, notably, causes extreme policy deviation in the 'transition window' following the Latent\_slot tokens. We develop D-GSPO (Decouple-GSPO) to target this root cause by decoupling the optimization of latent and discrete components. To support SFT, we construct EVA-230K, a high-quality text-image interleaved CoT dataset encompassing a diverse range of real-world scenes, documents, charts and OCR tasks. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks confirm that EVA achieves significant performance gains while enhancing inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EVA框架，通过生成连续的潜在视觉表示（Latent_slot tokens）作为中间视觉思考，并与离散文本token联合优化，实现高效多模态推理。为解决联合优化导致的策略偏差，提出D-GSPO方法解耦优化。构建了EVA-230K数据集用于SFT。实验表明性能提升且推理效率提高。
Motivation: 现有多模态推理依赖生成离散输出（如代码或框坐标）调用外部工具，导致刚性依赖和延迟。EVA旨在克服这些限制。
Method: EVA框架原生生成连续潜在视觉表示（Latent_slot tokens），作为推理过程中的中间视觉思考，并与离散文本token端到端训练。针对联合优化导致的策略偏差，提出D-GSPO（Decouple-GSPO）解耦潜在和离散组件的优化。构建了包含真实场景、文档、图表和OCR任务的EVA-230K数据集用于SFT。
Result: 在多个基准上取得显著性能提升，同时提高推理效率。
Conclusion: EVA通过生成连续潜在视觉表示实现了性能提升和推理效率增强。

papers.title: FiCA: Feed-forward instant Gaussian Codec Avatars from a Single Portrait Image
papers.abstract_en: We introduce FiCA, a Feed-forward, instant Gaussian Codec Avatar generation pipeline that creates lifelike avatars from a single portrait image. Generating a photorealistic and drivable avatar from just a single image is significantly challenging due to the limited visual information available to accurately infer the 3D appearance and geometry of human heads. To address this, we develop a novel system that combines human-centric vision foundation models with a diffusion model. This system is designed to fully exploit partial visual observations to generate lifelike human avatars. Our proposed diffusion model learns a generative mapping from these partial observations to complete and authentic 3D mesh reconstruction. Additionally, we introduce a feed-forward mesh refinement network that enhances the fidelity and identity preservation of the generated avatars, eliminating the need for person-specific test-time optimization. By leveraging a universal prior model that decodes a generated mesh into a set of 3D Gaussians, we generate a photorealistic 3D Gaussian avatar, capable of being driven with novel expressions in real-time. Our experiments demonstrate that the avatars generated by our feed-forward approach faithfully represent diverse identities and surpass the visual quality of avatars produced by recent competing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FiCA，一种前馈式即时高斯编码化身（Gaussian Codec Avatar）生成管线，能从单张肖像图像生成逼真的、可驱动的 3D 化身。系统结合人类中心视觉基础模型与扩散模型，生成完整的 3D 网格重建，并通过前馈网格细化网络增强保真度与身份保持。最终生成的 3D 高斯化身支持实时驱动新颖表情，且质量优于近期方法。
Motivation: 单张图像生成可驱动的逼真 3D 化身极其困难，因为有限的视觉信息难以准确推断人头的 3D 外观与几何。现有方法常需要测试时优化或无法达到足够保真度。
Method: 设计结合人类中心视觉基础模型与扩散模型的系统，学习从部分观测到完整 3D 网格的生成映射；引入前馈网格细化网络提升保真度；利用通用先验模型将生成的网格解码为 3D 高斯集合，实现实时表情驱动。
Result: 实验表明，前馈方式生成的化身能忠实表现多种身份，并在视觉质量上超越近期竞争方法。
Conclusion: FiCA 实现了从单张图像到可驱动 3D 化身的快速生成，无需测试时优化，性能优于现有方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowR2A: Learning Reward-to-Action Distribution for Multimodal Driving Planning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal driving planning faces a long-standing tension between two paradigms: scoring-based methods benefit from dense reward supervision but are confined to a fixed action vocabulary, while anchor-based methods generate proposals dynamically yet suffer from sparse supervision constrained to a single ground-truth trajectory. In this work, we propose FlowR2A, which resolves this tension by reframing simulation-based rewards from discriminative targets into generative conditions. By learning the reward-conditioned action distribution from dense trajectory-reward pairs with a flow-matching decoder, FlowR2A unifies the dense supervision of scoring-based methods with the proposal generation of anchor-based methods in a single generative model, forcing the model to internalize the correlation between an action and its outcomes in safety, progress, comfort, and rule compliance. To balance hard safety constraints against soft progress objectives, we introduce fine-grained per-timestep reward conditioning and reward noise augmentation. The generative formulation naturally supports controllable test-time sampling via reward guidance and anchored sampling, producing high-quality proposals. FlowR2A achieves state-of-the-art results on the NAVSIM v1 and v2 benchmarks, with multimodal proposals of substantially higher quality than prior methods.

TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowR2A，通过将仿真奖励从判别目标重构为生成条件，利用流匹配解码器学习奖励条件下的动作分布，统一了基于评分方法和基于锚点方法的优劣，在 NAVSIM v1 和 v2 基准上达到最先进结果。
Motivation: 多模态驾驶规划在基于评分方法（密集奖励但固定动作词汇）和基于锚点方法（动态生成但稀疏监督）之间存在矛盾，需要统一两者优势。
Method: 将奖励作为条件引入生成模型，通过流匹配解码器从密集轨迹-奖励对中学习奖励条件动作分布，并引入细粒度每时间步奖励调节和奖励噪声增强，支持测试时可控采样。
Result: 在 NAVSIM v1 和 v2 基准上取得最先进结果，多模态提议质量显著优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 生成式公式通过奖励引导和锚定采样实现可控测试时采样，产生高质量提议。

papers.title: Geometry-Instructed Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Object-level geometric edits, including translating, rotating, scaling, duplicating, or removing an object, are routine operations in digital content creation (DCC) workflows, yet they remain unreliable in generative video editing. The key challenge lies in specifying the target object's 3D state change unambiguously across viewpoint and time, while consistently updating geometry-dependent secondary effects such as shadows and reflections. We introduce GIVE, a geometry-instructed video editing framework that represents edits through a unified object-state formulation. Two video-aligned geometry streams describe the target object before and after editing: a depth-box encoding coarse 3D placement and extent, and an orientation-box providing an appearance-agnostic orientation cue. Together, these streams provide a compact pre/post geometric specification for object-state transitions. To provide paired supervision for learning these edits, we build a scalable graphics-engine pipeline that executes object-level edit programs and renders controlled before/after pairs, isolating the intended geometric edit while keeping secondary effects consistent with the transformation. Experimental results demonstrate that GIVE produces faithful geometric edits with temporal coherence and consistent secondary effects across operators in a unified framework, and shows promising transfer to in-the-wild videos. Project page: https://geometry-instructed-video-editing.github.io/give/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GIVE，一个基于几何指令的视频编辑框架，通过深度-框（depth-box）和方向-框（orientation-box）两个几何流来编码物体编辑前后的3D状态变化，从而实现物体的平移、旋转、缩放、复制或移除等操作，并保持阴影、反射等二次效果的一致性。实验表明该方法在保持时间一致性和二次效果方面表现良好。
Motivation: 现有生成式视频编辑在物体级别的几何编辑（如平移、旋转）中不可靠，难以明确指定目标物体的3D状态变化并保持二次效果的一致性。
Method: 提出 GIVE 框架，使用两个视频对齐的几何流（深度-框和方向-框）来描述编辑前后的物体状态，并通过可扩展的图形引擎生成成对的训练数据。
Result: 该方法能生成可信的几何编辑，具有时间一致性，并在野外视频上展现出良好的迁移能力。
Conclusion: GIVE 提供了一个统一的框架来处理多种物体级几何编辑，并保持二次效果的一致性，但局限性可能在于需要精确的几何输入。

papers.title: Exploring the relationship between human-centric AI and firm idiosyncratic risks
papers.abstract_en: Despite the extensive discussions of human-centric AI (HCAI) in Industry 5.0, its effects on firms' idiosyncratic risks (IR) remains underexplored. This is an imperative issue for firms navigate financial risks during the current technological revolution, as IR reflects investor reactions to corporate heterogeneous AI strategies and implementations by isolating firm-level stock volatility from systematic factors. Integrating situated AI theory with social-technical systems theory, we conceptualise HCAI as a situated AI strategy that reduces AI-related ethical risks and fosters AI-Human synergies in firms' business operations, ultimately reducing IR by aligning with stakeholders' diverse expectations. Moreover, socio-technical factors, namely digitalisation, operational efficiency, executive shareholding, and CEOs with IT background, may moderate the HCAI-IR relationship. Using a multi-source panel dataset of Chinese listed firms from 2015 to 2023, we find that HCAI is associated with lower firm IR. Furthermore, digitalisation and executive shareholding strengthen this risk-reducing effect, whereas operational efficiency and CEOs with IT background surprisingly attenuate it. Our findings offer theoretical contributions and practical insights for both ethical AI governance and firm financial risk management in the AI era.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了工业5.0背景下以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）对企业特质风险（IR）的影响。基于情境化AI理论和社会技术系统理论，将HCAI概念化为一种情境化AI策略，通过减少AI相关伦理风险并促进AI与人类协同，从而降低企业特质风险。利用2015-2023年中国上市公司面板数据，发现HCAI与更低的企业特质风险相关，且数字化和高管持股强化了这种风险降低效应，而运营效率和具有IT背景的CEO则意外地削弱了它。
Motivation: 尽管工业5.0中HCAI的讨论广泛，但其对企业特质风险的影响尚未被充分探索。理解这一关系对企业在技术革命中管理财务风险至关重要。
Method: 整合情境化AI理论与社会技术系统理论，将HCAI概念化为情境化AI策略。使用2015-2023年中国上市公司多源面板数据，通过回归分析检验HCAI与企业特质风险的关系，并考察数字化、运营效率、高管持股和CEO的IT背景的调节作用。
Result: 发现HCAI与企业特质风险负相关。数字化和高管持股加强了这种风险降低效应，而运营效率和具有IT背景的CEO则意外地削弱了它。
Conclusion: 研究为AI时代的伦理AI治理和企业财务风险管理提供了理论贡献和实践见解。

papers.title: MorVess: Morphology-Aware Pulmonary Vessel Segmentation Network
papers.abstract_en: Accurate pulmonary vessel segmentation remains challenging due to the sparse, tortuous, and multi-scale nature of vascular structures, where small branches are easily lost and topology integrity is difficult to preserve under voxel-wise supervision. Existing deep segmentation models primarily optimize binary masks, lacking explicit geometric constraints, thus struggling to recover continuous tubular morphology and fine vascular connectivity. In this study, we introduce MorVess, a morphology-aware segmentation framework that integrates differentiable geometric priors with large-scale foundation model adaptation to achieve fine-grained vascular parsing. MorVess jointly predicts vessel masks, distance maps, and thickness maps, providing explicit supervision for vascular boundaries, centerline consistency, and smooth diameter transitions. A lightweight 2.5D adapter bridges 3D spatial context and 2D SAM representations, while a global-local fusion block aggregates multi-level semantics and geometric cues for high-fidelity topology reconstruction. Across two challenging pulmonary CT benchmarks, MorVess delivers superior Dice, clDice, and HD95 scores, substantially improving small-vessel recovery and global connectivity. These results demonstrate that embedding geometric intelligence into pretrained vision models offers a principled and scalable pathway toward precise vessel analysis and clinically reliable structural quantification. Our source code is available at https://github.com/MaoFuyou/MorVess.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MorVess，一种形态学感知的肺血管分割框架，融合可微几何先验与大规模基础模型适配（SAM），联合预测血管掩膜、距离图和厚度图，以改善小血管恢复和拓扑完整性。在两个 CT 基准上，Dice、clDice 和 HD95 指标均取得更优结果。
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型主要优化二值掩膜，缺乏显式几何约束，导致血管分割中细小分支易丢失、拓扑连续性差。
Method: MorVess 联合预测血管掩膜、距离图和厚度图，提供血管边界、中心线一致性和平滑直径过渡的显式监督；采用轻量 2.5D 适配器桥接 3D 空间上下文与 2D SAM 表示，并通过全局-局部融合块聚合多级语义和几何线索以实现高保真拓扑重建。
Result: 在两个挑战性肺 CT 数据集上，MorVess 在 Dice、clDice 和 HD95 指标上均表现优异，显著提升了细小血管恢复与全局连通性。
Conclusion: 将几何智能嵌入预训练视觉模型为精确血管分析与临床可靠的结构量化提供了一条有原则且可扩展的路径。

papers.title: Inclusive Interactive Collisions for Multi-View Consistent Compositional 3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent breakthroughs in 3D generation have advanced notably with the development of text-to-image diffusion model. However, existing methods remain two practical challenges: (1) They primarily generate single 3D object, but struggle to generate multi-object compositional 3D assets due to the lack of the modeling for Gaussian primitives in reasonable interactions. (2) They often suffer from cross-view inconsistency during 3D optimization, as Score Distillation Sampling inherently performs on each single view, inevitably resulting in cross-view hallucinations. To solve above issues, we propose I2C-3D, a novel optimization-based method to generate multi-view consistent compositional 3D assets with reasonable interactions. Specifically, we propose an Inclusive Interactive Collisions strategy to guide Gaussian primitives appearing in reasonable interaction regions naturally, thereby ensuring objects in the compositional scene interact in a physically plausible and visually coherent way. Additionally, to enhance multi-view consistency, Multi-View Adaptive Score Distillation Sampling is devised to distill multi-view consistency prior and layout prior from pre-trained diffusion model by modulating attention map of instance token and spatial token across viewpoints. Benefiting from above elaborate designs, I2C-3D not only generates high-fidelity multi-view consistent compositional 3D assets but also supports 3D editing flexibly, facilitating complex scene generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate our I2C-3D outperforms existing methods in generation quality and multi-view consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出I2C-3D，一种基于优化的方法，用于生成多物体组合场景且多视图一致的3D资产。通过包含性交互碰撞策略引导高斯原语合理交互，以及多视图自适应分数蒸馏采样增强一致性，该方法在生成质量和多视图一致性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有3D生成方法主要生成单个物体，难以处理多物体组合场景，且分数蒸馏采样导致跨视图不一致和幻觉。
Method: 提出包含性交互碰撞策略，使高斯原语在合理交互区域自然出现；提出多视图自适应分数蒸馏采样，通过调节实例token和空间token的注意力图来蒸馏多视图一致性和布局先验。
Result: 实验表明I2C-3D在生成质量和多视图一致性上优于现有方法，并支持灵活3D编辑。
Conclusion: I2C-3D能生成高保真、多视图一致的多物体组合3D资产，并支持复杂场景生成和编辑。

papers.title: MMed-Bench-IR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Multilingual Medical Information Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) in clinical settings increasingly requires multilingual retrieval against predominantly English evidence corpora. Multilingual medical retrieval demands three capabilities: cross-lingual alignment, concept discrimination, and evidence retrieval. However, existing benchmarks evaluate these only in isolation, leaving the interaction between biomedical expertise and multilingual coverage unmeasured. We introduce MMed-Bench-IR, a benchmark designed to disentangle these axes across 6 languages and three structurally heterogeneous tasks: (1) cross-lingual medical QA retrieval with 6,127 queries grounded in the Unified Medical Language System (UMLS), (2) concept discrimination over 4,975 confusion sets at three difficulty tiers, and (3) multilingual evidence retrieval for RAG with 2,040 quality-assured queries. The three tasks share zero concept and query overlap by design, ensuring that aggregate scores reflect genuine capability breadth. Evaluation of ten systems across six paradigm families reveals severe cross-lingual failure: biomedical encoders that score 0.818 nDCG@10 in English drop to 0.056 in Japanese, a gap that English-only benchmarks cannot detect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了MMed-Bench-IR，一个多语言医学信息检索基准，包含三个异构任务：跨语言医学QA检索（6127个查询，基于UMLS）、概念区分（4975个混淆集，三个难度层级）和多语言证据检索（2040个查询）。评估10个系统发现跨语言性能严重下降，如生物医学编码器在英语中nDCG@10为0.818，日语中仅0.056。
Motivation: 现有基准孤立评估跨语言对齐、概念区分和证据检索能力，无法衡量生物医学专业知识与多语言覆盖的交互。需要统一的基准来解耦这些维度。
Method: 构建了MMed-Bench-IR基准，包含三个任务，无概念和查询重叠，覆盖6种语言。任务设计基于UMLS和多语言证据检索，确保评分反映真实能力广度。
Result: 评估10个系统，发现跨语言失败严重：生物医学编码器在英语中nDCG@10为0.818，日语中0.056。仅英语基准无法检测此差距。
Conclusion: MMed-Bench-IR揭示了现有系统在多语言医学检索中的严重跨语言差距，强调需要多语言评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Navigating User Behavior toward Personalized Multimodal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern AIGC pipelines deliver high-fidelity images and videos but presuppose a well-formed creation instruction, while end users rarely articulate visual details, leaving generators misaligned with user demand. We study personalized content generation, which turns a user's interaction history into an executable instruction for downstream synthesis, and identify two obstacles: behavior must be encoded in a form legible to language reasoning, and the model must acquire instruction-writing skill absent from both pretraining and behavior data. We propose NaviGen, which represents each item with a dual identifier coupling a collaborative code and a textual code as a behavioral substrate and a semantic bridge in one token stream. On this representation, a two-stage SFT+RL pipeline first distills preference reasoning and instruction writing from evolutionarily searched supervision, then aligns generation with user intent through hierarchical and self-consistent rewards. Experiments across product, game, and short-video domains show that NaviGen improves personalized image and video generation, strengthens next-item prediction, and yields more specific, relevant, and visually generatable instructions. Our code is anonymously released at: https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/NaviGen.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 15 figures, 5 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/NaviGen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NaviGen，一种通过双标识符（协作编码和文本编码）结合用户行为历史与语义信息，并采用两阶段 SFT+RL 流水线实现个性化图像和视频生成的方法。在电商、游戏和短视频领域的实验表明，NaviGen 提升了生成质量、下一项预测精度以及指令的规范性。
Motivation: 现有 AIGC 流水线假设用户提供完整创作指令，但实际用户很少表达视觉细节，导致生成内容与用户需求错位。
Method: 提出 NaviGen，为每个物品赋予协作编码和文本编码构成的双标识符，作为行为基元和语义桥；通过两阶段 SFT+RL 流水线（先蒸馏偏好推理和指令写作能力，再通过分层自洽奖励对齐生成与用户意图）。
Result: 在电商、游戏和短视频领域，NaviGen 提升了个性化图像和视频生成质量，增强了下一项预测能力，并生成了更具体、相关且可视觉生成的指令。
Conclusion: NaviGen 通过双标识符和两阶段训练有效弥合了用户行为与生成指令之间的鸿沟。

papers.title: Co-occurring associated retained concepts in Diffusion Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Unlearning has emerged as a key technique to mitigate harmful content generation in diffusion models. However, existing methods often remove not only the target concept, but also benign co-occurring concepts. As illustrated in Fig.1, unlearning nudity can unintentionally suppress the concept of person, preventing a model from generating images with person. We define these undesirably suppressed co-occurring concepts that must be preserved CARE (Co-occurring Associated REtained concepts). Then, we introduce the CARE score, a general metric that directly quantifies their preservation across unlearning tasks. With this foundation, we propose ReCARE (Robust erasure for CARE), a framework that explicitly safeguards CARE while erasing only the target concept. ReCARE automatically constructs the CARE-set, a curated vocabulary of benign co-occurring tokens extracted from target images, and leverages this vocabulary during training for stable unlearning. Extensive experiments across various target concepts (Nudity, Van Gogh style, and Tench object) demonstrate that ReCARE achieves overall state-of-the-art performance in balancing robust concept erasure, overall utility, and CARE preservation.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at ICLR 2026. Code available at https://github.com/damilab/CARE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型概念遗忘（unlearning）中意外移除良性共现概念的问题，提出CARE（共同出现的关联保留概念）度量指标和ReCARE框架。ReCARE通过自动构建保留概念词汇表并在训练中显式保护这些概念，在移除目标概念（如裸体、梵高风格、Ten种物体）时保持其他概念生成能力，实验表明在概念擦除、整体效用和CARE保留之间达到最新最优平衡。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型概念遗忘方法在移除目标概念时，往往无意识地抑制了良性共现概念（如移除裸体导致人物生成能力下降），缺乏对这些需保留概念的量化评估和显式保护。
Method: 提出CARE分数作为通用度量，量化共现概念的保留程度；并构建ReCARE框架，自动从目标图像中提取需保留的共现词构成CARE集，在训练中利用该词汇表实现稳定遗忘与保留的平衡。
Result: 在裸体、梵高风格、Ten种物体等多个概念遗忘任务上，ReCARE在概念擦除效果、整体生成效用和CARE保留方面均达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 显式保护共现良性概念是概念遗忘中不可忽视的维度，CARE分数和ReCARE框架为平衡擦除与保留提供了有效工具。
