papers.title: PORTER: Language-Grounded Event Representations for Portable Structured EHR Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Most electronic health record (EHR) foundation models encode clinical events as discrete event tokens from a fixed vocabulary and therefore cannot directly represent events containing unseen concepts or new combinations of concepts and attributes such as numeric values. This limits transfer across institutions and even across deployment pipelines within the same institution. We introduce PORTER, a language-grounded structured EHR foundation model that decouples event representation from this fixed vocabulary. PORTER represents events through their descriptions using a frozen text encoder, integrates numeric values through a dedicated pathway, and learns clinical dynamics over patient timelines with an autoregressively pretrained temporal backbone. Across 74 clinical prediction tasks at a pediatric hospital, PORTER matched the mean AUROC of a fixed-vocabulary model with the same temporal backbone and pretraining objective. When the same patient timelines were rendered using event descriptions not seen during pretraining, PORTER transferred without retraining or vocabulary mapping, recovering 97.1% of the mean AUROC of a model trained directly on the target vocabulary. When transferred to MIMIC, PORTER outperformed the fixed-vocabulary model, which dropped 69% of events because their tokens were unseen. Mechanistic analyses showed cross-vocabulary transfer tracked preservation of patient-level representation geometry rather than the scale of the text encoder, and the numeric pathway improved sensitivity to magnitude without disrupting clinical concept identity. PORTER also achieved higher AUROC than a task-specific text serialization comparator, at 329-fold lower amortized compute. PORTER is a step toward vocabulary-independent EHR foundation models that reduce the need for vocabulary harmonization while preserving in-domain performance and enabling efficient cross-task reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PORTER，一种基于语言的结构化EHR基础模型，通过冻结文本编码器表示临床事件，专用通道处理数值，并自回归预训练时间骨干。在74个儿科临床预测任务中，PORTER达到与固定词汇模型相当的AUROC；当使用未见过的词汇时，无需重训练即可迁移，恢复97.1%的AUROC；在MIMIC数据集上优于固定词汇模型。机械分析表明跨词汇迁移依赖于患者级表示几何保持，数值通道提高幅度敏感性。PORTER为词汇无关的EHR基础模型迈进一步。
Motivation: 现有EHR基础模型将临床事件编码为固定词汇离散标记，无法表示包含未见概念或新组合的事件，限制跨机构转移。
Method: PORTER通过冻结文本编码器（如BERT）将事件描述编码为表示，数值值通过独立数值通道处理，然后与事件表示融合，并使用自回归时间骨干（如GPT）在患者时间线上预训练。
Result: 在74个儿科任务上，PORTER的mean AUROC与固定词汇模型相同；跨词汇迁移恢复97.1%的mean AUROC；在MIMIC上，固定词汇模型因69%事件标记未见而性能下降，PORTER则超越它；数值通道提高对数值幅度的敏感性；与任务特定文本序列化基线相比，AUROC更高且计算量降低329倍。
Conclusion: PORTER减少了词汇协调需求，同时保持域内性能并实现高效跨任务复用，是实现词汇无关EHR基础模型的重要一步。

papers.title: NavWM: A Unified Navigation World Model for Foresight-Driven Planning
papers.abstract_en: Conventional visual navigation policies often struggle with myopic decision-making and mode collapse in complex environments. While world models offer a promising alternative, existing paradigms typically isolate perception, generation, and control, failing to capture their shared spatio-temporal dynamics. In this paper, we propose NavWM, a unified navigation world model that seamlessly integrates latent world reasoning, multimodal action prediction, and controllable visual generation. At its core, NavWM leverages latent world tokens to distill geometric and semantic priors, endowing the agent with robust structural understanding. To overcome the limitations of deterministic policies, we introduce an anchor-based multimodal trajectory forecasting framework that generates a diverse action space. This inherent diversity explicitly empowers the generative world model to act as a robust closed-loop planner, utilizing visual foresight to evaluate and select the optimal path. Extensive experiments across diverse robotics datasets demonstrate that NavWM significantly advances the state-of-the-art, delivering remarkable improvements in both high-fidelity future state generation and zero-shot navigation success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NavWM，一个统一的导航世界模型，整合了潜在世界推理、多模态动作预测和可控视觉生成。通过潜在世界标记提取几何与语义先验，并引入基于锚点的多模态轨迹预测框架，生成多样化动作空间，使生成式世界模型可作为鲁棒的闭环规划器。实验表明，该方法在多种机器人数据集上显著提升了未来状态生成质量和零样本导航成功率。
Motivation: 传统视觉导航策略在复杂环境中易出现短视决策和模式崩溃，而现有世界模型范式将感知、生成和控制分离，未能捕捉其共享的时空动态。
Method: 提出统一导航世界模型 NavWM，核心是使用潜在世界标记（latent world tokens）提取几何和语义先验，并设计基于锚点的多模态轨迹预测框架，生成多样化动作空间，通过视觉预见（visual foresight）评估和选择最优路径。
Result: 在多种机器人数据集上的实验表明，NavWM 在高质量未来状态生成和零样本导航成功率上均显著超越现有最先进方法。

papers.title: Exploring Academic Influence of Algorithms by Co-occurrence Network Based on Full-text of Academic Papers
papers.abstract_en: Algorithms have become central to scientific research in the era of artificial intelligence (AI). Although algorithm mentions in papers are often used to indicate popularity and influence, existing studies usually evaluate individual algorithms in isolation and pay limited attention to the collective influence formed through their interconnections. This study constructs large-scale algorithm co-occurrence networks in natural language processing (NLP) based on the full text of academic papers and investigates algorithm influence from a network perspective. Using deep learning models, we extract algorithm entities and build overall, cumulative, and annual co-occurrence networks. We analyze their structural characteristics and apply multiple centrality measures to assess the group influence of algorithms across the whole field and over time. The results show that algorithm networks display typical features of complex networks, with increasingly dense connections developing over approximately two decades. Classic, high-performing algorithms and those located at the intersections of different research periods tend to have high popularity, control, centrality, and balanced influence. When the influence of an algorithm declines, it usually loses its core network position first, followed by weaker associations with other algorithms. This study is the first large-scale analysis of algorithm co-occurrence networks. Covering more than four decades of academic publications, it provides a temporal and structural view of algorithm influence and offers a foundation for future research on networks linking algorithms, scholars, and tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于学术论文全文构建自然语言处理领域的算法共现网络，通过整体、累积和年度网络分析算法在学科中的群体影响力。网络呈现复杂网络特征，经典高性能算法和处于不同研究时期交叉点的算法具有较高流行度、控制力和均衡影响力。当算法影响力下降时，通常先失去核心网络位置，随后与其他算法的关联减弱。这是首次大规模算法共现网络分析，覆盖四十余年出版物，提供时间与结构视角。
Motivation: 现有研究通常孤立评估单个算法，很少关注算法通过相互联系形成的集体影响力。
Method: 利用深度学习模型从论文全文中提取算法实体，构建整体、累积和年度共现网络，并使用多种中心性指标评估算法在领域内和随时间变化的群体影响力。
Result: 算法网络呈现典型复杂网络特征，密度随时间增加；经典高性能算法和跨研究时期算法具有高中心性；影响力下降时先失去核心位置。
Conclusion: 该研究是首次大规模算法共现网络分析，为未来算法、学者和任务网络研究提供基础。

papers.title: Beyond Bayer: Task-Optimal Sensor Co-Design for Robust Autonomous-Driving Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Robust perception underpins autonomous driving, and most recent progress comes from scaling the model-larger backbones, foundation models, and cooperative multi-agent fusion. We pursue a complementary, upstream question: what should the camera itself measure? Using a differentiable RAW-to-task pipeline, we decompose which sensor degrees of freedom benefit dense prediction. Learning the spectral colour-filter-array (CFA) weights is the dominant lever, improving mIoU by +0.017 (KITTI-360) and +0.023 (ACDC) over a fixed camera. In contrast, point-spread-function (optics) co-design is net-negative (-0.020 mIoU on KITTI-360) - a consequence of the data-processing inequality, which also bounds the task information that any downstream model, however large or cooperative, can recover. Noise co-optimisation is marginal, and counter to intuition enlarging the CFA tile beyond 2x2 consistently hurts, as the filters are confined to the rank three sRGB input. Because the intervention is at the sensor, the gains are model-agnostic; we validate robustness on ACDC's fog, night, rain, and snow, and conclude with a simple recipe: learn the 2x2 CFA weights and keep an identity PSF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可微的 RAW-to-task 流水线，用于联合优化相机传感器的光谱滤波阵列（CFA）和点扩散函数（PSF），以提升自动驾驶语义分割的鲁棒性。实验表明，学习 2x2 CFA 权重能带来稳定的 mIoU 提升（KITTI-360 +0.017, ACDC +0.023），而点扩散函数联合设计反而带来负收益（-0.020 mIoU），噪声协同优化效果微弱。结论建议保持身份 PSF 并仅学习 CFA 权重，且 CFA 块不宜超过 2x2。
Motivation: 当前自动驾驶感知的进步主要来自模型侧扩展，忽视了传感器本身的设计。本文追问相机本身应该测量什么，即通过联合优化传感器参数（CFA、PSF、噪声）来提升下游分割任务性能。
Method: 构建一个可微的 RAW-to-task 流水线，将相机传感器参数（CFA 权重、PSF、噪声）纳入端到端优化，直接以语义分割的 mIoU 作为目标函数，并在多个数据集（KITTI-360, ACDC）上评估。
Result: 学习 2x2 CFA 权重是主要性能提升杠杆，在 KITTI-360 上 mIoU +0.017，ACDC 上 +0.023；PSF 联合设计导致 -0.020 mIoU 下降；噪声协同优化收益微弱；增大 CFA 块超过 2x2 反而有害。
Conclusion: 推荐简单方案：仅学习 2x2 CFA 权重，保持身份 PSF。传感器级干预带来的增益是模型无关的，并在 ACDC 的雾、夜、雨、雪条件下验证了鲁棒性。

papers.title: Universal Guideline-Driven Image Clustering via a Hybrid LLM Agent
papers.abstract_en: Unifying image clustering across different clustering scenarios remains challenging due to fundamental gaps among tasks. We introduce a Guideline-Driven Image Clustering Agent, the first universal framework that bridges these gaps through textual guidelines. To incorporate complex guidelines without task-specific training, we propose Generative Concept Proxy Modeling, which generates guideline-aware embeddings via concept proxy extraction. For scenarios requiring automatic cluster discovery, we introduce LLM Traversal based on Minimum Spanning Tree that selectively applies LLM reasoning for complex semantic judgments. Our method generalizes across diverse clustering scenarios spanning from general to fine-grained categorization, from global to local criteria, and from balanced to long-tail distributions. Our framework consistently outperforms specialized methods across diverse clustering tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个通用图像聚类框架Guideline-Driven Image Clustering Agent，通过文本指南桥接不同聚类任务的差距。方法包括Generative Concept Proxy Modeling生成指南感知嵌入，以及基于最小生成树的LLM Traversal自动发现聚类。该框架在从通用到细粒度、从全局到局部、从平衡到长尾分布等多种聚类场景中均优于专门方法。
Motivation: 现有图像聚类方法通常针对特定场景设计，缺乏跨不同聚类任务的统一框架，难以处理从通用到细粒度、从全局到局部等多种聚类标准。
Method: 提出Guideline-Driven Image Clustering Agent，包含Generative Concept Proxy Modeling（通过概念代理提取生成指南感知嵌入）和基于最小生成树的LLM Traversal（选择性应用LLM推理进行复杂语义判断），无需任务特定训练即可纳入复杂文本指南。
Result: 在涵盖通用到细粒度分类、全局到局部标准、平衡到长尾分布的多种聚类任务上，该框架一致优于专门方法。
Conclusion: 该通用框架通过文本指南有效统一了不同图像聚类场景，展示了LLM在无监督聚类中的潜力。

papers.title: Predicting Poets' Origins from Verse: A Computational Analysis of Regional Linguistic Fingerprints in the Complete Tang Poems
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether the geographic origin of Tang-dynasty poets leaves a detectable linguistic trace in their work. Aggregating every poem attributed to each author in the Complete Tang Poems (Quan Tang Shi) and linking poets to their administrative circuit of origin via the China Biographical Database (CBDB), we build a poet-level corpus of 357 poets across the ten Tang circuits and frame origin prediction as multi-class classification. Using character $n$-gram TF-IDF together with interpretable domain features (imagery, season, and allusion), classical and neural models predict a poet's broad region (South vs.\ North) at $0.69$ accuracy, well above the $0.53$ majority baseline, and finer circuit-level origin above chance. Beyond classification, three findings emerge. (i) Linguistic distance between circuits grows with geographic distance (Mantel $r=0.40$, $p\approx0.09$ over nine circuits), evidence of a distance-decay effect in poetic language. (ii) The signal interacts with time: South/North separability is at chance in the High Tang and strongest in the Late Tang, consistent with court-driven homogenization at the empire's height followed by regional divergence. (iii) The model's confident errors are historically meaningful -- in the Early Tang, every misclassification is a southern poet read as northern, reflecting the prestige of the northern court idiom. We further show that, when given the whole corpus through a hierarchical frozen-encoder representation, a classical-Chinese transformer (GuwenBERT) only matches -- not beats -- simple TF-IDF, and that combining them adds nothing, indicating that character $n$-grams already capture the regional signal. Our results position interpretable machine learning as a hypothesis generator for literary history.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用《全唐诗》中357位诗人的作品，结合中国传记数据库（CBDB）中诗人的行政区域信息，通过字符n-gram TF-IDF和可解释领域特征（意象、季节、用典），训练分类模型预测诗人的地域起源（南方/北方）及更细的节度区域。模型在南北分类上达到0.69准确率，显著高于多数基线0.53。此外发现语言距离与地理距离正相关（Mantel r=0.40），信号随时间变化（晚唐南北可分离性最强），以及早期唐错误分类反映北方宫廷语体的声望。
Motivation: 探究唐代诗人的地理起源是否在其作品中留下可检测的语言痕迹，为文学史提供计算假设生成工具。
Method: 构建诗人级别语料库，使用字符n-gram TF-IDF和领域特征（意象、季节、用典），应用经典和神经网络模型（包括GuwenBERT）进行多分类；通过层次冻结编码器与简单TF-IDF对比。
Result: 南北分类准确率0.69（多数基线0.53）；语言距离与地理距离相关（Mantel r=0.40）；晚唐南北可分离性最强；早期唐所有错误分类均为南方诗人被识别为北方；GuwenBERT并未超越TF-IDF。
Conclusion: 可解释机器学习可以作为文学史的假设生成器，字符n-gram已充分捕捉地域信号，简单模型优于复杂预训练模型。

papers.title: Progressive Pixel-Neighborhood Deformable Cross-Attention for Multispectral Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Effective cross-modal feature alignment and interaction are central challenges in multispectral object detection. Although global cross-attention provides strong long-range modeling ability, its quadratic complexity with respect to feature size limits deployment on resource-constrained platforms. We therefore propose Progressive Pixel-Neighborhood Deformable Cross-Attention for multispectral feature fusion, termed PNAFusion. The proposed framework is motivated by two observations: weak misalignment between visible and thermal images is usually concentrated around local neighborhoods, and semantic correspondence across modalities often follows non-linear spatial mappings that fixed receptive fields cannot model well. To address these issues, PNAFusion incorporates local spatial priors into its architectural design to concentrate feature interaction and alignment on the most relevant neighborhoods. Specifically, a Pixel-Neighborhood Cross-Attention (PNCA) module is introduced to avoid redundant global feature matching and suppress background noise. Meanwhile, an Adaptive Deformable Alignment (ADA) module captures non-linear spatial correspondences through learned pixel-wise offsets. These components are further integrated through an iterative feedback mechanism to progressively refine cross-modal feature alignment. Experiments on FLIR, M3FD, and DroneVehicle show that PNAFusion achieves 84.2, 90.5, and 85.5 mAP@0.5, respectively, under the YOLOv5 detector, and further reaches 86.8 mAP@0.5 on FLIR and 90.8 mAP@0.5 on M3FD when transferred to Co-DETR. Efficiency analysis indicates that PNAFusion reduces allocated GPU memory by 33.0\% compared with ICAFusion and reduces theoretical FLOPs from 194.8 G to 156.4 G, although the deformable sampling and iterative refinement introduce additional latency. Our code will be available at https://github.com/DanielQiuTian/PNAFusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多光谱目标检测中的跨模态特征对齐与交互问题，提出渐进式像素邻域可变形交叉注意力融合方法PNAFusion。该方法引入像素邻域交叉注意力（PNCA）模块聚焦局部邻域交互，并设计自适应可变形对齐（ADA）模块捕捉非线性空间对应，通过迭代反馈机制逐步精炼对齐。在FLIR、M3FD、DroneVehicle数据集上，PNAFusion在YOLOv5检测器下分别达到84.2、90.5、85.5 mAP@0.5，并降低了GPU内存和FLOPs。
Motivation: 多光谱目标检测中可见光与热红外图像存在弱错位，且跨模态语义对应通常呈现非线性空间映射，固定感受野难以有效建模。全局交叉注意力虽强但计算复杂度过高，不适合资源受限平台。
Method: 提出PNAFusion框架，包含像素邻域交叉注意力（PNCA）模块用于局部交互并抑制背景噪声，自适应可变形对齐（ADA）模块通过学习的像素级偏移捕捉非线性对应，并利用迭代反馈机制逐步精炼对齐。
Result: 在FLIR、M3FD、DroneVehicle上，PNAFusion在YOLOv5下mAP@0.5分别为84.2、90.5、85.5；迁移至Co-DETR后在FLIR和M3FD上分别达86.8和90.8。与ICAFusion相比，GPU内存减少33%，FLOPs从194.8G降至156.4G，但可变形采样和迭代精炼带来额外延迟。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过局部空间先验和可变形对齐的结合，PNAFusion能在降低计算量的同时提升多光谱目标检测性能。

papers.title: DynaWM: Dynamics-Aware Distillation with World Model and Momentum Targets for Smooth Locomotion over Continuous Stairs
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in control have enabled bipedal-wheeled robots to traverse slopes and single-step obstacles, yet long staircase traversal remains challenging as current teacher-student frameworks suffer from weakened dynamics-aware representations and incomplete terrain geometry encoding. To bridge this gap, we propose DynaWM, a dynamics-aware representation learning framework. To enhance terrain encoding capability and enable transparent assessment, we introduce a world model as a regularizer to enforce forward-dynamics awareness, preserving comprehensive terrain geometry while facilitating hierarchical encoding visualization. To stabilize knowledge transfer, we employ a momentum target encoder to provide consistent distillation targets, preventing dimensional collapse from non-stationary teacher updates. Evaluation of the learned representations through Principal Component Analysis (PCA) visualization and quantitative metrics reveals that our encoder hierarchically captures terrain geometry with higher terrain encoding capability, leading to enhanced terrain adaptability and motion smoothness. Experimental results in simulation and real hardware demonstrate that our method achieves superior terrain adaptability and motion smoothness, enabling bipedal-wheeled robots to overcome diverse continuous stairs, as shown in Fig. 1.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynaWM，一种动力学感知表示学习框架，用于解决双足轮式机器人在连续楼梯上行走的挑战。通过引入世界模型作为正则化器增强前向动力学感知，并采用动量目标编码器稳定知识蒸馏，使机器人能够层次化地捕捉地形几何信息，提升地形适应性和运动平滑性。仿真和实物实验验证了该方法在多种连续楼梯上的有效性。
Motivation: 现有教师-学生框架在长楼梯遍历中面临动力学感知表示弱化和地形几何编码不完整的问题，导致机器人难以平滑通过连续楼梯。
Method: 提出 DynaWM 框架：利用世界模型作为正则化器强制前向动力学感知，保留完整地形几何并支持层次化编码可视化；采用动量目标编码器提供一致的蒸馏目标，防止非平稳教师更新导致的维度坍缩。
Result: PCA 可视化和定量指标表明编码器层次化捕捉地形几何，编码能力更强；仿真和实物实验证明该方法在连续楼梯上具有优越的地形适应性和运动平滑性。
Conclusion: DynaWM 通过动力学感知表示学习和稳定蒸馏，有效提升了双足轮式机器人在连续楼梯上的行走性能，未来可应用于更复杂的非平坦地形。

papers.title: NeuroSonic: Conditional Flow Matching for EEG-to-Speech Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing continuous speech from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) remains fundamentally challenging. EEG provides a weak, spatially diffuse, and highly variable measurement of distributed cortical activity, whereas speech is organized as a coherent acoustic trajectory with strong harmonic and temporal structure. The resulting mismatch makes waveform regression unstable and causes stochastic multi-step generation to be sensitive to artifact-dependent conditioning and subject variability. We introduce NeuroSonic, a conditional flow-matching framework for EEG-to-speech reconstruction. Instead of predicting waveforms directly or refining them through stochastic denoising, NeuroSonic learns a deterministic probability-flow velocity field that transports a noise-corrupted acoustic state toward clean speech under EEG conditioning. EEG and audio are embedded into a shared token space and processed by a time-conditioned gated Transformer that parameterizes the transport ordinary differential equation. This formulation models trajectory evolution explicitly while avoiding iterative stochastic sampling. We evaluate NeuroSonic on the CineBrain and EAV benchmarks under cross-subject evaluation. Across both datasets, the proposed method improves distributional realism, spectral fidelity, and perceptual quality over representative GAN-, diffusion-, and mean-flow baselines, with up to a 26.3\% gain in overall perceptual quality. The performance gap is most evident in artifact-heavy segments, where conditioning variability is strongest. These findings indicate that deterministic conditional transport provides a stable and effective formulation for EEG-driven speech reconstruction. Code is available at https://github.com/Y-Research-SBU/NeuroSonic/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuroSonic提出基于条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）的框架，用于从头皮脑电图（EEG）重建连续语音。该方法学习一个由EEG条件引导的确定性概率流速度场，通过时间条件门控Transformer参数化传输常微分方程（ODE），避免迭代随机采样。在CineBrain和EAV基准的跨被试评估中，NeuroSonic在分布真实性、频谱保真度和感知质量上优于GAN、扩散和均值流基线，整体感知质量提升高达26.3%，尤其在高伪迹片段中表现更佳。
Motivation: EEG信号弱、空间弥散且变异性高，而语音是连贯的声学轨迹，两者的不匹配导致直接波形回归不稳定，随机多步生成对伪迹依赖和个体差异敏感。
Method: 将EEG和音频嵌入共享token空间，利用时间条件门控Transformer参数化条件流匹配的速度场，从而通过确定性传输ODE实现从噪声声学状态到干净语音的重建。
Result: 在CineBrain和EAV数据集上，NeuroSonic在分布真实性、频谱保真度和感知质量上均优于GAN、扩散和均值流基线，整体感知质量提升26.3%，尤其在伪迹丰富的片段上优势更显著。
Conclusion: 确定性条件传输为EEG驱动的语音重建提供了稳定有效的框架，避免了随机采样的不稳定性，并提升了在伪迹条件下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Blockwise Policy-Drift Gating for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student policy using teacher signals computed on trajectories sampled by the student itself. Recent work shows that sampled-token OPD can be fragile on long-horizon reasoning tasks and that local teacher-support matching is a simple and effective repair. This paper introduces blockwise policy-drift gating, a lightweight student-only old-current drift controller for OPD under rollout reuse. The method computes log-probability shifts between the behavior student and the current student on the sampled token path, aggregates these shifts over fixed blocks or spans, and uses the resulting detached, mean-normalized gates to reweight OPD position losses. It does not change teacher targets, teacher top-K supports, or the rollout policy. In a six-variant Qwen3 math reasoning benchmark with a uniform 200-step training budget for all trained variants, we use pass@8 as the primary problem-level solve-rate metric. Fixed 64-token block gating improves sampled-token OPD mean pass@8 from 0.4978 to 0.5160 across AIME24, AIME25, MATH500, and AMC23. On Teacher-TopK/LSM, Block64 gives the best four-benchmark mean pass@8 among trained students. The results identify local old-current policy drift as a practical control signal for reused OPD rollouts and motivate block-level gating as a simple default for improving solve-rate robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分块策略漂移门控（Blockwise Policy-Drift Gating），一种轻量级的仅学生端旧当前漂移控制器，用于在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中的rollout重用。该方法计算行为学生与当前学生在采样token路径上的对数概率偏移，按固定分块聚合，并使用解耦的均值归一化门控重新加权OPD位置损失，不改变教师目标或教师Top-K支持。在Qwen3数学推理基准上，固定64-token分块门控将采样token OPD的pass@8均值从0.4978提升至0.5160，识别出局部旧当前策略漂移作为重用OPD rollout的实用控制信号。
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏在长程推理任务上存在脆弱性，而局部教师支持匹配是一种简单有效的修复，但现有方法未充分利用rollout重用中的策略漂移信息。本文动机是探索本地旧当前策略漂移作为控制信号，提升OPD的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出分块策略漂移门控：计算行为学生与当前学生在采样token路径上的对数概率偏移，按固定分块（如64 tokens）聚合，得到解耦的均值归一化门控值，用于在位置损失上加权。该方法仅作用于学生端，不改变教师目标或教师支持集。
Result: 在包含AIME24、AIME25、MATH500和AMC23的六变体Qwen3数学推理基准上，使用统一200步训练预算，固定64-token分块门控将采样token OPD的均值pass@8从0.4978提升至0.5160，且在Teacher-TopK/LSM设置下获得最佳四基准均值pass@8。
Conclusion: 摘要指出本地旧当前策略漂移可作为重用OPD rollouts的实用控制信号，并推荐分块门控作为提升求解率鲁棒性的简单默认方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CAVEWOMAN: How Large Language Models Behave Under Linguistic Input and Output Compression
papers.abstract_en: "Talk short. Drop grammar. Save token." This caveman style is widely promoted as a way to cut inference cost, but whether it actually saves anything depends on which channel (the user's prompt or the model's response) is being compressed. We present Cavewoman, a two-channel evaluation protocol that scores every generation on task accuracy, realized per-item cost, and reference-text agreement against the model's unconstrained reference. We evaluate eight models on five datasets at five reduction levels, with both channels measured on the same items. Output compression cuts realized cost on most API models (1.4-2.4x per model, up to 3x in the best case) and on all four open-weight models under public-tier pricing. Input compression has the opposite effect, a strict lose-lose: it raises net cost rather than lowering it (~1.15x on the five-benchmark mean, up to 1.8x on the worst dataset and 2.7x under stronger compression), because models compensate with longer responses even as accuracy collapses. Under the same setting, surface text diverges from the unconstrained reference: on the non-reasoning models, roughly half of all generations are correct yet their surface text no longer entails the model's own unconstrained baseline generation. The divergence survives length-controlled re-scoring, multiple-comparisons correction, and replication under complementary semantic measures. Code and data are available at https://github.com/danielle34/cavewoman.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cavewoman两通道评估协议，系统评估了大语言模型在输入压缩和输出压缩下的表现。在五个数据集上对八个模型进行测试，发现输出压缩能有效降低推理成本（多数API模型降低1.4-2.4倍，最高3倍），而输入压缩反而增加成本（平均1.15倍，最高1.8倍）并导致准确性下降。此外，压缩后的正确生成文本与无约束基线存在显著不一致，且该现象在多项控制下仍然成立。
Motivation: 用户常被建议使用简短输入以节省token成本，但压缩输入或输出对实际成本的影响方向不同。论文旨在明确两种压缩渠道的真实效果，填补系统评估的空白。
Method: 提出Cavewoman协议，在五个数据集上，对八个模型（含API和开源模型）施加五个级别的输入或输出压缩，同时记录任务准确率、实际每项成本和与无约束参考文本的一致性。
Result: 输出压缩使多数API模型成本降至0.4-0.7倍（最佳3倍），所有开源模型在公开定价下成本下降。输入压缩则使成本上升约1.15倍（平均），最高1.8倍（更强压缩下2.7倍），同时准确性大幅下降。非推理模型约50%的正确生成文本在语义上不等同于无约束基线。
Conclusion: 输入压缩是严格的双输策略：既增加成本又降低性能。输出压缩是有效的降本手段，但会改变生成文本的表面形式，即使内容正确。该不一致性在长度控制、多重比较校正和语义测量下依然稳健。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PixJail: Self-Evolving Paper-to-Pipeline Reproduction for Text-to-Image Jailbreak Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: As Text-to-Image (T2I) jailbreak techniques evolve rapidly, existing benchmarks and reproduction workflows often struggle to keep pace. More importantly, T2I jailbreak evaluation is not a single prompt-level test, but a pipeline-level problem shaped by multiple stages, including prompt transformation, image generation, safety filtering, and multimodal judging. This makes results across papers difficult to reliably reproduce and fairly compare. To bridge this gap, we propose PixJail, a self-evolving paper-to-pipeline agent framework for reproducible T2I jailbreak evaluation. Given a T2I jailbreak paper and optional reference code, PixJail rapidly constructs a paper-specific attack module and a runnable evaluation pipeline under a unified contract, while faithfully reproducing the original experimental results. PixJail further maintains a memory bank that stores paper digests, attack evolution patterns, reusable templates, failure cases, and versioned artifacts, enabling future reproduction efforts to reuse prior experience. We reproduce eleven representative T2I jailbreak methods, including both code-available and code-unavailable papers. Under their original settings, our framework accurately recovers prior results with minimal error (2.1\% average, 0\% median). We hope that PixJail can serve as a unified foundation for future T2I jailbreak reproduction and evaluation, significantly reducing manual effort.

papers.title: End-to-End Radar and Communication Modulation Recognition with Neuromorphic Computing
papers.abstract_en: Although deep learning-based methods can achieve high accuracy in automatic modulation recognition (AMR) tasks, their high computational cost makes it difficult to strike a balance between accuracy and power consumption, thereby limiting their application on resource-constrained platforms. Neuromorphic architectures that perform spike-driven inference with modest energy budgets have recently been explored for vision and timeseries tasks. Motivated by these works, we propose EMRFormer, a novel end-to-end spiking nerural network (SNN) architecture that applies spike-driven transformer to the constraints of neuromorphic hardware for AMR. The model incorporates an adaptive spike encoder and Integer Leaky Integrate-and-Fire neurons to mitigate the degradation of effective information and enhance SNN representational capacity. By integrating spike-separable Convolution Neural Networks (SSCNN) into Spike-Driven Transformers (SpikeFormer), EMRFormer effectively extracts multi-scale temporal features from the raw IQ waveforms. We validate our approach across various mainstream datasets, the experimental results show that EMRFormer achieves state-of-the-art interms of accuracy, outperforming all the baselines. Furthermore, the model maintains strong performance in low signal-to-noise(SNR) environments and reduces theoretical energy consumption by over 90%. Finally, we evaluate our model on a KA200 neuromorphic chip. The results show that our model achieves up to 5 times reduction in power compared to running on a 3090 GPU or an Orin NX. This work demonstrates a promising pathway for AMR on resource-constrained devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EMRFormer，一种基于脉冲神经网络（SNN）的端到端架构，用于雷达与通信信号的自动调制识别（AMR）。模型通过自适应脉冲编码器和整数泄漏积分点火神经元缓解信息退化，并融合脉冲可分离卷积与脉冲驱动Transformer提取多尺度时间特征。在多个数据集上达到最高准确率，在低信噪比环境下仍保持强性能，理论能耗降低90%以上；在KA200神经形态芯片上功耗仅为GPU的1/5。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法在自动调制识别（AMR）中精度高但计算成本大，难以在资源受限平台上兼顾精度与功耗。
Method: 提出EMRFormer架构：采用自适应脉冲编码器和整数LIF神经元增强SNN表示能力，结合脉冲可分离卷积（SSCNN）与脉冲驱动Transformer（SpikeFormer）从原始IQ波形中提取多尺度时间特征。
Result: 在主流数据集上达到最高准确率，低信噪比下性能稳健，理论能耗降低超90%；KA200芯片实测功耗相比3090 GPU或Orin NX降低5倍。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了神经形态计算在资源受限设备上实现高效AMR的可行路径，但摘要未提及泛化性等局限性。

papers.title: Token Complexity of Certifying Stochastic-Oracle Reliability
papers.abstract_en: Wang~\cite{Wang2026} introduced the Stochastic-Oracle Turing Machine (SOTM) framework and defined token complexity as the minimum expected cost of interacting with a stochastic oracle needed to attain a specified solution quality for a task. This paper develops an analogous notion for certifying the reliability of a stochastic oracle on a given domain. Certification token complexity is the minimum expected token cost required, with controlled error probability, to distinguish oracles that meet a target reliability level from those that fall below a lower reliability threshold. We construct an SPRT-based certification SOTM that queries the oracle, computes binary correctness scores, and stops when the accumulated log-likelihood evidence crosses a decision threshold. The SOTM halts almost surely, satisfies the desired two-sided error guarantee over the reliability regions to be certified, and yields an explicit upper bound on certification token complexity in terms of the reliability thresholds, the error bound, and the expected per-turn token cost. We then establish a matching information-theoretic lower bound: even with adaptive queries, every error-bounded certification SOTM must incur the same leading-order expected token cost as the SPRT-based construction as the prescribed error bound tends to zero. Together, these bounds characterize the leading-order certification token complexity in the small-error regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在随机预言机图灵机（SOTM）框架下定义了认证 token 复杂度，用于区分达到目标可靠性的预言机与低于低可靠性阈值的预言机。构造了基于序贯概率比检验（SPRT）的认证 SOTM，证明了其满足双边误差保证并给出了显式上界。进一步证明了信息论下界，表明在误差趋于零时 SPRT 构造达到最优的领先阶复杂度，从而刻画了小误差情形下的认证 token 复杂度。
Motivation: 需要一种量化认证随机预言机可靠性所需交互成本的方法，尤其是区分可靠性是否达到指定阈值的最小期望 token 成本。
Method: 定义认证 token 复杂度，并构造基于 SPRT 的 SOTM，该机器逐次查询预言机、计算二元正确性分数，当累积对数似然证据跨越决策阈值时停止。
Result: 给出了显式的上界表达式；建立了匹配的信息论下界，证明误差有界时 SPRT 构造在主导阶上是最优的，从而刻画了小误差区域下认证 token 复杂度。
Conclusion: 该工作从理论和算法上为随机预言机可靠性认证提供了复杂度下界与可实现的构造，揭示了阈值与误差率对交互成本的影响。

papers.title: Fabric Image Demoiréing Benchmark from Synthesis to Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Fabric moiré is a sampling-induced aliasing artifact caused by the interaction between fine textile patterns and camera sensor grids, producing structured interference that severely degrades image quality. Unlike screen-induced moiré, which stems from strictly periodic display lattices, fabric moiré is intrinsically more challenging due to the broadband and semi-periodic nature of textile weaves. The heavy spectral overlap between intrinsic texture and aliasing components renders fabric demoiréing substantially more ill-posed. Consequently, existing models trained on screen moiré datasets generalize poorly to these complex textile patterns. Despite its practical importance, fabric image demoiréing remains underexplored and lacks standardized benchmarks. We present the first comprehensive benchmark for fabric image demoiréing. To address the difficulty of acquiring pixel-aligned real-world pairs, we develop a physically motivated synthesis framework and construct a large-scale dataset comprising 16,050 paired multi-resolution fabric images with controllable aliasing severity. Furthermore, we customize a baseline model, which establishes promising performance on the proposed benchmark dataset with strong generalization ability. Our benchmark provides a standardized platform for advancing research in fabric image demoiréing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对织物图像中的摩尔纹（moire）伪影问题，提出首个标准化基准。织物摩尔纹由纺织纹理与相机传感器网格相互作用产生，比屏幕摩尔纹更具挑战性。作者开发了物理启发的合成框架，构建了包含16,050对多分辨率织物图像的数据集，并设计了基线模型。实验表明该基线模型在基准数据集上性能良好且泛化能力强。
Motivation: 织物摩尔纹由于纺织纹理的宽带和半周期性，与混叠分量光谱重叠严重，导致去摩尔纹问题高度不适定。现有模型在屏幕摩尔纹数据集上训练，对复杂织物纹理泛化差，且缺乏标准化基准。
Method: 提出物理启发的合成框架生成像素对齐的真实感图像对，构建了包含16,050对多分辨率织物图像的数据集，并设计了基线模型。
Result: 基线模型在提出的基准数据集上建立了有希望的性能，并展现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该基准为织物图像去摩尔纹研究提供了标准化平台，有望推动该领域的发展。

papers.title: ObsGraph: Hierarchical Observation Representation for Embodied Reasoning and Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Embodied reasoning and exploration are increasingly considered crucial abilities for robots operating in complex and unfamiliar environments. To accomplish tasks in such settings, an agent must identify and acquire the information necessary for the task through exploration. We propose ObsGraph, an observation-centric hierarchical scene graph that unifies scene representation, retrieval, and exploration. It retains visual evidence and organizes it into room-view-object layers: rooms provide coarse semantic anchors, views preserve contextual object covisibility, and objects store fine-grained details. On top of this representation, we perform coarse-to-fine hierarchical retrieval under a bounded budget, and crucially use retrieval outcomes to structure the exploration candidate space--activating room-level exploration, view refinement, or frontier exploration--thereby tightly coupling representation, retrieval, and adaptive multi-scale exploration. Experiments across embodied reasoning and exploration benchmarks demonstrate improved success and efficiency, highlighting the benefits of structured scene representation and more targeted information gathering driven by identified evidence gaps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ObsGraph，一种以观察为中心的层次场景图，将场景表示、检索和探索统一起来。它按房间-视角-对象三层组织视觉证据，在有限预算下执行从粗到细的层次检索，并利用检索结果指导多尺度探索（房间级、视角细化或前沿探索）。在具身推理和探索基准上，该方法提升了成功率和效率，验证了结构化场景表示与针对性信息收集的有效性。
Motivation: 机器人在复杂陌生环境中需要自主探索以获取任务所需信息，但现有方法在场景表示、检索和探索之间缺乏紧密耦合，导致信息收集效率低下。
Method: 提出ObsGraph，构建层次场景图（房间→视角→对象）；在有限预算下进行粗到细的层次检索；根据检索结果结构化探索候选空间，包括房间级探索、视角细化或前沿探索，实现表示、检索与探索的自适应耦合。
Result: 在具身推理和探索基准上，ObsGraph提升了任务成功率和效率，表明结构化场景表示和基于证据缺口的针对性信息收集有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将场景表示、检索和探索紧密耦合，并利用检索结果驱动自适应多尺度探索，能够带来性能提升。

papers.title: Beyond Trajectory Imitation: Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Distilling reasoning capabilities from strong to weak language models typically involves imitating specific solution trajectories, effectively transferring what to answer rather than how to reason. This trajectory-level imitation encourages memorization of instance-specific steps rather than acquisition of transferable problem-solving skills, limiting generalization to novel problems. We propose Strategy-Guided Policy Optimization (SGPO), which replaces instance-level trajectory imitation with reusable strategy distillation. SGPO extracts structured strategy descriptions from strong-model responses and, for each problem, constructs both autonomous and strategy-guided trajectories to enable direct comparison of the model's behavior with and without strategic guidance. The framework then addresses two key questions. For how to distill, a token-level forward-KL objective selectively transfers the distributional shift induced by strategy conditioning into the unguided policy, with proximal constraints ensuring stability. For when to distill, adaptive instance-level weighting strengthens guidance when autonomous exploration falls short and reduces it as the model's own competence grows. Experiments on four mathematical benchmarks across two model families show that SGPO consistently outperforms SFT, on-policy RL, and hybrid-policy baselines, improving the average score by 2.2 points over the strongest baseline on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Analysis reveals that the forward-KL objective provides an inherently selective distillation signal that outperforms direct trajectory imitation, and that strategy distillation exhibits complementary scaling with base model capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出策略引导策略优化（SGPO），用可复用策略蒸馏替代轨迹级模仿，通过前向KL散度有选择地转移策略条件分布，并自适应调整实例级权重。在四个数学基准上，SGPO在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上比最强基线平均提升2.2分。
Motivation: 现有推理能力蒸馏方法通常模仿特定解轨迹，鼓励记忆而非可迁移的问题解决技能，限制了向新问题的泛化。
Method: 从强模型响应中提取结构化策略描述，为每个问题构建自主轨迹和策略引导轨迹，通过前向KL散度有选择地转移策略条件分布，并用自适应实例级权重调整蒸馏强度。
Result: 在四个数学基准上，SGPO一致优于SFT、在策略RL和混合策略基线，在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上平均提升2.2分。前向KL散度提供选择性蒸馏信号，优于直接轨迹模仿。
Conclusion: 策略蒸馏与基础模型能力呈现互补缩放特性，该框架可替代传统轨迹级蒸馏。

summary_sections.method: 从强模型响应中提取结构化策略描述，为每个问题构建自主轨迹和策略引导轨迹，通过前向KL散度有选择地转移策略条件分布，并用自适应实例级权重调整蒸馏强度。
summary_sections.result: 在四个数学基准上，SGPO一致优于SFT、在策略RL和混合策略基线，在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上平均提升2.2分。前向KL散度提供选择性蒸馏信号，优于直接轨迹模仿。
summary_sections.conclusion: 策略蒸馏与基础模型能力呈现互补缩放特性，该框架可替代传统轨迹级蒸馏。

papers.title: Selective Capability Unlearning in End-to-End Spoken Language Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Modern spoken language understanding (SLU) systems are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, where specific functionalities may need to be removed due to policy or safety constraints. In SLU, a functionality corresponds to an intent and its associated slot-generation behavior. However, in autoregressive models, suppressing a target intent does not eliminate the conditional mapping that generates slots conditioned on that intent. When the intent prefix is externally supplied, the model can reconstruct the original intent-slot structure. We identify this structural failure as \textbf{\emph{capability persistence}}. We propose \textit{\underline{B}inding \underline{S}ubspace (BSU)}, a representation-level framework that isolates and attenuates intent-conditioned directions underlying this mapping. Across SLU benchmarks, BSU substantially reduces forced-prefix recoverability while preserving retained performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨口语理解（SLU）系统中选择性能力遗忘的问题。作者发现，在自回归模型中，抑制目标意图（intent）并不会消除与该意图相关的槽（slot）生成的条件映射，即使用户意图前缀被外部提供，模型仍可重建原始意图-槽结构，这种结构失效被称为能力持久性（capability persistence）。为此，提出绑定子空间（BSU）方法，在表示层面隔离并削弱意图条件的映射方向。在SLU基准上，BSU显著降低了强制前缀的可恢复性，同时保留了保留性能。
Motivation: 现有的SLU系统在需要删除特定功能（如某意图及其槽生成行为）时，直接抑制意图无法完全消除功能，导致安全或策略约束下模型仍可能泄漏或重建原始意图-槽结构，因此需要更精确的遗忘机制。
Method: 提出绑定子空间（BSU），一种表示级框架，通过识别并削弱与意图条件相关的表示方向，隔离并衰减意图-槽映射路径，仅在表示层面操作而不修改模型参数或外部前缀。
Result: 在多个SLU基准测试上，BSU方法在保持原任务性能的同时，大幅降低了强制前缀攻击下的意图-槽可恢复性，证明了其有效解决了能力持久性问题。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了SLU中能力持久性这一结构缺陷，并提出BSU作为解决选择性遗忘的有效框架，为端到端SLU系统在安全约束下的部署提供了思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RAVEN: A Regime-Aware Variable-context Expert Network for Financial Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Financial time series forecasting presents structural challenges absent from standard benchmarks. Log-returns are non-stationary, exhibit exceptionally low signal-to-noise (SNR) ratios, and are governed by regime-dependent temporal dependencies. We identify a key limitation of state-of-the-art (SOTA) time series models in financial settings. A fixed context window is mismatched to the time-varying optimal look-back of non-stationary price processes. We propose the Regime-Aware Variable-context Expert Network (RAVEN), a Mixture-of-Experts framework designed to adaptively determine the temporal context for each input sample. Instead of relying on a fixed look-back horizon, RAVEN constructs a hierarchy of nested contiguous windows whose lengths are determined by the data itself. Specifically, RAVEN scores patches by learned importance in reverse chronological order and applies the Cumulative Importance Thresholding (CIT) mechanism to derive nested prefix windows, each routed to a scale-specialized expert. A Global Compressed Representation (GCR) branch runs in parallel over the full context, preserving global temporal coherence that local experts cannot guarantee. Because the nested routing induces structured overlap among expert inputs, we introduce a Correlation-Aware Weighting (CAW) to align variable-length expert outputs and penalize pairwise cosine similarity prior to aggregation. Experiments on cumulative log-return prediction (HS300, S&P500) and fund sales forecasting demonstrate that RAVEN achieves SOTA performances, improves Pearson correlation by 9.2% on HS300 and 20.2% on S&P500, and reduces MSE by 18.2% on fund sales forecasting, while achieving the best results in 14 of 16 metrics on four PEMS traffic benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融时间序列的非平稳性、低信噪比以及时变依赖性问题，提出RAVEN框架，利用混合专家网络（MoE）自适应地为每个样本选择最优时间上下文。具体通过累计重要性阈值机制（CIT）构建嵌套窗口，每个窗口由尺度专用专家处理，并引入全局压缩表示分支保持时间一致性，最后用相关性感知加权（CAW）聚合专家输出。在股票指数预测和基金销售预测上取得SOTA结果。
Motivation: 现有时间序列模型在金融领域中因使用固定上下文窗口，无法适应非平稳价格过程的时变最优回溯长度，导致预测性能受限。
Method: 提出RAVEN框架，包含：（1）按反时间顺序对patch进行重要性评分，通过CIT构建嵌套前缀窗口；（2）每个窗口路由到尺度专用专家；（3）全局压缩表示分支保持全局时间连贯性；（4）相关性感知加权（CAW）对齐变长专家输出并惩罚冗余。
Result: 在HS300和S&P500上Pearson相关系数分别提升9.2%和20.2%，基金销售预测MSE降低18.2%，在4个PEMS交通基准的16个指标中取得14个最优。
Conclusion: RAVEN通过自适应上下文选择和专家网络，有效提升了金融时间序列预测性能，且能泛化到交通等非金融时间序列数据。

papers.title: Ingredient-Level Food Image Segmentation for Nutrition Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Food images often contain several visible ingredients, so assigning one dish label to an entire image hides important visual structure. This work studies ingredient-level semantic segmentation on FoodSeg103, where the model predicts an ingredient class for each pixel. Two SegFormer variants were fine-tuned and evaluated under a controlled setup: SegFormer-B0 as the smaller baseline model and SegFormer-B1 as the larger final model. Both models use ImageNet-pretrained MiT backbones with newly initialized 104-class output layers. On the held-out FoodSeg103 test split of 2,135 images, B0 achieved 0.7709 pixel accuracy and 0.2521 mean IoU, while B1 achieved 0.7929 pixel accuracy and 0.3204 mean IoU. B1 improved every saved test metric, including a +0.0683 absolute gain in mean IoU. The system also converts predicted masks into visible ingredient-area percentages, giving a simple visual composition summary of the predicted meal. This summary can serve as a first-pass nutrition-awareness cue by providing a visual alternative to detailed food tracking similar to plate-based meal guidance, but it is not a direct estimate of calories, macronutrients, food mass, volume, density, or true portion size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该工作研究食品图像中的成分级语义分割（ingredient-level semantic segmentation），在FoodSeg103数据集上微调SegFormer-B0和SegFormer-B1模型。B1模型在保留测试集上达到0.7929像素精度和0.3204平均IoU，比B0提升0.0683平均IoU。系统将预测掩码转换为可见成分面积百分比，作为营养意识的粗略视觉提示，但并非直接的热量或营养素估计。
Motivation: 食品图像中常包含多种可见成分，仅给整张图像分配一个菜品标签会丢失重要的视觉结构，因此需要像素级的成分分割以提供更细粒度的信息。
Method: 使用两个SegFormer变体（B0和B1），均采用ImageNet预训练的MiT骨干网络和新建的104类输出层，在FoodSeg103数据集上进行微调和评估。
Result: 在包含2,135张图像的FoodSeg103测试集上，B0的像素精度为0.7709，平均IoU为0.2521；B1的像素精度为0.7929，平均IoU为0.3204，所有指标均有提升，平均IoU绝对增益0.0683。
Conclusion: 成分级分割可提供可见成分面积百分比，作为营养意识的视觉提示，但该方法不等同于直接的热量、宏观营养素或份量估算，需注意其局限性。

papers.title: VisChronos: Revolutionizing Image Captioning Through Real-Life Events
papers.abstract_en: This paper aims to bridge the semantic gap between visual content and natural language understanding by leveraging historical events in the real world as a source of knowledge for caption generation. We propose VisChronos, a novel framework that utilizes large language models and dense captioning models to identify and describe real-life events from a single input image. Our framework can automatically generate detailed and context-aware event descriptions, enhancing the descriptive quality and contextual relevance of generated captions to address the limitations of traditional methods in capturing contextual narratives. Furthermore, we introduce a new dataset, EventCap (https://zenodo.org/records/14004909), specifically constructed using the proposed framework, designed to enhance the model's ability to identify and understand complex events. The user study demonstrates the efficacy of our solution in generating accurate, coherent, and event-focused descriptions, paving the way for future research in event-centric image understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VisChronos框架，利用大语言模型和密集描述模型从单张图像中识别并描述真实世界事件，生成上下文感知的事件描述。同时构建了EventCap数据集以增强对复杂事件的识别能力，用户研究显示该方法能生成准确、连贯且聚焦事件的描述。
Motivation: 传统图像描述方法在捕捉上下文叙事方面存在局限，难以弥合视觉内容与自然语言理解之间的语义鸿沟，尤其缺乏对真实世界事件的理解和描述。
Method: 提出VisChronos框架，结合大语言模型和密集描述模型，从输入图像中自动识别和描述真实事件；并基于该框架构建EventCap数据集。
Result: 用户研究证实生成的描述在准确性、连贯性和事件聚焦方面优于传统方法，为事件中心图像理解奠定基础。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了利用历史事件知识提升图像描述质量的有效性，但需要进一步扩展事件类型和评估泛化能力。

papers.title: EPEdit: Redefining Image Editing with Generative AI and User-Centric Design
papers.abstract_en: The demand for image manipulation has seen a significant increase recently. Traditional tools like Photoshop and Capture One, while powerful, require considerable expertise to use effectively. Generative AI has introduced alternative platforms, such as Luminar Neo, Pixlr X, and Canva. However, many of these solutions, including resource-heavy models like Stable Diffusion, often require substantial retraining and fine-tuning, leading to high costs for users. To address these challenges, we introduce Efficient Photo Editor (EPEdit), an application that integrates a robust backend framework with a user-friendly front-end interface. EPEdit supports a wide range of creative image editing tasks, including image generation, object replacement, object removal, background modification, changes in object pose or perspective, region-specific editing, and thematic collection design, all guided by masks and prompts. Users can interact with the system through simple text commands or by marking areas for precise adjustments, making it accessible even to those without technical expertise. At its core, EPEdit leverages zero-shot image editing algorithms based on Stable Diffusion model, removing the need for additional fine-tuning. This approach enables efficient image manipulation and thematic collection creation. User evaluations for tasks of image editing, thematic design, and overall system performance demonstrate that EPEdit outperforms existing solutions, offering a user-friendly, cost-effective solution for comprehensive image editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EPEdit，一个集成了生成式AI的图像编辑应用，利用基于Stable Diffusion的零样本算法，支持对象替换、移除、背景修改等任务，无需用户微调。用户评估显示其在图像编辑、主题设计等方面优于现有方案。
Motivation: 传统图像编辑工具需要专业知识，而现有生成式AI方案如Stable Diffusion需要大量重训练和微调，成本高昂。EPEdit旨在提供一种用户友好、成本效益高的图像编辑工具。
Method: EPEdit结合了稳健的后端框架和用户友好的前端界面，核心采用基于Stable Diffusion的零样本图像编辑算法，通过掩码和提示词引导编辑，无需额外微调。
Result: 用户评估表明，EPEdit在图像编辑、主题设计和系统整体性能上均优于现有解决方案，提供了用户友好且成本效益高的全面图像编辑能力。
Conclusion: EPEdit通过零样本方法降低了使用门槛和计算成本，为广泛用户提供了高效的图像编辑方案。

papers.title: DriveStack-VLA: Render-Teacher Alignment for BEV-Based DeepStack Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action driving models convert a pretrained Vision-Language Model into a driving policy, allowing them to use world knowledge and follow language guidances. However, existing VLA driving models still lack driving-oriented spatial intelligence: their policies are mainly grounded on perspective image tokens and language priors, while precise motion planning requires metric geometry, top-down scene structure, and attention to safety-critical perceptual cues. This limitation makes current models vulnerable to weak visual geometry modeling and perceptual coverage in expert demonstrations. In this paper, we present DriveStack-VLA, a framework built upon a large VLM backbone. To strengthen the spatial grounding of VLA driving, we develop dual visual modeling components. We inject a Bird-Eye-View representation into the Large Language Model decoder through a DeepStack-style connection, and propose Render-Teacher Alignment to align the perceptual focus of real images with that of rasterized images. Furthermore, to bridge the gap in multimodal trajectory selection, we introduce a head-based self-critique module that ranks sampled trajectories and conditionally refines the best one. DriveStack-VLA achieves 91.6 PDMS on NAVSIMv1, 91.0 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2 (with the human penalty filter enabled), and a driving score of 79.49 with a success rate of 56.36\% on the closed-loop Bench2Drive. More visualizations are available on our project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/drivestack-vla/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DriveStack-VLA，一种基于大型 VLM 的自动驾驶框架。通过双视觉建模组件——将 Bird-Eye-View 表示注入 LLM 解码器（DeepStack 式连接）以及 Render-Teacher Alignment 对齐真实图像与光栅化图像的感知焦点——增强空间接地。此外，引入基于头的自批判模块对采样轨迹排序并条件性优化最佳轨迹。在 NAVSIMv1 上取得 91.6 PDMS，NAVSIMv2 上 91.0 EPDMS，闭环 Bench2Drive 上驾驶分数 79.49、成功率 56.36%。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 驾驶模型缺乏驾驶导向的空间智能：其策略主要基于透视图像标记和语言先验，而精确运动规划需要度量几何、自上而下场景结构以及对安全关键感知线索的关注，导致在专家演示中弱视觉几何建模和感知覆盖。
Method: 开发双视觉建模组件：通过 DeepStack 式连接将 BEV 表示注入 LLM 解码器；提出 Render-Teacher Alignment 使真实图像与光栅化图像的感知焦点对齐。同时引入基于头的自批判模块，对采样的轨迹进行排序并条件性优化最佳轨迹。
Result: DriveStack-VLA 在 NAVSIMv1 上达到 91.6 PDMS，NAVSIMv2 上达到 91.0 EPDMS（启用人类惩罚过滤器），在闭环 Bench2Drive 上驾驶分数 79.49，成功率 56.36%。
Conclusion: 该方法通过注入 BEV 表示和对齐感知焦点，显著增强了 VLA 驾驶模型的空间接地，并在多个基准上实现了高驾驶性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ensemble Feature Selection and Harris Hawks Optimization for Explainable Mental Health Risk Prediction in Female Sex Workers
papers.abstract_en: One of the significant mental health issues affecting female sex workers (FSWs) is mental disorders, especially depression. Exposure to violence, stigma, and economic hardship further increases their psychological risk. Current machine learning (ML) models are typically ineffective at capturing the high-dimensional and complex risk patterns that exist in this marginalized group. This paper suggests a hybrid predictive model that merges an ensemble feature selection strategy using ANOVA and mutual information and Harris Hawks optimization-tuned logistic regression and represents a new application of swarm intelligence to predict mental health in vulnerable groups. The explainable AI (XAI) methods can be used to understand the factors of trauma associated with model predictions. When applied to a group of 3,005 FSWs, it can be seen that the proposed model is more effective than traditional classifiers, with an accuracy of 95.78%, an F1 score of 95.77%, and an AUC of 0.96, and identifying post-traumatic stress, client-related violence, and occupational factors as major contributors to depression. This work bridges the gaps between conventional and ML approaches to develop an XAI tool that enables vulnerable groups to receive early assistance, evidence-based targeted psychosocial care, and health planning.
papers.comment: Accepted and presented at the 2026 8th IEEE Symposium on Computers & Informatics (ISCI 2026). To appear in IEEE conference proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对女性性工作者（FSWs）的心理健康预测问题，提出一种结合ANOVA和互信息的集成特征选择策略与Harris Hawks优化调整的Logistic回归的混合预测模型，并应用可解释AI（XAI）方法识别关键风险因素。在3005名FSWs的数据集上，模型准确率达95.78%，F1分数95.77%，AUC 0.96，发现创伤后应激、客户相关暴力和职业因素是抑郁的主要贡献因素。
Motivation: 现有机器学习模型在捕捉女性性工作者这一边缘群体的高维复杂心理风险模式方面效果不足，且缺乏可解释性，导致早期干预困难。
Method: 提出混合预测模型：采用ANOVA和互信息进行集成特征选择，使用Harris Hawks优化算法调优Logistic回归模型，并结合可解释AI方法（如SHAP）解释预测因素。
Result: 在3005名FSWs数据集上，模型准确率95.78%，F1分数95.77%，AUC 0.96，优于传统分类器；识别的关键风险因素包括创伤后应激、客户相关暴力和职业因素。
Conclusion: 该工作弥合了传统方法与机器学习之间的差距，开发了一个可解释AI工具，有助于为弱势群体提供早期、基于证据的心理健康关怀和健康规划。

papers.title: Rapid FinFET Modelling Using an Autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a machine learning framework that leverages an autoencoder (AE) for the efficient modeling of FinFET. We first calibrated a BSIM-CMG model to generate a dataset of current-voltage (ID-VG) characteristics. This data was used to train an autoencoder that compresses full I-V curves into a low-dimensional latent space, which intrinsically encodes key device physics. A key innovation is the explicit incorporation of parameter such as drain to source voltage (VDS) as an input feature, enhancing the model ability to capture bias dependent variation. The trained model successfully reconstructs full I-V curves and directly extracts critical device metrics including threshold voltage (VTH), subthreshold slope (SS), and peak transconductance (gm). This approach demonstrates that data driven compact models, built from actual characterization data, can achieve high accuracy with minimal training data, providing a powerful tool for rapid device characterization, modelling and circuit level simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于自编码器（autoencoder）的机器学习框架，用于FinFET器件的快速建模。首先校准BSIM-CMG模型生成I-V曲线数据集，训练自编码器将完整I-V曲线压缩到低维潜空间，并显式将漏源电压（VDS）作为输入特征以捕捉偏置依赖性。训练后的模型能重建完整I-V曲线并直接提取阈值电压（VTH）、亚阈值斜率（SS）和峰值跨导（gm）等关键参数，表明基于实际表征数据的数据驱动紧凑模型可在少量训练数据下实现高精度。
Motivation: 传统FinFET紧凑建模依赖于物理模型校准，过程耗时且需要大量专家知识。本文旨在开发一种数据驱动的快速建模方法，利用自编码器从实际测量或仿真数据中自动学习器件特性，减少对物理模型的依赖。
Method: 采用自编码器架构，输入为FinFET的I-V曲线（ID-VG），通过编码器压缩为低维潜变量，解码器重建曲线。创新之处在于将漏源电压（VDS）显式作为输入特征，增强模型对不同偏置条件的泛化能力。训练数据由校准后的BSIM-CMG模型生成。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但声称该方法能以最少训练数据实现高精度重建，并能准确提取VTH、SS和gm等关键器件参数。
Conclusion: 本文证明了自编码器可用于FinFET的快速紧凑建模，为器件表征和电路级仿真提供了一种高效的数据驱动工具，但未提及在真实测量数据上的验证或与传统方法的定量对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Breaking the Filter Bubble: A Semantic Pareto-DQN Framework for Multi-Objective Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems often induce filter bubbles and semantic homogenization by monolithically optimizing for immediate user engagement. Standard single-objective models, including traditional Deep Q-Networks, are ill-equipped to navigate the trade-offs between platform retention and critical societal values like information diversity and provider fairness. To address these limitations, we introduce a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that formalizes recommendation as a semantic multi-objective Markov decision process. By integrating high-fidelity semantic embeddings with a Pareto-DQN agent, our architecture treats engagement, diversity, and fairness as distinct, non-aggregable reward signals, avoiding the pitfalls of static reward scalarization. Empirical evaluations on the MovieLens small dataset shows that our hypervolume based action selection disrupts the feedback loops responsible for semantic collapse. By sustaining high state-trajectory variance, the Pareto-DQN effectively maps the Pareto frontier, achieving gains in auxiliary societal objectives with only marginal impacts on engagement. This work provides a path toward intrinsically aligned, responsible recommender systems.
papers.comment: IEEE International Conference on Responsible Artificial Intelligence (IRAI) - 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于语义Pareto-DQN的多目标强化学习框架，将推荐系统建模为语义多目标马尔可夫决策过程，通过高保真语义嵌入和Pareto-DQN智能体，将用户参与度、信息多样性和提供者公平性作为独立奖励信号，避免静态奖励标量化的缺陷。在MovieLens小数据集上的实验表明，基于超体积的动作选择能够打破语义崩溃的反馈循环，维持高状态轨迹方差，有效映射Pareto前沿，在提升社会目标的同时仅对参与度产生轻微影响。
Motivation: 现有推荐系统通常单一优化用户即时参与度，导致过滤气泡和语义同质化，而传统DQN等单目标模型难以权衡平台留存与信息多样性、公平性等社会价值。
Method: 提出多目标强化学习框架，将推荐形式化为语义多目标马尔可夫决策过程，结合高保真语义嵌入与Pareto-DQN智能体，将参与度、多样性和公平性作为不可聚合的独立奖励信号，采用基于超体积的动作选择来探索Pareto前沿。
Result: 在MovieLens小数据集上，该方法通过基于超体积的动作选择打破了语义崩溃的反馈循环，维持高状态轨迹方差，有效映射Pareto前沿，在辅助社会目标上获得增益而对参与度影响甚微。
Conclusion: 该工作为构建内在对齐的负责任推荐系统提供了一条可行路径。

papers.title: Towards Version-aware Operations and Transaction Memories for Multi-layer MeMo
papers.abstract_en: MeMo proposes language models with explicit multi-layer correlation matrix memories (CMMs), where memorization, retrieval, and forgetting are architectural operations. This paper asks how such memories can reduce the need for retraining when knowledge changes. For changes expressible as MeMo memory associations, the model's accessible knowledge can be updated by editing explicit memories rather than retraining the whole model. We propose a version-aware operation layer in which high-level operations such as replace, obsolete, keep-history, rollback, and trace are compiled into MeMo-native primitive calls over sequences and tokens. The key observation is that a version-aware operation is rarely a single MeMo association. It is an ordered transaction of primitive edits, for example forgetting one sequence-token chain, memorizing another, preserving a historical chain, and recording an inverse program. The framework introduces two auxiliary CMMs: a Version CMM (V-CMM) for mapping version transitions to transaction handles, and a Transaction CMM (T-CMM) for storing reusable change contents and inverse programs. It supports both direct sequence-level edits and structured diff-level inputs, and outlines an evaluation route for update success, rollback, traceability, locality, and transaction reuse.
papers.comment: Accepted by MeMo Workshop on Mechanistic Interpretability & Neuro-symbolic Approaches by-design, Rome (Italy), 24/6/2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出为多层级关联记忆模型（MeMo）设计版本感知操作层，通过编译高层操作（如替换、废弃、保留历史、回滚、追踪）为MeMo原生原语调用，支持对显式记忆的编辑而非重新训练模型。引入版本CMM和事务CMM来管理版本转换和可复用变更内容，支持序列级和diff级输入，并规划了更新成功、回滚、可追溯性、局部性和事务复用等评估路径。
Motivation: 当知识发生变化时，重新训练整个语言模型成本高昂。本文探索如何利用MeMo的显式关联记忆矩阵通过编辑操作来更新知识，减少重训练需求。
Method: 提出版本感知操作层，将替换、废弃、保留历史、回滚、追踪等高层操作编译为MeMo原语调用序列，并引入版本CMM（V-CMM）和事务CMM（T-CMM）两个辅助记忆矩阵来管理版本转换和事务内容。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅概述了框架设计和支持的操作类型，并规划了评估方向（更新成功、回滚、可追溯性、局部性、事务复用）。
Conclusion: 通过版本感知操作和事务记忆，MeMo模型可以在不重新训练的条件下编辑显式记忆，支持知识更新与回滚，未来可评估其效率与局部性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoPE-Aware Bit Allocation for KV-Cache Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Existing low-bit KV-cache quantizers often treat each cached key as a flat vector. Under RoPE, however, a key's contribution to a future attention logit decomposes into a position-dependent sum over two-dimensional frequency blocks. This makes key-cache quantization a block-wise bit-allocation problem: high-energy RoPE blocks are more sensitive to quantization error and should receive more bits. We introduce Block-GTQ, a RoPE-aware bit allocator for key-cache quantization built on TurboQuant-MSE(TQ-MSE). For each layer and KV head, Block-GTQ computes a label-free energy score for each RoPE block and greedily allocates integer bit widths by marginal gain. Under matched K/V bit budgets, Block-GTQ better preserves RoPE query-key logits on a ten-model diagnostic panel, cutting per-layer MAE by 32-80% at 2 and 3 b/dim K-only quantization and winning all 367/367 layer comparisons against uniform TQ-MSE. These fidelity gains translate to stronger downstream long-context retrieval, understanding, and reasoning. At K2V2 on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Block-GTQ raises the six-task NIAH average from 70.6 to 97.4, and the LongBench-EN average from 36.87 to 53.31. On AIME 2024/2025 with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, without an fp16 recent-key buffer, Block-GTQ at K3V2 scores 51.7/37.5, close to fp16's 54.2/37.9, whereas uniform TQ-MSE collapses to 0.0/0.0. We further implement a packed-cache serving path. papers.title: Can Language Model Agents be Helpful Circuit Explainers in Mechanistic Interpretability?
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability has made substantial progress in automatically localizing circuits, but explaining what localized components do remains labor-intensive and difficult to standardize. In this work, we study whether language model (LM) agents can assist with this explanation problem once a circuit has already been identified. We introduce AgenticInterpBench, a benchmark for circuit explanation built from 84 semi-synthetic transformer circuits with 163 component-level annotations. We propose HyVE (Hypothesize, Validate, Explain), an agentic explainer that analyzes each component through an iterative loop of observation, hypothesis generation, and causal validation, eventually producing a component-level explanation and a circuit-level task description. Across four LM backbones, HyVE recovers useful component- and task-level explanations, but no backbone is uniformly best. Our analysis shows that strong backbones usually form observation-grounded hypotheses, while failures more often arise later in the validation loop, through incomplete validation plans, code execution errors, or unresolved hypotheses. A case study on an arithmetic circuit in Llama-3-8B shows that the same formulation can extend beyond semi-synthetic benchmarks to naturally trained models. Overall, LM agents are promising circuit explainers, but reliable validation remains the key obstacle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型（LM）代理在机械可解释性中协助解释已定位电路的能力。作者构建了包含84个半合成变压器电路和163个组件级注释的基准AgenticInterpBench，并提出HyVE（假设、验证、解释）方法，通过迭代观察、假设生成和因果验证来生成组件级和电路级解释。实验表明，强LM骨干通常能形成基于观察的假设，但失败多发生在验证阶段。案例研究将方法扩展到Llama-3-8B的自然训练电路。
Motivation: 机械可解释性已能自动定位电路，但解释这些组件的功能仍依赖人工且难以标准化。
Method: 提出HyVE框架，通过迭代循环进行观察、假设生成和因果验证，最终生成组件级解释和电路级任务描述。
Result: 在AgenticInterpBench上，HyVE恢复有用的组件和任务级解释，但没有一个LM骨干在所有指标上最优；失败主要由验证不完整、代码执行错误或未解决假设导致。
Conclusion: LM代理有潜力作为电路解释器，但可靠验证仍是关键障碍。

papers.title: Information-Theoretic Classifier-Free Guidance with Adaptive Schedule Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved strong performance in image, text-to-image, and video generation, where conditional generation is often controlled by classifier-free guidance (CFG). CFG improves condition consistency by increasing a guidance weight, but stronger guidance typically reduces diversity and distributional coverage. It remains unclear how this consistency-coverage trade-off should be controlled across the reverse trajectory, since the distribution induced by CFG is not simply the fixed-time tilted distribution given by the guided score field. To address this issue, we propose an information-theoretic framework for CFG schedule optimization. Our approach uses a clean endpoint reference to specify the desired consistency-coverage trade-off, while optimizing the actual distribution induced by the guided sampler toward this reference. We derive trajectory-level formulas to estimate the objective from samples and score evaluations, avoiding explicit density estimation. On ImageNet-512 with EDM-XXL and COCO with SD-XL, the learned schedules achieve competitive or improved trade-offs over constant guidance and allocate guidance selectively across noise levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型中无分类器引导（CFG）导致的生成一致性与多样性权衡问题，提出一种信息论框架来优化引导调度。该方法通过干净的端点参考指定期望的权衡，并优化实际采样分布逼近该参考，避免显式密度估计。在ImageNet-512和COCO数据集上，学习到的调度相比恒定引导实现了更优的权衡，并自适应地分配不同噪声水平的引导强度。
Motivation: CFG引导权重增强条件一致性但降低多样性，且CFG诱导的分布并非简单的时间倾斜分布，导致一致性与多样性权衡难以控制。
Method: 提出基于信息论的CFG调度优化框架，利用干净的端点参考指定期望权衡，从样本和得分评估中估计轨迹级目标，避免显式密度估计。
Result: 在ImageNet-512（EDM-XXL）和COCO（SD-XL）上，学习到的调度在一致性与多样性权衡上优于恒定引导，且能自适应分配引导强度。
Conclusion: 学习调度可更有效地平衡一致性与多样性，作者认为该方法具有通用性，但主要验证在图像生成任务上。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quantum ring all-reduce: communication and privacy advantages for distributed learning
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models have scaled to unprecedented sizes, making training across distributed devices the de facto standard in the field. In this work, we explore how quantum communications can make distributed training both more communication-efficient and information-theoretically private, for both classical and quantum learning models. Ring all-reduce is the foundational communication primitive for large-scale distributed training. We present a quantum version that reduces per-link online communication by a provably optimal factor of two using pre-shared entanglement and superdense coding, without requiring the learning model or gradient computation to change. Beyond bandwidth, the primitive enables privacy guarantees that are information-theoretically impossible for any classical protocol, achieving composable ε-secure aggregation, via verified entanglement, at a 2x overhead in GHZ copies. Our hybrid quantum-classical communication architecture yields simultaneous communication and security advantages for large scale distributed training, regardless of whether the learning itself is quantum or classical. Finally, we characterise quantum advantages in gradient conflict detection for server-to-client communication under bandwidth constraints, a setting that arises after ring all-reduce is completed, when full gradient broadcast to external clients is infeasible. Two variants of the problem admit different separations. For margin-based alignment testing (\textsc{GapIP}_τ), the quantum advantage is quadratic in the margin parameter: \widetilde{O}(τ^{-1}\log P) qubits versus \widetilde{O}(\min(\τ^{-2},P)) bits. For sign-consistency auditing against a private parameter matching (\textsc{TieAudit}_ε), the advantage represents an exponential separation in communication complexity: Ω(\sqrt{P}) bits whereas O(ε^{-2}\log P) qubits suffice.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 1 figure / v2: Minor expository corrections; results unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子环 all-reduce（quantum ring all-reduce）协议，利用预共享纠缠和超密编码（superdense coding）将分布式训练中每链接的在线通信量减少到最优的二分之一的因子，并实现经典协议无法达到的信息论隐私保证，即可组合的 ε-安全聚合。此外，针对带宽受限下服务器到客户端的梯度冲突检测，本文证明了在间距对齐测试（GapIP_τ）中量子优势是二次的（qubits 对 bits），在符号一致性审计（TieAudit_ε）中量子优势是指数分离的。该混合量子-经典通信架构无论学习模型本身是量子还是经典，都能同时提升通信效率和隐私安全性。
Motivation: 大规模分布式训练中，通信效率与隐私保护之间存在根本矛盾：经典 ring all-reduce 无法在保持通信最优的同时提供信息论隐私。
Method: 提出了量子版本的 ring all-reduce，使用预共享纠缠态和超密编码实现每链接通信量减少一半；通过验证纠缠实现可组合 ε-安全聚合；并针对梯度冲突检测的两个变体设计了量子协议。
Result: 通信效率提升因子 2 是理论上最优的；隐私保障是信息论安全的，经典协议无法实现；在 GapIP_τ 测试中量子优势为二次（Õ(τ⁻¹ log P) qubits vs Õ(min(τ⁻², P)) bits），在 TieAudit_ε 测试中量子优势为指数分离（Ω(√P) bits vs O(ε⁻² log P) qubits）。
Conclusion: 混合量子-经典通信架构能够在分布式训练中同时获得通信和安全性优势，适用于经典和量子学习模型，且梯度冲突检测中的量子优势具有显著的分离特性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cross-Dataset, Age, and Gender Generalization: A Comprehensive Analysis of Fine-Tuning Strategies for Low-Resource Children's ASR
papers.abstract_en: The challenge associated with recognizing dysarthric speech primarily arises from pronounced acoustic variability attributed to impaired articulatory precision. Past research has demonstrated improved recognition through the use of hybrid DNN/HMM sequence discriminative training. This paper presents a comprehensive investigation of various combinations of acoustic features tailored to different Acoustic Models, offering suitable feature selections for each. The incorporation of Pitch features notably improved recognition performance, especially for sentence recognition tasks involving dysarthric speech. Through a systematic examination of the TORGO database, we have demonstrated the potential to enhance the performance of the state-of-the-art Factorized Time Delay Neural Network (F-TDNN) model for recognizing dysarthric speech. Our methods, implemented with the F-TDNN model, resulted in a 4.65\% relative improvement in isolated word recognition and a 4.63\% relative improvement in sentence recognition for dysarthric speech, compared to previous research. This improvement effectively compensates for speech variability, attributable to our deliberate selection of the number of overlapping frames between consecutive training example chunks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对构音障碍语音识别中的声学变异问题，系统研究了多种声学特征与不同声学模型的组合。在TORGO数据库上，通过使用F-TDNN模型并精心选择重叠帧数，孤立词识别相对提升4.65%，句子识别相对提升4.63%。
Motivation: 构音障碍语音因发音精度受损导致声学变异大，现有模型识别性能有限，需要有效的特征和模型组合来改善识别。
Method: 提出一种综合的声学特征选择方法，结合F-TDNN模型，并通过调整训练样本块间的重叠帧数来补偿语音变异。
Result: 在TORGO数据库上，使用F-TDNN模型，孤立词识别和句子识别分别获得4.65%和4.63%的相对提升。
Conclusion: 通过精心选择重叠帧数，可以有效地补偿构音障碍语音的声学变异，提升模型识别性能。

papers.title: SEAGAN: domain-Specific and Edge-Aware Graph Attention Network for Dynamic Plant Processes
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) offer a flexible framework for learning from scientific data with physical, biological, or functional associations. One promising domain is plant physiology, where observed responses result from several interacting processes that are difficult to isolate, even with human intervention. A key example is the A-Ci curve, which relates the net CO2 assimilation rate (Anet) to leaf intercellular CO2 concentration (Ci) and is also used to estimate photosynthetic parameters in biophysical models. However, accurate estimation requires accurate identification of the active biochemical limiting state at each curve point, which is a major source of uncertainty. Here, we express the limitation-state identification in A-Ci curves as a graph-based node classification problem. A graph representation of the A-Ci curve is created using distance-based k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) and auxiliary-signal-guided (ASG) connectivity. The methodology was evaluated against the conventional machine learning baselines, graph-based architectures, and an automated fitting-based benchmark. Results on a large synthetic dataset with known ground-truth limitation states show that graph-based models improve classification, especially near biochemical transition areas. The top-performing configuration, SEAGAN (domain-Specific and Edge-Aware Graph Attention Network for Dynamic Plant Processes), integrates process-aware node features, edge attributes, kNN connectivity, and graph attention with a weighted cross-entropy loss, obtaining an F1-score of 0.857 and accuracy of 0.882. The results suggest that using A-Ci curves as graphs enables better identification of the biochemical limiting condition and reduces the uncertainty associated with both human and automated methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEAGAN，一种针对植物光合作用 A-Ci 曲线的图注意力网络，将限制状态识别建模为图节点分类问题。利用 kNN 和辅助信号引导的图连接，结合过程感知节点特征和边属性，在合成数据集上取得 F1 0.857 和准确率 0.882，优于传统机器学习及自动拟合方法。
Motivation: 植物光合作用中 A-Ci 曲线的限制状态识别是参数估计的主要不确定性来源，现有方法难以准确识别生化过渡区域。
Method: 构建 A-Ci 曲线的图表示，采用基于距离的 kNN 和辅助信号引导连接，设计融合过程感知节点特征与边属性的图注意力网络，并使用加权交叉熵损失。
Result: 在已知真实限制状态的大规模合成数据集上，SEAGAN 获得 F1-score 0.857 和准确率 0.882，在生化过渡区域分类表现优于传统机器学习和自动拟合基准。

papers.title: TimeLAVA: Learning-Agnostic Data Valuation for Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Data valuation quantifies the intrinsic quality of individual samples to enable principled data curation, quality control, and robust learning. For time series in critical domains such as healthcare, finance, and industrial monitoring, effective valuation methods are essential yet fundamentally lacking. Existing approaches are either model-dependent, limiting their generalizability, or designed for i.i.d. data and thus fail to capture temporal dependencies, multi-scale patterns, and non-stationary dynamics inherent to sequential data. We introduce TimeLAVA, a learning-agnostic framework that values temporal segments by their marginal contribution to minimizing distributional discrepancy between evaluated and reference data. At its core is a novel Selective Wavelet-based Wasserstein discrepancy combining multi-scale wavelet transforms for temporal localization with unbalanced optimal transport for robustness to distributional shifts. Segment values are efficiently computed via sensitivity analysis without requiring model training and aggregated into point-wise scores. We provide theoretical guarantees linking valuation to model-agnostic generalization and prove bounded sensitivity to outlier contamination. Extensive experiments across anomaly detection, data pruning, and label noise detection demonstrate that TimeLAVA produces significantly more informative value scores than existing methods on diverse real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TimeLAVA，一种学习无关的时间序列数据估值框架，通过评估时间片段对最小化分布差异的边际贡献来量化数据价值。核心是选择性小波Wasserstein差异，结合多尺度小波变换和失衡最优传输，无需模型训练即可计算点级得分。实验在异常检测、数据剪枝和标签噪声检测上展示了优于现有方法的性能。
Motivation: 现有数据估值方法要么依赖模型（泛化性差），要么针对i.i.d.数据设计，无法捕捉时间序列的时间依赖性、多尺度模式和非平稳动态。
Method: TimeLAVA框架通过敏感性分析计算时间片段对最小化评估数据与参考数据之间分布差异的边际贡献，使用选择性小波Wasserstein差异结合多尺度小波变换和失衡最优传输。
Result: 在异常检测、数据剪枝和标签噪声检测任务上，TimeLAVA在多个真实世界时间序列数据集上产生了比现有方法更具信息性的价值评分。
Conclusion: TimeLAVA提供理论保证连接估值与模型无关的泛化性，并证明对异常污染有界敏感性，但需要参考数据且计算复杂度可能受数据长度影响。

papers.title: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating generalist robot manipulation policies in the real world is expensive, slow, and difficult to scale. Action-conditioned video world models offer a scalable alternative by simulating policy rollouts. Autoregressive rollouts accumulate compounding errors, observations across multiple camera views must remain mutually consistent, and the evaluator must generalize to policies whose behaviors lie outside the training distribution. We address these challenges with SC3-Eval, a self-consistent video generation recipe that adapts a pre-trained video foundation model into an accurate policy evaluator by enforcing three complementary forms of consistency. First, forward-inverse dynamics consistency jointly trains the model to predict frames from actions and to recover actions from frames, anchoring generated rollouts to a physically plausible action manifold and counteracting the drift a forward-only model cannot penalize. Second, cross-view consistency trains the model to inpaint each camera view from the other, keeping the multi-camera observation coherent over long rollouts without any explicit memory mechanism. Third, test-time consistency reuses the inverse dynamics mode at inference as a per-action-chunk uncertainty signal that terminates rollouts whose generated frames drift away from the requested actions. We also demonstrate SC3-Eval rollouts reproduce the failure modes that policies exhibit in real-world rollouts, supporting fine-grained diagnostic comparison rather than aggregate ranking alone. Across seven real-world vision-language-action policies, SC3-Eval attains a closed-loop Pearson correlation of $0.929$ and MMRV of $0.119$, outperforming three strong prior video-model-based baselines, and generalizes to new tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SC3-Eval 是一种通过自一致视频生成来评估机器人基础模型的方法，利用前向-逆动力学一致性、跨视角一致性和测试时一致性来生成准确的策略 rollout，并复现真实世界中的失败模式。在七个真实世界视觉-语言-动作策略上，达到了 0.929 的闭环 Pearson 相关性和 0.119 的 MMRV，优于三个强基线方法。
Motivation: 真实世界中评估通用机器人操作策略成本高、速度慢且难以扩展，而基于动作条件的视频世界模型提供可扩展的替代方案，但面临自回归误差累积、多视角观察不一致以及评估器需要泛化到分布外策略的挑战。
Method: SC3-Eval 采用三种一致性约束：前向-逆动力学一致性联合训练模型预测帧和从帧恢复动作；跨视角一致性训练模型从其他视角补全每个相机视图；测试时一致性利用逆动力学模式提供不确定性信号，在生成帧偏离请求动作时终止 rollout。
Result: 在七个真实世界视觉-语言-动作策略上，SC3-Eval 达到闭环 Pearson 相关性 0.929 和 MMRV 0.119，优于三个基于视频模型的基线方法，并泛化到新任务。
Conclusion: SC3-Eval 通过强制多种一致性约束，使预训练视频基础模型成为准确的策略评估器，能够复现真实世界 rollout 中的失败模式，支持细粒度诊断比较。

papers.title: Data-Forcing Distillation: Restoring Diversity and Fidelity in Few-Step Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress has shown promise in distilling multi-step video diffusion models into efficient few-step students. Among them, Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) and its successor DMD2 achieved strong generation quality and fast convergence. However, due to the nature of the reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) objective, these methods exhibit two persistent failure modes: a substantial drop in sample diversity, and visibly over-saturated outputs that deviate from real-video appearance. In this work, we propose Data-Forcing Distillation (DFD), a simple post-training framework that restores diversity and fidelity in DMD with only a single-line of code change. At its core is the teacher score discrepancy to guide the student toward the real-data distribution, pulling it to missing modes (mitigating mode collapse) and away from problematic modes absent in real data (avoiding over-saturation). We provide an in-depth theoretical analysis of our framework and validate our approach on text-to-video, image-to-video, and autoregressive video generation. With only 100--300 steps of finetuning, DFD effectively restores diversity and fidelity on both Wan2.1-1.3B and Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B model, resolving the over-saturation artifacts with significantly better video dynamics and appearance, and even outperforms the teacher model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出数据强制蒸馏（DFD），一种简单的后训练框架，用于修复分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）在少步视频生成中的多样性下降和过饱和问题。DFD通过教师分数差异（teacher score discrepancy）引导学生模型逼近真实数据分布，仅需100-300步微调即可在Wan2.1-1.3B和Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B模型上恢复多样性和保真度，甚至超越教师模型。
Motivation: DMD等少步视频蒸馏方法因反向KL目标导致样本多样性大幅下降和输出过饱和，偏离真实视频外观。
Method: 提出DFD框架，核心是教师分数差异项，引导学生模型向真实数据分布缺失模式移动（缓解模式崩塌）并远离问题模式（避免过饱和），仅需单行代码修改和少量微调。
Result: 在文本到视频、图像到视频和自回归视频生成任务上，DFD经过100-300步微调有效恢复多样性和保真度，消除过饱和伪影，提升视频动态和外观，甚至超过教师模型。
Conclusion: DFD提供一种简单有效的后训练方案，可修复DMD类方法的固有缺陷，适用于多种视频生成架构。

papers.title: KANLib -- A Modular, Extensible and Fast Kolmogorov-Arnold Network Implementation
papers.abstract_en: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to traditional multilayer perceptrons by replacing linear weights with learnable univariate functions. Despite their theoretical advantages in interpretability and expressiveness, practical research of KANs remains difficult due to high computational costs and inconsistent feature support across existing frameworks. This paper introduces KANLib, a modular, extensible, and computationally efficient framework for developing and evaluating KAN architectures. KANLib unifies core concepts from existing implementations, including PyKAN, EfficientKAN, and FastKAN, within a consistent software architecture that emphasizes flexibility, feature parity, and high performance. The framework supports two basis function types, adaptive grid rescaling, grid extension, and fine-grained architectural customization while maintaining compatibility with standard PyTorch workflows. Experimental evaluation on the California Housing benchmark demonstrates that KANLib reproduces the predictive behavior of established reference KAN implementations while achieving competitive computational efficiency. Furthermore, the framework enables the exploration of architectural variations beyond standard KAN formulations with only minor impacts on predictive performance. Overall, KANLib provides a robust foundation for future research on scalable and extensible KAN architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍KANLib，一个模块化、可扩展且计算高效的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）实现框架。该框架统一了PyKAN、EfficientKAN和FastKAN等现有实现的核心概念，支持两种基函数类型、自适应网格重缩放、网格扩展和细粒度架构定制，同时兼容PyTorch工作流。在California Housing基准上的实验表明，KANLib能复现参考KAN实现的预测行为，并具有竞争力的计算效率，且允许探索架构变体而对性能影响较小。
Motivation: 现有KAN实现存在计算成本高、功能支持不一致的问题，阻碍了实际研究。
Method: 提出KANLib框架，采用模块化设计，统一多种KAN变体，支持自适应网格、基函数选择等定制，并优化计算性能。
Result: 在California Housing基准上，KANLib复现了参考实现的预测行为，并达到竞争性的计算效率，同时支持架构变体探索且性能损失小。
Conclusion: KANLib为可扩展和可扩展的KAN架构的未来研究提供了稳健基础。

papers.title: EComAgentBench: Benchmarking Shopping Agents on Long-Horizon Tasks with Distributed Hidden Intent
papers.abstract_en: As LLM-based shopping agents enter production, existing benchmarks fail to capture how a shopper's requirements arrive: stated implicitly in the query, recorded in a profile, or revealed only when the right question is asked. Benchmarks that expose full intent upfront and grade only the final choice can neither pose this long-horizon challenge nor explain which requirement an agent missed. To address this gap, we introduce EComAgentBench, a benchmark of 662 tasks grounded in real Amazon products and reviews. Each task scatters these requirements across a visible query, a tool-gated profile, and scripted clarification; an agent must uncover hidden intent, verify candidates against attributes and review evidence, and commit to a single product within 100 tool calls. Moreover, typed, source-tagged rubrics grade every task, attributing each failure to a requirement and its source. Construction is automated yet reliable, with every answer fixed in code before any text is generated and every sample validated. Our evaluation of seven models reveals that even the strongest attains only 57.1% overall accuracy, and rubric satisfaction degrades from visible to hidden sources. Overall, we believe EComAgentBench will serve as a reproducible foundation for moving shopping agents from single-query search toward dependable assistance over long horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍EComAgentBench，一个基于真实亚马逊产品的购物代理基准测试，包含662个任务，要求代理在100次工具调用内发现隐藏需求并选择产品。评估7个模型，最高准确率57.1%。
Motivation: 现有基准测试无法模拟购物者需求以隐含方式呈现的实际情况，也无法指出代理遗漏的具体需求。
Method: 构建662个任务，需求分散在可见查询、工具门控的配置文件（profile）和脚本化澄清中；使用类型化、来源标记的评分标准（rubric）评价每个任务。
Result: 最强模型总体准确率仅57.1%，评分满意度从可见来源到隐藏来源逐渐下降。
Conclusion: EComAgentBench可作为可重复的基础，推动购物代理从单次查询搜索向长范围可靠辅助发展。
