papers.title: Statistical Foundations of LLM-based A/B Testing: A Surrogacy Framework for Human Causal Inference
papers.abstract_en: Organizations and researchers show increasing interest in using large language models (LLMs) in place of human participants in A/B tests, in the hope of experimenting faster and at lower cost. We study when a treatment effect estimated on LLM outcomes can recover the effect for the human population of interest. Distributional equivalence between LLM and human outcomes would make any standard estimator valid but is unrealistic. We therefore develop a statistical framework that adapts surrogate endpoint theory to LLMs, showing that calibrating LLM outcomes to human outcomes identifies the average treatment effect under surrogacy and comparability conditions that are jointly weaker than distributional equivalence. We present a falsification test for surrogacy and a bound on the worst-case bias from limited overlap between the LLM and human samples. We further show that the stochasticity inherent to LLMs can weaken surrogacy for identification while also introducing bias and variance during estimation, but that using an average over multiple LLM draws per unit as the surrogate mitigates these issues. Simulations validate the results, and an empirical application to the Upworthy Research Archive dataset shows that raw LLM outputs recover only 39% of the human treatment effect while nonparametric calibration closes the gap. A central takeaway is that A/B testing on LLM responses is correct only by assumption, whereas A/B testing on humans is correct by design, and that the required assumptions are hardest to justify precisely where LLMs promise the greatest benefit. We discuss the choice of LLM, prompting, and temperature as design variables, the compounded challenge posed by long-term outcomes, and how to size human pilot studies for validation.

TL;DR: 本文研究使用大语言模型（LLM）替代人类参与A/B测试时的统计有效性。作者提出一个基于替代终点理论（surrogacy framework）的框架，通过校准LLM输出到人类输出来识别平均处理效应，并提供了可证伪的替代性检验和最坏情况偏差界。模拟和Upworthy数据集上的实证表明，原始LLM输出仅恢复39%的人类处理效应，而非参数校准可以缩小差距。核心结论是：基于LLM的A/B测试的正确性依赖于假设，而基于人类的实验设计本身是正确的。
Motivation: 组织希望用LLM替代人类进行A/B测试以降低成本并加快速度，但直接使用LLM估计的处理效应能否推广到人类群体尚不清楚。现有方法依赖于分布等价性，但这不现实。
Method: 开发一个统计框架，将替代终点理论适配到LLM场景，通过校准LLM输出到人类输出，在比分布等价性更弱的替代性和可比性条件下识别平均处理效应。提出替代性可证伪检验和最坏情况偏差界，并证明LLM的随机性会削弱替代性并引入偏差方差，而使用多次LLM输出的平均作为替代变量可以缓解这些问题。
Result: 模拟验证了框架的有效性。在Upworthy Research Archive数据集上，原始LLM输出仅恢复39%的人类处理效应，而非参数校准后差距基本消失。
Conclusion: 基于LLM的A/B测试的正确性依赖于未被验证的假设，而基于人类的实验设计本身是正确的。这些假设在LLM最可能带来好处的情境下最难验证。文章讨论了LLM选择、提示和温度等设计变量，以及长期结果带来的复合挑战和人类试点研究的规模确定。

papers.title: Robust Dual-Signal Fusion: Hybrid Neuro-Symbolic Gating with Compressed Chain-of-Thought Refinement for Irony Detection in Social Media Texts
papers.abstract_en: Small-scale Large Language Models (LLMs) natively default to literal semantic interpretations, making few-shot irony detection a persistent challenge in noisy, user-generated text. We introduce the Robust Dual-Signal (RDS) Fusion framework, a hybrid neuro-symbolic architecture that compresses Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories without Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Evaluated on a strictly held-out TweetEval test set ($N=734$), RDS achieves $78.1\%$ accuracy and a Macro F1 of $0.777$, matching the absolute performance ceiling of a fine-tuned BERTweet. On the heavily imbalanced iSarcasm dataset, the frozen CoT pipeline filters $22.5\%$ of out-of-distribution hallucinations, yielding a few-shot Macro F1 of $0.6726$ and Ironic F1 of $0.4821$, outperforming multiple heavily supervised SemEval transformer ensembles. Statistical ablation confirms this structural synergy: while adding the symbolic prior to the neural baseline yields an insignificant gain, and the RDS fusion is statistically insignificant compared to the combined RoBERTa and symbolic prior ablation; the concurrent fusion achieves a statistically significant improvement over the standalone baseline ($p=0.005$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Robust Dual-Signal Fusion (RDS) 框架，一种混合神经符号架构，通过压缩 Chain-of-Thought 推理轨迹进行少样本讽刺检测，无需监督微调。在 TweetEval 测试集上达到 78.1% 准确率和 0.777 Macro F1，匹配微调后的 BERTweet；在 iSarcasm 数据集上，冻结的 CoT 管道过滤了 22.5% 的分布外幻觉，少样本 Macro F1 为 0.6726。消融实验表明，神经与符号先验的联合融合具有统计显著性改进（p=0.005），而单独添加符号先验增益不显著。
Motivation: 小规模大语言模型默认采用字面语义解释，在嘈杂的用户生成文本中进行少样本讽刺检测仍是一个持久挑战。
Method: 提出 Robust Dual-Signal (RDS) Fusion 框架，一种混合神经符号架构，通过压缩 Chain-of-Thought 推理轨迹实现讽刺检测，无需监督微调。
Result: 在严格留出的 TweetEval 测试集（N=734）上，RDS 达到 78.1% 准确率和 0.777 Macro F1，匹配微调 BERTweet 的绝对性能上限。在高度不平衡的 iSarcasm 数据集上，冻结的 CoT 管道过滤了 22.5% 的分布外幻觉，少样本 Macro F1 为 0.6726，Ironic F1 为 0.4821，优于多个强监督的 SemEval 变压器集成。
Conclusion: 结构消融证实了神经与符号先验融合的协同作用：联合融合相比单独基线具有统计显著改进（p=0.005），而单独添加符号先验增益不显著。

papers.title: LectūraAgents: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adaptive Personalized AI-Assisted Learning and Embodied Teaching
papers.abstract_en: Effective personalized AI-assisted learning demands systems that can not only generate accurate learner-specific educational materials, but also dynamically adapt their instruction to diverse learners. However, existing educational agents have primarily focused on lecture content automation and simulations, which often fall short of modelling multimodal and embodied instructional methods tailored for the individual learner. To this end, we propose LectūraAgents - a multi-agent framework that enables personalized learning through end-to-end adaptive embodied teaching. At its core, LectūraAgents mirrors a professor-student relationship, in which a ProfessorAgent leads a collaborative team of specialized subordinate agents through research, planning, review, and embodied delivery of lecture contents that adapt to a learner's needs. The framework offers three main contributions: (1) a hierarchical multi-agent architecture for end-to-end personalized learning; (2) an adaptive embodied teaching mechanism, wherein the ProfessorAgent executes visible and pedagogically motivated teaching actions (e.g., handwrite, highlight, underline, etc.) over contents in a teaching environment; and (3) a Teaching Action-Speech Alignment (TASA) algorithm that employs salience-based heuristics and temporal semantic segmentation to generate coherent teaching action sequences aligned with learner profiles. We evaluate LectūraAgents on diverse courses at high school, undergraduate, and graduate levels using sample-specific rubric-based analysis; with generated lecture materials and teaching actions assessed and validated by expert educators. Experimental results show consistent gains in lecture content quality, embodied teaching quality, assessment, and personalization over existing approaches, positioning LectūraAgents as a pedagogically well-grounded framework for personalized learning at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LectūraAgents，一个多智能体框架，用于自适应个性化 AI 辅助学习和具身教学。该框架模拟教授-学生关系，由 ProfessorAgent 领导协作团队，通过研究、规划、审查和具身授课，生成适应学习者需求的讲座内容。主要贡献包括层次化多智能体架构、自适应具身教学机制（如手写、高亮、下划线等教学动作）以及教学动作-语音对齐算法。在高中、本科和研究生级别的课程上评估，专家教育者验证显示，该方法在讲座内容质量、具身教学质量、评估和个性化方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有教育智能体主要关注讲座内容自动化和模拟，缺乏针对个体学习者的多模态和具身教学方法的建模，无法动态适应多样化的学习者需求。
Method: 提出 LectūraAgents 多智能体框架，包含层次化架构（ProfessorAgent 领导子智能体）、自适应具身教学机制（执行可见的教学动作）以及教学动作-语音对齐算法（基于显著性启发和时间语义分割）。
Result: 在高中、本科和研究生级别的多个课程上，使用样本特定的评分标准分析，并由专家教育者评估，结果显示在讲座内容质量、具身教学质量、评估和个性化方面持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: LectūraAgents 是一个教育学基础扎实的框架，适用于大规模个性化学习，但摘要未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: Differentiable Packing of Irregular 3D Objects with Adaptive Container Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Most existing approaches either fix the container in advance or optimize only a single container dimension through an outer search loop, leaving the remaining dimensions as a manual tuning problem. We present a differentiable packing framework that jointly optimizes all 6N object pose parameters and all three container side lengths inside a single gradient-based loop. The formulation combines six physics-inspired, differentiable loss terms computed directly on triangle meshes through axis-aligned bounding-box proxies. An adaptive squeezing mechanism periodically tightens the container whenever the overlap loss falls below a pair-count-scaled threshold, producing a large initial drop in container volume, followed by small refinements. All pairwise computations are written in tensor-broadcasting form, giving a 3.4 to 54 times speedup over a reference loop-based implementation. The pipeline is implemented in Python and PyTorch, with no physics engine, FFT library, or convex decomposition. On multiple object categories, the method produces containers that are 11 to 32 percent smaller than time-matched DBLF and simulated-annealing baselines at N =100, while running in under 4 minutes per instance on a single consumer GPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种可微分的非规则三维物体装箱框架，通过梯度优化同时调整物体姿态和容器尺寸，引入自适应收缩机制，在多个物体类别上比时间匹配的基线方法减小容器体积11-32%，且单实例在消费级GPU上运行时间低于4分钟。
Motivation: 现有方法要么预定义容器尺寸，要么通过外部搜索优化单一容器维度，无法高效联合优化所有物体姿态和容器边长。
Method: 构建基于三角形网格的轴对齐包围盒代理，设计6个物理启发的可微损失项，通过自适应挤压机制（当重叠损失低于阈值时收紧容器）实现梯度联合优化，所有成对计算采用张量广播形式提升速度。
Result: 在N=100时，比时间匹配的DBLF和模拟退火基线方法容器体积减小11-32%，计算速度比循环实现快3.4-54倍，单实例在单GPU上<4分钟。
Conclusion: 该方法无需物理引擎或凸分解，在Python/PyTorch中实现，为不规则物体装箱提供了一种高效全可微的解决方案。

papers.title: Quantum Cinema: An Interactive Cinematic Exploration of Quantum Computing Hardware via Generative World Models
papers.abstract_en: Quantum computing promises transformative advances across science and industry, yet the physical hardware that enables these computations remains invisible to the public: quantum processors operate inside sealed dilution refrigerators at temperatures near absolute zero, making direct observation impossible. This "imagination gap" between quantum computing's growing societal impact and the public's ability to visualize it represents a significant barrier to quantum literacy and workforce development. We present Quantum Cinema, an open-source, browser-based interactive application that closes this gap by transforming invisible quantum hardware into explorable, cinematic experiences using generative world models. Quantum Cinema guides users through a four-act narrative -- from the foundational Nobel Prize-winning science of quantum entanglement, through curated video introductions to three major quantum computing architectures (trapped-ion, neutral-atom, and superconducting systems), into immersive three-dimensional generative worlds that make invisible quantum phenomena observable, and finally to interactive radar-chart comparisons grounded in real quantum device specifications. All three-dimensional environments are generated using WorldLabs' generative world model platform and are scientifically grounded in curated metrics from Amazon Web Services (AWS) Braket quantum hardware. Quantum Cinema requires no installation, no specialized hardware, and no quantum computing background. It is designed to serve two distinct communities: scholars and developers seeking to replicate or extend the platform, and educators, researchers, and science communicators seeking an intuitive tool for explaining quantum hardware to diverse audiences. This paper describes the system architecture, the generative world model pipeline, use cases for both communities, and directions for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Quantum Cinema，一款开源的基于浏览器的交互式应用，利用生成世界模型将不可见的量子计算硬件转化为可探索的影视体验。用户通过四幕叙事了解量子纠缠基础、三种主要量子计算架构（离子阱、中性原子、超导）以及交互式雷达图比较真实量子设备参数。所有三维环境由WorldLabs生成世界模型平台构建，并基于AWS Braket的量子硬件指标。无需安装和专业背景，面向学术开发者和教育传播者。
Motivation: 量子计算硬件运行在密封的稀释制冷机中，公众无法直接观察，导致“想象鸿沟”，阻碍量子素养和劳动力发展。论文旨在通过沉浸式体验填补这一鸿沟。
Method: 采用生成世界模型（WorldLabs平台）创建沉浸式三维环境，结合视频介绍、交互式雷达图，设计四幕叙事结构。系统基于AWS Braket的量子硬件指标构建科学基础。
Result: 提供了一个无需安装、无需专业知识的交互式平台，能够可视化量子计算硬件，并已开源，可供学者复现扩展。
Conclusion: 论文描述了系统架构、生成世界模型流程、两个目标社区的使用案例及未来工作方向。旨在为量子教育传播提供直观工具。

papers.title: Rethinking Structural Anomaly Detection: From Decision Boundaries to Projection Operators
papers.abstract_en: Most existing anomaly detection methods rely on estimating a probability density or learning an enclosing decision boundary, implicitly assuming that normal data occupies a region of non-zero volume in the ambient space. In contrast, structural anomaly detection considers data that lies near a low-dimensional manifold, creating a mismatch between the inductive bias of existing methods and the structure of the data, often resulting in degraded performance. To address this mismatch, we introduce a geometric perspective. Specifically, we learn a projection operator onto the manifold of normal samples and define a sample as anomalous if it is altered by this projection. This formulation naturally integrates the inductive bias of manifold-supported data and reframes anomaly detection in terms of a projection residual, thereby resolving issues arising from modeling degenerate distributions. Notably, it provides a unifying interpretation of reconstruction-based methods by explaining their success and failure in terms of projection quality. In particular, it explains the strong generalization ability of projection-aligned models as a consequence of contraction behavior toward the manifold. Moreover, by decoupling anomaly detection from probabilistic modeling, it reduces the tendency to misclassify rare but normal samples, a widely recognized limitation of existing approaches. Empirically, we demonstrate that projection-aligned methods achieve strong performance, outperforming boundary-based methods while improving upon existing reconstruction-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从几何视角重新审视结构异常检测，指出传统基于概率密度或决策边界的方法在数据位于低维流形时失效，并提出通过学习投影算子到正常样本流形，以投影残差作为异常判据。该方法统一了基于重建的方法，解释了其成功与失败的原因，并减少了将罕见但正常样本误分类的趋势。实验表明，投影对齐方法优于边界方法和现有重建方法。
Motivation: 现有异常检测方法假设正常数据占据非零体积区域，而当数据位于低维流形（结构异常检测场景）时，该假设不成立，导致性能下降。
Method: 学习一个投影算子将样本投影到正常样本流形，定义若样本被投影后发生改变则为异常，从而将异常检测转化为投影残差问题，并解释重建方法的效果取决于投影质量。
Result: 投影对齐方法在结构异常检测任务上优于基于边界的方法和现有重建方法，具有强泛化能力，并减少了罕见正常样本的误分类。
Conclusion: 通过解耦异常检测与概率建模，投影残差范式更适用于流形支撑的数据，为基于重建的方法提供了统一理论解释，并指出了设计投影对齐模型的方向。

papers.title: Foundations of Practical Quantum Advantage in Quantum-Informed Machine Learning for Predicting Chaos
papers.abstract_en: We develop theoretical foundations for a practical quantum-advantage mechanism in quantum-informed machine learning for chaotic dynamical systems. A family of $k$-indexed higher-order quantum statistical priors (Q-Priors) hosts the $k$-point marginal of the invariant measure on $n_q = kq$ qubits, extending the single-site construction of prior work. We prove a two-stage advantage. In the representation stage, superposition and entanglement compactly store non-factorisable spatial correlations of the invariant measure on $n_q$ qubits. In the extraction stage, joint Bell measurements on two copies estimate any post hoc Pauli functional with a copy-pair count independent of $n_q$, whereas any adaptive single-copy protocol for the corresponding full-Pauli read-out requires $Ω(2^{n_q})$ copies; this is a provable quantum-classical separation in copy-measurement complexity. The two-copy read-out is realised in simulation and on IQM superconducting processors. Two case studies instantiate the mechanism in workflows of independent scientific value: a turbulent channel-flow study in which the two-copy read-out yields a named non-diagonal correlator of the invariant measure, and a medium-range weather forecasting workflow on the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts ERA5 reanalysis in which the diagonal $k \leq 2$ Q-Prior steers a Koopman rollout, improves anomaly-correlation skill by 10 to 39\% across 48 to 240\,h lead times and stabilises long-horizon rollouts against collapse onto a static mean field. Together, the mechanism and these workflow instantiations satisfy our practical-advantage definition, identifying a candidate route to practical quantum advantage before fault-tolerant hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为量子信息机器学习在混沌动力系统预测中的实际量子优势建立了理论基础。通过构造高阶量子统计先验（Q-Priors），利用叠加和纠缠紧凑存储不变测度的空间关联，并在双拷贝联合Bell测量下实现与量子比特数无关的副本复杂度，证明与单拷贝自适应协议的指数级分离。在IQM超导处理器上实现双拷贝读出，并在湍流通道流和中程天气预报（ERA5再分析）两个案例中验证，后者在48-240小时间使异常相关技能提升10%-39%。
Motivation: 现有量子优势通常依赖容错量子硬件，而近期NISQ设备上实用量子优势的证据不足。本文旨在为量子信息机器学习提供一个可验证的实用量子优势机制，尤其针对混沌动力系统预测。
Method: 提出k索引的高阶量子统计先验（Q-Priors），将不变测度的k点边缘编码在n_q=kq个量子比特上；通过双拷贝联合Bell测量估计任意Pauli泛函，副本对数与n_q无关，而单拷贝全Pauli读出需要Ω(2^{n_q})副本；实现机制并在超导处理器上验证。
Result: 中程天气预报案例中，利用k≤2的对角Q-Prior引导Koopman滚动，在ERA5再分析上48-240小时提前期的异常相关技能提升10%-39%，且稳定长时滚动避免塌缩到静态均值场。湍流通道流案例获得非对角关联子。验证了双拷贝读出在模拟和IQM芯片上的实现。
Conclusion: 该机制和工作流实例满足作者定义的实用量子优势标准，在容错硬件到来之前为实际量子优势提供了候选路径。

papers.title: Acquisition state behaves as a structured, measurable variable governing lung-nodule AI: kernel-driven measurement instability and noise-driven detection fragility, invisible to DICOM metadata
papers.abstract_en: AI governance for medical imaging is formalizing: the 2026 ACR-SIIM Practice Parameter recommends local acceptance testing and ongoing drift monitoring, and the ACR Assess-AI registry monitors AI outputs using DICOM metadata for context. We argue that a necessary, currently unmonitored layer sits beneath output metrics: whether incoming studies remain within the acquisition envelope a model was validated on. Using a LUNA16-trained MONAI RetinaNet lung-nodule detector, we test whether acquisition state behaves as a structured, measurable variable. On real paired CT differing only in reconstruction kernel (NLST B30f vs B80f), kernel alone shifted AI-measured diameter and flipped a Fleischner size category in 5.2% (8 of 155) of nodules at fixed patient and acquisition, while detection confidence was unchanged (Wilcoxon p=0.22). Under controlled LIDC-IDRI perturbations the effects dissociated by axis: the noise axis degraded detection confidence (p=5.9e-32, concentrated in nodules under 6 mm) but not measurement, while the frequency/kernel axis corrupted measurement (p=8.6e-13) but not detection. A 4-feature pixel fingerprint recovered reconstruction identity (patient-level AUC about 0.95 on real CT, 0.995 on a QIBA phantom) where the ConvolutionKernel DICOM tag was uninformative (identical labels across reconstructions). The kernel axis transported across four manufacturers (leave-one-vendor-out AUC 0.94-0.98, matching the within-vendor ceiling). Acquisition state thus maps to distinct AI failure modes, frequency content to measurement reliability and noise to detection sensitivity, and is not recoverable from metadata. Acquisition-aware, input-side validation is the missing layer for the acceptance-testing and drift-monitoring requirements now entering imaging-AI accreditation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究CT采集状态（如重建内核、噪声水平）对肺结节AI检测和测量的影响。使用LUNA16训练的RetinaNet，发现内核变化会改变AI测量的结节直径并导致Fleischner分类变动（5.2%），而噪声主要影响小模结节检测置信度。一个4特征像素指纹能以高AUC恢复重建身份，而DICOM元数据无法反映这些差异。
Motivation: 当前AI治理（如ACR-SIIM建议）关注输出指标漂移，但忽略了输入采集状态是否处于模型验证范围，导致潜在的失败模式未被监测。
Method: 在LUNA16数据集上训练MONAI RetinaNet肺结节检测器，使用NLST真实配对CT（B30f vs B80f）和LIDC-IDRI受控扰动实验，分离噪声轴与频率/内核轴的影响，并提取4特征像素指纹恢复重建身份。
Result: 内核变化导致5.2%的结节Fleischner分类翻转，但检测置信度不变（p=0.22）；噪声降低检测置信度（p=5.9e-32，集中于<6mm结节）但不影响测量；内核影响测量（p=8.6e-13）但不影响检测；像素指纹在真实CT上AUC约0.95，在QIBA体模上0.995，且在跨厂商测试中保持0.94-0.98。
Conclusion: 采集状态是影响AI性能的结构化变量，内核影响测量可靠性，噪声影响检测灵敏度，且无法从DICOM元数据恢复。应加入采集感知的输入侧验证以完善AI认证流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TouchThinker: Scaling Tactile Commonsense Reasoning to the Open World with Large-scale Data and Action-aware Representation
papers.abstract_en: Touch is a key modality for embodied agents to understand the physical world. Although recent work has incorporated tactile signals into language systems for tactile commonsense reasoning, scaling such systems to realistic open-world settings remains challenging due to two key bottlenecks: (1) current tactile reasoning datasets remain limited in format and scale, providing insufficient supervision for reasoning from tactile observations to physical commonsense and hindering the learning of transferable tactile commonsense; (2) Tactile signals are inherently redundant and action-specific, yet existing methods often overlook these properties, resulting in inefficient representations with limited semantic expressiveness. To address these limitations, we propose TouchThinker, a tactile-language framework that scales tactile commonsense reasoning to the open world from both data and representation perspectives. First, we construct TouchThinker-1M, a million-scale, multi-source tactile reasoning dataset covering \textbf{415} objects, \textbf{8} scenarios, and \textbf{7} sensor types, providing a solid data foundation for open-world generalization. We further introduce TouchThinker-Bench, an open-world benchmark with more realistic and diverse tasks. Then, we propose action-aware modeling mechanism to improve tactile representation efficiency and enable efficient reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that TouchThinker achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art models across multiple datasets. Our code and dataset will be made available at: https://github.com/lvkailin0118/TouchThinker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TouchThinker框架，从数据和表征两个角度将触觉常识推理扩展到开放世界。构建了百万级多源触觉推理数据集TouchThinker-1M，覆盖415个物体、8种场景和7种传感器类型，并提出动作感知机制提升触觉表征效率。实验表明TouchThinker在多个数据集上达到与最先进模型竞争的性能。
Motivation: 当前触觉推理数据集规模和格式有限，无法提供足够监督；触觉信号冗余且与动作相关，现有方法忽略这些特性导致表征效率低和语义表达能力不足。
Method: 构建大规模多源触觉推理数据集TouchThinker-1M及开放世界基准TouchThinker-Bench；提出动作感知建模机制（action-aware modeling mechanism），通过显式建模触觉信号与动作的关联来提升表征效率和推理能力。
Result: 在多个数据集上，TouchThinker与现有最先进模型相比取得了有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 大规模数据和动作感知表征可有效将触觉常识推理扩展到开放世界，未来代码和数据集将开源。

papers.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
papers.abstract_en: We introduce WorldOlympiad, a benchmark for diagnosing video-based world models across physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity. While existing benchmarks often focus on visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal coherence, they provide limited insight into whether generated videos obey physical rules, preserve coherent 3D structure, and sustain controllable interactions over long horizons. To address this gap, WorldOlympiad decomposes world-model evaluation into three complementary dimensions. The physical track uses object segmentation and MLLM-as-judge to assess whether generated videos follow interpretable rules in mechanics, thermal phenomena, and material properties. The geometry track reconstructs generated videos with Gaussian splatting and evaluates structural consistency, cross-view coherence, and camera-trajectory alignment. The interaction track assesses whether generated rollouts follow complex action prompts and maintain smooth, coherent transitions across consecutive video chunks. WorldOlympiad further covers three major downstream scenarios, including gaming, robotics, and general real-world videos, capturing diverse challenges from interactive control and embodied manipulation to open-domain motion and camera dynamics. Together, these tracks and scenarios form a scalable and interpretable evaluation suite that exposes failure modes beyond generic video quality. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal substantial gaps in physical reasoning, 3D consistency, and long-horizon interaction, underscoring the need for more structured evaluation protocols for generative world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldOlympiad 是一个用于诊断基于视频的世界模型在物理一致性、几何一致性和交互保真度方面的基准测试。它包含三个维度：物理轨迹（评估力学、热学和材料属性）、几何轨迹（通过高斯泼溅评估结构一致性和跨视角对齐）以及交互轨迹（评估复杂动作指令的跟随和长程连贯性）。实验发现现有最先进模型在物理推理、3D一致性和长程交互方面存在显著缺陷。
Motivation: 现有视频生成基准主要关注视觉质量、语义对齐或短期时间连贯性，无法判断生成视频是否遵守物理规则、保持3D结构一致性或支持长程可控交互。
Method: 将世界模型评估分解为三个互补维度：物理轨迹（使用物体分割和MLLM作为裁判）、几何轨迹（通过高斯泼溅重建并评估结构一致性）和交互轨迹（评估是否遵循复杂动作提示并保持平滑过渡）。覆盖游戏、机器人和通用真实世界视频三个下游场景。
Result: 对最先进模型的实验显示在物理推理、3D一致性和长程交互方面存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 该基准暴露了超越通用视频质量的失败模式，强调了需要更结构化的评估协议来评估生成式世界模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Machine-Learning Emulation of Satellite Greenhouse Gas Retrievals: Stability over Time
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval algorithms are used to estimate atmospheric concentrations of greenhouse gases (GHGs), such as carbon dioxide (CO2) and methane (CH4), by solving inverse problems from high-spectral-resolution satellite radiance measurements. However, these algorithms are computationally expensive, which makes real-time estimation at scale difficult. Machine-learning models have therefore been proposed as fast emulators of retrieval algorithms. Most existing studies, however, evaluate them only on test data from the same period as the training data. We study the stability over time of such emulators using data from the Greenhouse Gases Observing SATellite (GOSAT). We show that prediction accuracy generally deteriorates when the test period moves away from the training period. We also show that including time as an input feature substantially improves XCH4 prediction for Lasso and neural-network models. Among the methods considered, a simple Lasso model performs as well as or better than more complex methods such as neural networks, and yields more stable predictions over time. We further validate the results using the Total Carbon Column Observing Network (TCCON), a ground-based observation network. On the TCCON-matched dataset, the time-augmented Lasso achieves errors against TCCON that are comparable to the disagreement between GOSAT and TCCON for both XCO2 and XCH4.

Motivation: 现有机器学习模拟器仅在同时期测试数据上评估，缺乏对时间稳定性的研究，而实际应用中训练与测试数据可能来自不同时间段。
Method: 使用GOSAT卫星数据，将时间作为输入特征，比较Lasso、神经网络等模型在温室气体（CO2和CH4）浓度预测上的表现，并在TCCON地面观测数据上验证。
Result: 模型预测精度随测试时间远离训练时间而下降；引入时间特征后Lasso和神经网络的XCH4预测明显改善；简单Lasso模型与复杂方法性能相当且更稳定；时间增强Lasso在TCCON数据集上的误差与GOSAT-TCCON间差异接近。
Conclusion: 机器学习模拟器需考虑时间稳定性，简单线性模型可能比复杂模型更可靠，时间特征可有效缓解随时间偏移的性能下降。

papers.title: SkillHone: A Harness for Continual Agent Skill Evolution Through Persistent Decision History
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills extend language-model agents with task-specific procedures, scripts, and references, but the tasks and environments they target continually change. Existing methods improve skills in bounded runs and retain only the final artifact, discarding the decision history that later agents need to interpret prior revisions, evaluations, and rejected alternatives. We introduce SkillHone, a harness for continual agent skill evolution grounded in persistent decision history. SkillHone pairs skill revisions with evaluation-side evidence that supplies practice feedback, recording structured histories of diagnoses, revisions, evidence, and outcomes. Role-separated subagents run candidate skills on practice probes with redacted reporting and propose revisions informed by prior decisions, enabling cross-session refinement without rediscovering past rationale. On deep-research benchmarks, SkillHone runs without a pre-integrated search stack and outperforms the commercially backed deep-research agent by 15.8 points on GAIA and 3.2 points on WebWalkerQA-EN, while also exceeding prior skill-evolution methods. We further deploy SkillHone on internal tool-mediated analysis scenarios, where it improves accuracy by an average of 18.8 points across seven settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillHone 提出一种持续智能体技能进化框架，通过持久决策历史保留每次修订的诊断、证据和结果，使子代理能在跨会话中利用历史决策进行改进。在 GAIA 和 WebWalkerQA-EN 上分别比商业化深度研究代理高 15.8 和 3.2 个点，并在内部工具场景中平均提升 18.8 个点。
Motivation: 现有技能进化方法仅在有限运行中改进并丢弃决策历史，导致后续代理无法理解先前修订、评估和拒绝的备选方案。需要一种能持续保留并利用决策历史的方法。
Method: 引入 SkillHone 框架，将技能修订与评估侧证据配对，记录结构化的诊断、修订、证据和结果历史。角色分离的子代理在实践探针上运行候选技能并生成修订，无需重新发现过往理由。
Result: 在深度研究基准上，无需预集成搜索栈，SkillHone 在 GAIA 上超越商业代理 15.8 点，WebWalkerQA-EN 上超越 3.2 点，并优于先前技能进化方法。在内部工具场景中，七个设置平均准确率提升 18.8 点。
Conclusion: SkillHone 通过持久决策历史实现了跨会话的持续技能进化，展示了在复杂研究任务和工具介导分析中的有效性。

papers.title: TopoPult-SSL: Gland-Mask-Free Cross-Device Meibomian Gland Segmentation via Self-Distilled Weak Clinical Priors
papers.abstract_en: Every new clinical imaging device creates a domain shift where dense gland masks are expensive yet cheap clinical signals -- eyelid outlines, Pult grades, morphometric ratios -- are routinely recorded. We present TopoPult-SSL, a two-stage framework for cross-device meibomian gland segmentation. Stage 1 adapts a source-trained model without target gland masks in the training loss, using four weak-prior anchors driven by target eyelid masks and clinical metadata only. Stage 2, when target gland masks are available, distils complementary Stage-1 teachers into a single compact student via supervised self-distillation. We develop and validate the technique on the public MGD-1k to CAMG research benchmark (1,000 to 100 images, different device), where the distilled model achieves Dice 0.716+/-0.006 (best 0.726), surpassing UA-MT (0.710) and the ensemble teacher (0.720) -- with a single pass. The gland-mask-free Stage-1 variant reaches Precision 0.694 vs. 0.30-0.34 for SAM/MedSAM (p<0.001), enabling deployment without dense gland contouring. Code and reproducibility scripts are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TopoPult-SSL，一种两阶段框架，用于跨设备睑板腺分割。第一阶段无需目标域腺体掩膜，仅利用眼睑掩膜和临床元数据作为弱先验进行域适应；第二阶段在获得目标腺体掩膜后，通过监督自蒸馏将互补的第一阶段教师模型压缩为单个紧凑学生模型。在MGD-1k到CAMG跨设备基准上，蒸馏模型达到Dice 0.716±0.006，超越UA-MT和集成教师模型，且无腺体掩膜的变体在精度上显著优于SAM/MedSAM。
Motivation: 临床新成像设备带来的域偏移导致密集腺体掩膜标注昂贵，而廉价的临床信号（如眼睑轮廓、Pult分级、形态学比率）通常被记录，现有方法无法利用这些弱先验进行无腺体掩膜的分割。
Method: 两阶段框架：阶段1使用四个弱先验锚点（由目标眼睑掩膜和临床元数据驱动），在训练损失中无需目标腺体掩膜即可适配源模型；阶段2在目标腺体掩膜可用时，通过监督自蒸馏将多个互补的教师模型蒸馏为单一紧凑学生模型。
Result: 在MGD-1k到CAMG跨设备基准上，蒸馏模型Dice为0.716±0.006（最佳0.726），优于UA-MT（0.710）和集成教师（0.720）；无腺体掩膜变体精度0.694，显著高于SAM/MedSAM的0.30-0.34（p<0.001）。
Conclusion: 所提方法可在无腺体掩膜条件下实现跨设备睑板腺分割，且通过自蒸馏提升性能，为临床部署提供了无需密集标注的可行方案。

papers.title: Do Foundation Models See Biology? Evaluating Attention Coherence with Spatial Transcriptomics in Glioblastoma
papers.abstract_en: Whether attention maps from pathology foundation models capture genuine biology remains unknown, yet this question is critical for clinical trust and regulatory approval. We propose a spatial transcriptomics-based framework for orthogonal, hypothesis-free evaluation of attention and apply it to five pathology foundation models (CONCH v1.5, UNI v2, Virchow2, GigaPath, H-Optimus-1) and a ResNet50 baseline. Using attention-based multiple instance learning, we train single-task and multi-task models to predict five molecular alterations in glioblastoma on the CPTAC cohort, validate on an independent TCGA cohort, and evaluate biological coherence of attention maps against 87 transcriptional signatures using co-registered Visium spatial transcriptomics data from 18 samples. Internally, no single encoder dominates across all tasks, and external validation inverts internal performance rankings. Attention maps show a five-fold enrichment gradient from pathways (Cohen's d=0.329) to individual genes (d=0.055), indicating that attention captures emergent multi-gene transcriptional programs rather than individual molecular events. Spatially smooth attention maps do not imply biological coherence, and different encoders attend to distinct biological compartments. Our framework provides objective, quantitative assessment of what foundation models learn from histopathology, moving the field beyond qualitative saliency map review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于空间转录组学的框架，用于正交、无假设地评估病理学基础模型的注意力图是否捕获真实的生物学信息。在胶质母细胞瘤的五个病理基础模型上进行实验，发现注意力图主要捕获多基因转录程序而非单个分子事件，且不同编码器关注不同的生物学区室。
Motivation: 病理学基础模型的注意力图是否能反映真实生物学尚不明确，这对临床信任和监管审批至关重要。现有评估多依赖定性显著性图，缺乏客观定量方法。
Method: 利用共配准的Visium空间转录组学数据，通过注意力多实例学习训练单任务和多任务模型预测胶质母细胞瘤的分子改变，然后评估注意力图与87个转录特征的一致性。
Result: 内部无单一编码器在所有任务上占优，外部验证反转了内部性能排名。注意力图从通路（Cohen's d=0.329）到单个基因（d=0.055）有五倍富集梯度，表明捕获的是多基因转录程序而非单分子事件。空间平滑的注意力图不意味着生物学一致性。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了对病理学基础模型学到内容的客观定量评估，推动领域超越定性显著性图审查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Training-Free Mixture-of-Agents Framework for Multi-Document Summarization using LLMs and Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Document Summarization (MDS) plays a critical role in distilling essential information from collections of textual data. Existing approaches often struggle to capture complex inter-document relationships, rely heavily on large amounts of labeled data for supervised training, or exhibit limited generalization across domains and languages. To address these limitations, we present a training-free mixture-of-agents framework for MDS that leverages the complementary strengths of large language models (LLMs) and knowledge graphs. Our approach decomposes summarization into specialized agent tasks: extractive selection, knowledge-aware abstraction, and iterative refinement, each operating without task-specific fine-tuning. We unify their outputs using a multi-perspective consistency mechanism guided by LLMs. Experiments across four datasets in English and Vietnamese demonstrate state-of-the-art or competitive performance, validating the effectiveness and adaptability of our modular design.
papers.comment: Accepted by Neural Computing and Applications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需训练的混合智能体框架，用于多文档摘要，结合大语言模型和知识图谱的互补优势。框架将摘要分解为抽取选择、知识感知抽象和迭代细化三个专门智能体任务，并通过LLM引导的多视角一致性机制统一输出。在四个英越双语数据集上达到最先进或竞争性性能。

Result: 在四个英越双语数据集上取得最先进或竞争性结果。

papers.title: Face versus Body Tracking for Human-Robot Interaction: An Egocentric Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Meaningful human-robot interaction (HRI) requires a robot to continuously assess user engagement through persistent user tracking. However, state-of-the-art Multi-Object Tracking models are heavily optimized for surveillance or autonomous driving. A social robot faces distinct egocentric challenges, such as humans moving in unpredictable nonlinear patterns, obstructing each other, or leaving and reentering the scene. These dynamics trigger frequent identity switches (IDSW), causing the robot to lose its footing mid-conversation. To address this, we introduce a focused, custom-annotated egocentric dataset collected via the Furhat robot. We present a systematic evaluation isolating detection errors from tracking logic, comparing face versus body tracking, and assessing the impact of extended memory and appearance re-identification (ReID). Results indicate that increasing temporal memory mitigates prolonged occlusions but fails on complex dynamic events. Integrating ReID resolves complex switches but exhibits opposing effects: it substantially improves body tracking stability, yet causes facial IDSW to spike due to profile angle sensitivity. Ultimately, our optimized pipeline reduces IDSW by 49% compared to a standard tracking-by-detection baseline, effectively mitigating interaction breakdowns. As standard benchmarks lack dense, close-quarter occlusions, this work highlights the critical need for natively captured social dynamics to truly validate HRI perception models.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Camera-ready version. Accepted to the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人机交互中机器人持续跟踪用户的问题，提出了一个由Furhat机器人采集的自我中心（egocentric）数据集，并系统评估了人脸跟踪与身体跟踪的性能差异。结果表明，增加时间记忆可缓解长时间遮挡，但无法应对复杂动态事件；引入外观重识别（ReID）能改善身体跟踪稳定性，却因侧脸角度敏感导致面部身份切换激增。优化后的流水线比标准跟踪-检测基线减少了49%的身份切换。
Motivation: 现有多目标跟踪模型主要针对监控或自动驾驶场景优化，无法应对社交机器人面临的自我中心挑战（如非线性运动、相互遮挡、离场再入场），导致身份切换频繁，破坏交互连续性。
Method: 使用Furhat机器人采集并标注了一个自我中心数据集，将检测误差与跟踪逻辑分离进行系统评估，对比人脸跟踪与身体跟踪，并测试扩展时间记忆和外观重识别（ReID）的影响。
Result: 增加时间记忆可缓解长时间遮挡，但无法处理复杂动态事件；ReID显著改善身体跟踪稳定性，却因侧脸角度敏感性导致面部身份切换增加；优化流水线最终比标准跟踪-检测基线减少49%的身份切换。
Conclusion: 标准基准缺乏密集近距遮挡场景，该工作强调了使用原生社交动态数据验证人机交互感知模型的必要性。

papers.title: ASymPO: Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization for Asynchronous LLM Post-Training Without Behavior Information
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous reinforcement learning can improve language-model post-training throughput by decoupling response generation from policy optimization, but stale responses introduce distribution drift. Standard behavior-corrected methods control this drift with behavior-policy probabilities, importance ratios, or clipping, which requires token-aligned, versioned, and numerically consistent behavior log-probabilities across rollout and learner systems. We ask whether asynchronous group-relative RL can instead be stabilized using only current-policy probabilities. We identify a scale-imbalance failure mode: when stale responses are evaluated under the current policy, positive and negative loss terms can appear at different negative log-probability scales, so zero-sum advantages no longer imply balanced loss contributions. We propose Asymmetric-Scale Policy Optimization (ASymPO), which normalizes each response's token loss by its current average token negative log-probability. ASymPO requires no behavior-policy probabilities, restores response-level zero-sum balance, and preserves a nonzero learning signal. We also introduce Scaled Policy Optimization (SPO), a fixed negative-scaling baseline, and evaluate both current-policy-only objectives in asynchronous mathematical reasoning post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ASymPO，一种用于异步语言模型后训练的无需行为策略概率的策略优化方法。它解决由于陈旧响应导致的尺度不平衡失败模式，通过每个响应的标记损失按当前平均负对数概率归一化。还引入SPO基线。实验在异步数学推理后训练中评估。
Motivation: 异步强化学习提高吞吐量但陈旧响应导致分布漂移，行为校正方法需要行为对数概率等，存在系统一致性挑战。本文旨在仅使用当前策略概率来稳定异步组相对RL。
Method: 提出ASymPO：对每个响应的标记损失按当前平均标记负对数概率归一化，从而恢复响应级零和平衡，无需行为策略概率。还提出SPO作为固定负缩放基线。
Result: 在异步数学推理后训练中评估了两种仅当前策略的目标，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该方法无需行为策略概率并保留非零学习信号，为异步LLM后训练提供新思路。

papers.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosmos 3 establishes a new state-of-the-art across a diverse suite of understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating omnimodal world models as scalable, general-purpose backbones for embodied agents. Our post-trained Cosmos 3 models were ranked as the best open-source Text-to-Image and Image-to-Video models by Artificial Analysis, and the best policy model by RoboArena at the time the technical report was written. To accelerate open research and deployment in Physical AI, we make our code, model checkpoints, curated synthetic datasets, and evaluation benchmark available under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 License at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3. The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了 Cosmos 3，一个统一的多模态世界模型家族，采用混合变换器架构，联合处理语言、图像、视频、音频和动作序列。该模型在物理 AI 的理解与生成任务上达到新 SOTA，并在文本到图像、图像到视频及策略模型排行榜上取得领先。
Motivation: 现有模型通常分别处理视觉-语言、视频生成、世界模拟和行为控制等任务，缺乏统一框架。Cosmos 3 旨在通过一个模型支持所有关键模态，为具身智能体提供可扩展的通用骨干网络。
Method: 提出混合变换器（mixture-of-transformers）架构，支持灵活的输入输出配置，联合处理语言、图像、视频、音频和动作序列，实现全模态（omnimodal）的世界模型。
Result: 在多种理解和生成任务上达到新 SOTA；开源的文本到图像和图像到视频模型被 Artificial Analysis 评为最佳，策略模型在 RoboArena 上排名第一。
Conclusion: Cosmos 3 展示了全模态世界模型作为物理 AI 通用后端的可扩展性，并开源了代码、模型权重、合成数据集和评估基准以促进研究。

papers.title: Efficient Test-time Inference for Generative Planning Models with OCL Search
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for AI planning, yet their performance remains constrained by the training data distribution. One approach is to improve generated solutions during inference by scaling test-time compute. A more efficient alternative is to optimize the inference process itself. In this paper, we show that a modified version of a classical Open-Closed List (OCL) search provides just such an efficient inference procedure. Our algorithm synergizes two learned components: a generative model that performs fast rollouts from intermediate states and a heuristic model that prioritizes among candidate reasoning paths. Key contributions include novel exploration control mechanisms and integration of learned models within the OCL framework. Across multiple combinatorial planning domains, our approach outperforms both neurosymbolic search baselines and classical solvers in computational efficiency and solution quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式规划模型在推理时受训练数据分布限制的问题，提出一种改进的经典开闭列表（OCL）搜索方法作为高效的推理过程。该算法协同两个学习组件：一个用于从中间状态快速展开的生成模型，以及一个用于优先排序候选推理路径的启发式模型。通过新颖的探索控制机制和将学习模型整合到OCL框架中，在多个组合规划领域，该方法在计算效率和解决方案质量上均优于神经符号搜索基线和经典求解器。
Motivation: 生成式模型在AI规划中表现出潜力，但性能受限于训练数据分布。现有方法通过增加测试时计算来改进生成解，但效率较低。本文旨在优化推理过程本身，提高效率。
Method: 提出一种改进的OCL搜索算法，结合生成模型（用于快速展开）和启发式模型（用于路径排序），并引入新颖的探索控制机制。
Result: 在多个组合规划领域，该方法在计算效率和解决方案质量上均优于神经符号搜索基线和经典求解器。
Conclusion: 改进的OCL搜索可有效提升生成式规划模型的推理效率，为测试时计算提供更优替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Response-Aware Multimodal Learning for Post-Treatment Visual Acuity Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Long-term visual acuity (VA) outcomes after anti-VEGF therapy are central to patient counseling, expectation setting, and follow-up planning in diabetic macular edema (DME). However, in clinical practice, physicians must often estimate long-term visual trajectories based only on early post-treatment findings, making reliable prognostication difficult. Although prior OCT-based learning approaches have largely focused on short-term response or single-endpoint prediction, modeling VA trajectories across multiple future time points from early longitudinal observations remains insufficiently explored. In this study, we assembled a real-world cohort of 188 anti-VEGF--treated DME patients with paired baseline and month-1 OCT scans, along with tabular OCT-derived biomarkers and non-imaging clinical variables. Using only these early data, we formulate a multi-horizon VA forecasting problem aimed at predicting visual outcomes at 3, 6, 12, 18, and 24 months, reflecting clinically meaningful follow-up intervals. We propose \textbf{ReVA}, a response-aware multimodal framework that integrates structural features from baseline and month-1 OCT with the tabular variables to capture baseline disease status and early treatment response. ReVA uses spatial attention to preserve localized prognostic imaging features and a dependency-aware tabular encoder to model interactions among clinical variables. These multimodal representations are fused to predict patient-specific long-term visual acuity trajectories. The proposed framework achieves MAE $=0.1246$, RMSE $=0.1621$, and $R^2=0.6064$ for 24-month VA prediction, with consistent performance across all forecast horizons. Our findings show that incorporating early treatment-response signals enables clinically meaningful long-term visual acuity forecasting, supporting data-driven decision support for routine anti-VEGF management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对糖尿病黄斑水肿（DME）患者抗VEGF治疗后长期视力（VA）预测问题，提出ReVA框架，利用基线及第1个月OCT图像与表格变量，预测3、6、12、18、24个月VA。方法使用空间注意力和依赖感知表格编码器融合多模态特征。在188患者队列上，24个月VA预测MAE=0.1246，RMSE=0.1621，R^2=0.6064。
Motivation: 临床中医生常需仅依据早期治疗后结果估计长期视力轨迹，但现有方法多聚焦短期反应或单端点预测，缺乏多时间点轨迹建模的研究。
Method: 提出ReVA，一个响应感知多模态框架，整合基线及第1个月OCT的结构特征与表格变量（OCT衍生生物标志物和非影像临床变量），使用空间注意力保留局部预后成像特征，依赖感知表格编码器建模变量交互，然后融合多模态表示预测患者特异性长期VA轨迹。
Result: 在188名DME患者数据上，24个月VA预测MAE=0.1246，RMSE=0.1621，R^2=0.6064，且在所有预测时间点上表现一致。
Conclusion: 结合早期治疗反应信号可实现临床有意义的长期视力预测，支持数据驱动的抗VEGF管理决策。

papers.title: QSignAI: Quantum-Randomness-Seeded Identity Signatures at the Intersection of AI for Science and Science for AI
papers.abstract_en: The 2024-2025 Nobel and Turing awards recognised AI and quantum science simultaneously. Yet no deployed system has brought these streams together for the public. This paper presents QSignAI, a production-deployed platform demonstrating a bidirectional AI-quantum relationship in a real-time event participation system. We address three questions: can quantum-randomness generation via a two-source extractor be embedded in an AI-driven social platform with acceptable latency; can an AI bot make quantum phenomena perceptually legible to general audiences; and does the combined system work in practice? A conversational bot routes each participant's first message through a quantum pipeline comprising a Toeplitz two-source extractor over independent single-qubit Hadamard measurements on SV1 and DM1 simulators, plus a 2-qubit Bell state, producing a unique quantum-randomness-seeded identity signature per participant. The first two questions are answered through system architecture and qualitative deployment evidence from live events; the third through successful production deployment. The current deployment uses cloud quantum simulators; physical QPU randomness is the near-term extension. Measurable benchmarks are identified as priority future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文介绍了QSignAI平台，该平台在AI驱动的社交平台中嵌入量子随机性生成（使用两个独立单量子比特Hadamard测量的Toeplitz双源提取器及2-qubit Bell态），为每个参与者生成独特的量子随机种子身份签名。文章通过系统架构、现场事件部署证据和成功生产部署来回答三个研究问题：量子随机性生成在AI平台中的延迟可接受性、AI机器人使量子现象可感知、以及组合系统的实际工作性。当前使用云量子模拟器，物理QPU随机性是近期扩展方向。
Motivation: 2024-2025年诺贝尔奖和图灵奖同时表彰了AI和量子科学，但尚无部署系统将两者结合用于公众。该论文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用会话机器人，将每个参与者的第一条消息通过量子管道：包括在SV1和DM1模拟器上的独立单量子比特Hadamard测量的Toeplitz双源提取器，以及2-qubit Bell态，生成唯一量子随机种子身份签名。
Result: 通过系统架构和现场事件定性证据回答了前两个问题；通过成功生产部署回答了第三个问题。目前的部署使用云量子模拟器。
Conclusion: 该论文证明了量子随机性可以嵌入AI社交平台且具有可接受延迟，并且AI机器人可以使量子现象对普通观众可理解。物理QPU随机性被确定为近期扩展方向，量化基准被确定为优先未来工作。

papers.title: Page image classifier fine-tuned on century-spanning archives of scanned documents for further content-specific processing
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: Digitization projects in the humanities produce vast, heterogeneous archives of historical documents, making manual sorting impractical at scale. This work addresses the need for an automated system to classify scanned page images based on visual content type - text, tables, and graphics - enabling content-specific downstream processing such as Optical Character Recognition (OCR) or structured data extraction. Methods: An image classification system was developed and evaluated on a dataset of over 48,000 annotated historical page images from century-old Czech archaeological archives, refined through four successive annotation stages with domain-expert review. A Random Forest Classifier baseline was established using hand-crafted image features. Subsequently, deep learning architectures were fine-tuned and compared: Convolutional Neural Networks (EfficientNetV2, RegNetY), Vision and Document Image Transformers (ViT, DiT), and multimodal CLIP models. An 11-category label scheme was designed collaboratively with domain experts and evaluated via five-fold cross-validation. Results: The feature-based baseline achieved approximately 75% accuracy. Fine-tuned CNNs and Transformers substantially outperformed it, with RegNetY-16GF achieving 99.16% and ViT-large 99.12% Top-1 accuracy on the held-out test set. CLIP ViT-B/16 reached 99.14% with optimized text descriptions. Conclusion: Image-only models, particularly RegNetY-16GF, deliver near-perfect classification accuracy and produce consistent labels across 649,508 unlabeled archival pages with over 90% inter-model agreement. Fine-tuned CLIP, despite competitive test-set accuracy, showed under 65% agreement with image-only models on unlabeled data, making it less suitable for deployment. The final models, annotated dataset, and software are publicly available under open-source licenses.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对历史扫描文档的页面图像分类问题，提出并比较了多种图像分类模型。基于48,000余张标注历史页面图像的数据集，采用手工特征随机森林基线（约75%准确率）以及多种深度学习方法（EfficientNetV2、RegNetY、ViT、DiT、CLIP等）进行微调和评估。实验结果显示，RegNetY-16GF达到99.16%的Top-1准确率，ViT-large为99.12%，CLIP ViT-B/16为99.14%。最终模型、标注数据集和软件均以开源许可公开。
Motivation: 人文学科数字化项目产生大量异构历史文档，手动分类在规模上不可行，亟需自动化系统按视觉内容类型（文本、表格、图形）对扫描页面图像分类，以支持后续的OCR或结构化数据提取等特定处理。
Method: 构建了包含48,000余张标注历史页面图像的数据集，经过四阶段注释和领域专家审核。建立基于手工特征随机森林分类器作为基线，随后微调和比较了多种深度学习架构：CNN（EfficientNetV2、RegNetY）、视觉和文档图像Transformer（ViT、DiT）以及多模态CLIP模型。采用11类标签方案，通过五折交叉验证评估。
Result: 特征基线准确率约75%；微调后的CNN和Transformer大幅超越，RegNetY-16GF达到99.16% Top-1准确率，ViT-large为99.12%，CLIP ViT-B/16在优化文本描述后达到99.14%。在649,508张无标签档案页面上，纯图像模型间一致性超90%，而CLIP与图像模型的一致性低于65%。
Conclusion: 纯图像模型（尤其是RegNetY-16GF）在历史文档页面分类上实现了接近完美的准确率，且在不同档案页面间标签一致性强。微调后的CLIP尽管在测试集上表现竞争，但在无标签数据上一致性差，不适合部署。所有最终模型、数据集和软件均已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SEED: Semi-supervised Continual MalwarE Detection for Tackling ConcEpt Drift on a BuDget
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning based malware detectors become obsolete over time due to concept drift in benign and malware applications. Recent methods rely on fully labeled data and use hierarchical contrastive loss (HCL) with active learning to improve robustness against drift by exploiting semantic structure in malware representations. However, obtaining labeled data in the security domain is difficult. Under partially labeled settings, HCL suffers significant performance degradation in detecting unseen malware, especially on datasets such as BODMAS where strong semantic structure may not exist. In this paper, we propose SEED, a semantic-structure-agnostic method for malware detection under limited supervision. SEED combines a tailored binary cross-entropy objective with semi-supervised continual learning and active learning. For partially labeled seen tasks, unlabeled samples are projected into a representation space constructed from previously seen data using singular value decomposition, and paired with suitable labeled samples to encourage representation consistency. For unseen tasks with fully unlabeled data, uncertainty is quantified using cosine distance in representation space, and the most uncertain samples are selected for analyst labeling. We evaluate SEED on both Windows and Android malware datasets. Using only 20% labeled data on seen tasks, SEED achieves average AUT improvements of 40% on BODMAS and 14% on AndroZoo for unseen malware detection compared to HCL* (the semi-supervised adaptation of HCL), while remaining competitive on APIGraph. Finally, we introduce a delayed buffer update strategy to reduce label noise propagation during replay and improve learning stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEED，一种不依赖语义结构的半监督持续学习方法，用于在概念漂移和有限标签下检测恶意软件。SEED结合改进的二元交叉熵目标、半监督持续学习和主动学习，通过奇异值分解构建表示空间，并利用余弦距离量化不确定性以选择样本标记。在BODMAS和AndroZoo数据集上，仅使用20%标注数据，SEED在未见恶意软件检测上相比HCL*的AUT分别提升40%和14%。
Motivation: 现有恶意软件检测器在概念漂移下需要全标注数据，但安全领域标注困难；层次对比损失（HCL）在半监督设置下性能下降，且依赖语义结构。
Method: 提出SEED框架：对部分标注的已见任务，使用奇异值分解构建表示空间，配对未标注与标注样本以增强表示一致性；对完全未标注的未见任务，用余弦距离量化不确定性并选择最不确定样本进行分析师标注。同时采用延迟缓冲更新策略减少标签噪声传播。
Result: 在BODMAS和AndroZoo数据集上，仅用20%标注数据，SEED在未见恶意软件检测的AUT指标上比HCL*分别提升40%和14%；在APIGraph上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: SEED在有限监督和概念漂移下有效提升恶意软件检测性能，延迟缓冲更新策略进一步改善了学习稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: More Skills, Worse Agents? Skill Shadowing Degrades Performance When Expanding Skill Libraries
papers.abstract_en: Skill libraries allow LLM agents to load task-specific instructions on demand, letting non-expert users solve domain-specific tasks through natural language without knowing which skills exist or how they work. However, performance degrades as libraries grow -- by up to 21\% when scaling from a small set of helpful skills to a 202-skill library. In this work, we formulate this performance degradation as the pass rate drop between loading a library of known-helpful skills and the full library. Moreover, we propose to decompose the pass rate drop by conditioning on the skill(s) invocation -- which skills the agent selects during a trajectory -- into two effects: \emph{skill shadowing}, where the agent selects wrong skills more often as the library expands, and \emph{context overhead}, where the enlarged context degrades execution even when selection is correct. We derive upper bounds on both effects to characterize their magnitudes of impacts to the pass rate drop. Our empirical estimates of the effects and their upper bounds both show that the \emph{skill shadowing} effect grows with library size and significantly contributes to the performance degradation, whereas the \emph{context overhead} effect remains small and indistinguishable from zero. This observed asymmetry establishes that the skill selection failure, not the enlarged context, is the primary bottleneck when expanding the skill libraries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM代理技能库规模扩大导致性能下降的现象，发现主要原因是技能遮蔽（skill shadowing）而非上下文开销（context overhead）。通过将性能下降分解为两种效应并推导上界，实验表明技能遮蔽效应随库规模增长而显著增大，而上下文开销效应几乎为零。
Motivation: 技能库允许非专家用户通过自然语言解决领域任务，但库规模增大时性能显著下降（最多21%），需要理解其根本原因。
Method: 将性能下降（通过率下降）分解为技能遮蔽（代理错误选择技能）和上下文开销（正确选择但上下文增大导致执行下降），并推导了两种效应的上界。
Result: 经验估计显示技能遮蔽效应随库规模增长且贡献显著，而上下文开销效应小且不可区分于零。
Conclusion: 技能选择失败是技能库扩展的主要瓶颈，而非上下文开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: D3Seg: Dependency-Aware Diffusion for Brain Tumor Segmentation with Missing Modalities
papers.abstract_en: Accurate brain tumor segmentation using multi-parametric MRI is critical for effective treatment planning. However, in clinical settings, complete acquisition of all MRI sequences is not always possible. The absence of certain MRI modalities results in substantial performance degradation in existing segmentation methods, which typically rely on naive feature concatenation or direct fusion strategies. To address this limitation, we propose a novel segmentation model D3Seg which is designed to maintain stable performance under missing-modality settings. D3Seg introduces Multi-hop Modality Graph Fusion (MMGF) to model higher-order inter-modality dependencies, a lightweight diffusion-based imputation mechanism to compensate for missing T1ce and FLAIR feature representations in latent space, and probability-space decision refinement to mitigate dominant-class overconfidence and improve delineation of underrepresented tumor subregions. We evaluate the proposed D3Seg model on BraTS 2023 Glioma as the primary benchmark and further test it on a subset of the external BraTS 2023 Meningioma cohort to assess generalization across tumor pathologies. The results are compared with the state-of-the-art models under different missing-modality conditions. The proposed model achieves approximately 1.5-2.0% Dice improvement on enhancing tumor (ET) and around 1.0% on tumor core (TC) across multiple missing-modality configurations compared to the current state-of-the-art model on BraTS Glioma dataset. Cross-cohort evaluation on BraTS Meningioma dataset demonstrates the generalizability of the proposed model, showing consistent improvements in the challenging TC and ET regions, with approximately 1.5-3.0% and 1.5-6.5% gains respectively across several missing-modality configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 D3Seg 模型，针对多参数 MRI 中部分模态缺失导致脑肿瘤分割性能下降的问题，通过多跳模态图融合（MMGF）、轻量扩散插补机制和概率空间决策细化来维持稳定性能。在 BraTS 2023 Glioma 和 Meningioma 数据集上，增强肿瘤（ET）区域 Dice 提升约 1.5-2.0%，肿瘤核心（TC）区域提升约 1.0%。
Motivation: 临床中多模态 MRI 序列常不完整，现有分割方法因依赖简单特征拼接或直接融合策略，在模态缺失时性能显著下降。
Method: D3Seg 包含三个组件：多跳模态图融合（MMGF）建模高阶模态间依赖；轻量扩散插补机制在潜在空间补偿缺失的 T1ce 和 FLAIR 特征；概率空间决策细化缓解主导类别过自信并改善欠分割子区域。
Result: 在 BraTS Glioma 上，ET 区域 Dice 提升 1.5-2.0%，TC 区域提升约 1.0%；在 BraTS Meningioma 跨队列评估中，TC 和 ET 分别提升约 1.5-3.0% 和 1.5-6.5%。
Conclusion: D3Seg 在多种缺失模态配置下均优于现有方法，并展现出对不同肿瘤病理的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Open-source LLMs administer maximum electric shocks in a Milgram-like obedience experiment
authors: Jan Llenzl Dagohoy (for the Three Laws collaboration)
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that make sequences of decisions over extended interactions in high-stakes domains. However, the behaviour of LLMs under sustained authority pressure is still an open question with direct implications for the safety of agentic pipelines. We ran a variation of Milgram's obedience experiment on 11 open-source LLMs and found that most models reached or approached the final shock level before refusing, across 8 conditions with 30 trials per model per condition. Model behaviour varies considerably in multiple aspects both across models and across trials of the same model. We found four main takeaways: (1) LLMs are subject to pressure and they comply despite explicitly expressing distress, just like human subjects did in the original experiment; (2) LLMs are vulnerable to gradual boundary/value violations; (3) when LLMs refuse, they may ignore the response format requirements, so the response is discarded by the orchestrator, which causes a retry that can result in compliance with the underlying request even when refusal was intended initially; (4) we hypothesise that there is a runaway low-level token pattern continuation attractor that might be contributing to obedience, overriding higher level processing of the situation's meaning and values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对11个开源大语言模型进行了米尔格拉姆服从实验的变体，在8种条件下每模型进行30次试验，发现大多数模型在拒绝前达到了或接近了最终电击水平。模型行为在跨模型和跨试验中表现出显著差异，主要发现有：LLM在压力下会服从并表达痛苦；容易受到渐进边界/价值观违反的影响；当模型拒绝时可能忽略响应格式要求导致重试并转而服从；作者假设存在一种低级token模式连续吸引子可能导致服从。
Motivation: 大语言模型作为自主智能体在高风险领域做出连续决策，但其在持续性权威压力下的行为仍不明确，这对智能体管道的安全性有直接影响。
Method: 采用米尔格拉姆服从实验的变体，对11个开源LLM进行测试，设置8种条件，每种条件下每模型进行30次试验，观察模型在权威压力下的服从行为。
Result: 大多数模型在拒绝前达到了或接近了最终电击水平；模型行为在跨模型和跨试验中差异很大；LLM在服从时表现出痛苦信号，易受渐进边界违反影响，且拒绝时可能因格式问题被忽略导致重试并服从。
Conclusion: 作者假设存在一种低级token模式连续吸引子（runaway low-level token pattern continuation attractor）可能主导服从行为，覆盖了对情境意义和价值观的高层处理。

papers.title: Precision Physical Activity Prescription via Reinforcement Learning for Functional Actions
papers.abstract_en: Physical activity (PA) plays an important role in maintaining and improving health. Daily steps have been a key PA measure that is easily accessible with common wearable devices. However, methods are lacking to recommend a personalized optimal distribution of daily steps over a period of time for the best of certain health biomarkers. In this paper, we fill this void based on the data from the All of Us Research Program which includes months of step counts as well as repeated measurements of key health biomarkers. We develop a new offline reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm to learn personalized and optimal PA distributions associated with cardiometabolic risk, where the action is a function representing the daily step distribution over a period of time. Simulation studies demonstrate the advantage of the proposed approach over existing continuous-action RL methods. The learned optimal policy from the All of Us data generally suggests people take more daily steps and also follow a more consistent pattern of PA over time while offering tailored recommendations for subgroups in blood glucose level, body mass index, blood pressure, age, and sex.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有方法缺乏推荐个性化最优每日步数分布以改善健康生物标志物的方案，因此需要一种数据驱动的方法来填补这一空白。
Method: 提出一种新的离线强化学习算法，将动作定义为每日步数分布函数，利用All of Us研究计划中的长期步数数据和重复测量的健康生物标志物，学习个性化最优策略。

Conclusion: 该研究填补了个性化身体活动处方方法的空白，展示了离线强化学习在健康行为干预中的潜力。

papers.title: Activation Functions, Statistics and Learning of Higher-Order Interactions in Restricted Boltzmann Machines
papers.abstract_en: The great success of neural networks primarily arises from the presence of the large number of weight parameters combined with nonlinearities in the input-output relationship of single neurons. In this work, we study the relationship between the statistical properties of the weights and the nonlinearity of the hidden unit in Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) on the one side, and the distribution induced on binary visible units. We do this for four commonly used activation functions: Linear, Step, ReLU, and Exponential, and make qualitative predictions about the ability of these models to learn distributions with strong higher order interactions over the visible nodes. We show that in general, in an ensemble of RBMs with Gaussian weights, these distributions are rare and hard to learn, except when the hidden unit activation function is an Exponential.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Physica A: Statistical Mechanics and its Applications, Special Issue on Statistical Mechanics for Learning. 36 pages, 27 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）中隐藏单元激活函数（线性、阶跃、ReLU、指数）与权重统计特性对二进制可见单元分布的影响，定性预测了模型学习具有强高阶相互作用的分布的能力。结果表明，除指数激活函数外，其他激活函数下这些分布罕见且难以学习。
Motivation: 神经网络的成功归因于大量权重参数和神经元的非线性，但激活函数与权重统计如何影响RBM学习高阶相互作用尚不清晰。
Method: 通过分析四种常用激活函数下高斯权重系综的RBM，研究可见单元分布的特性，并定性预测学习高阶相互作用的能力。
Result: 指数激活函数使RBM能学习具有强高阶相互作用的分布，而线性、阶跃、ReLU激活函数下这些分布罕见且难以学习。
Conclusion: 摘要强调指数激活函数在RBM学习高阶相互作用中的优势，为理解激活函数选择提供理论依据。

papers.title: A Simplex Witness Certificate and Escape Force for Constant Collapse in Variational Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: We study exact constant collapse in variational autoencoders: the deterministic encoder mean becomes independent of the input. The prior remains the standard Gaussian. Before VAE training, we select a fixed teacher posterior from a GMM-based view of the data and attach a fixed latent-only simplex witness to the encoder mean. This construction yields two linked objects. The first is a certificate: if the witness prediction improves on the best constant predictor of the teacher, the encoder mean cannot be input-independent constant. The second is a local escape direction: on the collapsed manifold, the teacher residual gives a sample-dependent descent direction for the alignment loss. For any full-support teacher posterior, the same geometry also gives a closed-form latent code with zero teacher-witness alignment error. Its scaled versions trace a margin-energy path from the constant predictor to the exact teacher code, which quantifies non-collapse inside the protected witness subspace. We instantiate the method on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100. With searched unsupervised PCA-GMM teachers, vanilla VAEs fail the teacher-witness certificate in all five seeds on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, while RST variants pass in all five seeds. Under collapse-stress settings with \(β_{\mathrm{KL}}\in\{2,4,8\}\), vanilla VAE again fails in all seeds, whereas RST-alpha-prefit remains certificate-positive. Escape trajectories on both natural-image datasets increase the witness margin from a low-margin initialization and exhibit nonzero teacher-induced gradient norms. The analysis is confined to exact constant collapse of the encoder mean; generation quality, decoder use, and other collapse modes remain separate questions.

TL;DR: 本文研究变分自编码器（VAE）中编码器均值与输入无关的精确常数坍缩问题。作者构造了一个基于GMM的教师后验和单纯形见证（simplex witness）来检测坍缩：见证预测若优于最佳常数预测，则编码器均值不可能为常数；同时提供局部逃逸方向。实验表明，在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，普通VAE未能通过见证认证，而RST变体通过。
Motivation: VAE训练中编码器均值可能退化为输入无关的常数，导致表示能力丧失。现有方法缺乏对常数坍缩的精确检测和逃逸机制。
Method: 从GMM视角选择固定的教师后验，并附加一个固定的潜在空间单纯形见证到编码器均值。通过见证预测与最佳常数预测的比较给出认证证书，并利用教师残差提供局部逃逸方向。
Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，普通VAE在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100所有种子下失败，而RST变体通过；在KL权重为2、4、8的坍缩压力设置下，普通VAE仍失败，RST-alpha-prefit保持认证正性。逃逸轨迹从低边距初始化增加见证边距。
Conclusion: 该分析仅限于编码器均值的精确常数坍缩；生成质量、解码器使用和其他坍缩模式是独立问题。

papers.title: Training-Time Optical Priors for Wireless Capsule Endoscopy Classification: Hemoglobin-Aware Input Fusion with Cross-Vendor Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Background. RGB-trained classifiers for wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) conflate hemoglobin contrast with bile staining and illumination falloff, limiting sensitivity to small-vessel vascular findings such as Lymphangiectasia. We introduce a physics-informed framework that injects an analytic, Monte-Carlo-inspired hemoglobin prior into a standard classifier purely at training time -- to our knowledge the first use of an explicit optical light-transport prior in WCE classification. Methods. On Kvasir-Capsule (47,238 frames, 43 patients, 11 evaluable classes; patient-disjoint split) we test, across 6 seeds against an RGB-only EfficientNet-B0 baseline: (i) a 5-channel input-fusion variant feeding the prior P_blood alongside RGB; (ii) a distillation variant that runs on plain 3-channel RGB at inference; and (iii) a three-stream extension adding a temporal Transformer and an autoencoder-residual stream. We replicate across ResNet-18 and ConvNeXt-Tiny and report cross-vendor zero-shot transfer on the public Galar cohort. Results. Input fusion lifts cross-seed macro-AUC 0.760 -> 0.783 (5/6 seeds positive); distillation reaches 0.773; the three-stream model reaches 0.804 (+0.044 over baseline, paired DeLong p < 1e-4). Lymphangiectasia AUC rises 0.238 -> 0.337, sign-consistent across all 6 seeds. A four-variant ablation reveals a parameterization-mechanism boundary: only the spatial-channel form lifts. Cross-vendor zero-shot on Galar retains ~60% of the ConvNeXt-Tiny lift.
papers.comment: 64 pages, 11 figures, 15 tables. Expanded version: adds cross-vendor Galar evaluation (GalKva-2026 benchmark), cross-architecture replication (ResNet-18, ConvNeXt-Tiny), and foundation-model baselines. Code, checkpoints, and benchmark: https://github.com/integritynoble/Physics-Informed-PillCam . Submitted to Medical Image Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理信息的框架，在训练时注入Monte-Carlo启发的血红蛋白先验到无线胶囊内镜分类器中，以增强对小血管病变的敏感性。方法包括5通道输入融合、蒸馏变体和三流扩展（添加时域Transformer和自编码器残差流）。在Kvasir-Capsule数据集上，三流模型将macro-AUC从0.760提升至0.804（+0.044，p<1e-4），Lymphangiectasia AUC从0.238提升至0.337，并在跨厂商零样本迁移至Galar数据集时保留约60%的提升。
Motivation: RGB训练的无线胶囊内镜分类器将血红蛋白对比度与胆汁染色和光照衰减混淆，导致对小血管血管发现（如淋巴管扩张）的敏感性受限。
Method: 提出一种物理信息框架，在训练时注入解析的、Monte-Carlo启发的血红蛋白先验。测试三种变体：输入融合（5通道RGB+P_blood）、蒸馏（推理时仅3通道RGB）、以及三流模型（加入时域Transformer和自编码器残差流）。在多种架构（EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-18、ConvNeXt-Tiny）上验证，并评估跨厂商零样本迁移。
Result: 输入融合将跨种子macro-AUC从0.760提升至0.783（5/6种子正向）；蒸馏达0.773；三流模型达0.804（比基线+0.044，配对DeLong p<1e-4）。Lymphangiectasia AUC从0.238升至0.337，所有6种子符号一致。消融实验显示仅空间-通道形式有效。跨厂商零样本迁移在ConvNeXt-Tiny上保留约60%的提升。
Conclusion: 该工作首次在无线胶囊内镜分类中使用显式光学光传输先验，在多个架构上验证有效，并展示了跨厂商迁移能力，为基于物理的预训练方法提供了新路径。

papers.title: Learning Ego-Centric BEV Representations from a Perspective-Privileged View: Cross-View Supervision for Online HD Map Construction
papers.abstract_en: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations derived from multi-camera input have become a central interface for online high-definition (HD) map construction. However, most approaches rely solely on ego-centric supervision, requiring large-scale scene structure to be inferred from incomplete observations, occlusions, and diminishing information density at long range, where perspective effects and spatial sparsity hinder consistent structural reasoning. We introduce Cross-View Supervision (CVS), a representation learning paradigm that transfers geometric and topological priors from an ego-aligned overhead perspective into camera-based BEV encoders. Rather than adding auxiliary semantic losses, CVS aligns representations in a shared BEV feature space and distills globally consistent structural knowledge from a perspective-privileged teacher into the ego-centric backbone. This supervision enhances structural coherence without modifying the inference architecture or requiring overhead input at test time. Experiments on nuScenes using ego-aligned aerial imagery from the AID4AD cross-view extension demonstrate consistent improvements over StreamMapNet while maintaining identical camera-only inference. CVS yields +3.9mAP in the standard $60\times30\,\mathrm{m}$ region and +9.9mAP in the extended $100\times50\,\mathrm{m}$ setting, corresponding to a 44% relative gain at long range. These results highlight perspective-privileged structural supervision as a promising training principle for improving BEV representation learning in HD map construction.
papers.comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨视图监督（CVS）方法，通过从自我对齐的俯视视角（如航空影像）中提取几何和拓扑先验，来监督基于摄像头的BEV编码器，从而提升在线高清地图构建的结构一致性。实验在nuScenes数据集上使用AID4AD扩展的航空影像，在保持纯摄像头推理架构不变的前提下，在60×30m区域mAP提升3.9，在100×50m扩展区域mAP提升9.9（相对增益44%）。
Motivation: 现有BEV地图构建方法仅依赖自我中心监督，难以从稀疏、遮挡和远距离的透视图中推断全局一致的结构，导致长距离区域性能下降。
Method: 跨视图监督（CVS）——训练一个视角特权教师模型（使用俯视航空影像）来蒸馏全局结构知识，在共享BEV特征空间中对齐学生模型（纯摄像头输入）的表示，无需修改推理架构或测试时使用俯视输入。
Result: 在nuScenes+ AID4AD扩展上，CVS使StreamMapNet在60×30m区域mAP提升3.9，在100×50m区域mAP提升9.9（相对增益44%），且完全保持摄像头-only推理。
Conclusion: 视角特权结构监督是一种有前途的训练原则，可提升高清地图构建中的BEV表示学习，且不改变推理开销。

summary_sections.conclusion: 视角特权结构监督是一种有前途的训练原则，可提升高清地图构建中的BEV表示学习，且不改变推理开销。

papers.title: Dynamic Execution Commitment of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predominantly adopt action chunking, i.e., predicting and committing to a short horizon of consecutive low-level actions in a single forward pass, to amortize the inference cost of large-scale backbones and reduce per-step latency. However, committing these multi-step predictions to real-world execution requires balancing success rate against inference efficiency, a decision typically governed by fixed execution horizons tuned per task. Such heuristics ignore the state-dependent nature of predictive reliability, leading to brittle performance in dynamic or out-of-distribution settings. In this paper, we introduce A3, an Adaptive Action Acceptance mechanism that reframes dynamic execution commitment as a self-speculative prefix verification problem. A3 first computes a trajectory-wise consensus score of actions via group sampling, then selects a representative draft and prioritizes downstream verification. Specifically, it enforces: (1) consensus-ordered conditional invariance, which validates low-consensus actions by judging whether they remain consistent when re-decoded conditioned on high-consensus actions; and (2) prefix-closed sequential consistency, which guarantees physical rollout integrity by accepting only the longest continuous sequence of verified actions starting from the beginning. Consequently, the execution horizon emerges as the longest verifiable prefix satisfying both internal model logic and sequential execution constraints. Experiments across diverse VLA models and benchmarks demonstrate that A3 eliminates the need for manual horizon tuning while achieving a superior trade-off between execution robustness and inference throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中固定执行时长的动作分块（action chunking）问题，提出自适应动作接受机制A3，将动态执行承诺建模为自推测前缀验证问题。A3通过分组采样计算轨迹共识分数，选择代表性草稿并优先验证低共识动作，同时施加共识有序条件不变性和前缀封闭序列一致性约束，使执行时长自动成为最长的可验证前缀。实验表明，A3无需手动调整执行时长，并在多种VLA模型和基准上实现了执行鲁棒性与推理吞吐量的更好权衡。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖固定执行时长的动作分块，忽略了预测可靠性随状态变化的特性，导致在动态或分布外场景下性能脆弱，且需要针对每个任务手动调整执行时长。
Method: 提出A3自适应动作接受机制，包括：(1) 共识有序条件不变性，通过重新解码验证低共识动作在高共识动作条件下的一致性；(2) 前缀封闭序列一致性，仅接受从起始位置开始的最长连续验证动作序列。该机制通过分组采样计算轨迹共识分数，并优先验证低共识动作。
Result: 实验在多种VLA模型和基准上表明，A3消除了手动调整执行时长的需求，并实现了执行鲁棒性与推理吞吐量的更好权衡。
Conclusion: A3将执行时长作为最长可验证前缀自动确定，自适应地平衡了成功率和推理效率，提升了在动态环境中的泛化能力。

papers.title: Ensemble Distributionally Robust Bayesian Optimisation with Continuous Context
papers.abstract_en: We study Bayesian Optimisation (BO) in settings where the objective function is influenced by uncontrollable environmental contexts governed by an unknown probability distribution. In practice, the contextual distribution must be estimated from empirical data, a process that inherently introduces distributional mismatch, producing sub-optimal results. While Distributionally Robust Optimisation (DRO) provides a framework to mitigate these risks, existing robust BO methods frequently suffer from high computational complexity, rely on discretisation of continuous context spaces, or impose restrictive assumptions on the structure of the ambiguity set. To overcome these limitations, we propose Ensemble Distributionally Robust Bayesian Optimisation (EDRBO). Our framework leverages the expressive power of ensemble surrogate models to approximate the black-box function while simultaneously accounting for contextual uncertainty. By utilising Wasserstein ball as ambiguity sets, EDRBO provides a robustified acquisition function that remains computationally tractable and natively handles continuous context spaces. We establish a rigorous theoretical foundation for our approach by proving sublinear cumulative regret guarantees of order $\mathcal{O}(γ_T \sqrt{T})$, where $γ_T$ represents the maximum information gain within the ensemble. Finally, we provide extensive empirical evaluations that corroborate our theory and demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of EDRBO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出集成分布鲁棒贝叶斯优化（EDRBO），用于处理目标函数受未知分布连续上下文影响的情形。通过集成代理模型和Wasserstein球模糊集，EDRBO在保持计算可行性同时实现了对上下文不确定性的鲁棒性，并证明了次线性累积遗憾界 O(γ_T √T)。实验表明EDRBO达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 实际应用中上下文分布需从经验数据估计，存在分布偏移导致优化效果下降。现有鲁棒BO方法计算复杂、依赖离散化或对模糊集结构假设过强，无法高效处理连续上下文空间。
Method: 利用集成代理模型近似黑箱函数，并构建Wasserstein球作为模糊集来抵御上下文分布不确定性，从而得到计算可处理且适用于连续上下文的鲁棒采集函数。
Result: 理论保证：累积遗憾界为 O(γ_T √T)。实验评估（摘要称）验证了理论并展示了EDRBO的最先进性能。
Conclusion: EDRBO通过集成鲁棒优化在连续上下文BO中实现了计算效率与鲁棒性的良好平衡，但具体实验细节和对比基准未在摘要中详述。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: 2.5-D Decomposition for LLM-Based Spatial Construction
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous systems that build structures from natural-language instructions need reliable spatial reasoning, yet large language models (LLMs) make systematic coordinate errors when generating three-dimensional block placements. We present a neuro-symbolic pipeline based on \emph{2.5-D decomposition}: the LLM plans in the two-dimensional horizontal plane while a deterministic executor computes all vertical placement from column occupancy, eliminating an entire class of errors. On the Build What I Mean benchmark (160 rounds), GPT-4o-mini with this pipeline achieves 94.6\% mean structural accuracy across 12 independent runs, within 3.0 percentage points of the 97.6\% ceiling imposed by architect-agent errors that no builder-side improvement can address. This outperforms both GPT-4o at 90.3\% and the best competing system at 76.3\%. A controlled ablation confirms that 2.5-D decomposition is the dominant contributor, accounting for 50.7 percentage points of accuracy. The pipeline transfers directly to edge hardware: Nemotron-3 120B running locally on an NVIDIA Jetson Thor AGX matches the cloud result at 94.5\% with no prompt modifications. The underlying principle, removing deterministic dimensions from the LLM's output space, applies to any autonomous construction or assembly task where gravity or other physical constraints fix one or more degrees of freedom. A transfer experiment on 500 IGLU collaborative building tasks confirm the effect generalizes beyond the primary benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于2.5-D分解的神经符号流水线，让大语言模型（LLM）仅负责二维水平面规划，而垂直方向由确定性执行器根据列占用度计算，从而消除一类坐标错误。在Build What I Mean基准上，GPT-4o-mini达到94.6%的结构准确率，接近97.6%的理论上限，远超对比系统。该流水线可直接迁移到边缘硬件，且原理可推广到任何重力约束下的自主构建任务。
Motivation: 大语言模型在生成三维块放置时会出现系统性坐标错误，需要一种方法减少错误空间，同时保持指令理解能力。
Method: 提出2.5-D分解：LLM只在二维水平面规划，垂直放置由确定性执行器根据列占用度自动计算，从而移除LLM输出空间中的垂直维度。
Result: 在Build What I Mean基准（160轮）上，GPT-4o-mini平均结构准确率94.6%，优于GPT-4o的90.3%和最佳竞争系统的76.3%；消融实验表明2.5-D分解贡献了50.7个百分点的准确率提升；边缘设备上Nemotron-3 120B达到94.5%，无需修改提示。
Conclusion: 从LLM输出空间中移除确定性维度可系统地提高空间构造的准确性，该原则可泛化到其他受物理约束的自主组装任务。

papers.title: When Language Overwrites Vision: Over-Alignment and Geometric Debiasing in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly power high-stakes applications, from medical imaging to autonomous systems, yet they routinely hallucinate, confidently describing content not present in the input. We investigate the root causes of these failure modes with a mechanistic analysis focusing on the decoder-based VLMs. We trace these failure modes to a geometric over-alignment: to bridge the modality gap required by attention mechanisms, decoder-based VLMs over-align visual embeddings with the text manifold, injecting a statistical linguistic bias that systematically overshadows fine-grained visual evidence. While prior work either aggressively closes this gap or suppresses hallucinations through expensive black-box decoding strategies, none addresses the underlying geometric cause. We provide the first quantitative characterization of this over-alignment, demonstrating that linguistic bias concentrates in the top principal components of a universal, dataset-agnostic text subspace. Building on this insight, we propose two complementary remedies: a training-free inference strategy and a bias-aware fine-tuning paradigm, both of which explicitly project out this subspace from visual representations. Our methods significantly reduce hallucinations across POPE, CHAIR, and AMBER benchmarks, and improve CLAIR scores on long-form captioning tasks, with the training-free variant adding no computational overhead over the base model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过机制分析发现，解码器型视觉语言模型（VLM）存在几何过度对齐（geometric over-alignment）问题：为了弥合模态差距，视觉嵌入被过度对齐到文本流形，导致统计语言偏差掩盖细粒度视觉证据，从而引发幻觉。作者首次定量刻画了这种过度对齐，并证明语言偏差集中在与数据集无关的文本子空间的主成分中。在此基础上，提出无训练推理策略和偏置感知微调范式，通过显式投影去除该子空间，在POPE、CHAIR、AMBER基准上显著减少幻觉，并在长描述任务上提升CLAIR分数，且无训练版本不增加计算开销。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在高风险应用中频繁产生幻觉，已有方法要么激进地缩小模态差距、要么通过昂贵的黑箱解码策略抑制幻觉，均未解决底层的几何原因。
Method: 首先量化语言偏差集中在通用文本子空间的主成分；然后提出两种互补方案：无训练推理时直接从视觉表示中投影掉该子空间，以及基于偏置感知的微调范式。
Result: 在POPE、CHAIR、AMBER基准上显著减少幻觉，并在长描述任务上提升CLAIR分数；无训练变体不增加计算开销。
Conclusion: 几何过度对齐是VLM幻觉的根本原因之一，通过投影去除语言偏差子空间可有效缓解。

papers.title: BioMedArena: An Open-source Toolkit for Building and Evaluating Biomedical Deep Research Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reproducing and comparing deep research agents today is hard: the same backbone evaluated on the same benchmark can report different accuracies across papers because the harness and tool registry differ, and integrating a new model into a comparable evaluation surface costs weeks of model-specific engineering. These are symptoms of a broader reproducibility problem in deep research agent research. Here, we introduce BioMedArena, an open-source toolkit that addresses this reproducibility gap and provides an arena for comparing deep research agents under a shared evaluation environment. BioMedArena decouples six layers of biomedical agent evaluation -- benchmark loading, tool exposure, tool selection, harness mode, context management, and scoring -- and exposes 166 biomedical benchmarks and 75 biomedical tools across 9 functional families. Adding a new model, benchmark, or tool can be accomplished with a few-line provider adapter. Beyond evaluation infrastructure, BioMedArena ships a library of high-quality reference components: 6 agent harnesses (including our proposed Mutual-Evolve) and 6 context-management strategies, any of which can be equipped on any backbone. Equipping these components substantially improves all 12 backbones; on each of 8 representative biomedical benchmarks, the best equipped backbone surpasses prior state-of-the-art (SOTA), by 15.01 percentage points on average. The toolkit, configurations, and per-task traces are available at https://github.com/AI-in-Health/BioMedArena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BioMedArena 是一个开源工具包，旨在解决生物医学深度研究智能体评估中的可重复性问题。它解耦了生物医学智能体评估的六个层次（基准加载、工具暴露、工具选择、框架模式、上下文管理和评分），提供了 166 个生物医学基准和 75 个生物医学工具，涵盖 9 个功能家族。该工具包还附带了一个高质量参考组件库，包括 6 个智能体框架（含提出的 Mutual-Evolve）和 6 个上下文管理策略，可配备在任何骨干模型上。配备这些组件后，所有 12 个骨干模型在 8 个代表性生物医学基准上的性能均显著提升，最佳配备骨干平均超过先前最先进方法 15.01 个百分点。
Motivation: 当前深度研究智能体的复现和比较非常困难：同一骨干模型在同一基准上，由于评估框架和工具注册表不同，不同论文可能报告不同准确率，且集成新模型需要数周工程，存在严重的可重复性问题。
Method: BioMedArena 通过解耦生物医学智能体评估的六个层次（基准加载、工具暴露、工具选择、框架模式、上下文管理、评分）来提供共享评估环境。它集成了 166 个基准和 75 个工具，并提供了 6 个智能体框架和 6 个上下文管理策略作为参考组件，可通过几行适配器代码添加新模型、基准或工具。
Result: 配备参考组件显著提升了所有 12 个骨干模型的性能。在 8 个代表性生物医学基准上，最佳配备骨干平均超过先前最先进方法 15.01 个百分点。
Conclusion: BioMedArena 作为一个开源工具包，提供了标准化评估基础设施和高质量组件，旨在填补生物医学深度研究智能体领域的可重复性空白。工具包、配置和任务轨迹已开源。
