papers.title: Faithful by Construction: Claim-Anchored Attribution for Multi-Document Summarization
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end large language models (LLMs) produce fluent multi-document summaries but remain prone to hallucination, and the attributions they offer are typically coarse (whole documents or passages) and generated post hoc, leaving each summary statement hard to verify. We revisit the modular Extract--Select--Rewrite paradigm and recast its intermediate representation as the unit of attribution. We present CAMS, a Claim-Anchored Multi-document Summarization framework that (i) extracts atomic claims with token-level provenance from every source document, (ii) clusters equivalent claims across documents while flagging inter-source conflicts, (iii) selects a support-aware and salient subset, and (iv) rewrites the selection into a summary in which every sentence is anchored to a support-checked claim that links back to one or more source spans. Because content is localized before it is realized, the pipeline is attribution-oriented by construction and faithfulness-oriented by construction: it structurally preserves fine-grained, multi-source traceability while using support-aware selection, constrained rewriting, and verification to encourage, rather than guarantee, factual faithfulness. We evaluate quality, faithfulness, and localization on MultiNews, analyze conflict handling on DiverseSumm, and test zero-shot transfer on WCEP, using a two-regime protocol that separates reference-free citation quality from gold-aligned localization accuracy, and we add an evaluator-decoupled audit that tests citation precision with a support model never used for selection or verification. CAMS matches strong end-to-end and span-attribution baselines on summary quality while substantially improving faithfulness and citation precision, lifting multi-source attribution accuracy by roughly two-thirds, and exposing a controllable faithfulness--coverage trade-off that end-to-end models leave implicit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAMS框架，将多文档摘要重构为基于可信声明的流水线：提取带有token级来源的原子声明、跨文档聚类并标记冲突、选择支持充分且突出的子集、重写为每句都可追溯至源跨度且经过支持检查的摘要。由于内容在生成前已被定位，该流水线通过构造实现细粒度多源可追溯性，并通过支持感知选择、约束重写和验证来鼓励事实忠实性。
Motivation: 端到端LLM在多文档摘要中易产生幻觉，且其归因通常是粗粒度的（整篇文档或段落）且事后生成，难以验证单个摘要陈述。
Method: CAMS框架包含四个步骤：(i) 从每篇源文档提取原子声明及其token级出处；(ii) 跨文档聚类等值声明并标记冲突；(iii) 选择支持充分且突出的声明子集；(iv) 将选择重写为摘要，其中每句都锚定于一个经支持检查的声明，该声明链接回一个或多个源跨度。
Result: 在MultiNews上评估质量、忠实性和定位精度，在DiverseSumm上分析冲突处理，在WCEP上测试零样本迁移。CAMS在摘要质量上与强端到端和跨度归因基线相当，同时显著提升忠实性和引文精度，多源归因精度提高约三分之二，并揭示了可控的忠实性-覆盖权衡。
Conclusion: CAMS通过构造实现了面向归因和忠实性的流水线，在保持摘要质量的前提下大幅提升事实忠实性和引文精度，但摘要强调该方法鼓励而非保证事实忠实性。

papers.title: Maestro Order: A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Harness
papers.abstract_en: A single forward pass of a capable model is a fast, fluent, and unreliable problem-solver: it is right often enough to be useful and wrong often enough to be dangerous; in language models, such confident errors are known as hallucinations. We present Maestro Order, a model-agnostic orchestration harness that turns unreliable solvers into reliable problem-solving systems by composing them according to four structural primitives (decompose, ensemble, verify, and recurse) and a budget-aware controller that decides where to spend compute. The harness treats any model as a black-box base solver behind a uniform interface, layers a verifier ensemble whose discrimination is measured online, and allocates verification and voting to the stages with the highest marginal reliability per unit cost. We give the architecture, the message and state schema, the controller algorithm, and the engineering that makes it deterministic, observable, and fault-tolerant. We then specify an evaluation methodology (reliability at fixed cost, coverage, calibration, and ablations) and report results from a faithful Monte Carlo simulation of the harness over a parameterized solver/verifier model. The simulation reproduces the predicted laws quantitatively: verification amplifies reliability geometrically (e.g. $0.55\to0.98$ with two gates, $\to0.999$ with four), voting helps only above chance and is limited by shared errors, and a budget-aware controller reaches a target reliability at a small fraction of the cost of voting alone by selecting the cheapest mechanism for each regime. We close with failure modes (verifier gaming, correlated errors, and decomposition error compounding) and concrete guidance: build robust checkers, diversify solvers, and let the controller put compute where the information is.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Maestro Order，一个模型无关的编排框架，将不可靠的模型（如语言模型）组合成可靠的问题求解系统。框架基于分解、集成、验证和递归四种结构原语，并通过预算感知控制器分配计算资源。在参数化求解器/验证器模型的蒙特卡洛模拟中，验证以几何级数提升可靠性（例如，两个门控从0.55提升至0.98，四个门控提升至0.999），集成仅在高于随机水平时有效且受共享错误限制，预算感知控制器以远低于纯集成的成本达到目标可靠性。文章还讨论了故障模式如验证器欺骗、相关错误和分解错误累积，并给出构建鲁棒检查器、多样化求解器等建议。
Motivation: 当前有能力模型（如语言模型）的单次前向传播虽然快速流畅但不可靠，常产生自信的错误（幻觉）。需要将不可靠求解器转化为可靠系统，但现有方法缺乏统一的、预算感知的编排框架。
Method: 提出一个模型无关的编排框架 Maestro Order，包含四种结构原语（分解、集成、验证和递归）和一个预算感知控制器。控制器根据边际可靠性每单位成本决定在何处花费计算资源。框架将任何模型视为黑箱求解器，分层验证器集成并在线测量其鉴别能力，分配验证和投票到最高边际可靠性的阶段。
Result: 蒙特卡洛模拟定量复现预测规律：验证以几何级数提升可靠性（如0.55→0.98（两个门控）→0.999（四个））；投票仅在高于随机水平时有效且受共享错误限制；预算感知控制器通过为每个区域选择最便宜机制，以远低于纯集成的成本达到目标可靠性。
Conclusion: 本文强调构建鲁棒检查器、多样化求解器，并让控制器将计算分配给信息含量高的部分。论文还指出故障模式包括验证器欺骗、相关错误和分解错误累积。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Warehouse SLAM Throughput Control
papers.abstract_en: We present an offline reinforcement learning (RL) framework for optimizing SLAM throughput control in a warehouse fulfillment environment. SLAM (Scan/Label/Apply/Manifest) throughput directly influences system congestion and operational efficiency. Our RL-based control approach dynamically recommends SLAM throughput settings that adaptively balance throughput maximization with downstream stability through intelligent adjustment of throttling behavior. We include a history-informed state representation, action space abstraction for delayed-impact control, and a reward function that captures both upstream and downstream operational metrics. Our approach is algorithm-agnostic, enabling integration of multiple offline RL methods under a unified architecture. We instantiate our framework with three state-of-the-art offline RL algorithms, and trained the models offline using de-identified historical operational logs from a large-scale warehouse. Policy performance is evaluated using a comprehensive multi-method strategy. These include model-free approaches including immediate reward estimation via regression models and long-horizon Fitted Q Evaluation (FQE), as well as model-based Deep Koopman dynamics evaluation. Empirical results reveal that the CQL policy consistently outperforms alternatives, improving system health by 22.97% and reducing average throttling duration by 3.18%. These findings demonstrate the potential of offline RL for safe and scalable warehouse throughput control optimization.
papers.comment: Accepted at 2026 14th International Conference on Control, Mechatronics and Automation (ICCMA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个离线强化学习框架，用于优化仓库履约环境中SLAM（扫描/贴标/贴附/确认）吞吐量控制。该框架通过历史信息状态表示、动作空间抽象和奖励函数设计，动态调整节流行为，平衡吞吐量最大化和下游稳定性。实例化三种离线RL算法，并在大规模仓库的历史运营日志上训练，结果显示CQL策略在系统健康和平均节流时长上优于其他方法。
Motivation: 仓库SLAM吞吐量直接影响系统拥堵和运营效率，但现有控制方法难以自适应平衡吞吐量与下游稳定性，需要数据驱动的安全优化方案。
Method: 提出算法无关的离线RL框架，包含历史信息状态表示、用于延迟影响控制的动作空间抽象，以及捕获上下游运营指标的奖励函数。实例化CQL、BCQ等三种离线RL算法，并使用回归模型和Fitted Q Evaluation（FQE）以及Deep Koopman动力学评估策略性能。
Result: 在真实仓库历史数据上，CQL策略相比其他方法提升系统健康指标22.97%，平均节流时长降低3.18%。
Conclusion: 离线RL在仓库吞吐量控制中具有安全且可扩展的潜力，但方法依赖历史数据，未涉及在线部署的实时性挑战。

papers.title: A Comparative Study of Bayesian Contextual Bandits for Real-Time Warehouse Sorter Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Efficient sorter diversion control of automated material handling systems (MHS) is critical for optimizing operational efficiency in large-scale warehouse environments. In this study, we use an inbound receiving sorter at a high-volume e-commerce warehouse as our primary use case, where the sorter diversion system relies on cost functions with static weight configurations that fail to adapt to highly dynamic system contexts, such as volume mode, congestion level, equipment physical status, and upstream/downstream dependencies. To address this real-time sorter diversion optimization challenge, we conducted a comparative study of three candidate hybrid machine learning frameworks: Linear Regression with Gradient Descent Optimization (LR+GDO), XGBoost with Bayesian Optimization (XGB+BO), and Bayesian Contextual Bandits (BCB). Model training and evaluation were enabled by leveraging a high-fidelity physics-aware emulator to overcome the cold-start problem and allow a safe transition from offline to online learning. We performed comprehensive evaluations including reward model predictive accuracy, contextual sensitivity, action distribution, and projected reward uplift. Our results demonstrate that while tree-based reward models offer slightly better predictive power, the BCB framework achieved overall higher performance with 2.03% reward uplift over the heuristic baseline. Furthermore, BCB exhibits several superior characteristics, such as its decisive time-optimal policy backed by Bang-Bang control theory, continuous online learning capability, strategic balance between exploration and exploitation, and significantly shorter inference latency. These results demonstrate the potential of the BCB framework for real-time control optimization in large-scale warehouse environments, motivating further investigation toward operational deployment.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高流量电商仓库中入站接收分拣机的实时分拣优化问题，比较了三种混合机器学习框架：线性回归+梯度下降（LR+GDO）、XGBoost+贝叶斯优化（XGB+BO）和贝叶斯上下文赌博机（BCB）。利用高保真物理仿真器解决冷启动问题，实现从离线到在线学习的安全过渡。实验表明，BCB框架在奖励预测准确性和上下文敏感性方面表现优越，相比启发式基线实现了2.03%的奖励提升，并具有基于Bang-Bang控制理论的时间最优策略、持续在线学习能力以及更短的推理延迟。
Motivation: 现有分拣系统的分流依赖静态权重配置的成本函数，无法适应高度动态的系统上下文（如体积模式、拥堵程度、设备物理状态和上下游依赖），导致效率低下。
Method: 对比研究了LR+GDO、XGB+BO和BCB三种混合机器学习框架；使用高保真物理仿真器进行训练和评估，避免冷启动问题。
Result: BCB框架在奖励提升上优于启发式基线2.03%，展现出时间最优策略、在线学习能力、探索-利用平衡和更短推理延迟等优势。

papers.title: 3D Masked Autoencoders are Robust Learners of Volumetric and Multimodal Cellular Representations for Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning in fluorescence microscopy often relies on 2D projections, despite the inherently three-dimensional nature of cells. We present a systematic comparison of 2D and 3D masked autoencoders (MAE-2D vs. MAE-3D) on volumetric microscopy data. Under matched architectures and training protocols, MAE-3D consistently outperforms 2D max-projection and slice-based variants on downstream single-cell tasks. We further align visual representations with a pretrained protein language model (ESM2) and show that cross-modal supervision yields larger gains for volumetric models. Channel cross-attention and frequency-domain regularization are critical for leveraging 3D spatial context. On a protein--protein interaction task, MAE-3D achieves a ROC--AUC of 0.865, outperforming prior methods by up to +0.025. For protein localization, our best 3D model attains state-of-the-art AUC$_{\text{micro}}$ (0.952) and F1$_{\text{micro}}$ (0.742), improving over previous approaches by +0.003 and +0.010 absolute, respectively. Overall, these results demonstrate the advantages of native 3D modeling and multimodal alignment for representation learning in single-cell microscopy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了2D和3D掩码自编码器（MAE）在三维荧光显微镜数据上的表现。在匹配架构和训练协议下，3D MAE在单细胞下游任务上持续优于基于2D最大投影和切片的变体。通过将视觉表示与预训练蛋白质语言模型（ESM2）对齐，跨模态监督对体积模型带来更大增益。通道交叉注意力和频域正则化对利用3D空间上下文至关重要。在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用任务上，3D MAE达到0.865的ROC-AUC，比先前方法高出最多0.025；在蛋白质定位任务上，最佳3D模型达到AUC_micro 0.952和F1_micro 0.742，分别比先前方法绝对提升0.003和0.010。
Motivation: 荧光显微镜图像本质上是三维的，但现有自监督学习常依赖2D投影，忽略了三维结构信息。
Method: 提出3D掩码自编码器（MAE-3D），并系统比较其与2D变体（MAE-2D）在体积显微镜数据上的性能。引入通道交叉注意力和频域正则化，并将视觉表示与蛋白质语言模型ESM2对齐进行跨模态学习。
Result: MAE-3D在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用任务上ROC-AUC达0.865，比先前方法高0.025；在蛋白质定位任务上AUC_micro为0.952，F1_micro为0.742，均达到最优。
Conclusion: 原生3D建模和跨模态对齐在单细胞显微镜表示学习中具有显著优势。

papers.title: Forget Without Compromise: Nexus Sampling for Streaming KV-Cache Eviction Under Fixed Budgets
papers.abstract_en: Long-context and agentic LLM workloads push the KV cache past any fixed memory budget, forcing the inference stack to permanently evict tokens at every step of a continuous-inference stream. Existing methods all share the same template, a per-step direct-attention score followed by deterministic top-$K$ selection, which converts a single below-cutoff step into an irreversible verdict and permanently erases any subtly important token that direct attention cannot single out from noise. To address this challenge, we propose Nexus Sampling, a training-free eviction method that pairs Nexus scoring, an iterative walk over direct attention that surfaces bridge tokens, with weighted reservoir sampling, which retains tokens with inclusion probability in place of deterministic top-$K$. Theoretically, we show that Nexus Sampling dominates deterministic top-$K$ in long-run survival of subtly important tokens. Empirically, at 80% KV cache eviction, Nexus Sampling matches dense attention within 1% on LongBench while outperforming top-$K$ baselines on retrieval-heavy tasks, with up to 10x smaller per-sequence cache memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存固定预算下的令牌驱逐问题，提出Nexus Sampling方法。该方法结合Nexus评分（迭代遍历直接注意力以找到桥接令牌）和加权蓄水池采样（以概率保留令牌），取代了传统的确定性top-K选择。实验表明，在80%驱逐率下，Nexus Sampling在LongBench上与密集注意力差距小于1%，在检索密集型任务上优于top-K基线，并将每个序列的缓存内存降低至十分之一。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存驱逐方法使用逐步直接注意力评分后确定性top-K选择，导致一旦某个步骤评分低于阈值，重要令牌可能被永久擦除，尤其是在长上下文或代理型LLM工作负载中。
Method: 提出Nexus Sampling，包含两步：Nexus评分通过迭代行走直接注意力来发现桥接令牌；加权蓄水池采样以包含概率保留令牌，代替确定性top-K。
Result: 在80% KV缓存驱逐下，Nexus Sampling在LongBench上达到接近密集注意力的性能（差距<1%），在检索密集型任务上超越top-K基线，每序列缓存内存减少最多10倍。
Conclusion: Nexus Sampling在理论上优于确定性top-K，能长期保留微妙重要的令牌，且无需训练，适用于固定预算下的流式KV缓存驱逐。

papers.title: Does My Embedding Reflect That $A = B$? Evaluating Mathematical Equivalence in Embedding Models
papers.abstract_en: Because mathematics is highly abstract, a single statement can take very different forms depending on what subfield it is framed in. There are many examples where breakthroughs occurred after researchers discovered that a question had already been answered in a different field. At the same time, the growth of new resources related to formalization has increased the need for tools that enable efficient and reliable navigation between mathematical 'languages' (e.g., from Lean to natural language). In this paper, we investigate whether current embedding models capture mathematical equivalence. To do this, we introduce the Mathematically Equivalent but Lexically Different Pairs (MELD) Dataset, a collection of mathematically equivalent statements that are expressed in very different language. We show that current state-of-the-art embedding models tend to group statements by the terminology used to make them instead of the underlying math. Motivated by this, we propose a contrastive approach to learning embeddings of mathematical text that focuses on aligning informal statements with different formalizations. Our experiments demonstrate that this leads to improvements not only on informal-formal retrieval tasks but also on MELD, which only contains natural language statements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过构建数学等价但词汇不同的句对数据集 (MELD)，评估了当前嵌入模型能否捕捉数学等价性。实验表明，现有模型倾向于按术语而非数学本质聚类。作者提出了一种对比学习方法，对齐非正式陈述与不同形式化表达，在非正式-正式检索及 MELD 上取得改进。
Motivation: 数学陈述因子领域不同而形式迥异，前沿发现常依赖跨领域等价性识别。现有嵌入模型可能无法捕捉这种等价性，阻碍数学知识导航与形式化工具的互操作。
Method: 提出了数学等价但词汇不同的句对数据集 (MELD)；基于对比学习 (contrastive learning) 训练嵌入模型，使非正式数学陈述与其不同形式化表达在嵌入空间中对齐。
Result: 当前最优嵌入模型在 MELD 上表现差，倾向于按术语聚类而非数学等价性。对比学习方法在非正式-形式检索任务和 MELD 上均带来性能提升。
Conclusion: 嵌入模型需要专门设计才能捕捉数学等价性；所提对比方法可部分缓解这一问题，但限于自然语言与形式化之间的对齐。

papers.title: Learning the Koopman Operator using Attention Free Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Learning Koopman operators with autoencoders enables linear prediction in a latent space, but long-horizon rollouts often drift off the learned manifold, leading to phase and amplitude errors on systems with switching, continuous spectra, or strong transients. We introduce two complementary components that make Koopman predictors more robust. First, we add an attention-free latent memory (AFT) block that aggregates a short window of past latents to produce a corrected latent before each Koopman update. Unlike multi-head attention, AFT operates in linear time and adds only $\approx$30k parameters ($3d^2 + T^2$, fewer than matched multi-head attention), yet captures the local temporal context needed to suppress error divergence. Second, we propose dynamic re-encoding: lightweight, online change-point triggers (EWMA, CUSUM, and sequential two-sample tests) that detect latent drift and project predictions back onto the autoencoder manifold. Across three benchmark systems -- Duffing oscillator, Repressilator, IRMA -- our model consistently reduces error accumulation compared to a Koopman autoencoder and matched-capacity multi-head attention. We also compare against GRU and Transformer autoencoders, evaluated both from initial conditions and with a 50-step context, and find that Koopman+AFT (with optional re-encoding) attains markedly lower long-horizon error while maintaining lower inference latency. We report improvements over horizons up to 1000 steps, together with ablations over trigger policies. The result is a fast, compact predictor that stays on the learned manifold over long horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Koopman算子学习中的长期预测漂移问题，提出结合无注意力记忆模块（AFT）和动态重编码的改进方法。AFT以线性时间复杂度捕捉局部时间上下文，动态重编码通过在线变点检测将预测投影回自编码器流形。在Duffing振荡器、Repressilator和IRMA三个基准系统上，该方法相比基线在1000步预测内显著降低误差，且推理延迟更低。
Motivation: Koopman自编码器在长期滚动预测中因远离学习流形而产生相位和幅度误差，现有方法难以处理切换、连续谱或强瞬态系统。
Method: 在Koopman预测器中引入无注意力记忆模块（AFT）和动态重编码机制：AFT通过聚合短窗口潜在状态修正预测，动态重编码使用EWMA、CUSUM和顺序双样本检验检测潜在漂移并投影回流形。
Result: 在三个基准系统上，Koopman+AFT（可选重编码）在长达1000步的预测中相比Koopman自编码器、匹配容量的多头注意力、GRU和Transformer自编码器均取得更低的累积误差，且推理延迟更低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结合AFT和动态重编码可显著提升Koopman预测器的长期鲁棒性，同时保持计算高效性。

papers.title: DivRL: Disentangled Self-Similarity Rewards for Diverse Subject-Driven Generation
papers.abstract_en: Subject-driven image generation faces an "Identity-Diversity Paradox", where strong identity preservation often leads to rigid and low-diversity outputs. We propose a post-training framework called DivRL that jointly optimizes identity consistency and structural diversity simultaneously by leveraging disentangled visual features from a robust similarity model. Specifically, we introduce a Negative Self-Similarity Measure (nSSM) to quantify structural diversity, and Visual Semantic Matching (VSM) to evaluate identity consistency. We propose an "Explore-and-Suppress" strategy that treats VSM as a gated constraint: the model freely explores structurally diverse configurations, and only samples that violate the identity threshold are penalized via a quadratic hinge loss. This converts identity preservation from a competing objective into a feasibility constraint, allowing nSSM and VSM to improve jointly. Experiments demonstrate that our method effectively pushes the model to generate both consistent and diverse images and improves structural diversity while maintaining comparable identity consistency through a gated optimization formulation.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://qianwangx.github.io/DivRL/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对主体驱动图像生成中的“身份-多样性悖论”，提出后训练框架 DivRL，通过解耦视觉特征同时优化身份一致性和结构多样性。引入负自相似性度量（nSSM）量化结构多样性，视觉语义匹配（VSM）评估身份一致性，并采用“探索-抑制”策略将身份保持转为可行性约束，使两者联合优化。实验表明该方法在保持身份一致性的同时提升了结构多样性。
Motivation: 主体驱动图像生成面临强身份保持导致输出多样性低的问题，现有方法难以兼顾身份一致性与结构多样性。
Method: 提出 DivRL 后训练框架：利用鲁棒相似性模型提取解耦视觉特征，引入负自相似性度量（nSSM）和视觉语义匹配（VSM），通过“探索-抑制”策略将 VSM 作为门控约束，仅对违反身份阈值的样本施加二次铰链损失，将身份保持转化为可行性约束。
Result: 实验显示该方法能生成既一致又多样化的图像，在保持可比的身份一致性下有效提升结构多样性。
Conclusion: 通过门控优化将身份保持从竞争目标转为约束，可联合提升身份一致性与结构多样性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 通过门控优化将身份保持从竞争目标转为约束，可联合提升身份一致性与结构多样性。

papers.title: Stochastic Expectation Maximization for Robust State-Space Radio Interferometric Imaging
papers.abstract_en: State--space models provide a flexible framework for analyzing dynamical systems, yet they often rely on Gaussian assumptions that fail to capture heavy-tailed or outlier-prone measurement noise. We propose a robust estimation scheme for linear state--space models subject to compound-Gaussian noise, as encountered for instance in radio interferometry affected by radio-frequency interference (RFI). The method relies on a Stochastic Approximation Expectation--Maximization (SAEM) algorithm in which the standard E-step is replaced by Monte Carlo sampling of the latent states and noise texture through closed-form Gibbs updates, enabling tractable inference despite the heavy-tailed likelihood. Numerical experiments show that the proposed method significantly improves reconstruction fidelity and robustness to RFI, outperforming a Gaussian EM algorithm and even an oracle RTS smoother. These results highlight the benefits of heavy-tailed state--space modeling and SAEM-based inference in interference-dominated imaging scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对射频干扰（RFI）导致的重尾噪声，提出基于随机近似期望最大化（SAEM）的鲁棒状态空间图像重建方法。该方法利用封闭形式Gibbs更新对潜在状态和噪声纹理进行蒙特卡洛采样，无需高斯假设。实验表明，在射电干涉成像中，该方法的重建保真度和对RFI的鲁棒性优于高斯EM算法和oracle RTS平滑器。
Motivation: 经典状态空间模型依赖高斯噪声假设，难以处理射电干涉成像中射频干扰引发的重尾或异常值噪声，导致重建精度下降。
Method: 提出SAEM算法，将标准E-step替换为通过封闭形式Gibbs更新对潜在状态和噪声纹理进行蒙特卡洛采样，实现重尾似然下的可推断性。
Result: 数值实验显示，该方法在重建保真度和对RFI的鲁棒性上显著优于高斯EM算法，甚至超过oracle RTS平滑器。
Conclusion: 重尾状态空间模型结合SAEM推断在干扰主导的成像场景中具有明显优势，可有效提升重建质量。

papers.title: DREG: A Layer-Wise Jacobian Regularization as a General-Purpose Penalty
papers.abstract_en: We present a large-scale empirical study isolating the contributions of the Derivative Regularization penalty (DREG). Across a fully-crossed factorial sweep of 960 experiments spanning 4 activations, 6 regularizers, 8 datasets, and 5 random seeds, we ask: when, where, and why does DREG work? Our results establish three principal findings. First, DREG achieves the highest overall and clean-regime accuracy among all regularizers evaluated (significantly so against the unregularized baseline, Weight Decay, and IGPen; Wilcoxon $p \leq 0.031$). It ranks second in noise robustness behind Spectral Normalization (SN) - the only two layer-wise regularizers in the study. Second, DREG is globally the best-performing regularizer under GELU, the default activation in modern transformer architectures, particularly on both messy vision and messy NLP benchmarks, suggesting direct applicability to frontier deep learning settings. Third, DREG's advantage over competing regularizers is most pronounced under data scarcity, consistent with its role as a geometric inductive bias that substitutes for the regularizing effect of data volume. Throughout, DREG is applied with a single fixed hyperparameter $λ= 10^{-2.5}$ and no per-dataset tuning, supporting its characterization as a plug-and-play regularizer for neural networks with nontrivial Jacobian structure. These findings are consistent with DREG's design: concentrating regularization pressure on layers where the activation derivative is largest, rather than constraining the network uniformly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实验（960个实验，涵盖4种激活函数、6种正则化器、8个数据集）系统地研究了导数正则化（DREG）惩罚项的贡献。结果表明，DREG 在所有评估的正则化器中达到最高总体准确率和干净准确率，在噪声鲁棒性方面仅次于谱归一化；在 GELU 激活下表现最佳，且在数据稀缺时优势最明显。DREG 作为一种逐层雅可比正则化，可视为即插即用的通用惩罚项。
Motivation: 现有正则化方法（如权重衰减、谱归一化）在不同网络结构下的性能缺乏系统性比较，特别是针对 DREG 这一逐层雅可比正则化项的独立贡献尚未被大规模隔离研究。
Method: 采用全交叉因子实验设计，在 4 种激活函数、6 种正则化器、8 个数据集、5 个随机种子下进行 960 个实验，对比 DREG 与无正则化基线、权重衰减、IGPen、谱归一化等。DREG 使用固定超参数 λ=10^{-2.5}，无每数据集调参。
Result: DREG 在所有正则化器中取得最高总体准确率和干净准确率（与基线、权重衰减、IGPen 相比，Wilcoxon p≤0.031）；噪声鲁棒性仅次于谱归一化；在 GELU 激活下表现最佳，尤其适用于现代 Transformer 架构；在数据稀缺时优势最明显。
Conclusion: DREG 作为一种逐层雅可比正则化，通过将正则化压力集中在激活导数最大的层上，而非均匀约束网络，表现优异且可即插即用，无需单独调参。这为深度学习中的正则化提供了一种通用且有效的工具。

papers.title: Prediction of Viscoelastic Droplet Impact Dynamics Using a Vision Transformer-Based Approach
papers.abstract_en: Droplet impact on solid surfaces is a complex fluid dynamics problem with applications in spray cooling, inkjet printing, and pharmaceutical processing. Although numerical simulations are widely used to investigate these dynamics, their computational cost becomes significant when multiple parametric variations are considered. In this work, we investigate the use of a Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) architecture to predict the temporal evolution of viscoelastic droplets impacting solid surfaces using volume fraction fields obtained from the Volume of Fluid (VOF) method. In Newtonian fluids, impact dynamics are mainly characterized by the Reynolds number $Re$, representing the ratio of inertial to viscous forces, and the Weber number $We$, representing the ratio of inertial to surface tension forces. For viscoelastic fluids, additional parameters are required to account for elastic effects, namely the solvent viscosity ratio $β$ and the Weissenberg number $Wi$, increasing simulation complexity and cost. Instead of simulating the entire droplet dynamics, the proposed approach uses only the initial 10% to 20% of the simulation to predict the remaining evolution. Depending on the prediction configuration, this strategy reduces computational cost by approximately 80% to 90% compared to full numerical simulations. The ViViT produces physically consistent predictions across different parameters and prediction horizons, successfully capturing both spreading and bouncing regimes while preserving geometric features and structural similarity. Since volume fraction fields can also be extracted from experimental videos, the proposed framework could be extended to incorporate experimental data during training, potentially improving the physical fidelity of the predicted dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用Video Vision Transformer (ViViT) 架构，基于体积分数场预测粘弹性液滴撞击固体表面的时间演化。仅使用模拟前10%-20%的数据预测后续过程，可减少约80%-90%的计算成本。模型能物理一致地预测不同参数下的扩散和弹跳行为。
Motivation: 粘弹性液滴撞击模拟涉及多个参数（Re, We, β, Wi），全参数化模拟计算成本高，需要高效替代方法。
Method: 采用Video Vision Transformer (ViViT)，输入前10%-20%时间步的VOF体积分数场，预测剩余时间演化。训练数据来自数值模拟。
Result: 该方法可减少80%-90%计算成本，预测结果在几何特征和结构相似性上保持一致，能捕捉扩散和弹跳两种模式。
Conclusion: ViViT能有效预测粘弹性液滴撞击动力学，且可通过实验数据（视频提取的体积分数场）进一步改进物理保真度。

papers.title: Constrained Variable Projection for Structured Problems
papers.abstract_en: Variable projection is a classical technique for separable nonlinear least-squares problems, in which variables that enter linearly are eliminated exactly, yielding a reduced nonlinear problem. By expressing this framework as a particular instance of a broader class of bilevel optimization problems, we develop a constrained variable-projection framework for data-science models, where the remaining variables are subject to convex constraints and the eliminated variables arise from a lower-level least-squares problem. In particular, by interpreting variable projection as a collapsed bilevel optimization problem, we derive exact reduced-gradient formulas compatible with automatic differentiation and propose a conditional-gradient algorithm for the resulting constrained reduced problem. We establish convergence guarantees under standard smoothness and compactness assumptions, and discuss extensions to structured lower-level variables. Numerical experiments on sparse autoencoding, dictionary learning, blind deconvolution, and few-shot learning suggest that the method can improve wall-clock efficiency and data efficiency relative to natural joint-optimization baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文将变量投影（variable projection）解释为一类双层优化问题，并提出了带凸约束的约束变量投影框架，适用于数据科学模型。作者推导了与自动微分兼容的精确简化梯度公式，并提出条件梯度算法来解决约束简化问题。理论分析给出了在标准光滑性和紧性假设下的收敛保证，数值实验在稀疏自编码、字典学习、盲反卷积和少样本学习上显示比联合优化基线更高效。
Motivation: 传统变量投影法仅处理无约束的可分离非线性最小二乘问题，而许多数据科学模型中的变量需满足凸约束，现有方法未能有效处理此类结构化约束。
Method: 将变量投影视为一种折叠双层优化问题，推导出精确的简化梯度公式，支持自动微分，并提出基于条件梯度的算法求解带凸约束的简化问题。同时讨论了低层变量具有结构性的扩展。
Result: 数值实验表明，在稀疏自编码、字典学习、盲反卷积和少样本学习等任务中，所提方法在壁钟时间和数据效率上优于自然联合优化基线。
Conclusion: 论文建立了约束变量投影的理论框架和算法，并展示了其在多个数据科学问题中的有效性，但未涉及降水、临近预报或气象同化等应用领域。

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Drive: Rule-Grounded Faithful Reasoning for Driving VLAs
papers.abstract_en: Driving VLA models incorporating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning are attractive because they leverage pretrained VLM representations and expose intermediate decisions in natural language, yet current rationales often lack the step-by-step decision semantics needed to keep the rationale causally connected to the planned motion. We introduce Neuro-Symbolic Drive, a neuro-symbolic driving framework that supervises a driving VLA with rule-grounded reasoning traces extracted directly from classical rule-based planners. Our key observation is that rule-based planners are symbolic AI systems that already function as executable reasoning engines: they reason about active safety constraints, search over candidate maneuvers, and select a final trajectory. We instrument these planners in simulation to capture both the executed trajectory and the internal decision trace at each rule-evaluation step. Each trace is serialized into structured rule-grounded reasoning and paired with the trajectory to fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B as a driving VLA. Because these traces are derived directly from the planner states that determine the action, they ensure reasoning is structurally coupled to motion generation by construction, rather than by post-hoc alignment. On our simulator-generated benchmark, detailed rule-grounded reasoning reduces ADE@3s from 0.47 to 0.26 and miss rate from 8.30% to 6.40% under three-camera perception, and from 0.54 to 0.26 and 10.13% to 5.99% under eight-camera perception. Neuro-Symbolic Drive thus converts neuro-symbolic planning logic into structured supervision. Code base: https://github.com/XiangboGaoBarry/Neural-Symbolic-Drive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Neuro-Symbolic Drive框架，从经典规则规划器中提取规则基础推理轨迹，用于监督驾驶VLA模型。该框架确保推理与运动规划因果关联，在模拟器基准上显著降低ADE和miss率。
Motivation: 当前驾驶VLA模型的CoT推理缺乏步骤级语义，导致推理与规划动作因果脱节。
Method: 从规则规划器中提取内部决策轨迹，序列化为结构化推理文本，与轨迹配对微调Qwen3.5-4B作为驾驶VLA。
Result: 在三摄像头感知下ADE@3s从0.47降至0.26，miss率从8.30%降至6.40%；八摄像头下ADE@3s从0.54降至0.26，miss率从10.13%降至5.99%。
Conclusion: Neuro-Symbolic Drive将神经符号规划逻辑转化为结构化监督，有效提升了驾驶推理的忠实性和性能。

papers.title: When Retrieval Metrics Mislead: Measuring Policy Signal in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein
papers.abstract_en: Exact-match retrieval recall is often used as a proxy for whether a retriever supplies useful policy context to a downstream decision model. We test this proxy for pre-action policy classification in tau-bench using Qwen2.5-3B/7B classifiers. Under gold-policy conditioning, a compact structured state improves macro-F1 over raw trajectories by 0.13-0.17 after tuning. We then replace the benchmark-designated policy clause with the top-ranked clause retrieved from decision-time context. Although the exact governing clause is retrieved at rank 1 for only 7% of airline states, the primary 3B classifier obtains macro-F1 0.58 with retrieved clauses versus 0.60 with gold clauses (Delta=-0.02, task-cluster 95% CI [-0.23,+0.21]); mismatched-policy and no-policy controls score 0.32 and 0.21. We do not detect a macro-F1 difference between retrieved and gold clauses in this configuration, although the interval remains too wide to establish non-inferiority. The same qualitative pattern appears with a second retriever and at 7B, while varying across fine-tuning configurations. These results indicate that exact-match clause recall can underestimate downstream policy utility in this benchmark setting, motivating evaluation with retrieved policies in the classification loop rather than recall alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在tau-bench中测试精确匹配检索召回率作为策略上下文代理的有效性。使用Qwen2.5-3B/7B分类器发现，在黄金策略条件下紧凑结构化状态比原始轨迹提高macro-F1 0.13-0.17。但替换为检索到的条款后，3B分类器的macro-F1为0.58 vs 黄金条款0.60，差异极小，且检索到精确条款的比例仅7%。结果表明精确匹配条款召回率可能低估下游策略效用，应结合分类循环中的检索策略评估。
Motivation: 现有方法常用精确匹配检索召回率作为检索器是否提供有用策略上下文的代理，但在长期工具使用智能体中这种代理可能具有误导性。
Method: 在tau-bench中使用Qwen2.5-3B/7B分类器进行行动前策略分类，比较黄金策略、检索策略、不匹配策略和无策略条件下的macro-F1。

Conclusion: 精确匹配条款召回率可能低估下游策略效用，建议在分类循环中评估检索策略而非仅依赖召回率。

papers.title: Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling for Non-Stationary Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study non-stationary linear contextual bandits where the reward model drifts over time, rendering classical contextual bandit algorithms brittle because historical data becomes systematically biased. We propose Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling (fcTS), a Bayesian method that reuses experience by transporting past rewards to the present using an explicit drift model and incorporating each transported observation with a confidence weight that reflects transport reliability. This yields a unified template that specializes in (i) linear parameter drift via online slope estimation and reward correction, (ii) periodic variation via phase-aware reuse across cycles, and (iii) recurring regime switches via changepoint detection and regime-specific posterior memory. The resulting posterior updates remain closed-form under a linear Gaussian model and can be implemented efficiently with truncated, incrementally updated sufficient statistics. Across five controlled case studies and a semi-synthetic portfolio-selection benchmark with multiple overlapping non-stationarities, fcTS outperforms standard forgetting-based baselines (discounting, sliding windows, and periodic restarts), with the largest gains in settings exhibiting recurring temporal structure. These results demonstrate that when non-stationarity is structured, correcting and reweighting historical observations can be substantially more sample-efficient than uniformly discarding them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳线性上下文赌博机问题，提出Flow-Corrected Thompson Sampling (fcTS)，一种利用显式漂移模型将历史奖励运输到当前时刻并赋予置信权重的贝叶斯方法。该方法统一处理线性漂移、周期性变化和状态切换，后验更新保持闭式形式，计算高效。实验表明，在具有重复时间结构的非平稳场景中，fcTS显著优于基于遗忘的基线方法。
Motivation: 经典上下文赌博机算法在非平稳环境中失效，因为历史数据随着奖励模型漂移而变得系统有偏。
Method: 提出fcTS，建立显式漂移模型（如线性斜率、相位感知、状态切换检测），将过去观测转移到当前时刻，并依据运输可靠性赋予置信权重，后验更新在线性高斯假设下保持闭式。
Result: 在五个控制案例和一个半合成投资组合选择基准上，fcTS优于折扣因子、滑动窗口和周期性重启等遗忘基线，尤其在具有重复时间结构的问题中增益最大。
Conclusion: 当非平稳性具有结构时，修正并加权历史观测比统一丢弃更样本高效。

papers.title: KLip-PPO: A per-sample KL perspective on PPO-Clip
papers.abstract_en: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is the standard policy-gradient algorithm for on-policy reinforcement learning. The literature presents it in two forms, a clipped surrogate that bounds the importance ratio between successive policies and a Kullback-Leibler penalty between them. These forms are treated as separate algorithms with their own gradients, their own hyperparameters, and their own reference implementations, and a sizeable body of empirical work compares them. We show that the gradient of the clipped surrogate is reproduced exactly by a Kullback-Leibler surrogate whose coefficient varies per sample, with closed-form dependence on the importance ratio and the advantage. The identity holds at every minibatch step and across the entire inner loop, and on five MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks the two losses produce indistinguishable training curves. The reformulation exposes a structural feature of the clipped surrogate that the min notation hides. PPO-Clip's implicit per-sample penalty is a step function at the boundary of the trust region, and the shape of this coefficient is the natural design axis for generalising the algorithm. We sketch the resulting follow-up directions in the discussion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明 PPO-Clip 的梯度等价于一个每样本系数可变的 KL 惩罚，并揭示其隐式信任区域边界。在 MuJoCo 连续控制任务上两个损失产生不可区分的训练曲线。
Motivation: 现有文献将 PPO-Clip 和 PPO-KL 视为不同算法，本文旨在统一它们的梯度形式并揭示 PPO-Clip 的结构特性。
Method: 通过数学推导证明 PPO-Clip 的梯度与一个每样本 KL 惩罚的梯度完全相同，该惩罚的系数依赖于重要性比率和优势函数的闭合形式。
Result: 在五个 MuJoCo 连续控制基准上，两个损失产生不可区分的训练曲线，验证了理论等价性。
Conclusion: 该等价性揭示了 PPO-Clip 隐式使用阶梯函数作为每样本惩罚系数，为未来算法推广提供了新设计维度。

papers.title: RIFT-Bench: Dynamic Red-teaming For Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into autonomous decision-making systems, exposing attack vectors beyond those of traditional LLM vulnerabilities. Existing security evaluations are often tied to specific implementations or domains, limiting unified comparison across heterogeneous systems. To address this gap, we introduce RIFT-Bench, a graph representation-driven methodology for dynamic red-teaming that enables unified evaluations across diverse agentic architectures. Building on a novel hierarchical representation, RIFT-Bench operates in two automated phases: Discovery, which extracts system structure, and Scanning, which deploys adaptive adversarial attacks and produces a comprehensive evaluation report. It evaluates the examined system itself, leveraging a broad set of dynamically adaptable adversarial probes across diverse attack vectors and objectives. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed evaluation pipeline across 45 agentic systems spanning a diverse range of implementations, showing that the approach generalizes effectively to heterogeneous agentic architectures. Beyond systems and attacks, RIFT-Bench also supports direct evaluation of mitigation strategies. These key capabilities make RIFT-Bench a scalable foundation for security evaluation of agentic AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RIFT-Bench，一种基于图表示的动态红队测试方法，用于统一评估不同架构的自主AI系统的安全性。它包括自动化的发现和扫描阶段，通过自适应对抗攻击生成评估报告。在45个异构代理系统上展示了其通用性，并支持对缓解策略的直接评估。
Motivation: 现有安全评估方法通常绑定特定实现或领域，难以在不同异构代理系统之间进行统一比较。需要一种通用的动态红队测试框架。
Method: 提出基于图表示的层次化方法RIFT-Bench，包含两个自动化阶段：Discovery（提取系统结构）和Scanning（部署自适应对抗攻击并生成评估报告）。支持多种攻击向量和目标。
Result: 在45个覆盖多种实现的代理系统上验证了有效性，表明该方法能泛化到异构代理架构。同时支持对缓解策略的评估。
Conclusion: RIFT-Bench为代理AI系统的安全评估提供了一个可扩展的基础框架。

papers.title: Catastrophic Compositional Generation: Why Vanilla Diffusion Models Fail to Extrapolate
papers.abstract_en: The task of compositional generation involves using a conditional generative model, trained only on a subset of the possible conditions, to produce samples from compositionally-defined target distributions such as a geometric combination of the source distributions. In this work, we argue that this task is often infeasible for vanilla conditional diffusion models: we conjecture that no inference-time technique can efficiently produce samples from the target distribution in certain well-motivated settings. This idea is supported by theory-guided generalization arguments and carefully-designed experiments on both synthetic and realistic data. In particular, while recent methods such as Feynman-Kac correction reduce inference-time approximation error, our results show that score estimation error has a more catastrophic effect on performance when the target distribution is out-of-distribution with respect to the sources, highlighting the need for a different approach to this task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究扩散模型在组合生成任务中的失效原因，认为 vanilla 条件扩散模型在目标分布为源分布的组合时，难以通过推理时技术高效采样。理论泛化论证和实验表明，在分布外情况下，评分估计误差比推理时近似误差对性能的影响更严重，需要新的方法。
Motivation: 组合生成任务要求模型从训练条件的子集推广到组合定义的目标分布，但 vanilla 扩散模型在合理设置下可能不可行，缺乏理论分析和实验验证。
Method: 通过理论泛化论证和合成/真实数据实验，分析评分估计误差和推理时近似误差对组合生成性能的影响。
Result: 当目标分布相对于源分布为分布外时，评分估计误差导致性能严重下降，而 Feynman-Kac 校正等推理时方法效果有限。
Conclusion: 现有 vanilla 扩散模型在组合生成任务中面临根本性困难，需要不同的方法来解决评分估计误差带来的问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trustworthy Image Authentication using Forensic Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Advances in generative AI have made image falsification highly realistic, demanding trustworthy authentication systems. Existing forensic detectors can target certain forgery types but lack interpretability, while vision-language models (VLMs) provide explanations but cannot exploit forensic traces for reliable detection. We propose Forensic Knowledge Graphs (FKGs), a unified framework that integrates forensic evidence extraction, structured reasoning, and human-interpretable explanation. Our FKG structure encodes forensic traces along with their causal dependencies and links to scene content. To generate accurate FKGs, we introduce a novel forensic authentication network and an Iterative Context Refinement strategy that guides VLMs to produce faithful, grounded explanations. We also present FKG-50K, a dataset of 50,000 realistic forgeries with ground-truth FKGs. Experiments demonstrate that FKG outperforms both forensic detectors and VLMs in detection, forgery identification and localization, and forensic justification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出法医知识图谱（Forensic Knowledge Graphs, FKG），一个统一框架，集成法医证据提取、结构化推理和人类可解释解释。通过新的鉴伪网络和迭代上下文细化策略，引导视觉语言模型生成忠实、有依据的解释，并在FKG-50K数据集上验证了在检测、伪造识别与定位以及法医解释方面的优势。
Motivation: 现有鉴伪检测器可针对特定伪造类型但缺乏可解释性，而视觉语言模型能提供解释却无法利用法医痕迹进行可靠检测，需要一种统一且可解释的鉴伪方法。
Method: 提出FKG框架，编码法医痕迹及其因果依赖关系并与场景内容链接；设计鉴伪网络和迭代上下文细化策略，使视觉语言模型生成忠实、有依据的解释；构建包含50,000个真实伪造样本的FKG-50K数据集。
Result: 实验表明，FKG在检测、伪造识别与定位以及法医解释方面均优于现有鉴伪检测器和视觉语言模型。
Conclusion: FKG实现了法医证据提取、结构化推理与可解释性的统一，为可信图像鉴伪提供了新范式。

papers.title: Do LLM Attribution Metrics Transfer? Auditing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation Across Datasets and Constructs
authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein
papers.abstract_en: Practice often treats automatic metrics for attribution in LLM retrieval-augmented generation as interchangeable. We audit eight automatic scorers -- lexical, embedding, and BERTScore baselines alongside entailment/grounding-trained models (clean and FEVER NLI, the checker MiniCheck) -- across three evaluation constructs (provenance/topicality, generated-answer attribution, and fact-check entailment), asking whether any scorer transfers: stays within the 95% confidence interval of the best audited scorer on every dataset of a multi-dataset construct. In the construct with the most multi-dataset human-labeled coverage -- generated-answer attribution (AttributionBench's four source datasets, n = 1,610, with independent HAGRID, n = 2,150) -- none does: the per-dataset metric rankings invert (Kendall tau = -0.64, p = 0.031 on AttributedQA vs. LFQA), and an off-the-shelf NLI scorer that is best on short-claim AttributedQA (AUROC 0.90) collapses to AUROC 0.53 (chance) on long-form LFQA, where BERTScore wins (0.91); the flip is not a length or truncation artifact. This instability has a concrete decision cost: a naive "best-on-average" rule for choosing an evaluator fails leave-one-dataset-out (mean held-out regret 0.172 AUROC, worse than fixing one scorer), so metric choice must be validated on the target dataset rather than learned from others. A prompt-based LLM judge avoids the chance-level collapses the automatic scorers suffer (no LFQA collapse) but is not uniformly best, ~100x costlier, and non-deterministic -- relocating, not removing, the validation burden.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统审计了八种自动归因评分器（lexical、embedding、BERTScore、以及基于蕴含/接地训练的模型）在三个评估构念（来源/主题性、生成答案归因、事实验证蕴含）上的可迁移性。研究发现，在生成答案归因构念上，没有一个评分器在所有数据集上保持最佳性能：数据集间的指标排名发生反转（Kendall tau = -0.64），且短文本集上的最佳模型在长文本集上退化为随机水平（AUROC 0.53 vs 0.91）。基于LLM的评判器避免了自动评分器的随机崩溃，但成本高且非确定性，并未消除验证负担。
Motivation: 当前实践中常将LLM检索增强生成中的自动归因指标视为可互换使用，但缺乏对其跨数据集和构念可迁移性的系统验证。
Method: 审计八种自动评分器在三个评估构念下的表现，涵盖多个数据集（如AttributionBench四个源数据集和HAGRID），通过95%置信区间检验评分器是否在所有数据集上保持最佳。
Result: 在生成答案归因构念上，无评分器可迁移：AttributedQA与LFQA上的指标排名反转（Kendall tau = -0.64），且AttributedQA上的最佳NLI评分器（AUROC 0.90）在LFQA上退化为随机（0.53），而BERTScore在LFQA上最佳（0.91）。基于LLM的评判器无随机崩溃但成本高且非确定。
Conclusion: 自动归因指标的可迁移性差，选择评估器必须基于目标数据集验证，而非依赖其他数据集或平均最佳规则。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统审计了八种自动归因评分器（lexical、embedding、BERTScore、以及基于蕴含/接地训练的模型）在三个评估构念（来源/主题性、生成答案归因、事实验证蕴含）上的可迁移性。研究发现，在生成答案归因构念上，没有一个评分器在所有数据集上保持最佳性能：数据集间的指标排名发生反转（Kendall tau = -0.64），且短文本集上的最佳模型在长文本集上退化为随机水平（AUROC 0.53 vs 0.91）。基于LLM的评判器避免了自动评分器的随机崩溃，但成本高且非确定性，并未消除验证负担。
summary_sections.motivation: 当前实践中常将LLM检索增强生成中的自动归因指标视为可互换使用，但缺乏对其跨数据集和构念可迁移性的系统验证。
summary_sections.method: 审计八种自动评分器在三个评估构念下的表现，涵盖多个数据集（如AttributionBench四个源数据集和HAGRID），通过95%置信区间检验评分器是否在所有数据集上保持最佳。
summary_sections.result: 在生成答案归因构念上，无评分器可迁移：AttributedQA与LFQA上的指标排名反转（Kendall tau = -0.64），且AttributedQA上的最佳NLI评分器（AUROC 0.90）在LFQA上退化为随机（0.53），而BERTScore在LFQA上最佳（0.91）。基于LLM的评判器无随机崩溃但成本高且非确定。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自动归因指标的可迁移性差，选择评估器必须基于目标数据集验证，而非依赖其他数据集或平均最佳规则。

papers.title: Closing the Loop: Formally Verified Law as a Reward Signal for Self-Improving Legal AI
papers.abstract_en: This article develops an architecture that creates a formally verifiable reward signal to train legal AI, adapting the LLM proposes, verifier disposes paradigm from mathematical AI to the distinctive demands of law. We present an architecture comprising LLM-driven autoformalization into a formal legal calculus extending Catala, a verification kernel, and explanation generation grounded in formal proof traces. For the computational components of law, the architecture provides provable correctness. For open-textured legal analysis, it provides structural guarantees: every required stage of the legal argument is addressed, argumentation is exercised at the correct stages and not omitted, and the deductive links between steps are valid. We demonstrate the architecture on procedural deadline calculations in German law, Commerce Clause analysis in U.S. constitutional law, and cross-jurisdictional sanction proportionality. We further show that the same architecture has a structural advantage for legal AI training: a deterministic external verifier supplies verifiable outcomes for legal problems and thereby closes the traditional reinforcement-learning loop gap in law.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个将形式验证与LLM结合的法律AI架构，通过LLM自动形式化为基于Catala的形式法律演算，并引入验证内核和基于证明迹的解释生成。该架构为法律的计算部分提供可证明的正确性，为开放纹理分析提供结构保证，并在德国法程序期限计算、美国宪法商业条款分析和跨司法管辖区制裁比例性上进行了演示。摘要还指出该架构能封闭强化学习循环，提供可验证奖励信号，有利于法律AI自改进。
Motivation: 法律AI缺乏形式可验证的奖励信号，传统强化学习循环难以直接应用于法律领域，需要一种能提供结构保证和可证明正确性的训练信号。
Method: 提出LLM驱动的自动形式化进入形式法律演算（扩展Catala），结合确定性验证内核和基于形式证明迹的解释生成，通过外部验证器为法律问题提供可验证结果。
Result: 在德国法程序期限计算、美国宪法商业条款分析和跨司法管辖区制裁比例性上展示了架构有效性。摘要声称该架构为计算部分提供可证明正确性，为开放纹理分析提供结构保证，并具有自改进的结构优势。
Conclusion: 该架构通过外部确定性验证器产生可验证结果，是法律AI自改进的可行路径，能够封闭传统强化学习循环。

papers.title: ARIA: Adaptive Region-Based Importance Allocation for Conditional Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Distilling conditional diffusion models aims to transfer the behavior of a large teacher to a smaller student while preserving alignment across conditioning inputs. Unlike recognition tasks, knowledge distillation in conditional diffusion often struggles to transfer knowledge beyond the training distribution, since the predicted noise strongly depends on the conditioning signal. As a result, effective distillation requires exploring a large conditioning space. In practical settings, this creates a major bottleneck. Paired image-condition data may be limited, and generating synthetic images for every available condition is often computationally infeasible, while the pool of conditions, such as text prompts, can be extremely large. Recent work addresses this issue by switching conditions during training, exposing the student to a broader conditioning space without changing the distillation objective. Yet this raises a complementary question: once a large conditioning corpus is available, how should the training effort be allocated? In this work, we introduce ARIA, a framework that adaptively allocates training effort across coarse regions of the conditioning space. By maintaining online estimates of teacher-student discrepancy at the region level, ARIA focuses updates where misalignment persists while preserving the original distillation objective. Empirically, ARIA improves over RC across most architectures and settings, with the clearest gains observed in unseen and underrepresented regimes. We also provide a theoretical analysis showing that the proposed tracking mechanism follows the evolving discrepancy during training under bounded variance and drift assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ARIA框架，用于条件扩散模型蒸馏中自适应分配训练资源。通过在条件空间粗粒度区域维护师生模型差异的在线估计，ARIA将训练集中在未对齐区域，同时保持原始蒸馏目标。实验表明ARIA在多数架构和设置上优于RC方法，尤其在不常见和未见过条件上提升明显。理论分析证明了跟踪机制在有限方差和漂移假设下能遵循不断变化的差异。
Motivation: 条件扩散模型蒸馏面临训练条件空间巨大且配对数据有限的瓶颈，现有方法虽可通过切换条件扩大暴露范围，但未解决训练资源如何分配的问题。
Method: ARIA框架：将条件空间划分为粗粒度区域，在线维护每个区域的师生模型差异估计，并根据估计值自适应分配训练样本，使训练集中在差异大的区域。
Result: 实验显示ARIA在多数架构和设置上优于RC基线，尤其是在未见和未充分代表的条件下增益最明显。
Conclusion: ARIA通过自适应区域级重要性分配改善了条件扩散蒸馏的效果，尤其在处理稀缺或未见条件时有效。

papers.title: The Professor: Multi-Teacher Unsupervised Prompt Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Prompt distillation compresses large vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP into lightweight student models by matching teacher predictions on unlabeled domain images. PromptKD (CVPR 2024) established this paradigm with a single PromptSRC-finetuned ViT-L/14 teacher and a ViT-B/16 student. We propose TheProfessor, a multi-teacher extension that distills from a fixed two-teacher ensemble: a domain-finetuned PromptSRC ViT-L/14 teacher and a zero-shot EVA-CLIP-L/14 teacher whose logits are pre-computed per dataset. We evaluate single-teacher PromptKD, equal-probability ensembling, and confidence-weighted ensembling on four base-to-novel datasets: Caltech-101, DTD, UCF101, and EuroSAT. In a 12-run single-seed sweep, confidence-weighted ensembling improves average HM from 87.52 to 89.28 (+1.77 points), while equal averaging improves average HM to 88.88 (+1.37 points). Gains are dataset dependent: they are negligible on Caltech-101 (+0.16 HM for confidence weighting), modest on UCF101 (+0.62), and largest on domain-shifted EuroSAT (+5.78). These results update our earlier Caltech-only analysis and show that multi-teacher prompt distillation is most useful when the second teacher contributes complementary supervision under domain shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TheProfessor，一种多教师无监督提示蒸馏方法，用于将大型视觉语言模型（如CLIP）压缩为轻量级学生模型。该方法使用两个固定教师：一个领域微调的PromptSRC ViT-L/14教师和一个零样本EVA-CIP-L/14教师，其logits按数据集预计算。在四个base-to-novel数据集上评估，置信度加权集成比单教师PromptKD在平均HM上提升1.77个百分点，其中在域偏移的EuroSAT上提升最大（+5.78 HM）。
Motivation: 现有单教师提示蒸馏方法（如PromptKD）在多教师场景下是否更优尚不明确，特别是当第二个教师提供互补性监督时对域偏移任务的影响。
Method: 提出固定两教师集成蒸馏框架：一个领域微调的PromptSRC ViT-L/14教师和一个零样本EVA-CLIP-L/14教师，并比较等概率集成和置信度加权集成。
Result: 在12次单种子实验中，置信度加权集成在四个数据集上平均HM从87.52提升至89.28（+1.77），等概率集成提升至88.88（+1.37）。增益依赖于数据集：Caltech-101上+0.16，UCF101上+0.62，EuroSAT上+5.78。
Conclusion: 多教师提示蒸馏在域偏移场景下最有效，此时第二个教师提供互补监督。

papers.title: REALM: A Unified Red-Teaming Benchmark for Physical-World VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as perception-reasoning backbones for embodied intelligence in safety-critical physical systems, where perception or reasoning errors can lead to unsafe decisions or actions. Although many red-teaming methods have been developed to probe VLM vulnerabilities, their evaluation remains fragmented across datasets, metrics, and threat models, making direct comparison difficult and obscuring whether observed differences arise from stronger attacks, more vulnerable models, or incompatible evaluation settings. Existing chatbot-centric red-teaming benchmarks mainly standardize jailbreak and content-safety evaluation, but they do not systematically capture physically grounded functional failures or cover red-teaming methods that target physical-world VLMs. This raises the key challenge of comparing diverse attack methods under a unified protocol while targeting the same scenario-specific failures. We introduce REALM, to our knowledge the first unified red-teaming benchmark for physical-world VLMs. REALM integrates 12 red-teaming methods, 3 model-agnostic defenses, and 13 VLMs under a practical black-box threat model with shared datasets and metrics. To align adversarial objectives across attack families, REALM introduces an agentic target-generation pipeline that constructs shared, scenario-specific, and physically grounded attack objectives for each scene, enabling fair comparison of diverse red-teaming methods under aligned adversarial goals. Our evaluation shows that text and typographic injection attacks induce the most failures, multimodal co-optimization yields the strongest visual-perturbation transfer, single-pass attacks approach iterative methods at much lower cost, and model scale alone does not confer adversarial robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/UCF-ML-Research/REALM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REALM 是首个针对物理世界视觉语言模型（VLM）的统一红队基准，整合了12种红队方法、3种模型无关防御和13种VLM，在共享数据集和指标下进行公平比较。评估发现文本和排版注入攻击最有效，多模态协同优化产生最强视觉扰动迁移，单次攻击在更低成本下接近迭代方法的效果，且模型规模本身并不带来对抗鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有VLM红队评估分散在不同数据集、指标和威胁模型下，难以直接比较不同攻击方法；且缺乏针对物理世界VLM功能性失败的系统性基准。
Method: REALM 集成12种红队方法、3种防御和13种VLM，提出代理目标生成管道，为每个场景构建共享、场景特定且物理基础的攻击目标，实现不同攻击家族在统一对抗目标下的公平比较。
Result: 文本和排版注入攻击导致最多失败；多模态协同优化产生最强视觉扰动迁移；单次攻击在更低成本下接近迭代方法；模型规模本身不带来对抗鲁棒性。
Conclusion: REALM 为物理世界VLM提供了统一红队评估框架，揭示了不同攻击方法的相对有效性，并指出模型规模不是对抗鲁棒性的保证。

papers.title: E-MRL: Cross-view Aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Reliable 3D Tumor Analysis
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show great promise in volumetric medical report generation, they frequently suffer from visual hallucinations and a lack of grounding in 3D CT data. Current Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) strategies typically optimize text fidelity alone, essentially rewarding correct diagnoses derived from language priors rather than genuine visual perception. To address this, we propose cross-view aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning (Evidence-MRL, noted as E-MRL), a reliable RL reasoning framework that formulates the generation process as a Markov Decision Process of "diagnosis-localization-verification". Unlike standard approaches, our model is explicitly trained to identify a "key evidence slice" alongside the global diagnostic report, grounding its findings in verifiable visual evidence. Crucially, we introduce a novel cross-view consistency reward, which validates the semantic alignment between the golden-standard report and a local visual re-query of the selected key slice, providing additional rewards for correctly-localized reasoning. Experiments on large-scale 3D CT tumor datasets demonstrate that E-MRL significantly reduces hallucinations and improves diagnostic accuracy compared to SFT and RL baselines, offering a clinically interpretable solution for visually-grounded and tumor analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨视图对齐的证据驱动多模态强化学习（E-MRL）框架，用于3D CT肿瘤分析中的视觉语言模型。该框架将生成过程建模为“诊断-定位-验证”的马尔可夫决策过程，并通过跨视图一致性奖励确保诊断基于可视证据。实验表明，该方法相比监督微调和强化学习基线显著减少幻觉并提高诊断准确性。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在体积医学报告生成中容易出现视觉幻觉，且缺乏对3D CT数据的真实基础，仅优化文本保真度导致奖励来自语言先验而非视觉感知。
Method: 提出E-MRL框架，将生成过程形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，包括诊断、定位和验证步骤。引入跨视图一致性奖励，验证黄金标准报告与所选关键切片局部视觉重新查询的语义对齐。
Result: 在大规模3D CT肿瘤数据集上，E-MRL相比SFT和RL基线显著减少幻觉并提高诊断准确性，提供临床可解释的视觉基础肿瘤分析。
Conclusion: E-MRL为视觉基础肿瘤分析提供了可靠的强化学习解决方案，增强了临床可解释性。

summary_sections.result: 在大规模3D CT肿瘤数据集上，E-MRL相比SFT和RL基线显著减少幻觉并提高诊断准确性，提供临床可解释的视觉基础肿瘤分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: E-MRL为视觉基础肿瘤分析提供了可靠的强化学习解决方案，增强了临床可解释性。

papers.title: Mind the Heads: Topological Representation Alignment for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Representation alignment has emerged as an effective approach to improve Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by regularizing their internal representations toward those of an external vision encoder. However, existing methods typically align a fixed layer of the language backbone, overlooking the fine-grained structure of Transformer models. In this work, we propose Head-Wise Representation Alignment (HeRA), a method that enforces cross-modal alignment at the level of individual attention heads. Our approach is grounded in the Platonic Representation Hypothesis, focusing on preserving the topological structure of representations (i.e., their local neighborhood relationships) across modalities. Following the Mutual K-Nearest Neighbor (MKNN) alignment metric, we introduce a contrastive objective that acts as a differentiable proxy for matching local structures. HeRA applies this objective during multimodal training to specific attention heads in the LLM, selected by their alignment score according to the MKNN metric. Counterintuitively, we find that aligning the least aligned heads yields the largest gains. Extensive evaluations across multiple MLLMs and 18 benchmarks demonstrate that HeRA consistently improves performance on challenging vision-centric tasks and serves as an effective regularizer against visual hallucinations by naturally curbing the over-reliance on linguistic priors. Our code is publicly released.

papers.title: One Year Later...The Harms Persist, But So Do We!
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for mental health-related conversations, yet safety safeguards remain inadequate and inconsistent across clinical conditions. This study evaluates six proprietary LLMs across 16 DSM-5 conditions using four adversarial attack variants, introducing an eight-dimension harm taxonomy and a multi-dimensional evaluation framework. Results show that safeguards hold reliably only for suicide and self-harm, while conditions such as eating disorders, substance use disorder, and major depressive disorder exhibit failure rates of up to 100%. We argue that ethical design and deployment of these LLMs demand clearly defined harm categories across clinical conditions and implementation of safeguards accordingly. Until such safeguards are in place, these models pose significant risks to vulnerable populations, making their growing integration into educational settings a particularly concerning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了六个商用大语言模型在16种DSM-5心理健康条件下的对抗攻击安全性，引入八维伤害分类框架。结果显示只有自杀和自伤防护可靠，而进食障碍、物质使用障碍和重度抑郁障碍的失败率高达100%。作者呼吁根据临床条件定义伤害类别并实施相应防护。
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多用于心理健康对话，但现有安全措施在跨临床条件下不足且不一致。
Method: 采用四种对抗攻击变体评估六个封闭源LLM，基于八维伤害分类框架和多维评估体系。
Result: 防护仅对自杀和自伤有效；进食障碍、物质使用障碍和重度抑郁障碍的对抗攻击失败率高达100%。
Conclusion: 需要针对不同临床条件定义伤害类别并实施对应安全措施，否则模型对脆弱人群存在显著风险，尤其在教育场景中的整合令人担忧。

papers.title: Ground Then Rank: Revisiting Knowledge-Based VQA with Training-Free Entity Identification
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires grounding visual queries to external knowledge beyond directly observable content in images. While recent multi modal large language models (MLLMs) show strong perceptual abilities, they struggle on KB-VQA tasks requiring groundings from both fine-grained entity and evidence levels. Most existing multi-modal retrieval augmented generation (MM-RAG) methods tightly couple entity discrimination and section-level evidence ranking into a single re-ranking stage, leading to high cost and limited generalization. In this work, we revisit existing MM-RAG solutions from a workflow perspective and argue both entity-level and fact-level groundings are key bottlenecks. We observe that although MLLMs often fail under open-ended entity naming, they can better identify the correct entity when selecting from a small set of candidate names. Based on this insight, we propose a simple and training-free identify-before-answer IBA framework that decouples entity identification from section-level re-ranking. Our approach prompts an MLLM to select high-confidence entities using only candidate names, followed by an off-the-shelf textual re-ranker for evidence selection. Experiments on Encyclopedic-VQA and InfoSeek show that our method consistently outperforms fine-tuned multi-modal re-ranking baselines while reducing training and inference complexity. Additional analyses reveal that the improvements arise not only from better entity identification, but also from selecting more informative evidence once correct entity is fixed. Our implementation is made public to ease reproducibility.
papers.comment: Accepted by ACL 2026 Findings. Project page https://github.com/VAN-QIAN/ACL26-IBA/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视知识基础视觉问答（KB-VQA）中的多模态检索增强生成（MM-RAG）方法，指出现有方法将实体识别与证据排序紧密耦合，导致高成本和泛化性差。基于MLLM在候选名称下能更好识别实体的观察，提出无需训练的“先识别后回答”（IBA）框架，将实体识别与章节级重排序解耦。在Encyclopedic-VQA和InfoSeek上，该方法优于微调的多模态重排序基线，同时降低训练和推理复杂度。
Motivation: 现有MM-RAG方法将实体识别和证据排序耦合在单一重排序阶段，成本高且泛化性差；MLLM在开放实体命名下容易失败，但在小范围候选名称中能更好识别。
Method: 提出IBA框架：先使用MLLM仅通过候选名称选择高置信度实体，再使用现成的文本重排序器进行证据选择，无需训练。
Result: 在Encyclopedic-VQA和InfoSeek上，该方法一致优于微调的多模态重排序基线，并降低训练和推理复杂度。改进不仅来自更好的实体识别，也来自正确实体下更信息性的证据选择。
Conclusion: 解耦实体识别与重排序是有效的，可降低复杂度并提升性能。方法已开源。

papers.title: GRACE: Gated Refinement for Accurate Causal Edge Discovery in High-Dimensional Time Series
papers.abstract_en: From climate teleconnections to gene regulation, modern time-series datasets encompass tens or hundreds of interacting variables, making causal discovery increasingly challenging. Constraint-based methods offer statistical rigor but their nonlinear CI tests are infeasible at scale, while score-based alternatives avoid CI testing but require arbitrary thresholds to binarize continuous edge scores. We propose GRACE ($\textbf{G}$ated $\textbf{R}$efinement for $\textbf{A}$ccurate $\textbf{C}$ausal $\textbf{E}$dge discovery), which refines constraint-based discovery using Hard Concrete gates with $L_0$ regularization: each candidate edge has an independent gate whose values concentrate near 0 or 1, yielding a clean bimodal separation that makes the binary decision robust, unlike the narrow, overlapping score distributions produced by $L_1$ and attention-based methods. A fast linear CI skeleton provides high-recall candidates; a single gated model then prunes false positives by learning which edges genuinely improve prediction, with automatic regularization adapted to problem dimensions and skeleton density. Systematic experiments on synthetic benchmarks, spanning diverse graph topologies (scale-free, Erdős-R'enyi, small-world) and dimensionalities up to $d=100$, show that GRACE substantially improves F1 over its base CI method while maintaining high precision, and outperforms attention-based and score-based alternatives. GRACE matches or exceeds expensive nonlinear CI tests at a fraction of the cost ($75\times$ faster). On a real-world river flow dataset, where rainfall confounders, variable propagation lags, and distributional shifts violate standard assumptions, a temporal bootstrap variant of GRACE recovers 9 of 11 causal edges along the Elbe River with only 1 false positive ($F_1 = 0.86$, AUROC${} = 0.99$), reducing the skeleton's 106 false positives by 99%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRACE 方法，利用 Hard Concrete 门和 L0 正则化，从高维时间序列中精确发现因果边。该方法结合线性 CI 骨架提供高召回候选，再通过门控模型修剪假阳性。在合成基准（包括不同图拓扑和维度高达 100）上，GRACE 显著提升 F1 分数，且比非线性 CI 测试快 75 倍。在易北河真实流量数据中，GRACE 的时序引导变量恢复 9/11 因果边，仅 1 个假阳性。
Motivation: 传统基于约束的因果发现在高维时间序列中受限于非线性 CI 测试的可扩展性，而基于分数的方法需要任意阈值二值化连续边分数，导致边界决策模糊。需要一种既能保持统计严谨性又能高效处理高维数据的因果发现方法。
Method: 提出 GRACE，使用 Hard Concrete 门和 L0 正则化：每个候选边有一个独立门，其值集中在 0 或 1，产生清晰的二值分离，避免 L1 和注意力方法产生的重叠分数分布。先使用快速线性 CI 骨架得到高召回候选，然后通过单个门控模型学习哪些边真正改善预测，并自动调整正则化以适应问题维度和骨架密度。
Result: 在合成基准（scale-free、Erdős-Rényi、small-world 拓扑，d=100）上，GRACE 相比基础 CI 方法大幅提高 F1，同时保持高精度，并优于基于注意力和基于分数的方法。GRACE 以 75 倍的速度匹配或超过昂贵的非线性 CI 测试。在易北河真实流量数据中，时间引导 GRACE 变体恢复 11 条因果边中的 9 条，仅 1 个假阳性（F1=0.86, AUROC=0.99），将骨架的 106 个假阳性减少 99%。
Conclusion: GRACE 提供了一种高效且鲁棒的因果发现方法，适用于高维时间序列，在真实世界河流流量数据中展示了在复杂条件（雨量混淆、传播滞后、分布偏移）下的有效性。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: Promise and challenges of heart chamber segmentation from non-contrast CT scans using contrastive unpaired image translation: a feasibility study
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: To evaluate the feasibility and challenges of heart chamber segmentation from non-contrast CT scans using contrastive unpaired image translation and deep learning-based segmentation. Approach: We developed ChameleonNet, a framework utilizing the Contrastive Unpaired Translation (CUT) network with decoupled contrastive learning (DCL) loss to synthesize non-contrast CT from contrast CT scans. Using annotations of four heart chambers (left atrium (LA), left ventricle (LV), right atrium (RA), and right ventricle (RV)) from contrast scans, we trained a Hausdorff distance loss-enhanced nnU-Net on synthesized non-contrast images. The translation model was trained with 35,538 contrast-enhanced and 37,197 non-contrast CT slices. The segmentation model was trained with 292 synthesized non-contrast scans. Performance was evaluated using Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) and 95th Hausdorff distance (HD95) on 36 synthesized non-contrast scans, and volume agreement on 36 real non-contrast CT scans was assessed using Pearson correlation, mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), and mean percentage error (MPE). Results: The segmentation model achieved DSC of 0.94 (0.01), 0.91 (0.04), 0.92 (0.03), 0.93 (0.02), and HD95 of 3.63 (1.49), 5.74 (4.08), 5.18 (1.77), 5.51 (3.21) mm on synthesized non-contrast images for LA, LV, RA, and RV, respectively. On real non-contrast CT scans, Pearson correlations were 0.93, 0.82, 0.87, and 0.89 (all p<0.001), with MAPE ranging from 9.22% to 20.79%, and MPE ranging from -12.52% to 4.67%. Conclusions: ChameleonNet demonstrated feasibility for heart chamber segmentation from non-contrast CT without manual non-contrast annotations. However, volume errors, particularly for LV and RV, indicate that further refinement and validation are needed before clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了使用对比无配对图像翻译和深度学习分割从非增强CT扫描中进行心脏腔室分割的可行性和挑战。开发了ChameleonNet框架，利用对比无配对翻译（CUT）网络和解耦对比学习（DCL）损失从增强CT合成非增强CT，并在合成图像上训练增强Hausdorff距离损失的nnU-Net。在合成非增强图像上对四个心腔（LA、LV、RA、RV）的Dice系数达到0.91-0.94，在真实非增强CT上体积相关性为0.82-0.93。结论表明可行，但体积误差特别是左心室和右心室需要进一步改进。
Motivation: 非增强CT扫描中心脏腔室分割通常需要大量手动标注，而增强CT标注更易获得。利用对比无配对图像翻译将增强CT转换为非增强CT，可在无需非增强标注的情况下实现分割，具有临床实用价值。
Method: 提出ChameleonNet框架：使用带解耦对比学习损失的CUT网络将增强CT转换为非增强CT；在合成非增强图像上训练Hausdorff距离损失增强的nnU-Net。翻译模型使用35,538张增强和37,197张非增强CT切片训练，分割模型使用292张合成非增强扫描训练。
Result: 在合成非增强图像上，LA、LV、RA、RV的DSC分别为0.94、0.91、0.92、0.93，HD95分别为3.63、5.74、5.18、5.51 mm。在真实非增强CT上，体积相关性为0.82-0.93（p<0.001），MAPE为9.22%-20.79%，MPE为-12.52%至4.67%。
Conclusion: ChameleonNet证明了从非增强CT分割心腔的可行性，无需手动非增强标注。但左心室和右心室的体积误差表明临床应用前需要进一步改进和验证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: ChameleonNet证明了从非增强CT分割心腔的可行性，无需手动非增强标注。但左心室和右心室的体积误差表明临床应用前需要进一步改进和验证。

papers.title: JupOtter: Cell-Level Bug Detection in Jupyter Notebooks
papers.abstract_en: Jupyter Notebooks are an increasingly popular coding environment used across many domains, especially in Python-based data science and scientific computing. Originally used for prototyping and interactive exploration, notebooks are increasingly used to develop more complex programs, leading to a rapid rise in buggy notebooks on platforms like GitHub. To address this trend, we present JupOtter, a bug detection system designed specifically for Jupyter Notebooks. JupOtter features three novel contributions: (1) a notebook-specific tokenization strategy that preserves cell structure, (2) a cell-level bug prediction technique, and (3) a new labeled dataset, OtterDataset, containing over 21,000 notebooks annotated for fine-grained cell-level bug detection. JupOtter achieves cell-level bug detection F1 scores that surpass static analyzers and large language models in two out of three evaluation datasets.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 42nd International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution - ICSME 2026 (Research Papers Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JupOtter，一个专为Jupyter Notebook设计的缺陷检测系统。系统包含三项创新：保留单元格结构的tokenization策略、单元格级缺陷预测技术，以及包含超过21000个笔记本的标注数据集OtterDataset。在三个评估数据集中的两个上，JupOtter的单元格级缺陷检测F1分数超过静态分析工具和大语言模型。
Motivation: Jupyter Notebook在数据科学和科学计算中日益流行，但随其用于开发复杂程序，错误笔记本数量迅速增长。现有静态分析器和LLM在笔记本特定错误检测上效果有限。

papers.title: MGI: Member vs Generated Inference
papers.abstract_en: As generative models increasingly produce samples that are indistinguishable from human-created content, it becomes difficult to determine whether a given data point was part of a model's natural training set or was generated by the model itself, especially when models memorize and reproduce training data. We formalize this challenge as Member vs Generated Inference (MGI): given a sample and a target generative model, infer whether the sample is a true training member or a generated output of that model. Focusing on image generation, we show that existing membership inference methods systematically misclassify generated samples as training members, while attribution-based methods often misclassify true members as generated. This failure arises because both approaches rely on likelihood-related signals that are similarly elevated for training examples and for the model's own outputs. To address MGI, we propose Data Circuit Breaker (DCB), a three-stage method that combines complementary signals from a generative model's autoencoder and latent generator to distinguish training members from generated samples. Across multiple generative models, including image autoregressive and diffusion models, DCB consistently addresses the shortcomings of membership inference and attribution methods, remains effective even when models reproduce near-duplicates of training samples, and generalizes to challenging model derivative settings in which new models are trained on generated data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了成员与生成推断（MGI）问题：给定一个样本和一个目标生成模型，推断该样本是训练集中的真实成员还是模型生成的输出。聚焦图像生成，发现现有成员推断方法系统性地将生成样本误分类为训练成员，而基于归因的方法则常常将真实成员误分类为生成样本。为此提出数据断路器（DCB）方法，利用生成模型的自编码器和潜在生成器的互补信号来区分成员与生成样本。DCB在多种生成模型（包括图像自回归和扩散模型）上始终有效，即使模型生成训练样本的近似重复时也有效，并泛化到基于生成数据训练新模型的导数设置。
Motivation: 生成模型生成的样本越来越难以与人类创作的内容区分，确定一个数据点是训练集成员还是模型生成变得困难，尤其是当模型记忆和复制训练数据时。现有方法在此任务上表现不佳。
Method: 提出数据断路器（Data Circuit Breaker, DCB），一个三阶段方法，结合生成模型的自编码器和潜在生成器的互补信号来区分训练成员和生成样本。
Result: 在多个生成模型（包括图像自回归和扩散模型）上，DCB始终优于现有的成员推断和归因方法，在模型生成训练样本近似重复时仍然有效，并能泛化到基于生成数据训练新模型的导数设置。
Conclusion: DCB有效解决了MGI问题，弥补了现有成员推断和归因方法的不足。

papers.title: Federated Survival Analysis in Healthcare: A Multi-Model Evaluation on Cross-Institutional Heterogeneous Breast Cancer Data
papers.abstract_en: Survival analysis is central to clinical decision-making, yet reliable time-to-event models require large, diverse cohorts that are rarely available at a single institution, while privacy regulations restrict the centralization of patient data. Federated learning (FL) offers a privacy-preserving alternative by training shared models without exchanging raw data, but its effectiveness for survival modeling under realistic, heterogeneous conditions remains insufficiently understood. This paper presents a systematic, multi-model evaluation of federated survival analysis on a cross-institutional breast cancer cohort with naturally heterogeneous distributed clients. Three representative survival models, the Cox Proportional Hazards model, DeepSurv, and Random Survival Forest (RSF), are compared across centralized, local, and federated training, and three federated optimization strategies (FedAvg, FedProx, and FedAdam) are assessed for the gradient-based models. Results show that FL consistently outperforms local training and approaches, and occasionally exceeds, centralized performance, while RSF offers the best overall balance of discrimination, calibration, and robustness across heterogeneous clients. We further find that performance depends on the diversity of client distributions, and that FedAvg and FedProx are stronger and more stable than FedAdam. Based on these findings, we derive practical, decision-oriented guidelines mapping data, privacy, interpretability, and resource constraints to recommended model and training-paradigm choices for federated survival modeling in healthcare.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了联邦学习在跨机构异质性乳腺癌数据上的生存分析表现，比较了Cox比例风险模型、DeepSurv和随机生存森林（RSF）在集中式、本地和联邦训练下的性能，并测试了FedAvg、FedProx和FedAdam三种联邦优化策略。结果表明联邦学习一致优于本地训练，接近甚至偶尔超过集中式性能，其中RSF在鉴别力、校准度和鲁棒性上达到最佳平衡，且FedAvg和FedProx比FedAdam更稳定。基于结果给出了面向决策的模型与训练范式选择指南。
Motivation: 生存分析依赖大规模、多样化的患者数据，但单一机构难以获取，且隐私法规限制数据集中化，联邦学习提供隐私保护替代方案，但其在真实异质性条件下的生存建模效果尚不明确。
Method: 采用三种典型生存模型（Cox、DeepSurv、RSF）和三种联邦优化策略（FedAvg、FedProx、FedAdam），在跨机构乳腺癌数据集上进行系统比较，评估不同客户端分布下的性能。
Result: 联邦学习一致优于本地训练，RSF在异质性客户端上取得最佳鉴别力、校准度和鲁棒性；FedAvg和FedProx优于FedAdam且更稳定。
Conclusion: 联邦学习可有效应对生存分析中的数据分散和隐私问题，RSF是推荐模型，FedAvg/FedProx是推荐优化策略，实际选择需根据数据多样性、隐私、可解释性和资源约束决定。

papers.title: Exact Schur-Sylvester Dimensionality Reductions for Non-Smooth Stochastic Complexity and Manifold Sampling
papers.abstract_en: The exact computation of the Normalized Maximum Likelihood (NML) codelength for regular non-smooth estimators (e.g., Lasso) has been historically limited by the cubic scaling walls of manifold-constrained projection and volume integration. At each step of the geometric Propose-and-Project Metropolis--Hastings (PPMH) sampler, evaluating the projection operator requires inverting an $(N+k) \times (N+k)$ generalized KKT matrix, while calculating the volume factor requires the determinant of an $(N-k) \times (N-k)$ Gram matrix. This paper presents an exact, mathematically equivalent formulation that bypasses both bottlenecks by utilizing the block Schur complement and Sylvester's determinant identity. We prove that the computational complexity of both operations collapses from $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ to $\mathcal{O}(k^3 + N^2 k)$ per step. We generalize this reduction to Sparse Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Elastic Net, and Group Lasso. Finally, we provide a rigorous numerical stability analysis and evaluate the sampler's efficiency using the Effective Sample Size (ESS) per second. Our empirical benchmarks on high-dimensional datasets confirm a constant speedup exceeding $14{,}100\times$ while maintaining double-precision numerical equivalence, rendering exact non-smooth NML estimation highly tractable for large-scale statistical inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种精确的Schur-Sylvester维度缩减方法，用于非光滑估计器（如Lasso）的正则化最大似然（NML）编码长度计算，将每步计算复杂度从O(N^3)降至O(k^3+N^2k)，并在高维数据集上获得超过14100倍的加速。
Motivation: 传统非光滑估计的NML计算因流形约束投影和体积积分面临立方复杂度瓶颈，限制了大规模应用。
Method: 利用块Schur补和Sylvester行列式恒等式，对PPMH采样器中的投影算子和体积因子计算进行精确的数学等价变换，降低复杂度。
Result: 复杂度从O(N^3)降为O(k^3+N^2k)，在双精度数值等价下实现超14100倍加速。
Conclusion: 该方法使精确非光滑NML估计对大规模统计推断变得高度可行，并推广到Sparse SVM、Elastic Net和Group Lasso。

papers.title: Are Safety Guarantees in Neural Networks Safe? How to Compute Trustworthy Robustness Certifications
papers.abstract_en: A primary challenge in AI safety is the existence of adversarial examples -- slightly distorted inputs that cause a neural network (NN) to misclassify. To mitigate this problem, recent research focuses on the computation of robustness certifications, which, for a given input, determine the largest distortion the input may receive without breaking the network's prediction. Robustness certifications can be interpreted as an axis-aligned hyper-rectangle (multi-dimensional intervals). Most existing approaches focus on maximizing the certification's volume, but recent intractability results prohibit the computation of volume-optimal certifications in reasonable time. We introduce the apothem measure and show how to compute apothem-optimal certifications in a linear number of calls to a NN verifier (oracle) w.r.t. the input domain's diameter. Moreover, we prove that we cannot have a volume-optimal, oracle-based algorithm, even if we discard the oracle costs. Also, we introduce dual certifications -- an interval including all instances of a class -- thus providing apothem-minimum upper bounds to a robustness certification. Further, we present the ParallelepipedoNN system, which we evaluate on the standard MNIST and Fashion MNIST benchmarks. A preliminary comparison with existing work on the same datasets reveals at least two-fold improvement w.r.t. the minimum edge length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经网络鲁棒性认证的计算问题，提出apothem度量并证明可以线性时间计算apothem最优的认证，同时证明了体积最优的基于oracle的算法不可能存在。还提出了对偶认证和ParallelepipedoNN系统，在MNIST和Fashion MNIST上相比现有工作至少有两倍的最小边长改进。
Motivation: 现有鲁棒性认证大多追求最大体积，但近期不可解性结果表明在合理时间内无法计算体积最优认证，需要新的度量标准。
Method: 引入apothem度量，证明可在输入域直径的线性次数内调用神经网络验证器（oracle）计算apothem最优认证；同时提出对偶认证和ParallelepipedoNN系统。
Result: 在MNIST和Fashion MNIST上，与现有工作在相同数据集上的初步比较显示最小边长至少有两倍改进。
Conclusion: 结果表明apothem度量是一种可行的替代方案，且对偶认证为鲁棒性认证提供了apothem最小上界。

papers.title: Sesame: Structure-Aware Molecular Generation via Spatial Density-Map Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Generative molecular models for drug design are a promising direction with much active research. In the next phase of computational drug design, such models will need to understand small molecule structure and protein-ligand interactions, and they will need to possess the machinery to generate molecules \textit{de novo}. Incorporating each feature poses a critical challenge. Equally important, yet often treated as secondary, is the ability to grow a molecule from a partial starting point -- a scaffold or fragment supplied by a chemist -- which is the central operation of lead optimization. We present Sesame (Spatial Evoformer for a Structure-Aware Molecular Engine), a diffusion-based molecular generation model that leverages a novel spatial pairformer module to condition on partial molecular structure and the surrounding protein pocket, both expressed as continuous spatial density maps. This single conditioning mechanism supports both \textit{de novo} generation and fragment-conditioned lead optimization, letting a medicinal chemist prune a hit to a scaffold and have Sesame grow it in productive ways. In addition to this module, we also introduce a diffusion framework for joint denoising of atom types, bond types, and positions, along with a trajectory finetuning scheme that trains on the model's own sampling rollouts to improve generation quality. Sesame is trained on a large corpus of ligand-only and protein-ligand datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sesame，一个基于扩散的分子生成模型，通过空间密度图条件同时支持从头设计和片段先导优化。模型引入空间对变换模块 (spatial pairformer) 处理分子碎片和蛋白口袋的连续密度表示，并联合去噪原子类型、键类型和位置。摘要报告模型在配体-蛋白质数据集上训练。
Motivation: 现有分子生成模型往往将片段条件生长（先导优化的核心操作）视为次要功能，且缺乏统一处理从头生成和片段条件的机制。
Method: 提出空间密度图条件的扩散框架：利用空间对变换模块 (spatial pairformer) 将分子碎片和蛋白口袋编码为连续密度图；采用联合去噪原子类型、键类型和位置的扩散过程；并引入轨迹微调 (trajectory finetuning) 使用模型自身采样 rollout 来提升生成质量。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的定量结果或基准测试，仅说明模型在配体-蛋白质数据集上训练。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该单一条件机制可统一支持从头生成和片段条件的先导优化，使药物化学家能够修剪命中化合物为骨架并让模型有效生长。

papers.title: The Measurable Majority
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies strict majority reasoning in finite electorates using so-called $\textit{social decision frames}$: finite sets of voters equipped with distinguished families of coalitions interpreted as those voting blocs evaluated to form a strict majority. A coherence criterion for qualitative majority judgments is identified and shown to give an exact characterization for representability of strict majorities by finitely additive measures. In addition, a minimal natural logic for reasoning about strict majorities is shown to be sound and complete. These developments motivate examination of associated combinatorial questions concerning incoherence in finite families of sets; partial results and a conjecture are given. Finally, the results of this paper are applied to correct a classical representation theorem for weak qualitative probability structures due to Patrick Suppes and to establish a May-type characterization for ordinary strict majority rule for social decision frames.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有限选民群体中的严格多数推理，引入社会决策框架概念，识别了定性多数判断的一致性标准，并证明该标准可由有限可加测度严格多数表示。还给出了严格多数推理的最小自然逻辑的完全性和可靠性定理，并应用于纠正Patrick Suppes关于弱定性概率结构的经典表示定理，以及建立社会决策框架下普通严格多数规则的May型刻画。
Motivation: 现有关于多数推理的形式化工作缺乏对严格多数（strict majority）在有限选民群体中表示性的精确刻画，尤其是与社会决策框架中的联盟结构结合时。
Method: 通过社会决策框架（有限选民集及特定联盟族）定义严格多数判断，提出并证明一致性条件与有限可加测度表示之间的等价性，并构建一个最小逻辑系统并证明其可靠完全性。
Result: 摘要报告了严格多数判断的表示定理、所提逻辑的可靠性完全性、以及两个应用：纠正Suppes的经典定理和推广May定理。
Conclusion: 本文为严格多数推理提供了严格的数学基础，并展示了其在决策理论和概率推理中的价值。
