papers.title: Machine Learning Modeling for Real-Time Melt Pool Monitoring in Laser Powder Bed Fusion Additive Manufacturing: A Hybrid Approach
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates the implementation of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) for real-time monitoring in laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) additive manufacturing. We developed a binary image classification framework for distinguishing normal and abnormal melt pool images using a balanced dataset of 1,200 images collected from Nickel superalloy 625 on the NIST AMMT platform. The study evaluates accuracy and inference time based on control requirements and hardware limitations of open-architecture LPBF machines. We benchmark three transfer learning architectures (ResNet50, EfficientNetB0, and MobileNetV2) against two Random Forest approaches: one trained on EfficientNetB0 feature embeddings (hybrid) and one trained on raw pixel features (baseline). Images are stratified into 80/20 train-test splits, with a further 90/10 validation split on the training set, and undergo standardized resizing, normalization, and label-preserving data augmentation to emulate realistic process variability. Each model is evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), along with training time, inference latency, and CPU & GPU usage to capture deployability constraints relevant to factory-floor monitoring. The hybrid EfficientNetB0-plus-Random Forest approach achieves the best performance on the held-out test set, with an F1 score of 0.9451, accuracy of 0.9458, and AUC of 0.9904, while maintaining sub-millisecond per-image inference (1.15 ms). In contrast, purely deep learning models exhibit significantly higher inference times with lower accuracy. These results demonstrate that combining pre-trained convolutional features with classical ensemble methods provides a robust, computationally efficient route to real-time melt pool anomaly detection in data-limited additive manufacturing environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）增材制造中，利用机器学习实现实时熔池监控。通过平衡数据集（1200张镍超合金625图像），比较了三种迁移学习架构（ResNet50、EfficientNetB0、MobileNetV2）与两种随机森林方法（基于EfficientNetB0特征嵌入的混合模型和基于原始像素的基线模型）的性能。混合EfficientNetB0加随机森林方法在测试集上取得最佳效果，F1分数0.9451，准确率0.9458，AUC 0.9904，且每张图像推理时间仅1.15毫秒。
Motivation: LPBF增材制造中，实时监控熔池异常有助于提高打印质量，但数据有限且需要兼顾计算效率，现有纯深度学习模型推理时间较长，需要更高效的方案。
Method: 采用二值图像分类框架，利用迁移学习提取特征（EfficientNetB0）后，再使用随机森林进行分类（混合方法），并与纯深度学习模型及基于原始像素的随机森林基线进行对比。数据增强模拟过程变异性，评估指标包括精度、召回率、F1分数、AUC以及推理延迟和资源占用。
Result: 混合EfficientNetB0加随机森林方法在测试集上F1分数0.9451，准确率0.9458，AUC 0.9904，推理时间1.15毫秒，优于纯深度学习模型和其他对比方法。
Conclusion: 结合预训练卷积特征与经典集成方法，能在数据有限的增材制造环境中实现鲁棒、计算高效的实时熔池异常检测，适合工厂部署。

papers.title: HANCLIP: A Family of Hyperbolic Angular Negation Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are typically pre-trained on large-scale image-text datasets to capture semantic correspondences between visual content and natural language. However, they remain surprisingly brittle to negation: models often rely on shallow word co-occurrence and are easily distracted by misleading or irrelevant textual cues, even when their overall retrieval or classification performance is strong. Moreover, directly finetuning on negation data can interfere with previously acquired knowledge, causing noticeable degradation on standard vision-language benchmarks. To tackle these issues, this work introduces HANCLIP (Hyperbolic + Angular + Negation), a family of VLMs that explicitly restructures the embedding space to encode "what an image is not" alongside "what it is." HANCLIP is trained on a compact set of 20,000 image-text quadruplets and combines a hyperbolic formulation, which models hierarchical semantic relations and asymmetries, with an angular triplet objective that drives systematic separation between negated descriptions and their corresponding positives. This geometry-aware design strengthens negation sensitivity while preserving the global structure of pretrained representations, rather than overwriting them. Extensive experiments across multiple vision-language tasks show that HANCLIP delivers consistent gains on the negation-focused NegBench benchmark, while maintaining competitive or improved performance on standard classification and image-text retrieval benchmarks. The framework is model-agnostic and can be plugged into CLIP, LongCLIP, SmartCLIP, and HiMo-CLIP without large-scale retraining, demonstrating that a carefully designed geometric objective can substantially extend the reasoning capabilities of existing VLMs using only modest additional data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HANCLIP系列模型，通过双曲空间和角度三元组目标重构嵌入空间，显式编码“图像不是什么”，以提升视觉语言模型对否定的理解能力。在2万图像-文本四元组上训练后，模型在NegBench基准上取得一致提升，同时保持标准分类和检索任务的性能。该框架可即插即用到CLIP等现有VLM中。
Motivation: 现有VLM对否定表达脆弱，容易依赖表层词共现，而直接微调否定数据会干扰已有知识，导致标准基准性能下降。
Method: 结合双曲公式建模层级语义和不对称性，以及角度三元组目标驱动否定描述与对应肯定描述的系统性分离，在紧凑数据集上训练。
Result: 在NegBench上取得一致增益，标准分类和图像-文本检索基准上保持竞品或更优性能。
Conclusion: 精心设计的几何目标能用少量扩展数据显著增强现有VLM的推理能力，且方法模型无关。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Degeneracy Distillery
papers.abstract_en: When two or more parameters or labels produce similar data, they are degenerate, or hard to distinguish. Degeneracies render both label prediction and inverse problems difficult, since both machine learning algorithms and probabilistic samplers rely on the distinguishability of data and its gradients with respect to parameters. However, identifying degeneracies in physical models or real-world datasets can be elucidating about the choice of model or the underlying process that produces the data. We present the degeneracy distillery, a method that (1) detects and (2) resolves degenerate parameter combinations (a) automatically and (b) symbolically, from parameter-data (or parameter-simulation) pairs alone, through estimation and flattening of the Fisher information matrix. By exploring the information geometry of the likelihood, we characterize degeneracies as an intrinsic property of the physical model, requiring no realised data observation. We demonstrate our approach on a range of synthetic and real-world problems, discovering symbolic coordinate transformations that identify the combinations of parameters of a model which yield independent effects on the data. The resulting coordinates flatten the Fisher information in expectation globally, in contrast to posterior-based methods that flatten only at a single point, and substantially reduce the simulation budget required for downstream neural posterior estimation. In test cases we require up to $10\times$ fewer simulations for posterior estimation at matched validation calibration whilst simultaneously gaining physical insight on the system.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 10 figures. Supporting code found at https://github.com/tlmakinen/degeneracy_distillery
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“退化蒸馏”（degeneracy distillery）方法，通过估计和展平Fisher信息矩阵，自动且符号化地检测并解决参数-数据对中的退化参数组合，从而揭示物理模型的内在退化结构，并显著降低后续神经后验估计所需的模拟预算。
Motivation: 在物理模型和真实数据集中，参数或标签的退化（degeneracy）导致预测和反问题求解困难，而识别退化有助于理解模型和数据生成过程。现有方法难以自动、符号化地处理退化。
Method: 基于Fisher信息矩阵的估计与展平，从参数-数据（或参数-模拟）对中自动提取符号化的坐标变换，使得新坐标在期望上全局展平Fisher信息，无需实际数据观测。
Result: 在合成和真实问题上，方法发现了符号化的坐标变换，识别出对数据产生独立影响的参数组合；在神经后验估计中，以匹配的验证校准为条件，最多可减少10倍的模拟预算。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种自动、符号化的退化检测与解决框架，能节省下游模拟预算并增进对系统的物理理解。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: ABACUS: Adapting Unified Foundation Model for Bridging Image Count Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: ABACUS is a unified vision-language model that handles object counting, crowd counting, referring-expression counting, and count-faithful image generation without any benchmark-specific training required. Our model is built on existing 3B-parameter unified foundation model and is adapted for object localization tasks using three key innovations: density-aware adaptive zooming with objectness maps for spatial grounding; a boundary-aware count policy via GRPO to eliminate crop-boundary errors; and a cycle-consistent GRPO strategy where the understanding branch self-critiques generated outputs, closing the understanding-generation gap without any external annotations. ABACUS achieves state-of-the-art results across seven benchmarks, outperforming both task-specific specialists and larger generalist models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ABACUS 是一个统一的视觉语言模型，能够处理目标计数、人群计数、参照表达计数以及计数逼真的图像生成，无需针对特定基准进行训练。该模型基于现有的 3B 参数统一基础模型，通过三个关键创新进行适配：密度感知自适应缩放（结合 objectness maps 实现空间定位）、基于 GRPO 的边界感知计数策略（消除裁剪边界误差）以及循环一致性 GRPO 策略（理解分支自我批评生成输出，缩小理解-生成差距）。在七个基准测试上取得了最先进的结果，超越了任务特定专家和更大的通用模型。
Motivation: 现有计数和生成模型通常需要针对特定基准进行训练，缺乏统一的解决方案；同时，空间定位不准确和裁剪边界错误等问题影响了性能。
Method: 提出三个创新：1) 密度感知自适应缩放，利用 objectness maps 进行空间定位；2) 通过 GRPO 实现的边界感知计数策略，减少裁剪边界误差；3) 循环一致性 GRPO 策略，让理解分支对生成输出进行自我批评，从而缩小理解与生成之间的差距。
Result: 在七个基准测试上取得了最先进的结果，超过了任务特定专家和更大的通用模型。
Conclusion: ABACUS 展示了统一基础模型在计数理解和生成任务上的有效性，无需外部标注即可达到优异性能。

papers.title: Reconstructing GRACE Terrestrial Water Storage with Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks: An Application to South America
papers.abstract_en: Terrestrial water storage (TWS) integrates snow, soil moisture, surface water, and groundwater and is a key indicator of how climate variability and human activity reshape the global water cycle. The GRACE and GRACE-FO satellite missions provide the only direct, globally consistent observations of TWS change, but their record only begins in 2002 which is too short for many climate-scale analyses. We present a deep learning application that reconstructs monthly GRACE-like TWS anomalies (TWSA) back to 1940 by learning the relationship between daily ERA5 meteorological forcing (precipitation, evapotranspiration, runoff) and monthly GRACE observations. In contrast to prior reconstruction approaches based on grid-cell-wise regression, CNNs, or LSTMs, we adapt a multi-variate time series graph neural network (MTGNN) architecture, which was originally developed for mobility and traffic forecasting on urban sensor networks to this satellite-geodesy task. Spatial dependencies are encoded in a static, interpretable hybrid adjacency matrix that combines geodesic proximity with lagged correlations of climatic time series, capturing both local hydrological coupling and large-scale teleconnections. The reconstruction achieves a grid-cell Pearson correlation of 0.69, a basin-mean correlation of 0.94, and a near-zero bias, and it reproduces the spatial fingerprints of the 2015/16 El Niño and 2020/21 La Niña events. A systematic comparison with established reconstruction approaches (GTWS-MLrec, RM-REC, GRAiCE) shows that the graph-based model is statistically competitive at basin scale, reaching a correlation within 0.025 of the best baseline while using only roughly half to a tenth of the predictors the other models require and revealing characteristic weaknesses in arid regions in all models. The complete implementation is publicly available at github.com/hcu-cml/MTGNN-TWS-Reconstruction-GRACE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用时空图神经网络（MTGNN）重建GRACE卫星的陆地水储量异常（TWSA），将时间回溯至1940年。方法基于ERA5气象强迫数据（降水、蒸散发、径流）与GRACE观测之间的关系，构建静态可解释的混合邻接矩阵（结合测地距离与滞后相关性），在南美洲实现网格单元相关系数0.69、流域平均相关系数0.94，并成功再现2015/16厄尔尼诺和2020/21拉尼娜事件的空间特征。与现有方法（GTWS-MLrec、RM-REC、GRAiCE）相比，该模型在流域尺度上统计竞争力相当，但仅需较少预测变量。
Motivation: GRACE卫星仅从2002年开始提供TWS观测，记录太短，不足以支撑气候尺度的分析。现有重建方法（如网格回归、CNN、LSTM）未能充分捕捉空间依赖性和遥相关。
Method: 采用多变量时间序列图神经网络（MTGNN），将水文站点视为图节点，构建混合邻接矩阵（结合测地距离和气候变量的滞后相关性），以ERA5逐日数据作为输入，训练模型重建月尺度的GRACE-like TWSA。
Result: 网格单元Pearson相关系数0.69，流域均值相关系数0.94，偏差接近零。在2015/16厄尔尼诺和2020/21拉尼娜事件中再现空间模式。与三种基线相比，流域相关性差距不超过0.025，但所需预测变量仅为基线的十分之一到一半。
Conclusion: 图神经网络可有效利用空间结构信息进行TWS重建，在精度相当的前提下大幅降低输入变量需求，但在干旱区域所有模型均存在系统性弱点。

papers.title: Decentralized Coordination of Autonomous Traffic Through Advanced Air Mobility Corridors
papers.abstract_en: The use of dedicated corridors for Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) traffic is one of the most commonly proposed pathways to integrating them into existing airspace operations. Most prior research has focused on the design of networks of AAM corridors and conflict resolution for aircraft within corridors. It is also generally believed that while attractive from an implementation perspective, corridor-based operations may be inefficient, especially in the absence of centralized traffic management. In this paper, we show that contrary to this belief, it is possible for autonomous aircraft to learn to self-organize into corridor flows in decentralized settings. We illustrate our approach using scenarios in which fixed-wing aircraft need to safely and efficiently traverse (1) a single corridor with metering after the exit, (2) a sequence of two consecutive corridors, and (3) a corridor that splits into two. We find that in decentralized settings with only local information, the aircraft are able to conform to the corridor boundaries more than 94% of the time and reach their goal in a relatively efficient manner. Furthermore, tactical interventions to handle violations of the separation minimum are needed only infrequently in low- and medium-density settings. However, such tactical interventions become more frequently necessary only when traffic density is high.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究先进空中交通（AAM）走廊中自主飞行器的分散协调问题。通过三个仿真场景（单走廊、连续双走廊、分叉走廊），证明在仅依赖局部信息的情况下，飞行器能自组织形成走廊流，超过94%的时间遵守走廊边界，并高效到达目标。低中密度下战术干预需求极少，高密度下则频繁出现。
Motivation: 先前认为走廊操作在缺乏集中管理时效率低下，本文旨在反驳这一观点，探索分散场景下自主飞行器自组织的可行性。
Method: 采用三个仿真场景（单走廊出口计费、连续双走廊、走廊分叉），飞行器仅基于局部信息进行分散协调，观察其自组织行为。
Result: 飞行器超过94%的时间遵守走廊边界；低中密度下战术干预需求极少，高密度下干预频率增加。
Conclusion: 分散协调在低中密度场景下可行且高效，但高密度场景下需更多战术干预，表明该方法的适用性受流量密度限制。

papers.title: Deciphering Fingerprints of 3D Molecular Surfaces for Accurate Epitope Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Molecular surfaces encode the geometric and physicochemical patterns that determine antibody-antigen recognition, central to epitope prediction. However, existing methods rely on sequences or backbone structures and struggle to capture discontinuous, surface-driven epitopes. This study presents SurfBind, a surface-centric learning framework for epitope prediction that operates directly on molecular surface representations. SurfBind integrates geometric and physicochemical cues through a Transformer-based architecture with patch-level surface modeling, binder-aware cross-attention, and a hierarchical coarse-to-fine prediction paradigm. Experiments on challenging epitope identification benchmarks, including SAbDab and DB5.5, demonstrate that SurfBind achieves state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization across unseen antibodies and conformational states, highlighting the value of interaction-aware surface modeling for understanding the crucial mechanisms of protein-protein interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SurfBind，一种直接基于分子表面表示进行表位预测的框架。该方法通过 Transformer 架构、补丁级表面建模、结合剂感知交叉注意力和层次化粗到细预测范式，集成几何和物理化学线索。在 SAbDab 和 DB5.5 基准上，SurfBind 取得了最优性能，并在未见抗体和构象状态下展现出强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有表位预测方法依赖序列或骨架结构，难以捕获不连续的、表面驱动的表位，亟需一种表面导向的建模方式。
Method: 提出 SurfBind，直接操作分子表面表示，集成几何和物理化学线索；采用 Transformer 架构进行补丁级表面建模，引入结合剂感知交叉注意力，并设计层次化粗到细预测范式。
Result: 在 SAbDab 和 DB5.5 表位识别基准上达到最优性能，并在未见抗体和不同构象状态下展现强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 交互感知的表面建模对于理解蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的关键机制具有重要价值。

papers.title: From stable online coupling to decade-long climate simulations: A machine learning parameterization for cloud microphysics in ICON
papers.abstract_en: The representation of cloud microphysics and its nonlinear character and scale-dependence is a remaining source of uncertainty in Earth system models (ESMs). Here, we develop and couple online a machine learning (ML)-based cloud microphysics parameterization with the Icosahedral non-hydrostatic modeling framework (ICON). The primary challenge is achieving numerically stable, long-term online coupling when transitioning from training with km-scale data to application in coarse-scale simulations, where the coupled system encounters atmospheric states and feedbacks not seen during training. The training data is obtained from a global convection-permitting ICON simulation at 5 km resolution. The ML microphysics scheme uses a two-stage design: a classifier to identify active grid cells and a regressor to predict cloud microphysical tendencies. Physical constraints such as enforcing mass positivity and overshoot prevention prove essential for numerical stability in the coupled system. We demonstrate that achieving stable online coupling requires enforcing physical constraints and careful dataset curation, and that strong offline performance alone is insufficient. The coupled model maintains numerical stability over decade-long simulations with a performance in reproducing the observed climate comparable to the classical graupel scheme. The ML-based scheme eliminates two microphysics-specific tuning parameters of the classical graupel scheme, though systematic improvements in long-term mean-state biases are not yet realized. This study demonstrates that stable, decade-long climate simulations with an ML-based cloud microphysics scheme trained on convection-permitting data are feasible, providing a foundation for future hybrid ESMs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文开发并在线耦合了一个基于机器学习的云微物理参数化方案到ICON地球系统模型中，使用从5公里对流允许模拟中获得的训练数据。该方案采用两阶段设计（分类器识别活跃网格点，回归器预测微物理倾向），并施加物理约束（如质量正性、过冲抑制）以实现数值稳定性。耦合模型在十年尺度模拟中保持稳定，重现观测气候的性能与经典霰方案相当，但尚未实现系统性偏差改进。
Motivation: 云微物理的非线性和尺度依赖性仍是地球系统模型不确定性的重要来源，现有经典方案需手动调整参数，且从高分辨率训练数据到粗分辨率耦合应用存在稳定性挑战。
Method: 基于ICON框架，使用5公里对流允许模拟数据训练ML微物理方案：两阶段结构（分类器+回归器），强制施加质量正性和过冲抑制等物理约束，并精心筛选训练数据集以实现稳定在线耦合。
Result: 耦合模型在十年模拟中保持数值稳定，重现观测气候的性能与经典霰方案相当，且消除了经典方案中的两个微物理特定调参参数，但长时均态系统性偏差尚未改善。
Conclusion: 基于ML的云微物理方案可实现与经典方案相当的十年稳定气候模拟，为未来混合地球系统模型提供基础；但需进一步减小长期偏差。

papers.title: Hessian-augmented Supervised Learning for Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman PDEs
papers.abstract_en: A data-driven method is developed for approximating value functions in deterministic optimal control problems with nonlinear control-affine dynamics. The Pontryagin Maximum Principle optimality system is solved from multiple initial conditions to generate training data consisting of values, gradients, and Hessians of the value function, where Hessian information is obtained from a matrix Riccati equation along optimal trajectories. These quantities augment a weighted least-squares regression over sparse polynomial bases on hyperbolic cross index sets, with gradients and Hessians contributing additional linear equations per sample and substantially reducing sample complexity compared to value-only regression. Feedback laws are recovered analytically from the learned value function. In high dimensions, a partial Hessian strategy controls the cost of data generation. The approach is validated on problems of increasing state dimension, where second-order data augmentation is shown to improve approximation accuracy and closed-loop performance, with up to an order-of-magnitude reduction in the number of training samples required relative to lower-order methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动方法，通过求解Pontryagin最大值原理最优性系统生成包含值函数、梯度和Hessian的训练数据，其中Hessian来自沿最优轨迹的矩阵Riccati方程。这些量增强了对稀疏多项式基（双曲交叉索引集）的加权最小二乘回归，每个样本提供梯度和Hessian的附加线性方程，相比仅用值回归大幅降低了样本复杂度。从学得的值函数解析恢复反馈律。在高维中，采用部分Hessian策略控制数据生成成本。在状态维数递增的问题上验证，二阶数据增强提高了近似精度和闭环性能，所需训练样本比低阶方法减少一个数量级。
Motivation: 高维最优控制中值函数近似面临维数灾难，仅用值函数信息的回归方法需要大量样本。本文利用Pontryagin最优性系统提供的额外Hessian信息来增强回归，旨在降低样本复杂度并提高近似精度。
Method: 从多个初始条件求解Pontryagin最大值原理最优性系统，生成值、梯度和Hessian的训练数据；将这三个量纳入稀疏多项式基的加权最小二乘回归（梯度与Hessian提供每样本多条线性方程）；通过解析恢复反馈律；高维时采用部分Hessian策略（仅对部分状态变量计算Hessian）。
Result: 在状态维数递增的测试问题上，二阶数据增强相比仅用值或一阶方法的近似误差更小，闭环控制性能更优，且所需训练样本数量降低一个数量级。
Conclusion: 利用Pontryagin最大值原理及矩阵Riccati方程获取的Hessian信息，可以显著提升数据驱动价值函数近似的样本效率与精度，尤其适用于无模型设置或需要高精度反馈律的场景。

papers.title: From Spatial to Spectral: An Efficient, Frequency-Guided Feature Representation Learner for Small Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Efficient small object detection is bottlenecked by the inherent feature scarcity of tiny targets, which is further aggravated by operations of spatial-domain detectors that indiscriminately discard critical high-frequency details. Recovering these fragile cues within the spatial domain is notoriously difficult, as it often requires computationally expensive architectural upscaling that inadvertently amplifies background noise. To bridge this gap, we propose a paradigm \textbf{shift from spatial to spectral} feature processing, introducing a holistic solution with the following novelty: (1) A versatile \textbf{Frequency-Guided Feature Representation framework} that generalizes across diverse detector architectures (both CNN and Transformer-based), offering a robust alternative to spatial-only feature extraction; (2) The unified \textbf{Decompose--Enhance--Reconstruct (DER)} operator, instantiated via three \textbf{lightweight, plug-and-play} modules -- Wavelet-Difference Gate (WDG), Log-Gabor Enhancer (LGE), and Frequency-Driven Head (FDHead) -- to systematically inject frequency-aware modulation into the backbone, neck, and head. This mechanism decouples feature modeling from resolution reduction, capturing discriminative high-frequency components to enable accurate localization with significantly reduced parameter redundancy; (3) Extensive validation on multi-domain benchmarks (VisDrone2019, UAVDT, TinyPerson, DOTAv1) demonstrating consistent gains. Notably, our proposed \textbf{DERNet} series outperforms YOLOv11 models under the same scale while requiring \textbf{only 1/6 of the parameters}, backed by rigorous spectral diagnostics and error decomposition analysis.

papers.title: Ten Digits on a Train: AI-Assisted Verification of Two Eigenvalue Problems
papers.abstract_en: Accurate numerical eigenvalues are often difficult to certify, especially in singular or non-normal settings. This article reports a human--AI collaboration on two such computations. For a singular self-adjoint Schrödinger operator, a verified zero count and Dirichlet--Neumann bracketing certify the complete negative spectrum to ten decimal places. For a delicate non-normal atom--molecule benchmark, a previously unresolved resonance pair is separated, with each member enclosed to ten digits. The second result is achieved not by increasing the precision of one-way shooting, but by reformulating the problem as a global matching system for projective solution lines. The infinite tail is encoded as uncertainty in the terminal projective data, and a componentwise, tail-robust Krawczyk--Brouwer inclusion supplies the certificate. This gives a reusable architecture for analytic boundary-value systems with ill-conditioned propagation and uncertain asymptotic data. The collaboration also exposes the strengths and limits of AI assistance. AI rapidly produced accurate candidates and plausible proof strategies, but several failed, including one apparently complete tail argument that omitted the componentwise check required by a nonuniform polydisc. Validated computation is a stringent test of AI-assisted mathematics: the output is not merely a number, but a number with a proof. These examples show why the proof object matters, and why human mathematical judgment remained decisive. More broadly, as AI makes code, exposition, and plausible numerical claims inexpensive, standards for verification, attribution, peer review, and training must adapt. The implications are unsettling; the opportunity is extraordinary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报道人类与AI协作验证两个特征值问题：对奇异自伴Schrödinger算子，通过零计数与Dirichlet-Neumann bracketing将完全负谱认证至十位小数；对非正规原子-分子基准，将此前未解析的共振对分离并各认证至十位数字。后者通过全局匹配系统与尾鲁棒Krawczyk-Brouwer包含实现。协作也暴露了AI辅助的局限，验证计算是对AI辅助数学的严格测试。
Motivation: 准确数值特征值难以认证，尤其在奇异或非正规设置中，亟需可靠验证方法。
Method: 采用人类-AI协作：对奇异自伴算子使用零计数与Dirichlet-Neumann bracketing；对非正规问题，重新表述为全局匹配系统，将无穷尾编码为末端射影数据的不确定性，并使用分量方式、尾鲁棒的Krawczyk-Brouwer包含提供证书。
Result: 成功将奇异自伴Schrödinger算子的完全负谱认证至十位小数，并分离非正规原子-分子基准中先前未解析的共振对，各成员认证至十位数字。
Conclusion: 验证计算是AI辅助数学的严格测试，输出不仅是数字，而是带证明的数字；人类判断仍决定性。AI时代需适应更高的验证、归属、同行评议和培训标准。

papers.title: From Task-Guided Conversational Graphs to Goal-Oriented Dialogue Runtimes
papers.abstract_en: Graph and multi-agent orchestration frameworks make production large language model (LLM) workflows practical, but they do not by themselves solve conversational continuity when users maintain several interdependent objectives. This conceptual systems paper focuses on the high-complexity end of that design space, where goals can be suspended, resumed, revised, and invalidated by actions in other goals. We introduce the Goal-Oriented Dialogue Runtime (GODR), a framework-neutral design pattern that treats goals, task frames, lifecycle state, invalidation rules, and resumption contracts as first-class runtime objects while delegating bounded execution to graph runtimes, agents, tools, or application programming interfaces (APIs). GODR is not proposed as a replacement for workflow graphs in simple guided processes; it is intended for complex, multi-domain, interruptible conversations where objective continuity cannot be recovered reliably from agent identity, chat history, or execution-graph position alone. The paper formalizes the problem, proposes runtime objects and architecture-selection criteria, and frames evaluation as an agenda for future empirical validation rather than as a measured performance claim.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向复杂、多域、可中断对话的目标导向对话运行时（GODR），将目标、任务帧、生命周期状态、失效规则和恢复契约作为一等运行时对象，委托给图运行时、智能体、工具或API执行，旨在解决用户维护多个相互依赖目标时的对话连续性难题。
Motivation: 现有的图编排和多智能体框架虽使LLM工作流实用化，但在处理用户同时维护多个相互依赖目标时的对话连续性方面存在不足。
Method: 提出GODR设计模式，形式化问题，定义运行时对象和架构选择标准，将目标、任务帧、生命周期状态、失效规则和恢复契约作为一等运行时对象，图运行时等负责有界执行。
Result: 论文为概念性系统论文，未给出实测性能声明，仅提出评估作为未来实证验证议程。
Conclusion: GODR旨在补充而非替代简单引导流程中的工作流图，适用于复杂、多域、可中断的对话场景，其有效性需未来实证验证。

papers.title: Integrated Sensing and Communications for Real-time Avatar Control in XR over 5G
papers.abstract_en: Extended Reality (XR) presents a challenging use case for 5G and 6G networks, requiring high data-rates and lowlatency communication to deliver a truly immersive experience. Moreover, in order to seamlessly translate physical actions to the virtual world, accurate gesture recognition and pose estimation are required. Current XR interaction solutions based on handheld controllers and cameras cannot easily capture full-body poses, inhibit the free use of hands, and require good visibility and a clear line of sight. In this work, we propose a multimodal sensing architecture for XR that combines 5G MillimeterWave (mmWave) Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) and surface electromyography (sEMG) signals. 5G mmWave ISAC cannot only be used to deliver content wirelessly to the Head-mounted display (HMD), but also the same communication signals can be used to derive coarse body-level gestures and poses of the user, to support real-time avatar control. For fine-grained finger-level gestures, our architecture leverages lightweight sEMG sensors that capture forearm muscle activity. To illustrate the need of both modalities, we present evaluations of both sensing technologies. At the body level (5G), our architecture relies on power-per-beam-pair (PPBP), which can be computed from standard beam management or beam sweeping procedures of the 5G NR standard. PPBP-based sensing achieves 82.2$\pm$5.9% average accuracy when evaluated on users not seen during training. For fine-grained finger-level interactions, we show that surface electromyography (sEMG) carries strong discriminative information achieving consistent promising performance across different movement settings. Thus, combining the two modalities enables multi-scale gesture recognition, at the body level via existing 5G signals and finger level via lightweight sEMG sensors, forming a complete XR framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种多模态感知架构，结合5G毫米波集成感知与通信（ISAC）和表面肌电图（sEMG），用于扩展现实（XR）中的实时化身控制。5G毫米波信号可同时用于无线通信和粗粒度身体级手势识别，sEMG则提供细粒度手指级手势信息。基于功率每波束对（PPBP）的感知方法对未见用户达到82.2±5.9%的平均准确率。
Motivation: 现有XR交互方案（如手持控制器、摄像头）难以捕捉全身姿态、限制手部自由，且依赖视线清晰。需要更自然的交互方式来实现物理动作到虚拟世界的无缝映射。
Method: 提出多模态感知架构：利用5G毫米波ISAC进行身体级粗粒度手势和姿态估计，通过5G NR标准波束管理中的PPBP实现；同时使用轻量级sEMG传感器捕获前臂肌肉活动进行手指级细粒度手势识别。
Result: PPBP感知在未见用户测试集上平均准确率82.2±5.9%；sEMG在不同运动设置下表现出稳定且强的判别能力。
Conclusion: 结合两种模态可实现多尺度手势识别，构成完整的XR控制框架，无需额外专用传感器。

papers.title: Cryptographic certificates of validity for trustworthy AI
papers.abstract_en: We propose cryptographic certificates of validity for agentic AI systems. The core idea is to formally specify a correctness or policy condition as a logical predicate, compile this predicate to a witness-checking problem over polynomial constraints, and use a succinct cryptographic proof system (and optionally zero-knowledge) to certify that the condition holds. This offers a middle ground between formal verification of source code, and cryptographic authentication. An agent's action can be accompanied by an independently checkable proof that it satisfies an agreed formal policy, without requiring the verifier to trust the agent or to re-execute computation. We outline the approach at a high level, give the core mathematical translation, relate the proposal to proof-carrying code, zkVMs, formal methods, and agent governance, and note the specification, auditing, and deployment questions that a full implementation must answer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于智能AI系统的加密有效性证书，核心思想是将正确性或策略条件形式化为逻辑谓词，编译为多项式约束下的见证检查问题，并使用简洁的加密证明系统（可选零知识）来证明条件成立。这提供了源代码形式化验证与加密认证之间的折中方案。
Motivation: 现有AI系统缺乏一种机制，使得代理行为能够附带独立可验证的证明，表明其满足约定的正式策略，而无需验证者信任代理或重新执行计算。
Method: 将形式化的正确性谓词编译为多项式约束的见证检查问题，利用简洁加密证明系统（如zkVM）生成证书。
Result: 论文从高层次概述了方法，给出了核心数学翻译，并将提议与证明携带代码、zkVM、形式化方法和代理治理联系起来，指出了完整实现必须解决的规范、审计和部署问题。
Conclusion: 该方法作为形式化验证和加密认证之间的中间地带，但实际应用需要进一步解决规范、审计和部署问题。

papers.title: One Ruler: A Same-Hands Re-Evaluation of Bivariate Causal Direction on Tuebingen, with a Parameter-Free Compression Baseline
papers.abstract_en: Headline accuracies on the Tuebingen cause-effect pairs are routinely compared across papers even though each is measured under its authors' own protocol -- different pair subsets, weightings, model-selection, and decision rates. We argue this is the wrong comparison and run the right one: a same-hands re-evaluation in which every method is run by us on the identical 102 pairs, with one strict rule -- no tuning and a decision forced on every pair. As a clean reference point we introduce a deliberately minimal baseline: sorted-conditional compression, which feeds quantized, sorted, first-differenced data to an off-the-shelf compressor (bz2) and has zero fitted parameters. Under the common ruler the ranking differs sharply from the literature. Our baseline reaches 74.7% weighted accuracy (p = 3.7e-7); on the same 100 pairs that SLOPE is evaluated on it scores 76.0%, a 1.2-point gap below the authors' own forced-decision SLOPE (77.2%) that is well inside noise (McNemar p = 0.39). A faithful re-run of RECI lands at 70.7% -- inside the original authors' reported error bar, not the 77.5% often quoted (which we trace to a mis-copied cell). SLOPE's published 82.4% is a decided-subset figure: scoring the authors' own stored output only on the pairs its significance test chose to answer reproduces 81.7%. Under the common ruler the methods cluster in the low-to-mid 70s and the zero-parameter compressor ties the strongest of them. We document the mechanisms that inflate published figures (test-set model selection, significance-gated abstention) and contribute two further results: compression score magnitude is a model-free confounding flag (p = 2.8e-68), and a pre-registered falsification test fails in an instructive way that bounds the method's theoretical interpretation. Code, pre-registrations, and per-pair outputs are released.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 1 table. Code, pre-registrations and per-pair outputs: https://github.com/WStienstra/one-ruler-cep
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对Tuebingen因果方向基准进行了控制实验的重新评估，统一了评价协议（same-hands），并引入无参数的压缩基线（sorted-conditional compression with bz2）。结果表明，在统一规则下各方法得分集中在70-77%，且零参数压缩机与最强方法持平，揭露了文献中因不同协议导致的夸大结果。
Motivation: 现有关于Tuebingen因果对的准确率比较均基于不同作者的不同协议（子集、权重、模型选择、决策率），导致不公平比较。作者认为这是错误的比较方式，需要统一标准。
Method: 作者自行对所有方法在相同的102对数据上强制决策，无调参。引入baseline：sorted-conditional compression — 对量化、排序、一阶差分后的数据使用通用压缩机bz2，零参数。同时忠实复现RECI和SLOPE等方法。
Result: baseline达到74.7%加权准确率（p=3.7e-7）；在SLOPE的100对子集上得分76.0%，与SLOPE的77.2%差距不显著（McNemar p=0.39）。RECI复现结果为70.7%（而非常引用的77.5%）。SLOPE的82.4%仅为决定子集得分。统一规则下各方法聚集在70%中段。
Conclusion: 文献中因测试集模型选择和显著性门控弃权而夸大结果。压缩得分大小可作为无模型混杂信号（p=2.8e-68）。预注册的证伪测试提供了理论解释边界。代码和结果公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文对Tuebingen因果方向基准进行了控制实验的重新评估，统一了评价协议（same-hands），并引入无参数的压缩基线（sorted-conditional compression with bz2）。结果表明，在统一规则下各方法得分集中在70-77%，且零参数压缩机与最强方法持平，揭露了文献中因不同协议导致的夸大结果。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有关于Tuebingen因果对的准确率比较均基于不同作者的不同协议（子集、权重、模型选择、决策率），导致不公平比较。作者认为这是错误的比较方式，需要统一标准。

papers.title: Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Exoplanet Detection and Atmospheric Characterization with JWST and the Upcoming Ariel Mission
papers.abstract_en: The detection and atmospheric characterization of exoplanets have entered a new data-intensive era driven by the James Webb Space Telescope and the upcoming Ariel mission. Modern surveys produce millions of light curves and high-resolution spectra that overwhelm traditional pipelines, motivating the rapid integration of Machine Learning and Deep Learning methods into the exoplanet workflow. This review synthesizes the latest progress in applying ML/DL techniques to exoplanet detection (transit identification, candidate vetting, false-positive rejection) and atmospheric characterization (retrieval, detrending, cross-correlation, surrogate modelling) in the context of JWST and Ariel. We start with classical algorithms such as Random Forests and Convolutional Neural Networks, move through Transformers and Recurrent architectures, then survey modern simulation-based inference using Neural Posterior Estimation and Flow Matching Posterior Estimation with normalizing or continuous normalizing flows. We discuss benchmark efforts, including the Ariel Machine Learning Data Challenges (2019 to 2025) hosted with NeurIPS, and key JWST case studies such as the WASP-39b Early Release Science programme. Results indicate that DL approaches consistently match or exceed traditional pipelines in both speed and accuracy, while ML-driven retrievals reduce inference time from CPU-hours to seconds and can accelerate nested-sampling retrievals by factors of 3-8 without compromising Bayesian evidence. We identify outstanding challenges interpretability, calibration of uncertainties under noisy data, hybrid modelling, and the generalization of models across instruments and planet populations and outline a research roadmap spanning the JWST era and beyond into Ariel's launch in 2029.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了机器学习和深度学习方法在系外行星探测与大气表征中的应用，特别是针对詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜和即将到来的Ariel任务。文章涵盖经典算法（随机森林、CNN）到现代方法（Transformer、RNN、神经后验估计），并讨论了基准测试（Ariel ML数据挑战）和案例研究（WASP-39b）。结果显示DL方法在速度和精度上匹配或超越传统流程，ML驱动的反演将推理时间从CPU小时级降至秒级，嵌套采样反演加速3-8倍。
Motivation: 传统数据处理管线难以应对JWST和Ariel产生的大量光变曲线和高分辨率光谱数据，需要集成ML/DL方法以提高效率。
Method: 综述了从经典ML（随机森林、CNN）到现代DL（Transformer、RNN）以及基于模拟的推断（神经后验估计、流匹配后验估计）的方法在系外行星检测（凌星识别、候选体筛选、假阳性排除）和大气表征（反演、去趋势、互相关、替代建模）中的应用。
Result: DL方法在速度和精度上一致匹配或超越传统管线；ML驱动的反演将推理时间从CPU小时级缩短到秒级，嵌套采样反演加速3-8倍而不损害贝叶斯证据。
Conclusion: 目前仍存在可解释性、噪声下不确定性校准、混合建模及跨仪器/行星种群泛化等挑战，并提出了从JWST时代到Ariel 2029年发射的研究路线图。

papers.title: Emergent Relational Order in LLM Agent Societies: From Collective Affect to Authority Stratification
papers.abstract_en: Fei Xiaotong's Differential Order Pattern characterizes rural society as egocentric and relationally graded, with cooperation attenuating over social distance. Although often treated as culturally specific, its mechanistic basis remains under-operationalized, and prior LLM-based simulations have mainly addressed short-term coordination rather than long-horizon social structure. We propose CAREB-MAS, a multi-agent framework grounded in Affect Control Theory, Social Identity Theory, and Durkheimian collective affect. Agents reason through an emotion-ethics-belief chain and maintain dynamically evolving egocentric identities, while the macro environment specifies only individual production, preference-based allocation, and minimal interaction protocols. Across long-horizon simulations, agents spontaneously reproduce five core Differential Order phenomena: stable labor specialization, guanxi-based economic ethics, relational decay of cooperation, emergent relational authority, and clan-based center-periphery stratification. These patterns shift with production structure from kin-centered integration toward greater functional interdependence. Extensive experiment results support interpreting Differential Order as a structure-sensitive emergent outcome of general social mechanisms, with LLM-based multi-agent simulation providing an interdisciplinary framework for studying social structure and change.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAREB-MAS多智能体框架，基于情感控制理论、社会认同理论和涂尔干集体情感，让LLM智能体通过情感-伦理-信念链推理并维护动态自我中心身份。在长期模拟中，智能体自发重现了差序格局的五个核心现象：稳定的劳动分工、关系型经济伦理、合作随社会距离衰减、涌现的关系权威以及以宗族为中心的边缘-中心分层。这些模式随生产结构从亲缘中心整合向功能相互依赖转变。
Motivation: 差序格局虽被视为中国文化特有，但其机制基础缺乏可操作性，且先前LLM模拟主要关注短期协作而非长期社会结构。
Method: CAREB-MAS框架，结合情感控制理论、社会认同理论和涂尔干集体情感，智能体通过情感-伦理-信念链推理，维护动态自我中心身份，宏观环境仅规定个体生产、偏好分配和最小交互协议。
Result: 长期模拟中自发重现了差序格局的五种核心现象：稳定劳动专业化、关系型经济伦理、合作衰减、涌现关系权威和宗族中心-边缘分层。
Conclusion: 支持将差序格局解释为社会机制的结构敏感涌现结果，LLM多智能体模拟为研究社会结构和变迁提供了跨学科框架。

papers.title: Listening makes Vision Clear for VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent work typically assesses vision--language consistency using attention distributions of answer-side tokens. However, we observe that highest attention regions are not always consistent with the intended semantic token. This probably stems from decoding drift, where language priors from previously generated answer tokens accumulate and mismatch with visual attention. Besides the priors from previous answer tokens, we find that structural tokens, e.g., modality boundary markers, may encompass the entire context and generate high attention to areas unrelated to the target. To avoid these distortions and provide consistency evaluation for large VLMs, we adopt prompt-side semantics and propose Prompt-Vision Token Activation Map (PV-TAM). PV-TAM further incorporates a filter to remove systematic bias induced by modality boundary markers. Unlike traditional methods that evaluate overlap solely through masks while ignoring activation intensity, our metrics leverage the peak distribution of attention to measure the alignment between prompts and visual regions. In experiments, PV-TAM consistently improves both attention-based and IoU-style localization metrics over answer-side baselines on various datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）中，基于答案侧标记的注意力分布评估视觉-语言一致性存在解码漂移和结构标记干扰问题。提出Prompt-Vision Token Activation Map (PV-TAM)，利用提示侧语义并过滤模态边界标记的系统偏差，通过注意力峰值分布衡量提示与视觉区域的对齐。实验表明，PV-TAM在多个数据集上优于基于答案侧的基线方法，提升了注意力与IoU风格的定位指标。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言一致性评估通常使用答案侧标记的注意力分布，但高注意力区域常与语义不一致，源于解码漂移（语言先验累积）和结构标记（如模态边界标记）的干扰。
Method: 提出PV-TAM，采用提示侧语义并引入滤波器去除模态边界标记引起的系统偏差，利用注意力峰值分布而非传统掩码重叠来评估提示与视觉区域的对齐。
Result: PV-TAM在多个数据集上一致优于基于答案侧的基线方法，同时提升注意力与IoU风格的定位指标。
Conclusion: PV-TAM通过利用提示侧语义和消除结构标记偏差，为大型VLMs提供了更可靠的一致性评估方法。

papers.title: Neuromorphic Speech Enhancement with Dual-Branch Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural network (SNN)-based neuromorphic speech enhancement has emerged as a promising paradigm due to its energy efficiency, yet it still underperforms classical artificial neural network (ANN)-based approaches owing to binary activations and the lack of well-designed network architectures. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel dual-branch spiking neural network architecture equipped with a gated spiking unit (GSU), termed GSU-DBNet. Specifically, GSU-DBNet simultaneously models the speech magnitude spectrum and complex spectrum, predicting the corresponding magnitude and complex spectral masks. Meanwhile, a dual-path GSU module is adopted to exploit temporal and frequency information for enhanced spatiotemporal feature representation. Experiments on a popular benchmark dataset show that GSU-DBNet achieves a PESQ score of 3.04 with only 394K parameters, outperforming existing SNN-based methods while using only 4.5%--10.6% of the parameters of representative ANN-based models.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to Interspeech 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于脉冲神经网络（SNN）的双分支语音增强架构 GSU-DBNet，包含门控脉冲单元（GSU），同时建模语音幅度谱和复数谱并预测相应掩膜。在基准数据集上以仅394K参数取得PESQ 3.04，性能超越现有SNN方法，且参数量仅为典型ANN模型的4.5%–10.6%。
Motivation: 现有SNN在语音增强任务中性能低于经典ANN，主要受限于二值激活和缺乏精心设计的网络结构。
Method: 提出GSU-DBNet，采用双分支SNN架构，分别处理幅度谱和复数谱，引入双路径GSU模块以同时利用时间和频率信息增强时空特征表示。
Result: 在流行基准数据集上，GSU-DBNet达到PESQ 3.04，参数量394K，优于现有SNN方法，且仅为代表性ANN模型参数量的4.5%–10.6%。
Conclusion: GSU-DBNet以极低参数量实现了有竞争力的语音增强性能，展示了SNN在低功耗场景的潜力。

papers.title: Engineering Reliable Autonomous Systems: Challenges and Solutions
papers.abstract_en: Engineering reliable autonomous systems is an important and growing topic in computer science. As autonomous systems become more prevalent, easy-to-use techniques for building them reliably are increasingly important. This workshop report captures and expands on the discussions at the Lorentz Center Workshop "Engineering Reliable Autonomous Systems" (ERAS), held from 10 to 14 June 2024. The workshop was co-organised by the organisers of the Workshop on Formal Methods for Autonomous Systems (FMAS) and the Workshop on Agents and Robots for reliable Engineered Autonomy (AREA). It brought together members of the FMAS and AREA communities, industry practitioners, and representatives from sectors where autonomous systems pose distinctive engineering challenges. The workshop focused on three main research topics: techniques for verification and validation of autonomous systems; engineering real-world autonomous systems; and software architectures for safe autonomous systems. Its main outcome is a catalogue of challenges in these areas and, most importantly, a pathway to solutions. Some challenges can already be tackled by techniques that are well known in academia but have not yet become regularly used in practice. Other challenges remain unresolved and require further research. This roadmap is intended to support future research and industrial collaboration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本研讨会报告整理了2024年6月Lorentz中心“工程可靠自主系统”（ERAS）研讨会的讨论成果，聚焦自主系统验证与确认、工程实践及安全软件架构三大主题，提出了当前挑战及解决路径，部分挑战可通过已有学术技术解决，另一些需进一步研究。
Motivation: 自主系统日益普及，但构建可靠自主系统的易用技术仍显不足，工业界与学术界之间存在技术转化鸿沟，亟需系统性梳理挑战并规划解决路径。
Method: 通过跨社区研讨会（FMAS与AREA）汇聚学术界、工业界及领域专家，围绕验证与确认、工程实践、软件架构三个方向进行结构化讨论，形成挑战目录及解决路线图。
Result: 报告识别出两类挑战：一类可通过已有学术技术（如形式化方法）解决但未普及；另一类需全新研究。最终产出是一份支持未来研究与工业合作的路线图。
Conclusion: 自主系统可靠性工程仍面临诸多开放问题，现有学术技术需向实践转化，同时基础研究方向需聚焦长期未解挑战。

papers.title: VeriPilot: An LLM-Powered Verilog Debugging Framework
papers.abstract_en: Verilog debugging remains one of the most time-consuming stages in digital circuit design. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled automated debugging; however, most existing approaches rely solely on test outputs and compiler feedback in an end-to-end manner, limiting their effectiveness on complex bugs. A key challenge is that the root cause of an error may be far removed from its observable outputs, making it difficult for LLMs to trace long dependency chains in code. This challenge is further exacerbated in large codebases, where long context lengths hinder efficient reasoning. To address these limitations, we propose VeriPilot, an LLM-powered debugging framework that leverages golden reference models to enable fine-grained bug localization and repair. VeriPilot goes beyond output-level comparison by aligning internal variable semantics between the Verilog design and its corresponding golden model through LLM-based analysis. It then performs step-by-step signal tracing using Control-Data-Flow Graphs (CDFGs) derived from static analysis, identifying a minimal set of suspicious code regions along with their correct counterparts from the golden model. These structured insights are subsequently provided to the LLM to guide reasoning and automated code repair. Experimental results on the Comprehensive Verilog Design Problems (CVDP) benchmark from NVIDIA demonstrate that VeriPilot improves the repair success rate of GPT-4o from 54.3\% to 85.71\%, significantly enhancing both bug localization accuracy and repair effectiveness for complex Verilog designs. The source code and benchmark are publicly available at Github https://github.com/YihanWn/VeriPilot.git.

papers.title: Exploring Dualistic Meta-Learning to Enhance Domain Generalization in Open Set Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Domain generalization learns from multiple source domains to generalize to unseen target domains. However, it often neglects the realistic case of label mismatch between source and target. Open set domain generalization is then proposed to recognize unseen classes in unseen domains. A simple approach trains one-vs-all classifiers to separate each class and detect outliers as unknown. Yet, the imbalance between few positive samples and many negative samples skews the decision boundary towards the positive ones, leading the model to over-reject out-of-distribution data, even from known classes in unseen domains. In this paper, we propose a novel meta-learning stategy called dualistic MEta-learning with joint DomaIn-Class matching (MEDIC), which considers implicit gradient matching towards inter-domain and inter-class task splits simultaneously to find optimal boundaries balanced for both domains and classes. Experimental results show that MEDIC not only outperforms prior methods in open set scenarios, but also maintains competitive close set generalization ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放集域泛化（open set domain generalization）中已知类与未知类的边界偏移问题，提出一种名为MEDIC的双重元学习策略，该策略同时考虑域间和类间的隐式梯度匹配，以找到对域和类都均衡的最优边界。实验表明，MEDIC在开放集场景下优于先前方法，并保持了有竞争力的封闭集泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有开放集域泛化方法通常训练一对多分类器，但正负样本不平衡导致决策边界偏向正样本，使得模型过度拒绝来自未知域的已知类数据。
Method: 提出双重元学习策略MEDIC，联合域间与类间任务划分（task splits）进行隐式梯度匹配，同时优化域和类两种视角下的边界。
Result: 在开放集场景下优于先前方法，且封闭集泛化能力保持竞争性。
Conclusion: MEDIC通过联合考虑域与类的匹配，有效缓解了开放集域泛化中的过拒绝问题。

papers.title: Synergizing Physically Constrained MCMC and Chemical-Informed Gaussian Processes for Reaction Network Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Extracting interpretable governing equations from sparse, noisy chemical time-series data remains difficult because discrete reaction topology and continuous kinetic parameters are tightly coupled. We present PC-MCMC-CIGP, a reproducible gray-box workflow that combines spike-and-slab topology sampling, hard conservation and thermodynamic screening, and a Chemical-Informed Gaussian Process (CIGP) residual model for parameter calibration and experimental design. The methodological contribution is not a new MCMC or GP family in isolation; rather, it is the integration of these components into a physically constrained workflow with explicit uncertainty-aware acquisition choices. On the H2 + Br2 benchmark, the constrained sampler distinguishes elementary radical pathways from deceptive phenomenological fits in our experiments. On styrene epoxidation, the CIGP optimization loop improves final yield by 12.5% over the reported GP-BO baseline. A new 10-seed acquisition study shows that EI, GWU, PC-EI, uncertainty sampling, discrepancy hunting, and random search have different trade-offs: PC-EI substantially reduces low-yield BO suggestions, while EI-style criteria give the strongest final-yield performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PC-MCMC-CIGP，一种结合物理约束MCMC和化学信息高斯过程的灰箱工作流，用于从稀疏有噪化学时间序列数据中提取可解释的反应网络。该方法在H2 + Br2基准上成功区分了基本自由基路径，并在苯乙烯环氧化反应中将最终产率比GP-BO基线提升12.5%。10种子采集研究揭示了不同采集策略（如EI、PC-EI等）在低产率建议与最终性能之间的权衡。
Motivation: 从稀疏、有噪声的化学时间序列数据中提取可解释的支配方程仍然困难，因为离散的反应拓扑和连续的动力学参数紧密耦合。
Method: 提出PC-MCMC-CIGP工作流，整合了spike-and-slab拓扑采样、硬守恒和热力学筛选，以及化学信息高斯过程（CIGP）残差模型，用于参数校准和实验设计。
Result: 在H2 + Br2基准上，约束采样器成功区分了基本自由基路径与欺骗性唯象拟合；在苯乙烯环氧化反应中，CIGP优化循环将最终产率比GP-BO基线提高12.5%。10种子采集研究显示EI、GWU、PC-EI等策略有不同权衡：PC-EI大幅减少低产率BO建议，而EI类标准给出最强的最终产率性能。
Conclusion: 该工作的贡献并非孤立的MCMC或GP新方法，而是将这些组件集成为物理约束的工作流，并具有显式的不确定性感知采集选择。

papers.title: Verifiable Foundation Models for Robot Safety
papers.abstract_en: Deploying foundation models for robot control raises a central challenge: the expressive power that enables rich, multimodal perception also makes these models opaque and difficult to analyze formally, rendering them intractable for existing verification tools. In this paper, we present FEARL (Foundation-Enabled Assured Robot Learning), a framework that addresses this tension through a modular architectural decomposition. FEARL separates the policy into a large Controller (C) responsible for high-dimensional perception and task reasoning, and a small Safety module (S) that receives low-dimensional observations from dedicated safety sensors together with a bounded context embedding from C and produces the final action. Since many robot safety requirements, such as collision avoidance and workspace boundary constraints, can be expressed over these safety sensor observations, formal verification can be applied to S rather than to the full foundation-model backbone. This makes formal analysis tractable with existing tools while preserving the Controller's expressive power for task reasoning. To show that the decomposed policy remains capable of solving diverse tasks, we evaluate FEARL on three simulated robotic domains using multiple Controller backbones and training procedures, including pretrained off-the-shelf vision-language-action models. We further transfer the learned policy from one of our simulated tasks to a physical robot, suggesting that the low-dimensional safety interface supports practical sim-to-real transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FEARL（Foundation-Enabled Assured Robot Learning）框架，通过将机器人策略分解为大型控制器（Controller, C）和小型安全模块（Safety module, S），使得形式验证只应用于安全模块而非整个基础模型。该方法在三个仿真机器人领域验证了任务完成能力，并成功迁移至物理机器人。
Motivation: 基础模型在机器人控制中具有强大的表达能力和多模态感知，但因其不透明性难以进行形式化验证，现有验证工具无法处理。
Method: 将策略模块化分解：控制器 C 负责高维感知和任务推理，安全模块 S 接收来自专用安全传感器的低维观测以及 C 的受限上下文嵌入，输出最终动作。对可在安全传感器观测上表达的机器人安全需求（如避碰、边界约束），仅对 S 进行形式验证。
Result: 在三个仿真机器人领域使用多种控制器骨干和训练程序（包括预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型）评估，并成功将学习策略从仿真迁移到物理机器人。
Conclusion: FEARL 通过保留控制器表达能力并仅验证安全模块，使形式分析在现有工具下可行，且低维安全接口支持实用的 sim-to-real 迁移。

papers.title: EnerInfer: Energy-Aware On-Device LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: On-device LLM inference is increasingly attractive for privacy-preserving, reliable, and cost-effective deployment, yet its energy and thermal costs remain a critical bottleneck. Existing systems primarily optimize for decoding speed, implicitly assuming that faster execution is always preferable. We show instead that on-device LLM inference often has exploitable configuration slack: modestly lowering NPU and memory frequencies preserves quality of experience (QoE) while substantially improving energy efficiency and reducing heat. Realizing this opportunity in production is challenging. The most energy-efficient NPU/DDR setting varies with the model, inference engine, platform, and runtime conditions, with no stable ranking across configurations. Commercial devices further lack component-level power sensing, and shell temperature evolves with request arrivals, response lengths, and thermal history. To address these challenges, we propose EnerInfer, the first on-device LLM inference framework that jointly manages energy efficiency, throughput, and thermal comfort for LLM workloads. EnerInfer replaces per-model profiling and sensor-heavy control with disaggregated, model-structure-aware prediction and ranking-driven online feedback. It predicts throughput and power for unseen LLMs across NPU/DDR frequency settings, selects QoE-satisfying efficient configurations under runtime interference, and uses lightweight limited-horizon thermal prediction to dynamically switch between energy-optimized and thermally constrained inference. Evaluations on real-world LLMs show that EnerInfer improves energy efficiency by up to 65%, 12%, and 24% on phones, a laptop, and a development board, respectively, without QoE violation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EnerInfer，首个联合管理端侧 LLM 推理能耗、吞吐量和热舒适度的框架。通过动态调整 NPU 和内存频率，在保证服务质量 (QoE) 的前提下大幅提升能效。实验在手机、笔记本和开发板上分别实现高达 65%、12% 和 24% 的能效提升。
Motivation: 现有端侧 LLM 推理系统主要优化解码速度，忽略了可调节的频率配置松弛空间。适度降低 NPU 和内存频率可在不损害用户体验时显著节能，但实际部署面临配置选择复杂、缺乏组件级功耗感知等挑战。
Method: EnerInfer 采用模型结构感知的能耗预测、在线反馈机制和轻量级有限视野热预测，替代逐模型预配置和传感器密集型控制，自动选择满足 QoE 的高效配置并动态切换能量优化与热约束模式。
Result: 在真实 LLM 上，EnerInfer 在手机、笔记本和开发板上分别实现最高 65%、12% 和 24% 的能效提升，且未违反 QoE 约束。
Conclusion: EnerInfer 是首个联合管理能耗、吞吐量和热舒适度的端侧 LLM 推理框架，实验证明了其在实际设备上的有效性和通用性。

papers.title: MortarBench: Evaluating Mortgage Loan Origination Agents
papers.abstract_en: Loan origination is the process by which a lender creates a new loan, from application and underwriting through approval and funding. This process serves a critical role in evaluating the eligibility and level of risk posed by an applicant. Recently, firms have begun using mortgage loan agents to augment human loan officers, despite a lack of any public benchmark. To fill this gap, we present MortarBench, a loan origination agent benchmark. MortarBench uses a financial data synthesis and mutation pipeline to generate examples with broad edge case coverage that match real-world distributions and questions. We find that state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) perform poorly, with closed-source models achieving at most 77.1\% exact match accuracy. We also discover systematic biases in LLM perception of foreignness related to non-English names. Noting these weaknesses, we introduce CRIT, a confidence calibration framework. Our method increases accuracy to 80.5\% while improving risk management steering and reducing bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MortarBench 是一个用于评估抵押贷款发起代理的基准，通过金融数据合成和变异管道生成覆盖边缘情况的样本，发现现有大语言模型表现不佳，封闭源模型最高仅 77.1% 的精确匹配准确率，并存在对外国名字的偏差。引入 CRIT 置信度校准框架，将准确率提升至 80.5%，同时改善风险管理和减少偏差。
Motivation: 贷款发起在金融中至关重要，但缺乏公开基准来评估自动化代理的性能，现有 LLM 在该任务上表现差且存在偏差。
Method: 构建 MortarBench，使用金融数据合成和变异管道生成匹配真实分布和问题的样本，并提出 CRIT 置信度校准框架。
Result: 封闭源 LLM 最高准确率 77.1%，CRIT 将其提升至 80.5%，并减少了对非英语名字的偏差。
Conclusion: MortarBench 揭示了现有 LLM 在贷款发起任务中的不足，CRIT 能有效提升准确率、风险管理和公平性。

papers.title: Tensor-based second-order causal discovery
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery seeks to uncover the causal dependencies among variables. For this purpose, we propose an algorithm called Tensor-based Second-order Causal Discovery (TSCD). Its input is a tensor obtained from the covariance matrices of observational and interventional data. Assuming the causal dependencies follow a linear structural equation model on a directed acyclic graph (DAG), TSCD outputs the DAG and the functions on its edges, requiring only that the noise variables are uncorrelated. We also implement a version of the approach for nonlinear models. Our focus on second-order statistics (via the covariance matrices) is motivated by their statistical and computational efficiency relative to higher-order moments, their identifiability relative to first-order statistics, and that they work regardless of whether the variables are Gaussian. We show that TSCD has identifiable causal order and parameters from a number of interventions that is logarithmic in the number of variables. Experiments show that TSCD is robust to noise, competitive with existing methods, and scales to hundreds of variables.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出了一种基于张量的二阶因果发现算法 (TSCD)，利用观测和干预数据的协方差矩阵构成的张量来推断有向无环图 (DAG) 及其边的函数。方法假设线性结构方程模型，噪声变量不相关，并扩展至非线性情况。实验表明 TSCD 在噪声下稳健，可扩展至数百变量，所需的干预次数与变量数成对数关系。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在高阶矩或一阶统计量上存在统计效率、可识别性或高斯假设限制，而二阶统计量在效率和可识别性之间取得平衡。
Method: 将观测和干预数据的协方差矩阵堆叠为张量，通过张量分解和代数约束恢复 DAG 结构及线性函数系数。对于非线性模型，采用类似思路但使用核技巧。
Result: 理论上证明 TSCD 在干预次数与变量数成对数关系时可识别因果顺序和参数。实验上显示对噪声鲁棒，与现有方法竞争力相当，并能处理数百变量。
Conclusion: 二阶统计量在因果发现中兼具统计和计算优势，TSCD 提供了一种可扩展且无需高斯假设的解决方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Loss Landscape Poisoning: Targeted Extraction of Unseen Training Data from LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models are increasingly trained on proprietary or sensitive data, from private healthcare and financial records to user conversations containing secrets. Ensuring the privacy of such data against extraction attacks has become a central concern. In this paper, we ask whether an attacker who can poison a portion of the training data can facilitate the leakage of a separate target record they have no access to. We answer in the affirmative and show that such leakage can be induced by a poisoning mechanism that reshapes the model's local loss landscape around the target completion. Our key insight is that poisoning to create a sharp loss minimum at the target, surrounded by elevated loss on nearby alternatives, forces the model to memorize the target as the unique low-loss solution in its neighborhood. The attack requires no architectural changes, and generalizes across centralized and federated learning settings. We demonstrate that the attack amplifies privacy leakage across language (up to 100% successful extraction), and vision-language models (up 90% successful extraction). We show that the attack is thwarted when the model is trained to be differentially private. However, we introduce a new attack that directly probes the loss landscape bypassing even differential privacy defenses.
papers.comment: Updated author order. No technical changes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究针对大语言模型的训练数据提取攻击，提出通过投毒部分训练数据来重塑损失景观，使得目标完成点成为尖锐的最小值，从而强制模型记忆未见过的目标记录。攻击在纯语言和视觉-语言模型上分别达到100%和90%的成功提取率，并且可以绕过差分隐私防御。
Motivation: 保护专有或敏感数据免受提取攻击是核心关注，现有攻击通常需要访问模型或数据，本文探索投毒是否能促进对未访问的目标记录的泄露。
Method: 通过投毒制造目标完成点的尖锐损失最小值，同时提高相邻替代点的损失，迫使模型将目标唯一地记忆为低损失解。攻击不需要改变架构，适用于集中式和联邦学习。
Result: 在语言模型上实现高达100%成功提取，在视觉-语言模型上高达90%成功提取。差分隐私可以阻止攻击，但本文提出新的攻击可以直接探测损失景观绕过差分隐私。
Conclusion: 投毒可以显著放大隐私泄露，但差分隐私提供防护，不过存在新的绕过方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric Action Model for Robot Policy Learning
papers.abstract_en: Generalist robot policies must follow user instructions while reasoning about how objects, cameras, and robot actions interact in the 3D physical world. Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs) and video world-action models (WAMs) inherit strong semantic or temporal priors from large-scale foundation models, but they still operate primarily on 2D image frames or 2D-derived latent spaces, leaving implicit the 3D geometry required for contact-rich manipulation. We propose the Geometric Action Model (GAM), a language-conditioned manipulation policy that directly repurposes a pretrained geometric foundation model (GFM) as a shared substrate for perception, temporal prediction, and action decoding. GAM splits the GFM at an intermediate layer: the shallow layers serve as an observation encoder, and a causal future predictor inserted at the split layer forecasts future latent tokens conditioned on language, proprioception, and action history. The predicted future tokens are then routed through the remaining GFM blocks for feature propagation and decoding, allowing a single backbone to produce both future geometry and actions. This design equips the GFM with language-conditioned temporal world modeling through minimal architectural modification while preserving its rich geometric priors. Across a broad suite of simulation and real-robot manipulation benchmarks, GAM is more accurate, more robust, faster, and lighter than current foundation-model-scale baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何动作模型（GAM），通过分割预训练的几何基础模型（GFM）并插入因果未来预测器，实现语言条件的时间世界建模与动作解码。GAM在中间层分割GFM：浅层作为观察编码器，因果未来预测器根据语言、本体感受和动作历史预测未来潜在令牌，后续GFM块进行特征传播和解码，同时产生未来几何和动作。该方法在多个仿真和真实机器人操作基准上比当前基础模型规模的基线更准确、鲁棒、快速和轻量。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型和视频世界-动作模型主要在2D图像帧或2D导出潜在空间操作，缺乏接触丰富操作所需的显式3D几何建模，限制了机器人策略在物理世界中的推理能力。
Method: 直接利用预训练的几何基础模型（GFM）作为共享基础，在中间层分割：浅层作为观察编码器，深层保留几何先验；在分割层插入因果未来预测器，以语言、本体感受和动作历史为条件预测未来潜在令牌；预测令牌通过剩余GFM块进行特征传播和动作解码。
Result: 在广泛的仿真和真实机器人操作基准上，GAM比当前基础模型规模的基线（如VLA和WAM）更准确、更鲁棒、推理更快且模型更轻量。
Conclusion: 通过最小的架构修改，GAM为GFM赋予语言条件时间世界建模能力，同时保持其丰富的几何先验，实现了高效的通用机器人策略学习。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Teaching Diffusion to Speculate Left-to-Right
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, but their autoregressive decoding process incurs substantial inference costs due to inherently sequential token generation. Speculative decoding addresses this bottleneck by employing a lightweight draft model to propose multiple future tokens that are subsequently verified in parallel by a larger target model. Recent work has demonstrated that diffusion language models are well suited for this setting, as they can generate entire blocks of draft tokens in parallel and thereby alleviate the sequential constraints of autoregressive drafting. A subtlety of this regime is that block-diffusion drafters generate tokens bidirectionally within a block, whereas verification is performed by an autoregressive target model that evaluates tokens in a strictly left-to-right manner, leaving a gap between the symmetric training-time objective and the asymmetric verification-time reward. In this work, we offer an empirical analysis of three training-time interventions that narrow this gap: token positional weighting, a first-error focal loss that targets the position that breaks the accepted prefix within each block, and a chain loss term that substitutes a differentiable surrogate for the expected accepted length. The three interventions act along orthogonal axes (position, block-conditional first error, joint prefix) and compose additively; they are likewise orthogonal to test-time alignment mechanisms such as multi-draft self-selection, with which they can in principle be combined. Across four target models and six reasoning, code, and dialogue benchmarks, the three interventions raise accepted draft length by 21-76% per benchmark over a position-uniform baseline, without adding additional forward passes and without changing the inference pipeline or the rejection-sampling exactness contract.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散语言模型作为草稿模型时，其双向块级生成与自回归验证模型从左到右验证之间的不对称性，提出了三种训练时干预：token位置加权、首错误聚焦损失和链损失。这些干预可正交组合，在多个基准上将接受的推测长度提高21-76%，且不增加推理开销。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型可以并行生成整块token作为草稿，但其训练目标是双向的，而验证过程是严格的从左到右，这种不对称性限制了推测解码的效率。
Method: 提出三种正交的训练时干预：token位置加权（调整不同位置token的损失权重）、第一错误聚焦损失（针对每个块中首个错误位置加强惩罚）、以及链损失（用可微替代项近似期望接受长度）。
Result: 在四个目标模型和六个推理、代码、对话基准上，三种干预相比位置均匀基线将接受的推测长度每基准提高21-76%，且不增加额外前向传播或改变推理流水线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明这些训练时干预是正交且可组合的，能有效提升扩散推测解码效率，并与测试时对齐机制（如多草稿自选择）兼容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedSteer: Taming Extreme Gradient Staleness in Federated Learning with Corrective Projections and Caching
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is often subject to aggregation variance if clients do not consistently participate in training rounds. While reusing stale model updates from inactive clients is a common technique to reduce this variance, we find that with skewed client participation, the resulting update staleness can become severe enough to destabilize training. To remedy this, we propose FedSteer, a novel method that constructs a gradient subspace from a cache of recent client gradients to serve as a low-dimensional representation of the current optimization landscape. FedSteer projects an active client's true gradient onto this subspace to find a set of optimal coordinates. For an inactive client, FedSteer reuses these coordinates with the now-evolved subspace drifted by other active clients. This process effectively "steers" outdated gradients toward the current global objective. This is complemented by a selective caching strategy that identifies a representative client subset to form the subspace, reducing server memory. Experiments demonstrate that FedSteer significantly outperforms baselines, preventing performance collapse in challenging scenarios while delivering accuracy gains of over 7% in others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对联邦学习中客户端参与偏斜导致的梯度严重陈旧问题，提出FedSteer方法，通过从最近的客户端梯度缓存构建梯度子空间作为当前优化势场的低维表示，将活动客户端的真实梯度投影到该子空间以找到最优坐标，并利用子空间漂移引导陈旧梯度朝向当前全局目标。配合选择性缓存策略减少服务器内存。实验表明FedSteer显著优于基线，在挑战性场景下防止性能崩溃，并在其他场景下获得超过7%的准确率提升。
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端非一致参与引起聚合方差，重用陈旧模型更新会导致梯度陈旧严重到使训练不稳定，现有方法难以应对高度偏斜的参与模式。
Method: 构建一个由近期客户端梯度缓存的梯度子空间，作为当前优化势场的低维表示；将活动客户端真实梯度投影到该子空间得到最优坐标，对非活动客户端则利用这些坐标引导陈旧梯度；辅以选择性缓存策略选择代表性客户端子集以降低服务器内存。
Result: 在挑战性场景下防止性能崩溃，在其他场景下获得超过7%的准确率提升，显著优于基线方法。
Conclusion: FedSteer通过梯度子空间投影和缓存引导有效处理了极端梯度陈旧问题，提升联邦学习训练稳定性。

papers.title: Resonant Minds: Closed-Loop Social Avatars with Theory of Mind
papers.abstract_en: Creating lifelike digital humans with genuine social intelligence requires unifying cognitive reasoning and multimodal generation within a coherent framework. Current approaches treat these as separate tasks: Large Language Models excel at dialogue but lack embodied expression, while diffusion-based talking head models achieve visual fidelity but ignore social cognition. To bridge this gap, we propose a closed-loop dual-agent framework integrating perception, social reasoning, and expression into a continuous interaction cycle. The perception module analyzes partners' multimodal behaviors from video, while the social reasoning module infers hidden mental states through Theory of Mind and selects responses via an ensemble mechanism. The expression module then generates emotion-controllable videos that jointly synthesize speaker speech and facial expressions with listener reactive behaviors, capturing bidirectional dynamics absent in prior work. We further construct a hierarchical Persona-Scenario dataset with psychologically grounded personas and private social goals to support evaluation under information asymmetry. Experiments on this dataset demonstrate competitive or superior performance on both dialogue quality and video generation metrics. Notably, our method surpasses even the full-information Script mode on key dialogue quality dimensions, suggesting that explicit mental state inference under uncertainty can elicit more thoughtful dialogue than unrestricted information access. Project page: https://resonantminds.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个闭环双智能体框架，将感知、社会推理和表达整合到连续交互循环中，用于生成具有社会智能的逼真数字人类。感知模块分析视频中伙伴的多模态行为，社会推理模块通过心智理论推断隐藏心理状态并选择响应，表达模块生成情感可控的视频，联合合成说话者的语音、面部表情和听众的反应行为。论文还构建了基于心理社会人格和私有社会目标的分层人格-场景数据集，实验表明该方法在对话质量和视频生成指标上具有竞争力，甚至在关键对话质量维度上超越了全信息脚本模式。
Motivation: 现有方法将认知推理和多模态生成视为分离的任务：大语言模型擅长对话但缺乏具身表达，扩散驱动的说话头模型实现视觉保真度但忽略社会认知。需要统一框架来弥合这一差距。
Method: 提出闭环双智能体框架，包含感知模块（分析视频中伙伴的多模态行为）、社会推理模块（通过心智理论推断隐藏心理状态，并通过集成机制选择响应）和表达模块（生成情感可控的视频，联合合成说话者的语音、面部表情和听众的反应行为），实现双向动态。
Result: 在构建的数据集上，该方法在对话质量和视频生成指标上表现出竞争性或优越性，尤其在关键对话质量维度上甚至超越了全信息脚本模式，表明不确定性下显式心理状态推断能引出比无限制信息访问更深思熟虑的对话。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过闭环框架整合感知、推理和表达，可以实现更具社会智能的数字人类，并指出心智理论在信息不对称场景下的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Function-Vector Heads Are Two Populations: Writers and Cancellers in In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Function-vector (FV) heads are identified by the magnitude of their causal contribution to in-context rule tasks, and the resulting top set is treated as a single functional class. We show this hides a sign structure. Under a sign-preserving criterion (refined direct logit attribution, validated head by head with path patching) the FV population splits into two opposing groups: writers push the rule-correct logit up, cancellers push it down, and ablating both together moves the readout less than the sum of the two. The split is causal and reproducible. It holds in all but two of the fifteen (model, task) cells we test, spanning three architectures and six Pythia scales, and a sign-shuffle null rejects the single-class account in all but one of the six main cells. It is also invisible to magnitude-only ranking, which surfaces whichever group locally dominates and misses the other, so any function vector or ablation built that way silently averages a promoting and a suppressing mechanism. Cancellers are not attention sinks, induction heads, or copy-suppression heads, and their causal effect is larger than that of magnitude-matched non-FV controls. Zero-ablating them recovers $+0.13$ to $+0.29$ nats on the correct label in every main cell, and shifts accuracy by $+2$ to $+7$ pp in the same direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现函数向量（FV）头部在大语境学习中的因果贡献存在符号结构，揭示了两类对立群体：写入者（writers）提升规则正确logit，取消者（cancellers）抑制它。仅基于幅度排序会掩盖这种分裂，导致功能向量或消融实验无意中平均了促进和抑制机制。该分裂在多个架构和模型尺度上可重复，且取消者的因果效应大于幅度匹配的非FV控制。
Motivation: 现有研究将FV头部视为单一功能类，忽略了其内部可能的符号分化，导致对上下文学习机制的理解不完整。
Method: 采用保留符号的直接logit归因（sign-preserving refined direct logit attribution），并通过路径修补（path patching）逐头验证，将FV群体划分为写入者和取消者。
Result: 在15个（模型，任务）实验中，13个支持分裂；符号打乱null检验在6个主要单元中仅1个未拒绝单一类假设。零消融取消者在每个主要单元中恢复+0.13至+0.29 nats的正确标签logit，准确率提升+2至+7个百分点。
Conclusion: FV头部存在因果可复现的符号分裂，幅度排序会遗漏取消者，构建功能向量时需考虑符号结构以避免机制混淆。取消者不是注意力汇或复制抑制头，其因果效应显著。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Priors Persist Through Suppression: A Stroop Paradigm for Lexical Override
papers.abstract_en: Glossaries, technical specifications, and system prompts routinely ask language models to use familiar words in unfamiliar ways. When this works, the local rule does not overwrite the old meaning; the pretrained prior keeps operating underneath, and its strength still shows through. We test this with a Stroop-style paradigm: a remapping rule (doctor means forest) pitted against the query word's lexical-prior distractor (hospital), with matched neutral controls. Across 11 open-weight models spanning four families and 1B-9B parameters, lexical-prior strength predicts interference even after item-level controls for answer prior, frequency, tokenization, and prompt wording. Activation patching on five models then locates where the override is repaired internally. Restoring three source positions that carry the redefinition (the definition subject, its new target, and the query word) almost fully recovers the effect (aggregate $R \in [0.92, 1.06]$). The repair works by protecting the contextual target rather than by silencing the prior; the distractor's probability falls whenever these positions are perturbed, but the target survives only when the redefinition is restored intact. Behavior and mechanism converge on the same channel: the prior's strength both predicts which overrides fail and marks where the causal repair lands.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过Stroop范式研究语言模型中的词汇覆盖现象，发现局部规则无法覆盖预训练先验，先验强度仍会干扰。在11个开源模型上验证，并通过激活修补定位修复机制。
Motivation: 理解语言模型在重新定义词汇时，预训练先验如何持续影响行为，以及内部修复机制。
Method: 设计Stroop范式，将重新映射规则（如doctor意味着forest）与词汇先验干扰项（如hospital）对峙，使用中性对照。在11个模型上测量干扰，并对5个模型进行激活修补。
Result: 先验强度预测干扰，激活修补显示恢复三个定义位置可几乎完全恢复效果（聚合R∈[0.92,1.06]），修复机制是保护上下文目标而非压制先验。
Conclusion: 行为与机制均表明先验强度决定覆盖成败，并标记因果修复位置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VISTA: An End-to-End Benchmark for Visual Spec-to-Web-App Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: We present VISTA (VIsual Spec-To-App Benchmark), a benchmark for evaluating the end-to-end web-app generation capabilities of LLM-based agents. Unlike prior code generation benchmarks that focus on algorithmic tasks, VISTA targets realistic UI-centric development, where agents must produce functional, visually coherent applications from underspecified inputs. We define five prompt-information conditions that vary along two axes, visual/structural fidelity and stack constraint: (1) text only with free stack choice, (2) text with reference screenshots under three specified stacks, (3) text with reference screenshots under free stack choice, (4) text with screenshots and pruned Figma structure under a single specified stack, and (5) text with screenshots and pruned Figma structure under free stack choice. To enable robust evaluation, each page in the benchmark is manually annotated with interactive UI components and around three visual anchor points, addressing the well-known limitations of script-based testing tools such as Playwright in open-ended code generation settings. Evaluation combines DOM-grounded reference matching, behavior-specific browser tests, and CLIP-based visual similarity, jointly measuring structural alignment, behavioral completeness, and overall visual fidelity. We use VISTA to assess four agent systems drawn from two model families and two harnesses, finding that visual fidelity and functional correctness are partially decoupled across both input conditions and agents, and that agent editing style varies sharply but is largely orthogonal to task quality. VISTA establishes a rigorous and reproducible foundation for advancing agent-based software engineering research. Code is available at https://github.com/kaboider/VISTA_Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VISTA基准，用于评估基于LLM的智能体从视觉规格到Web应用生成的端到端能力。不同于传统算法代码生成，VISTA聚焦于UI中心开发，要求智能体从不完整的输入（如文本、截图、Figma结构）生成功能完整且视觉一致的应用程序。基准包含五种输入条件，并引入结合DOM匹配、浏览器测试和CLIP视觉相似性的多维度评估方法。实验显示视觉逼真度与功能正确性部分解耦，且智能体编辑风格差异显著但与任务质量正交。
Motivation: 现有代码生成基准主要关注算法任务，缺乏对真实世界UI中心开发场景的评估，且脚本测试工具（如Playwright）在开放式代码生成中存在局限性。
Method: 构建VISTA基准，定义五种从纯文本到包含截图和Figma结构的不同输入条件；手动标注交互式UI组件和视觉锚点；采用DOM接地参考匹配、行为特定浏览器测试和CLIP视觉相似性联合评估结构对齐、行为完整性和视觉逼真度。
Result: 对四种智能体系统（来自两个模型族和两个框架）的评估表明，视觉逼真度与功能正确性在不同输入条件和智能体间部分解耦，智能体编辑风格差异显著但与任务质量正交。
Conclusion: VISTA为推进基于智能体的软件工程研究提供了严谨且可复现的基准，Code已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sensing Intelligence as a Trainable Metamaterial Property
papers.abstract_en: In biological systems, sensing is not performed by the brain alone: the body deforms, vibrates, and filters external stimuli before they are transduced into neural signals. In engineered systems, this processing burden is placed largely on electronics and computation, while the mechanical body is usually designed only for strength and stability. Here, we present sensing intelligence as a trainable property of the body. We show that the geometry of a metamaterial can be optimized to reshape external stimuli into internal signals that are easier for a neural network to interpret. Rather than hand-designing this physical preprocessing, we let the neural network train its own body for sensing by backpropagating the sensing loss to the body's design parameters through differentiable simulation. Across numerical and experimental sensing scenarios, the optimized body improves sensing accuracy by up to fivefold or reduces the number of required electronic sensors by nearly an order of magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将感知智能视为机械超材料的一种可训练属性，通过可微仿真反向传播感知损失，优化超材料几何结构，使外部刺激被重塑为神经网络更易解释的内部信号。数值和实验表明，优化后的身体可将感知准确性提升高达5倍，或减少近一个数量级的电子传感器需求。
Motivation: 生物系统中身体本身参与感知预处理，而工程系统通常将处理负担全放在电子计算上，机械体仅设计为强度和稳定。
Method: 通过可微仿真将感知损失反向传播到超材料设计参数，让神经网络训练自己的物理身体用于感知预处理。
Result: 优化后的超材料身体在数值和实验场景中使感知准确性提升高达5倍，或减少所需电子传感器数量近一个数量级。
Conclusion: 感知智能可以作为身体的可训练属性，通过优化机械超材料几何结构实现更高效的感知预处理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Similarity of Neural Network Representations in Superposition
papers.abstract_en: Comparing internal representations is a central goal in neuroscience and machine learning, but standard linear alignment metrics (Representational Similarity Analysis, Centered Kernel Alignment, and linear regression) are frequently applied to neural activity coordinates rather than on the underlying features. We show this matters when neural systems operate in superposition, encoding more features than they have neurons via linear compression. Closed-form derivations prove that these metrics depend on the Gram matrices of each system's projection, not on the latent features themselves: alignment thus combines what a system represents with how it is encoded. For those interested in what features two systems share, this is a problem: Two networks can have identical feature content yet appear more dissimilar than networks exhibiting partial feature overlap. This apparent misalignment need not reflect lost information as compressed sensing guarantees sparse features remain recoverable from the compressed activity. We confirm this by training supervised TopK sparse autoencoders that realize solvable compressed sensing by construction, finding alignment on recovered latents restored even when raw-activation alignment remains deflated. We extend the result to unsupervised SAEs trained without ground-truth latents, and to pretrained vision and language model SAEs, where SAE-latent alignment exceeds raw-activation alignment, consistent with superposition in real systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，当神经网络处于叠加（superposition）状态（即通过线性压缩编码比神经元更多的特征）时，标准线性对齐度量（如 RSA、CKA、线性回归）实际上衡量的是系统投影的 Gram 矩阵，而非潜在特征本身。因此，两个网络可能因编码方式不同而显示低对齐，即使它们共享相同的特征内容。通过训练有监督的 TopK 稀疏自编码器（SAE），压缩感知保证稀疏特征可从压缩活动中恢复，实验表明恢复的潜在特征对齐度提升，而原始激活对齐度仍较低。该结果也推广到无监督 SAE 和预训练视觉/语言模型 SAE。
Motivation: 神经科学和机器学习中常用线性对齐度量比较内部表示，但这些度量通常应用于神经活动坐标而非底层特征。当神经系统的表示处于叠加（superposition）状态时，这种做法的有效性尚不明确。
Method: 通过闭合形式推导证明标准对齐度量依赖于投影的 Gram 矩阵；然后训练有监督 TopK 稀疏自编码器（SAE）实现可解压缩感知，并在恢复的潜在特征上重新计算对齐；最后扩展到无监督 SAE 和预训练模型 SAE。
Result: 两个网络即使具有相同的特征内容，也可能因编码方式不同而显得比部分特征重叠的网络更不相似；而使用 SAE 恢复潜在特征后，对齐度得到恢复，原始激活对齐度则仍被抑制。预训练视觉/语言模型 SAE 上，SAE 潜在对齐度也高于原始激活对齐度。

papers.title: Does it matter which Gaussians you pick in 4D Gaussian streaming?
papers.abstract_en: Anchor-driven 4D Gaussian streaming methods such as Instant Gaussian Stream (IGS) update a dynamic scene each frame from a compact set of Gaussian anchors, chosen by default with Farthest Point Sampling (FPS) at a fixed budget of $8{,}192$. Because these anchors act as control points that drive the whole scene through linear blend skinning, the rule used to choose them ought to affect reconstruction quality. We test this by holding the IGS pipeline fixed and changing only the sampler, comparing FPS, random, uniform, an opacity-scale heuristic, and a learned policy across budgets and refinement settings on N3DV and MeetingRoom. At deployment budgets the sampler has no measurable effect: a cheap random or uniform sampler at $4{,}096$ anchors matches FPS@8192 within measurement error, the default budget is over-provisioned, and the result holds on a second backbone (3DGStream). The learned policy is mixed rather than consistently better: it can improve the N3DV validation set at tight budgets, but does not give a stable cross-dataset rule, and selection is never the bottleneck because refinement dominates runtime. We will release our full sweep and evaluation protocol as a sampler benchmark.
papers.comment: updated version of Adaptive Anchor Policies
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在4D高斯流（4D Gaussian streaming）中，锚点（anchor）选择策略对动态场景重建质量的影响。通过固定Instant Gaussian Stream（IGS）管线，仅改变锚点采样器（FPS、随机、均匀、不透明度启发式及学习策略）并在N3DV和MeetingRoom数据集上比较，发现默认预算下采样器选择对重建质量无显著影响，且默认预算过剩。学习策略仅在极低预算下对特定验证集有提升，但不稳定。
Motivation: 锚点驱动的高斯流方法中，锚点作为控制点通过线性混合蒙皮驱动整个场景，其选择规则理论上应影响重建质量，但现有工作未系统探究不同采样策略的影响。
Method: 保持IGS管线不变，仅替换锚点采样器，对比Farthest Point Sampling (FPS)、随机、均匀、基于不透明度启发式及学习策略，在不同预算和精细度设置下评估。
Result: 在部署预算（如4096锚点）下，随机或均匀采样器与FPS@8192在测量误差内匹配，默认8192锚点预算过度配置；该结论在另一管线3DGStream上也成立。学习策略在极低预算下可提升N3DV验证集，但跨数据集不稳定。
Conclusion: 锚点选择不是性能瓶颈，精细度处理（refinement）才是运行时主要开销；默认预算可大幅削减而不损失质量。
