papers.title: LLM-MINE: Large Language Model based Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias Phenotypes Mining from Clinical Notes
papers.abstract_en: Accurate extraction of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) phenotypes from electronic health records (EHR) is critical for early-stage detection and disease staging. However, this information is usually embedded in unstructured textual data rather than tabular data, making it difficult to be extracted accurately. We therefore propose LLM-MINE, a Large Language Model-based phenotype mining framework for automatic extraction of ADRD phenotypes from clinical notes. Using two expert-defined phenotype lists, we evaluate the extracted phenotypes by examining their statistical significance across cohorts and their utility for unsupervised disease staging. Chi-square analyses confirm statistically significant phenotype differences across cohorts, with memory impairment being the strongest discriminator. Few-shot prompting with the combined phenotype lists achieves the best clustering performance (ARI=0.290, NMI=0.232), substantially outperforming biomedical NER and dictionary-based baselines. Our results demonstrate that LLM-based phenotype extraction is a promising tool for discovering clinically meaningful ADRD signals from unstructured notes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM-MINE，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的表型挖掘框架，用于从临床笔记中自动提取阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症（ADRD）表型。通过两个专家定义的表型列表，作者评估了提取的表型在队列间的统计显著性和无监督疾病分期的实用性。卡方分析确认了显著的表型差异，少样本提示结合两个表型列表取得了最佳聚类性能（ARI=0.290，NMI=0.232），显著优于生物医学NER和基于词典的基线方法。结果表明基于LLM的表型提取是从非结构化笔记中发现临床有意义ADRD信号的有前景工具。
Motivation: 准确的ADRD表型提取对于早期检测和疾病分期至关重要，但这类信息通常嵌入在非结构化文本中难以准确提取。
Method: 提出LLM-MINE框架，利用大语言模型通过少样本提示从临床笔记中提取表型，结合两个专家定义的表型列表，使用卡方分析和聚类评估提取质量。
Result: 卡方分析显示表型在队列间具有显著统计差异；少样本提示结合两个列表的最佳聚类ARI=0.290，NMI=0.232，显著优于NER和基于词典的基线。
Conclusion: 基于LLM的表型提取是发现临床有意义ADRD信号的有前景工具。

papers.title: Bitwise Systolic Array Architecture for Runtime-Reconfigurable Multi-precision Quantized Multiplication on Hardware Accelerators
papers.abstract_en: Neural network accelerators have been widely applied to edge devices for complex tasks like object tracking, image recognition, etc. Previous works have explored the quantization technologies in related lightweight accelerator designs to reduce hardware resource consumption. However, low precision leads to high accuracy loss in inference. Therefore, mixed-precision quantization becomes an alternative solution by applying different precision in different layers to trade off resource consumption and accuracy. Because regular designs for multiplication on hardware cannot support the precision reconfiguration for a multi-precision Quantized Neural Network (QNN) model in runtime, we propose a runtime reconfigurable multi-precision multi-channel bitwise systolic array design for QNN accelerators. We have implemented and evaluated our work on the Ultra96 FPGA platform. Results show that our work can achieve 1.3185 to 3.5671 times speedup in inferring mixed-precision models and has less critical path delay, supporting a higher clock frequency (250MHz).
papers.comment: Accepted at ISQED 2025. RTL source code, Vivado projects, and packaged Vivado IPs are available at: https://github.com/liuyh-Horizon/BitSys
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种运行时可重构的多精度位级脉动阵列架构，用于量化神经网络加速器，支持混合精度推理。在Ultra96 FPGA上实现，相比基线获得1.32-3.57倍加速，关键路径延迟更短，支持250MHz时钟频率。
Motivation: 低精度量化导致高精度损失，混合精度量化可平衡资源与精度，但现有乘法器硬件不支持运行时精度重配置。
Method: 设计运行时可重构的多精度多通道位级脉动阵列（bitwise systolic array），支持在运行时切换不同量化精度。
Result: 在Ultra96 FPGA上评估，混合精度模型推理加速1.32-3.57倍，关键路径延迟降低，支持250MHz时钟频率。
Conclusion: 该架构能有效支持混合精度量化神经网络的硬件加速，且具备运行时重构能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamic Symmetric Point Tracking: Tackling Non-ideal Reference in Analog In-memory Training
papers.abstract_en: Analog in-memory computing (AIMC) performs computation directly within resistive crossbar arrays, offering an energy-efficient platform to scale large vision and language models. However, non-ideal analog device properties make the training on AIMC devices challenging. In particular, its update asymmetry can induce a systematic drift of weight updates towards a device-specific symmetric point (SP), which typically does not align with the optimum of the training objective. To mitigate this bias, most existing works assume the SP is known and pre-calibrate it to zero before training by setting the reference point as the SP. Nevertheless, calibrating AIMC devices requires costly pulse updates, and residual calibration error can directly degrade training performance. In this work, we present the first theoretical characterization of the pulse complexity of SP calibration and the resulting estimation error. We further propose a dynamic SP estimation method that tracks the SP during model training, and establishes its convergence guarantees. In addition, we develop an enhanced variant based on chopping and filtering techniques from digital signal processing. Numerical experiments demonstrate both the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对模拟内存计算（AIMC）训练中非理想参考点（对称点SP）导致的权重更新偏差问题，首次对SP校准的脉冲复杂度和估计误差进行理论刻画，并提出一种动态SP估计方法，在训练过程中追踪SP并给出收敛保证，同时基于数字信号处理的斩波和滤波技术提出增强变体。
Motivation: 现有的AIMC训练方法假设SP已知并预先校准到零，但校准需要昂贵的脉冲更新且残余误差会降低训练性能，亟需一种无需预校准的动态方法。
Method: 提出动态对称点估计方法，在模型训练期间实时追踪SP，并给出收敛性保证；进一步引入基于斩波和滤波的增强变体以提升性能。
Result: 数值实验表明所提方法在效率和有效性上均优于现有方案。
Conclusion: 本文首次从理论上分析了SP校准的复杂度与估计误差，并提供了动态跟踪方法的收敛性保证，为AIMC训练中的非理想参考问题提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Separating Oblivious and Adaptive Models of Variable Selection
papers.abstract_en: Sparse recovery is among the most well-studied problems in learning theory and high-dimensional statistics. In this work, we investigate the statistical and computational landscapes of sparse recovery with $\ell_\infty$ error guarantees. This variant of the problem is motivated by \emph{variable selection} tasks, where the goal is to estimate the support of a $k$-sparse signal in $\mathbb{R}^d$. Our main contribution is a provable separation between the \emph{oblivious} (``for each'') and \emph{adaptive} (``for all'') models of $\ell_\infty$ sparse recovery. We show that under an oblivious model, the optimal $\ell_\infty$ error is attainable in near-linear time with $\approx k\log d$ samples, whereas in an adaptive model, $\gtrsim k^2$ samples are necessary for any algorithm to achieve this bound. This establishes a surprising contrast with the standard $\ell_2$ setting, where $\approx k \log d$ samples suffice even for adaptive sparse recovery. We conclude with a preliminary examination of a \emph{partially-adaptive} model, where we show nontrivial variable selection guarantees are possible with $\approx k\log d$ measurements.
papers.comment: 40 pages, Extended abstract accepted for presentation at COLT 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有 ℓ∞ 误差保证的稀疏恢复问题，区分了 oblivious（“对每个”）和 adaptive（“对所有”）两种变量选择模型。作者证明在 oblivious 模型下，最优 ℓ∞ 误差可用约 k log d 个样本在线性时间内达到；但在 adaptive 模型下，任何算法都需要至少约 k² 个样本才能实现相同误差界限。这一结果与 ℓ2 设置形成鲜明对比。论文还初步考察了部分自适应模型。
Motivation: 现有稀疏恢复研究多关注 ℓ2 误差，但 ℓ∞ 误差更直接对应变量选择任务（如估计 k-稀疏信号的支持集）。需要厘清在不同查询模型（oblivious vs. adaptive）下 ℓ∞ 稀疏恢复的统计与计算边界。
Method: 理论证明：构造上下界，在 oblivious 模型下给出高效算法（近线性时间，约 k log d 样本），在 adaptive 模型下给出样本复杂度下界（至少 k²）。部分自适应模型则结合两者特点。
Result: Obvious 模型下最优 ℓ∞ 误差可高效实现；Adaptive 模型则需要至少 k² 样本，与 ℓ2 情形（仅需 k log d）存在显著差距。部分自适应模型可实现约 k log d 样本下的非平凡变量选择保证。
Conclusion: 该工作严格分离了 oblivious 与 adaptive 两种 ℓ∞ 稀疏恢复模型，揭示了 adaptive 模型下高的样本代价，并指出部分自适应模型作为折衷方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作严格分离了 oblivious 与 adaptive 两种 ℓ∞ 稀疏恢复模型，揭示了 adaptive 模型下高的样本代价，并指出部分自适应模型作为折衷方向。

papers.title: Toward Autonomous O-RAN: A Multi-Scale Agentic AI Framework for Real-Time Network Control and Management
papers.abstract_en: Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) promise flexible 6G network access through disaggregated, software-driven components and open interfaces, but this programmability also increases operational complexity. Multiple control loops coexist across the service management layer and RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC), while independently developed control applications can interact in unintended ways. In parallel, recent advances in generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) are enabling a shift from isolated AI models toward agentic AI systems that can interpret goals, coordinate multiple models and control functions, and adapt their behavior over time. This article proposes a multi-scale agentic AI framework for O-RAN that organizes RAN intelligence as a coordinated hierarchy across the Non-Real-Time (Non-RT), Near-Real-Time (Near-RT), and Real-Time (RT) control loops: (i) A Large Language Model (LLM) agent in the Non-RT RIC translates operator intent into policies and governs model lifecycles. (ii) Small Language Model (SLM) agents in the Near-RT RIC execute low-latency optimization and can activate, tune, or disable existing control applications; and (iii) Wireless Physical-layer Foundation Model (WPFM) agents near the distributed unit provide fast inference close to the air interface. We describe how these agents cooperate through standardized O-RAN interfaces and telemetry. Using a proof-of-concept implementation built on open-source models, software, and datasets, we demonstrate the proposed agentic approach in two representative scenarios: robust operation under non-stationary conditions and intent-driven slice resource control.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the IEEE Network magazine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向 O-RAN 的多尺度智能体 AI 框架，将 RAN 智能组织为非实时、近实时和实时控制循环的层级协调结构，分别利用 LLM 智能体、SLM 智能体和无线物理层基础模型智能体。通过在开源模型和数据集上的概念验证实现，展示了在非平稳条件下的鲁棒运行和意图驱动的切片资源控制两个场景中的效果。
Motivation: O-RAN 的可编程性增加了操作复杂性，多个控制循环并存且独立开发的控制应用可能产生意外交互，需要更自主的智能管理框架。
Method: 提出三层智能体架构：非实时 RIC 中的 LLM 智能体将运营商意图转化为策略并管理模型生命周期；近实时 RIC 中的 SLM 智能体执行低延迟优化并激活/调整/禁用现有控制应用；分布式单元附近的 WPFM 智能体提供接近空口的快速推理。智能体通过标准化 O-RAN 接口和遥测协作。
Result: 通过基于开源模型、软件和数据集的实现，在两个代表性场景（非平稳条件下的鲁棒运行和意图驱动的切片资源控制）中展示了所提方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架利用生成式 AI 的进展，实现从孤立 AI 模型向自主智能体系统的转变，有望提升 O-RAN 的实时控制和管理能力。

papers.title: Are LLM Evaluators Really Narcissists? Sanity Checking Self-Preference Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Recent research has shown that large language models (LLMs) favor their own outputs when acting as judges, undermining the integrity of automated post-training and evaluation workflows. However, it is difficult to disentangle which behaviors are explained by narcissism versus experimental confounds. Specifically, LLM evaluators may deliver self-preferring verdicts when comparing responses to questions they fail on; these verdicts may not depend on the identity of the author, but on evaluator quality. We correct this by directly comparing the judge's voting distribution in cases where it evaluates itself versus another model. This evaluator quality baseline reveals that only 51% of examples in previous findings retain statistical significance against this null hypothesis, covering 89.6% of total self-preference probability mass. Finally, we compare the entropy of voting distributions, suggesting uncertainty-driven overlap, and show that our procedure enables more careful documentation against the backdrop of judge-bias research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究质疑了LLM作为评估者时存在“自恋”偏见的结论，通过引入评估者质量基线，发现之前研究中的自偏好结果只有51%具有统计显著性，且覆盖89.6%的自偏好概率质量。进一步比较投票分布的熵，表明不确定性驱动了部分重叠，并提出了更严谨的文档记录方法。
Motivation: 现有研究表明LLM评估者倾向于偏好自己的输出，但这种行为可能源于实验混淆（如评估者自身能力不足），而非真正的自恋。需要区分真正的自偏好与由评估者质量导致的伪自偏好。
Method: 通过在LLM评估者对自己和他人输出的投票分布之间引入评估者质量基线，直接比较两种情况下的投票分布，并采用统计显著性检验和熵分析来量化不确定性驱动的重叠。
Result: 发现之前研究中仅51%的案例在统计上显著支持自偏好假设，但覆盖了89.6%的自偏好概率质量；自偏好现象部分可由评估者自身的不确定性解释。
Conclusion: LLM评估者的自偏好可能被夸大，需要更谨慎的基线校正和文档记录来避免混淆。

papers.title: The $\mathbf{P}$-Completeness of Inverted Index Traversal: On the Complexity of Evaluating Boolean Query DAGs
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI agents increasingly rely on search infrastructure to execute complex, neuro-symbolic reasoning workflows. These workflows often compile into deeply nested, non-monotonic Boolean queries over text fields. However, standard query evaluation strategies over inverted indices face severe theoretical limits when handling these structures. Stateful iterator models (Document-at-a-Time) are structurally bounded by $\text{NC}^1$ formula evaluation, suffering a worst-case $O(2^{|Q|})$ exponential blowup in query complexity when unrolling re-convergent logic. Conversely, recursive materialization models (Term-at-a-Time) incur an $Ω(|U|)$ space complexity penalty (the Universal Scan) when evaluating logical negation over the document universe. In this paper, we establish the theoretical boundaries of executing complex logic natively over an inverted index. We formalize a retrieval language ($\mathcal{L}_R$) based on Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) and prove that its evaluation problem is strictly \textbf{$\mathbf{P}$-Complete}. To make evaluation tractable, we introduce \texttt{ComputePN}, a deterministic, sparsity-aware evaluation algorithm. By decoupling logical negation from universe-scale materialization via a novel Positive-Negative dual representation, and utilizing native DAG memoization, \texttt{ComputePN} strictly bounds evaluation time to $O(|Q| \cdot |U_{\mathit{active}}|)$. This approach successfully evaluates $\mathbf{P}$-Complete queries natively over the index, avoiding both the combinatorial tree-expansion bottleneck and the universal scan penalty, laying the formal foundation for computational retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究现代AI代理中复杂布尔查询DAG在倒排索引上的评估复杂性，证明该问题为P完全，并提出ComputePN算法，通过正负对偶表示和DAG记忆化实现高效评估。
Motivation: 现代AI代理的神经符号推理工作流生成深层嵌套的非单调布尔查询，现有倒排索引评估策略面临指数级树扩展或全域扫描空间惩罚的理论极限。
Method: 形式化检索语言L_R基于DAG，证明其评估问题为P完全；提出ComputePN算法，采用正负对偶表示解耦逻辑否定与全域物化，并利用DAG记忆化将评估时间约束为O(|Q|·|U_active|)。
Result: 成功评估P完全查询，避免组合树扩展和全域扫描惩罚。
Conclusion: 为计算检索建立形式基础。

papers.title: A Fast and Effective Method for Euclidean Anticlustering: The Assignment-Based-Anticlustering Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Anticlustering is an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem that consists of partitioning a set of objects into equal-sized groups called anticlusters such that the objects in the same anticluster are as dissimilar as possible and thereby representative of the entire set of objects. Here we study the case where the dissimilarity metric is the squared Euclidean distance between the respective feature vectors. Applications of Euclidean anticlustering include social studies, cross-validation, creating mini-batches for stochastic gradient descent, and finding balanced K-cut partitions. In particular, machine-learning applications such as mini-batch generation involve million-scale datasets and very large values of K, making scalable anticlustering algorithms essential. We propose a new algorithm, the Assignment-Based Anticlustering (ABA) algorithm, that scales to instances with millions of objects and hundreds of thousands of anticlusters within seconds to minutes, which is far beyond what existing anticlustering methods can manage. We demonstrate here, via an extensive computational study, that our algorithm outperforms existing anticlustering methods in both solution quality and running time. This is so also for anticlustering with categories. For the related problem of balanced K-cut partitioning, our algorithm is superior to the well-known METIS method. The code of our algorithm is available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对欧几里得反聚类问题，提出Assignment-Based Anticlustering (ABA)算法。该算法能够处理数百万对象和数十万反聚类，在解质量和运行时间上显著优于现有方法，且支持类别约束。实验表明ABA在平衡K-cut分区上也优于METIS。
Motivation: 现有反聚类方法无法扩展到大规模实例（百万级对象、大量反聚类），且解质量不够高。
Method: 基于分配（assignment-based）的算法，将反聚类转化为分配问题求解，通过高效优化实现大规模扩展。
Result: 在大量计算实验中，ABA在解质量和运行时间上均优于现有反聚类方法，对于带有类别约束的反聚类同样有效，并在平衡K-cut分区上超越METIS。
Conclusion: ABA是一种可扩展、高质量的反聚类方法，适用于大规模应用，代码已开源。

papers.title: Evolving Programmatic Skill Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study continual skill acquisition in open-ended embodied environments where an agent must construct, refine, and reuse an expanding library of executable skills. We introduce the Programmatic Skill Network (PSN), a framework in which skills are executable symbolic programs forming a compositional network that evolves through experience. PSN defines three core mechanisms instantiated via large language models: (1)~\opreflect for structured fault localization over skill compositions, (2)~progressive optimization with maturity-aware update gating that stabilizes reliable skills while maintaining plasticity for uncertain ones, and (3)~canonical structural refactoring under rollback validation that maintains network compactness. We further show that PSN's learning dynamics exhibit structural parallels to neural network training. Experiments on MineDojo and Crafter demonstrate robust skill reuse, rapid adaptation, and strong generalization across open-ended task distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出程序化技能网络（PSN），一种通过大语言模型实例化的框架，使具身智能体在开放世界中持续构建、优化和重用可执行的符号化技能程序。PSN定义了三种核心机制：结构化故障定位（opreflect）、基于成熟度的更新门控渐进优化，以及带回滚验证的规范结构重构。实验在MineDojo和Crafter环境中证明了鲁棒的技能重用、快速适应和强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法在开放环境中的持续技能获取存在技能组合故障定位困难、已学技能不稳定与学习新技能之间的平衡问题，以及技能网络随经验增长而变得臃肿。
Method: 提出程序化技能网络（PSN），将技能表示为可执行的符号程序，并通过大语言模型实现三种机制：opreflect用于结构化故障定位、渐进优化（含成熟度感知更新门控）以稳定可靠技能并保持不确定性技能的塑性、以及带回滚验证的规范结构重构以维持网络紧凑性。
Result: 在MineDojo和Crafter环境中，PSN展现出鲁棒的技能重用、快速适应和强泛化能力。此外，作者指出PSN的学习动态与神经网络训练具有结构相似性。
Conclusion: PSN框架为开放环境中持续技能获取提供了一种可解释且可组合的方法，但其有效性依赖于大语言模型的推理能力，且实验环境为特定模拟器，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Generative Manifold Distillation: Aligning Restoration Trajectories with Natural Image Prior
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained image restoration models often fail on out-of-distribution (OOD) real-world degradations. Adapting to these domains is challenging as real-world data lacks paired ground truth, and unsupervised methods often require unstable architectural changes. We propose Generative Manifold Distillation (GMD), which reframes domain adaptation as geometric manifold alignment. GMD operates in a strictly unpaired setting, requiring only low-quality (LQ) target observations. By leveraging the flow-matching dynamics of a frozen text-to-image foundation model, GMD projects off-manifold restorations onto the natural image manifold to generate high-quality pseudo-targets. To ensure stability, a quality-gated manifold filter rejects off-manifold samples, while source-anchored trajectory regularization prevents error accumulation. Ultimately, GMD distills a powerful generative prior into an efficient restoration network. Experiments demonstrate that GMD seamlessly adapts to new distributions using only LQ inputs, drastically improving perceptual quality with zero architectural modifications or added inference latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式流形蒸馏 (GMD)，通过流匹配动力学将低质量恢复图像对齐到自然图像流形，实现无需配对数据的领域自适应。方法冻结 text-to-image 基础模型作为先验，用质量门控流形过滤器和源锚定轨迹正则化保证稳定，最终蒸馏到高效恢复网络。实验证明仅用低质量输入即可提升感知质量，无需架构修改或额外推理延迟。
Motivation: 预训练图像恢复模型在真实世界退化 (OOD) 上表现不佳，而无监督域适应需要不稳定架构修改，且缺乏配对真值。需要一种无需配对数据、无需修改架构的域适应方法。
Method: 利用冻结的 text-to-image 基础模型的流匹配动力学，将偏离流形的恢复结果投影到自然图像流形生成高质量伪目标；通过质量门控流形过滤器拒绝离流形样本，源锚定轨迹正则化防止误差累积，最终将生成先验蒸馏到高效恢复网络。
Result: 实验表明，仅使用低质量目标域输入，无需任何架构修改或额外推理延迟，即可显著提升感知质量，适应新分布。
Conclusion: GMD 重新定义域适应为几何流形对齐，在严格无配对设定下有效，且零架构修改。局限性包括依赖预训练基础模型，可能受其分布限制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ATHENA: Agentic Team for Hierarchical Evolutionary Numerical Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Progress in computational science depends on complex numerical workflows that must faithfully encode physical laws, yet translating conceptual insight into reliable code remains a major bottleneck. Although large language models can generate isolated code fragments, they lack the structured reasoning required to design, verify, and iteratively refine complete scientific pipelines. Here we introduce ATHENA, an agentic framework explicitly designed to emulate scientific research modeled as a knowledge-driven contextual bandit process. Its core loop separates conceptual policy from numerical realization through expert-derived conceptual scaffolding, enabling principled diagnosis, reformulation, and repair of computational strategies. Across scientific computing and scientific machine learning tasks, ATHENA autonomously derives and correctly applies exact analytical solutions, constructs stable numerical solvers, diagnoses ill-posed formulations, and orchestrates hybrid symbolic-numeric workflows. Quantitatively, ATHENA matches and frequently surpasses the accuracy of expert-authored reference solutions reported in the literature on canonical benchmarks. By reframing computation as an object of agentic reasoning, our framework enables autonomous orchestration of heterogeneous algorithms across scientific domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ATHENA，一个基于智能体（agent）的框架，用于自主设计和优化科学计算中的数值算法。该框架将科学研究建模为知识驱动的语境赌博机（contextual bandit）过程，通过概念策略与数值实现的分离，实现计算策略的诊断、重构和修复。在科学计算和科学机器学习任务上，ATHENA 能够自主推导解析解、构建稳定数值求解器、诊断不适定问题，并协调混合符号-数值工作流，在经典基准上达到甚至超越专家水平的准确性。
Motivation: 将概念洞察转化为可靠的科学计算代码仍是主要瓶颈，现有大语言模型能生成孤立代码片段，但缺乏设计、验证和迭代完善完整科学流程的结构化推理能力。
Method: 提出 agentic 框架 ATHENA，其核心循环通过专家导出概念脚手架（conceptual scaffolding）分离概念策略与数值实现，将科学研究建模为知识驱动的语境赌博机过程。
Result: 在科学计算和科学机器学习任务上，ATHENA 自主推导并正确应用精确解析解、构建稳定数值求解器、诊断不适定问题、协调混合符号-数值工作流，在经典基准上匹配并常超越专家撰写的参考解的准确性。
Conclusion: 通过将计算重构为 agentic 推理的对象，该框架实现了跨科学领域的异构算法自主编排。

papers.title: Bilevel Data Curation for LLM Fine-tuning: Offline Selection and Online Self-Refining Generation
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) datasets are critical to the downstream performance of large language models, yet they often contain low-quality or harmful question-response pairs. To improve SFT data quality, we develop a unified bilevel framework that combines offline data selection with the online self-refining generation. In the offline setting, bilevel data selection (BDS) selects question-response pairs from the offline SFT dataset to maximize the validation performance. We theoretically show that the optimal model given by BDS outperforms direct data mixing approach in useful data coverage. Moreover, we provide a global convergence analysis for gradient-based BDS approach for one-layer Transformer, showing that the epsilon-global optimum of offline BDS is achievable in finite time. Although efficient, offline BDS discards potentially harmful questions together with responses, thereby reducing question diversity. We address this limitation by refining the responses to selected questions using online self-refining generation framework. However, BDS is inefficient to update the response weights when responses are regenerated online. To address this issue, we introduce bilevel multi-objective optimization (BMO) for response-level weighting. We show that BMO recovers the same validation-aligned solution as BDS, but admits a closed-form importance-ratio weight that adapts to regenerated responses. Experiments on LLM quality enhancement and safety-aware fine-tuning demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves both data quality and downstream fine-tuning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个双层优化框架，用于大语言模型微调的数据筛选，包括离线数据选择（BDS）和在线自精炼生成。离线BDS从SFT数据集中选择高质量问答对，理论证明其优于直接混合，并提供收敛性分析；在线通过双层多目标优化（BMO）对重新生成的响应进行闭式权重更新。实验表明该方法提升了数据质量和下游微调性能。
Motivation: 监督微调数据集常含有低质量或有害的问答对，影响模型下游性能，亟需有效的数据筛选方法。
Method: 提出双层框架：离线通过梯度优化的双层数据选择（BDS）最大化验证性能；在线通过双层多目标优化（BMO）为重新生成的响应分配闭式重要性权重，替代BDS的低效更新。
Result: 理论证明BDS在有用数据覆盖上优于直接混合，且单层Transformer在有限时间内可达ε-全局最优。实验在质量增强和安全微调任务上持续改进性能。
Conclusion: 该框架有效结合离线和在线数据筛选，提高了SFT数据质量与下游微调效果，兼顾了数据多样性和安全性。

papers.title: FlowerDance: MeanFlow for Efficient and Refined 3D Dance Generation
papers.abstract_en: Music-to-dance generation aims to translate auditory signals into expressive human motion, with broad applications in virtual reality, choreography, and digital entertainment. Despite promising progress, the limited generation efficiency of existing methods leaves insufficient computational headroom for high-fidelity 3D rendering, thereby constraining the expressiveness of 3D characters during real-world applications. Thus, we propose FlowerDance, which not only generates refined motion with physical plausibility and artistic expressiveness, but also achieves significant generation efficiency on inference speed and memory utilization. Specifically, FlowerDance combines MeanFlow with Physical Consistency Constraints, which enables high-quality motion generation with only a few sampling steps. Moreover, FlowerDance leverages a simple but efficient model architecture with BiMamba-based backbone and Channel-Level Cross-Modal Fusion, which generates dance with efficient non-autoregressive manner. Meanwhile, FlowerDance supports motion editing, enabling users to interactively refine dance sequences. Extensive experiments on AIST++ and FineDance show that FlowerDance achieves state-of-the-art results in both motion quality and generation efficiency. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowerDance，一种基于MeanFlow的高效精细3D舞蹈生成方法，通过物理一致性约束和BiMamba骨干网络实现非自回归生成，在AIST++和FineDance上达到SOTA。
Motivation: 现有音乐到舞蹈生成方法效率低，无法为高保真3D渲染留出计算空间，限制了3D角色的表现力。
Method: 结合MeanFlow与物理一致性约束，仅需少量采样步骤即可生成高质量运动；采用BiMamba骨干和通道级跨模态融合的非自回归架构，支持运动编辑。
Result: 在AIST++和FineDance上，在运动质量和生成效率方面均达到最优结果。
Conclusion: 方法兼顾运动质量与生成效率，支持交互式编辑，代码将开源。

papers.title: A global log for medical AI
papers.abstract_en: Modern computer systems rely on syslog, a universal protocol that records critical events across heterogeneous infrastructure. Medicine's rapidly growing AI stack has no equivalent. As medicine deploys AI tools at scale, there is no standard way to record how, when, by whom, and for whom these models are used. Without such records, it is difficult to measure real-world performance and outcomes, detect adverse events, or identify bias and dataset drift. Here we introduce MedLog, a protocol for event-level logging of medical AI. Each time an AI model interacts with a human, another algorithm, or an automated workflow, MedLog creates a record. Each record contains nine core fields: header, model, user, target, inputs, artifacts, outputs, outcomes, and feedback. We apply MedLog across four deployments in the US, Switzerland, and Vietnam: ICU deterioration prediction, tetanus progression monitoring from wearable signals, automated sepsis quality reporting, and patient attendance prediction. MedLog records capture model behavior, workflow interactions, and downstream outcomes, including AI performance degradation during severe weather events in patient attendance prediction and increased laboratory testing after ICU deterioration alerts. MedLog limits the data footprint through risk-based sampling, lifecycle-aware retention policies, and write-behind caching, enabling deployment in low-resource settings. It also supports detailed traces for complex, agentic, or multi-stage workflows, creating a foundation for continuous monitoring, auditing, and improvement of medical AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MedLog，一种用于医疗AI事件级日志记录的协议，包含九个核心字段（header、model、user、target、inputs、artifacts、outputs、outcomes、feedback）。该协议在美国、瑞士和越南的四个部署（ICU恶化预测、破伤风进展监测、自动化脓毒症报告、患者出诊预测）中应用，能够捕获模型行为、工作流交互和下游结果，包括恶劣天气期间AI性能下降等。MedLog通过基于风险的采样、生命周期感知的保留策略和后写缓存限制数据足迹，适用于低资源环境。
Motivation: 医疗领域缺乏类似计算机系统syslog的通用日志记录协议，导致难以测量AI的真实世界性能和结果、检测不良事件或识别偏差和数据集漂移。
Method: 提出MedLog协议，每次AI模型与人、其他算法或自动化工作流交互时创建包含九个核心字段的记录，并通过基于风险的采样、生命周期感知的保留策略和后写缓存限制数据足迹，支持复杂代理或多阶段工作流的详细追踪。
Result: 在ICU恶化预测、破伤风进展监测、自动化脓毒症报告和患者出诊预测四个部署中应用，日志记录了恶劣天气事件中AI性能下降和ICU恶化警报后实验室检查增加等现象。
Conclusion: MedLog为医疗AI的持续监控、审计和改进奠定了基础，适用于低资源环境，并支持复杂工作流的详细追踪。

papers.title: Removing Noise, not Finding Gold: Quality Filtering for Large-Scale Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale models are pretrained on massive web-crawled datasets containing documents of mixed quality, making data filtering essential. A popular method is Classifier-based Quality Filtering (CQF), which trains a binary classifier to distinguish between pretraining data and a small, high-quality set. It assigns each pretraining document a quality score defined as the classifier's score and retains only the top-scoring ones. We provide an in-depth analysis of CQF. We show that while CQF improves downstream task performance, it does not necessarily enhance language modeling on the high-quality dataset. We explain this paradox by the fact that CQF implicitly filters the high-quality dataset as well. We further compare the behavior of models trained with CQF to those trained on synthetic data of increasing quality, obtained via random token permutations, and find starkly different trends. Our results challenge the view that CQF captures a meaningful notion of data quality.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 22 figures, 2 tables, accepted at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文深入分析基于分类器的质量过滤（CQF）方法，用于大规模预训练数据筛选。研究表明CQF能提升下游任务性能，但会同时过滤高质量数据集，且与通过随机词元排列合成的数据表现趋势不同，挑战了CQF捕捉数据质量有意义的观点。
Motivation: 大规模模型预训练依赖网络抓取的混合质量数据，需要有效的质量过滤方法。现有CQF方法虽然流行，但其对高质量数据的影响尚未被充分理解，存在矛盾现象。
Method: 对CQF进行深入分析，比较CQF训练模型与使用随机词元排列合成的不同质量数据训练模型的行为，揭示CQF的内在行为。
Result: 发现CQF提升下游任务性能，但并未改善对高质量数据集的语言建模，反而也过滤了高质量数据。与合成数据对比，趋势截然不同。
Conclusion: 结果挑战了CQF能捕捉有意义数据质量这一观点，提示CQF可能并非理想的质量过滤方法。

papers.title: HyMaTE: A Hybrid Mamba and Transformer Model for EHR Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health Records (EHRs) have become a cornerstone in modern-day healthcare. They are a crucial part for analyzing the progression of patient health; however, their complexity, characterized by long, multivariate sequences, sparsity, and missing values poses significant challenges in traditional deep learning modeling. While Transformer-based models have demonstrated success in modeling EHR data and predicting clinical outcomes, their quadratic computational complexity and limited context length hinder their efficiency and practical applications. On the other hand, State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba present a promising alternative offering linear-time sequence modeling and improved efficiency for handling long sequences, but focus mostly on mixing sequence-level information rather than channel-level data. To overcome these challenges, we propose HyMaTE (A Hybrid Mamba and Transformer Model for EHR Representation Learning), a novel hybrid model tailored for representing longitudinal data, combining the strengths of SSMs with advanced attention mechanisms. By testing the model on predictive tasks on multiple clinical datasets, we demonstrate HyMaTE's ability to capture an effective, richer, and more nuanced unified representation of EHR data. Additionally, the interpretability of the outcomes achieved by self-attention illustrates the effectiveness of our model as a scalable and generalizable solution for real-world healthcare applications. Codes are available at: https://github.com/healthylaife/HyMaTE.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 16th ACM International Conference on Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, and Health Informatics (BCB), 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyMaTE，一种混合 Mamba 和 Transformer 的模型，用于电子健康记录（EHR）表征学习。该模型结合状态空间模型（SSM）的线性时间序列建模能力和注意力机制的通道交互能力，旨在处理 EHR 数据的长序列、稀疏性和缺失值问题。在多个临床数据集上的预测任务中，模型展现了更丰富的统一表征，并通过自注意力机制提供了可解释性。
Motivation: EHR 数据具有长序列、多变量、稀疏和缺失值等特点，传统 Transformer 模型二次计算复杂度和有限上下文长度限制了效率，而纯 SSM 模型主要关注序列级信息而忽略通道级信息。需要一种能够同时高效处理序列和通道信息的模型。
Method: 提出 HyMaTE，一种混合架构，结合 Mamba（SSM）的线性时间建模和 Transformer 的自注意力机制，分别处理序列级和通道级信息，形成统一的 EHR 表征。
Result: 在多个临床数据集上的预测任务中，HyMaTE 能够捕捉更丰富、更细致的 EHR 统一表征，且自注意力机制提供了可解释性。
Conclusion: HyMaTE 作为可扩展且通用的解决方案，适用于真实世界的医疗应用，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MOCHA: Multi-modal Objects-aware Cross-arcHitecture Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Personalized object detection aims to adapt a general-purpose detector to recognize user-specific instances from only a few examples. Lightweight models often struggle in this setting due to their weak semantic priors, while large vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong object-level understanding but are too computationally demanding for real-time or on-device applications. We introduce MOCHA (Multi-modal Objects-aware Cross-arcHitecture Alignment), a distillation framework that transfers multimodal region-level knowledge from a frozen VLM teacher into a lightweight vision-only detector. MOCHA extracts fused visual and textual teacher's embeddings and uses them to guide student training through a dual-objective loss that enforces accurate local alignment and global relational consistency across regions. This process enables efficient transfer of semantics without the need for teacher modifications or textual input at inference. MOCHA consistently outperforms prior baselines across four personalized detection benchmarks under strict few-shot regimes, yielding a +10.1 average improvement, with minimal inference cost.
papers.comment: 18 pages main paper, 10 pages supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MOCHA框架，通过知识蒸馏将冻结的多模态VLM（视觉-语言模型）的区域级知识转移到轻量级纯视觉检测器，实现个性化目标检测。在四个少样本检测基准上，平均性能提升+10.1%，且推理代价极小。
Motivation: 轻量级目标检测模型因语义先验弱，在少样本个性化检测中表现不佳；大VLM虽具备强对象理解能力，但计算开销大，无法用于实时或端侧部署。
Method: 提出跨架构对齐蒸馏框架，从冻结VLM教师提取融合视觉和文本的区域嵌入，并通过双重损失（局部对齐与全局关系一致性）指导学生网络训练。推理时无需文本输入。
Result: 在四个个性化检测基准的严格少样本设置下，平均提升+10.1%，且推理成本极低。
Conclusion: 该方法无需修改教师模型或推理时提供文本，即可高效迁移语义知识，适用于轻量级实时检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VoltanaLLM: Energy-Efficient and SLO-Aware Disaggregated LLM Serving via Adaptive Frequency Control and State-Space Routing
papers.abstract_en: The energy cost of Large Language Model (LLM) inference is rapidly becoming a barrier to sustainable and scalable deployment. Although modern serving architectures expose distinct prefill and decode behaviors, existing systems fail to exploit these phase differences for energy-efficient serving under strict latency SLOs. This paper introduces VoltanaLLM, the first system that explicitly targets and reduces the energy bloat in modern prefill-decode (P/D) disaggregated LLM serving. Guided by a control-theory perspective, VoltanaLLM separates two levers: per-instance operating-point selection (GPU frequency per iteration) and system-level state-space routing of requests. We empirically observe that LLM inference exhibits a U-shaped energy-frequency curve creating "sweet spots" that depend on phase behavior and load. VoltanaLLM exploits this by combining phase-specific, iteration-level frequency selection driven by a lightweight, online-adaptive latency predictor, with a decode state-space guided router that avoids architectural granularity-induced inefficiencies, all while meeting desired SLOs. We implement VoltanaLLM using SGLang and evaluate it across multiple models and real-world workloads. Our results show VoltanaLLM reduces end-to-end energy by up to 36.3% versus a static max-frequency baseline while maintaining high SLO attainment, and generalizes to newer GPUs. These results point to sustainable LLM serving via phase-aware, iteration-level frequency selection coupled with architecture-aware routing. Source code is available in https://github.com/Supercomputing-System-AI-Lab/VoltanaLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VoltanaLLM，首个针对prefill-decode分离LLM服务中能源浪费的系统。通过控制理论视角，分离每实例操作点选择（GPU频率每迭代）和系统级状态空间路由，利用LLM推理的U型能量-频率曲线实现节能。在多个模型和真实工作负载上，相比静态最大频率基线，端到端能耗降低高达36.3%，同时维持高SLO达标率，且可推广到新GPU。
Motivation: LLM推理能耗成为可持续部署和扩展的障碍，现有系统未利用prefill和decode阶段的相位差异来节能，导致能源浪费。
Method: 采用控制理论视角，分离两个杠杆：每实例操作点选择（GPU频率每迭代）和系统级请求状态空间路由。通过轻量级在线自适应延迟预测器驱动相位特定、迭代级频率选择，并结合解码状态空间导向路由器，避免架构粒度导致的低效，同时满足SLO。
Result: 在多个模型和真实工作负载上，VoltanaLLM相比静态最大频率基线降低端到端能耗高达36.3%，同时保持高SLO达标率，并可推广到新GPU。
Conclusion: 通过相位感知的迭代级频率选择和架构感知路由，可实现可持续的LLM服务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Breaking the Mirror: Activation-Based Mitigation of Self-Preference in LLM Evaluators
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as automated evaluators, yet they suffer from "self-preference bias": a tendency to favor their own outputs over those of other models. This bias undermines fairness and reliability in evaluation pipelines, particularly for tasks like preference tuning and model routing. We investigate whether lightweight steering vectors can mitigate this problem at inference time without retraining. We introduce a curated dataset that distinguishes self-preference bias into justified examples of self-preference and unjustified examples of self-preference, and we construct steering vectors using two methods: Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) and an optimization-based approach. Our results show that steering vectors can reduce unjustified self-preference bias by up to 97\%, substantially outperforming prompting and direct preference optimization baselines. Yet steering vectors are unstable on legitimate self-preference and unbiased agreement, implying self-preference spans multiple or nonlinear directions. This underscores both their promise and limits as safeguards for LLM-as-judges and motivates more robust interventions.
papers.comment: Presented at {Mechanistic Interpretability, Evaluations, Reliable-ML} Workshops, NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型作为自动评估者时的“自我偏好偏差”，即倾向于偏爱自身输出而非其他模型输出。作者构建了一个区分合理和不合理自我偏好的数据集，并使用对比激活添加（CAA）和优化方法构建轻量级引导向量（steering vectors），在推理时无需重训练即可缓解此偏差。结果表明，引导向量可将不合理自我偏好降低高达97%，优于提示工程和直接偏好优化基线，但在合理自我偏好和无偏见一致场景下不稳定，表明自我偏好涉及多个或非线性方向。
Motivation: LLM作为自动评估者存在自我偏好偏差，影响评估的公平性和可靠性，特别是在偏好调整和模型路由等任务中。现有方法如重训练成本高，需轻量级推理时干预。
Method: 构建区分合理与不合理自我偏好的数据集；采用对比激活添加（CAA）和优化方法构造引导向量，在推理时通过激活干预减少不合理自我偏好。
Result: 引导向量将不合理自我偏好降低高达97%，显著优于提示工程和直接偏好优化基线；但在合理自我偏好和无偏见一致场景下不稳定。
Conclusion: 引导向量展示了作为LLM评估者安全机制的前景和局限性，自我偏好可能涉及多个或非线性方向，需要更鲁棒的干预方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rule2Text: A Framework for Generating and Evaluating Natural Language Explanations of Knowledge Graph Rules
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graphs (KGs) can be enhanced through rule mining; however, the resulting logical rules are often difficult for humans to interpret due to their inherent complexity and the idiosyncratic labeling conventions of individual KGs. This work presents Rule2Text, a comprehensive framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to generate natural language explanations for mined logical rules, thereby improving KG accessibility and usability. We conduct extensive experiments using multiple datasets, including Freebase variants (FB-CVT-REV, FB+CVT-REV, and FB15k-237) as well as the ogbl-biokg dataset, with rules mined using AMIE 3.5.1. We systematically evaluate several LLMs across a comprehensive range of prompting strategies, including zero-shot, few-shot, variable type incorporation, and Chain-of-Thought reasoning. To systematically assess models' performance, we conduct a human evaluation of generated explanations on correctness and clarity. To address evaluation scalability, we develop and validate an LLM-as-a-judge framework that demonstrates strong agreement with human evaluators. Leveraging the best-performing model (Gemini 2.0 Flash), LLM judge, and human-in-the-loop feedback, we construct high-quality ground truth datasets, which we use to fine-tune the open-source Zephyr model. Our results demonstrate significant improvements in explanation quality after fine-tuning, with particularly strong gains in the domain-specific dataset. Additionally, we integrate a type inference module to support KGs lacking explicit type information. All code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/idirlab/KGRule2NL.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Rule2Text 是一个利用大语言模型 (LLM) 将知识图谱挖掘出的逻辑规则自动翻译为自然语言解释的框架。在多个知识图谱数据集 (FB-CVT-REV, FB+CVT-REV, FB15k-237, ogbl-biokg) 上，使用 AMIE 3.5.1 挖掘规则，并通过人类评估和 LLM-as-a-judge 框架系统评估了解释的正确性与清晰度。通过微调开源模型 Zephyr，在领域特定数据集上取得了显著改进。
Motivation: 知识图谱规则挖掘产生的逻辑规则因复杂性和图谱特有的标签约定而难以被人类理解，限制了知识图谱的可访问性和可用性。
Method: 提出 Rule2Text 框架，使用 LLM 生成规则的自然语言解释，系统评估多种提示策略 (零样本、少样本、变量类型引入、链式推理)，并开发了与人类评估高度一致的 LLM-as-a-judge 评估框架。基于最佳模型 (Gemini 2.0 Flash) 生成高质量真值数据集，用于微调开源 Zephyr 模型。
Result: 微调后的 Zephyr 模型在解释质量上显著提升，尤其在领域特定数据集上。LLM-as-a-judge 与人类评估者表现高度一致。
Conclusion: Rule2Text 能够有效提高知识图谱规则的可解释性，微调开源模型是提升领域特定规则解释质量的有效途径。框架还集成了类型推理模块以支持缺乏显式类型信息的知识图谱。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SLEEPING-DISCO 9M: A large-scale pre-training dataset for generative music modeling
papers.abstract_en: We present Sleeping-DISCO 9M, a large-scale pre-training dataset for music and song. To the best of our knowledge, there are no open-source high-quality dataset representing popular and well-known songs for generative music modeling tasks such as text-music, music-captioning, singing-voice synthesis, melody reconstruction and cross-model retrieval. Past contributions focused on isolated and constrained factors whose core perspective was to create synthetic or re-recorded music corpus (e.g. GTSinger, M4Singer) and arbitrarily large-scale audio datasets (e.g. DISCO-10M and LAIONDISCO-12M) had been another focus for the community. Unfortunately, adoption of these datasets has been below substantial in the generative music community as these datasets fail to reflect real-world music and its flavour. Our dataset changes this narrative and provides a dataset that is constructed using actual popular music and world-renowned artists.
papers.comment: The submitter is withdrawing this paper to correct an administrative error regarding submission authorship and institutional affiliation. A corrected version may be submitted by the primary authors in the future
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Sleeping-DISCO 9M，一个用于生成音乐建模的大规模预训练数据集，包含真实流行歌曲和知名艺术家作品。该数据集填补了高质量开源流行歌曲数据集的空白，旨在支持文本到音乐、音乐字幕、歌声合成、旋律重建和跨模态检索等任务。
Motivation: 现有开源音乐数据集要么是合成或重新录制的（如 GTSinger、M4Singer），要么是任意大规模音频（如 DISCO-10M、LAIONDISCO-12M），但未能反映真实流行音乐的风格，因此未被生成音乐社区广泛采用。
Method: 基于实际流行音乐和全球知名艺术家的作品构建数据集。
Result: 提供了 Sleeping-DISCO 9M 数据集，据称是首个反映真实流行音乐风味的高质量开源预训练数据集。
Conclusion: 该数据集有望改变生成音乐领域缺乏真实流行音乐数据的现状，促进相关任务的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graph Alignment for Benchmarking Graph Neural Networks and Learning Positional Encodings
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel benchmarking methodology for graph neural networks (GNNs) based on the graph alignment problem, a combinatorial optimization task that generalizes graph isomorphism by aligning two unlabeled graphs to maximize overlapping edges. We frame this problem as a self-supervised learning task and present several methods to generate graph alignment datasets using synthetic random graphs and real-world graph datasets from multiple domains. For a given graph dataset, we generate a family of graph alignment datasets with increasing difficulty, allowing us to rank the performance of various architectures. Our experiments prove that there is an optimal task difficulty for having a statistically relevant ranking of different models and that, even on a structure-only task, anisotropic models perform better compared to isotropic ones. To further prove that our synthetic task capture meaningful information, we show its effectiveness for self-supervised GNN pre-training: the learned node embeddings can be leveraged as positional encodings by transformers for graph regression or can be used to reconstruct the full structure of the graph with $98\%$ accuracy. To support reproducibility and further research, we provide an open-source Python package to generate graph alignment datasets and benchmark new GNN architectures. The source code is available at https://github.com/adrien-lagesse/graph-alignment-benchmark.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于图对齐问题的图神经网络（GNN）基准测试方法，该问题通过对齐两个未标记图以最大化重叠边来泛化图同构。作者将其构建为自监督学习任务，并利用合成随机图和多领域真实图数据集生成不同难度的图对齐数据集，从而对多种架构进行排序。实验证明存在最佳任务难度以使模型排名具有统计意义，并发现各向异性模型表现优于各向同性模型。此外，学习的节点嵌入可作为位置编码用于Transformer进行图回归，或用于以98%准确率重建图结构。
Motivation: 现有GNN基准测试缺乏标准化的结构感知任务来评估模型表达能力，且难以有效比较不同架构。图对齐问题提供了一个自然的、难度可控的基准，能更细致地衡量模型对图结构的理解能力。
Method: 将图对齐表述为自监督学习任务，生成合成随机图和真实图数据的对齐数据集，通过控制对齐难度（如节点数、噪声水平）创建多难度基准；利用该基准评估多种GNN架构，并验证自监督预训练的有效性。
Result: 实验发现存在最佳任务难度使模型排名具有统计显著性，各向异性模型优于各向同性模型；自监督学习的节点嵌入作为位置编码可提升图回归性能，并能以98%准确率重建图结构。
Conclusion: 图对齐基准是一种有效的GNN评估方法，可区分架构能力并支持自监督预训练；提供了开源Python包以促进可重复研究和新型架构测试。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Minimisation of Quasar-Convex Functions Using Random Zeroth-Order Oracles
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores the performance of a random Gaussian smoothing zeroth-order (ZO) scheme for minimising quasar-convex (QC) and strongly quasar-convex (SQC) functions in both unconstrained and constrained settings. For the unconstrained problem, we establish the ZO algorithm's convergence to a global minimum along with its complexity when applied to both QC and SQC functions. For the constrained problem, we introduce the new notion of proximal-quasar-convexity and prove analogous results to the unconstrained case. Specifically, we derive complexity bounds and prove convergence of the algorithm to a neighbourhood of a global minimum whose size can be controlled under a variance reduction scheme. Beyond the theoretical guarantees, we demonstrate the practical implications of our results on several machine learning problems where quasar-convexity naturally arises, including linear dynamical system identification and generalised linear models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机高斯平滑零阶优化方法在最小化拟凸函数（quasar-convex functions）和强拟凸函数上的性能。针对无约束问题，证明了算法收敛到全局最小值并给出复杂度；针对约束问题，引入近端拟凸性概念并得到类似结果。在方差缩减下，算法收敛到可控制大小的全局最小值邻域。在线性动力系统辨识和广义线性模型等机器学习问题上展示了实际效果。
Motivation: 拟凸函数在机器学习中自然出现（如线性动力系统辨识），但零阶优化针对这类函数的理论分析不足。
Method: 采用随机高斯平滑零阶方案，分别分析无约束与约束情形。对约束问题提出近端拟凸性新概念，并引入方差缩减策略。
Result: 理论上证明了算法收敛到全局最小值，给出了复杂度界；约束情形下算法收敛到能通过方差缩减控制大小的邻域。
Conclusion: 提供了拟凸函数零阶优化的理论保证，并在多个机器学习任务中验证了方法的实用价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Sparse Frontier: Sparse Attention Trade-offs in Transformer LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Sparse attention offers a promising strategy to extend long-context capabilities in Transformer LLMs, yet its efficiency-accuracy trade-offs remain unclear due to the lack of comprehensive evaluation. We address this gap with the largest-scale empirical analysis to date of training-free sparse attention, evaluating six methods across multiple model families and sizes, sequences up to 128K tokens, and sparsity levels up to 0.95 (i.e., $1/20$ attention budget) on nine diverse tasks. We first organise the rapidly evolving landscape of sparse attention methods into a taxonomy along four design axes. Our analysis then yields actionable insights: 1) sparse attention is effective: larger sparse models outperform smaller dense ones at equivalent cost, improving the Pareto frontier; 2) for the training-free methods we study, fine-grained per-query importance estimation during prefilling remains impractical-due to both the cost of estimation and the lack of sparse kernels that translate fine-grained sparsity into wall-clock gains-forcing a task-dependent choice between global-to-token and block-to-block selection. Instead, during decoding, token-to-page selection becomes feasible, enabling better generalisation and higher sparsity tolerance; 3) longer sequences tolerate higher sparsity, suggesting that fixed-budget methods in production are suboptimal. Together, these findings provide practical guidance for deploying sparse attention and methodological recommendations for future evaluations. Our code is available at https://github.com/PiotrNawrot/sparse-frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过大规模实证分析（涵盖6种方法、多个模型族、序列长度达128K、稀疏度达0.95），系统评估了训练无关的稀疏注意力在Transformer LLM中的效率-精度权衡。研究得出关键结论：1) 更大稀疏模型在等价成本下优于较小稠密模型；2) 训练无关方法中，预填充阶段细粒度逐查询重要性估计因成本与内核支持不足而不可行，解码阶段令牌到页面选择成为可行方案；3) 长序列容忍更高稀疏度，固定预算方法次优。
Motivation: 稀疏注意力有望扩展Transformer LLM的长上下文能力，但其效率-精度权衡因缺乏全面评估而不清晰。
Method: 对6种训练无关的稀疏注意力方法进行大规模实证分析，涵盖多个模型族和尺寸、序列长度达128K、稀疏度达0.95，并在9种多样任务上评估。
Result: 更大稀疏模型在等价成本下优于较小稠密模型；预填充阶段细粒度逐查询重要性估计不可行，解码阶段令牌到页面选择可行；长序列容忍更高稀疏度。
Conclusion: 这些发现为部署稀疏注意力提供了实用指导，并为未来评估提出了方法论建议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Robust Model-Based Approach for Continuous-Time Policy Evaluation with Unknown Lévy Process Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a model-based framework for continuous-time policy evaluation (CTPE) in reinforcement learning, incorporating both Brownian and Lévy noise to model stochastic dynamics influenced by rare and extreme events. Our approach formulates the policy evaluation problem as solving a partial integro-differential equation (PIDE) for the value function with unknown coefficients. A key challenge in this setting is accurately recovering the unknown coefficients in the stochastic dynamics, particularly when driven by Lévy processes with heavy tail effects. To address this, we propose a robust numerical approach that effectively handles both unbiased and censored trajectory datasets. This method combines maximum likelihood estimation with an iterative tail correction mechanism, improving the stability and accuracy of coefficient recovery. Additionally, we establish a theoretical bound for the policy evaluation error based on coefficient recovery error. Through numerical experiments, including a real-data BTC price experiment, we demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our method in recovering heavy-tailed Lévy dynamics and verify the theoretical error analysis in policy evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于模型的连续时间策略评估（CTPE）框架，同时考虑了布朗噪声和Lévy噪声，用于对由罕见和极端事件影响的随机动力学建模。作者将策略评估问题转化为求解带有未知系数的偏积分微分方程（PIDE），并提出一个结合最大似然估计和迭代尾校正机制的鲁棒数值方法，以提高系数恢复的稳定性和准确性。通过数值实验（包括比特币价格数据）验证了方法在恢复重尾Lévy动力学方面的有效性，并建立了基于系数恢复误差的策略评估误差的理论界。
Motivation: 现有连续时间策略评估方法通常假设布朗噪声，难以处理由Lévy过程驱动的重尾极端事件，且动力学系数未知。需要一种鲁棒的方法来恢复未知系数并准确评估策略。
Method: 提出基于模型的CTPE框架，将策略评估问题转化为求解PIDE。提出结合最大似然估计和迭代尾校正机制的数值方法，适用于无偏和有删失的轨迹数据集，以鲁棒地恢复未知系数。
Result: 通过数值实验（包括比特币价格数据）展示了方法在恢复重尾Lévy动力学方面的有效性和鲁棒性，并验证了基于系数恢复误差的策略评估误差理论界。
Conclusion: 本文建立的理论界和数值实验表明，所提方法能鲁棒地处理Lévy过程驱动的连续时间策略评估，对极端事件建模有应用价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Variational Tail Bounds for Norms of Random Vectors and Matrices
papers.abstract_en: We propose a variational tail bound for norms of random vectors and matrices under moment assumptions on their one-dimensional marginals. A simplified version of the bound that parametrizes the ``aggregating distribution'' using a certain pushforward of the Gaussian distribution is also provided. We apply the proposed method to reproduce some of the well-known bounds on norms of Gaussian random vectors, and also obtain dimension-free tail bounds for the Euclidean norm of random vectors with arbitrary moment profiles. Furthermore, we reproduce a dimension-free concentration inequality for sum of independent and identically distributed positive semidefinite matrices with sub-exponential marginals, and obtain a concentration inequality for the sample covariance matrix of sub-exponential random vectors. We also obtain a tail bound for the operator norm of a random matrix series whose random coefficients may have arbitrary moment profiles. Furthermore, we use coupling to formulate an abstraction of the proposed approach that applies more broadly. As a corollary, we derive a PAC-Bayesian-style bound in terms of a certain combination of the KL and Rényi divergences between the prior and posterior distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于矩条件的随机向量和矩阵范数的变分尾界方法，通过参数化“聚合分布”的高斯推前（pushforward）简化版本。方法可重现高斯随机向量范数的经典界，得到具有任意矩轮廓的随机向量欧几里得范数的维数无关尾界，并导出次指数随机向量样本协方差矩阵的浓度不等式、随机矩阵级数算子范数尾界。通过耦合抽象，进一步得到KL与Rényi散度组合的PAC-Bayesian型界。
Motivation: 现有基于矩条件的范数尾界往往依赖特定分布假设或维数依赖，缺乏统一变分框架。
Method: 提出变分尾界，利用高斯分布的推前（pushforward）参数化聚合分布，简化计算并扩展适用性；通过耦合抽象推广方法。
Result: 复现了高斯随机向量范数的已知界，获得欧几里得范数维数无关尾界、独立同分布次指数正半定矩阵和的浓度不等式、样本协方差矩阵浓度不等式，以及随机系数矩阵级数算子范数尾界；并导出KL与Rényi散度组合的PAC-Bayesian界。
Conclusion: 该变分尾界方法统一了多种随机结构下的矩条件尾界，为概率不等式提供了新工具，并可通过耦合进一步扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CrossFusion: A Multi-Scale Cross-Attention Convolutional Fusion Model for Cancer Survival Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Cancer survival prediction from whole slide images (WSIs) is a challenging task in computational pathology due to the large size, irregular shape, and high granularity of the WSIs. These characteristics make it difficult to capture the full spectrum of patterns, from subtle cellular abnormalities to complex tissue interactions, which are crucial for accurate prognosis. To address this, we propose CrossFusion, a novel multi-scale feature integration framework that extracts and fuses information from patches across different magnification levels. By effectively modeling both scale-specific patterns and their interactions, CrossFusion generates a rich feature set that enhances survival prediction accuracy. We validate our approach across six cancer types from public datasets, demonstrating significant improvements over existing state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, when coupled with domain-specific feature extraction backbones, our method shows further gains in prognostic performance compared to general-purpose backbones. The source code is available at: https://github.com/RustinS/CrossFusion

TL;DR: 本文提出CrossFusion，一种多尺度特征融合框架，用于从全切片图像(WSIs)中提取和融合不同放大倍数的补丁信息，以提升癌症生存预测准确性。在六种癌症类型上的实验表明，该方法显著优于现有方法，且结合领域特定的特征提取骨干网络可进一步改善预后性能。
Motivation: 全切片图像尺寸大、形状不规则、粒度高，现有方法难以同时捕捉从细微细胞异常到复杂组织交互的完整多尺度模式，限制了生存预测的准确性。
Method: CrossFusion通过多尺度交叉注意力机制对不同放大倍数的图像补丁进行特征提取与融合，生成富含尺度特定信息及尺度间交互的特征表示。
Result: 在六种公开癌症数据集上，该方法在生存预测指标上显著超越现有最先进方法；使用特定领域的特征提取骨干网络（如病理预训练模型）进一步提升了性能。
Conclusion: 多尺度特征融合与领域特征提取器相结合是提高WSI生存预测的有效途径，代码已开源。

papers.title: Impatient Bandits: Optimizing for the Long-Term Without Delay
papers.abstract_en: Increasingly, recommender systems are tasked with improving users' long-term satisfaction. In this context, we study a content exploration task, which we formalize as a bandit problem with delayed rewards. There is an apparent trade-off in choosing the learning signal: waiting for the full reward to become available might take several weeks, slowing the rate of learning, whereas using short-term proxy rewards reflects the actual long-term goal only imperfectly. First, we develop a predictive model of delayed rewards that incorporates all information obtained to date. Rewards as well as shorter-term surrogate outcomes are combined through a Bayesian filter to obtain a probabilistic belief. Second, we devise a bandit algorithm that quickly learns to identify content aligned with long-term success using this new predictive model. We prove a regret bound for our algorithm that depends on the Value of Progressive Feedback, an information-theoretic metric that captures the quality of short-term leading indicators that are observed prior to the long-term reward. We apply our approach to a podcast recommendation problem, where we seek to recommend shows that users engage with repeatedly over two months. We empirically validate that our approach significantly outperforms methods that optimize for short-term proxies or rely solely on delayed rewards, as demonstrated by an A/B test in a recommendation system that serves hundreds of millions of users.
papers.comment: To appear in Journal of Machine Learning (JMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对推荐系统优化长期满意度的问题，提出一种处理延迟奖励的强盗算法。通过贝叶斯滤波结合短期代理和长期奖励的预测模型，快速学习识别长期成功的内容。在播客推荐中显著优于基线方法。
Motivation: 推荐系统需要优化长期满意度，但延迟奖励（数周）与短期代理（不完美）之间存在权衡。现有方法难以平衡学习速度和准确性。
Method: 开发预测延迟奖励的模型，通过贝叶斯滤波整合所有信息（包括短期代理）得到概率信念。基于该模型设计强盗算法，并证明其遗憾界依赖于渐进反馈的价值（Value of Progressive Feedback）。
Result: 在播客推荐问题的A/B测试中（服务数亿用户），方法显著优于优化短期代理或仅依赖延迟奖励的方法。
Conclusion: 提出并验证了一种有效处理延迟奖励的强盗算法，利用短期代理信息加速学习长期目标，具有理论保证和实际效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predictive variational inference: Learn the predictively optimal posterior distribution
papers.abstract_en: Vanilla variational inference finds an optimal approximation to the Bayesian posterior distribution, but even the exact Bayesian posterior is often not meaningful under model misspecification. We propose predictive variational inference (PVI): a general inference framework that seeks and samples from an optimal posterior density such that the resulting posterior predictive distribution is as close to the true data generating process as possible, while this closeness is measured by multiple scoring rules. By optimizing the objective, the predictive variational inference is generally not the same as, or even attempting to approximate, the Bayesian posterior, even asymptotically. Rather, we interpret it as implicit hierarchical expansion. Further, the learned posterior uncertainty detects heterogeneity of parameters among the population, enabling automatic model diagnosis. This framework applies to both likelihood-exact and likelihood-free models. We demonstrate its application in real data examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出预测变分推断（PVI），一种新的贝叶斯推断框架，旨在找到使后验预测分布最接近真实数据生成过程的最优后验密度，通过多种评分规则度量接近程度。与标准变分推断不同，PVI不近似贝叶斯后验，而是隐含地实现层次扩展；其学到的后验不确定性能够检测参数的异质性，从而实现自动模型诊断。该方法适用于似然精确和似然自由模型，并在真实数据示例中展示应用。
Motivation: 标准贝叶斯后验在模型错误指定时往往不具有预测最优性，而现有变分推断仅近似后验，未直接优化预测性能。
Method: 提出预测变分推断（PVI），通过优化目标函数使后验预测分布与真实数据生成过程在多个评分规则下最接近，同时将学习到的后验不确定性解释为隐式层次扩展，并利用参数异质性进行模型诊断。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但表明该方法在真实数据示例中有效，并可作为统一框架适用于似然精确和似然自由模型。
Conclusion: PVI提供了一种通用推断框架，通过直接优化预测性能获得的后验不同于贝叶斯后验，并具备自动模型诊断能力，适用于模型错误指定场景。

papers.title: CORE-Bench: Fostering the Credibility of Published Research Through a Computational Reproducibility Agent Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: AI agents have the potential to aid users on a variety of consequential tasks, including conducting scientific research. To spur the development of useful agents, we need benchmarks that are challenging, but more crucially, directly correspond to real-world tasks of interest. This paper introduces such a benchmark, designed to measure the accuracy of AI agents in tackling a crucial yet surprisingly challenging aspect of scientific research: computational reproducibility. This task, fundamental to the scientific process, involves reproducing the results of a study using the provided code and data. We introduce CORE-Bench (Computational Reproducibility Agent Benchmark), a benchmark consisting of 270 tasks based on 90 scientific papers across three disciplines (computer science, social science, and medicine). Tasks in CORE-Bench consist of three difficulty levels and include both language-only and vision-language tasks. We provide an evaluation system to measure the accuracy of agents in a fast and parallelizable way, saving days of evaluation time for each run compared to a sequential implementation. We evaluated two baseline agents: the general-purpose AutoGPT and a task-specific agent called CORE-Agent. We tested both variants using two underlying language models: GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini. The best agent achieved an accuracy of 21% on the hardest task, showing the vast scope for improvement in automating routine scientific tasks. Having agents that can reproduce existing work is a necessary step towards building agents that can conduct novel research and could verify and improve the performance of other research agents. We hope that CORE-Bench can improve the state of reproducibility and spur the development of future research agents.
papers.comment: Benchmark harness and code available at http://github.com/siegelz/core-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORE-Bench 是一个用于评估 AI 代理在计算可重复性任务上准确性的基准，包含 270 个任务，涵盖计算机科学、社会科学和医学三个领域的 90 篇论文。任务分为三个难度级别，包括纯语言和视觉-语言任务。最佳代理在最难任务上的准确率仅为 21%，表明在该领域有很大的改进空间。
Motivation: AI 代理在辅助科学研究方面有潜力，但目前缺乏直接对应现实世界任务的基准。计算可重复性是科学过程的基础，但现有基准不足以衡量代理在此任务上的表现。
Method: 构建了 CORE-Bench 基准，包含基于 90 篇科学论文的 270 个任务，每个任务要求代理使用提供的代码和数据重现研究结果。提供了快速并行化的评估系统，并测试了 AutoGPT 和 CORE-Agent 两种基线代理，使用 GPT-4o 和 GPT-4o-mini 作为底层语言模型。
Result: 最佳代理（CORE-Agent + GPT-4o）在最难任务上的准确率为 21%，在整体任务上的准确率也未达到高水平，表明自动化可重复性任务仍需大幅改进。
Conclusion: CORE-Bench 可推动计算可重复性的改进，并促进未来研究代理的发展。代理能够复现现有工作是迈向自主进行新颖研究的关键步骤。

papers.title: Accelerated Stochastic Min-Max Optimization Based on Bias-corrected Momentum
papers.abstract_en: Lower-bound analyses for nonconvex strongly-concave minimax optimization problems have shown that stochastic first-order algorithms require at least $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$ sample complexity to find an $\varepsilon$-stationary point. Some works indicate that this complexity can be improved to $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ when the stochastic loss gradient is Lipschitz continuous. The question of achieving enhanced convergence rates under distinct conditions, remains open. In this work, we address this question for optimization problems that are nonconvex in the minimization variable and strongly concave or Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) in the maximization variable. We introduce novel bias-corrected momentum algorithms utilizing efficient Hessian-vector products. We establish convergence conditions and demonstrate a lower iteration complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ for the proposed algorithms. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated through applications to robust logistic regression and robust adaptive cruise control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非凸强凹（或PL条件）的极小极大优化问题，提出了一种基于偏差校正动量的随机一阶算法，通过高效的海森-向量积实现了O(ε^{-3})的迭代复杂度，并在鲁棒逻辑回归和鲁棒自适应巡航控制中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有下界分析指出随机一阶算法需要Ω(ε^{-4})样本复杂度，但在随机梯度Lipschitz连续时可改进至O(ε^{-3})；本文旨在针对更一般的非凸强凹情形实现该加速率。
Method: 引入偏差校正动量算法，结合高效的海森-向量积估计，推导出收敛条件并证明迭代复杂度为O(ε^{-3})。
Result: 理论分析表明算法达到ε-稳定点所需的迭代次数为O(ε^{-3})；实验在鲁棒逻辑回归和鲁棒自适应巡航控制任务上验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作为随机极小极大优化提供了加速的动量方法，但方法依赖海森-向量积计算；未来可探索更宽松条件下的扩展。

papers.title: Configurable Holography: Towards Display and Scene Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Rendering holograms for holographic displays is often an iterative and computationally costly process. Emerging learned holography methods have alleviated this bottleneck by enabling fast hologram rendering with improved reconstruction quality. However, existing methods still depend on fixed display hardware and scene parameters, requiring retraining for each new configuration. This limits rapid adaptation to different visual needs, including scene brightness, user focus preference, and hardware compatibility. We introduce Configurable Holography, a learned CGH framework in which a single model adapts to diverse display-scene parameters through explicit conditioning, eliminating the need for retraining. As a prototype, we present a configurable structure and derive a family of models that continuously adapt to propagation distance, volume depth, peak brightness, pixel pitch, and wavelength. To further improve efficiency, we incorporate auxiliary monocular depth estimation for depth-aware 3D hologram synthesis from RGB-only inputs and apply knowledge distillation for interactive inference. Our extensive simulation and hardware experiments on three holographic display prototypes with different combinations of configurations show on-par reconstruction quality with existing methods, offering up to 2x speed-up in fp32. Our work represents an initial step toward flexible, general-purpose learned holography systems that can seamlessly adapt across diverse hardware and user-specific visual requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种可配置的全息渲染框架 (Configurable Holography)，通过显式条件化使单个模型适应不同的显示硬件参数（如传播距离、像素间距、波长等）和场景参数（如亮度、深度），无需针对每种配置重新训练。原型模型结合辅助单目深度估计实现从RGB输入的深度感知3D全息图合成，并通过知识蒸馏加速推理。实验在三个不同配置的全息显示器上验证了与现有方法相当的图像质量，同时fp32推理速度提升2倍。
Motivation: 现有学习型全息渲染方法依赖于固定的显示硬件和场景参数，每次改变配置都需要重新训练，限制了快速适应不同视觉需求（如亮度、焦点偏好、硬件兼容性）的能力。
Method: 提出可配置的全息框架，通过显式条件化将显示和场景参数（传播距离、体积深度、峰值亮度、像素间距、波长）注入网络，从而用一个模型覆盖连续参数空间。同时引入辅助单目深度估计以支持仅RGB输入的深度感知3D全息合成，并采用知识蒸馏实现交互式推理速度。
Result: 在三个不同配置的全息显示原型上的仿真和硬件实验表明，该方法达到了与现有方法相当的再现质量，并在fp32精度下实现最高2倍的速度提升。
Conclusion: 该工作是迈向灵活、通用学习型全息系统的一步，能够无缝适应多样化的硬件和用户特定的视觉需求。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作是迈向灵活、通用学习型全息系统的一步，能够无缝适应多样化的硬件和用户特定的视觉需求。

papers.title: Full-resolution MLPs Empower Medical Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Dense prediction is a fundamental requirement for many medical vision tasks such as medical image restoration, registration, and segmentation. The most popular vision model, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), has reached bottlenecks due to the intrinsic locality of convolution operations. Recently, transformers have been widely adopted for dense prediction for their capability to capture long-range visual dependence. However, due to the high computational complexity and large memory consumption of self-attention operations, transformers are usually used at downsampled feature resolutions. Such usage cannot effectively leverage the tissue-level textural information available only at the full image resolution. This textural information is crucial for medical dense prediction as it can differentiate the subtle human anatomy in medical images. In this study, we hypothesize that Multi-layer Perceptrons (MLPs) are superior alternatives to transformers in medical dense prediction where tissue-level details dominate the performance, as MLPs enable long-range dependence at the full image resolution. To validate our hypothesis, we develop a full-resolution hierarchical MLP framework that uses MLPs beginning from the full image resolution. We evaluate this framework with various MLP blocks on a wide range of medical dense prediction tasks including restoration, registration, and segmentation. Extensive experiments on six public well-benchmarked datasets show that, by simply using MLPs at full resolution, our framework outperforms its CNN and transformer counterparts and achieves state-of-the-art performance on various medical dense prediction tasks.
papers.comment: The extended version is published as an IEEE-JBHI paper titled "Capturing Finer-grained Long-range Dependency for Dense Prediction in Medical Images: An Empirical Investigation of MLPs"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究医学图像密集预测任务，认为传统CNN和Transformer受限于卷积局部性或self-attention的高计算量而无法充分利用全分辨率下的组织级纹理信息。作者提出全分辨率分层MLP框架，从全分辨率开始使用MLP捕获长程依赖，在六项公共数据集上取得优于CNN和Transformer的性能。
Motivation: 现有Transformer因计算和内存限制通常在下采样分辨率上使用，无法利用全分辨率下的细微纹理信息，而医学密集预测需要区分细微解剖结构。
Method: 提出全分辨率分层MLP框架，从全图像分辨率开始使用MLP块逐层处理，无需下采样；框架可适配多种MLP块如Mixer、ResMLP等。
Result: 在医学图像恢复、配准和分割的六个公开基准上，该方法全面超越CNN和Transformer对应模型，达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 摘要指出在医学密集预测任务中，全分辨率MLP比Transformer更适合捕获组织级细节，为该方向提供了新思路。

papers.title: A Differentially Private Weighted Empirical Risk Minimization Procedure and its Application to Outcome Weighted Learning
papers.abstract_en: Data used to train predictive models via empirical risk minimization (ERM) often contain sensitive personal information. While differential privacy (DP) provides mathematically provable bounds to protect such data, previous work has focused almost exclusively on unweighted ERM. We consider weighted ERM (wERM) -- an important generalization where individual contributions to the objective function vary. We propose the first DP algorithm for general wERM with formal privacy guarantees and derive both its empirical and population excess risk bounds. Crucially, this general wERM framework provides a pathway for deriving privacy-preserving learning methods for individualized treatment rules, including the popular outcome-weighted learning (OWL) approach. We evaluate DP-wERM applied to OWL in simulated and real data experiments. Our empirical results demonstrate that training OWL models via wERM provides strong DP guarantees while maintaining robust performance, proving the method is practical for sensitive, real-world data.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, and 1 table for the main manuscript; 10 pages, 2 figures, and 1 table for the supplementary materials
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个为加权经验风险最小化 (wERM) 提供正式差分隐私 (DP) 保证的算法 DP-wERM，并将其应用于结果加权学习 (OWL) 以学习个性化治疗规则。摘要通过模拟和真实数据实验表明，该方法能在保持强隐私保证的同时维持稳健性能。
Motivation: 现有 DP 方法主要针对未加权的经验风险最小化 (ERM)，而许多实际应用（如个性化治疗规则学习）需要加权目标，其中个体贡献不同。
Method: 提出 DP-wERM 算法，通过向加权梯度添加噪声实现差分隐私，并推导了其经验风险和总体风险的上界。
Result: 在模拟和真实数据中，DP-wERM 应用于 OWL 时能提供强差分隐私保证，同时保持与未加权方法相当的稳健性能。
Conclusion: DP-wERM 是一种通用的差分隐私加权经验风险最小化框架，能够有效扩展到个性化治疗规则学习任务，适用于敏感数据场景。

papers.title: Subtyping patients with chronic disease using longitudinal BMI patterns
papers.abstract_en: Obesity is a major health problem, increasing the risk of various major chronic diseases, such as diabetes, cancer, and stroke. While the role of obesity identified by cross-sectional BMI recordings has been heavily studied, the role of BMI trajectories is much less explored. In this study, we use a machine-learning approach to subtype individuals' risk of developing 18 major chronic diseases by using their BMI trajectories extracted from a large and geographically diverse EHR dataset capturing the health status of around two million individuals for a period of six years. We define nine new interpretable and evidence-based variables based on the BMI trajectories to cluster the patients into subgroups using the k-means clustering method. We thoroughly review each cluster's characteristics in terms of demographic, socioeconomic, and physiological measurement variables to specify the distinct properties of the patients in the clusters. In our experiments, the direct relationship of obesity with diabetes, hypertension, Alzheimer's, and dementia has been re-established and distinct clusters with specific characteristics for several of the chronic diseases have been found to be conforming or complementary to the existing body of knowledge.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics, 27(4):2083-2093, 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用机器学习方法，从大型电子健康记录数据中提取体重指数（BMI）轨迹，用于对18种主要慢性疾病风险进行亚型分型。通过定义九个基于BMI轨迹的可解释变量，使用k-means聚类将患者分组，并分析各集群的人口学、社会经济和生理测量特征。
Motivation: 虽然横截面BMI与肥胖相关疾病的关系已被广泛研究，但BMI轨迹（随时间变化模式）对慢性病风险的作用尚未被充分探索。
Method: 从约200万个体六年的EHR数据中提取BMI轨迹，定义九个新的可解释变量，运用k-means聚类方法将患者分为亚组，并详细审查各集群特征。
Result: 重新确认了肥胖与糖尿病、高血压、阿尔茨海默病和痴呆症的直接关系，并发现了一些与现有知识一致或互补的特定慢性病集群。
Conclusion: 基于BMI轨迹的聚类可以揭示慢性病风险亚型，为个性化预防和治疗提供新视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Machine Learning Classification and Portfolio Construction: Does the Loss Function Matter?
papers.abstract_en: Classification outperforms regression across matched machine learning models in portfolio construction. A stacking ensemble of gradient boosted tree, random forest, and neural network yields a value-weighted annualized Sharpe ratio of 1.83 for classification and 1.11 for regression. This outperformance persists in multiclass settings, across subsamples, and after transaction costs. Spanning tests show that classification retains economically large alphas after we control for regression, whereas regression alphas shrink substantially once we control for classification. These results indicate that classification extracts more return information than matched regression. Our diagnostics trace classification's advantage to sharper and more precise separation of return deciles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较机器学习模型在投资组合构建中使用分类损失与回归损失的性能差异。研究发现，在多种模型（梯度提升树、随机森林、神经网络）中，分类任务均显著优于回归任务，例如集成模型的价值加权年化夏普比率分类为1.83，回归仅为1.11。这种优势在多分类设定、子样本和扣费后依然稳健，且通过跨期检验表明分类的alpha在控制回归后仍显著，而回归的alpha在控制分类后大幅缩小。诊断分析将分类的优势归因于其对收益十分位更清晰和更精确的分离。
Motivation: 现有研究多采用回归方法构建投资组合，但分类损失函数是否能够提取更多有效信息尚未得到系统验证。本文旨在比较匹配的机器学习模型在分类与回归设定下的投资组合表现。
Method: 采用梯度提升树、随机森林和神经网络三种模型，分别以分类（多类别标签）和回归（连续收益）作为学习目标，使用Stacking集成方法构建投资组合。通过夏普比率、跨期alpha检验和诊断分析（收益十分位分离精度）进行对比。
Result: 分类集成组合的年化夏普比率为1.83，显著高于回归的1.11；多分类、子样本和扣费后结果一致。跨期检验显示分类保留经济上较大的alpha，而回归alpha在控制分类后大幅缩小。
Conclusion: 在投资组合构建中，分类损失函数相比回归损失函数能提取更多收益相关信息，这一结论对模型选择和风险管理具有重要启示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JEDEL: Zero-Shot DNA-Encoded Library Design for Early-Stage Drug Discovery
papers.abstract_en: We present JEDEL, a framework for generating synthesis-ready DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) directly from three-dimensional pharmacophore representations of active ligands. JEDEL is the first model to map pharmacophore interaction patterns to actionable, scalable synthesis instructions, enabling the design of targeted libraries comprising potentially millions of molecules. Unlike existing generative approaches that produce virtual compounds requiring downstream synthesis planning, JEDEL operates within the space of purchasable building blocks and validated reactions, ensuring that every output is experimentally realizable by construction. JEDEL learns a predictive alignment between pharmacophore geometry and molecular structure and decodes this into combinatorial synthesis routes at scale. Across 18 protein targets, it generates focused libraries that outperform random and diversity-based baselines in predicted binding affinity, pharmacophore recovery, and sample efficiency, without target-specific retraining. JEDEL enables a shift from virtual molecule generation to experimentally deployable library design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JEDEL 框架，直接从活性配体的三维药效团表示生成可合成的 DNA 编码库（DELs）。JEDEL 是首个将药效团相互作用模式映射到可扩展合成指令的模型，通过操作可购买构建块和已验证反应，确保每个输出分子均可实验实现。在 18 个蛋白质靶标上，JEDEL 生成的聚焦库在预测结合亲和力、药效团恢复和样本效率方面优于随机和多样性基线的对照，无需针对性重新训练。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法通常生成虚拟化合物，需要后续合成规划，且难以保证实验可实现性。
Method: JEDEL 学习药效团几何与分子结构之间的预测对齐，并将其解码为组合合成路线，操作空间限于可购买构建块和已验证反应。
Result: 在 18 个蛋白质靶标上，JEDEL 生成的聚焦库在预测结合亲和力、药效团恢复和样本效率方面优于随机和多样性基线。
Conclusion: JEDEL 实现了从虚拟分子生成到可实验部署库设计的转变，无需目标特定重新训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Performance and Interpretability of Convolutional, Transformer, and Hybrid Deep Learning Models in Colorectal Histology Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has become an important tool in computational pathology, enabling automated analysis of histopathological images. While convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have traditionally dominated this field, transformer-based and hybrid architectures have recently demonstrated promising performance. However, comprehensive comparisons of these approaches for colorectal histopathology remain limited. This study evaluated twelve ImageNet-pretrained CNN, transformer, and hybrid architectures using the Kather colorectal histopathology dataset containing 5,000 image tiles from eight tissue classes. All models were trained using a standardized transfer-learning and fine-tuning protocol and assessed using multiple performance metrics, including accuracy, precision, sensitivity, specificity, F1-score, ROC-AUC, Cohen's kappa, and Matthews correlation coefficient. All evaluated models achieved high classification performance, with accuracies ranging from 93.2% to 97.1%. EVA-02 achieved the highest overall performance (97.1% accuracy, 97.0% F1-score), closely followed by ViT-B/16. Among CNNs, ResNet34 and ConvNeXt-Tiny demonstrated highly competitive performance, achieving accuracies of 96.4% and 96.3%, respectively. Transformer architectures generally produced the strongest results across evaluation metrics, although the performance gap between the best transformer and CNN models was relatively small. Per-class analysis showed consistently strong classification performance across all tissue categories, with Complex Stroma representing the most challenging class. Overall, transformer-based architectures achieved the highest predictive performance, whereas modern CNNs provided a favorable balance between accuracy and model complexity. These findings provide a comprehensive benchmark of major deep learning paradigms for colorectal histopathology classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究系统比较了12种ImageNet预训练的CNN、Transformer和混合架构在Kather结直肠组织学数据集上的分类性能。所有模型采用标准迁移学习与微调流程，准确率范围为93.2%至97.1%。EVA-02取得最佳结果（准确率97.1%，F1-score 97.0%），ViT-B/16紧随其后；Transformer整体最强，但与最佳CNN差距较小。现代CNN（如ResNet34、ConvNeXt-Tiny）在准确率与模型复杂度间取得良好平衡。
Motivation: 尽管卷积神经网络在结直肠病理学中占主导，但Transformer及混合架构的全面比较仍有限，缺乏标准化的基准。
Method: 使用Kather数据集（5000张图像，8个组织类别）评估12种架构（CNN、Transformer、混合），采用统一的ImageNet预训练、全模型微调及多种指标（准确率、F1、ROC-AUC等）。
Result: 所有模型准确率93.2%-97.1%；EVA-02最优（97.1%准确率，97.0% F1），CNN中ResNet34（96.4%）和ConvNeXt-Tiny（96.3%）表现突出；Complex Stroma类别最具挑战性。
Conclusion: Transformer架构预测性能最高，现代CNN提供了准确率与复杂度的良好平衡，该结果为结直肠组织学分类提供了全面基准。

summary_sections.motivation: 尽管卷积神经网络在结直肠病理学中占主导，但Transformer及混合架构的全面比较仍有限，缺乏标准化的基准。
summary_sections.method: 使用Kather数据集（5000张图像，8个组织类别）评估12种架构（CNN、Transformer、混合），采用统一的ImageNet预训练、全模型微调及多种指标（准确率、F1、ROC-AUC等）。
summary_sections.result: 所有模型准确率93.2%-97.1%；EVA-02最优（97.1%准确率，97.0% F1），CNN中ResNet34（96.4%）和ConvNeXt-Tiny（96.3%）表现突出；Complex Stroma类别最具挑战性。
summary_sections.conclusion: Transformer架构预测性能最高，现代CNN提供了准确率与复杂度的良好平衡，该结果为结直肠组织学分类提供了全面基准。

papers.title: Sol Video Inference Engine: Agent-Native Full-Stack Acceleration Framework for Efficient Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern video diffusion models achieve higher generation quality through scaling, but this also increases inference cost. Although many acceleration methods have been proposed, a central challenge is that the most effective acceleration strategy is highly instance-specific: a recipe that works well for one combination of model, hardware, and inference configuration often does not transfer to another. Different models vary in architecture, numerical sensitivity, and attention concentration patterns. Inference settings differ in spatial and temporal resolution and video duration, while hardware platforms differ in memory hierarchy, supported numerical formats, and kernel throughput. These factors create a large tuning space, making manual performance engineering costly. We present Sol Video Inference Engine, an agentic, native, training-free acceleration framework for video diffusion models. It organizes five broadly applicable techniques, cache, sparse attention, token pruning, quantization, and kernel fusion, into an agentic acceleration stack for instance-specific optimization. For a concrete deployment target defined by a model, hardware platform, and serving configuration, parallel skill agents optimize the implementation of each technique, an agent integrator composes them into a global acceleration stack, and a human validator provides feedback on generation quality. We instantiate this workflow on three video models with different sizes and architectures: 64B Cosmos3-Super, 22B LTX-2.3, and 2B SANA-Video. With little human effort, the full stack achieves more than 2x end-to-end acceleration while maintaining near-lossless VBench quality, demonstrating the effectiveness of the agent framework for video diffusion acceleration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Sol视频推理引擎，一个无需训练的视频扩散模型加速框架。该框架由多个智能体组成，针对具体模型、硬件和推理配置自动优化五种加速技术（缓存、稀疏注意力、token剪枝、量化、核融合）。在64B Cosmos3-Super、22B LTX-2.3和2B SANA-Video三个模型上实现超过2倍端到端加速，同时VBench质量几乎无损。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型规模扩大导致推理成本高，而最有效的加速策略高度依赖于具体的模型、硬件和推理配置组合，手动调优成本高。
Method: 提出基于智能体的加速框架，包含并行技能智能体（针对每种技术优化）、智能体集成器（组合成全局加速栈）和人类验证器（反馈生成质量）。自动为每个部署目标（模型、硬件、配置）生成优化方案。
Result: 在三个不同规模和架构的视频模型上，以极少人工干预实现超过2倍端到端加速，且保持VBench质量接近无损。
Conclusion: 该智能体加速框架能够自动为不同实例生成高效加速方案，在多个模型上验证了有效性和可迁移性。

papers.title: Low-power analogue neural networks with trainable nonlinear connections for continuous control
papers.abstract_en: Physical neural networks promise low-power machine learning by computing directly with analogue device physics, but most architectures force nonlinear device responses to act as scalar weights. Inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, we place trainable nonlinear functions on the connections, making each physical connection a learnable computational element. Realising these functions as analogue band-pass filters on field-programmable analogue arrays, we find that the benefit is task-dependent and follows from the smoothness of the physical basis: the networks represent smooth, continuously valued targets, including robotic kinematics, continuous control, and photovoltaic maximum-power-point tracking, with far fewer nodes and connections than multilayer perceptrons, but offer no parameter-efficiency advantage on classification-like decision boundaries. Trained networks transfer to hardware across approximately 35,000 connections with quantified fidelity, and a dedicated CMOS implementation is projected to operate at approximately 30 microwatts. A memristive realisation reproduces the same behaviour in simulation, indicating that the advantage comes from placing trainable nonlinearity on connections, rather than from a particular device.
papers.comment: Preprint. Further verification of all simulations is ongoing. Any resulting corrections will be incorporated in a revised version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的模拟神经网络架构，在连接上放置可训练非线性函数，使用现场可编程模拟阵列实现带通滤波器。实验表明，该方法在连续控制任务（如机器人运动学、光伏最大功率点跟踪）上能以更少的节点和连接达到良好性能，但在分类决策边界上没有参数效率优势。训练网络可转移到约35000个连接的硬件，专用CMOS实现功耗约30微瓦。
Motivation: 现有物理神经网络通常将非线性器件响应作为标量权重，限制了表达能力。本文受Kolmogorov-Arnold网络启发，将可训练非线性函数置于连接上，使每个物理连接成为可学习计算单元。
Method: 在模拟网络中，将可训练非线性函数实现为模拟带通滤波器，基于现场可编程模拟阵列。训练后网络可转移到硬件，并进行了CMOS和忆阻器实现评估。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在连续控制任务上以更少的节点和连接实现了良好性能，分类任务上无参数效率优势。硬件转移保真度量化，CMOS功耗约30微瓦。
Conclusion: 优势来源于将可训练非线性置于连接上，而非特定器件。
