papers.title: A Survey on Federated Causal Discovery and Inference
papers.abstract_en: Causal reasoning, which encompasses the discovery of causal structures and the inference of causal effects, is fundamental to data-driven decision making. In practice, data for reliable causal analysis are often distributed across institutions and cannot be centralized due to privacy regulations or communication constraints. Federated learning (FL) addresses this by enabling collaborative analysis without raw data sharing, giving rise to the rapidly growing field of federated causal discovery (FCD) and inference (FCI). However, the interdisciplinary nature of this field and the absence of a comprehensive survey present barriers to entry for researchers. This paper bridges that gap by providing a systematic review through multi-dimensional taxonomies. Grounded in the three core design decisions underlying any FCD solution, namely how structures are learned, how data are partitioned, and what structural knowledge each party obtains, we organize FCD along three axes: methodological paradigm, federation topology, and structural scope. We further examine key practical dimensions, including temporal dynamics, data heterogeneity, missing data, and non-identical variable sets. For FCI, we categorize methods by target estimand (average versus individualized/conditional treatment effects) and by estimation strategy, from classical weighting methods to modern deep generative architectures. Unlike prior works that treat FCD and FCI separately, we formalize their connection as complementary stages of a unified federated causal reasoning pipeline, where FCD supplies the structural knowledge required for valid effect estimation in FCI. Finally, we highlight their shared concerns regarding privacy, communication efficiency, theoretical guarantees, and application domains, and conclude by identifying open challenges for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了联邦因果发现（FCD）与联邦因果推理（FCI）领域，通过多维分类法从方法论范式、联邦拓扑、结构范围三个轴组织FCD，并讨论时间动态、数据异质性、缺失数据等实际维度。对于FCI，按目标估计量（平均/个体处理效应）和估计策略（经典加权到深度生成架构）分类。论文强调FCD与FCI是统一因果推理流程的互补阶段，并指出隐私、通信效率、理论保证与开放挑战。
Motivation: 联邦因果发现与推理领域跨学科性强，缺乏全面综述，阻碍研究者进入。本文旨在填补该空白。
Method: 构建三维分类法（方法论范式、联邦拓扑、结构范围）组织FCD；对FCI按目标估计量与估计策略分类；整合实际维度（时间动态、数据异质性、缺失数据、非相同变量集）；形式化FCD与FCI的互补关系。
Result: 未报告新实验结果，提供系统化的综述框架与分类体系。
Conclusion: FCD与FCI是统一因果推理管道的互补阶段，FCD提供FCI所需的结构知识；指出隐私、通信效率、理论保证及应用领域的开放挑战。

papers.title: Weight-Space Geometry of Offline Reasoning Training
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement-learning losses (RFT, RIFT, DFT, Offline GRPO, DPO) are widely used to distill reasoning from large teachers into smaller students, and are typically compared on downstream accuracy alone. We ask whether they are mechanistically distinct or converge to a similar weight update. Training six methods (SFT, RFT, DFT, RIFT, Offline GRPO, DPO) on identical math rollouts from a single base model (Qwen3-4B) with attention-only LoRA, we analyze the resulting deltas via cosine similarity, principal-angle subspace analysis, linear mode connectivity, and CKA. We observe: (i) SFT, RFT, and RIFT have nearly colinear weight deltas (cosine >= 0.97, top-1 principal angle ~7 deg median over 144 modules) and comparable GSM8K accuracy (87-88%, n=1319; pairwise McNemar p >= 0.15); (ii) DFT diverges further in direction than any reward-weighted method despite using the same data; (iii) Offline GRPO adds a substantial component orthogonal to the SFT direction (~67% globally, up to ~86% in late layers) while staying in the SFT loss basin; (iv) DPO sits in a near-orthogonal subspace, shows a mode-connectivity barrier, and collapses late-layer CKA to ~0.46. DPO also reaches the highest accuracy in our protocol on both GSM8K (93.5%, McNemar p < 10^-9 vs. each other method) and AIME26 (30.0% vs. 3.3-10.0%); its training uses a 10x smaller learning rate than the others (the standard convention), so the update-norm and accuracy gaps reflect loss-function and optimizer choices jointly, and a learning-rate-matched DPO comparison is left for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过余弦相似度、主角度子空间分析、线性模式连接和CKA等方法，研究了六种离线推理训练方法（SFT、RFT、RIFT、DFT、Offline GRPO、DPO）在数学任务上的权重更新几何特性。发现SFT、RFT和RIFT的权重增量几乎共线（cosine ≥ 0.97），DPO则处于近正交子空间，并达到最高准确率（GSM8K 93.5%，AIME26 30.0%），但使用了比其他方法小10倍的学习率。
Motivation: 现有离线推理训练方法通常只通过下游准确率进行比较，但缺乏对它们机制差异性的理解。作者希望探究这些方法在权重空间中的几何关系，判断它们是否收敛到相似的权重更新或存在结构差异。
Method: 在Qwen3-4B基础模型上使用attention-only LoRA，对相同数学rollout数据分别训练SFT、RFT、RIFT、DFT、Offline GRPO和DPO。通过余弦相似度、主角度子空间分析、线性模式连接和CKA分析权重增量（deltas）的几何性质。
Result: SFT、RFT和RIFT的权重增量几乎共线（cosine ≥ 0.97，中位主角度约7度），GSM8K准确率相近（87-88%）；DFT方向偏离更大；Offline GRPO包含正交于SFT方向的分量（全局约67%，后期层达86%）但仍位于SFT损失盆地；DPO处于近正交子空间，存在模式连接障碍，后期层CKA降至0.46，但达到最高准确率（GSM8K 93.5%，对每种其他方法McNemar p < 10^-9；AIME26 30.0% vs 3.3-10.0%）。
Conclusion: DPO的高准确率部分源于更小的学习率（与其他方法相比为1/10），因此准确率差距反映了损失函数和优化器选择的共同影响。作者指出学习率匹配的DPO比较留待未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Systematic Exploration of 4-Expert Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts via Automated Pipeline Search
papers.abstract_en: We present an automated large-scale search pipeline for heterogeneous 4-Expert Mixture-of-Experts (MoE4) architectures within the LEMUR neural network dataset ecosystem. Building on a hand-crafted heterogeneous MoE reference model, we replace manual design with a deterministic code-assembly generator that systematically combines base architecture families drawn from the LEMUR database into MoE4 ensembles, each governed by a convolutional gating network with temperature scaling, mixup augmentation, and cosine-annealed learning rate scheduling. Over a 28-day campaign on an NVIDIA RTX 4090, the pipeline generated 4,463 candidate models across 197 batches, of which 1,021 were evaluated successfully. A critical finding emerged from the campaign: due to alphabetical enumeration via itertools.combinations, the entire explored search space (4.8% of the theoretical 23,751 possible 4-family combinations) is anchored to a single family, AirNet. We characterise this coverage bias precisely, identify the root cause in the generator, and propose a stratified random sampling fix. Within the AirNet anchored scope, ShuffleNet and MobileNetV3 consistently co-produce the highest-accuracy ensembles (mean accuracy up to 0.632), while FractalNet and MNASNet are identified as low-yield families warranting exclusion in future campaigns. The pipeline, analysis artefacts, and corrected generator are released as part of the open-source NNGPT project at https://github.com/ABrain-One/nn-gpt
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自动化大规模搜索管道，用于在LEMUR神经网络数据集生态系统中搜索异构4专家混合专家模型（MoE4）。该管道基于确定性代码组装生成器，结合卷积门控网络、温度缩放、mixup数据增强和余弦退火学习率调度。在NVIDIA RTX 4090上进行了28天的搜索，生成了4463个候选模型，其中1021个成功评估。发现由于字母顺序枚举，搜索空间仅覆盖了理论组合的4.8%，且锚定于AirNet家族。在AirNet锚定范围内，ShuffleNet和MobileNetV3组成的高准确率集成模型平均准确率达0.632，而FractalNet和MNASNet被认为是低产家族。管道和分析工具已开源。
Motivation: 手动设计异构MoE架构耗时且可能忽略潜在有效组合，需要自动化搜索方法来系统探索并发现高性能的MoE集成架构。
Method: 提出一个自动化流水线，使用确定性代码组装生成器，从LEMUR数据库中选择基架构家族，组合成4专家MoE集成，每个集成由卷积门控网络控制，并辅以温度缩放、mixup增强和余弦退火学习率调度。
Result: 在28天搜索中，评估了1021个模型；发现搜索空间仅覆盖理论组合的4.8%，且锚定于AirNet；ShuffleNet和MobileNetV3组合平均准确率最高达0.632；FractalNet和MNASNet表现低效。
Conclusion: 自动化搜索管道能够有效探索异构MoE架构，但需注意搜索空间偏差；建议采用分层随机采样修正；低效家族应被排除。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动化大规模搜索管道，用于在LEMUR神经网络数据集生态系统中搜索异构4专家混合专家模型（MoE4）。该管道基于确定性代码组装生成器，结合卷积门控网络、温度缩放、mixup数据增强和余弦退火学习率调度。在NVIDIA RTX 4090上进行了28天的搜索，生成了4463个候选模型，其中1021个成功评估。发现由于字母顺序枚举，搜索空间仅覆盖了理论组合的4.8%，且锚定于AirNet家族。在AirNet锚定范围内，ShuffleNet和MobileNetV3组成的高准确率集成模型平均准确率达0.632，而FractalNet和MNASNet被认为是低产家族。管道和分析工具已开源。

summary_sections.method: 提出一个自动化流水线，使用确定性代码组装生成器，从LEMUR数据库中选择基架构家族，组合成4专家MoE集成，每个集成由卷积门控网络控制，并辅以温度缩放、mixup增强和余弦退火学习率调度。
summary_sections.result: 在28天搜索中，评估了1021个模型；发现搜索空间仅覆盖理论组合的4.8%，且锚定于AirNet；ShuffleNet和MobileNetV3组合平均准确率最高达0.632；FractalNet和MNASNet表现低效。

papers.title: Computational references are not experiments: pre-registered validation of machine-learned sodium-cathode voltages
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning screens for battery materials are trained and judged almost entirely against computed reference voltages, and those references carry their own systematic errors. We report a case in which this matters quantitatively: our own screening stack (a graph-network voltage screen, a prior-art triage layer, and a local PBE+U bench) fails pre-registered validation against experiment-anchored literature values. Verdict thresholds, failure modes, and the primary metric were committed before analysis. On an operator-audited set of known Na-ion cathodes (n = 6 after one documented exclusion; verdict unchanged at n = 7), the raw held-out mean absolute error was 0.67 V, the pre-registered conservative metric, the upper 95% confidence bound of the cross-validated bias-corrected error, was 1.09 V, and the residual was strongly voltage-dependent (r = -0.94), so no additive calibration is valid. On the two compounds where prediction, database reference, and experiment could all be compared, the Materials Project PBE+U reference sat about 0.54 V below measurement: the reference, not the model, dominated the error. A prior-art screen found at least 70% of the targeted Na substitution space already published. We retire the screen, bound what "verified" means for our DFT ledger, and pre-register a calibration audit of it against four benchmark Li couples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一项预先注册的验证实验，表明机器学习筛选电池材料时，常用的计算参考电压（如PBE+U）本身存在系统误差，导致模型预测偏离实验值。作者发现其图网络电压筛选堆栈在已知钠离子阴极上的误差主要由参考数据而非模型引起，且残差与电压强相关，无法通过加性校准修正。最终作者退役该筛选流程，并提议预先注册针对锂对的校准审计。
Motivation: 机器学习电池材料筛选通常基于计算参考电压进行训练和评估，但这些计算参考本身携带系统误差，其影响未被充分量化。本文通过预先注册的验证实验，量化这种误差对模型验证的影响。
Method: 采用预先注册的验证流程，使用图网络电压筛选、先前技术分诊层和局部PBE+U基准组成的堆栈，在操作员审计的已知钠离子阴极集上进行测试。主要指标是交叉验证偏差校正误差的95%置信上限。
Result: 在n=6（排除一个后）的验证集上，原始保留MAE为0.67 V，保守上界为1.09 V；残差与电压强相关（r=-0.94）。在两种可比较的化合物上，Materials Project PBE+U参考比实验测量值低约0.54 V，说明参考数据主导了误差。
Conclusion: 计算参考电压本身可能成为机器学习模型验证中的主要误差来源，简单的加性校准无效。作者建议对DFT参考数据进行校准审计，并预先注册此类验证。

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Runtime Verification and Model-Based Diagnosis in LOLA
papers.abstract_en: We present an integrated framework that unifies runtime verification and model-based diagnosis within the stream specification language LOLA. By encoding system descriptions, component health states, and observations into a single stream-based formalism, the approach enables continuous, online fault localization directly alongside fault detection, without requiring separate toolchains. The framework supports both time-invariant and transient faults, and naturally accommodates nondeterministic observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将运行时验证和基于模型的诊断集成到流规范语言LOLA中，支持连续在线故障定位与检测。
Motivation: 现有运行时验证和模型诊断依赖分离的工具链，缺乏统一的连续故障定位方法。
Method: 将系统描述、组件健康状态和观测编码为基于流的单一形式体系，在LOLA中实现。
Result: 同时支持时间不变和瞬态故障，自然适应非确定性观测。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论限制，但框架统一了两种方法。

papers.title: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Approach for Melt Pool Prediction in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) is a promising additive manufacturing technique that suffers from quality assurance concerns. Predicting melt pools from process parameters is crucial for assessing quality prior to manufacturing but remains a difficult problem because of the complex physical processes underlying LPBF. Quantum computers present a new computing paradigm, providing a new approach to information processing using quantum entanglement and superposition. This paper presents a practical demonstration of a hybrid quantum-classical model that leverages quantum computing to improve process parameter feature extraction with a quantum feature encoder. To make the quantum approach computationally feasible for large datasets, we first employ a clustering algorithm to reduce the number of expensive quantum computations. These quantum features are then processed by a classical neural network to predict the melt pool morphology, allowing for more accurate predictions of melt pools. We demonstrate the method using a quantum simulator, analyze the effect of measurement shot noise on the predictive performance of the network, and verify the results using quantum hardware. Finally, by examining which quantum features are most important, we provide insights that can inform the future design of more effective quantum encoding circuits. Ultimately, the performance improvement over purely classical networks validates the hybrid approach, demonstrating an engineering application of quantum computing using noisy and intermediate scale quantum (NISQ) devices.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, to be presented at the ASME IDETC/CIE 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合量子-经典方法用于激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）过程中的熔池形态预测。该方法先使用聚类算法减少量子计算量，再通过量子特征编码器提取特征，最后由经典神经网络预测熔池形态。在量子模拟器和硬件上的实验表明，该方法优于纯经典网络，展示了NISQ设备在工程中的应用潜力。
Motivation: LPBF的质量保证因熔池预测困难而受影响，传统方法难以捕捉复杂物理过程。量子计算提供新范式，但直接应用在大数据集上计算开销大，需要混合策略。
Method: 采用混合量子-经典架构：首先用聚类算法对大量过程参数进行分组，减少昂贵量子计算的次数；然后用量子特征编码器提取量子特征；最后通过经典神经网络预测熔池形态。研究还分析了测量shot噪声对预测性能的影响，并验证了量子硬件上的结果。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在熔池形态预测上性能优于纯经典网络，量子模拟器和硬件均验证了有效性。通过分析量子特征重要性，为设计更有效的量子编码电路提供了见解。
Conclusion: 混合量子-经典方法在LPBF熔池预测中有效，展示了NISQ设备的实际工程应用。未来可基于特征重要性分析优化量子编码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dimensionality Reduction of QAOA Parameter Space with Kernel PCA for Max-Cut
papers.abstract_en: The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) is a leading variational algorithm for combinatorial optimization on near term quantum devices. As circuit depth increases, the number of optimization parameters grows, making the search landscape increasingly nonlinear and difficult to optimize. Previous studies have shown that optimal QAOA parameters often lie on a low dimensional manifold that can be approximated using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) at shallow circuit depths. However, the effectiveness of PCA decreases at higher depths because the underlying parameter manifold becomes increasingly nonlinear. In this work, we investigate Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) with a radial basis function kernel as a nonlinear dimensionality reduction technique for QAOA parameter optimization. The model is trained using 200 graphs from each of 3 graph families, namely Erdos-Renyi, Barabasi-Albert, and Watts-Strogatz, with graph sizes ranging from 7 to 10 nodes. Performance is evaluated on 30 test graphs containing 12 nodes at circuit depths 1, 2, 4, and 8. Experimental results demonstrate that KPCA consistently outperforms PCA at deeper circuit depths across all graph families. At depth 8, KPCA achieves approximation ratios above 0.86, while PCA declines to approximately 0.81 to 0.83. Both methods reduce the number of quantum circuit evaluations by more than 93 percent relative to unrestricted QAOA optimization. These findings suggest that nonlinear kernel methods more effectively capture the structure of the QAOA parameter manifold and provide a practical approach for scaling variational quantum optimization to deeper circuits.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, submitted to IEEE Quantum Week Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用核主成分分析（KPCA）对量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的参数空间进行非线性降维，用于解决Max-Cut问题。在3种图族（Erdos-Renyi、Barabasi-Albert、Watts-Strogatz）上训练，测试12节点图。实验表明，在电路深度为8时，KPCA的近似比超过0.86，优于PCA的0.81-0.83，同时减少93%以上的量子电路评估次数。
Motivation: QAOA电路深度增加导致参数空间高度非线性，主成分分析（PCA）降维效果下降，需要更有效的非线性降维方法。
Method: 采用径向基函数核的核主成分分析（KPCA）进行非线性降维，在200个7-10节点图上训练，并在30个12节点图上测试深度1、2、4、8的性能。
Result: 深度8时，KPCA近似比>0.86，PCA约0.81-0.83；两者均减少93%以上的量子电路评估。
Conclusion: 非线性核方法能更有效捕捉QAOA参数流形结构，为变分量子优化扩展到更深电路提供实用方案。

papers.title: Legal Reasoning Is Not Lawyering: Rethinking Legal Benchmarks for Pro Se Access to Justice
papers.abstract_en: Legal AI benchmark research frequently invokes the assumption that large language models can improve access to justice, including for people who cannot access lawyers in order to understand and exercise their legal rights. We argue that current benchmarks are not equipped to support this assumption because they evaluate legal reasoning over inputs that have already been preprocessed by legal experts, which measures the upper bound of model performance. Access to justice depends on a lower bound: how models perform when inputs come from pro se litigants, whose prompts may contain noisy narratives, buried facts, omissions, folk-legal assumptions, and surface-level errors. These degradations are comparable to conditions under which LLMs are known to degrade in the general machine learning literature, including long-context sensitivity, underspecification, hallucination, and typographical perturbations. We connect evidence from pro se literature with this body of machine learning research and present a small perturbation experiment on LEXam, a legal benchmark, to illustrate the gap between these two bounds. If model development continues to focus on benchmarks that measure only the upper bound, this gap may remain hidden or even widen. We conclude by calling for legal benchmarks that directly measure robustness under pro se-like inputs so that access-to-justice claims about legal AI can become empirically testable.
papers.comment: Both authors contributed equally. Accepted to the AI4Law Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批评当前法律AI基准测试仅评估专家预处理后的输入，认为这忽略了自诉人（pro se litigants）实际输入的噪声和错误，从而高估了模型在司法可及性方面的表现。通过扰动实验，作者展示了LLM在自诉人输入下的性能下降，呼吁开发面向自诉人输入的鲁棒性基准。
Motivation: 现有法律基准假设输入由法律专家预处理，导致模型性能上限被测量，而忽视自诉人输入中的噪声、遗漏和错误，这与“改善司法可及性”的初衷相悖。
Method: 连接自诉人文献与机器学习文献（如长上下文敏感、欠规约、幻觉、打字错误），并在LEXam基准上设计小型扰动实验，模拟自诉人输入的退化。
Result: 扰动实验显示，在自诉人级别的输入下，模型性能显著下降，表明当前基准的上限评估掩盖了实际部署中的差距。
Conclusion: 呼吁法律AI基准直接测量对自诉人输入的鲁棒性，使司法可及性声明可经验检验。

papers.title: Random coloured digraphs defined by a Markov logic network
papers.abstract_en: A Markov Logic Network (MLN) is a probabilistic relational model used in Statistical Relational Artificial Intelligence for defining a probability distribution on the set of possible worlds with domain $D$ for an arbitrary finite domain $D$. An MLN consists of soft constraints with associated weights which are nonnegative real numbers. In this study we consider a language speaking about a property $P(x)$ and a relation $R(x, y)$. We consider an MLN for which every Boolean combination of $P(x)$ and $R(x, y)$ is a soft constraint (with associated weight). Let $n$ denote the size (cardinality) of the domain. We show that, for every choice of weights, if the weights are scaled by $1/n$ then, for every first-order sentence $\varphi$, the probability that $\varphi$ holds tends to either 0 or 1 as $n \to \infty$; that is, a 0-1 law for first-order logic holds. Morover, the limit probability does {\em not} depend on the weights. If we instead use the standard semantics of MLNs, in the case of which the weights are {\em not} scaled, then the limit behaviour is more complicated and {\em depends} on the weights. With unscaled weights we get 7 qualitatively different cases which depend on the weights. In some cases we have a 0-1 law for first-order logic, in some cases not, but we may still have a convergence law. The influence of the weights on the asymptotic probability of a first-order sentence may be in the form of a sudden ``phase transition'' from one of the 7 cases to another. The presence of a convergence law has positive implications for inference on large domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了由马尔可夫逻辑网络（MLN）定义的随机有色有向图的极限性质。当权重按1/n缩放时，一阶逻辑的0-1律成立且极限概率与权重无关；当权重不缩放时，存在7种依赖于权重的定性不同的情形，包括相变现象。
Motivation: MLN是统计关系AI中的概率关系模型，其渐近行为对大规模域上的推理有重要影响，但此前对MLN定义随机结构的一阶逻辑极限性质研究不足。
Method: 考虑仅含一元谓词P和二元关系R的语言，每个布尔组合作为软约束并赋予权重，分析当域大小n→∞时，一阶语句的概率极限行为，分别处理权重缩放与不缩放两种情况。
Result: 权重按1/n缩放时，一阶逻辑0-1律成立且极限概率与权重无关；权重不缩放时，得到7种依赖于权重的定性情形，某些情形有0-1律，某些仅有收敛律，且存在相变。
Conclusion: 结论强调收敛律的存在对大规模域推理有积极意义，且权重选择会根本改变极限行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Audio-visual Contrastive Alignment for Diffusion-based Visual-conditioned Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual speech enhancement (AVSE) exploits visual cues such as lip movements to recover speech in noisy environments. Recent work introduced diffusion-based unsupervised AVSE, where a speech diffusion model conditioned on visual features via cross-attention is trained and used as a data-driven prior for posterior sampling-based speech enhancement. Despite promising performance over its audio-only counterpart, the impact of explicitly enforcing cross-modal alignment in the fusion remains unclear. In this work, we propose to augment the diffusion training objective with a contrastive audio-visual loss to encourage stronger use of visual information while keeping the posterior sampling framework unchanged. Experiments across matched and mismatched test data show consistent improvements in interference suppression, signal reconstruction, and perceptual quality, with the largest gains at low SNRs. Code is available at https://github.com/ cexauce/AV-CA-DiffUSE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于扩散的无监督音频-视觉语音增强（AVSE），提出在扩散训练目标中增加对比性音频-视觉损失，以显式促进跨模态对齐，而无需改变后验采样框架。实验表明，该方法在匹配与不匹配测试数据上均能提升干扰抑制、信号重建和感知质量，尤其在低信噪比下增益最大。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的AVSE方法虽优于纯音频版本，但跨模态对齐的作用尚不明确；未显式鼓励融合中视觉信息的利用。
Method: 在扩散训练损失中引入对比性音频-视觉损失，通过拉近配对音频-视觉特征、推远非配对特征来强化视觉信息利用，保持后验采样框架不变。
Result: 在匹配与不匹配测试数据上，干扰抑制、信号重建和感知质量均有一致改进，低SNR下增益最大。
Conclusion: 对比性跨模态对齐能有效提升扩散AVSE的性能，且无需修改后验采样流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Self-Evolution-Ready Workflow Harnesses: A Reversible Migration Path and Convertibility Taxonomy for Expert LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: While expert-validated "LLM + script" workflows deliver significant value, they remain static: they encode hard-won domain knowledge yet fail to adapt execution based on feedback. Existing agent research predominantly targets greenfield agents and synthetic benchmarks, leaving the migration of active legacy workflows unresolved. To bridge this gap, we present a reversible, Strangler-Fig migration path that refactors legacy workflows into composable, typed, and auditable stages. Central to this framework is a three-tier convertibility taxonomy (A/B/C), implemented as a routing stage within the system harness, which diagnoses a workflow's readiness and routes it accordingly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 Strangler-Fig 模式的可逆迁移路径，用于将现有的专家验证过的 LLM+脚本工作流重构为可组合、类型化且可审计的阶段。核心是一个三层可转换性分类（A/B/C），通过系统 harness 中的路由阶段诊断工作流的就绪状态并相应路由。
Motivation: 现有的专家 LLM 工作流虽是静态的，但编码了宝贵领域知识，却无法根据反馈调整执行。当前的智能体研究主要针对绿色field智能体和合成基准，遗留工作流的迁移问题未解决。
Method: 提出可逆的 Strangler-Fig 迁移路径，将遗留工作流重构为可组合、类型化、可审计的阶段，并引入三层可转换性分类（A/B/C）作为路由阶段。
Result: 摘要中未报告具体实验结果，主要贡献是框架和分类法。
Conclusion: 该框架为遗留 LLM 工作流向自适应系统迁移提供了可逆路径，但未涉及具体应用领域如降水预报。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WiFi-Based People Counting Using Beam-Steerable Antennas: A Test-bed Study
papers.abstract_en: Ubiquitous perception through RF signals is a pivotal opportunity for future technology: it enables personalized services such as smart living, remote healthcare, automated logistics or interaction through free-space gestures. The ubiquity of Wi-Fi and cellular networks presents a promising platform for the development of innovative sensing tools. Future standards will also introduce dedicated sensing features which, for example, will allow routers to work as frequency modulated continuous wave radios targeting radar applications. Most of the current chip designs support ad-hoc firmware for CSI extraction with MIMO arrangements of the transmitter (TX) and receiver (RX) antennas and OFDM subcarriers. The CSI describes the phase shift and amplitude attenuation of multiple propagation paths on each subcarrier. The latest IEEE 802.11be standard (Wi-Fi 7) offers a wider subcarrier bandwidth of 160MHz (up to 320MHz), providing at least 120 usable pilot subcarriers for CSI or CIR estimation. Additionally, Wi-Fi signals have been recently exploited to track daily human movements and behaviors, while Wi-Fi signal variations have been shown to differ between different people and can consequently be used for their re-identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对WiFi人体计数问题，利用波束可控天线（beam-steerable antennas）构建测试床（test-bed），研究基于信道状态信息（CSI）的感知能力。摘要综述了WiFi感知的机遇，并指出最新IEEE 802.11be标准（Wi-Fi 7）提供更宽子载波带宽，有助于CSI估计。论文通过实验展示了WiFi信号变化可用于人体计数和身份再识别。
Motivation: WiFi感知的普遍性是未来技术的关键驱动力，但现有研究多基于固定天线配置，波束可控天线在人体计数中的潜力尚未充分探索。
Method: 搭建基于波束可控天线的WiFi测试床，利用CSI提取多径传播信息，通过信号变化分析实现人体计数。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，仅声称WiFi信号变化能区分不同个体并用于再识别。
Conclusion: WiFi感知（尤其是波束可控天线结合宽带宽）有望实现低成本、非侵入式的人体计数和身份识别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coordinate-Queryable Neural Field Reconstruction for EEG Spatial Super-Resolution with Unseen-Electrode Generation
papers.abstract_en: EEG spatial super-resolution (EEGSR) in real deployments is challenged by random channel missingness, unstable electrode quality, and changing visible-channel patterns caused by bad contacts or device variability. Most existing EEGSR methods learn a fixed low-to-high channel mapping under pre-defined input-output layouts, which makes them brittle when missing channels vary at test time. In this paper, we reformulate EEGSR as learning a shared conditional scalp field from partially observed support channels. Specifically, a position-guided encoder summarizes the observed EEG channels and their coordinates into a latent condition, and a conditional implicit neural representation decoder reconstructs target EEG signals by querying this condition at desired electrode coordinates. During inference, the model directly reconstructs unseen electrode signals from the available EEG support and the queried coordinates. To strengthen the constraint of the encoded latent representation on the decoder and thereby construct a more stable scalp field consistent with the observed channels, we further introduce a fidelity-preserving channel corruption training strategy under mixed electrode states. Extensive experiments across multiple EEG datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework for both random missing-channel reconstruction and strict unseen-electrode signal generation. Notably, under the strict held-out-electrode setting on AAD, our method reduces NMSE by 37.5\% and improves SNR by 2.12 dB over the strongest baseline, showing its ability to synthesize signals at electrode locations never exposed during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新定义了EEG空间超分辨率任务，提出一种坐标可查询的神经场重建框架，通过学习从部分观测通道到完整头皮电位的条件隐式神经表示，实现任意电极位置的信号重建。实验表明，该方法在随机缺失通道重建和严格未见过电极生成任务上均优于现有方法，在AAD数据集上NMSE降低37.5%，SNR提升2.12 dB。
Motivation: 实际部署中EEG空间超分辨率面临通道随机缺失、电极质量不稳定等挑战，现有方法依赖固定的低-高通道映射，对测试时缺失模式变化敏感。
Method: 提出位置引导编码器将观测通道及其坐标编码为隐条件，结合条件隐式神经表示解码器，通过查询目标电极坐标重建信号；并引入混合电极状态下的保真保留通道损坏训练策略以增强约束。
Result: 在多个EEG数据集上，方法在随机缺失通道重建和严格未见过电极生成任务上均有效，尤其是在AAD的严格留出电极设置下，NMSE降低37.5%，SNR提升2.12 dB。
Conclusion: 提出的框架可泛化到训练时未见的电极位置，为动态通道模式下的EEG空间超分辨率提供了有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Zero-Shot Neural Priors for Generalizable Cross-Subject and Cross-Task EEG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: The development of generalizable electroencephalography (EEG) decoding models is essential for robust brain-computer interfaces (BCI) and objective neural biomarkers in mental health. Conventional approaches have been hindered by poor cross-subject and cross-task generalization, owing to high inter-subject variability and non-stationary neural signals. We address this challenge with a zero-shot cross-subject decoding framework on the large-scale Healthy Brain Network dataset, benchmarking a convolutional neural network baseline, a hybrid LSTM, and a Transformer-based foundation model. To adapt the Transformer for regression while averting catastrophic forgetting, we propose a novel progressive unfreezing strategy. The baseline yielded an nRMSE of 0.9991, whereas our fine-tuned Transformer achieved 0.9799 on unseen subjects. This work advances scalable, calibration-free EEG decoding for computational psychiatry and behavioral prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对EEG解码中跨被试和跨任务泛化性差的问题，在大规模Healthy Brain Network数据集上提出了零样本跨被试解码框架，比较了CNN、混合LSTM和Transformer基础模型。通过提出渐进解冻策略适配Transformer进行回归并避免灾难性遗忘，在未见被试上实现了nRMSE从0.9991降至0.9799。
Motivation: 现有EEG解码模型因被试间差异大和信号非平稳，跨被试和跨任务泛化性差，限制了脑机接口和神经生物标记物的应用。
Method: 提出零样本跨被试解码框架，使用卷积神经网络基线、混合LSTM和基于Transformer的基础模型，并针对Transformer提出渐进解冻策略以避免灾难性遗忘。
Result: 基线CNN的nRMSE为0.9991，而微调后的Transformer在未见被试上达到0.9799，改善了跨被试解码性能。
Conclusion: 本文推进了可扩展、无需校准的EEG解码，适用于计算精神病学和行为预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Event-Aligned Analysis of Multi-Rater Pain Assessments Using Continuous Wearable Physiology
papers.abstract_en: Pain is assessed differently by patients, nurses, and clinicians, yet most computational approaches assume a single ground-truth label - effectively ignoring who is doing the rating. We introduce a rater-aware, event-aligned framework that converts sparse, rater-specific pain ratings into discrete pain-change events and aligns continuous wearable physiological signals to these events, preserving rater identity throughout. Applied to multimodal wearable data collected during spine-related pain procedures, the framework identifies substantial disagreement across rater groups and provides preliminary, exploratory evidence of rater-dependent physiological differences preceding reported pain increases. These findings suggest that pain-physiology relationships may not be rater-invariant, and that aggregating assessments across raters may mask meaningful physiological patterns. A rater-aware, event-aligned perspective is therefore a promising direction for interpreting wearable data in real-world clinical pain assessment.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at IEEE EMBC 2026 (Toronto, Canada, July 26-30, 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向多评价者疼痛评估的事件对齐分析框架，将稀疏的、评价者特定的疼痛评分转换为离散的疼痛变化事件，并将连续的可穿戴生理信号与这些事件对齐，保留评价者身份。应用于脊柱相关疼痛过程中的多模态可穿戴数据，发现不同评价者组之间存在显著不一致，并初步证据表明在报告疼痛增加前存在评价者依赖的生理差异。
Motivation: 现有计算疼痛评估方法通常假设单一真实标签，忽略了不同评价者（患者、护士、临床医生）之间的差异。需要一种能够保留评价者身份的方法来探索疼痛-生理关系是否因评价者而异。
Method: 提出一个评价者感知的、事件对齐的框架，将稀疏评价者特定评分转化为离散疼痛变化事件，并将连续可穿戴生理信号对齐到这些事件，保留评价者身份。应用于脊柱相关疼痛手术中的多模态可穿戴数据。
Result: 框架识别出评价者组之间存在显著不一致，并提供初步探索性证据表明在报告疼痛增加前存在评价者依赖的生理差异。
Conclusion: 疼痛-生理关系可能不是评价者不变的，跨评价者汇总评估可能掩盖有意义的生理模式。评价者感知的事件对齐视角是解释真实世界临床疼痛评估中可穿戴数据的有希望方向。

papers.title: AI Tokenomics: The Economics of Tokens, Computation, and Pricing in Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tokens have become the practical accounting unit for modern foundation model services, linking information processing, computation, memory use, energy expenditure, pricing, and economic value. This paper develops a framework for AI tokenomics: the study of how tokens are generated, consumed, priced, allocated, and optimized across AI systems. We connect token-level technical costs to workflow-level production functions, enterprise resource allocation, measurement and instrumentation methods, and emerging market-design questions. The framework shows that token expenditure and economic value are distinct: value depends on marginal productivity, workflow position, hidden reasoning activity, risk, and downstream propagation effects. The paper concludes by identifying open research directions in hidden-token measurement, empirical calibration, token productivity, dynamic allocation, and token-based markets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AI令牌经济学（AI Tokenomics）框架，将令牌层面的技术成本与工作流生产函数、企业资源分配、测量工具和市场设计联系起来。框架强调令牌支出与经济价值不同，价值取决于边际生产率、工作流位置、隐藏推理活动和下游传播效应。
Motivation: 现有AI服务中令牌作为实际会计单位，但缺乏统一的经济框架来理解令牌的生成、消耗、定价、分配和优化问题。
Method: 建立令牌经济学框架，连接令牌级技术成本与工作流级生产函数，并引入隐藏令牌测量、经验校准、令牌生产率和动态分配等概念。
Result: 框架表明令牌支出与经济价值不同，价值取决于边际生产率、工作流位置、隐藏推理活动、风险及下游传播效应。
Conclusion: 论文指出开放研究方向包括隐藏令牌测量、经验校准、令牌生产率、动态分配和基于令牌的市场。

papers.title: Heterogeneous 2D/1D Signal Representation Fusion for Underwater Acoustic Modulation Recognition Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Modulation recognition systems rely on heterogeneous signal representations. 2D signal-image modalities such as time-frequency and cyclostationary maps capture structural patterns, while 1D statistical descriptors such as higher-order power spectra encode complementary cues. Under distribution shift, these modalities degrade unevenly, making robust fusion a central challenge for practical deployment. Progress is further limited by the lack of a unified evaluation protocol that systematically separates different shift types. This paper addresses both challenges through a joint benchmark-and-model study in underwater acoustic modulation recognition. UAMR-ShiftBench is the first benchmark to jointly cover in-distribution, low-SNR, unseen-environment, unseen-communication-parameter, and measured sea-trial evaluation under a single matched protocol, with two independent real-world subsets collected during two sea-trial campaigns conducted in March and November in the South China Sea. SCP-TriCA fuses STFT, cyclostationary, and P2/P4 (second- and fourth-order power spectra) modalities hierarchically: the two 2D modalities are first aligned through bidirectional cross-attention, and the 1D statistical modality is then incorporated through a sample-adaptive selective gate. On UAMR-ShiftBench, SCP-TriCA achieves 95.33% in-distribution accuracy and 74.59% simulated OOD average, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.12 percentage points, and reaches 91.14% and 94.86% on the two sea-trial subsets, exceeding the best baseline by 15.71 and 23.00 percentage points respectively. Ablation results confirm that the gains stem from modality complementarity and the hierarchical fusion design. Code and models are available at https://github.com/ronglaiqian/UAMR-ShiftBench.

TL;DR: 本文针对水下声学调制识别在分布偏移下模态融合不鲁棒的问题，提出了统一的基准测试UAMR-ShiftBench和层次化融合方法SCP-TriCA。该方法通过双向交叉注意力对齐2D时频图和循环平稳图，再通过自适应门融合1D功率谱特征。在仿真和真实海试数据上均显著优于基线，验证了模态互补性和融合设计的有效性。
Motivation: 现有水下声学调制识别系统依赖异质信号表示，但不同模态在分布偏移下退化不均，且缺乏统一评估协议来分离不同偏移类型。
Method: 提出UAMR-ShiftBench基准，涵盖分布内、低信噪比、未见环境、未见通信参数和实测海试五种场景。同时提出SCP-TriCA融合框架：先以双向交叉注意力对齐STFT和循环平稳图，再通过样本自适应选择门引入P2/P4功率谱。
Result: 在UAMR-ShiftBench上，SCP-TriCA达到分布内准确率95.33%、模拟OOD平均74.59%，分别领先最强基线5.12个百分点；在两个海试子集上准确率91.14%和94.86%，领先基线15.71和23.00个百分点。
Conclusion: 消融实验表明性能提升源于模态互补性和层次化融合设计。该工作提供了统一基准和有效融合方法，有利于实际部署中的鲁棒调制识别。

papers.title: Evaluating LLM Usage for Efficient and Explainable Numerical and Classified Implicit Sentiment Analysis of Product Desirability
papers.abstract_en: Qualitative product feedback can reveal nuanced user experiences, but its implicit sentiment is difficult to measure. This paper presents a scalable and interpretable framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to quantify product desirability from such data. Using two Product Desirability Toolkit (PDT) datasets from ZORQ and CARMA comprising 106 respondent term groupings with gold-standard human annotation, zero-shot continuous numerical sentiment scoring and categorical sentiment classification are evaluated without relying on explicit review scores. Across the datasets, LLMs generated numerical sentiment scores directly from qualitative responses and closely matched expert labels, achieving Pearson correlations up to 0.97 and classification accuracy up to 94%. LLMs maintained robustness even when handling data presented in multiple forms and consistently expressed high confidence. In contrast, lexicon-based and transformer baselines did not produce statistically significant results. Among the models tested, GPT-4o-mini achieved performance comparable to larger models at 94% lower cost, supporting scalable deployment. The framework also incorporates model confidence ratings and human-readable rationale explanations (xAI), improving interpretability, transparency, and trust while supporting practical use in product satisfaction assessment. In general, using the PDT tool as a survey method along with a cost efficient LLM for sentiment analysis has the potential to provide for product evaluation with results that are rich in terms of sentiment scores (both numerical and classified sentiment) and in terms of the high-level user impressions of the product that can be used to identify ideas for product development and improvement, as well as marketing ideas for target audiences.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可扩展且可解释的框架，利用大语言模型（LLMs）对定性产品反馈进行隐式情感分析，量化产品期望。在ZORQ和CARMA两个产品期望工具包数据集上，零样本数值情感评分与专家标签的Pearson相关系数高达0.97，分类准确率达94%。LLM即使在多种形式的数据下也保持鲁棒性，而词库和Transformer基线未产生统计显著结果。GPT-4o-mini以较低成本达到与更大模型相当的性能，并提供了模型置信度和可解释性理由。
Motivation: 定性产品反馈包含微妙的用户体验，但其隐式情感难以量化。现有方法依赖显式评分，无法充分利用定性文本中的信息。
Method: 提出一个框架，使用大语言模型进行零样本连续数值情感评分和分类情感分类，并集成模型置信度评级和人类可读的理性解释（xAI）。
Result: 在PDT数据集上，LLM生成的数值情感评分与专家标签的Pearson相关性高达0.97，分类准确率94%。GPT-4o-mini以94%的低成本达到与更大模型相近的性能。词库和Transformer基线未产生统计显著结果。
Conclusion: 使用PDT工具作为调查方法并结合经济高效的LLM进行情感分析，可以为产品评估提供丰富的数值和分类情感分数以及高层次的用户印象，支持产品开发和营销。

papers.title: Self-Recognition Finetuning can Prevent and Reverse Emergent Misalignment
papers.abstract_en: Emergent misalignment (EM) has been linked to the activation of misaligned persona vectors and evil character traits, suggesting that EM operates through disruption of the model's aligned character rather than direct learning of harmful content. Motivated by this connection, we study self-generated text recognition (SGTR) finetuning as a character-targeted intervention that is distinct from existing in-training defenses. We conduct two-stage finetuning experiments across three models (GPT-4.1, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct) and multiple EM datasets to compare SGTR finetuning against benign finetuning baselines (correct domain-specific data, general knowledge, and word counting) to find it an effective defense in both reversal and prevention settings. We find that all interventions produce comparable EM reversal, but only when restoring capabilities that EM had degraded. For prevention, only SGTR finetuning consistently reduces misalignment without exacerbating any individual metric, suggesting that character fortification specifically drives prevention. We provide further evidence for EM's relation to the LLM's default character by showing that EM finetuning induces diversity into the LLM's identity self-reports, artificially corrupting self-recognition exacerbates misalignment caused by EM finetuning, and that removing the model's identity-bearing system prompt substantially reduces the effect of EM finetuning. Together, these findings reframe EM not as the adoption of a coherent misaligned persona but as the destabilization of aligned character.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型中的突现失调现象，发现其机制是破坏模型的对齐角色而非直接学习有害内容。提出自生成文本识别（SGTR）微调作为一种面向角色的干预方法，在GPT-4.1、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct等模型上实验，证明SGTR在逆转和预防失调方面有效，而其他干预仅在逆转上有效。进一步实验表明突现失调与模型默认角色相关。
Motivation: 现有研究将突现失调归因于激活失调角色向量和邪恶特质，但缺乏针对模型对齐角色的干预方法。本文旨在探索一种面向角色的防御策略。
Method: 采用两阶段微调实验，在多个模型和失调数据集上比较自生成文本识别（SGTR）微调与良性微调基线（正确领域数据、通用知识、单词计数）的效果。
Result: 所有干预都能逆转失调，但仅SGTR微调能持续预防失调而不恶化其他指标。此外，失调微调会降低模型自识别的多样性，人为破坏自识别会加剧失调，移除身份系统提示会减弱失调效果。
Conclusion: 突现失调的本质是模型对齐角色的不稳定，而非采用连贯的失调角色；SGTR微调通过强化角色实现预防效果。

papers.title: A Geometry-Informed Computer Vision Method for Detecting and Examining Overtaking Vehicles From A Bicycle
papers.abstract_en: Instrumented bicycle studies have produced direct field evidence on vehicle passing behavior, but extracting overtaking events from continuous rear-facing video has remained dependent on manual, frame-by-frame annotation. This bottleneck constrains sample sizes and limits naturalistic cycling safety research. We present a geometry-informed computer vision pipeline that automates overtaking event detection from a single bicycle-mounted camera without multi-sensor configurations or explicit camera calibration. The system combines RT-DETR object detection with ByteTrack multi-object tracking through a three-stage geometric validation module enforcing bearing angle trend, apparent size growth, and spatial confirmation criteria derived from perspective projection principles. Validated on 315 manually annotated real-world overtaking events from urban roads in Ann Arbor, Michigan, the pipeline achieved 97.8% recall with zero false positives. The system identified overtaking intentions a mean of 2.44 seconds before vehicle passage, with 84.1% of events exceeding the 1.5-second human reaction time threshold, demonstrating feasibility for active cyclist warning. Lateral passing distance measurements from 96 events revealed 33.3% of passes below the 5-foot (152.4 cm) threshold, consistent with non-compliance rates in prior field and self-reported studies. A preliminary calibration-free lateral distance estimation approach using bounding box geometric features achieved mean absolute errors of 13-14 cm under leave-one-out cross-validation, sufficient to distinguish close passes from standard passes for safety categorization. By automating event isolation from consumer-grade footage, the system removes the primary annotation bottleneck of instrumented bicycle research and provides a scalable foundation for vehicle-bicycle interaction analysis across larger datasets and diverse urban environments.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于几何信息的计算机视觉方法，利用单台自行车安装摄像头自动检测超车事件，无需多传感器或显式标定。系统结合RT-DETR目标检测和ByteTrack多目标跟踪，通过三个几何验证模块（方位角趋势、视大小增长、空间确认）实现97.8%召回率和零误报，平均在超车前2.44秒识别意图。横向距离估计误差13-14厘米，可区分近距超车。该自动化方法消除了传统人工标注瓶颈，为大规模自行车安全研究提供可扩展基础。
Motivation: 仪器化自行车研究中从后视视频提取超车事件依赖人工逐帧标注，严重限制样本量，阻碍自然骑行安全研究。
Method: 提出几何信息计算机视觉流水线：使用RT-DETR进行目标检测，ByteTrack进行多目标跟踪，结合三阶段几何验证模块（方位角趋势、视大小增长、空间确认），并基于透视投影原理设计规则。横向距离估计利用边界框几何特征进行无标定近似。
Result: 在密歇根州安娜堡真实道路315个标注事件上达到97.8%召回率和零误报；平均提前2.44秒识别超车意图，84.1%事件超过1.5秒人类反应阈值；96个事件中33.3%的横向距离低于5英尺（152.4厘米）安全阈值；横向距离估计平均绝对误差13-14厘米。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种基于几何信息的计算机视觉方法，利用单台自行车安装摄像头自动检测超车事件，无需多传感器或显式标定。系统结合RT-DETR目标检测和ByteTrack多目标跟踪，通过三个几何验证模块（方位角趋势、视大小增长、空间确认）实现97.8%召回率和零误报，平均在超车前2.44秒识别意图。横向距离估计误差13-14厘米，可区分近距超车。该自动化方法消除了传统人工标注瓶颈，为大规模自行车安全研究提供可扩展基础。
summary_sections.motivation: 仪器化自行车研究中从后视视频提取超车事件依赖人工逐帧标注，严重限制样本量，阻碍自然骑行安全研究。

papers.title: Harmonic: Hierarchical State Space Models for Efficient Long-Context Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We present Harmonic, a hierarchical state space model (SSM) for language modeling. The architecture stacks three recurrent levels at progressively slower timescales; each level receives the prediction error of the level below as input, rather than its raw hidden state. On enwiki8 with equal token budgets, Harmonic outperforms a comparable Transformer (28M params) by +1.4% at 1K tokens, +6.7% at 8K tokens, and +11.4% at 32K tokens (bpt, lower is better). It also outperforms Mamba at every tested length by 0.7--1.8%. At 64K tokens, both Mamba and Transformer run out of memory on an 80GB H100; Harmonic trains successfully, reaching 6.169 bpt. Results replicate on WikiText-103 (H-TF gap +1.7% to +7.2% across 1K--32K). At 1B parameter scale, replacing all attention layers in TinyLlama 1.1B with HarmonicBlock eliminates the RoPE positional encoding limit: the resulting Hallamonic model maintains stable loss across sequence lengths 1K--8K on two independent clean benchmarks (Lambada and fineweb-edu held-out), while TinyLlama degrades catastrophically past its 2K-token RoPE limit (gap: +9.4 bpt at seq=8K on Lambada). Compute is O(L) per forward pass vs. O(L^2) for attention. Logs: https://github.com/Omibranch/harmonic-logs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Harmonic，一种层次状态空间模型（SSM）用于语言建模。架构堆叠三个递归层级，每层接收下一层的预测误差作为输入。在enwiki8上，相同token预算下，Harmonic优于Transformer和Mamba，尤其在长序列上提升显著（32K tokens时比Transformer好11.4%）。在1B参数规模，替换TinyLlama的注意力层为HarmonicBlock后，模型在1K-8K序列长度上保持稳定损失，而TinyLlama超过2K位置编码限制后性能崩溃。计算复杂度为O(L)。
Motivation: 传统Transformer在长上下文语言建模中受限于二次计算复杂度和位置编码（如RoPE）的有效长度限制，导致无法高效处理超长序列。
Method: 提出层次SSM Harmonic，包含三个递归层级，每个层级以更慢的时间尺度运行，并接收下一层预测误差作为输入，而非原始隐藏状态，从而实现对长距离依赖的高效建模。
Result: 在enwiki8上，Harmonic（28M参数）在1K、8K、32K tokens上分别比可比Transformer好1.4%、6.7%、11.4%，比Mamba好0.7-1.8%；在64K tokens时，仅Harmonic能成功训练（6.169 bpt）。在WikiText-103上结果类似。1B规模时，Hallamonic模型（HarmonicBlock替换注意力）在1K-8K序列上保持稳定损失，而TinyLlama在8K时损失增加9.4 bpt。
Conclusion: 层次SSM Harmonic在长上下文语言建模中优于Transformer和Mamba，能处理更长的序列且无位置编码限制，同时保持线性计算复杂度。

papers.title: Reentrant value fields as delayed coupled reaction-diffusion systems on finite graphs
papers.abstract_en: We describe a dynamical system in which a symbolic field is coupled to a geometric field via a bipartite Hilbert-Schmidt kernel. The system is fully described by a retarded functional differential equation (RFDE) on the history space, subject to Lipschitz and small gain conditions. We show that the RFDE is well-posed under constant input and that it admits a compact global attractor. The principal subsystem $(H_L, X_R, P)$, which is comprised of the two primary fields as well as an executive field, is shown to be globally stable independent of delay, provided that the interfield coupling satisfies $C_{\mathcal{K}}^2<μ_Lμ_R$. In addition, we describe design specifications that fulfill the hypotheses of the main Theorem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种动力系统，其中符号场通过双边Hilbert-Schmidt核与几何场耦合，系统由延迟泛函微分方程（RFDE）描述。作者证明了在常数输入下系统适定，存在紧全局吸引子，并在耦合强度满足C_K^2<μ_Lμ_R时全局稳定且与延迟无关。同时给出了满足主要定理假设的设计规范。
Motivation: 研究符号场与几何场耦合的延迟反应扩散系统的动力学行为，并给出稳定性条件。
Method: 通过双边Hilbert-Schmidt核将符号场与几何场耦合，用延迟泛函微分方程（RFDE）在历史空间上描述系统，并施加Lipschitz和小增益条件。
Result: 证明系统在常数输入下适定，存在紧全局吸引子；当耦合强度满足C_K^2<μ_Lμ_R时，主子系统(H_L, X_R, P)全局稳定且独立于延迟。
Conclusion: 给出了保证系统全局稳定性的耦合条件，并描述了满足定理假设的设计规范。

papers.title: Context-Aware Prediction of Student Quiz Performance with Multimodal Textbook Features
papers.abstract_en: Educational platforms often predict student performance from prior interactions, but the assessment content itself also varies in linguistic and visual complexity. This paper studies whether lightweight content features extracted from CourseKata chapter-review questions improve prediction of end-of-chapter quiz scores beyond a student's average prior exercise performance. The study combines 2023 CourseKata student response data with chapter-level text features from review-question wording and image features from textbook visuals. Across 4,742 student-chapter observations from 562 class-student IDs, adding content features improves student-grouped five-fold quiz prediction performance by 9.1% relative to a prior-performance baseline. In leave-chapter-out validation, text features reduce prediction error relative to the baseline, while image-containing models have higher error. This paper suggests that a context-aware model adds useful signal about the text and visual features of questions to better predict student quiz performance compared with using past student performance alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在预测学生章节测验成绩时，除了学生的历史答题表现，加入练习题的文本特征和教材图像特征是否能提升预测效果。使用CourseKata平台的数据，包含4,742个学生-章节观测值，发现加入内容特征后，学生分组的五折交叉验证预测性能相对提升9.1%，但留章验证中图像特征反而增加误差。
Motivation: 现有学生成绩预测主要依赖历史交互数据，忽略了测验题目本身的文本和视觉复杂度差异对成绩的影响。
Method: 将CourseKata章节复习题的文本特征和教材图像特征作为额外输入，结合学生历史平均练习成绩，构建上下文感知的预测模型。
Result: 加入内容特征后，学生分组的五折交叉验证预测性能相对基线提升9.1%；留章验证中文本特征降低误差，但包含图像特征的模型误差更高。
Conclusion: 上下文感知模型能利用题目的文本和视觉特征提供有用信号，比仅用历史成绩更好地预测学生测验表现。图像特征在跨章泛化时可能引入噪声。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FP8 is All You Need (Part 2): Efficient Ozaki-Bailey Style FFT Through Tensor-core Garner Reformulation and Kulisch Escape Route
papers.abstract_en: NVIDIA's Blackwell Ultra (B300) cuts FP64 vector throughput to ~1.3 TFLOPS per GPU, roughly 30x below B200 and well below the level at which bandwidth-limited FP64 workloads stay memory-bound. The Ozaki Scheme II framework recovers FP64-equivalent throughput by routing dense matrix multiply through FP8 tensor cores with a mantissa-sliced Chinese-remainder reconstruction. A companion Part (1) paper covers dense GEMM, batched GEMV, stencils, and SpMV; this paper adds the fifth canonical primitive, the 3-D FFT. We present Ozaki-Bailey FFT, an emulated 3-D FFT via the Bailey six-step decomposition with both 1-D FFT GEMMs on FP8 tensor cores. Bailey's small inner factor k ~ sqrt(N) (k=32 for N=1024) puts the kernel in the regime k << r^2, where the third TME parameter gamma (reconstruction latency) binds rather than amortising. Garner reconstruction splits into Phase A (inner products on FP8/INT8 tensor cores, ~1 ms for 1024^3 on B300) and Phase B (per-output reduction). We identify Kulisch fixed-point complete arithmetic as a Phase B reformulation that keeps full FP64 accuracy while running entirely on the INT32 SIMT pipe. We derive closed-form bandwidth-parity floors. The native FP64 floor is 1.56*B_HBM (12.5 TF at 8 TB/s): B300's 1.3 TF sits ~10x below, Rubin's 33 TF within 4%. The Kulisch escape route needs an INT32 sub-floor 8.25*B_HBM and an FP8 floor 170*B_HBM; B300 meets both. The projection is ~18 ms for 1024^3 at full FP64, essentially the 12.9 ms memory roof. A GPU meets memory-roof FFT parity if it satisfies either the native floor or both Kulisch floors. If the projection holds in practice, B300 becomes viable for full-FP64 FFT through software alone, motivating a libKulisch library and benchmark campaign.
papers.comment: There is an accompanying Part (1) paper also submitted to arXiv:2606.06510
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是Ozaki-Bailey FFT的FP8实现，通过Garner重构和Kulisch逃逸路径，在NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra (B300) GPU上利用FP8张量核仿真FP64精度的3-D FFT，预计1024^3 FFT耗时约18 ms，接近内存带宽天花板。
Motivation: B300的FP64吞吐量降至约1.3 TFLOPS，远低于B200，传统FP64计算受限；需要利用FP8张量核恢复全精度FFT性能。
Method: 基于Bailey六步分解，将1-D FFT映射到FP8张量核上的GEMM；采用Garner重构分为Phase A (FP8/INT8内积)和Phase B (Kulisch定点算术在INT32 SIMT流水线上全精度归约)。
Result: 推导了FP64、INT32和FP8的带宽匹配下限；B300满足Kulisch逃逸路径条件；面向1024^3的FFT预计约18 ms，几乎达到内存带宽天花板12.9 ms。
Conclusion: B300可通过纯软件方法实现全FP64精度的FFT，建议开发libKulisch库并进行基准测试以验证实际可行性。

papers.title: SemChunk-C: Semantic Segmentation for C Code
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation of code written in a C-family language remains a challenging problem, due to the language's complex syntax, macro expansion, and irregular structural patterns. Existing chunking methods, such as fixed-sized windows, heuristic splitting, and syntax-based tools, often fail to capture meaningful functional units, limiting the efficacy of retrieval and other downstream LLM driven tasks. In this paper, we address the problem of chunking in C-related languages. First, we define a set of code chunk categories. Second, we train an LLM-based classifier to a) identify chunk boundaries, and b) assign each chunk a descriptive functional attribute (a category), which can be useful for downstream tasks. By leveraging the LLM's ability to capture semantic context within the code, we assume flexible chunk boundaries, allowing to adapt to the specific structure and context of each instance. Third, we introduce SemChunk-C, a family of lightweight language models for semantic chunking of C-related files (.c, .cpp, .h, .cs, etc.). These models are based on the first four Ettin encoders [1] with 17M, 32M, 68M, and 150M parameters. Despite their relatively small size, they are capable of identifying cohesive code units, such as data structures, interface blocks, and other components. Furthermore, we demonstrate the robustness of our approach on real-world code, including challenging constructs such as nested definitions and macros. We test our approach on various datasets, and show that it achieves high boundary accuracy and semantic coherence, matching or outperforming chunkers that are based on much larger code-oriented LLMs. We also validate the improved performance of the downstream tasks on a few curated benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对C语言代码的语义分割问题，定义了代码块类别并训练了基于LLM的分类器来识别块边界并分配功能属性。提出SemChunk-C系列轻量级模型（17M-150M参数），在真实代码上展示了高边界准确性和语义连贯性。
Motivation: 现有分块方法（固定窗口、启发式分割、语法工具）无法捕捉有意义的代码功能单元，限制了LLM驱动的检索等下游任务的效果。
Method: 首先定义代码块类别，然后训练基于LLM的分类器同时识别块边界和分配功能描述属性。基于Ettin编码器前四层构建SemChunk-C系列轻量级模型。
Result: 在多个数据集上测试，SemChunk-C在边界准确性和语义连贯性上达到或超越基于更大代码LLM的分块器，并改进了下游任务性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在真实代码（包括嵌套定义和宏）上的鲁棒性，以及小模型能够实现高性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantifying Prior Dominance in RAG Systems
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds Large Language Models in external knowledge, yet current evaluations rely on discrete heuristics that suffer from ''epistemic blindness'' - failing to distinguish genuine contextual information extraction from parametric memory recall. To address this, we introduce the Normalized Context Utilization (NCU) metric, leveraging continuous token log-probabilities across zero-shot, oracle, and adversarial conditions to strictly quantify contextual information gain. Evaluating architectures ranging from 1.5B to 72B parameters alongside a proprietary commercial API reveals that for strict factual extraction (without Chain-of-Thought reasoning), traditional scaling laws exhibit extreme diminishing returns: highly efficient Small Language Models (SLMs) match or outperform high-capacity architectures. Furthermore, we demonstrate that ``Prior Dominance'' correlates with model scale and proprietary alignments. The evaluated commercial API not only overrode explicit external evidence in nearly half of adversarial conflicts, but also frequently suffered from systemic confidence collapse (Negative Transfer) when its parametric priors were contradicted. Our findings highlight the structural epistemic advantage and superior contextual adherence of SLMs in strict extraction workflows.

papers.title: Beyond the Autoregressive Horizon: A Comprehensive Survey of Diffusion Models, World Modelling, and State Space Models for Code
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) language models have driven significant progress in automated software engineering, enabling powerful code generation and assistance systems. However, the next-token prediction paradigm introduces structural limitations for code reasoning, including restricted global planning, challenges in maintaining long-range dependencies, and limited grounding in program execution semantics. Noting the heavy skewness of existing literature towards AR models, we discuss emerging paradigms that could potentially overcome the logic and scaling bottlenecks of next-token prediction by unlocking next-generation architectural capabilities for code intelligence. Specifically, we discuss the potential of Diffusion Models, which generate code via holistic denoising that captures long-range syntactic constraints often missed by AR models. We also discuss Code World Models (CWMs), which simulate execution states to support reasoning, and State Space Models (SSMs), which provide linear-time efficiency for massive contexts. By connecting these developments with findings from cognitive neuroscience, we outline directions for developing "System 2" code generation agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了非自回归范式在代码智能中的潜力，重点探讨扩散模型、代码世界模型（CWM）和状态空间模型（SSM）如何克服自回归模型在全局规划、长程依赖和执行语义方面的局限，并联系认知神经科学提出“系统2”代码生成代理的方向。
Motivation: 自回归语言模型在代码生成中虽取得进展，但受限于逐词预测范式，难以进行全局规划、维护长程依赖和融入执行语义，亟需探索替代架构。
Method: 从三个新兴方向展开综述：扩散模型通过整体去噪捕捉长程句法约束；代码世界模型模拟执行状态辅助推理；状态空间模型提供线性时间效率处理大规模上下文。
Result: 论文指出这些非自回归方法有望突破自回归的逻辑和扩展瓶颈，但未提供定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁结合认知神经科学发现，发展具有“系统2”推理能力的代码生成代理，强调未来方向而非当前实证。
Relevance: 0
